<file path="AI_HANDOFF/big50/GAPMATRIX.md">
# GAPMATRIX — capability × game-integratie (BIG50)

Prioriteit uit AUTOPILOT_ROADMAP (P0 E2E > P1 UI > P3 presentatie) en
CANVAS_DIRECTION (additief, skin over data). Status = code-bewijs.

| # | Capability | Backend | Bestaande route/service | In game | Kleinste interactie | Gap / eerlijk pad |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| G1 | Research→dossier→missie | ✅ getest | `/research/queue|run-once|dossiers|/{id}/plan` | /side station (queue/run/dossier/plan) | dossier→Plan-knop | wikipedia offline → `ran:false`; geen dossier → géén Plan-knop (Fase 4-fix) |
| G2 | Oracle-advies | ✅ live bewezen | `POST /api/v1/advise` | /play + /side knop | ongewijzigd | Ollama offline → 502/UNAVAILABLE |
| G3 | Knowledge-lifecycle | ✅ getest | `/candidates`, `/support`, `/promote`, `/reject` | discovery (create) | **gekozen Fase 5: in-world Support op eigen vondst** | fact-tier eist `verified_by` |
| G4 | Quest/missie-volgen | ✅ getest | `/quests`, `/missions`, `/play/mission` | links + journey | **gekozen Fase 3: Journal (lezen + YES/tick)** | geen nieuwe backlog-tabel |
| G5 | Worker-taken | ✅ live bewezen | `/play/code-task`, claim/complete | workshop-view | ongewijzigd | worker offline → wacht-stand |
| G6 | INVENTory-lezen | ✅ (bridge nodig) | `/world/search|entity|graph` | tellingen only | later: projectdoelen uit echte `proj_`-records | `:8080` offline → UNAVAILABLE |
| G7 | Automation-drive | ✅ getest | `/automation/runs/{id}/drive` | /play workshop | ongewijzigd | geen scheduler (contract) |
| G8 | Fabricage-status | 🟠 SIMULATED | `/fab/*`, `fabrication_chain()` | chain-states bij quests | geen executie-knop | printer UNAVAILABLE; paho-mqtt ontbreekt stock |
| G9 | Camera/VLM | 🟠 file-ingest only | `/cameras/*`, inbox | geen in game | buiten scope | geen adapter → geen live |
| G10 | Herinneringen/memory | ✅ getest | `/memory`, retrieve/verify | geen in game | later: dossier→geheugen-link | embeddings vereisen Ollama-model |

## Fasering (rest, na BIG50; BIG51-status 2026-09-25)

- F1: G6 projectdoelen in Journal uit echte `proj_`-records (alleen lezen; :8080-vereiste eerlijk). — **DONE in BIG51** (`play_journal` projects-sectie + Journal-view; offline → UNAVAILABLE, leeg → eerlijk leeg).
- F2: G10 dossierkennis → memory-promote zichtbaar in game (bestaande gates). — **DONE in BIG51** (Journal kennis-sectie + station "Onthouden als mem_" + wereldsporen/zaailingen uit echte telling).
- F3: G8 werkbank toont live `fabrication_chain()` per model (read-only). — **DONE in BIG52** (werkbank in `/side`: echte keten + `mdl_`-modellen + deeplinks; alleen GET, start niets).
- F4: G7 automation-drive vanuit Journal-missie (bestaande drive-route).
- F5 (P3): Terraria-skin verdiepen (tiles/sprites) over ongewijzigde data.
- Nooit: tweede backlog/missie/task/project-database; fysieke executie
  buiten bestaande YES/fingerprint/TTL/hardware-gates.
</file>

# GAPMATRIX — capability × game-integratie (BIG50)

Prioriteit uit AUTOPILOT_ROADMAP (P0 E2E > P1 UI > P3 presentatie) en
CANVAS_DIRECTION (additief, skin over data). Status = code-bewijs.

| # | Capability | Backend | Bestaande route/service | In game | Kleinste interactie | Gap / eerlijk pad |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| G1 | Research→dossier→missie | ✅ getest | `/research/queue|run-once|dossiers|/{id}/plan` | /side station (queue/run/dossier/plan) | dossier→Plan-knop | wikipedia offline → `ran:false`; geen dossier → géén Plan-knop (Fase 4-fix) |
| G2 | Oracle-advies | ✅ live bewezen | `POST /api/v1/advise` | /play + /side knop | ongewijzigd | Ollama offline → 502/UNAVAILABLE |
| G3 | Knowledge-lifecycle | ✅ getest | `/candidates`, `/support`, `/promote`, `/reject` | discovery (create) | **gekozen Fase 5: in-world Support op eigen vondst** | fact-tier eist `verified_by` |
| G4 | Quest/missie-volgen | ✅ getest | `/quests`, `/missions`, `/play/mission` | links + journey | **gekozen Fase 3: Journal (lezen + YES/tick)** | geen nieuwe backlog-tabel |
| G5 | Worker-taken | ✅ live bewezen | `/play/code-task`, claim/complete | workshop-view | ongewijzigd | worker offline → wacht-stand |
| G6 | INVENTory-lezen | ✅ (bridge nodig) | `/world/search|entity|graph` | tellingen only | later: projectdoelen uit echte `proj_`-records | `:8080` offline → UNAVAILABLE |
| G7 | Automation-drive | ✅ getest | `/automation/runs/{id}/drive` | /play workshop | ongewijzigd | geen scheduler (contract) |
| G8 | Fabricage-status | 🟠 SIMULATED | `/fab/*`, `fabrication_chain()` | chain-states bij quests | geen executie-knop | printer UNAVAILABLE; paho-mqtt ontbreekt stock |
| G9 | Camera/VLM | 🟠 file-ingest only | `/cameras/*`, inbox | geen in game | buiten scope | geen adapter → geen live |
| G10 | Herinneringen/memory | ✅ getest | `/memory`, retrieve/verify | geen in game | later: dossier→geheugen-link | embeddings vereisen Ollama-model |

## Fasering (rest, na BIG50)

- F1: G6 projectdoelen in Journal uit echte `proj_`-records (alleen lezen; :8080-vereiste eerlijk).
- F2: G10 dossierkennis → memory-promote zichtbaar in game (bestaande gates).
- F3: G8 werkbank toont live `fabrication_chain()` per model (read-only).
- F4: G7 automation-drive vanuit Journal-missie (bestaande drive-route).
- F5 (P3): Terraria-skin verdiepen (tiles/sprites) over ongewijzigde data.
- Nooit: tweede backlog/missie/task/project-database; fysieke executie
  buiten bestaande YES/fingerprint/TTL/hardware-gates.

<file path="docs/TESTING.md">
# TESTING — snelle teststrategie (FAST / FEATURE / FULL)

Stand: 2026-10-05. Tooling: bestaande `pytest` per project, dunne
wrappers in `tools/`. Geen nieuwe infrastructuur, geen CI.

## Scopes

| Scope | Wanneer | Commando | Wat draait |
|---|---|---|---|
| **FAST** | na elke codewijziging (standaard) | `.\tools\test-fast.ps1 -Project <p> -TestPath <file> [-K naam]` | alleen direct geraakte testmodule + `-K`-filter voor één test |
| **FEATURE** | feature af / grenscontrole | `.\tools\test-feature.ps1 -Feature <naam>` | alle testfiles van die feature (mapping hieronder) |
| **FULL** | alleen expliciet of vóór milestone | `.\tools\test-full.ps1 -Project <p\|all>` | volledige per-project suite |

Directe pytest-mag ook (vanuit de projectsubdir):
`pytest tests/test_objects.py -v`, `pytest tests/test_x.py -k naam -v`.

## Feature-mapping (`test-feature.ps1`)

- `inventory-objects` → `test_objects.py`, `test_database.py`
- `inventory-search` → milestone-3x + `test_milestone_4.py`, `test_search_types_ui.py`
- `inventory-all` → `inventory/tests/`
- `missions` → `test_missions.py`, `test_big46_quest_mission.py`
- `research` → `test_research_*.py` (api/engine/extract/plan/security/transport)
- `knowledge` → `test_big32_knowledge.py`, `test_knowledge_lifecycle.py`
- `nodes-tasks` → `test_nodes.py`, `test_node_auth.py`, `test_node_client.py`, `test_dist_queue.py`, `test_desktop_agent.py`
- `vision` → `test_cameras.py`, `test_bambu_camera.py`, `test_vision_*.py`, `test_big34_camera_ecosystem.py`, `test_capture_probe.py`, `test_probe_grab.py`, `test_vision_capabilities.py`
- `fab` → `test_fab_*.py`, `test_printer3d.py`, `test_advanced_3d.py`, `test_bambu_readonly.py`
- `workshop` → `test_workshop.py`, `test_big35_workshop.py`, `test_big57_printfase.py` (incl. bibliotheek-importketen)
- `automation` → `test_big38_automation.py`, `test_controlled_writes.py`, `test_approvals_api.py`
- `game` → `test_big43/44/48` + `test_big46 t/m test_big57`, `test_canvas.py` (lezen mag; `/side` zelf is frozen)
- `solarpunk` → `test_solarpunk.py` (fase 1: read-only projectie; fase 2+ breidt uit)
- `insta360` → `test_insta360.py` (grab-runtime; alles gemockt, echte camera nooit in pytest)
- `homebase` → `test_homebase.py` (3D-pand pagina; render-only)
- `town` → `test_town.py` (fase 3+4; NPC zonder model → eerlijke noot, reflect → 409)
- `world` → `test_world_*.py` (`areas`, `observations`, `proxy`, `workspace`)
- `hermes` → `test_hermes_*.py` (`npc`, `bridge`, `all_npcs`)
- `agent` → `Mycelium/agent/tests/`

Mapping-aanpassing: voeg de nieuwe testfile toe aan de feature-lijst
in `tools/test-feature.ps1`; geen aparte lijsten elders.

## Regels

1. **Scope past bij wijziging**: FAST na elke edit, FEATURE bij
   feature-grens, FULL nooit standaard.
2. **Geen ongerelateerde suites** als verificatie van een kleine edit.
3. **Geen dubbele tests**: één testfile per gedrag; nieuwe edge →
   bestaande file uitbreiden i.p.v. nieuwe file.
4. **Geen `sleep`/willekeurige timeouts** in nieuwe tests (huidig:
   3x coordinator, 0x inventory — niet uitbreiden). Poll/wacht met
   deadline + expliciete timeout-constante.
5. **Geen externe services in unit tests**: netwerk gemockt of
   fail-closed (Ollama `:11434` down → 502/503; Wikipedia offline →
   `ran:false`). Echte calls alleen in handmatige checks.
6. **Geen echte hardware in pytest**: printer/camera-tests zijn
   gemockt en fail-closed (`PrinterUnavailable`, file-inbox +
   `UNAVAILABLE`). Echte Bambu/Insta360/Garmin-checks altijd apart
   en handmatig, nooit onderdeel van FAST/FEATURE/FULL.
7. **Duidelijke timeouts**: wrappers default 300s (FAST) / 600s
   (FEATURE); pytest-output kort (`-q --tb=short`).
8. **Tmp-DB discipline**: wrappers zetten `INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH`,
   `MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH`, `MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH` op tmp
   (`$env:TEMP`). Nooit echte `data/*.db` aanraken.
9. **Output kort en bruikbaar**: `-q --tb=short`; bij falen alleen
   de falende test + 5 regels context in het rapport.

## Voorbeelden

```powershell
# FAST: één module na een edit in inventory
.\tools\test-fast.ps1 -Project inventory -TestPath tests/test_objects.py

# FAST: één test binnen coordinator-missies
.\tools\test-feature.ps1 -Feature missions   # feature-grens
.\tools\test-fast.ps1 -Project coordinator -TestPath tests/test_missions.py -K test_approve

# FULL: alleen op verzoek / voor milestone
.\tools\test-full.ps1 -Project inventory
```

## Bekende quirks (niet "fixen" via infra)

- Inventory-tests zetten `INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH` direct
  (`os.environ`, geen `monkeypatch`) → lekkage tussen tests in één
  proces; wrappers isoleren via tmp-pad per run.
- Coordinator-tests bouwen `TestClient(app)` met lifespan; zet DB-paden
  vóór client-constructie. Enkele tests skippen op non-Windows of
  eisen `git` op PATH.
</file>

<file path="inventory/app/database.py">
import json
import os
import sqlite3
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any


def database_path() -> str:
    path = os.environ.get("INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH", "data/inventory.db")
    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


@contextmanager
def connection():
    db = sqlite3.connect(database_path(), timeout=15.0)
    db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    db.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout = 15000;")
    try:
        yield db
        db.commit()
    finally:
        db.close()


def init_database() -> None:
    """Initialize all database tables with WAL mode enabled."""
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;")
        db.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL;")
        db.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS objects (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            quantity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_objects_created_at ON objects(created_at DESC);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_created_at ON projects(created_at DESC);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ideas (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'raw',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ideas_created_at ON ideas(created_at DESC);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS relationships (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            from_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            predicate TEXT NOT NULL,
            to_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rel_from ON relationships(from_id);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rel_to ON relationships(to_id);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            timestamp TEXT NOT NULL,
            data TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_entity ON events(entity_id);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_timestamp ON events(timestamp DESC);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hardware (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            manufacturer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            category TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
            capabilities TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            interfaces TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hardware_created_at ON hardware(created_at DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hardware_category ON hardware(category);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensors (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            sensor_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            manufacturer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            unit TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            measurement_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
            capabilities TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            interfaces TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sensors_created_at ON sensors(created_at DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sensors_type ON sensors(sensor_type);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cameras (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            camera_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            manufacturer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            resolution TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
            capabilities TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            interfaces TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cameras_created_at ON cameras(created_at DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cameras_type ON cameras(camera_type);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            location_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_locations_created_at ON locations(created_at DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_locations_type ON locations(location_type);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS models (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            provider TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            model_identifier TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            model_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
            capabilities TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            interfaces TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_models_created_at ON models(created_at DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_models_type ON models(model_type);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            task_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
            priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            input_requirements TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            expected_output TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            parameters TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_created_at ON tasks(created_at DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_type ON tasks(task_type);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_status ON tasks(status);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS actuators (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            actuator_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            manufacturer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            model TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
            capabilities TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            interfaces TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            parameters TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_actuators_created_at ON actuators(created_at DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_actuators_type ON actuators(actuator_type);

        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files (
            id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            name TEXT NOT NULL,
            file_kind TEXT NOT NULL,
            mime_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            sha256 TEXT NOT NULL,
            size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_created_at ON files(created_at DESC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_kind ON files(file_kind);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_files_sha256 ON files(sha256);
        """)
        _init_fts(db)
        rebuild_fts(db)


# =============================================================================
# FTS5 foundation (M4.1) — additive full-text index over existing entities.
#
# The canonical tables above remain the single source of truth. The *_fts
# virtual tables below are a derived, rebuildable search index:
# - new/changed/deleted rows are synced automatically via triggers;
# - rebuild_fts() re-indexes all existing rows (also called by
#   init_database, so older databases gain FTS without any migration);
# - entity_id is UNINDEXED: it links a match back to the canonical row
#   without polluting the full-text index.
# No query API lives here; sanitizing user queries belongs to M4.2.
# =============================================================================

FTS_TABLES = ("objects_fts", "projects_fts", "ideas_fts", "relationships_fts",
              "hardware_fts", "sensors_fts", "cameras_fts", "locations_fts",
              "models_fts", "tasks_fts", "actuators_fts", "files_fts")


def _init_fts(db) -> None:
    db.executescript("""
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS objects_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, provenance
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS projects_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, provenance
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ideas_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, provenance
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS relationships_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, from_id, predicate, to_id, metadata
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hardware_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, manufacturer, model, category
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sensors_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, manufacturer, model, sensor_type
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cameras_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, manufacturer, model, camera_type
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS locations_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, location_type
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS models_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, provider, model_identifier, model_type
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, task_type, status
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS actuators_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, manufacturer, model, actuator_type
    );
    CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS files_fts USING fts5(
        entity_id UNINDEXED, name, description, file_kind, mime_type
    );

    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS objects_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON objects BEGIN
        INSERT INTO objects_fts(entity_id, name, description, provenance)
        VALUES (new.id, new.name, new.description, new.provenance);
    END;
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS objects_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON objects BEGIN
        DELETE FROM objects_fts WHERE entity_id = old.id;
    END;
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS objects_fts_update AFTER UPDATE ON objects BEGIN
        DELETE FROM objects_fts WHERE entity_id = old.id;
        INSERT INTO objects_fts(entity_id, name, description, provenance)
        VALUES (new.id, new.name, new.description, new.provenance);
    END;

    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS projects_fts_insert AFTER INSERT ON projects BEGIN
        INSERT INTO projects_fts(entity_id, name, description, provenance)
        VALUES (new.id, new.name, new.description, new.provenance);
    END;
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS projects_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON projects BEGIN
        DELETE FROM projects_fts WHERE entity_id = old.id;
    END;
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS projects_fts_update AFTER UPDATE ON projects BEGIN
        DELETE FROM projects_fts WHERE entity_id = old.id;
        INSERT INTO projects_fts(entity_id, name, description, provenance)
        VALUES (new.id, new.name, new.description, new.provenance);
    END;

    END;
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ideas_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON ideas BEGIN
        DELETE FROM ideas_fts WHERE entity_id = old.id;
    END;
    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS ideas_fts_update AFTER UPDATE ON ideas BEGIN

    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS relationships_fts_delete AFTER DELETE ON relationships BEGIN

    CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS relationships_fts_update AFTER UPDATE ON relationships BEGIN

def rebuild_fts(db=None) -> dict:
    """Re-index all canonical rows into FTS. Safe to run at any time.

    Returns per-table indexed row counts. Accepts an open connection (used by
    init_database) or opens one when called standalone.
    """
    if db is None:
        with connection() as handle:
            return rebuild_fts(handle)
    db.execute("DELETE FROM objects_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO objects_fts(entity_id, name, description, provenance)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, provenance FROM objects"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM projects_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO projects_fts(entity_id, name, description, provenance)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, provenance FROM projects"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM ideas_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO ideas_fts(entity_id, name, description, provenance)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, provenance FROM ideas"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM relationships_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO relationships_fts(entity_id, from_id, predicate, to_id, metadata)"
        " SELECT id, from_id, predicate, to_id, metadata FROM relationships"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM hardware_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO hardware_fts(entity_id, name, description, manufacturer, model, category)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, manufacturer, model, category FROM hardware"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM sensors_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO sensors_fts(entity_id, name, description, manufacturer, model, sensor_type)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, manufacturer, model, sensor_type FROM sensors"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM cameras_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO cameras_fts(entity_id, name, description, manufacturer, model, camera_type)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, manufacturer, model, camera_type FROM cameras"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM locations_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO locations_fts(entity_id, name, description, location_type)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, location_type FROM locations"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM models_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO models_fts(entity_id, name, description, provider, model_identifier, model_type)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, provider, model_identifier, model_type FROM models"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM tasks_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO tasks_fts(entity_id, name, description, task_type, status)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, task_type, status FROM tasks"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM actuators_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO actuators_fts(entity_id, name, description, manufacturer, model, actuator_type)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, manufacturer, model, actuator_type FROM actuators"
    )
    db.execute("DELETE FROM files_fts")
    db.execute(
        "INSERT INTO files_fts(entity_id, name, description, file_kind, mime_type)"
        " SELECT id, name, description, file_kind, mime_type FROM files"
    )
    return {
        "objects_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM objects_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "projects_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "ideas_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ideas_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "relationships_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM relationships_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "hardware_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hardware_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "sensors_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sensors_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "cameras_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cameras_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "locations_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM locations_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "models_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM models_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "tasks_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "actuators_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actuators_fts").fetchone()[0],
        "files_fts": db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM files_fts").fetchone()[0],
    }


# =============================================================================
# Search helpers (M4.2) — read-only access to the FTS foundation.
#
# sanitize_fts_query() treats user input as plain text: every token becomes a
# double-quoted FTS5 phrase, so quotes, wildcards, column filters and boolean
# operators lose their special meaning instead of crashing the query.
# search_fts() only ever interpolates hardcoded table names; the MATCH
# expression travels as a bound parameter. Unknown entity types are refused.
# =============================================================================

SEARCHABLE_TYPES = {
    "objects": "objects_fts",
    "projects": "projects_fts",
    "ideas": "ideas_fts",
    "relationships": "relationships_fts",
    "hardware": "hardware_fts",
    "sensors": "sensors_fts",
    "cameras": "cameras_fts",
    "locations": "locations_fts",
    "models": "models_fts",
    "tasks": "tasks_fts",
    "actuators": "actuators_fts",
    "files": "files_fts",
}

SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS = 50
SEARCH_MAX_QUERY_LENGTH = 200


def sanitize_fts_query(query) -> str | None:
    """Turn free text into a safe FTS5 MATCH expression, or None when unusable."""
    if not isinstance(query, str):
        return None
    if len(query) > SEARCH_MAX_QUERY_LENGTH:
        return None
    tokens = [token.replace('"', "") for token in query.split()]
    tokens = [token for token in tokens if token]
    if not tokens:
        return None
    return " ".join(f'"{token}"' for token in tokens)


def search_fts(query, entity_types=None, limit=SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS) -> list:
    """Search the FTS tables; returns [(entity_type, entity_id)].

    ``query`` must be a pre-sanitized MATCH expression. Table names come
    exclusively from SEARCHABLE_TYPES; user input never reaches the SQL string.
    """
    types = list(entity_types) if entity_types else list(SEARCHABLE_TYPES)
    for entity_type in types:
        if entity_type not in SEARCHABLE_TYPES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown searchable type: {entity_type!r}")
    try:
        limit = max(1, min(int(limit), SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        limit = SEARCH_MAX_RESULTS
    hits: list = []
    with connection() as db:
        for entity_type in types:
            table = SEARCHABLE_TYPES[entity_type]
            rows = db.execute(
                f"SELECT entity_id FROM {table} WHERE {table} MATCH ? LIMIT ?",
                (query, limit),
            ).fetchall()
            hits.extend((entity_type, row["entity_id"]) for row in rows)
    return hits[:limit]


def dump(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, separators=(",", ":"), sort_keys=True)


def load(value: str) -> Any:
    return json.loads(value)

import secrets
import time


def _generate_id(prefix: str) -> str:
    timestamp_ms = int(time.time() * 1000)
    random_part = secrets.token_hex(4)
    return f"{prefix}_{timestamp_ms:x}{random_part}"


def generate_object_id() -> str:
    """Generate a collision-resistant, sortable, stable object ID (obj_...)."""
    return _generate_id("obj")


def generate_project_id() -> str:
    """Generate a collision-resistant, sortable, stable project ID (proj_...)."""
    return _generate_id("proj")

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator, model_validator

SourceType = Literal[
    "user-created",
    "imported",
    "ai-generated",
    "sensor-observed",
    "external-source",
]

ProjectStatus = Literal["idea", "planned", "active", "paused", "completed", "archived"]
IdeaStatus = Literal["raw", "considered", "planned", "rejected", "converted"]


def utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


class Provenance(BaseModel):
    source_type: SourceType = "user-created"
    creator_id: str = Field(default="user", min_length=1, max_length=120)
    confidence_score: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    human_verified: bool = True
    verified_by: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=120)
    created_at: str = Field(default_factory=utc_now)
    notes: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=1000)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def enforce_ai_unverified_rule(self) -> "Provenance":
        """Enforce that AI-generated data is not marked as human-verified by default."""
        if self.source_type == "ai-generated" and not self.verified_by:
            self.human_verified = False
        elif self.source_type == "user-created" and not self.verified_by:
            self.human_verified = True
        return self


# --- Object ---

class ObjectCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=5000)
    quantity: int = Field(default=1, ge=0)
    provenance: Provenance | None = None


class ObjectUpdate(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=5000)
    quantity: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    provenance: Provenance | None = None


class ObjectResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str = Field(pattern=r"^obj_[a-z0-9_-]+$")
    name: str
    description: str
    quantity: int
    provenance: Provenance
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str

HardwareStatus = Literal["available", "in_use", "maintenance", "retired", "unknown"]


class HardwareCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    manufacturer: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)

# --- File (M7.5, record only: never opens, copies, executes or imports files) ---

FileKind = Literal["cad", "mesh", "gcode", "image", "document", "data", "other"]
FileStatus = Literal["available", "in_use", "maintenance", "retired", "unknown"]
SHA256_PATTERN = r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$"


def normalize_sha256(value) -> str:
    """Lowercase and validate a SHA-256 hex digest. Never hashes anything."""
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError("sha256 must be a 64-character hex digest")
    cleaned = value.strip().lower()
    if len(cleaned) != 64 or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in cleaned):
        raise ValueError("sha256 must be a 64-character hex digest")
    return cleaned


class FileCreate(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    file_kind: FileKind = "other"
    mime_type: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    sha256: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=64)
    size_bytes: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=5000)
    status: FileStatus = "unknown"
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    provenance: Provenance | None = None

    @field_validator("sha256")
    @classmethod
    def _check_sha256(cls, value):
        return normalize_sha256(value)


class FileUpdate(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    file_kind: FileKind | None = None
    mime_type: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)
    sha256: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=64)
    size_bytes: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    description: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=5000)
    status: FileStatus | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    provenance: Provenance | None = None

    @field_validator("sha256")
    @classmethod
    def _check_sha256(cls, value):
        if value is None:
            return value
        return normalize_sha256(value)


class FileResponse(BaseModel):
    id: str = Field(pattern=r"^file_[a-z0-9_-]+$")
    name: str
    file_kind: FileKind
    mime_type: str
    sha256: str = Field(pattern=SHA256_PATTERN)
    size_bytes: int
    description: str
    status: FileStatus
    metadata: dict[str, Any]
    provenance: Provenance
    created_at: str
    updated_at: str

RelationshipPredicate = Literal[
    "used_in",
    "uses",
    "related_to",
    "part_of",
    "contains",
    "became",
    "led_to",
    "depends_on",
    "produced_by",
    "stored_in",
]


class RelationshipCreate(BaseModel):
    from_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=100)
    predicate: RelationshipPredicate
    to_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=100)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    provenance: Provenance | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def check_not_self_referential(self) -> "RelationshipCreate":
        if self.from_id == self.to_id:
            raise ValueError("from_id and to_id must differ")
        return self


class RelationshipResponse(BaseModel):

<file path="inventory/tests/test_database.py">
import os
from app.database import connection, init_database


def test_init_database_creates_objects_table(tmp_path):
    db_path = str(tmp_path / "test_inventory.db")
    os.environ["INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH"] = db_path

    init_database()

    with connection() as db:
        tables = [row["name"] for row in db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchall()]
        assert "objects" in tables

        columns = [row["name"] for row in db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(objects)").fetchall()]
        assert "id" in columns
        assert "name" in columns
        assert "description" in columns
        assert "quantity" in columns
        assert "provenance" in columns
        assert "created_at" in columns
        assert "updated_at" in columns


def test_wal_mode_and_busy_timeout(tmp_path):
    db_path = str(tmp_path / "test_wal.db")
    os.environ["INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH"] = db_path

    init_database()

    with connection() as db:
        mode = db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0]
        assert mode.lower() == "wal"

        timeout = db.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout").fetchone()[0]
        assert timeout == 15000

"""Tests voor INVENTory Milestone 1B — Projects, Ideas, Relationships, Events."""
import os

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture()
def client(tmp_path):
    os.environ["INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "test_1b.db")
    # Re-import to pick up fresh env var
    import importlib
    import app.database as db_mod
    import app.main as main_mod
    importlib.reload(db_mod)
    importlib.reload(main_mod)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as c:
        yield c


# =============================================================================
# PROJECT CRUD
# =============================================================================

def test_create_project(client):
    res = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "3D Printer Build", "status": "active"})
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data["id"].startswith("proj_")
    assert data["name"] == "3D Printer Build"
    assert data["status"] == "active"
    assert data["provenance"]["human_verified"] is True


def test_list_projects(client):
    client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Alpha"})
    client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Beta"})
    res = client.get("/api/v1/projects")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert len(res.json()) == 2


def test_get_project_by_id(client):
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Filament Dryer"}).json()
    res = client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{proj['id']}")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["name"] == "Filament Dryer"


def test_update_project(client):
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Old Name", "status": "idea"}).json()
    res = client.patch(f"/api/v1/projects/{proj['id']}", json={"name": "New Name", "status": "active"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json()["name"] == "New Name"
    assert res.json()["status"] == "active"


def test_delete_project(client):
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "To Delete"}).json()
    res = client.delete(f"/api/v1/projects/{proj['id']}")
    assert res.status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/projects/{proj['id']}").status_code == 404


def test_project_invalid_status_rejected(client):
    res = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Bad", "status": "flying"})
    assert res.status_code == 422

def test_create_relationship_between_object_and_project(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Motor"}).json()
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Printer"}).json()
    res = client.post("/api/v1/relationships", json={
        "from_id": obj["id"], "predicate": "used_in", "to_id": proj["id"]
    })
    assert res.status_code == 201
    data = res.json()
    assert data["id"].startswith("rel_")
    assert data["predicate"] == "used_in"
    assert data["from_id"] == obj["id"]
    assert data["to_id"] == proj["id"]


def test_create_relationship_idea_to_project(client):
    idea = client.post("/api/v1/ideas", json={"name": "Automate it"}).json()
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Automation Project"}).json()
    res = client.post("/api/v1/relationships", json={
        "from_id": idea["id"], "predicate": "became", "to_id": proj["id"]
    })
    assert res.status_code == 201
    assert res.json()["predicate"] == "became"


def test_create_relationship_object_to_object(client):
    obj1 = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Frame"}).json()
    obj2 = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Rail"}).json()
    res = client.post("/api/v1/relationships", json={
        "from_id": obj1["id"], "predicate": "contains", "to_id": obj2["id"]
    })
    assert res.status_code == 201


def test_self_referential_relationship_rejected(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Motor"}).json()
    res = client.post("/api/v1/relationships", json={
        "from_id": obj["id"], "predicate": "related_to", "to_id": obj["id"]
    })
    assert res.status_code == 422


def test_list_relationships_for_entity(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Bearing"}).json()
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "CNC Build"}).json()
    client.post("/api/v1/relationships", json={"from_id": obj["id"], "predicate": "used_in", "to_id": proj["id"]})
    res = client.get(f"/api/v1/relationships?entity_id={obj['id']}")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert len(res.json()) == 1


def test_delete_relationship(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Capacitor"}).json()
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "PCB"}).json()
    rel = client.post("/api/v1/relationships", json={
        "from_id": obj["id"], "predicate": "used_in", "to_id": proj["id"]
    }).json()
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/relationships/{rel['id']}").status_code == 204
    assert len(client.get("/api/v1/relationships").json()) == 0


def test_invalid_predicate_rejected(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Motor"}).json()

        "from_id": obj["id"], "predicate": "invented_by", "to_id": "proj_fake"

def test_object_create_generates_event(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Sensor"}).json()
    events = client.get(f"/api/v1/events?entity_id={obj['id']}").json()
    assert any(e["event_type"] == "object_created" for e in events)


def test_object_update_generates_event(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Motor"}).json()
    client.patch(f"/api/v1/objects/{obj['id']}", json={"quantity": 5})
    events = client.get(f"/api/v1/events?entity_id={obj['id']}").json()
    assert any(e["event_type"] == "object_updated" for e in events)


def test_object_delete_registers_event_before_deletion(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Doomed Object"}).json()
    obj_id = obj["id"]
    client.delete(f"/api/v1/objects/{obj_id}")
    # Object should be gone
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/objects/{obj_id}").status_code == 404
    # But event must still exist
    events = client.get(f"/api/v1/events?entity_id={obj_id}").json()
    assert any(e["event_type"] == "object_deleted" for e in events)


def test_project_create_update_delete_events(client):
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "P1"}).json()
    pid = proj["id"]
    client.patch(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}", json={"status": "active"})
    client.delete(f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}")
    events = client.get(f"/api/v1/events?entity_id={pid}").json()
    types = [e["event_type"] for e in events]
    assert "project_created" in types
    assert "project_updated" in types
    assert "project_deleted" in types


def test_idea_create_update_delete_events(client):
    idea = client.post("/api/v1/ideas", json={"name": "I1"}).json()
    iid = idea["id"]
    client.patch(f"/api/v1/ideas/{iid}", json={"status": "considered"})
    client.delete(f"/api/v1/ideas/{iid}")
    events = client.get(f"/api/v1/events?entity_id={iid}").json()
    types = [e["event_type"] for e in events]
    assert "idea_created" in types
    assert "idea_updated" in types
    assert "idea_deleted" in types


def test_relationship_events(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Wheel"}).json()
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Robot"}).json()
    rel = client.post("/api/v1/relationships", json={
        "from_id": obj["id"], "predicate": "used_in", "to_id": proj["id"]
    }).json()
    client.delete(f"/api/v1/relationships/{rel['id']}")
    events = client.get(f"/api/v1/events?entity_id={rel['id']}").json()
    types = [e["event_type"] for e in events]
    assert "relationship_created" in types
    assert "relationship_deleted" in types


def test_events_are_append_only(client):
    """Events can never be deleted via API — they accumulate."""
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Permanent"}).json()
    client.patch(f"/api/v1/objects/{obj['id']}", json={"quantity": 2})
    client.patch(f"/api/v1/objects/{obj['id']}", json={"quantity": 3})
    events = client.get(f"/api/v1/events?entity_id={obj['id']}").json()
    # 1 created + 2 updated = 3 events minimum
    assert len(events) >= 3

"""Tests voor INVENTory Milestone 3.1 — Hardware-entiteit.

Uitsluitend tijdelijke databases via INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH. Geen echte
gebruikersdata wordt geraakt. Geen echte hardware wordt benaderd: alle tests
beschrijven hardware als data, zoals elk ander wereldmodel-record.
"""
import os

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture()
def client(tmp_path):
    os.environ["INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "test_hw.db")
    import importlib
    import app.database as db_mod
    import app.main as main_mod
    importlib.reload(db_mod)
    importlib.reload(main_mod)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as c:
        yield c


def make_hw(client, **overrides):
    payload = {"name": "Raspberry Pi 5", "category": "single-board-computer"}
    payload.update(overrides)
    res = client.post("/api/v1/hardware", json=payload)
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
    return res.json()


# =============================================================================
# CRUD
# =============================================================================

def test_create_hardware(client):
    hw = make_hw(client, manufacturer="Raspberry Pi Ltd", model="Pi 5 8GB",
                 description="werkplaats-controller", status="available",
                 capabilities=["gpio", "wifi"], interfaces=["usb-c", "hdmi"],
                 metadata={"locatie": "werkbank"})
    assert hw["id"].startswith("hw_")
    assert hw["name"] == "Raspberry Pi 5"
    assert hw["manufacturer"] == "Raspberry Pi Ltd"
    assert hw["model"] == "Pi 5 8GB"
    assert hw["category"] == "single-board-computer"
    assert hw["status"] == "available"
    assert hw["capabilities"] == ["gpio", "wifi"]
    assert hw["interfaces"] == ["usb-c", "hdmi"]
    assert hw["metadata"] == {"locatie": "werkbank"}


def test_read_hardware(client):
    created = make_hw(client)
    res = client.get(f"/api/v1/hardware/{created['id']}")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert res.json() == created
    assert client.get("/api/v1/hardware/hw_bestaatniet").status_code == 404


def test_list_hardware(client):
    make_hw(client, name="Printer A", category="3d-printer")
    make_hw(client, name="Laptop B", category="computer")
    res = client.get("/api/v1/hardware")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    names = {hw["name"] for hw in res.json()}
    assert {"Printer A", "Laptop B"} <= names


def test_update_hardware(client):
    created = make_hw(client)
    res = client.patch(f"/api/v1/hardware/{created['id']}",
                       json={"status": "in_use", "capabilities": ["gpio"],
                             "description": "nu in gebruik"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    updated = res.json()
    assert updated["status"] == "in_use"
    assert updated["capabilities"] == ["gpio"]
    assert updated["description"] == "nu in gebruik"
    assert updated["name"] == "Raspberry Pi 5"
    assert client.patch("/api/v1/hardware/hw_bestaatniet",
                        json={"status": "retired"}).status_code == 404


def test_delete_hardware(client):
    created = make_hw(client)
    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/hardware/{created['id']}").status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/hardware/{created['id']}").status_code == 404
    assert client.delete("/api/v1/hardware/hw_bestaatniet").status_code == 404


def test_hardware_ids_unique(client):
    ids = {make_hw(client, name=f"Apparaat {i}")["id"] for i in range(5)}
    assert len(ids) == 5
    assert all(hw_id.startswith("hw_") for hw_id in ids)

    assert client.post("/api/v1/hardware", json={"category": "x"}).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/api/v1/hardware", json={"name": "x"}).status_code == 422
    assert client.post("/api/v1/hardware",
                       json={"name": "x", "category": "y",
                             "status": "vliegend"}).status_code == 422


def test_hardware_provenance_default(client):
    hw = make_hw(client)
    assert hw["provenance"]["source_type"] == "user-created"
    assert hw["provenance"]["human_verified"] is True
    events = client.get("/api/v1/events", params={"entity_id": hw["id"]}).json()
    assert events and events[0]["event_type"] == "hardware_created"

                                     "creator_id": "test-model"})

    assert hw["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False

def test_hardware_relationship_with_project(client):
    hw = make_hw(client)
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Printer Build"}).json()
    rel = client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                      json={"from_id": hw["id"], "predicate": "used_in",
                            "to_id": proj["id"],
                            "metadata": {"rol": "controller"}}).json()
    assert rel["id"].startswith("rel_")
    assert rel["predicate"] == "used_in"
    linked = client.get("/api/v1/relationships",
                        params={"entity_id": hw["id"]}).json()
    assert [r["id"] for r in linked] == [rel["id"]]

def test_search_finds_hardware(client):
    hw = make_hw(client, name="Unieke Boormachine", category="gereedschap",
                 manufacturer="ZoekFabrikant")
    res = client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "Boormachine"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    found = {(r["entity_type"], r["entity_id"]) for r in res.json()["results"]}
    assert ("hardware", hw["id"]) in found
    res = client.get("/api/v1/search",
                     params={"q": "ZoekFabrikant", "type": "hardware"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert {(r["entity_type"], r["entity_id"]) for r in res.json()["results"]} == {
        ("hardware", hw["id"])}


def test_graph_shows_hardware(client):
    hw = make_hw(client)
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", json={"name": "Bouw"}).json()
    client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                json={"from_id": hw["id"], "predicate": "used_in",
                      "to_id": proj["id"]})
    res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": hw["id"], "depth": 1})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    by_id = {n["entity_id"]: n for n in data["nodes"]}
    assert by_id[hw["id"]]["entity_type"] == "hardware"
    assert by_id[hw["id"]]["provenance"]["source_type"]
    assert proj["id"] in by_id
    res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": proj["id"], "depth": 1})
    assert hw["id"] in {n["entity_id"] for n in res.json()["nodes"]}

    assert "Raspberry Pi 5" in index.text
    detail = client.get(f"/hardware/{hw['id']}")
    assert detail.status_code == 200
    assert "single-board-computer" in detail.text
    assert f"/graph/{hw['id']}" in detail.text
    assert client.get("/hardware/hw_bestaatniet").status_code == 404

def test_camera_relationship_with_hardware(client):
    cam = make_camera(client)
    hw = client.post("/api/v1/hardware",
                     json={"name": "Print Server",
                           "category": "single-board-computer"}).json()
    assert hw["id"].startswith("hw_")
    rel = client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                      json={"from_id": cam["id"], "predicate": "part_of",
                            "to_id": hw["id"],
                            "metadata": {"montage": "behuizing"}}).json()
    assert rel["id"].startswith("rel_")
    assert rel["predicate"] == "part_of"
    linked = client.get("/api/v1/relationships",
                        params={"entity_id": cam["id"]}).json()
    assert [r["id"] for r in linked] == [rel["id"]]
    linked_hw = client.get("/api/v1/relationships",
                           params={"entity_id": hw["id"]}).json()
    assert [r["id"] for r in linked_hw] == [rel["id"]]

    res = client.get("/api/v1/search",
                     params={"q": "ZoekCamFabrikant", "type": "cameras"})

def test_graph_shows_camera(client):

    hw = client.post("/api/v1/hardware",
                     json={"name": "Cam Server", "category": "node"}).json()
    client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                json={"from_id": cam["id"], "predicate": "part_of",
                      "to_id": hw["id"]})
    res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": cam["id"], "depth": 1})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    data = res.json()
    by_id = {n["entity_id"]: n for n in data["nodes"]}
    assert by_id[cam["id"]]["entity_type"] == "camera"

    res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": hw["id"], "depth": 1})

def test_location_hierarchy_via_relationships(client):
    huis = make_location(client, name="Uniek Huis", location_type="huis")
    werkplaats = make_location(client, name="Unieke Werkplaats", location_type="kamer")
    werkbank = make_location(client, name="Unieke Werkbank", location_type="werkplek")
    relate(client, werkplaats["id"], "part_of", huis["id"])
    relate(client, werkbank["id"], "part_of", werkplaats["id"])
    res = client.get("/api/v1/graph",
                     params={"entity_id": werkbank["id"], "depth": 2})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    node_ids = {n["entity_id"] for n in res.json()["nodes"]}
    assert {huis["id"], werkplaats["id"], werkbank["id"]} <= node_ids
    predicates = {e["predicate"] for e in res.json()["edges"]}
    assert predicates == {"part_of"}

# Hardware / Sensor / Camera → Location (bestaand stored_in-predicaat)
# =============================================================================

def test_hardware_sensor_camera_to_location(client):
    loc = make_location(client, name="Unieke Schuur", location_type="schuur")
    hw = client.post("/api/v1/hardware",
                     json={"name": "Schuur Printer",
                           "category": "3d-printer"}).json()
    sns = client.post("/api/v1/sensors",
                      json={"name": "Schuur Sensor",
                            "sensor_type": "temperatuur"}).json()
    cam = client.post("/api/v1/cameras",
                      json={"name": "Schuur Cam",
                            "camera_type": "webcam"}).json()
    for entity in (hw, sns, cam):
        rel = relate(client, entity["id"], "stored_in", loc["id"])
        assert rel["predicate"] == "stored_in"
    linked = {r["from_id"] for r in client.get(
        "/api/v1/relationships", params={"entity_id": loc["id"]}).json()}
    assert linked == {hw["id"], sns["id"], cam["id"]}
    res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": loc["id"], "depth": 1})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert {hw["id"], sns["id"], cam["id"]} <= {
        n["entity_id"] for n in res.json()["nodes"]}

def test_model_relationships(client):
    mod = make_model(client)
    hw = client.post("/api/v1/hardware",
                     json={"name": "Edge Pi", "category": "single-board-computer"}).json()
    cam = client.post("/api/v1/cameras",
                      json={"name": "Werkplaats Cam", "camera_type": "webcam"}).json()
    loc = client.post("/api/v1/locations",
                      json={"name": "Werkplaats", "location_type": "kamer"}).json()
    rel_hw = relate(client, mod["id"], "uses", hw["id"])
    rel_cam = relate(client, mod["id"], "related_to", cam["id"])
    rel_loc = relate(client, mod["id"], "related_to", loc["id"])
    assert rel_hw["predicate"] == "uses"
    linked = {r["to_id"] for r in client.get(
        "/api/v1/relationships", params={"entity_id": mod["id"]}).json()}
    assert linked == {hw["id"], cam["id"], loc["id"]}
    assert rel_cam["id"].startswith("rel_") and rel_loc["id"].startswith("rel_")

voeren niets uit: geen subprocess, geen netwerk, geen hardware, geen AI.
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


@pytest.fixture()
def client(tmp_path):
    os.environ["INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "test_task.db")
    import importlib
    import app.database as db_mod
    import app.main as main_mod
    importlib.reload(db_mod)
    importlib.reload(main_mod)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as c:

def make_task(client, **overrides):
    payload = {"name": "Werkplaats inspecteren", "task_type": "inspect"}

def test_task_relationships(client):
    task = make_task(client)
    mod = client.post("/api/v1/models",
                      json={"name": "Kijker", "model_type": "vision"}).json()
    cam = client.post("/api/v1/cameras",
                      json={"name": "Werkplaats Cam",
                            "camera_type": "webcam"}).json()
    hw = client.post("/api/v1/hardware",
                     json={"name": "Hoek Pi",
                           "category": "single-board-computer"}).json()
    rel_mod = relate(client, task["id"], "uses", mod["id"])
    rel_cam = relate(client, task["id"], "uses", cam["id"])
    rel_hw = relate(client, task["id"], "related_to", hw["id"])
    assert rel_mod["predicate"] == "uses"
    linked = {r["to_id"] for r in client.get(
        "/api/v1/relationships", params={"entity_id": task["id"]}).json()}
    assert linked == {mod["id"], cam["id"], hw["id"]}
    assert rel_cam["id"].startswith("rel_") and rel_hw["id"].startswith("rel_")

    mod = client.post("/api/v1/models",
                      json={"name": "Teller", "model_type": "detection"}).json()
    relate(client, task["id"], "uses", mod["id"])
    res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": task["id"], "depth": 1})

    assert by_id[task["id"]]["entity_type"] == "task"
    assert by_id[task["id"]]["provenance"]["source_type"]
    assert mod["id"] in by_id
    assert data["edges"][0]["predicate"] == "uses"
    res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": mod["id"], "depth": 1})
    assert task["id"] in {n["entity_id"] for n in res.json()["nodes"]}

<file path="inventory/tests/test_milestone_4.py">
"""Tests voor INVENTory Milestone 4.1 — FTS5 foundation (database-laag).

Uitsluitend tijdelijke databases via INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH. Geen echte
gebruikersdata wordt geraakt. M4.1 bouwt geen publieke search-endpoint;
deze tests bevragen de FTS-tabellen direct via SQL.
"""
import os

from app.database import (
    FTS_TABLES,
    connection,
    dump,
    init_database,
    rebuild_fts,
)

PROV = dump({"source_type": "user-created", "creator_id": "test",
             "human_verified": True})


def use_tmp_db(tmp_path, name="test_fts.db"):
    os.environ["INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / name)
    init_database()


def match_ids(table, query):
    with connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            f"SELECT entity_id FROM {table} WHERE {table} MATCH ?", (query,)
        ).fetchall()
    return sorted(row["entity_id"] for row in rows)


# =============================================================================
# FTS-tabellen bestaan
# =============================================================================

def test_fts_tables_exist(tmp_path):
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        tables = [row["name"] for row in db.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'").fetchall()]
    for fts in FTS_TABLES:
        assert fts in tables


def test_fts_triggers_exist(tmp_path):
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        triggers = [row["name"] for row in db.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='trigger'").fetchall()]
    for base in ("objects", "projects", "ideas", "relationships"):
        for operation in ("insert", "delete", "update"):
            assert f"{base}_fts_{operation}" in triggers


# =============================================================================
# Bestaande records indexeerbaar (init/rebuild indexeert mee)
# =============================================================================

def test_existing_records_indexed_on_init(tmp_path):
    os.environ["INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "test_fts.db")
    init_database()
    # Records die vóór (her-)initialisatie bestaan, moeten daarna vindbaar zijn.
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO objects (id, name, description, quantity, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("obj_legacy", "Legacy Moer", "oude voorraad", 3, PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO projects (id, name, description, status, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("proj_legacy", "Legacy Printer", "oude build", "active", PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO ideas (id, name, description, status, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("idea_legacy", "Legacy Droger", "oud plan", "raw", PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
    init_database()
    assert match_ids("objects_fts", "Legacy") == ["obj_legacy"]
    assert match_ids("projects_fts", "Legacy") == ["proj_legacy"]
    assert match_ids("ideas_fts", "Legacy") == ["idea_legacy"]


# =============================================================================
# Nieuwe records, updates, deletes
# =============================================================================

def test_new_records_auto_indexed(tmp_path):
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO objects (id, name, description, quantity, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("obj_step", "Nema Stappenmotor", "1.8 graden 12V", 2, PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO projects (id, name, description, status, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("proj_step", "Printer Build", "stappenmotor montage", "planned",
             PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO ideas (id, name, description, status, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("idea_step", "Filament Idee", "droger met stappenmotor", "raw",
             PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
    assert match_ids("objects_fts", "Stappenmotor") == ["obj_step"]
    assert match_ids("projects_fts", "stappenmotor") == ["proj_step"]
    assert match_ids("ideas_fts", "stappenmotor") == ["idea_step"]


def test_update_syncs_fts(tmp_path):
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO objects (id, name, description, quantity, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("obj_upd", "Oude Naam", "beschrijving", 1, PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
    assert match_ids("objects_fts", "Oude") == ["obj_upd"]
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE objects SET name=? WHERE id=?", ("Nieuwe Naam", "obj_upd"))
    assert match_ids("objects_fts", "Oude") == []
    assert match_ids("objects_fts", "Nieuwe") == ["obj_upd"]


def test_delete_syncs_fts(tmp_path):
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO projects (id, name, description, status, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("proj_del", "Weg Project", "verdwijnt", "planned", PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
    assert match_ids("projects_fts", "Weg") == ["proj_del"]
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute("DELETE FROM projects WHERE id=?", ("proj_del",))
    assert match_ids("projects_fts", "Weg") == []


def test_relationships_metadata_indexed(tmp_path):
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO relationships (id, from_id, predicate, to_id, metadata,"
            " provenance, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("rel_meta", "obj_a", "stored_in", "proj_b",
             dump({"basis": "werkplaatsplank"}), PROV, "t"),
        )
    assert match_ids("relationships_fts", "stored_in") == ["rel_meta"]
    assert match_ids("relationships_fts", "werkplaatsplank") == ["rel_meta"]


# =============================================================================
# Rebuild en canonieke integriteit
# =============================================================================

def test_rebuild_restores_and_reports_counts(tmp_path):
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO objects (id, name, description, quantity, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("obj_rb", "Rebuild Moer", "test", 1, PROV, "t", "t"),
        )
        db.execute("DELETE FROM objects_fts")
    assert match_ids("objects_fts", "Rebuild") == []
    counts = rebuild_fts()
    assert counts["objects_fts"] == 1
    assert match_ids("objects_fts", "Rebuild") == ["obj_rb"]
    # Rebuild is idempotent: geen duplicaten.
    counts_again = rebuild_fts()
    assert counts_again == counts
    assert match_ids("objects_fts", "Rebuild") == ["obj_rb"]


def test_canonical_tables_intact(tmp_path):
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO objects (id, name, description, quantity, provenance,"
            " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
            ("obj_int", "Intact Ding", "blijft", 5, PROV, "t1", "t2"),
        )
    rebuild_fts()
    with connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM objects WHERE id=?", ("obj_int",)).fetchone()
        columns = [r["name"] for r in db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(objects)").fetchall()]
    assert row["name"] == "Intact Ding"
    assert row["quantity"] == 5
    assert row["created_at"] == "t1"
    assert columns == ["id", "name", "description", "quantity",
                       "provenance", "created_at", "updated_at"]

def test_sanitize_normal_text():
    from app.database import sanitize_fts_query
    assert sanitize_fts_query("stappenmotor") == '"stappenmotor"'
    assert sanitize_fts_query("  printer  build ") == '"printer" "build"'


def test_sanitize_empty_and_whitespace():
    from app.database import sanitize_fts_query
    assert sanitize_fts_query("") is None
    assert sanitize_fts_query("   ") is None
    assert sanitize_fts_query(None) is None
    assert sanitize_fts_query(123) is None


def test_sanitize_neutralises_special_syntax():
    from app.database import sanitize_fts_query
    assert sanitize_fts_query('"quoted"') == '"quoted"'
    assert sanitize_fts_query("a*b (c) OR d:e") == '"a*b" "(c)" "OR" "d:e"'
    assert sanitize_fts_query('"""') is None
    assert sanitize_fts_query("x" * 201) is None


def test_search_fts_limit(tmp_path):
    from app.database import sanitize_fts_query, search_fts
    use_tmp_db(tmp_path)
    with connection() as db:
        for i in range(60):
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO objects (id, name, description, quantity, provenance,"
                " created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (f"obj_bulk{i}", f"Bulk Ding {i}", "bulkterm voorraad", 1,
                 PROV, "t", "t"),
            )
    hits = search_fts(sanitize_fts_query("bulkterm"))
    assert 0 < len(hits) <= 50

def _search_client(tmp_path):
    import importlib
    os.environ["INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "test_search.db")
    import app.database as db_mod
    import app.main as main_mod
    importlib.reload(db_mod)
    importlib.reload(main_mod)
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def _seed_search_data(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects",
                      json={"name": "Zoek Moer", "description": "uniekzoekterm bout"}).json()
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects",
                       json={"name": "Zoek Project", "description": "uniekzoekterm plan",
                             "status": "active"}).json()
    idea = client.post("/api/v1/ideas",
                       json={"name": "Zoek Idee", "description": "uniekzoekterm gedachte"}).json()
    rel = client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                      json={"from_id": obj["id"], "predicate": "used_in",
                            "to_id": proj["id"],
                            "metadata": {"notitie": "uniekzoekterm koppeling"}}).json()
    return obj, proj, idea, rel


def test_search_finds_all_types_without_filter(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:
        obj, proj, idea, rel = _seed_search_data(client)
        res = client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "uniekzoekterm"})
        assert res.status_code == 200
        data = res.json()
        assert data["query"] == "uniekzoekterm"
        found = {(r["entity_type"], r["entity_id"]) for r in data["results"]}
        assert ("object", obj["id"]) in found
        assert ("project", proj["id"]) in found
        assert ("idea", idea["id"]) in found
        assert ("relationship", rel["id"]) in found
        assert data["total"] == len(data["results"])
        for result in data["results"]:
            assert result["title"] and result["entity_id"]
            assert result["provenance"]["source_type"] in (
                "user-created", "imported", "ai-generated",
                "sensor-observed", "external-source")


def test_search_type_filters(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:
        obj, proj, idea, rel = _seed_search_data(client)
        expectations = {
            "objects": ("object", obj["id"]),
            "projects": ("project", proj["id"]),
            "ideas": ("idea", idea["id"]),
            "relationships": ("relationship", rel["id"]),
        }
        for entity_type, expected in expectations.items():
            res = client.get("/api/v1/search",
                             params={"q": "uniekzoekterm", "type": entity_type})
            assert res.status_code == 200
            found = {(r["entity_type"], r["entity_id"]) for r in res.json()["results"]}
            assert found == {expected}


def test_search_unknown_type_rejected(tmp_path):

def test_search_empty_and_whitespace_rejected(tmp_path):

        assert client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": "   "}).status_code == 422

def test_search_special_chars_do_not_crash(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:

        for tricky in ['"quote"', "a*b (c) OR d:e", "' OR '1'='1", "--", "x" * 201]:
            res = client.get("/api/v1/search", params={"q": tricky})
            assert res.status_code in (200, 422)

def _seed_chain(client):
    obj = client.post("/api/v1/objects",
                      json={"name": "Graaf Moer", "description": "keten"}).json()
    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects",
                       json={"name": "Graaf Project", "description": "keten"}).json()
    idea = client.post("/api/v1/ideas",
                       json={"name": "Graaf Idee", "description": "keten"}).json()
    rel1 = client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                       json={"from_id": obj["id"], "predicate": "used_in",
                             "to_id": proj["id"]}).json()
    rel2 = client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                       json={"from_id": proj["id"], "predicate": "led_to",
                             "to_id": idea["id"]}).json()
    return obj, proj, idea, rel1, rel2


def test_graph_one_hop(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:
        obj, proj, idea, rel1, rel2 = _seed_chain(client)
        res = client.get("/api/v1/graph",
                         params={"entity_id": obj["id"], "depth": 1})
        assert res.status_code == 200
        data = res.json()
        assert data["entity_id"] == obj["id"]
        assert data["depth"] == 1
        node_ids = {n["entity_id"] for n in data["nodes"]}
        assert node_ids == {obj["id"], proj["id"]}
        assert [e["id"] for e in data["edges"]] == [rel1["id"]]


def test_graph_two_hops(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:
        obj, proj, idea, rel1, rel2 = _seed_chain(client)
        res = client.get("/api/v1/graph",
                         params={"entity_id": obj["id"], "depth": 2})
        assert res.status_code == 200
        data = res.json()
        node_ids = {n["entity_id"] for n in data["nodes"]}
        assert node_ids == {obj["id"], proj["id"], idea["id"]}
        assert {e["id"] for e in data["edges"]} == {rel1["id"], rel2["id"]}


def test_graph_invalid_depth_rejected(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:
        obj, _, _, _, _ = _seed_chain(client)
        for bad in (0, -1, 3, 99):
            res = client.get("/api/v1/graph",
                             params={"entity_id": obj["id"], "depth": bad})
            assert res.status_code == 422
        res = client.get("/api/v1/graph",
                         params={"entity_id": obj["id"], "depth": "diep"})
        assert res.status_code == 422


def test_graph_cycle_terminates(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:
        a = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Knoop A"}).json()
        b = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Knoop B"}).json()
        c = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Knoop C"}).json()
        client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                    json={"from_id": a["id"], "predicate": "related_to",
                          "to_id": b["id"]})
        client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                    json={"from_id": b["id"], "predicate": "related_to",
                          "to_id": c["id"]})
        client.post("/api/v1/relationships",
                    json={"from_id": c["id"], "predicate": "related_to",
                          "to_id": a["id"]})
        res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": a["id"], "depth": 2})
        assert res.status_code == 200
        data = res.json()
        assert {n["entity_id"] for n in data["nodes"]} == {a["id"], b["id"], c["id"]}
        assert len(data["edges"]) == 3


def test_graph_unknown_entity_404(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:
        res = client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": "obj_bestaatniet"})
        assert res.status_code == 404
        assert client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={"entity_id": "  "}).status_code == 422
        assert client.get("/api/v1/graph").status_code == 422


def test_graph_predicates_and_provenance(tmp_path):
    with _search_client(tmp_path) as client:
        obj, proj, idea, rel1, rel2 = _seed_chain(client)
        res = client.get("/api/v1/graph",
                         params={"entity_id": proj["id"], "depth": 1})
        assert res.status_code == 200
        data = res.json()
        by_id = {e["id"]: e for e in data["edges"]}
        assert by_id[rel1["id"]]["predicate"] == "used_in"
        assert by_id[rel2["id"]]["predicate"] == "led_to"
        for node in data["nodes"]:
            assert node["title"] and node["entity_type"] in ("object", "project", "idea")
            assert node["provenance"]["source_type"]
        for edge in data["edges"]:
            assert edge["provenance"]["source_type"]

            "quantity": 3,

        # List all objects

        created = client.post("/api/v1/objects", json={"name": "Resistor 10k", "quantity": 100}).json()
        obj_id = created["id"]

        update_res = client.patch(
