<file path="Mycelium/agent/tests/test_checkpoint.py">
"""Tests for local Git checkpoints.

Every repository is created under pytest's tmp_path. No real project path is
used or modified by these tests.
"""

import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

import checkpoint
from permissions import PermissionDeniedError


def git(repository: Path, *arguments: str, check: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    return subprocess.run(
        ["git", *arguments],
        cwd=repository,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=check,
    )


def make_repository(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
    repository = tmp_path / "repo"
    repository.mkdir()
    git(repository, "init", "--quiet")
    git(repository, "config", "user.name", "Mycelium Test")
    git(repository, "config", "user.email", "test@mycelium.local")
    (repository / "README.md").write_text("# test repository\n", encoding="utf-8")
    git(repository, "add", "README.md")
    git(repository, "commit", "--quiet", "-m", "initial")
    return repository


def approval(repository: Path, approved: bool = True):
    return {
        "approved": approved,
        "action": checkpoint.CHECKPOINT_ACTION,
        "target": str(repository.resolve()),
        "request_id": "test-request",
    }


def test_inspect_repository_reports_status_cleanliness_and_head(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    inspection = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    assert inspection["is_repository"] is True
    assert inspection["cleanliness"] == "clean"
    assert inspection["clean"] is True
    assert inspection["status"] == ""
    assert inspection["status_lines"] == []
    assert inspection["current_head"]
    assert len(inspection["current_head"]) == 40
    assert inspection["provenance"]["source"] == "mycelium-desktop-agent:checkpoint"


def test_inspect_repository_detects_dirty_repository(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    (repository / "changes.txt").write_text("uncommitted", encoding="utf-8")
    inspection = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    assert inspection["cleanliness"] == "dirty"
    assert inspection["clean"] is False
    assert inspection["status_lines"]


def test_checkpoint_on_clean_repository_creates_commit(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    before = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    result = checkpoint.create_checkpoint(repository, approval(repository))
    after = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    assert result["previous_head"] == before["current_head"]
    assert result["checkpoint_id"] == after["current_head"]
    assert result["checkpoint_id"] != before["current_head"]
    assert result["message"].startswith("Mycelium checkpoint")
    assert after["cleanliness"] == "clean"


def test_checkpoint_contains_correct_commit_message_and_parent(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    before = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    result = checkpoint.create_checkpoint(
        repository,
        approval(repository),
        message="M2A safety checkpoint",
    )
    commit_message = git(repository, "show", "-s", "--format=%s", "HEAD").stdout.strip()
    parent = git(repository, "rev-parse", "HEAD^").stdout.strip()
    assert commit_message == "M2A safety checkpoint"
    assert parent == before["current_head"]
    assert result["checkpoint_id"] == git(repository, "rev-parse", "HEAD").stdout.strip()


def test_checkpoint_refuses_without_permission(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    before = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    denied = {
        "approved": False,
        "action": checkpoint.CHECKPOINT_ACTION,
        "target": str(repository.resolve()),
        "request_id": "test-request",
    }
    with pytest.raises(PermissionDeniedError):
        checkpoint.create_checkpoint(repository, denied)
    after = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    assert after["current_head"] == before["current_head"]


def test_checkpoint_refuses_when_permission_is_omitted(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    before = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    denied = {
        "approved": False,
        "action": checkpoint.CHECKPOINT_ACTION,
        "target": str(repository.resolve()),
        "request_id": "test-request",
    }
    with pytest.raises(PermissionDeniedError):
        checkpoint.create_checkpoint(
            repository,
            permission_func=lambda _action, _target, _details: denied,
        )
    after = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    assert after["current_head"] == before["current_head"]


def test_checkpoint_refuses_dirty_repository_before_permission(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    before = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    (repository / "dirty.txt").write_text("do not checkpoint", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(checkpoint.DirtyRepositoryError):
        checkpoint.create_checkpoint(repository, approval(repository))
    after = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    assert after["current_head"] == before["current_head"]


def test_checkpoint_refuses_if_repository_changes_after_permission(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    before = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    calls = {"count": 0}
    original_inspect = checkpoint.inspect_repository

    def inspect_then_change(path):
        result = original_inspect(path)
        calls["count"] += 1
        if calls["count"] == 2:
            (Path(path) / "race.txt").write_text("changed after permission", encoding="utf-8")
        return result

    monkeypatch.setattr(checkpoint, "inspect_repository", inspect_then_change)
    with pytest.raises(checkpoint.RepositoryChangedError):
        checkpoint.create_checkpoint(repository, approval(repository))
    assert checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)["current_head"] == before["current_head"]


def test_checkpoint_never_invokes_forbidden_git_operations(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    calls = []

    original_run_git = checkpoint._run_git

    def record(repository_path, arguments, *, check=True):
        calls.append(list(arguments))
        return original_run_git(repository_path, arguments, check=check)

    monkeypatch.setattr(checkpoint, "_run_git", record)
    checkpoint.create_checkpoint(repository, approval(repository))
    operations = {args[0] for args in calls}
    assert operations <= {"rev-parse", "status", "branch", "-c"}
    assert not (operations & checkpoint.FORBIDDEN_GIT_OPERATIONS)


def test_checkpoint_does_not_touch_real_projects(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    real_candidate = Path("C:/Users/Jelles/Desktop/Projects/myceliuma-and-inventory")
    assert real_candidate.exists()
    before = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    result = checkpoint.create_checkpoint(repository, approval(repository))
    after = checkpoint.inspect_repository(repository)
    assert result["previous_head"] == before["current_head"]
    assert after["current_head"] != before["current_head"]
    assert not (real_candidate / ".mycelium-test-marker").exists()


def test_checkpoint_permission_is_logged_with_provenance(tmp_path):
    repository = make_repository(tmp_path)
    log_path = tmp_path / "permission_log.jsonl"
    result = checkpoint.create_checkpoint(
        repository,
        permission_func=lambda action, target, details: checkpoint.request_checkpoint_permission(
            repository,
            input_func=lambda _prompt: "YES",
            log_path=log_path,
        ),
    )
    assert result["approval"]["provenance"]["source"] == "mycelium-desktop-agent:permission"
    assert result["approval"]["provenance"]["default"] == "deny"
    assert json.loads(log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["approved"] is True

<file path="Mycelium/agent/tests/test_discovery.py">
"""Tests for the smarter Mycelium Desktop Agent discovery.

All tests use isolated tmp_path fixtures — never the real Desktop,
Documents or Downloads folders. Read-only scanner behavior is verified.
"""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

import agent


def make_project(base: Path, name: str, files: dict | None = None, dirs: list | None = None) -> Path:
    project = base / name
    project.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for filename, content in (files or {}).items():
        target = project / filename
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        target.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    for dirname in dirs or []:
        (project / dirname).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return project


def write_git_config(project: Path, url: str) -> None:
    git_dir = project / ".git"
    git_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (git_dir / "config").write_text(
        '[core]\n\trepositoryformatversion = 0\n[remote "origin"]\n\turl = '
        + url
        + "\n\tfetch = +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )


def by_name(projects: list, name: str) -> dict:
    matches = [p for p in projects if p["name"] == name]
    assert matches, f"expected project {name!r} in results"
    return matches[0]


def test_detect_python_project(tmp_path):
    make_project(tmp_path, "pyproj", files={"pyproject.toml": "[project]\nname='x'\n"})
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[tmp_path])
    entry = by_name(projects, "pyproj")
    assert "python" in entry["types"]
    assert entry["git"] is False
    assert entry["path"] == str(tmp_path / "pyproj")


def test_detect_node_project(tmp_path):
    make_project(tmp_path, "nodeproj", files={"package.json": '{"name":"x"}'})
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[tmp_path])
    entry = by_name(projects, "nodeproj")
    assert "node" in entry["types"]
    assert "package.json" in entry["recognized_files"]


def test_detect_git_with_remote_safe(tmp_path):
    project = make_project(tmp_path, "gitproj", files={"README.md": "# hi"})
    write_git_config(project, "https://example.com/org/gitproj.git")
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[tmp_path])
    entry = by_name(projects, "gitproj")
    assert entry["git"] is True
    assert "git" in entry["types"]
    assert "documented" in entry["types"]
    assert entry["git_remote"] == "https://example.com/org/gitproj.git"


def test_git_without_remote_returns_none(tmp_path):
    make_project(tmp_path, "plainrepo", dirs=[".git"], files={"README.md": "# hi"})
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[tmp_path])
    entry = by_name(projects, "plainrepo")
    assert entry["git"] is True
    assert entry["git_remote"] is None


def test_backup_copy_detection(tmp_path):
    make_project(
        tmp_path,
        "INVENTory-Milestone-1E-BACKUP",
        files={"requirements.txt": "flask\n", "README.md": "# backup"},
    )
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[tmp_path])
    entry = by_name(projects, "INVENTory-Milestone-1E-BACKUP")
    assert entry["is_backup_copy"] is True


def test_non_backup_not_flagged(tmp_path):
    make_project(tmp_path, "myapp", files={"pyproject.toml": "[project]\n"})
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[tmp_path])
    entry = by_name(projects, "myapp")
    assert entry["is_backup_copy"] is False


def test_nested_repository_detection(tmp_path):
    outer = make_project(tmp_path, "outer", files={"README.md": "# outer"})
    write_git_config(outer, "https://example.com/org/outer.git")
    inner = outer / "INVENTory"
    inner.mkdir()
    (inner / "README.md").write_text("# inner", encoding="utf-8")
    (inner / ".git").mkdir()
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[tmp_path])
    inner_entry = by_name(projects, "INVENTory")
    outer_entry = by_name(projects, "outer")
    assert inner_entry["is_nested"] is True
    assert inner_entry["parent_project"] == str(outer)
    assert outer_entry["is_nested"] is False
    assert outer_entry["parent_project"] is None


def test_duplicate_name_detection(tmp_path):
    root_a = tmp_path / "a"
    root_b = tmp_path / "b"
    make_project(root_a, "myapp", files={"pyproject.toml": "[project]\n"})
    make_project(root_b, "myapp", files={"package.json": "{}"})
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[root_a, root_b])
    matches = [p for p in projects if p["name"] == "myapp"]
    assert len(matches) == 2
    for entry in matches:
        assert entry["duplicate_group"] == "name:myapp"
        assert len(entry["duplicate_candidates"]) == 1


def test_same_remote_candidates(tmp_path):
    url = "https://example.com/org/shared.git"
    first = make_project(tmp_path / "r1", "clone-a", files={"README.md": "# a"})
    second = make_project(tmp_path / "r2", "clone-b", files={"README.md": "# b"})
    write_git_config(first, url)
    write_git_config(second, url)
    projects = agent.find_projects(scan_roots=[tmp_path])
    first_entry = by_name(projects, "clone-a")
    second_entry = by_name(projects, "clone-b")
    assert str(second) in first_entry["same_remote_candidates"]
    assert str(first) in second_entry["same_remote_candidates"]

"""Tests for the M2B mapping/import layer (inventory_bridge.py).

Dry-run only: every test uses synthetic index documents or tmp_path fixtures.
No INVENTory process, database, network call or real project path is used.
"""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

import inventory_bridge as bridge
from inventory_bridge import (
    MAPPING_STATUSES,
    build_plan,
    classify_entry,
    dry_run,
    new_mapping_record,
)

STAMP = "2026-09-11T00:00:00+00:00"


def now():
    return STAMP


def make_entry(pid, path, name="app", **overrides):
    entry = {
        "id": pid,
        "path": path,
        "name": name,
        "types": ["python"],
        "git": False,
        "git_remote": None,
        "last_modified": None,
        "file_count": 1,
        "recognized_files": [],
        "is_backup_copy": False,
        "is_nested": False,
        "parent_id": None,
        "relations": {
            "parent_id": None,
            "nested_children_ids": [],
            "same_remote_ids": [],
            "shared_name_ids": [],
            "possible_copy_ids": [],
        },
    }
    entry.update(overrides)
    return entry


def make_index(entries, **extra):
    doc = {
        "index_version": "1.0.0",
        "computer": "PC-TEST",
        "provenance": {
            "source": "mycelium-desktop-agent:discovery.json",
            "discovery_timestamp": "2026-09-11T00:00:00",
            "indexed_at": STAMP,
            "indexer": "mycelium-project-index",
            "indexer_version": "1.0.0",
        },
        "projects": entries,
    }
    doc.update(extra)
    return doc


def mapping_by_id(plan, pid):
    matches = [m for m in plan["mappings"] if m["desktop_project_id"] == pid]
    assert matches, f"expected mapping for {pid}"
    return matches[0]


# --- record shape -----------------------------------------------------------

def test_mapping_record_has_required_fields():
    record = new_mapping_record("abc123", "C:/dev/alpha", "proposed", now=now)
    for field in ("desktop_project_id", "desktop_path", "inventory_project_id",
                  "mapping_status", "mapping_reason", "provenance", "created_at"):
        assert field in record, f"missing field {field}"
    assert record["provenance"]["source"] == "mycelium-desktop-agent:inventory-bridge"
    assert record["created_at"] == STAMP


def test_mapping_status_vocabulary():
    assert set(MAPPING_STATUSES) == {
        "unmapped", "proposed", "mapped", "copy",
        "nested", "rejected", "conflict",
    }


def test_fresh_record_defaults_to_unmapped_and_needs_approval():
    record = new_mapping_record("abc123", "C:/dev/alpha", now=now)
    assert record["mapping_status"] == "unmapped"
    assert record["requires_approval"] is True
    assert record["inventory_project_id"] is None


# --- classification ----------------------------------------------------------

def test_clean_project_yields_one_proposed_mapping():
    plan = build_plan(make_index([make_entry("id1", "C:/dev/alpha")]), now=now)
    mapping = mapping_by_id(plan, "id1")
    assert mapping["mapping_status"] == "proposed"
    assert mapping["requires_approval"] is True
    assert mapping["inventory_project_id"] is None
    assert mapping["proposed_inventory_project"] is not None
    assert plan["summary"]["proposed_mappings"] == 1
    assert plan["summary"]["desktop_projects_discovered"] == 1

    entries = [
        make_entry("id1", "C:/dev/alpha"),
        make_entry("id1", "C:/dev/alpha"),
    ]
    plan = build_plan(make_index(entries), now=now)
    assert plan["summary"]["desktop_projects_discovered"] == 1
    assert plan["summary"]["duplicate_paths_deduped"] == 1


def test_same_remote_does_not_merge_projects():
    url = "https://example.com/org/shared.git"
    entries = [
        make_entry("id1", "C:/a/one", git_remote=url, git=True, relations={
            "parent_id": None, "nested_children_ids": [],
            "same_remote_ids": ["id2"], "shared_name_ids": [],
            "possible_copy_ids": ["id2"]}),
        make_entry("id2", "C:/b/two", git_remote=url, git=True, relations={
            "parent_id": None, "nested_children_ids": [],
            "same_remote_ids": ["id1"], "shared_name_ids": [],
            "possible_copy_ids": ["id1"]}),
    ]
    plan = build_plan(make_index(entries), now=now)
    first = mapping_by_id(plan, "id1")
    second = mapping_by_id(plan, "id2")
    assert first["mapping_status"] == "conflict"
    assert second["mapping_status"] == "conflict"
    assert first["desktop_project_id"] != second["desktop_project_id"]
    # No silent merge: no shared inventory ID, no proposed project payload.
    assert first["inventory_project_id"] is None
    assert second["inventory_project_id"] is None
    assert first["proposed_inventory_project"] is None
    assert second["proposed_inventory_project"] is None
    assert plan["summary"]["ambiguous_mappings"] == 2


def test_shared_name_alone_is_conflict_not_merge():
    entries = [
        make_entry("id1", "C:/a/app", relations={
            "parent_id": None, "nested_children_ids": [],
            "same_remote_ids": [], "shared_name_ids": ["id2"],
            "possible_copy_ids": ["id2"]}),
        make_entry("id2", "C:/b/app", relations={
            "parent_id": None, "nested_children_ids": [],
            "same_remote_ids": [], "shared_name_ids": ["id1"],
            "possible_copy_ids": ["id1"]}),
    ]
    plan = build_plan(make_index(entries), now=now)
    assert mapping_by_id(plan, "id1")["mapping_status"] == "conflict"
    assert mapping_by_id(plan, "id2")["mapping_status"] == "conflict"


def test_nested_repositories_remain_distinguishable():
    entries = [
        make_entry("outer", "C:/dev/outer", relations={
            "parent_id": None, "nested_children_ids": ["inner"],
            "same_remote_ids": [], "shared_name_ids": [],
            "possible_copy_ids": []}),
        make_entry("inner", "C:/dev/outer/inner", is_nested=True,
                   parent_id="outer", relations={
                       "parent_id": "outer", "nested_children_ids": [],
                       "same_remote_ids": [], "shared_name_ids": [],
                       "possible_copy_ids": []}),
    ]
    plan = build_plan(make_index(entries), now=now)
    inner = mapping_by_id(plan, "inner")
    outer = mapping_by_id(plan, "outer")
    assert inner["mapping_status"] == "nested"
    assert inner["desktop_project_id"] != outer["desktop_project_id"]
    assert inner["evidence"]["parent_id"] == "outer"
    # Nested projects still get their own separate proposal, never folded in.
    assert inner["proposed_inventory_project"] is not None
    assert inner["proposed_inventory_project"]["for_desktop_id"] == "inner"
    assert any(p["desktop_project_id"] == "inner" for p in plan["nested"])
    assert plan["summary"]["nested_mappings"] == 1
    assert plan["summary"]["nested_relationships"] == 1

# --- provenance ----------------------------------------------------------------

def test_provenance_exists_on_plan_and_every_mapping():
    entries = [make_entry("id1", "C:/dev/alpha"),
               make_entry("bak", "C:/backups/app", is_backup_copy=True)]
    plan = build_plan(make_index(entries), now=now)
    assert plan["provenance"]["source"] == "mycelium-desktop-agent:inventory-bridge"
    assert plan["provenance"]["mode"] == "dry-run-proposal"
    assert plan["provenance"]["created_at"] == STAMP
    for mapping in plan["mappings"]:
        assert mapping["provenance"]["source"] == "mycelium-desktop-agent:inventory-bridge"
        assert mapping["provenance"]["desktop_project_id"] == mapping["desktop_project_id"]
        assert mapping["created_at"] == STAMP
        assert mapping["mapping_reason"]
    for payload in plan["proposed_projects"]:
        assert payload["provenance"]["source_type"] == "imported"
        assert payload["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False

def test_dry_run_performs_zero_inventory_writes(tmp_path):

                      "urllib.request", "requests", "TestClient", "uvicorn"):

def test_existing_inventory_projects_are_not_overwritten():

    plan = build_plan(make_index([entry]),
                      existing_inventory_ids=["proj_existing"],
                      now=now)

        assert "id" not in payload
    for mapping in plan["mappings"]:
        assert mapping["inventory_project_id"] in (None,)
    operations = {m["mapping_status"] for m in plan["mappings"]}
    assert operations <= set(MAPPING_STATUSES)

def test_invalid_entries_are_handled_safely():
    index = make_index([
        make_entry("good", "C:/dev/good"),
        {"no": "id-or-path"},
        "not-a-dict",
        {"id": "nopath"},
    ])
    plan = build_plan(index, now=now)
    # "good" is proposed; {"id": "nopath"} keeps a rejected record (it has an
    # id to key on); the two entries without any id cannot form a mapping and
    # are skipped safely.
    assert plan["summary"]["desktop_projects_discovered"] == 2
    assert mapping_by_id(plan, "good")["mapping_status"] == "proposed"
    rejected = mapping_by_id(plan, "nopath")
    assert rejected["mapping_status"] == "rejected"
    assert rejected["requires_approval"] is False
    assert rejected["proposed_inventory_project"] is None
    assert plan["summary"]["rejected_mappings"] == 1
    assert plan["summary"]["skipped_invalid"] == 2
    assert len(plan["skipped_invalid"]) == 2

        try:
            build_plan(bad, now=now)
        except ValueError:
            pass
        else:

        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("expected FileNotFoundError")

def test_dry_run_answers_all_seven_questions():

        "parent_id": None, "nested_children_ids": ["inner"],
        "same_remote_ids": [], "shared_name_ids": [], "possible_copy_ids": []})
    inner = make_entry("inner", "C:/dev/outer/inner", is_nested=True,
                       parent_id="outer", relations={
                           "parent_id": "outer", "nested_children_ids": [],
                           "same_remote_ids": [], "shared_name_ids": [],
                           "possible_copy_ids": []})
    solo = make_entry("solo", "C:/dev/solo")
    plan = build_plan(make_index([outer, inner, solo]), now=now)
    assert len(plan["discovered"]) == 3                      # 1. discovered
    # 2. proposed: solo (clean) + outer (clean parent) + inner (nested but
    #    kept distinguishable with its own separate proposal)
    assert len(plan["proposed_projects"]) == 3
    assert plan["copies"] == []                              # 3. copies
    assert len(plan["nested"]) == 1                          # 4. nested
    assert plan["ambiguous"] == []                           # 5. ambiguous
    assert set(plan["requires_approval"]) == {"outer", "inner", "solo"}  # 6. approval
    assert plan["would_create"]["projects"] == plan["proposed_projects"]  # 7. would-create
    assert plan["would_create"]["relationships"]
    # Whole plan stays machine-readable JSON.
    json.dumps(plan)

"""Tests for the approval-gated M2B writer (inventory_writer.py).

All INVENTory interaction uses in-process fakes; the checkpoint layer uses
injected fakes. No HTTP, no database, no real project is touched. Every
refusal test asserts zero client calls.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

import inventory_bridge as bridge
import inventory_writer as writer
from inventory_writer import (
    IMPORT_ACTION,
    WriteRefusedError,
    request_approval_and_write,
    validate_project_payload,
    write_approved_mapping,
)
from mapping_store import MappingStore

STAMP = "2026-09-11T00:00:00+00:00"


class FakeInventoryClient:
    def __init__(self, proj_id="proj_test123"):
        self.calls = []
        self.proj_id = proj_id

    def create_project(self, payload):
        self.calls.append(dict(payload))
        return {"id": self.proj_id, "name": payload["name"]}


_dir_counter = {"n": 0}


def make_dir(tmp_path, name=None):
    _dir_counter["n"] += 1
    target = tmp_path / (name or f"proj{_dir_counter['n']}")
    target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    return str(target)


def valid_payload(name="alpha"):
    return {
        "name": name,
        "description": "synthetic test project",
        "status": "planned",
        "provenance": {
            "source_type": "imported",
            "creator_id": "mycelium-desktop-agent:inventory-bridge",
            "human_verified": False,
        },
    }


def import_approval(target, approved=True):
    return {"approved": approved, "action": IMPORT_ACTION,
            "target": target, "request_id": "test-req"}


def checkpoint_approval(target, approved=True):
    return {"approved": approved, "action": "create_git_checkpoint",
            "target": target, "request_id": "test-ckpt"}


def call_writer(tmp_path, status="proposed", is_git=False, **overrides):
    desktop = make_dir(tmp_path)
    params = {
        "desktop_id": "abc123",
        "desktop_path": desktop,
        "is_git": is_git,
        "payload": valid_payload(),
        "mapping_status": status,
        "approval": import_approval(desktop),
        "inventory_client": FakeInventoryClient(),
        "store": MappingStore(),
        "allowed_roots": [str(tmp_path)],
        "now": lambda: STAMP,
    }
    params.update(overrides)
    return params


# --- refusals: zero writes -----------------------------------------------------

def test_denied_approval_writes_nothing(tmp_path):
    params = call_writer(tmp_path)
    params["approval"] = import_approval(params["desktop_path"], approved=False)
    with pytest.raises(WriteRefusedError):
        write_approved_mapping(**params)
    assert params["inventory_client"].calls == []


def test_missing_approval_writes_nothing(tmp_path):

    with pytest.raises(WriteRefusedError):
        write_approved_mapping(**params)
    assert params["inventory_client"].calls == []


def test_wrong_action_approval_writes_nothing(tmp_path):

    params["approval"] = {"approved": True, "action": "something_else",
                          "target": params["desktop_path"]}

        write_approved_mapping(**params)
    assert params["inventory_client"].calls == []

def test_checkpoint_failure_writes_nothing(tmp_path):
    order = []

    def fail_checkpoint(repository, approval, message=None):
        order.append("checkpoint")
        raise RuntimeError("git exploded")

    class RecordingClient(FakeInventoryClient):
        def create_project(self, payload):
            order.append("create")
            return super().create_project(payload)

    desktop = make_dir(tmp_path)
    client = RecordingClient()

        write_approved_mapping(
            desktop_id="abc123", desktop_path=desktop, is_git=True,
            payload=valid_payload(), mapping_status="proposed",
            approval=import_approval(desktop),
            checkpoint_approval=checkpoint_approval(str(Path(desktop).resolve())),
            inventory_client=client, store=MappingStore(),
            allowed_roots=[str(tmp_path)], checkpoint_func=fail_checkpoint,
            now=lambda: STAMP,
        )

    assert client.calls == []

"""Tests for the explicit permission gate."""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from permissions import PermissionGate, request_permission


def decisions(log_path: Path):
    return [json.loads(line) for line in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]


def test_permission_default_deny_without_input(tmp_path):
    log_path = tmp_path / "permissions.jsonl"
    gate = PermissionGate(log_path=log_path)
    approval = gate.request_permission("modify", "C:/tmp/project", {"reason": "test"})
    assert approval["approved"] is False
    assert approval["decision"] == "denied"
    assert approval["decision_source"] == "default-deny"
    assert decisions(log_path) == [approval]


def test_permission_default_deny(tmp_path):
    log_path = tmp_path / "permissions.jsonl"
    gate = PermissionGate(log_path=log_path, input_func=lambda _prompt: "")
    approval = gate.request_permission("modify", "C:/tmp/project", {"reason": "test"})
    assert approval["approved"] is False
    assert approval["decision"] == "denied"
    assert approval["decision_source"] == "human-input"
    assert decisions(log_path) == [approval]


def test_permission_requires_exact_yes(tmp_path):
    log_path = tmp_path / "permissions.jsonl"
    gate = PermissionGate(log_path=log_path, input_func=lambda _prompt: "YES")
    approval = gate.request_permission(
        "modify",
        "C:/tmp/project",
        {"reason": "controlled test modification"},
    )
    assert approval["approved"] is True
    assert approval["decision"] == "approved"
    assert approval["response"] == "YES"
    assert decisions(log_path)[0]["approved"] is True


def test_permission_reject_without_explicit_yes(tmp_path):
    log_path = tmp_path / "permissions.jsonl"
    gate = PermissionGate(log_path=log_path, input_func=lambda _prompt: "no")
    approval = gate.request_permission("delete", "C:/tmp/project", "test rejection")
    assert approval["approved"] is False
    assert approval["response"] == "DENY"
    assert decisions(log_path)[0]["decision"] == "denied"


def test_permission_log_has_timestamp_and_provenance(tmp_path):
    log_path = tmp_path / "permissions.jsonl"
    now = iter(["2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "2026-01-01T00:00:01+00:00"])
    gate = PermissionGate(
        log_path=log_path,
        input_func=lambda _prompt: "YES",
        now=lambda: next(now),
    )
    approval = gate.request_permission(
        "checkpoint",
        "C:/tmp/project",
        {"reason": "before modification"},
    )
    logged = decisions(log_path)[0]
    assert logged["requested_at"] == "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
    assert logged["decided_at"] == "2026-01-01T00:00:01+00:00"
    assert logged["provenance"]["source"] == "mycelium-desktop-agent:permission"
    assert logged["provenance"]["mode"] == "explicit-human-confirmation"
    assert logged["provenance"]["default"] == "deny"
    assert approval == logged


def test_interactive_wrapper_requires_exact_yes(tmp_path):
    log_path = tmp_path / "permissions.jsonl"
    approval = request_permission(
        "modify",
        "C:/tmp/project",
        {"reason": "interactive test"},
        input_func=lambda _prompt: "YES",
        log_path=log_path,
    )
    assert approval["approved"] is True
    assert decisions(log_path)[0]["approved"] is True

<file path="Mycelium/agent/tests/test_project_index.py">
"""Tests for the Mycelium project index layer (project_index.py).

All tests are local-only and use synthetic discovery documents or tmp_path
fixtures — never the real Desktop/Documents/Downloads folders and never
the real discovery.json / project_index.json.
"""

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

import agent
import project_index
from project_index import build_index, project_id


def make_discovery(paths, computer="PC-TEST", **extra):
    projects = []
    for spec in paths:
        if isinstance(spec, str):
            spec = {"path": spec}
        entry = {
            "path": spec["path"],
            "name": spec.get("name", Path(spec["path"]).name),
            "types": spec.get("types", ["python"]),
            "git": spec.get("git", False),
            "git_remote": spec.get("git_remote"),
            "last_modified": spec.get("last_modified"),
            "file_count": spec.get("file_count", 0),
            "recognized_files": spec.get("recognized_files", []),
            "is_backup_copy": spec.get("is_backup_copy", False),
            "is_nested": spec.get("is_nested", False),
            "parent_project": spec.get("parent_project"),
        }
        projects.append(entry)
    doc = {
        "timestamp": "2026-09-11T00:00:00",
        "computer": computer,
        "scanner": {"name": "mycelium-desktop-agent", "version": "0.2.0",
                    "mode": "local-readonly", "source": "local-filesystem-scan"},
        "projects": projects,
    }
    doc.update(extra)
    return doc


def by_id(index, pid):
    matches = [p for p in index["projects"] if p["id"] == pid]
    assert matches, f"expected id {pid} in index"
    return matches[0]


def test_ids_deterministic_across_builds():
    doc = make_discovery(["C:/dev/alpha", "C:/dev/beta"])
    first = build_index(doc, indexed_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00")
    second = build_index(doc, indexed_at="2026-06-01T00:00:00")
    assert [p["id"] for p in first["projects"]] == [p["id"] for p in second["projects"]]

<file path="Mycelium/agent/agent.py">
"""Mycelium Desktop Agent — local-first, read-only discovery scanner.

Scans Desktop, Documents and Downloads for recognizable project folders
and writes a JSON inventory to discovery.json next to this file.

Read-only: never deletes, moves or modifies user projects.
No network, no external APIs, no AI models.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import configparser
import hashlib
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime

SCANNER_NAME = "mycelium-desktop-agent"
SCANNER_MODE = "local-readonly"

HOME = Path.home()

SCAN_ROOTS = [
    HOME / "Desktop",
    HOME / "Documents",
    HOME / "Downloads",
]

IGNORE = {
    ".git",
    ".venv",
    "node_modules",
    "__pycache__",
    ".pytest_cache",
}

# Marker file/dir -> project type. Original five mappings are kept intact
# for backward compatibility with the Flask UI; the rest only extends.
MARKERS = {
    ".git": "git",
    "pyproject.toml": "python",
    "setup.py": "python",
    "setup.cfg": "python",
    "requirements.txt": "python",
    "package.json": "node",
    "package-lock.json": "node",
    "yarn.lock": "node",
    "README.md": "documented",
    "README.rst": "documented",
    "README.txt": "documented",
}

# Recognizable project files reported per project (existence only, safe).
RECOGNIZED_FILES = [
    ".git",
    "pyproject.toml",
    "setup.py",
    "setup.cfg",
    "requirements.txt",
    "package.json",
    "package-lock.json",
    "yarn.lock",
    "README.md",
    "README.rst",
    "README.txt",
    "LICENSE",
    "LICENSE.md",
    ".gitignore",
    "Dockerfile",
    "docker-compose.yml",
    "docker-compose.yaml",
    "Makefile",
]

BACKUP_KEYWORDS = (
    "backup",
    "-bak",
    "_bak",
    ".bak",
    "copy",
    "kopie",
    "-old",
    "_old",
    ".old",
    "(1)",
    "(2)",
    " - copy",
    "_copy",
    "-copy",
)

FILE_COUNT_LIMIT = 5000
GIT_CONFIG_MAX_BYTES = 102_400


def scanner_version() -> str:
    """Single source of truth: agent.json next to this file."""
    try:
        meta = json.loads((Path(__file__).parent / "agent.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        version = str(meta.get("version", "0.2.0"))
        return version if version else "0.2.0"
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return "0.2.0"


def computer_name() -> str:
    return (
        os.environ.get("COMPUTERNAME")
        or os.environ.get("COMPUTER")
        or os.environ.get("HOSTNAME")
        or "unknown"
    )


def _is_ignored(path: Path) -> bool:
    return any(part in IGNORE for part in path.parts)


def _detect_types(path: Path) -> list:
    found = []
    for marker, kind in MARKERS.items():
        try:
            if (path / marker).exists() and kind not in found:
                found.append(kind)
        except OSError:
            continue
    return found


def is_backup_copy(path: Path) -> bool:
    name = path.name.lower()
    return any(keyword in name for keyword in BACKUP_KEYWORDS)


def _resolve_git_dir(project_path: Path) -> Path | None:
    """Resolve the .git directory without running any git command.

    Handles both a .git directory and a .git file (worktree/gitlink).
    Returns None when there is no usable git dir. Read-only.
    """
    dot_git = project_path / ".git"
    try:
        if dot_git.is_dir():
            return dot_git
        if dot_git.is_file():
            try:
                content = dot_git.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").strip()
            except OSError:
                return None
            if content.lower().startswith("gitdir:"):
                target = content.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                candidate = (project_path / target).resolve() if not os.path.isabs(target) else Path(target)
                try:
                    if candidate.is_dir():
                        return candidate
                except OSError:
                    return None
            return None
    except OSError:
        return None
    return None


def read_git_remote_safe(project_path: Path) -> str | None:
    """Read the origin remote URL from .git/config only. No subprocess, no network.

    Returns the URL string or None when absent/unreadable. Never raises.
    """
    try:
        git_dir = _resolve_git_dir(project_path)
        if git_dir is None:
            return None
        config_path = git_dir / "config"
        if not config_path.is_file():
            return None
        if config_path.stat().st_size > GIT_CONFIG_MAX_BYTES:
            return None
        parser = configparser.ConfigParser()
        try:
            parser.read(config_path, encoding="utf-8")
        except (OSError, configparser.Error, UnicodeError):
            return None
        for section in parser.sections():
            if section.strip().lower() == 'remote "origin"':
                try:
                    url = parser.get(section, "url", fallback=None)
                except configparser.Error:
                    url = None
                if url:
                    url = url.strip()
                    return url or None
                return None
        return None
    except OSError:
        return None


def count_files_safe(path: Path, limit: int = FILE_COUNT_LIMIT) -> int:
    """Count files under path, pruning ignored dirs. Capped at limit. Never raises."""
    total = 0
    try:
        for current, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(path, onerror=lambda err: None, followlinks=False):
            # Prune ignored directories to keep scans fast and avoid venv/node_modules noise.
            dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames if d not in IGNORE]
            total += len(filenames)
            if total >= limit:
                return limit
    except OSError:
        pass
    return total


def last_modified_safe(path: Path) -> str | None:
    try:
        return datetime.fromtimestamp(path.stat().st_mtime).isoformat()
    except OSError:
        return None


def recognized_files_safe(path: Path) -> list:
    present = []
    for filename in RECOGNIZED_FILES:
        try:
            if (path / filename).exists():
                present.append(filename)
        except OSError:
            continue
    return present


def stable_id(computer: str, path_str: str) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha1(f"{computer.lower()}|{path_str.lower()}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    return digest[:16]


def find_projects(scan_roots=None, found_at: str | None = None, computer: str | None = None) -> list:
    """Scan for projects and enrich each entry with safe metadata.

    Keeps backward-compatible keys: path, types, git.
    Accepts custom scan_roots for testability. Read-only, never raises
    for unreadable directories; those entries are skipped or marked None.
    """
    roots = list(scan_roots) if scan_roots is not None else list(SCAN_ROOTS)
    timestamp = found_at or datetime.now().isoformat()
    host = computer or computer_name()
    version = scanner_version()

    candidates: list[dict] = []

    for root in roots:
        root = Path(root)
        try:
            if not root.exists():
                continue
        except OSError:
            continue

        try:
            entries = root.rglob("*")
        except OSError:
            continue

        for path in entries:
            try:
                if not path.is_dir():
                    continue
            except OSError:
                continue

            if _is_ignored(path):
                continue

            types = _detect_types(path)
            if not types:
                continue

            try:
                path_str = str(path)
            except OSError:
                continue

            has_git = "git" in types
            candidates.append({
                # Backward-compatible keys (used by the Flask UI).
                "path": path_str,
                "types": types,
                "git": has_git,
                # Enriched metadata (all safe, existence/mtime only).
                "name": path.name,
                "git_remote": read_git_remote_safe(path) if has_git else None,
                "last_modified": last_modified_safe(path),
                "file_count": count_files_safe(path),
                "recognized_files": recognized_files_safe(path),
                "is_backup_copy": is_backup_copy(path),
                # Filled in second pass below.
                "is_nested": False,
                "parent_project": None,
                "duplicate_group": None,
                "duplicate_candidates": [],
                "same_remote_candidates": [],
                # Future INVENTory/Mycelium linkage (deterministic, local only).
                "inventory": {
                    "entity_type": "local_project",
                    "stable_id": stable_id(host, path_str),
                    "sync_ready": True,
                },
                # Provenance: locally found, when, by which scanner.
                "provenance": {
                    "source": "local-filesystem-scan",
                    "found_at": timestamp,
                    "scanner": SCANNER_NAME,
                    "scanner_version": version,
                },
            })

    # Deterministic output order.
    candidates.sort(key=lambda item: item["path"].lower())

    # Second pass: nested repositories (a project inside another project).
    path_set = {item["path"] for item in candidates}
    for item in candidates:
        parents = list(Path(item["path"]).parents)
        parent_hit = None
        for parent in parents:
            if str(parent) in path_set:
                # Nearest ancestor wins: parents are ordered nearest-first.
                if parent_hit is None or len(str(parent)) > len(parent_hit):
                    parent_hit = str(parent)
        if parent_hit is not None:
            item["is_nested"] = True
            item["parent_project"] = parent_hit

    # Second pass: possible duplicate locations (same folder name, >1 location).
    by_name: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for item in candidates:
        by_name.setdefault(item["name"].lower(), []).append(item)
    for name_lower, group in by_name.items():
        if len(group) > 1:
            group_id = f"name:{name_lower}"
            for item in group:
                item["duplicate_group"] = group_id
                item["duplicate_candidates"] = sorted(
                    other["path"] for other in group if other["path"] != item["path"]
                )

    # Second pass: same git remote in multiple locations (copies/clones).
    by_remote: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for item in candidates:
        remote = item.get("git_remote")
        if remote:
            by_remote.setdefault(remote, []).append(item)
    for group in by_remote.values():
        if len(group) > 1:
            for item in group:
                item["same_remote_candidates"] = sorted(
                    other["path"] for other in group if other["path"] != item["path"]
                )

    return candidates


def build_result(scan_roots=None) -> dict:
    timestamp = datetime.now().isoformat()
    host = computer_name()
    version = scanner_version()
    roots = [str(Path(r)) for r in (scan_roots if scan_roots is not None else SCAN_ROOTS)]
    projects = find_projects(scan_roots=scan_roots, found_at=timestamp, computer=host)

    duplicate_groups = sorted({p["duplicate_group"] for p in projects if p.get("duplicate_group")})

    return {
        # Backward-compatible top-level keys.
        "timestamp": timestamp,
        "computer": host,
        "projects": projects,
        # Provenance of this scan.
        "scanner": {
            "name": SCANNER_NAME,
            "version": version,
            "mode": SCANNER_MODE,
            "source": "local-filesystem-scan",
        },
        "scan_roots": roots,
        "summary": {
            "total_projects": len(projects),
            "git_count": sum(1 for p in projects if p.get("git")),
            "python_count": sum(1 for p in projects if "python" in p.get("types", [])),
            "node_count": sum(1 for p in projects if "node" in p.get("types", [])),
            "documented_count": sum(1 for p in projects if "documented" in p.get("types", [])),
            "backup_copy_count": sum(1 for p in projects if p.get("is_backup_copy")),
            "nested_count": sum(1 for p in projects if p.get("is_nested")),
            "duplicate_groups": len(duplicate_groups),
        },
    }


def main():
    result = build_result()

    output = Path(__file__).parent / "discovery.json"
    output.write_text(
        json.dumps(result, indent=2),
        encoding="utf-8"
    )

    print(f"Found {len(result['projects'])} project locations.")
    print(f"Saved: {output.resolve()}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<file path="Mycelium/agent/ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.md">
# ARCHITECTURE CONTRACT — Milestone 1F

Contract voor Mycelium AI + INVENTory + Desktop Agent. Vastgesteld op basis van
analyse van de bestaande implementatie (zie §H). Alleen analyserend en
vastleggend: geen codewijzigingen, geen API's, geen UI-wijzigingen.

Analysebronnen: `agent/agent.py` v0.2.0, `agent/agent_ui.py`, `agent/discovery.json`
(9 projecten), `agent/project_index.py` v1.0.0, `agent/project_index.json`
(9 projecten, 7 met relaties), `agent/README.md`, `agent/WORLD_MODEL.md`,
`agent/CANONICAL_PROJECTS.md`, `agent/tests/` (35 tests), INVENTory
(`inventory/app/main.py`, `schemas.py`, `README.md`, `tests/`, FastAPI :8080,
SQLite WAL), Mycelium (`mycelium-ai-main`: `coordinator/`, `node_client/`,
`docs/architecture.md`, `tests/`, :8000).

Reparatiestatus Milestone 1G (2026-09-11): §I.1 en §I.2 zijn hersteld
(INVENTory-README dekt Milestones 1A+1B; testaantal 35 geverifieerd).
Resterende §I-punten zijn gedocumenteerde openstaande interfaces, geen
contradicties meer.

## A. Rollen

- **Desktop Agent** (`agent/`): observeert het lokale filesystem (Desktop,
  Documents, Downloads), read-only. Produceert `discovery.json` (observaties)
  en `project_index.json` (identiteit + relaties). UI op :8787 toont alleen.
  Voert nooit mutaties uit aan gebruikersprojecten; enige schrijfactie is het
  (her)schrijven van de eigen twee JSON-bestanden.
- **INVENTory** (`inventory/`): wereldmodel-store voor fysiek én digitaal.
  SQLite (WAL), FastAPI-REST + server-rendered UI op :8080. Entiteiten met
  `obj_`/`proj_`/`idea_`/`rel_`/`evt_`-IDs en afgedwongen provenance
  (AI-gegenereerd = standaard ongeverifieerd). Bewaart staat en historie;
  beslist niets.
- **Mycelium Brain/Orchestrator** (`mycelium-ai-main/`, ambitie): reasoning,
  coördinatie en actie-aansturing. Huidige realiteit: `coordinator/` is een
  taakqueue met capability-matching (tiers seed/worker/core, nodes pollen),
  géén reasoning. De server verstuurt nooit uitvoerbare code; enige
  allow-list-taak is `system_inventory`. Elke AI-beslislaag is TOEKOMST en valt
  onder §D en §F.

## B. Wat INVENTory als wereldmodel moet representeren

| Concept | Status in INVENTory | Dekking |
|---|---|---|
| fysieke objecten | AANWEZIG | `Object` (naam, beschrijving, aantal) |
| hardware | ONTBREEKT | geen entiteit; hooguit als `Object`-tekst |
| sensoren | ONTBREEKT | alleen bronlabel `sensor-observed`, geen `Sensor`-entiteit |
| camera's | ONTBREEKT | geen entiteit, geen pipeline |
| software/projecten | AANWEZIG | `Project` + status (`idea…archived`) |
| bestanden/code | ONTBREEKT | gepland als Milestone 3 (Files + SHA-256) |
| materialen | ONTBREEKT | alleen als `Object`-beschrijving |
| locaties | ONTBREEKT | alleen predicaat `stored_in`, geen `Location`-entiteit |
| projecten | AANWEZIG | `Project` |
| ideeën | AANWEZIG | `Idea` + status (`raw…converted`) |
| modellen (AI) | ONTBREEKT | geen register; zie §D |
| events | AANWEZIG | `Event` (alle CRUD-overgangen) + `GET /api/v1/events` |
| relaties | AANWEZIG | `Relationship`, 10 predicaten, geen zelfreferentie |

## C. Kernrelaties → INVENTory-predicaat

| Relatie | Predicaat | Status |
|---|---|---|
| object → project | `used_in` / `part_of` | ONDERSTEUND |
| hardware → sensor | — | ONTBREEKT (geen entiteiten) |
| hardware → project | (`uses`) | ONTBREEKT (geen hardware-entiteit) |
| file → project | — | ONTBREEKT (wacht op Files, M3) |
| project → project | `depends_on` / `related_to` | ONDERSTEUND |
| object → location | `stored_in` | GEDEELTELIJK (geen Location-entiteit) |
| sensor → observation | — | ONTBREEKT (geen Sensor-entiteit, geen observatie-tabel) |
| idea → project | `became` / `led_to` | ONDERSTEUND |
| model → task | — | ONTBREEKT (geen modelregister; Mycelium-taken kennen alleen capability-strings) |
| event → entity | `Event.entity_id` | ONDERSTEUND |

De Desktop Agent levert verwante paren (`same_remote_ids`, `shared_name_ids`,
`possible_copy_ids`, `nested_children_ids`); het contract schrijft voor deze bij
import te vertalen naar bovenstaande predicaten (bv. `possible_copy_ids` →
`related_to` + metadata `{basis: same_remote|shared_name}`, nooit automatisch
samenvoegen).

## D. Model-agnostische AI (bindend)

- Alle AI-capabilities lopen via adapters/interfaces. Directe koppeling van
  core/database aan één model is verboden.
- Adapter-contract (te implementeren): input = index + plan-context, output =
  plan-voorstel (data, geen actie). Adapter vermeldt model + versie in provenance.
- Bestaande fundamenten: INVENTory-bron `ai-generated` + validator
  (`human_verified=False` tenzij `verified_by`); Mycelium allow-list
  (`system_inventory`) als precedent voor kleinste veilige capability.
- Wat ontbreekt: de interface zelf — nergens code voor; eerste adapter krijgt
  géén executierechten (alleen voorstellen).

## E. Physical-world architecture (normatieve lus)

`observe → understand → plan → permission → act → verify → record`

- observe: Desktop Agent (digitaal), INVENTory-objecten/sensoren (fysiek).
- understand/plan: Mycelium (TOEKOMST als runtime; nu alleen core loop op papier).
- permission: gate vóór elke mutatie (§F; code ONTBREEKT).
- act: skills met gedeclareerde output-grenzen; fysieke actuatie altijd achter een gate.
- verify: testsuites na wijzigingen; fysieke verificatie via nieuwe observatie.
- record: INVENTory-events + Git-checkpoints + provenance.

## F. Safety (bindend, per item met status)

1. Read-only discovery by default — GEÏMPLEMENTEERD (`SCANNER_MODE=local-readonly`).
2. Inspect before modify — BELEID (`README.md`), geen afdwinging in code.
3. Explicit permission voor destructieve wijzigingen — BELEID, geen gate-code.
4. Git-checkpoint vóór wijziging van getrackte projecten — ONTBREEKT (voorgesteld: `checkpoint.py`).
5. Test na wijzigingen — GEÏMPLEMENTEERD als suites (35 agent-tests; INVENTory-suite, zie §I.2), maar geen automatische koppeling aan acties.
6. Provenance voor AI-gegenereerde informatie — GEÏMPLEMENTEERD in INVENTory
   (`enforce_ai_unverified_rule`); Desktop Agent/index hebben nog géén
   `ai-generated`-bron (ze produceren ook geen AI-output — consistent).
7. Fysieke acties vereisen expliciete toestemming tot een toekomstige veilige
   automatiseringslaag bestaat — VACUÜM WAAR (er bestaan geen actuatoren), als
   norm vastgelegd zodat de eerste actuator er nooit omheen kan.

## G. Dataflow (normatief)

`Desktop Agent → Project Index → INVENTory → Mycelium → controlled workspace → tests/checkpoint → INVENTory/event history`

- Elke pijl is een expliciete, lokale overdracht met provenance; geen laag
  schrijft direct in een andere laag.
- `controlled workspace` bestaat nog niet: gedefinieerd als de enige plek waar
  goedgekeurde plannen worden uitgevoerd (werk-kopieën, nooit live projectmappen).
- Terugkoppeling (`event history`) is het enige toegestane pad van uitvoering
  terug naar het wereldmodel.

## H. Grenzen tussen de drie componenten

| Grens | Mechanisme | Contract |
|---|---|---|
| Desktop Agent → Project Index | bestand | `discovery.json` in, `project_index.json` uit; index bindt via `discovery_timestamp` |
| Project Index → INVENTory | REST (TOEKOMST) | `POST /api/v1/projects` + `POST /api/v1/relationships`; mappingtabel desktop-ID ↔ `proj_`-ID (ONTBREEKT, vereist) |
| Mycelium → INVENTory | REST (TOEKOMST, gepland M5) | alleen lezen + voorstellen; coordinator ziet vandaag geen bestanden/sensordata (bewust, `docs/architecture.md`) |
| INVENTory → Mycelium | REST/events (TOEKOMST) | wereldstaat + historie als context, nooit als opdracht |
| Mens → alles | UI's + gates | :8787 (lezen), :8080 (CRUD + webformulieren), :8000 (dashboard); destructief/fysiek alleen na expliciete toestemming |
| Mycelium → workspace | bestand/proces (TOEKOMST) | `controlled workspace` = werk-kopieën, nooit live projectmappen; enige plek waar goedgekeurde plannen draaien |
| ID-ruimten | gescheiden | agent: `sha1(computer\|pad)[:16]` zonder prefix; INVENTory: `obj_/proj_/idea_/rel_/evt_`; koppeling alleen via mappingtabel |

Binnen `agent/` geldt bovendien: `agent_ui.py` leest `discovery.json` direct en
slaat de indexlaag over (§I.5).

## I. Contradicties en ontbrekende interfaces (gevonden bij analyse)

1. ~~Stale INVENTory-README~~ **HERSTELD in 1G**: README dekt nu Milestones 1A+1B
   (Project/Idea/Relationship/Event-CRUD + event-stream + UI-pagina's) en noemt
   expliciet wat ontbreekt. Resterende plan-items: M3 (Conversations/Files),
   M4 (FTS5/graaf), M5 (Mycelium↔INVENTory REST).
2. ~~Testaantal INVENTory~~ **GEVERIFIEERD in 1G**: canonieke suite = 35 tests
   in 3 bestanden, 35/35 groen op 2026-09-11. Oudere "73/73"-claims zijn niet
   reproduceerbaar en worden nergens meer gesteld (INVENTory-README,
   `WORLD_MODEL.md` en dit contract).
3. **ID-kloof — VOLGENDE KERNINTERFACE (M2B)**: geen mapping tussen
   desktop-project-ID (`stable_id`) en INVENTory-`proj_`-ID; het index-haakveld
   `inventory: {stable_id, sync_ready}` wordt door geen enkele schrijver gevuld
   of gelezen. Canoniek-vs-kopie-beleid staat in `agent/CANONICAL_PROJECTS.md`:
   kopie-ID's worden als `copy_of` gemarkeerd, nooit als zelfstandige projecten
   geïmporteerd.
4. **Entiteitsgaten** (§B): hardware, sensor, camera, file, material, location,
   model, task ontbreken als entiteit; C-relaties hardware→sensor,
   sensor→observation, file→project, model→task zijn daardoor niet uitdrukbaar.
   Fysieke entiteiten (hardware, sensor, camera, materiaal, locatie, model, taak,
   observatie/event) mogen later via hetzelfde wereldmodel worden toegevoegd —
   nu alleen gedocumenteerd, GEEN entiteit toegevoegd in 1G.
5. **UI slaat index over**: `agent_ui.py` leest `discovery.json`, niet
   `project_index.json` — relaties/ID's zijn onzichtbaar in de UI.
6. **Geen gate-/checkpoint-code**: §F items 2–4 zijn beleid zonder afdwinging;
   enige schrijfactie in `agent/` is ongegatede lokale herschrijf van eigen JSON
   (acceptabel, maar precedent voor discipline).
7. **Geen import-/dedup-beleid**: index kent 7/9 gerelateerde (kopie/nested)
   projecten; INVENTory heeft geen regel wat er gebeurt als die geïmporteerd
   worden. Gedeeltelijk afgedekt in 1G: `agent/CANONICAL_PROJECTS.md` legt vast
   welke checkout canoniek is en verbiedt automatisch samenvoegen; volledige
   mappingtabel + `copy_of`-markering is M2B-werk.
8. **Zwakke index-binding**: index bewaart `discovery_timestamp` maar geen hash
   van de discovery-inhoud; staleness is detecteerbaar op tijd, niet op inhoud.
9. **Mycelium↔INVENTory-spanning**: coordinator mag bewust geen
   bestanden/sensordata zien (privacy-ontwerp), terwijl M5 juist
   hardware-inventarisatie-koppeling wil — vereist expliciete, minimale
   interface (alleen vrijwillige profielen + provenance), geen algemene lezing.
10. **Auth ontbreekt overal** (:8787/:8080/:8000 zonder tokens; Mycelium-docs
    noemen API-tokens als toekomstige stap) — acceptabel lokaal, moet expliciet
    blijven tot besloten wordt anders.

## J. Volgende 5 milestones (geprioriteerd)

1. **M1G — Contract-reparatie zonder code-risico**: INVENTory-README
   gelijkzetten met realiteit (M1B-geïmplementeerd markeren), testaantal
   ophelderen, `stored_in`-conventie documenteren. Klein, deblokkeert alles.
2. **M2A — Permission gates + `checkpoint.py`**: gate-functie +
   Git-checkpoint-skill met tests op tmp-repos; §F items 2–4 worden afdwingbaar.
   Vereist vóór elke mutatie- of import-mijlpaal.
3. **M2B — Index→INVENTory import (read-only eerst)**: mappingtabel
   desktop-ID ↔ `proj_`-ID, dry-run-modus, dedup-beleid (§I.7), provenance-bron
   voor index-import, C-vertaling `possible_copy_ids → related_to`. Pas daarna
   echt schrijven.
4. **M3 — Wereldmodel-entiteiten fase 1**: `Location`, `File` (+SHA-256, reeds
   gepland), minimale `Hardware`/`Sensor`-schema's; daarmee worden C-relaties
   hardware→sensor, sensor→observation, file→project, object→location
   uitdrukbaar.
5. **M5′ — Mycelium↔INVENTory leesbrug**: vrijwillige node-capability-profielen
   als `sensor-observed`/`ai-generated`-objecten met `human_verified=false`;
   expliciete minimale interface die het privacy-ontwerp (§I.9) respecteert.
   Adapter-interface (§D) en `controlled workspace` (§G) schuiven door naar M6.

<file path="Mycelium/agent/checkpoint.py">
"""Local, read-before-write Git checkpoint layer for the Desktop Agent."""

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from permissions import PermissionDeniedError, request_permission

CHECKPOINT_ACTION = "create_git_checkpoint"
CHECKPOINT_COMPONENT = "checkpoint"
CHECKPOINT_SOURCE = "mycelium-desktop-agent:checkpoint"
CHECKPOINT_VERSION = "1.0.0"
GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30
FORBIDDEN_GIT_OPERATIONS = {
    "push",
    "reset",
    "clean",
    "rm",
    "stash",
    "checkout",
    "fetch",
    "pull",
}
ALLOWED_GIT_OPERATIONS = {"rev-parse", "status", "branch", "commit"}


class RepositoryError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class DirtyRepositoryError(RepositoryError):
    pass


class UnbornRepositoryError(RepositoryError):
    pass


class RepositoryChangedError(RepositoryError):
    pass


class ForbiddenGitOperationError(RepositoryError):
    pass


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _git_operation(arguments: list[str]) -> str:
    index = 0
    while index < len(arguments) and arguments[index] == "-c":
        index += 2
    return arguments[index] if index < len(arguments) else ""


def _run_git(repository: Path, arguments: list[str], *, check: bool = True) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    operation = _git_operation(arguments)
    if operation not in ALLOWED_GIT_OPERATIONS or operation in FORBIDDEN_GIT_OPERATIONS:
        raise ForbiddenGitOperationError(f"Git operation is not allowed: {operation or 'empty'}")
    if operation == "commit":
        commit_index = arguments.index("commit")
        commit_arguments = arguments[commit_index:]
        forbidden_commit_options = {
            "--amend",
            "--reset-author",
            "--author",
            "--no-gpg-sign",
            "--gpg-sign",
            "--signoff",
            "--reuse-message",
            "--reedit-message",
            "--fixup",
            "--squash",
        }
        if any(argument in forbidden_commit_options for argument in commit_arguments):
            raise ForbiddenGitOperationError("Checkpoint commit uses an unsafe option")
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *arguments],
        cwd=repository,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        check=False,
        timeout=GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    )
    if check and completed.returncode != 0:
        message = completed.stderr.strip() or completed.stdout.strip() or "Git command failed"
        raise RepositoryError(message)
    return completed


def _repository_path(repository) -> Path:
    path = Path(repository).expanduser()
    if not path.exists() or not path.is_dir():
        raise RepositoryError(f"Repository does not exist or is not a directory: {path}")
    return path.resolve()


def inspect_repository(repository) -> dict:
    """Inspect a local Git repository without changing it."""
    path = _repository_path(repository)
    work_tree = _run_git(path, ["rev-parse", "--is-inside-work-tree"]).stdout.strip()
    if work_tree != "true":
        raise RepositoryError(f"Not a Git work tree: {path}")
    root_text = _run_git(path, ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"]).stdout.strip()
    root = Path(root_text).resolve()
    status_result = _run_git(path, ["status", "--porcelain=v1", "--untracked-files=all"])
    status = status_result.stdout
    status_lines = [line for line in status.splitlines() if line]
    head_result = _run_git(path, ["rev-parse", "--verify", "HEAD"], check=False)
    head = head_result.stdout.strip() if head_result.returncode == 0 else None
    branch_result = _run_git(path, ["branch", "--show-current"], check=False)
    branch = branch_result.stdout.strip() if branch_result.returncode == 0 else None
    if head is None:
        cleanliness = "unborn"
    elif status_lines:
        cleanliness = "dirty"
    else:
        cleanliness = "clean"
    return {
        "path": str(path),
        "root": str(root),
        "is_repository": True,
        "cleanliness": cleanliness,
        "clean": cleanliness == "clean",
        "status": status,
        "status_lines": status_lines,
        "current_head": head,
        "branch": branch or None,
        "inspected_at": _utc_now(),
        "provenance": {
            "source": CHECKPOINT_SOURCE,
            "component": CHECKPOINT_COMPONENT,
            "version": CHECKPOINT_VERSION,
            "mode": "local-git-inspection",
        },
    }


def request_checkpoint_permission(
    repository,
    inspection: dict | None = None,
    details: dict | None = None,
    *,
    input_func=None,
    log_path=None,
) -> dict:
    """Request explicit human permission for a checkpoint commit."""
    path = _repository_path(repository)
    request_details = {
        "reason": "Create a local Git checkpoint before a controlled modification.",
        "inspection": inspection or inspect_repository(path),
    }
    if details:
        request_details.update(details)
    return request_permission(
        CHECKPOINT_ACTION,
        path,
        request_details,
        input_func=input_func,
        log_path=log_path,
    )


def _approval_matches(approval: dict, action: str, target: str) -> bool:
    return (
        isinstance(approval, dict)
        and approval.get("approved") is True
        and approval.get("action") == action
        and approval.get("target") == target
    )


def create_checkpoint(repository, approval: dict | None = None, message: str | None = None, permission_func=request_permission) -> dict:
    """Create one local checkpoint commit after inspection and explicit approval.

    The repository must be clean before permission is requested and again
    immediately before the commit. No remote, destructive, or hook operation is
    used.
    """
    path = _repository_path(repository)
    before = inspect_repository(path)
    if before["cleanliness"] != "clean":
        raise DirtyRepositoryError(
            f"Checkpoint refused: repository is {before['cleanliness']}; inspect and resolve changes first"
        )
    if before["current_head"] is None:
        raise UnbornRepositoryError("Checkpoint refused: repository has no HEAD commit")

    if approval is None:
        approval = permission_func(
            CHECKPOINT_ACTION,
            path,
            {
                "reason": "Create a local Git checkpoint before a controlled modification.",
                "inspection": before,
            },
        )
    target = str(path)
    if not _approval_matches(approval, CHECKPOINT_ACTION, target):
        raise PermissionDeniedError("Checkpoint refused: explicit matching approval is required")

    after_permission = inspect_repository(path)
    if not after_permission["clean"] or after_permission["current_head"] != before["current_head"]:
        raise RepositoryChangedError("Checkpoint refused: repository changed after permission was granted")
    before_commit = inspect_repository(path)
    if not before_commit["clean"] or before_commit["current_head"] != before["current_head"]:
        raise RepositoryChangedError("Checkpoint refused: repository changed before commit")

    checkpoint_message = (message or f"Mycelium checkpoint {before_commit['inspected_at']}").strip()
    if not checkpoint_message:
        raise RepositoryError("Checkpoint message must not be empty")
    _run_git(
        path,
        [
            "-c",
            "commit.gpgsign=false",
            "commit",
            "--allow-empty",
            "--no-verify",
            "-m",
            checkpoint_message,
        ],
    )
    after = inspect_repository(path)
    if after["current_head"] == before["current_head"]:
        raise RepositoryError("Checkpoint commit did not create a new HEAD")
    return {
        "repository": str(path),
        "checkpoint_id": after["current_head"],
        "previous_head": before["current_head"],
        "message": checkpoint_message,
        "created_at": after["inspected_at"],
        "inspection_before": before,
        "inspection_after_permission": after_permission,
        "inspection_after": after,
        "approval": approval,
        "provenance": {
            "source": CHECKPOINT_SOURCE,
            "component": CHECKPOINT_COMPONENT,
            "version": CHECKPOINT_VERSION,
            "mode": "local-git-checkpoint",
            "permission_action": CHECKPOINT_ACTION,
        },
    }
</file>
