<file path="Mycelium/agent/inventory_bridge.py">
"""M2B mapping/import layer: safe bridge from project_index.json to INVENTory.

Architecture boundary (see ARCHITECTURE_CONTRACT.md and CANONICAL_PROJECTS.md):

- Desktop Agent = discovery / index / orchestration boundary. It observes and
  proposes; it never decides identity.
- INVENTory = canonical world model / database / provenance. Its ``proj_`` IDs
  are a separate identity space, assigned server-side on creation.
- The desktop ``stable_id`` from ``project_index.json`` is the ONLY desktop
  project identity. It is never merged, never guessed, never rewritten.

Safety rules (binding for this module):

- Default to dry-run. :func:`build_plan` and :func:`dry_run` are pure
  functions: they perform zero INVENTory writes, zero network I/O and zero
  file writes. They only read the index document given to them.
- Index relationships (``parent_id``, ``nested_children_ids``,
  ``same_remote_ids``, ``shared_name_ids``, ``possible_copy_ids``) are treated
  as *evidence*, never as proof of identity. A shared remote or a shared name
  never merges two desktop projects.
- Copies and nested repositories remain distinguishable: they get their own
  mapping records with ``copy`` / ``nested`` status instead of being folded
  into another project.
- This milestone implements NO write path to INVENTory. There is deliberately
  no HTTP client, no SQLite access and no import of INVENTory code in this
  module. Any future write operation must go through the existing permission
  system (``permissions.request_permission`` with an explicit human ``YES``)
  and is out of scope for M2B.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BRIDGE_NAME = "mycelium-inventory-bridge"
BRIDGE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
BRIDGE_SOURCE = "mycelium-desktop-agent:inventory-bridge"
BRIDGE_MODE = "dry-run-proposal"

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DEFAULT_INDEX_PATH = BASE / "project_index.json"

# Every mapping record distinguishes exactly these lifecycle states.
MAPPING_STATUSES = (
    "unmapped",   # tracked before (or freshly registered) but no decision yet
    "proposed",   # clean standalone project; exactly one proposal, needs YES
    "mapped",     # linked to an existing INVENTory proj_ ID via a stored table
    "copy",       # evidence this path is a copy/backup; never auto-imported
    "nested",     # nested inside another indexed project; stays distinguishable
    "rejected",   # invalid entry or human-declined; nothing will be imported
    "conflict",   # ambiguous evidence (shared remote/name); needs human review
)

# Statuses that require an explicit human YES before anything may be created.
REQUIRES_APPROVAL = {"unmapped", "proposed", "copy", "nested", "conflict"}


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _as_id_list(value) -> list:
    if not isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
        return []
    return sorted({str(item) for item in value if isinstance(item, (str, int)) and str(item).strip()})


def new_mapping_record(desktop_project_id, desktop_path, status="unmapped",
                       now=None) -> dict:
    """Create a fresh mapping record. Defaults to ``unmapped``: no decision."""
    if status not in MAPPING_STATUSES:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown mapping status: {status!r}")
    stamp = (now or _utc_now)()
    return {
        "desktop_project_id": str(desktop_project_id),
        "desktop_path": str(desktop_path),
        "inventory_project_id": None,
        "mapping_status": status,
        "mapping_reason": "registered; no mapping decision yet",
        "requires_approval": status in REQUIRES_APPROVAL,
        "provenance": {
            "source": BRIDGE_SOURCE,
            "component": "inventory_bridge",
            "version": BRIDGE_VERSION,
            "mode": BRIDGE_MODE,
            "default": "no-write",
            "desktop_project_id": str(desktop_project_id),
            "created_at": stamp,
        },
        "created_at": stamp,
    }


def _mapping_provenance(desktop_id, index_provenance, stamp) -> dict:
    return {
        "source": BRIDGE_SOURCE,
        "component": "inventory_bridge",
        "version": BRIDGE_VERSION,
        "mode": BRIDGE_MODE,
        "default": "no-write",
        "desktop_project_id": desktop_id,
        "discovery_timestamp": (index_provenance or {}).get("discovery_timestamp"),
        "indexer": (index_provenance or {}).get("indexer"),
        "indexer_version": (index_provenance or {}).get("indexer_version"),
        "created_at": stamp,
    }


def _proposed_project_payload(entry, stamp) -> dict:
    """Build the INVENTory ProjectCreate-shaped payload that *would* be sent.

    Create-only shape: no ``id`` field is ever set (``proj_`` IDs are assigned
    server-side). Returned for human review only; nothing is transmitted.
    """
    name = entry.get("name") or Path(entry.get("path", "unknown")).name or "unknown"
    return {
        "name": str(name),
        "description": (
            f"Desktop project {name!r} at {entry.get('path')} "
            f"(desktop_id={entry.get('id')}). "
            f"Proposed by {BRIDGE_NAME} dry-run; requires human approval."
        ),
        "status": "planned",
        "provenance": {
            "source_type": "imported",
            "creator_id": BRIDGE_SOURCE,
            "human_verified": False,
            "verified_by": None,
            "created_at": stamp,
            "notes": (
                f"dry-run proposal for desktop_id={entry.get('id')}; "
                "not verified, not written anywhere"
            ),
        },
        "for_desktop_id": entry.get("id"),
        "for_desktop_path": entry.get("path"),
    }


def _proposed_relationships(entry) -> list:
    """Translate index relations into relationship *proposals* (evidence only).

    ``possible_copy_ids`` becomes ``related_to`` with the basis recorded in
    metadata, per the contract: never an automatic merge.
    """
    relations = entry.get("relations") or {}
    proposals = []
    parent = entry.get("parent_id") or relations.get("parent_id")
    if parent:
        proposals.append({
            "from_desktop_id": entry.get("id"),
            "predicate": "part_of",
            "to_desktop_id": parent,
            "basis": "nested-parent",
            "metadata": {
                "basis": "nested-parent",
                "note": "evidence only; nested project stays distinguishable",
            },
        })
    for child in _as_id_list(relations.get("nested_children_ids")):
        proposals.append({
            "from_desktop_id": entry.get("id"),
            "predicate": "contains",
            "to_desktop_id": child,
            "basis": "nested-child",
            "metadata": {
                "basis": "nested-child",
                "note": "evidence only; nested project stays distinguishable",
            },
        })
    same_remote = set(_as_id_list(relations.get("same_remote_ids")))
    shared_name = set(_as_id_list(relations.get("shared_name_ids")))
    possible = set(_as_id_list(relations.get("possible_copy_ids"))) | same_remote | shared_name
    for other in sorted(possible):
        if other == entry.get("id"):
            continue
        if other in same_remote and other in shared_name:
            basis = "same_remote+shared_name"
        elif other in same_remote:
            basis = "same_remote"
        else:
            basis = "shared_name"
        proposals.append({
            "from_desktop_id": entry.get("id"),
            "predicate": "related_to",
            "to_desktop_id": other,
            "basis": basis,
            "metadata": {
                "basis": basis,
                "note": "evidence only; shared remote/name never merges projects",
            },
        })
    return proposals


def classify_entry(entry, existing_mappings=None, now=None) -> dict:
    """Classify one index entry into a mapping record. Never writes anything."""
    stamp = (now or _utc_now)()
    existing_mappings = existing_mappings or {}
    desktop_id = entry.get("id") if isinstance(entry, dict) else None
    desktop_path = entry.get("path") if isinstance(entry, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(entry, dict) or not desktop_id or not desktop_path:
        return {
            "desktop_project_id": str(desktop_id) if desktop_id else None,
            "desktop_path": str(desktop_path) if desktop_path else None,
            "inventory_project_id": None,
            "mapping_status": "rejected",
            "mapping_reason": "invalid index entry: missing id or path; skipped safely",
            "requires_approval": False,
            "evidence": {},
            "proposed_inventory_project": None,
            "proposed_relationships": [],
            "provenance": _mapping_provenance(str(desktop_id), None, stamp),
            "created_at": stamp,
        }

    desktop_id = str(desktop_id)
    relations = entry.get("relations") or {}
    evidence = {
        "parent_id": entry.get("parent_id") or relations.get("parent_id"),
        "is_nested": bool(entry.get("is_nested", False)),
        "is_backup_copy": bool(entry.get("is_backup_copy", False)),
        "same_remote_ids": _as_id_list(relations.get("same_remote_ids")),
        "shared_name_ids": _as_id_list(relations.get("shared_name_ids")),
        "possible_copy_ids": _as_id_list(relations.get("possible_copy_ids")),
        "nested_children_ids": _as_id_list(relations.get("nested_children_ids")),
    }

    record = {
        "desktop_project_id": desktop_id,
        "desktop_path": str(desktop_path),
        "inventory_project_id": None,
        "mapping_status": "unmapped",
        "mapping_reason": "",
        "requires_approval": True,
        "evidence": evidence,
        "proposed_inventory_project": None,
        "proposed_relationships": _proposed_relationships(entry),
        "provenance": None,  # filled below
        "created_at": stamp,
    }

    if desktop_id in existing_mappings:
        target = existing_mappings[desktop_id]
        if target:
            record["mapping_status"] = "mapped"
            record["mapping_reason"] = (
                f"already linked to INVENTory project {target} via stored mapping table"
            )
            record["inventory_project_id"] = str(target)
            record["requires_approval"] = False
        else:
            record["mapping_status"] = "unmapped"
            record["mapping_reason"] = "tracked before; still no mapping decision"
            record["requires_approval"] = True
    elif evidence["is_nested"] or evidence["parent_id"]:
        record["mapping_status"] = "nested"
        record["mapping_reason"] = (
            f"nested inside parent {evidence['parent_id']}; "
            "stays a distinguishable project, requires human approval"
        )
        record["proposed_inventory_project"] = _proposed_project_payload(entry, stamp)
    elif evidence["is_backup_copy"]:
        record["mapping_status"] = "copy"
        record["mapping_reason"] = (
            "flagged as backup copy; never imported as a standalone project "
            "without explicit human approval"
        )
    elif evidence["possible_copy_ids"] or evidence["same_remote_ids"] or evidence["shared_name_ids"]:
        record["mapping_status"] = "conflict"
        others = sorted(set(evidence["possible_copy_ids"])
                        | set(evidence["same_remote_ids"])
                        | set(evidence["shared_name_ids"]))
        record["mapping_reason"] = (
            f"ambiguous evidence shared with {len(others)} other project(s) "
            f"({', '.join(others)}); shared remote/name is not identity, "
            "requires human approval, never auto-merged"
        )
    else:
        record["mapping_status"] = "proposed"
        record["mapping_reason"] = (
            "clean standalone project with no conflicting evidence; "
            "exactly one INVENTory project proposed, requires human approval"
        )
        record["proposed_inventory_project"] = _proposed_project_payload(entry, stamp)

    record["provenance"] = _mapping_provenance(desktop_id, None, stamp)
    return record


def build_plan(index, existing_mappings=None, existing_inventory_ids=None,
               now=None) -> dict:
    """Build a dry-run import/mapping plan from a project index. Pure: no I/O.

    ``existing_inventory_ids`` (list of known ``proj_`` IDs) is accepted only
    to *avoid* collisions: proposed payloads never carry an ``id`` and mapped
    links are never rewritten. Nothing is read from or written to INVENTory.
    """
    stamp = (now or _utc_now)()
    if not isinstance(index, dict) or not isinstance(index.get("projects"), list):
        raise ValueError("Not a valid project index: expected object with project list")
    existing_mappings = dict(existing_mappings or {})
    known_inventory = {str(i) for i in (existing_inventory_ids or []) if str(i).strip()}

    mappings = []
    skipped_invalid = []
    seen_ids = set()
    duplicates_deduped = 0
    for raw in index.get("projects", []):
        desktop_id = raw.get("id") if isinstance(raw, dict) else None
        if desktop_id is not None and str(desktop_id) in seen_ids:
            duplicates_deduped += 1
            continue
        record = classify_entry(raw, existing_mappings, now=lambda: stamp)
        if record["mapping_status"] == "rejected" and not record["desktop_project_id"]:
            skipped_invalid.append({
                "reason": record["mapping_reason"],
                "entry": str(raw)[:200],
            })
            continue
        if desktop_id is not None:
            seen_ids.add(str(desktop_id))
        if (record["inventory_project_id"]
                and record["inventory_project_id"] not in known_inventory
                and known_inventory):
            # Stored table points at an unknown proj_ ID: do not trust it.
            record["mapping_status"] = "conflict"
            record["mapping_reason"] = (
                f"stored mapping points at unknown INVENTory ID "
                f"{record['inventory_project_id']}; requires human review"
            )
            record["inventory_project_id"] = None
            record["requires_approval"] = True
        mappings.append(record)

    mappings.sort(key=lambda m: (m["desktop_project_id"] or ""))
    by_status = {}
    for mapping in mappings:
        by_status.setdefault(mapping["mapping_status"], []).append(mapping["desktop_project_id"])

    proposed = [m for m in mappings if m["mapping_status"] == "proposed"]
    nested = [m for m in mappings if m["mapping_status"] == "nested"]
    copies = [m for m in mappings if m["mapping_status"] == "copy"]
    ambiguous = [m for m in mappings if m["mapping_status"] == "conflict"]
    needs_approval = [m["desktop_project_id"] for m in mappings if m["requires_approval"]]
    would_create_projects = [
        m["proposed_inventory_project"] for m in mappings
        if m["proposed_inventory_project"] is not None
    ]
    would_create_relationships = [
        rel for m in mappings for rel in m["proposed_relationships"]
    ]

    index_provenance = index.get("provenance") if isinstance(index.get("provenance"), dict) else {}
    plan = {
        "bridge": {"name": BRIDGE_NAME, "version": BRIDGE_VERSION},
        "mode": "dry-run",
        "writes_performed": 0,
        "generated_at": stamp,
        "provenance": {
            "source": BRIDGE_SOURCE,
            "component": "inventory_bridge",
            "version": BRIDGE_VERSION,
            "mode": BRIDGE_MODE,
            "default": "no-write",
            "discovery_timestamp": index_provenance.get("discovery_timestamp"),
            "indexer": index_provenance.get("indexer"),
            "indexer_version": index_provenance.get("indexer_version"),
            "created_at": stamp,
        },
        # 1. Which desktop projects were discovered?
        "discovered": [
            {"desktop_project_id": m["desktop_project_id"],
             "desktop_path": m["desktop_path"]}
            for m in mappings
        ],
        # 2. Which logical INVENTory projects are proposed?
        "proposed_projects": would_create_projects,
        # 3. Which paths appear to be copies?
        "copies": [
            {"desktop_project_id": m["desktop_project_id"],
             "desktop_path": m["desktop_path"],
             "reason": m["mapping_reason"]}
            for m in copies
        ],
        # 4. Which paths are nested?
        "nested": [
            {"desktop_project_id": m["desktop_project_id"],
             "desktop_path": m["desktop_path"],
             "parent_id": m["evidence"]["parent_id"],
             "reason": m["mapping_reason"]}
            for m in nested
        ],
        # 5. Which mappings are ambiguous?
        "ambiguous": [
            {"desktop_project_id": m["desktop_project_id"],
             "desktop_path": m["desktop_path"],
             "reason": m["mapping_reason"]}
            for m in ambiguous
        ],
        # 6. Which projects require human approval?
        "requires_approval": needs_approval,
        "approval_gate": {
            "mode": "explicit-human-confirmation",
            "mechanism": "permissions.request_permission",
            "rule": "no project or relationship is created without an explicit human YES per mapping",
        },
        # 7. What would be created if approved?
        "would_create": {
            "projects": would_create_projects,
            "relationships": would_create_relationships,
            "writes_now": 0,
            "note": (
                "Nothing was written. If every approval were granted, the "
                "payloads above would be POSTed as new INVENTory projects "
                "(server-assigned proj_ IDs) plus related_to/part_of/contains "
                "relationships. Copies and conflicts would still create "
                "nothing until a human reclassifies them."
            ),
        },
        "mappings": mappings,
        "skipped_invalid": skipped_invalid,
        "summary": {
            "desktop_projects_discovered": len(mappings),
            "proposed_mappings": len(proposed),
            "nested_mappings": len(nested),
            "copy_mappings": len(copies),
            "ambiguous_mappings": len(ambiguous),
            "mapped_mappings": len(by_status.get("mapped", [])),
            "unmapped_mappings": len(by_status.get("unmapped", [])),
            "rejected_mappings": len(by_status.get("rejected", [])),
            "require_approval": len(needs_approval),
            "would_create_projects": len(would_create_projects),
            "would_create_relationships": len(would_create_relationships),
            "copy_relationships": len(copies),
            "nested_relationships": len(nested),
            "duplicate_paths_deduped": duplicates_deduped,
            "skipped_invalid": len(skipped_invalid),
            "writes_performed": 0,
        },
    }
    return plan


def load_index_document(path=None) -> dict:
    target = Path(path) if path is not None else DEFAULT_INDEX_PATH
    data = json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("projects"), list):
        raise ValueError(f"Not a valid project index: {target}")
    return data


def dry_run(index=None, index_path=None, existing_mappings=None,
            existing_inventory_ids=None, now=None) -> dict:
    """Dry-run the import: plan without writing. Reads only the index file."""
    if index is None:
        index = load_index_document(index_path)
    return build_plan(index, existing_mappings, existing_inventory_ids, now)


def plan_to_json(plan) -> str:
    return json.dumps(plan, indent=2, sort_keys=True)


def save_plan(plan, path) -> Path:
    """Write a plan to an explicitly given path. Never called implicitly."""
    target = Path(path)
    target.write_text(plan_to_json(plan), encoding="utf-8")
    return target


def main(index_path=None, output_path=None):
    import sys
    plan = dry_run(index_path=index_path)
    summary = plan["summary"]
    print(
        f"Discovered {summary['desktop_projects_discovered']} desktop projects: "
        f"{summary['proposed_mappings']} proposed, "
        f"{summary['nested_mappings']} nested, "
        f"{summary['copy_mappings']} copies, "
        f"{summary['ambiguous_mappings']} ambiguous, "
        f"{summary['require_approval']} require approval. "
        f"Writes performed: {summary['writes_performed']}.",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )
    if output_path is not None:
        target = save_plan(plan, output_path)
        print(f"Saved plan: {target.resolve()}", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        print(plan_to_json(plan))
    return plan


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<file path="Mycelium/agent/inventory_writer.py">
"""Approval-gated writer: desktop mapping -> INVENTory project (M2B).

This module is the ONLY place that may create INVENTory projects, and it does
so only when every gate passes, in this order:

1. identifiers present, desktop path exists and is a directory;
2. idempotency: a ``mapped`` row in the store short-circuits with 0 writes;
3. eligibility: only ``proposed`` / ``nested`` bridge mappings are writable.
   ``copy`` / ``conflict`` / ``unmapped`` / ``rejected`` / ``mapped`` are
   refused — a human must reclassify them first, never the code;
4. canonical workspace: the desktop path must sit inside an explicitly passed
   ``allowed_roots`` list. Empty or missing ``allowed_roots`` refuses everything;
5. payload validation against the existing ``ProjectCreate`` contract
   (``POST /api/v1/projects``): create-only shape, no ``id`` field,
   ``provenance.source_type == "imported"``, ``human_verified is False``;
6. explicit approval: a decision dict with ``approved is True`` whose
   ``action``/``target`` match this exact import. Anything else refuses.
   Interactive callers obtain it via :func:`request_approval_and_write`,
   which uses ``permissions.request_permission`` (exact-YES gate);
7. git checkpoint: for git projects ``checkpoint.create_checkpoint`` must
   succeed BEFORE any write, with its own matching checkpoint approval;
8. exactly one ``create_project`` call on the injected inventory client;
9. the returned ``proj_`` ID is validated and stored via ``mark_mapped``.

Any violation raises :class:`WriteRefusedError` and performs zero writes.
Only CREATE operations exist here: no update, no delete, no overwrite path.
Relationship writes are NOT implemented (no safe contract yet — M2B scope).
"""

import json
import os
import urllib.request
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

from checkpoint import CHECKPOINT_ACTION, create_checkpoint
from permissions import request_permission

IMPORT_ACTION = "import_project_to_inventory"
IMPORT_COMPONENT = "inventory_writer"
IMPORT_SOURCE = "mycelium-desktop-agent:inventory-writer"
IMPORT_VERSION = "1.0.0"

# Writable bridge statuses: clean proposal or distinguishable nested project.
WRITABLE_STATUSES = {"proposed", "nested"}

# Mirrors INVENTory ProjectCreate: name 1..200, description <=5000,
# status one of the ProjectStatus literals. Verified against
# inventory/app/schemas.py (M1B contract); nothing invented.
PROJECT_STATUSES = {"idea", "planned", "active", "paused", "completed", "archived"}
INVENTORY_PROJECTS_PATH = "/api/v1/projects"


class WriteRefusedError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _approval_matches(approval, action, target) -> bool:
    return (
        isinstance(approval, dict)
        and approval.get("approved") is True
        and approval.get("action") == action
        and str(approval.get("target") or "").strip() == str(target).strip()
    )


def _within_roots(desktop_path: Path, allowed_roots) -> bool:
    if not allowed_roots:
        return False
    candidate = os.path.normcase(str(desktop_path))
    for root in allowed_roots:
        try:
            resolved = Path(root).resolve()
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            continue
        if not resolved.exists():
            continue
        prefix = os.path.normcase(str(resolved))
        if candidate == prefix or candidate.startswith(prefix + os.sep):
            return True
    return False


def validate_project_payload(payload) -> dict:
    """Validate a create-only payload against the ProjectCreate contract."""
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise WriteRefusedError("Project payload must be an object")
    if "id" in payload:
        raise WriteRefusedError("Payload must not carry an ID; proj_ IDs are server-assigned")
    name = payload.get("name")
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip() or len(name) > 200:
        raise WriteRefusedError("Payload name must be 1..200 characters")
    description = payload.get("description", "")
    if not isinstance(description, str) or len(description) > 5000:
        raise WriteRefusedError("Payload description must be at most 5000 characters")
    if payload.get("status") not in PROJECT_STATUSES:
        raise WriteRefusedError("Payload status is not a known INVENTory project status")
    provenance = payload.get("provenance")
    if not isinstance(provenance, dict):
        raise WriteRefusedError("Payload requires a provenance object")
    if provenance.get("source_type") != "imported":
        raise WriteRefusedError("Payload provenance.source_type must be 'imported'")
    if provenance.get("human_verified") is not False:
        raise WriteRefusedError("Payload provenance.human_verified must be false")
    return payload


class HttpInventoryClient:
    """Thin adapter over the existing INVENTory REST API (create-only)."""

    def __init__(self, base_url, timeout=15):
        self.base_url = str(base_url).rstrip("/")
        self.timeout = timeout

    def create_project(self, payload) -> dict:
        body = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            self.base_url + INVENTORY_PROJECTS_PATH,
            data=body,
            method="POST",
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=self.timeout) as response:
                data = json.loads(response.read().decode("utf-8"))
        except Exception as error:
            raise WriteRefusedError(f"INVENTory create failed: {error}") from error
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not str(data.get("id") or "").startswith("proj_"):
            raise WriteRefusedError("INVENTory did not return a proj_ ID")
        return data


def _writer_provenance(desktop_id, stamp) -> dict:
    return {
        "source": IMPORT_SOURCE,
        "component": IMPORT_COMPONENT,
        "version": IMPORT_VERSION,
        "mode": "approval-gated-create",
        "desktop_project_id": desktop_id,
        "created_at": stamp,
    }


def write_approved_mapping(*, desktop_id, desktop_path, is_git, payload,
                           mapping_status, approval, checkpoint_approval=None,
                           inventory_client, store=None, allowed_roots=(),
                           checkpoint_func=None, now=None) -> dict:
    """Create exactly one INVENTory project after all gates pass.

    Returns a result record with ``writes == 1``. Raises
    :class:`WriteRefusedError` (0 writes) on any violation, including an
    already-``mapped`` row, which short-circuits as ``already_mapped``.
    """
    stamp = (now or _utc_now)()
    desktop_id = str(desktop_id or "").strip()
    if not desktop_id:
        raise WriteRefusedError("Missing desktop stable_id")
    try:
        resolved_path = Path(desktop_path).resolve()
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        raise WriteRefusedError(f"Unresolvable desktop path: {error}") from error
    if not resolved_path.exists() or not resolved_path.is_dir():
        raise WriteRefusedError(f"Desktop path is not an existing directory: {resolved_path}")

    if store is not None:
        existing = store.get(desktop_id)
        if isinstance(existing, dict) and existing.get("mapping_status") == "mapped":
            return {
                "desktop_project_id": desktop_id,
                "inventory_project_id": existing.get("inventory_project_id"),
                "mapping_status": "already_mapped",
                "checkpoint_id": None,
                "writes": 0,
                "provenance": _writer_provenance(desktop_id, stamp),
                "created_at": stamp,
            }

    if mapping_status not in WRITABLE_STATUSES:
        raise WriteRefusedError(
            f"Mapping status {mapping_status!r} is not writable; "
            "a human must reclassify it to proposed/nested first"
        )
    if not _within_roots(resolved_path, allowed_roots):
        raise WriteRefusedError(
            f"Desktop path {resolved_path} is outside the canonical workspace"
        )
    validate_project_payload(payload)
    if not _approval_matches(approval, IMPORT_ACTION, str(desktop_path).strip()):
        raise WriteRefusedError("Missing or denied import approval: no write")

    checkpoint_id = None
    if is_git:
        target = str(resolved_path)
        if not _approval_matches(checkpoint_approval, CHECKPOINT_ACTION, target):
            raise WriteRefusedError("Git project requires a matching checkpoint approval")
        run_checkpoint = checkpoint_func or create_checkpoint
        try:
            checkpoint_result = run_checkpoint(
                resolved_path, checkpoint_approval,
                message=f"Mycelium pre-import checkpoint for {desktop_id}",
            )
        except Exception as error:
            raise WriteRefusedError(f"Checkpoint failed, refusing write: {error}") from error
        checkpoint_id = checkpoint_result.get("checkpoint_id")
        if not checkpoint_id:
            raise WriteRefusedError("Checkpoint did not return a checkpoint ID")

    if inventory_client is None:
        raise WriteRefusedError("No inventory client supplied")
    created = inventory_client.create_project(payload)
    inventory_id = created.get("id") if isinstance(created, dict) else None
    if not isinstance(inventory_id, str) or not inventory_id.startswith("proj_"):
        raise WriteRefusedError("INVENTory did not return a proj_ ID; mapping not stored")

    if store is not None:
        store.mark_mapped(desktop_id, str(desktop_path), inventory_id, approval,
                          provenance=_writer_provenance(desktop_id, stamp))
    return {
        "desktop_project_id": desktop_id,
        "inventory_project_id": inventory_id,
        "mapping_status": "mapped",
        "checkpoint_id": checkpoint_id,
        "writes": 1,
        "provenance": _writer_provenance(desktop_id, stamp),
        "created_at": stamp,
    }


def request_approval_and_write(*, desktop_id, desktop_path, is_git, payload,
                               mapping_status, inventory_client, store=None,
                               allowed_roots=(), checkpoint_func=None,
                               permission_func=None, input_func=None,
                               log_path=None, now=None) -> dict:
    """Obtain explicit human approvals, then delegate to :func:`write_approved_mapping`.

    Uses ``permissions.request_permission`` unless another ``permission_func``
    is injected (tests). Without an ``input_func`` the gate default-denies,
    so unattended calls always refuse with 0 writes.
    """
    ask = permission_func or request_permission
    checkpoint_approval = None
    if is_git:
        try:
            target = str(Path(desktop_path).resolve())
        except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
            target = str(desktop_path)
        checkpoint_approval = ask(
            CHECKPOINT_ACTION,
            target,
            {"reason": f"Create a local Git checkpoint before importing {desktop_id}."},
            input_func=input_func,
            log_path=log_path,
        )
    approval = ask(
        IMPORT_ACTION,
        desktop_path,
        {"reason": f"Create INVENTory project for desktop {desktop_id} ({desktop_path}).",
         "payload": {"name": payload.get("name") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None}},
        input_func=input_func,
        log_path=log_path,
    )
    return write_approved_mapping(
        desktop_id=desktop_id,
        desktop_path=desktop_path,
        is_git=is_git,
        payload=payload,
        mapping_status=mapping_status,
        approval=approval,
        checkpoint_approval=checkpoint_approval,
        inventory_client=inventory_client,
        store=store,
        allowed_roots=allowed_roots,
        checkpoint_func=checkpoint_func,
        now=now,
    )

<file path="Mycelium/agent/mapping_store.py">
"""Persistent mapping table: desktop stable_id <-> INVENTory proj_-ID (M2B).

The table lives inside ``agent/`` and uses the terminology of
``inventory_bridge.py``. It records decisions; it never makes them:

- a row is created as ``unmapped`` / ``proposed`` / ``nested`` / ``copy`` /
  ``conflict`` by a dry-run plan or by explicit operator action;
- only the approval-gated writer (``inventory_writer.py``) may flip a row to
  ``mapped``, and only after a real ``proj_`` ID was returned by INVENTory.

The store never contacts INVENTory and never touches user projects. With
``path=None`` it is purely in-memory and performs no file I/O at all.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from inventory_bridge import MAPPING_STATUSES

STORE_NAME = "mycelium-mapping-store"
STORE_VERSION = "1.0.0"
STORE_SOURCE = "mycelium-desktop-agent:mapping-store"

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DEFAULT_STORE_PATH = BASE / "inventory_mappings.json"


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


class MappingStore:
    """Small JSON-backed table of desktop -> INVENTory mappings."""

    def __init__(self, path=None, now=None):
        self.path = Path(path) if path is not None else None
        self.now = now or _utc_now
        self._rows = {}
        if self.path is not None and self.path.exists():
            self.load()

    def load(self) -> dict:
        if self.path is None:
            return dict(self._rows)
        raw = json.loads(self.path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        if not isinstance(raw, dict) or not isinstance(raw.get("mappings"), dict):
            raise ValueError(f"Not a valid mapping store: {self.path}")
        self._rows = {str(k): v for k, v in raw["mappings"].items()}
        return dict(self._rows)

    def save(self) -> Path | None:
        """Persist to the configured path. Memory-only stores save nothing."""
        if self.path is None:
            return None
        self.path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        document = {
            "store": {"name": STORE_NAME, "version": STORE_VERSION},
            "source": STORE_SOURCE,
            "updated_at": self.now(),
            "mappings": self._rows,
        }
        self.path.write_text(json.dumps(document, indent=2, sort_keys=True), encoding="utf-8")
        return self.path

    def get(self, stable_id) -> dict | None:
        return self._rows.get(str(stable_id))

    def all(self) -> dict:
        return dict(self._rows)

    def record(self, stable_id, desktop_path, mapping_status, approval=None,
               inventory_project_id=None, provenance=None) -> dict:
        """Insert or replace a row. Only ``mapped`` rows may carry a proj_ ID."""
        stable_id = str(stable_id)
        if mapping_status not in MAPPING_STATUSES:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown mapping status: {mapping_status!r}")
        if inventory_project_id is not None and mapping_status != "mapped":
            raise ValueError("Only mapped rows may carry an inventory_project_id")
        stamp = self.now()
        previous = self._rows.get(stable_id)
        row = {
            "stable_id": stable_id,
            "desktop_path": str(desktop_path),
            "inventory_project_id": str(inventory_project_id) if inventory_project_id else None,
            "mapping_status": mapping_status,
            "approval": approval,
            "provenance": provenance or {
                "source": STORE_SOURCE,
                "component": "mapping_store",
                "version": STORE_VERSION,
            },
            "source": STORE_SOURCE,
            "created_at": (previous or {}).get("created_at", stamp),
            "updated_at": stamp,
        }
        self._rows[stable_id] = row
        return row

    def mark_mapped(self, stable_id, desktop_path, inventory_project_id,
                    approval, provenance=None) -> dict:
        """Flip a row to ``mapped`` after INVENTory returned a real proj_ ID."""
        if not str(inventory_project_id or "").startswith("proj_"):
            raise ValueError("Refusing to store a non-proj_ inventory ID")
        return self.record(stable_id, desktop_path, "mapped",
                           approval=approval,
                           inventory_project_id=str(inventory_project_id),
                           provenance=provenance)

<file path="Mycelium/agent/permissions.py">
"""Explicit, default-deny permission gate for local Desktop Agent actions."""

from pathlib import Path
import json
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DEFAULT_LOG_PATH = BASE / "permission_log.jsonl"
PERMISSION_SOURCE = "mycelium-desktop-agent:permission"
PERMISSION_COMPONENT = "permissions"
PERMISSION_MODE = "explicit-human-confirmation"


class PermissionDeniedError(RuntimeError):
    pass


class PermissionLogError(RuntimeError):
    pass


def _utc_now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _json_safe(value):
    if isinstance(value, Path):
        return str(value)
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(key): _json_safe(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
        return [_json_safe(item) for item in value]
    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, int, float, bool)):
        return value
    return str(value)


def _normalise_details(details):
    if details is None:
        return {}
    if isinstance(details, str):
        return {"reason": details}
    if isinstance(details, dict):
        return _json_safe(dict(details))
    return {"reason": str(details)}


def _prompt(action, target, reason) -> str:
    return (
        "Mycelium permission required\n"
        f"Action: {action}\n"
        f"Target: {target}\n"
        f"Reason: {reason}\n"
        "Type YES to approve; any other response denies: "
    )


class PermissionGate:
    def __init__(self, log_path=None, input_func=None, now=None):
        self.log_path = Path(log_path) if log_path is not None else DEFAULT_LOG_PATH
        self.input_func = input_func
        self.now = now or _utc_now

    def _append_log(self, decision):
        self.log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with self.log_path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(json.dumps(decision, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
            handle.flush()

    def request_permission(self, action, target, details=None):
        action = str(action).strip()
        target = str(target).strip()
        normalised = _normalise_details(details)
        reason = str(normalised.get("reason") or normalised.get("details") or "not supplied").strip()
        request_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        requested_at = self.now()
        request = {
            "request_id": request_id,
            "action": action,
            "target": target,
            "details": normalised,
            "reason": reason,
            "requested_at": requested_at,
        }

        if self.input_func is None:
            response = ""
            decision_source = "default-deny"
        else:
            try:
                response = self.input_func(request["reason"] + "\n" + _prompt(action, target, reason))
                response = response.strip() if isinstance(response, str) else ""
            except Exception:
                response = ""
            decision_source = "human-input"

        approved = response == "YES"
        decided_at = self.now()
        decision = {
            **request,
            "approved": approved,
            "decision": "approved" if approved else "denied",
            "response": "YES" if approved else "DENY",
            "decided_at": decided_at,
            "decision_source": decision_source,
            "provenance": {
                "source": PERMISSION_SOURCE,
                "component": PERMISSION_COMPONENT,
                "mode": PERMISSION_MODE,
                "default": "deny",
                "request_id": request_id,
            },
        }
        self._append_log(decision)
        return decision


def request_permission(action, target, details=None, *, log_path=None, input_func=None, now=None):
    """Ask for an explicit permission and return a JSON-serialisable decision.

    Omitted input always denies. Callers that provide an interactive UI or CLI
    must pass ``input_func=input`` explicitly; no approval is ever implicit.
    """
    gate = PermissionGate(log_path=log_path, input_func=input_func, now=now)
    return gate.request_permission(action, target, details)


def request_permission_interactive(action, target, details=None, *, log_path=None, now=None):
    """Interactive wrapper; it still accepts only an exact YES response."""
    return request_permission(
        action,
        target,
        details,
        input_func=input,
        log_path=log_path,
        now=now,
    )

<file path="Mycelium/agent/project_index.py">
"""Mycelium Desktop Agent — local project index layer.

Builds a deterministic, local-only PROJECT INDEX from discovery.json
without touching user projects. No network, no external APIs, no AI.

Pipeline:  agent.py (scan) -> discovery.json -> project_index.py -> project_index.json

Project IDs are stable: same computer + same path always yields the same ID
(case-insensitive, so Windows path casing cannot fork identities).
The ID scheme is shared with the discovery scanner (agent.stable_id),
which is the single source of truth for ID computation.
"""

from pathlib import Path
import json
from datetime import datetime

from agent import stable_id, SCANNER_NAME

INDEXER_NAME = "mycelium-project-index"
INDEX_VERSION = "1.0.0"
INDEX_SOURCE = "mycelium-desktop-agent:discovery.json"

BASE = Path(__file__).parent
DISCOVERY_PATH = BASE / "discovery.json"
INDEX_PATH = BASE / "project_index.json"


def project_id(computer: str, path_str: str) -> str:
    """Stable project ID. Same computer + same path -> same ID. Never raises."""
    computer = (computer or "unknown").strip() or "unknown"
    path_str = (path_str or "").strip()
    return stable_id(computer, path_str)


def load_discovery(path=None) -> dict:
    """Read a discovery document. Raises FileNotFoundError/ValueError on problems."""
    target = Path(path) if path is not None else DISCOVERY_PATH
    raw = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    data = json.loads(raw)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"Discovery document is not an object: {target}")
    projects = data.get("projects", [])
    if not isinstance(projects, list):
        raise ValueError(f"Discovery document has no project list: {target}")
    return data


def _normalize_entry(raw: object) -> dict | None:
    """Normalize one discovery entry to index metadata. Returns None when unusable."""
    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
        return None
    path_str = raw.get("path")
    if not isinstance(path_str, str) or not path_str.strip():
        return None
    path_str = path_str.strip()

    types = raw.get("types", [])
    types = list(types) if isinstance(types, list) else []
    types = sorted({str(t) for t in types})

    recognized = raw.get("recognized_files", [])
    recognized = list(recognized) if isinstance(recognized, list) else []
    recognized = sorted({str(f) for f in recognized})

    name = raw.get("name")
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
        name = Path(path_str).name or path_str

    git_remote = raw.get("git_remote")
    if not isinstance(git_remote, str) or not git_remote.strip():
        git_remote = None
    else:
        git_remote = git_remote.strip()

    last_modified = raw.get("last_modified")
    if not isinstance(last_modified, str):
        last_modified = None

    file_count = raw.get("file_count", 0)
    if isinstance(file_count, bool) or not isinstance(file_count, int):
        try:
            file_count = int(file_count)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            file_count = 0
    if file_count < 0:
        file_count = 0

    parent = raw.get("parent_project")
    if not isinstance(parent, str) or not parent.strip():
        parent = None
    else:
        parent = parent.strip()

    return {
        "path": path_str,
        "name": name,
        "types": types,
        "git": bool(raw.get("git", False)),
        "git_remote": git_remote,
        "last_modified": last_modified,
        "file_count": file_count,
        "recognized_files": recognized,
        "is_backup_copy": bool(raw.get("is_backup_copy", False)),
        "is_nested": bool(raw.get("is_nested", False)),
        "parent_project": parent,
    }


def build_index(discovery: dict, indexed_at: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Build a deterministic project index from a discovery document.

    Pure function of its input (plus indexed_at timestamp): same discovery
    content -> same IDs, same relations, same ordering. Never touches disk.
    """
    if not isinstance(discovery, dict):
        raise ValueError("Discovery document must be an object")
    raw_projects = discovery.get("projects", [])
    if not isinstance(raw_projects, list):
        raise ValueError("Discovery document has no project list")

    computer = discovery.get("computer", "unknown")
    computer = computer if isinstance(computer, str) and computer.strip() else "unknown"
    discovery_timestamp = discovery.get("timestamp")
    if not isinstance(discovery_timestamp, str):
        discovery_timestamp = None
    scanner = discovery.get("scanner")
    scanner = dict(scanner) if isinstance(scanner, dict) else {}
    stamped = indexed_at or datetime.now().isoformat()

    # First pass: normalize + assign stable IDs, dedupe by normalized path.
    by_path: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for raw in raw_projects:
        entry = _normalize_entry(raw)
        if entry is None:
            continue
        key = entry["path"].lower()
        if key in by_path:
            continue  # deterministic: first occurrence wins
        entry["id"] = project_id(computer, entry["path"])
        by_path[key] = entry

    path_to_id = {entry["path"]: entry["id"] for entry in by_path.values()}
    # Parent links may differ in casing from indexed paths (Windows-safe lookup).
    lower_to_id = {entry["path"].lower(): entry["id"] for entry in by_path.values()}

    # Second pass: resolve parent links to IDs.
    for entry in by_path.values():
        parent_id = None
        if entry["parent_project"]:
            parent_id = lower_to_id.get(entry["parent_project"].lower())
        entry["parent_id"] = parent_id

    # Groupings for relations (all lookups case-normalized where applicable).
    by_remote: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    by_name: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    children: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for entry in by_path.values():
        if entry["git_remote"]:
            by_remote.setdefault(entry["git_remote"], []).append(entry["id"])
        by_name.setdefault(entry["name"].lower(), []).append(entry["id"])
        if entry["parent_id"] is not None:
            children.setdefault(entry["parent_id"], []).append(entry["id"])

    # Third pass: attach relations (sorted ID lists, self excluded).
    index_projects = []
    for entry in sorted(by_path.values(), key=lambda e: e["id"]):
        pid = entry["id"]
        same_remote = sorted(i for i in by_remote.get(entry["git_remote"], []) if i != pid) \
            if entry["git_remote"] else []
        shared_name = sorted(i for i in by_name.get(entry["name"].lower(), []) if i != pid)
        possible_copies = sorted(set(same_remote) | set(shared_name))
        nested_children = sorted(children.get(pid, []))

        index_projects.append({
            "id": pid,
            "path": entry["path"],
            "name": entry["name"],
            "types": entry["types"],
            "git": entry["git"],
            "git_remote": entry["git_remote"],
            "last_modified": entry["last_modified"],
            "file_count": entry["file_count"],
            "recognized_files": entry["recognized_files"],
            "is_backup_copy": entry["is_backup_copy"],
            "is_nested": entry["is_nested"],
            "parent_id": entry["parent_id"],
            "relations": {
                "parent_id": entry["parent_id"],
                "nested_children_ids": nested_children,
                "same_remote_ids": same_remote,
                "shared_name_ids": shared_name,
                "possible_copy_ids": possible_copies,
            },
            "provenance": {
                "source": INDEX_SOURCE,
                "discovery_timestamp": discovery_timestamp,
                "scanner": scanner.get("name", SCANNER_NAME),
                "scanner_version": scanner.get("version"),
                "indexed_at": stamped,
                "indexer": INDEXER_NAME,
                "indexer_version": INDEX_VERSION,
            },
        })

    related = sum(1 for p in index_projects if p["relations"]["possible_copy_ids"])

    return {
        "index_version": INDEX_VERSION,
        "indexer": {"name": INDEXER_NAME, "version": INDEX_VERSION},
        "computer": computer,
        "generated_at": stamped,
        "discovery_timestamp": discovery_timestamp,
        "scanner": scanner,
        "provenance": {
            "source": INDEX_SOURCE,
            "discovery_timestamp": discovery_timestamp,
            "indexed_at": stamped,
            "indexer": INDEXER_NAME,
            "indexer_version": INDEX_VERSION,
        },
        "summary": {
            "total_projects": len(index_projects),
            "git_count": sum(1 for p in index_projects if p["git"]),
            "backup_copy_count": sum(1 for p in index_projects if p["is_backup_copy"]),
            "nested_count": sum(1 for p in index_projects if p["is_nested"]),
            "with_remote_count": sum(1 for p in index_projects if p["git_remote"]),
            "related_count": related,
        },
        "projects": index_projects,
    }


def save_index(index: dict, path=None) -> Path:
    """Write the index as JSON. Only ever writes inside the agent directory by default."""
    target = Path(path) if path is not None else INDEX_PATH
    target.write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    return target


def load_index(path=None) -> dict:
    target = Path(path) if path is not None else INDEX_PATH
    data = json.loads(target.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not isinstance(data.get("projects"), list):
        raise ValueError(f"Not a valid project index: {target}")
    return data


def main(discovery_path=None, output_path=None):
    discovery = load_discovery(discovery_path)
    index = build_index(discovery)
    target = save_index(index, output_path)
    summary = index["summary"]
    print(f"Indexed {summary['total_projects']} projects "
          f"({summary['related_count']} with relations).")
    print(f"Saved: {target.resolve()}")
    return index


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

<file path="Mycelium/agent/README.md">
# Mycelium Desktop Agent

Local-first desktop agent for the Mycelium + INVENTory ecosystem.

Core loop:

DISCOVER → UNDERSTAND → PLAN → ASK PERMISSION → BUILD → TEST → CHECKPOINT

Safety principles:

- Never delete or move user files without explicit permission.
- Never execute destructive commands without explicit permission.
- Inspect before modifying.
- Create a Git checkpoint before modifying tracked projects.
- Run tests after code changes.
- Keep provenance for discovered information.
- Prefer existing code/projects over rebuilding from scratch.
</file>

<file path="Mycelium/agent/SAFETY.md">
# SAFETY — Milestone 2A

Local-first safety contract for the Mycelium Desktop Agent. This milestone adds
an explicit permission gate and a local Git checkpoint capability. It does not
integrate with or modify any existing user project.

## Permission model

`permissions.request_permission(action, target, details)` returns a
JSON-serialisable approval decision.

- **Default is DENY.** No approval is granted by omission, timeout, exception,
  or an unrecognized response.
- A human must explicitly type the exact response `YES` through an interactive
  caller (`request_permission_interactive`) or an explicitly supplied input
  callback. Any other response is a denial.
- The prompt always states the action, target, and reason.
- An optional approver callback is an explicit integration point for a UI/CLI;
  it must return exactly `True` to approve. It is never an implicit policy grant.
- Every request and decision is appended as one JSON line to
  `agent/permission_log.jsonl` (or a caller-supplied log path) with:
  - UTC `requested_at` and `decided_at`
  - unique `request_id`
  - action, target, details, reason
  - approved/denied decision and response
  - `provenance.source = mycelium-desktop-agent:permission`
  - `provenance.default = deny`
- A denied request performs no action. A caller must inspect the returned
  decision before doing anything.

The gate is intentionally separate from discovery/indexing. Read-only scan and
index operations do not require permission; mutating capabilities do.

## Checkpoint model

`checkpoint.create_checkpoint(repository, approval, ...)` implements:

`INSPECT → SHOW → PERMISSION → CHECKPOINT → MODIFY → TEST → VERIFY`

For this milestone, `INSPECT`, `SHOW` (the inspection returned to the caller),
`PERMISSION`, and `CHECKPOINT` are implemented. `MODIFY`, `TEST`, and
`VERIFY` remain future workflow stages and are not performed by this module.

Before a checkpoint is created:

1. Resolve and inspect the local repository.
2. Read Git status with untracked files included.
3. Require a clean work tree and an existing HEAD.
4. Require an explicit, matching approval for action
   `create_git_checkpoint` and the exact repository target.
5. Re-inspect after permission and immediately before commit; any status or
   HEAD change aborts the checkpoint.
6. Create one local empty commit with a generated or supplied message.
7. Re-inspect and return the previous HEAD, new checkpoint ID, inspection
   records, approval, and provenance.

Only local Git read operations and the single approved local `commit` are
allowed. The checkpoint command disables GPG signing and hooks for this
controlled checkpoint (`-c commit.gpgsign=false --no-verify`), and never invokes
network or destructive Git operations.

## Explicitly forbidden actions

This layer never performs, schedules, or silently permits:

- `git push`, including force push
- `git reset` or any history rewrite
- `git clean`
- `git rm` or deletion
- `git stash` (even though it is not destructive by itself)
- checkout/branch switching
- fetch/pull or any network operation
- automatic commits without a matching permission decision
- operations outside the explicitly approved repository target

Future mutating skills must call the permission gate independently and must not
reuse a checkpoint approval for a different action or target.

## Test boundary

Checkpoint tests create repositories only under pytest `tmp_path` directories.
They verify clean/dirty detection, permission denial/approval, commit parent and
message, race detection, command allow-listing, provenance logging, and that no
real project path is touched. No test uses Desktop, Documents, Downloads, or a
canonical user repository as its target.

## Current boundary and next step

M2A is a safety primitive, not an execution framework. It does not modify
tracked user projects, does not integrate with INVENTory, and does not add an
AI model or API. M2B must add the Desktop `stable_id` → INVENTory `proj_`
mapping and a dry-run import policy before any project data is written to the
world model.
</file>

<file path="Mycelium/agent/WORLD_MODEL.md">
# WORLD MODEL — Mycelium + INVENTory symbiose

Architectuurspecificatie. Gebaseerd uitsluitend op bestaande code, documentatie
en de huidige project-index. Normatief voor toekomstige milestones; geen code,
geen API's, geen UI-wijzigingen in dit document.

Bronnen (stand 2026-09-11): `agent.py` v0.2.0, `project_index.py` v1.0.0,
`agent_ui.py` (Flask, read-only, :8787), `discovery.json`, `project_index.json`
(9 projecten: 6 git, 5 met remote, 1 backup, 4 nested, 7 met relaties),
`README.md` (core loop + safety principles), 35/35 agent-tests groen.

## 1. Lagen en verantwoordelijkheden

| Laag | Rol | Eigenaar van waarheid |
|---|---|---|
| Mycelium | Reasoning, coördinatie, acties aansturen | Plannen, beslissingen, toestemmingen |
| INVENTory | Fysieke wereld: objecten, hardware, sensoren | Fysieke staat en metingen |
| Desktop Agent | Computer-laag: filesystem, projecten, Git | `discovery.json` (observaties) |
| Project Index | Digitale projectwereld-index | `project_index.json` (identiteit + relaties) |
| World Model | Verbindende laag (dit document) | Koppelingen tussen alle lagen |

Regel: elke laag spreekt alleen via vastgelegde, lokale datastructuren
(JSON-bestanden). Geen laag schrijft direct in een andere laag.

## 2. Mycelium — reasoning/coördinatie/action-laag

- Interpreteert index + sensordata, maakt plannen, coördineert uitvoering.
- Voert zelf nooit mutaties uit; delegeert aan capabilities (skills) via permission gates (§8).
- Volgt strikt de core loop uit `README.md`: DISCOVER → UNDERSTAND → PLAN → ASK PERMISSION → BUILD → TEST → CHECKPOINT.
- Vandaag bestaat Mycelium als principe + core loop; reasoning-runtime is TOEKOMST (§12-status).

## 3. INVENTory — fysieke wereld/object/hardware/sensor-laag

- Aparte codebase (niet in deze repo). Rapporteert objecten, hardware en sensormetingen.
- Koppeling met Mycelium verloopt later via stabiele IDs en provenance, nooit via direct filesystem-schrijven.
- Statusopgave: eigen testsuite, geverifieerd 35/35 groen op 2026-09-11 (3 testbestanden);
  eerdere "73/73"-claims zijn niet reproduceerbaar en worden nergens meer gesteld.
  Geldt hier als externe context, niet als geverifieerd feit in deze repo.

## 4. Desktop Agent — computer/project/filesystem-laag (NU)

- `agent.py` v0.2.0, scanner `mycelium-desktop-agent`, modus `local-readonly`.
- Scant Desktop, Documents, Downloads; slaat `node_modules`, `.venv`, `__pycache__` e.d. over.
- Detecteert: git, python, node, documented, backup/kopie, nested, duplicaten.
- Leest Git-remotes uitsluitend uit `.git/config` (geen subprocess, geen netwerk).
- Schrijft alleen `discovery.json` naast zichzelf. Verwijdert, verplaatst of wijzigt nooit gebruikersprojecten.
- `agent_ui.py`: read-only Flask-UI met scan-knop; toont metadata, muteert niets.

## 5. Project Index — digitale projectwereld-index (NU)

- `project_index.py` v1.0.0 (`mycelium-project-index`), input `discovery.json`, output `project_index.json`.
- Stabiele project-ID: `sha1(computer|pad)[:16]`, case-insensitief. Zelfde computer + zelfde pad = zelfde ID, altijd. ID-schema is gedeeld met de scanner (`inventory.stable_id`); `agent.stable_id` is single source of truth.
- Per project: path, name, types, git-status, git remote, last_modified, file_count, recognized_files, backup/nested-status, `parent_id`, `relations` (`nested_children_ids`, `same_remote_ids`, `shared_name_ids`, `possible_copy_ids` = unie van remote + naam).
- Relaties zijn ID-verwijzingen (geen padafhankelijkheid), deterministisch gesorteerd.
- `possible_copy_ids` is een heuristiek (zelfde remote óf gedeelde naam), geen bewijs van identiteit.

## 6. World Model — verbindende laag (dit document + index)

- Het World Model is geen database maar een contract: lagen verwijzen naar elkaar via stabiele IDs + provenance.
- Digitale identiteit: project-ID uit de index. Fysieke identiteit (later): INVENTory-object-ID. Koppeltabel tussen die twee is TOEKOMST; het index-veld `inventory: {entity_type, stable_id, sync_ready}` is de gereserveerde haak.
- Alles wat het model beweert, is herleidbaar tot een observatie (§7).

## 7. Model-agnostische AI-adapters (TOEKOMST)

- Er is vandaag géén AI-model in de agent (bewust). Toekomstige modellen worden adapters achter een interface: input = index + plan-context, output = plan-voorstel, nooit directe actie.
- Adapters zijn vervangbaar zonder de lagen te wijzigen; provenance vermeldt altijd welk model/welke versie een voorstel deed.

## 8. Skills als herbruikbare capabilities (IN ONTWIKKELING)

- Een skill = één herbruikbare, geteste capability met vaste input/output (bv. `scan`, `index`, `checkpoint`, later `sense`, `detect`).
- Bestaande skills in de geest van dit model: discovery-scan (`agent.py`), indexbouw (`project_index.py`).
- Elke nieuwe skill krijgt: eigen module, eigen tests, eigen provenance-vermelding. Geen skill muteert buiten zijn gedeclareerde output.

## 9. Provenance (NU, verplicht voor alles nieuw)

- Elke observatie draagt: `source` (waar vandaan), `found_at`/`indexed_at` (wanneer), `scanner` + `scanner_version` / `indexer` + `indexer_version` (wie).
- Scanner-bron: `local-filesystem-scan`. Index-bron: `mycelium-desktop-agent:discovery.json`.
- Regel: informatie zonder provenance wordt niet vertrouwd en niet gekoppeld.

## 10. Permission gates (beleid NU, afdwinging IN ONTWIKKELING)

- Beleid staat in `README.md`: nooit verwijderen/verplaatsen zonder expliciete toestemming, nooit destructieve commando's zonder toestemming, eerst inspecteren, Git-checkpoint vóór wijzigingen, tests na wijzigingen.
- Gates als code bestaan nog niet; elke muterende skill moet straks een gate aanroepen vóór uitvoering (voorstel volgende milestone: `checkpoint.py`).
- Read-only paden (scan, index, UI-weergave) hebben geen gate nodig en krijgen er geen.

## 11. Plan → approve → execute → test → checkpoint → learn (norm)

- PLAN: Mycelium stelt een plan op uit index + context; plan is data, geen actie.
- APPROVE: mens (of gedelegeerde policy) keurt goed via permission gate.
- EXECUTE: skills voeren uit binnen hun gedeclareerde output-grenzen.
- TEST: bestaande testsuites draaien; falen = stoppen en herstellen.
- CHECKPOINT: Git-checkpoint van geraakte projecten + index-momentopname.
- LEARN: uitkomsten terugvoeren als provenance-gelabelde observaties (TOEKOMST, gesloten lus).

## 12. Toekomstige camera/VLM/detectie pipeline (TOEKOMST)

- Camera → VLM/detector → objectobservaties met provenance → INVENTory-laag → optionele koppeling aan project-ID (bv. "welk project hoort bij dit werkstuk").
- Pipeline is read-only ten opzichte van de fysieke wereld; stuurt nooit hardware aan zonder gate (§10).
- Vereist eerst: adapter-interface (§7) + koppelveld project-ID ↔ object-ID (§6).

## 13. Toekomstige sensoren en fysieke hardware (TOEKOMST)

- Sensoren publiceren metingen met provenance (sensor-ID, timestamp, eenheid) naar INVENTory.
- Hardware-actuatie valt altijd onder permission gates; geen autonome fysieke acties zonder goedkeuring.
- Desktop Agent raakt hardware nooit direct aan; communicatie loopt via INVENTory-structuren.

## 14. Toekomstige digitale twin (TOEKOMST)

- Twin = World Model + live observaties (index + INVENTory-metingen) + plannen.
- Geen aparte database in fase 1: de twin is een samengestelde view over `project_index.json` en INVENTory-output, met provenance per feit.
- Doel: "waar staat alles, wat verandert, wat is van plan" — alleen lezen tot gates + checkpoint bestaan.

## 15. Statusoverzicht

| Onderdeel | Status | Bewijs / opmerking |
|---|---|---|
| Discovery-scan v0.2.0 | NU | `agent.py`, 16 tests |
| `discovery.json` + provenance | NU | 9 projecten, scanner-veld |
| Project Index v1.0.0 | NU | `project_index.py`, 19 tests |
| `project_index.json` + relaties | NU | 9 projecten, 7 met relaties |
| Read-only UI | NU | `agent_ui.py`, scan-knop, muteert niets |
| Provenance-velden | NU | scanner- + indexer-provenance |
| Permission-beleid | NU (beleid) | `README.md` safety principles |
| INVENTory-koppeling via `stable_id` | IN ONTWIKKELING | haakveld `inventory` bestaat, koppeling nog niet |
| Permission gates als code | IN ONTWIKKELING | voorgesteld: `checkpoint.py` |
| Checkpoint-skill | IN ONTWIKKELING | voorgestelde volgende milestone |
| Mycelium reasoning-runtime | TOEKOMST | alleen core loop + principes |
| Model-agnostische AI-adapters | TOEKOMST | expliciet nog géén model |
| Skills-framework (formeel) | TOEKOMST | nu: conventie, geen framework |
| Camera/VLM/detectie | TOEKOMST | vereist §6 + §7 |
| Sensoren/hardware-aansturing | TOEKOMST | altijd achter gates |
| Digitale twin | TOEKOMST | view over index + INVENTory |
| Learn-lus (gesloten) | TOEKOMST | vereist checkpoint + provenance |

## 16. Harde grenzen (blijvend)

- Lokaal-first: geen externe API's zonder expliciet architectuurbesluit.
- Read-only als default; mutaties alleen via plan → approve → checkpoint.
- Niets buiten `agent/` schrijven; nooit gebruikersbestanden verwijderen, verplaatsen of wijzigen zonder toestemming.
- Geen UI-redesign zonder apart besluit; UI blijft observatie-instrument, geen actieconsole.
