<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/executor_registry.py">
"""Explicit executor registry for Mycelium (M7.3).

Identity plus capability discovery only. This module answers three
questions and nothing more:

- is this kind registered? (:func:`resolve_executor`)
- which spec belongs to it? (the returned :class:`ExecutorSpec`)
- does a node claim the matching capability? (:func:`supports_node`)

It never authorizes, never dispatches, never completes, and never
approves anything. A successful registry match means exclusively:
"this executor exists and this node claims the matching capability."

Namespace rule: only capabilities of the exact form ``exec:<kind>``
count. Bare names, longer names sharing a prefix, and names from other
namespaces never match. No substring or fuzzy matching anywhere.
"""

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

EXEC_NAMESPACE = "exec:"
SYSTEM_INVENTORY_KIND = "system_inventory"


class ExecutorSpec(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    executor_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    capability: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    input_contract: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
    output_contract: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
    allowed_side_effects: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


def _canonical_capability(value) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return None
    text = value.strip().lower()
    if not text or not text.startswith(EXEC_NAMESPACE):
        return None
    return text


class ExecutorRegistry:
    """Explicit, deterministic registry. Entries are fixed at construction."""

    def __init__(self):
        self._by_kind: dict[str, ExecutorSpec] = {}
        self._ids: set[str] = set()
        self._capabilities: set[str] = set()

    def register(self, spec: ExecutorSpec) -> ExecutorSpec:
        if not isinstance(spec, ExecutorSpec):
            raise ValueError("Only ExecutorSpec entries can be registered")
        if spec.executor_id in self._ids:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate executor_id '{spec.executor_id}'")
        if spec.kind in self._by_kind:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate kind '{spec.kind}'")
        if spec.capability in self._capabilities:
            raise ValueError(f"Duplicate capability '{spec.capability}'")
        self._by_kind[spec.kind] = spec
        self._ids.add(spec.executor_id)
        self._capabilities.add(spec.capability)
        return spec

    def kinds(self) -> list[str]:
        return sorted(self._by_kind)

    def executor_ids(self) -> list[str]:
        return sorted(self._ids)


def resolve_executor(registry: ExecutorRegistry, kind) -> ExecutorSpec | None:
    """Exact lookup of a registered kind. Unknown or malformed kinds deny."""
    if not isinstance(kind, str) or not kind:
        return None
    return registry._by_kind.get(kind)


def supports_node(spec: ExecutorSpec, node_capabilities) -> bool:
    """Exact capability check: the node must claim spec.capability verbatim.

    Node entries are normalized (trimmed, lowercased) exactly as M6.2
    permits; the registry value itself is canonical. Anything else denies.
    """
    if not isinstance(spec, ExecutorSpec):
        return False
    if not isinstance(node_capabilities, (list, tuple, set)):
        return False
    claimed = set()
    for entry in node_capabilities:
        canonical = _canonical_capability(entry)
        if canonical is not None:
            claimed.add(canonical)
    return spec.capability in claimed


def default_executor_registry() -> ExecutorRegistry:
    """Registry holding only the pre-existing system_inventory executor."""
    registry = ExecutorRegistry()
    registry.register(ExecutorSpec(
        executor_id=SYSTEM_INVENTORY_KIND,
        kind=SYSTEM_INVENTORY_KIND,
        capability=f"{EXEC_NAMESPACE}{SYSTEM_INVENTORY_KIND}",
        input_contract={},
        output_contract={"operating_system": "str", "machine": "str",
                         "cpu_cores": "int", "memory_mb": "int"},
        allowed_side_effects=[],
    ))
    return registry
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/finance.py">
"""Finance ecosystem foundation (BIG #42).

Minimal, first-class finance records. This is NOT accounting
software: just enough to make money a real ecosystem entity that
projects, missions, symbiosis, guide and the morning report can
reference honestly.

- No fake records: rows are only created through the explicit API
  with operator-supplied figures. Unknown amounts stay NULL and
  render as UNKNOWN — never zero, never invented.
- Kinds (closed): income | expense | budget.
- Status (closed): DRAFT | CONFIRMED | ARCHIVED.
- Privacy: amounts live ONLY in this store + its dedicated
  endpoints. Generic packets carry counts; amounts are included
  only when the packet's project_id matches the record's
  project_ref. Telemetry never carries finance data.

Storage: chat DB table finance_records (additive, idempotent).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re as _re
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

FINANCE_KINDS = ("income", "expense", "budget")
FINANCE_STATUSES = ("DRAFT", "CONFIRMED", "ARCHIVED")

_CURRENCY_RE = _re.compile(r"^[A-Z]{3}$")


class FinanceRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was stored."""


class FinanceRecord(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    record_id: str = Field(min_length=4, max_length=80)
    kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=16)
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    amount_minor: int | None = None
    currency: str = Field(default="EUR", max_length=3)
    project_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    status: str = Field(default="DRAFT", max_length=16)
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""
    provenance: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_record_id() -> str:
    return f"fin_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def init_finance_tables(db) -> None:
    db.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS finance_records (
            record_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            amount_minor INTEGER DEFAULT NULL,
            currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EUR',
            project_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT',
            note TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
        );
        """)
    db.execute("""
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_finance_project
            ON finance_records(project_ref, status);
        """)


def _ensure(db) -> None:
    init_finance_tables(db)


def new_record(*, kind: str, title: str,
               amount_minor: int | None = None,
               currency: str = "EUR", project_ref: str = "",
               note: str = "", recorded_by: str = "operator",
               provenance: dict | None = None) -> FinanceRecord:
    cleaned_kind = str(kind or "").strip().lower()[:16]
    if cleaned_kind not in FINANCE_KINDS:
        raise FinanceRefusedError(
            f"Unknown finance kind '{kind}'; expected one of "
            f"{list(FINANCE_KINDS)}")
    cleaned_title = str(title or "").strip()
    if not cleaned_title:
        raise FinanceRefusedError("Finance record needs a title")
    if len(cleaned_title) > 200:
        raise FinanceRefusedError("Finance title is too long")
    amount = None
    if amount_minor is not None:
        try:
            amount = int(amount_minor)
        except (TypeError, ValueError) as error:
            raise FinanceRefusedError(
                "amount_minor must be an integer or omitted") from error
        if amount < 0:
            raise FinanceRefusedError("amount_minor cannot be negative")
        if amount > 10**15:
            raise FinanceRefusedError("amount_minor is unrealistically large")
    cur = str(currency or "EUR").strip().upper()[:3]
    if not _CURRENCY_RE.match(cur):
        raise FinanceRefusedError(
            "currency must be a 3-letter code (e.g. EUR)")
    project = str(project_ref or "").strip()[:120]
    stamp = now()
    actor = str(recorded_by or "operator").strip()[:120] or "operator"
    prov = dict(provenance) if isinstance(provenance, dict) else {}
    prov.update({"source_type": "human-recorded",
                 "creator_id": actor, "human_verified": False})
    return FinanceRecord(
        record_id=generate_record_id(), kind=cleaned_kind,
        title=cleaned_title[:200], amount_minor=amount,
        currency=cur, project_ref=project, status="DRAFT",
        note=str(note or "").strip()[:1000],
        created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp, provenance=prov)


def save_record(record: FinanceRecord) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        db.execute(
            """INSERT INTO finance_records
            (record_id, kind, title, amount_minor, currency,
             project_ref, status, note, created_at, updated_at,
             provenance) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(record_id) DO UPDATE SET
             title=excluded.title, amount_minor=excluded.amount_minor,
             currency=excluded.currency,
             project_ref=excluded.project_ref, status=excluded.status,
             note=excluded.note, updated_at=excluded.updated_at,
             provenance=excluded.provenance""",
            (record.record_id, record.kind, record.title,
             record.amount_minor, record.currency, record.project_ref,
             record.status, record.note, record.created_at,
             record.updated_at, dump(record.provenance)))
    _audit("finance.recorded",
           f"Finance {record.kind} '{record.title}' "
           f"[{record.status}]",
           payload={"record_id": record.record_id,
                    "kind": record.kind})


def _row_to_record(row) -> FinanceRecord:
    from .database import load
    try:
        prov = load(row["provenance"])
    except Exception:
        prov = {}
    if not isinstance(prov, dict):
        prov = {}
    return FinanceRecord(
        record_id=row["record_id"], kind=row["kind"] or "expense",
        title=row["title"] or "", amount_minor=row["amount_minor"],
        currency=row["currency"] or "EUR",
        project_ref=row["project_ref"] or "",
        status=row["status"] or "DRAFT", note=row["note"] or "",
        created_at=row["created_at"] or "",
        updated_at=row["updated_at"] or "", provenance=prov)


def get_record(record_id: str) -> FinanceRecord | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    cleaned = str(record_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned:
        return None
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM finance_records WHERE record_id=?",
            (cleaned,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return _row_to_record(row)


def list_records(*, project_ref: str = "", kind: str = "",
                 status: str = "", limit: int = 100) -> list[FinanceRecord]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 100), 200))
    clauses: list = []
    args: list = []
    if project_ref:
        clauses.append("project_ref=?")
        args.append(str(project_ref)[:120])
    if kind:
        if str(kind).strip().lower() not in FINANCE_KINDS:
            raise FinanceRefusedError(f"Unknown finance kind '{kind}'")
        clauses.append("kind=?")
        args.append(str(kind).strip().lower())
    if status:
        if str(status).strip().upper() not in FINANCE_STATUSES:
            raise FinanceRefusedError(
                f"Unknown finance status '{status}'")
        clauses.append("status=?")
        args.append(str(status).strip().upper())
    query = "SELECT * FROM finance_records"
    if clauses:
        query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(clauses)
    query += " ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?"
    args.append(count)
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        rows = db.execute(query, tuple(args)).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_record(row) for row in rows]


def set_status(record_id: str, status: str) -> FinanceRecord | None:
    cleaned = str(status or "").strip().upper()[:16]
    if cleaned not in FINANCE_STATUSES:
        raise FinanceRefusedError(
            f"Unknown finance status '{status}'")
    record = get_record(record_id)
    if record is None:
        return None
    record.status = cleaned
    record.updated_at = now()
    save_record(record)
    return record


def summarize(*, project_ref: str = "") -> dict:
    """Counts + per-kind totals for CONFIRMED rows with known amounts.
    Unknown amounts are counted, never summed."""
    records = list_records(project_ref=project_ref, limit=200)
    out: dict = {"total": len(records), "by_kind": {},
                 "unknown_amounts": 0}
    for record in records:
        bucket = out["by_kind"].setdefault(
            record.kind, {"count": 0, "known_minor": 0,
                          "known_count": 0})
        bucket["count"] += 1
        if record.amount_minor is None:
            out["unknown_amounts"] += 1
        elif record.status == "CONFIRMED":
            bucket["known_minor"] += int(record.amount_minor)
            bucket["known_count"] += 1
    return out


def _audit(event_type: str, summary: str, *,
           payload: dict | None = None) -> None:
    try:
        from .events import new_event, save_event
        save_event(new_event(event_type, summary,
                             payload=payload or {}))
    except Exception:
        pass

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/garmin.py">
"""Garmin integration layer (BIG #11-15, Phase 2).

Honest states only: IMPLEMENTED (adapter interface, mock
provider, import pipeline) vs LIVE (real account data — only
when a real, legal API path with user credentials exists,
which it does not here). This module never pretends live
Garmin data works.

Provider states: AVAILABLE / UNAVAILABLE / MOCK /
CONFIGURED / AUTH_REQUIRED. Import maps provider samples to
health measurements (source=wearable,
provenance=external-source/imported) with cursor paging,
deduplication and a simulated rate limit on the mock.
"""

import os
import secrets
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

GARMIN_STATES = (
    "AVAILABLE",
    "UNAVAILABLE",
    "MOCK",
    "CONFIGURED",
    "AUTH_REQUIRED",
)

# Provider sample type → health metric.
GARMIN_METRIC_MAP = {
    "steps": "steps",
    "sleep_hours": "sleep_hours",
    "stress": "stress",
    "resting_heart_rate": "heart_rate_bpm",
    "calories": "calories",
}

MOCK_RATE_LIMIT = 60


class GarminRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed Garmin validation."""


def now() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now(
        datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


class GarminSample(BaseModel):
    sample_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    sample_type: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    value: float
    observed_at: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)


class GarminProvider:
    """Adapter interface. Subclasses implement status() and
    fetch(). No network in the base."""

    name = "base"

    def status(self) -> dict:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def fetch(self, *, since: str = "", cursor: int = 0,
              limit: int = 50) -> tuple[list[GarminSample], int]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class UnavailableGarminProvider(GarminProvider):
    """Default: no credentials, no API path configured."""

    name = "unavailable"

    def status(self) -> dict:
        token = bool(os.environ.get("GARMIN_TOKEN", ""))
        if token:
            return {"state": "AUTH_REQUIRED",
                    "detail": "a token is configured but no "
                              "reviewed live Garmin transport "
                              "exists; live import stays off",
                    "provider": self.name}
        return {"state": "UNAVAILABLE",
                "detail": "no Garmin credentials and no live "
                          "transport; use the mock provider for "
                          "tests and development",
                "provider": self.name}

    def fetch(self, *, since: str = "", cursor: int = 0,
              limit: int = 50) -> tuple[list[GarminSample], int]:
        raise GarminRefusedError(
            "live Garmin provider is unavailable; no data "
            "was fetched and none is pretended")


class MockGarminProvider(GarminProvider):
    """Deterministic synthetic samples for tests/dev. Labelled
    MOCK everywhere; cursor paging, dedup-safe ids and a
    simulated rate limit included."""

    name = "mock"

    def __init__(self, days: int = 7):
        self.days = max(1, min(int(days), 30))
        self.calls = 0

    def status(self) -> dict:
        return {"state": "MOCK",
                "detail": "synthetic deterministic samples; "
                          "not a live integration",
                "provider": self.name}

    def _samples(self) -> list[GarminSample]:
        import datetime
        # Fixed anchor: deterministic across instances, so
        # re-imports deduplicate like a real cursor feed.
        base = datetime.datetime(
            2026, 9, 1, 8, 0, tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
        out = []
        for day in range(self.days):
            moment = (base - datetime.timedelta(
                days=day)).isoformat()
            seed = day + 1
            out.append(GarminSample(
                sample_id=f"grm-mock-steps-{seed}",
                sample_type="steps",
                value=float(4000 + (seed * 137) % 6000),
                observed_at=moment))
            out.append(GarminSample(
                sample_id=f"grm-mock-sleep-{seed}",
                sample_type="sleep_hours",
                value=round(6.5 + (seed % 5) * 0.4, 2),
                observed_at=moment))
            out.append(GarminSample(
                sample_id=f"grm-mock-stress-{seed}",
                sample_type="stress",
                value=float(1 + (seed % 4)),
                observed_at=moment))
        return out

    def fetch(self, *, since: str = "", cursor: int = 0,
              limit: int = 50) -> tuple[list[GarminSample], int]:
        self.calls += 1
        if self.calls > MOCK_RATE_LIMIT:
            raise GarminRefusedError(
                "mock rate limit hit; back off")
        try:
            start = max(0, int(cursor or 0))
            count = max(1, min(int(limit or 50), 100))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise GarminRefusedError(
                "cursor/limit must be integers")
        items = [sample for sample in self._samples()
                 if not since or sample.observed_at > since]
        page = items[start:start + count]
        return page, start + len(page)


def get_garmin_provider(name: str | None = None,
                        **kwargs) -> GarminProvider:
    if (name or "unavailable") == "mock":
        return MockGarminProvider(**kwargs)
    return UnavailableGarminProvider()


def import_samples(provider: GarminProvider, *,
                   since: str = "", cursor: int = 0,
                   limit: int = 50) -> dict:
    """Fetch one page and map it to health measurements.
    Deduplicates on metric/source/observed_at; returns counts
    plus the next cursor. Provenance always
    external-source/imported with the provider named."""
    from .health import new_measurement, save_measurement
    try:
        page, next_cursor = provider.fetch(
            since=since, cursor=cursor, limit=limit)
    except GarminRefusedError:
        raise
    except Exception as error:
        raise GarminRefusedError(f"fetch failed: {error}")
    imported = 0
    duplicates = 0
    skipped = 0
    for sample in page:
        metric = GARMIN_METRIC_MAP.get(sample.sample_type)
        if metric is None:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        try:
            measurement = new_measurement(
                metric, sample.value, source="wearable",
                observed_at=sample.observed_at,
                provenance=Provenance(
                    source_type="external-source",
                    creator_id=f"garmin:{provider.name}",
                    human_verified=False,
                    notes=f"imported {sample.sample_type} "
                          f"(ref {sample.sample_id})"))
        except Exception:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        if save_measurement(measurement):
            imported += 1
        else:
            duplicates += 1
    return {"imported": imported, "duplicates": duplicates,
            "skipped": skipped, "next_cursor": next_cursor,
            "provider": provider.name,
            "provider_state": provider.status()["state"]}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/git_commit.py">
"""Git controlled-commit capability (BIG #5).

The read-only context (``git_context.py``: status/branch/diff)
stays exactly as it is. This module adds ONE write capability —
create a commit — behind the same proposal/approval/fingerprint
machinery as every other controlled write.

What is NOT here (deliberately, no exceptions):

- no push, no fetch, no force-push, no branch deletion;
- no checkout, no merge, no arbitrary git command;
- no shell: only fixed argv lists through ``subprocess.run``
  with ``shell=False`` and a 10s timeout;
- no credential or secret handling of any kind.

A commit executes only when ALL of these hold:

- the repository is on an explicit operator allow-list
  (``MYCELIUM_GIT_WRITE_REPOS``, OS path separator; default
  empty means everything refuses);
- the WriteApproval binds to the exact proposal (fingerprint,
  non-stale) via ``controlled_writes.revalidate``;
- the current branch matches and HEAD still equals expected_head;
- every file is inside the repository, relative, without
  traversal, and on the proposal's file allow-list;
- the working tree contains NO changes outside the allow-listed
  files (unexpected changes BLOCK, never auto-commit);
- the message is bounded operator-approved text.

Verification re-reads HEAD, parent and branch afterwards and
compares them — a ``commit`` return code alone never verifies.
"""

import os
import subprocess

from .controlled_writes import (
    WriteApproval,
    WriteProposal,
    WriteResult,
    now,
    propose_write,
    revalidate,
)
from .inventory_read import Provenance

ALLOW_LIST_ENV_VAR = "MYCELIUM_GIT_WRITE_REPOS"
GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0
MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS = 500
MAX_FILES = 20

STATUS_ARGV = ["status", "--porcelain=v1", "-b"]
HEAD_ARGV = ["rev-parse", "HEAD"]
BRANCH_ARGV = ["branch", "--show-current"]
LOG_ARGV = ["log", "-1", "--format=%H%x00%P%x00%s"]


class GitWriteRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused the commit; nothing was executed."""


class GitWriteFailedError(RuntimeError):
    """The commit failed; nothing is verified."""


def allow_listed_repos() -> list[str]:
    """Operator allow-list of writable repositories (absolute paths)."""
    raw = os.environ.get(ALLOW_LIST_ENV_VAR, "")
    repos: list[str] = []
    for entry in raw.split(os.pathsep):
        entry = entry.strip()
        if not entry:
            continue
        path = os.path.abspath(entry)
        if os.path.isdir(path) and path not in repos:
            repos.append(path)
    return repos


def _repository_path(repo: str, allow_list: list[str] | None) -> str:
    if not isinstance(repo, str) or not repo.strip():
        raise GitWriteRefusedError("Repository must be non-empty text")
    path = os.path.abspath(repo.strip())
    allowed = allow_list if allow_list is not None else allow_listed_repos()
    if path not in [os.path.abspath(entry) for entry in allowed]:
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            f"Repository '{repo.strip()[:120]}' is not on the "
            "operator write allow-list; refusing")
    if not os.path.isdir(path):
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(f"Not a directory: {path[:200]}")
    if not os.path.isdir(os.path.join(path, ".git")):
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(f"Not a git repository: {path[:200]}")
    return path


def _checked_files(files, repo: str) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(files, list) or not files:
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            "Commit needs a non-empty file allow-list")
    if len(files) > MAX_FILES:
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            f"Too many files (max {MAX_FILES})")
    clean: list[str] = []
    for entry in files:
        if not isinstance(entry, str) or not entry.strip():
            raise GitWriteRefusedError("File entries must be non-empty text")
        text = entry.strip().replace("\\", "/")
        if (text.startswith("/") or text.startswith("~")
                or ".." in text.split("/")):
            raise GitWriteRefusedError(
                f"File '{entry[:120]}' escapes the repository; refusing")
        resolved = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(repo, text))
        if resolved != repo and not resolved.startswith(repo + os.sep):
            raise GitWriteRefusedError(
                f"File '{entry[:120]}' is outside the repository; refusing")
        if text in clean:
            raise GitWriteRefusedError(f"Duplicate file '{text}'")
        clean.append(text)
    return clean


def _checked_message(message: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(message, str) or not message.strip():
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            "Commit message must be non-empty text")
    if len(message.strip()) > MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS:
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            f"Commit message exceeds {MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS} characters")
    return message.strip()


def _checked_head(value: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise GitWriteRefusedError("expected_head must be non-empty text")
    text = value.strip()
    if len(text) < 7 or len(text) > 40:
        raise GitWriteRefusedError("expected_head is not a plausible SHA")
    if any(char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in text.lower()):
        raise GitWriteRefusedError("expected_head is not a hex SHA")
    return text.lower()


def propose_git_commit(proposal_id: str, repository: str, branch: str,
                       expected_head: str, message: str,
                       files: list[str], *,
                       changeset_fingerprint: str,
                       actor: str = "mycelium",
                       allow_list: list[str] | None = None) -> WriteProposal:
    """Build a validated git-commit proposal. Performs nothing.

    ``changeset_fingerprint`` binds the approval to the exact diff
    the human reviewed (e.g. sha256 of the approved diff stat); a
    changed worktree re-fingerprints differently at execution and
    refuses.
    """
    repo = _repository_path(repository, allow_list)
    if not isinstance(branch, str) or not branch.strip():
        raise GitWriteRefusedError("branch must be non-empty text")
    if "/" in branch.strip() or ".." in branch.strip():
        raise GitWriteRefusedError("branch must be a plain branch name")
    head = _checked_head(expected_head)
    text = _checked_message(message)
    clean_files = _checked_files(files, repo)
    if (not isinstance(changeset_fingerprint, str)
            or len(changeset_fingerprint) != 64
            or any(char not in "0123456789abcdef"
                   for char in changeset_fingerprint.lower())):
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            "changeset_fingerprint must be a sha256 hex digest")
    payload = {
        "repository": repo,
        "branch": branch.strip(),
        "expected_head": head,
        "message": text,
        "files": clean_files,
        "changeset_fingerprint": changeset_fingerprint.lower(),
    }
    return propose_write(proposal_id, "git.commit",
                         f"git:{repo}", payload, actor=actor)


def capability_for(_proposal: WriteProposal) -> str:
    return "git.write.commit"


def _run_git(repo: str, argv: list[str]) -> str:
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", repo, *argv],
            capture_output=True, text=True,
            timeout=GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, shell=False)
    except FileNotFoundError as error:
        raise GitWriteFailedError("git binary not available") from error
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        raise GitWriteFailedError("git timed out") from error
    except OSError as error:
        raise GitWriteFailedError(f"git could not run: {error}") from error
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise GitWriteFailedError(
            f"git refused: {(completed.stderr or '').strip()[:200]}")
    return completed.stdout or ""


def read_commit_state(repo: str,
                      allow_list: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
    """Independent readback of branch, HEAD and worktree. Read-only."""
    path = _repository_path(repo, allow_list)
    head = _run_git(path, HEAD_ARGV).strip()
    branch = _run_git(path, BRANCH_ARGV).strip()
    status = _run_git(path, STATUS_ARGV)
    changed = sorted(
        line[3:].strip() for line in status.splitlines()
        if line.strip() and not line.startswith("##"))
    return {"repository": path, "head": head, "branch": branch,
            "changed_files": changed}


def execute_git_commit(proposal: WriteProposal,
                       approval: WriteApproval, *,
                       allow_list: list[str] | None = None,
                       now_str: str | None = None) -> WriteResult:
    """Execute one approved commit proposal. Fixed argv only.

    Any boundary violation BLOCKs with no commit; transport/git
    failures yield a failed result — never a false success.
    """
    fingerprint = revalidate(proposal, approval,
                             now_str or now())
    if proposal.mutation_type != "git.commit":
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            f"Mutation '{proposal.mutation_type}' is not a git commit")
    payload = proposal.payload
    repo = _repository_path(payload.get("repository", ""), allow_list)
    branch = str(payload.get("branch", ""))
    expected_head = _checked_head(payload.get("expected_head", ""))
    message = _checked_message(payload.get("message", ""))
    files = _checked_files(payload.get("files", []), repo)
    before = _git_state_safe(repo, allow_list)
    try:
        _preconditions(repo, branch, expected_head, files, allow_list)
        _run_git(repo, ["add", "--", *files])
        _post_add_check(repo, files, allow_list)
        _run_git(repo, ["commit", "-m", message])
        after_state = read_commit_state(repo, allow_list)
    except (GitWriteRefusedError, GitWriteFailedError) as error:
        return WriteResult(
            proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id,
            fingerprint=fingerprint, outcome="blocked",
            before={"commit_state": before}, after={},
            actor=proposal.actor, executed_at=now(),
            error=str(error)[:2000],
            provenance=Provenance(
                source_type="ai-generated",
                creator_id=proposal.actor, human_verified=False,
                notes="git commit blocked/failed; nothing is verified"),
        )
    log = _run_git(repo, LOG_ARGV)
    parts = log.split("\x00")
    sha = parts[0].strip() if parts else ""
    parent = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
    return WriteResult(
        proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id, fingerprint=fingerprint,
        outcome="executed",
        before={"commit_state": before},
        after={"commit_state": after_state, "commit_sha": sha,
               "parent": parent,
               "subject": parts[2].strip() if len(parts) > 2 else ""},
        actor=proposal.actor, executed_at=now(),
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="ai-generated", creator_id=proposal.actor,
            human_verified=False,
            notes=f"controlled git commit {proposal.proposal_id}; "
                  "unverified until independent verification"),
    )


def _git_state_safe(repo: str,
                    allow_list: list[str] | None) -> dict:
    try:
        return read_commit_state(repo, allow_list)
    except (GitWriteRefusedError, GitWriteFailedError) as error:
        return {"repository": repo, "read_error": str(error)[:200]}


def _preconditions(repo: str, branch: str, expected_head: str,
                   files: list[str],
                   allow_list: list[str] | None) -> None:
    state = read_commit_state(repo, allow_list)
    if state["branch"] != branch:
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            f"Branch is '{state['branch']}'; proposal targets "
            f"'{branch}'; refusing")
    if not state["head"].lower().startswith(expected_head):
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            "HEAD moved since approval (expected "
            f"{expected_head[:12]}); refusing")
    unexpected = [entry for entry in state["changed_files"]
                  if entry not in files]
    if unexpected:
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            f"Unexpected worktree changes: {unexpected[:5]}; refusing")


def _post_add_check(repo: str, files: list[str],
                      allow_list: list[str] | None) -> None:
    """After staging, the worktree must still show only approved files."""
    state = read_commit_state(repo, allow_list)
    unexpected = [entry for entry in state["changed_files"]
                  if entry not in files]
    if unexpected:
        raise GitWriteRefusedError(
            f"Worktree changed during staging: {unexpected[:5]}; refusing")


def verify_git_commit(request, result: WriteResult, *,
                      allow_list: list[str] | None = None,
                      now_str: str | None = None):
    """Verify one git commit by independent readback (branch, HEAD,
    parent chain). A commit return code alone never verifies."""
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    from .verification import VerificationResult
    if not isinstance(result, WriteResult):
        raise ValueError("Verification needs a WriteResult")
    if result.proposal_id != request.proposal_id:
        raise ValueError("Verification does not belong to this result")
    if request.result_fingerprint != result.fingerprint:
        raise ValueError("Verification binds to a different result")
    stamp = now_str or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    base = {
        "verification_id": request.verification_id,
        "proposal_id": request.proposal_id,
        "result_fingerprint": request.result_fingerprint,
        "method": "git.readback",
        "expected": dict(request.expected),
        "observer": "mycelium-verifier",
        "provenance": Provenance(
            source_type="sensor-observed",
            creator_id="mycelium-verifier", human_verified=False,
            notes="independent git readback"),
    }
    if result.outcome != "executed":
        return VerificationResult(
            **base, outcome="failed",
            observed={"execution_outcome": result.outcome},
            source="write-result", verified_at=stamp,
            note="execution did not succeed; nothing to verify")
    expected = request.expected
    try:
        state = read_commit_state(
            str(expected.get("repository", "")), allow_list)
    except (GitWriteRefusedError, GitWriteFailedError) as error:
        return VerificationResult(
            **base, outcome="inconclusive",
            observed={"read_error": str(error)[:500]},
            source="git-readback", verified_at=stamp,
            note="repository unreadable; verification inconclusive")
    observed = {
        "repository": state["repository"],
        "branch": state["branch"],
        "head": state["head"],
    }
    sha = str(result.after.get("commit_sha", ""))
    if sha and not state["head"].lower().startswith(sha.lower()[:7]):
        return VerificationResult(
            **base, outcome="failed", observed=observed,
            source="git-readback", verified_at=stamp,
            note="HEAD does not contain the recorded commit; NOT verified")
    checks = [
        ("repository", expected.get("repository"), state["repository"]),
        ("branch", expected.get("branch"), state["branch"]),
    ]
    for label, want, got in checks:
        if want is not None and want != got:
            return VerificationResult(
                **base, outcome="failed", observed=observed,
                source="git-readback", verified_at=stamp,
                note=f"{label} mismatch (expected {want!r}); NOT verified")
    want_parent = str(expected.get("parent", "") or "")
    got_parent = str(result.after.get("parent", "") or "")
    if want_parent and want_parent != got_parent:
        return VerificationResult(
            **base, outcome="failed", observed=observed,
            source="git-readback", verified_at=stamp,
            note="parent mismatch; possible history rewrite; NOT verified")
    return VerificationResult(
        **base, outcome="passed", observed=observed,
        source="git-readback", verified_at=stamp,
        note="independent readback matches repository, branch, HEAD "
             "and parent")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/git_context.py">
"""Read-only Git context for Mycelium/agent (Fase M).

The agent may look at version control but never change it: this module
exposes exactly three facts — status, current branch, diff — through
fixed git argument lists. There is no push, no merge, no commit, no
checkout and no generic "run this git command" entry point; adding
write access needs an explicit, separately approved capability and
does not exist here.

Rules (tested):

- repository must be an existing local directory; missing paths and
  files fail closed before any process starts.
- only fixed argv lists are ever executed (no shell, no user flags,
  10s timeout); stderr/stdout are size-capped.
- a non-git directory or missing git binary surfaces as
  GitUnavailable, never as a traceback and never as partial output.
- diff output is truncated to DIFF_MAX_CHARS; status lines are
  line-capped. No automatic push exists anywhere in this module.
"""

import os
import subprocess

STATUS_ARGV = ["status", "--porcelain=v1", "-b"]
BRANCH_ARGV = ["branch", "--show-current"]
DIFF_STAT_ARGV = ["diff", "--stat"]
DIFF_ARGV = ["diff", "--no-color", "--no-ext-diff", "--"]
GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0
DIFF_MAX_CHARS = 20000
STATUS_MAX_LINES = 200
BRANCH_MAX_CHARS = 120


class GitUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    """Git context could not be read. Fail-closed, no partial facts."""


class GitRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused the request; nothing was executed."""


def _repository_path(repo: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(repo, str) or not repo.strip():
        raise GitRefusedError("Repository must be non-empty text")
    path = os.path.abspath(repo.strip())
    if not os.path.isdir(path):
        raise GitRefusedError(f"Not a directory: {repo.strip()[:200]}")
    return path


def _run_git(repo: str, argv: list[str]) -> str:
    path = _repository_path(repo)
    try:
        completed = subprocess.run(
            ["git", "-C", path, *argv],
            capture_output=True, text=True,
            timeout=GIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, shell=False)
    except FileNotFoundError as error:
        raise GitUnavailable("git binary not available") from error
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        raise GitUnavailable("git timed out") from error
    except OSError as error:
        raise GitUnavailable(f"git could not run: {error}") from error
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise GitUnavailable(
            f"git refused: {(completed.stderr or '').strip()[:200]}")
    return completed.stdout or ""


def git_status(repo: str) -> dict:
    """Porcelain status, line-capped. Read-only."""
    output = _run_git(repo, STATUS_ARGV)
    lines = [line for line in output.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    return {"repository": _repository_path(repo),
            "lines": lines[:STATUS_MAX_LINES],
            "truncated": len(lines) > STATUS_MAX_LINES}


def git_branch(repo: str) -> dict:
    """Current branch name. Read-only."""
    output = _run_git(repo, BRANCH_ARGV)
    return {"repository": _repository_path(repo),
            "branch": output.strip()[:BRANCH_MAX_CHARS] or "(geen branch)"}


def git_diff(repo: str, stat_only: bool = True) -> dict:
    """Diff stat (default) or full capped diff. Read-only, never pushed."""
    argv = DIFF_STAT_ARGV if stat_only else DIFF_ARGV
    output = _run_git(repo, argv)
    truncated = len(output) > DIFF_MAX_CHARS
    return {"repository": _repository_path(repo),
            "diff": output[:DIFF_MAX_CHARS],
            "truncated": truncated}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/hardware_links.py">
"""Human hardware links (BIG #42).

Explicit human-controlled verification for node/device claims.

Trust levels (see nodes.hardware_trust):
- ADVERTISED: the node said so (default, never a fact).
- OBSERVED: connected + fresh telemetry (<300s). Derived automatically.
- VERIFIED: ONLY via a row in this store with status VERIFIED,
  created by PROPOSE (anyone) + VERIFY (operator key only).

No automatic promotion exists: new_link() always creates PROPOSED,
verify_link() requires a non-empty human verified_by AND is only
called from routes that already checked the operator key. Nodes can
never self-verify with their own token. Revocation is operator-only
and sticks (a REVOKED link never counts as verified again).

Audit trail: every propose/verify/revoke emits a closed bus event
(hardware.linked / hardware.verified / hardware.revoked) naming the
human, node, device and evidence — never secrets.

Storage: chat DB table hardware_links (additive, idempotent).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re as _re
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

LINK_STATUSES = ("PROPOSED", "VERIFIED", "REVOKED")

_LINK_ID_RE = _re.compile(r"^hv_[0-9a-f]{8,32}$")


class HardwareLinkRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was stored."""


class HardwareLink(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    link_id: str = Field(min_length=4, max_length=80)
    human_ref: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    node_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    device_ref: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    device_kind: str = Field(default="", max_length=60)
    capability: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    evidence: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)
    status: str = Field(default="PROPOSED", max_length=16)
    verified_by: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    verified_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=40)
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""
    provenance: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_link_id() -> str:
    return f"hv_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def init_hardware_tables(db) -> None:
    """Additive, idempotent table setup (agenda-pattern)."""
    db.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS hardware_links (
            link_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            human_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            node_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            device_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            device_kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            capability TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            evidence TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PROPOSED',
            verified_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            verified_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
        );
        """)
    db.execute("""
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_hw_links_node
            ON hardware_links(node_id, status);
        """)


def _ensure(db) -> None:
    init_hardware_tables(db)


def _check_id(value: str, name: str, limit: int = 120) -> str:
    cleaned = str(value or "").strip()
    if not cleaned:
        raise HardwareLinkRefusedError(f"{name} is required")
    if len(cleaned) > limit:
        raise HardwareLinkRefusedError(f"{name} is too long")
    if _re.search(r"[\x00-\x1f\x7f]", cleaned):
        raise HardwareLinkRefusedError(f"{name} has control chars")
    return cleaned


def new_link(*, human_ref: str, node_id: str, device_ref: str,
             device_kind: str = "", capability: str = "",
             evidence: str = "", provenance: dict | None = None) -> HardwareLink:
    """Propose a human link. ALWAYS starts as PROPOSED — there is no
    parameter that can create a VERIFIED link directly."""
    from .nodes import check_node_id
    try:
        node = check_node_id(node_id)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise HardwareLinkRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    human = _check_id(human_ref, "human_ref")
    device = _check_id(device_ref, "device_ref")
    kind = str(device_kind or "").strip()[:60]
    cap = str(capability or "").strip()[:120]
    ev = str(evidence or "").strip()[:2000]
    stamp = now()
    prov = dict(provenance) if isinstance(provenance, dict) else {}
    prov.update({"source_type": "human-link-proposed",
                 "creator_id": human, "human_verified": False})
    return HardwareLink(
        link_id=generate_link_id(), human_ref=human, node_id=node,
        device_ref=device, device_kind=kind, capability=cap,
        evidence=ev, status="PROPOSED", verified_by="",
        verified_at="", created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp,
        provenance=prov)


def save_link(link: HardwareLink) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        db.execute(
            """INSERT INTO hardware_links
            (link_id, human_ref, node_id, device_ref, device_kind,
             capability, evidence, status, verified_by, verified_at,
             created_at, updated_at, provenance)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(link_id) DO UPDATE SET
             evidence=excluded.evidence, status=excluded.status,
             verified_by=excluded.verified_by,
             verified_at=excluded.verified_at,
             updated_at=excluded.updated_at,
             provenance=excluded.provenance""",
            (link.link_id, link.human_ref, link.node_id,
             link.device_ref, link.device_kind, link.capability,
             link.evidence, link.status, link.verified_by,
             link.verified_at, link.created_at, link.updated_at,
             dump(link.provenance)))


def _row_to_link(row) -> HardwareLink:
    from .database import load
    try:
        prov = load(row["provenance"])
    except Exception:
        prov = {}
    if not isinstance(prov, dict):
        prov = {}
    return HardwareLink(
        link_id=row["link_id"], human_ref=row["human_ref"],
        node_id=row["node_id"], device_ref=row["device_ref"],
        device_kind=row["device_kind"] or "",
        capability=row["capability"] or "",
        evidence=row["evidence"] or "",
        status=row["status"] or "PROPOSED",
        verified_by=row["verified_by"] or "",
        verified_at=row["verified_at"] or "",
        created_at=row["created_at"] or "",
        updated_at=row["updated_at"] or "",
        provenance=prov)


def get_link(link_id: str) -> HardwareLink | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    cleaned = str(link_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned:
        return None
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM hardware_links WHERE link_id=?",
            (cleaned,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return _row_to_link(row)


def list_links(*, node_id: str = "", status: str = "",
               limit: int = 100) -> list[HardwareLink]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 100), 200))
    query = "SELECT * FROM hardware_links"
    args: list = []
    clauses: list = []
    if node_id:
        clauses.append("node_id=?")
        args.append(str(node_id)[:80])
    if status:
        if status not in LINK_STATUSES:
            raise HardwareLinkRefusedError(
                f"Unknown link status '{status}'")
        clauses.append("status=?")
        args.append(status)
    if clauses:
        query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(clauses)
    query += " ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?"
    args.append(count)
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        rows = db.execute(query, tuple(args)).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_link(row) for row in rows]


def verify_link(link_id: str, *, verified_by: str) -> HardwareLink | None:
    """Mark a PROPOSED link VERIFIED. Caller MUST have checked the
    operator key first — this function enforces the human + state
    gates (non-empty verifier, PROPOSED only, never REVOKED)."""
    verifier = _check_id(verified_by, "verified_by")
    link = get_link(link_id)
    if link is None:
        return None
    if link.status == "VERIFIED":
        return link
    if link.status != "PROPOSED":
        raise HardwareLinkRefusedError(
            f"Link {link_id} is {link.status}; only PROPOSED links "
            "can be verified")
    link.status = "VERIFIED"
    link.verified_by = verifier
    link.verified_at = now()
    link.updated_at = link.verified_at
    prov = dict(link.provenance or {})
    prov.update({"source_type": "human-verified",
                 "human_verified": True,
                 "verified_by": verifier})
    link.provenance = prov
    save_link(link)
    _audit("hardware.verified",
           f"Hardware link {link.link_id} verified by {verifier}",
           node_id=link.node_id,
           payload={"link_id": link.link_id,
                    "device_ref": link.device_ref,
                    "verified_by": verifier})
    return link


def revoke_link(link_id: str, *, revoked_by: str,
                reason: str = "") -> HardwareLink | None:
    """Revoke a link. REVOKED sticks: verify_link() refuses to
    re-verify a revoked link."""
    actor = _check_id(revoked_by, "revoked_by")
    link = get_link(link_id)
    if link is None:
        return None
    link.status = "REVOKED"
    link.updated_at = now()
    prov = dict(link.provenance or {})
    prov.update({"human_verified": False,
                 "revoked_by": actor,
                 "revoke_reason": str(reason or "")[:500]})
    link.provenance = prov
    save_link(link)
    _audit("hardware.revoked",
           f"Hardware link {link.link_id} revoked by {actor}",
           node_id=link.node_id,
           payload={"link_id": link.link_id,
                    "revoked_by": actor})
    return link


def audit_propose(link: HardwareLink) -> None:
    _audit("hardware.linked",
           f"Hardware link {link.link_id} proposed by "
           f"{link.human_ref} for {link.node_id}/{link.device_ref}",
           node_id=link.node_id,
           payload={"link_id": link.link_id,
                    "device_ref": link.device_ref,
                    "human_ref": link.human_ref})


def verified_device_refs(node_id: str) -> set[str]:
    """Device refs with a live VERIFIED link for this node."""
    try:
        links = list_links(node_id=str(node_id or "")[:80],
                           status="VERIFIED", limit=200)
    except Exception:
        return set()
    return {link.device_ref for link in links
            if link.status == "VERIFIED"}


def trust_for(node_id: str, device_ref: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Human-link trust overlay: VERIFIED iff a live VERIFIED link
    names this exact node + device ref. Pure read, never derives."""
    ref = str(device_ref or "").strip()
    if not ref:
        return ("ADVERTISED", "no device reference")
    if ref in verified_device_refs(node_id):
        return ("VERIFIED", "explicit human link (operator-verified)")
    return ("", "")


def _audit(event_type: str, summary: str, *,
           node_id: str = "", payload: dict | None = None) -> None:
    try:
        from .events import new_event, save_event
        save_event(new_event(event_type, summary, node_id=node_id,
                             payload=payload or {}))
    except Exception:
        pass

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/health.py">
"""Health domain (BIG #11-15, Phase 2).

Personal tracking and trends — never a medical engine. There
is no illness-assessment function in this module, no hidden
score and no medical claim: the personal health index is a
transparent set of per-dimension ratios (raw values, method
shown, completeness shown, missing data shown).

Every measurement carries source + provenance. Sources arrive
through adapters (manual/wearable/sensor/derived/external/
file); the engine never hardcodes one integration.
"""

import secrets
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

# Closed metric allow-list: tracking only.
METRICS = {
    "sleep_hours": "h",
    "sleep_quality": "1-5",
    "steps": "count",
    "activity_min": "min",
    "training_min": "min",
    "recovery": "1-5",
    "hydration_l": "l",
    "meals_count": "count",
    "weight_kg": "kg",
    "bmi": "index",
    "waist_cm": "cm",
    "hip_cm": "cm",
    "waist_hip": "ratio",
    "energy": "1-5",
    "stress": "1-5",
    "heart_rate_bpm": "bpm",
    "calories": "kcal",
}

SOURCES = (
    "manual",
    "wearable",
    "sensor",
    "inventory_derived",
    "external",
    "file_import",
)

# Transparent index dimensions: metric → (dimension, target,
# direction). The method string is part of every output.
INDEX_DIMENSIONS = {
    "sleep": [("sleep_hours", 8.0, "near"),
              ("sleep_quality", 4.0, "max")],
    "activity": [("steps", 8000.0, "max"),
                 ("activity_min", 30.0, "max")],
    "recovery": [("recovery", 4.0, "max"),
                 ("sleep_hours", 8.0, "near")],
    "hydration": [("hydration_l", 2.0, "max")],
    "nutrition": [("meals_count", 3.0, "max")],
    "body": [("weight_kg", None, "trend")],
    "habits": [("energy", 4.0, "max")],
    "training": [("training_min", 150.0, "max-week")],
}


class HealthRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed health validation."""


def now() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now(
        datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_measurement_id() -> str:
    return f"hlth_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


class HealthMeasurement(BaseModel):
    measurement_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    metric: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    value: float
    unit: str = Field(default="", max_length=20)
    source: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    provenance: Provenance
    observed_at: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    created_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


def _check_metric_value(metric: str, value: float) -> float:
    if metric not in METRICS:
        raise HealthRefusedError(
            f"Unknown metric '{metric}'")
    try:
        number = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HealthRefusedError("value must be numeric")
    if number != number or number in (float("inf"),
                                      float("-inf")):
        raise HealthRefusedError("value must be finite")
    bounds = {"sleep_hours": (0, 24), "sleep_quality": (1, 5),
              "steps": (0, 200000), "activity_min": (0, 1440),
              "training_min": (0, 1440), "recovery": (1, 5),
              "hydration_l": (0, 15), "meals_count": (0, 12),
              "weight_kg": (20, 400), "bmi": (10, 80),
              "waist_cm": (30, 300), "hip_cm": (30, 300),
              "waist_hip": (0.3, 3.0), "energy": (1, 5),
              "stress": (1, 5), "heart_rate_bpm": (25, 250),
              "calories": (0, 20000)}
    low, high = bounds[metric]
    if not low <= number <= high:
        raise HealthRefusedError(
            f"{metric} must be within {low}..{high}")
    return number


def new_measurement(metric: str, value: float, *,
                    source: str = "manual",
                    observed_at: str = "",
                    provenance: Provenance | None = None
                    ) -> HealthMeasurement:
    """One validated measurement. Source is explicit; wearable
    or external values are marked, never silently trusted."""
    if source not in SOURCES:
        raise HealthRefusedError(f"Unknown source '{source}'")
    number = _check_metric_value(metric, value)
    stamp = now()
    return HealthMeasurement(
        measurement_id=generate_measurement_id(),
        metric=metric, value=number, unit=METRICS[metric],
        source=source,
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="user-created"
            if source == "manual" else "sensor-observed",
            creator_id=f"health:{source}",
            human_verified=source == "manual"),
        observed_at=observed_at or stamp, created_at=stamp)


def dedup_key_for(metric: str, source: str,
                  observed_at: str) -> str:
    return f"{metric}|{source}|{observed_at}"


def save_measurement(entry: HealthMeasurement) -> bool:
    """Insert unless the same metric/source/moment exists.
    Returns True when stored, False on duplicate."""
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        cursor = db.execute("""INSERT INTO health_measurements
        (measurement_id, metric, value, unit, source,
         provenance, observed_at, created_at, dedup_key)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(measurement_id) DO NOTHING""",
                            (entry.measurement_id,
                             entry.metric, entry.value,
                             entry.unit, entry.source,
                             dump(entry.provenance.model_dump(
                                 mode="json")),
                             entry.observed_at,
                             entry.created_at,
                             dedup_key_for(
                                 entry.metric, entry.source,
                                 entry.observed_at)))
        if cursor.rowcount == 0:
            return False
        existing = db.execute(
            "SELECT measurement_id FROM health_measurements "
            "WHERE dedup_key=? AND measurement_id!=?",
            (dedup_key_for(entry.metric, entry.source,
                           entry.observed_at),
             entry.measurement_id)).fetchone()
        if existing is not None:
            db.execute("DELETE FROM health_measurements WHERE "
                       "measurement_id=?",
                       (entry.measurement_id,))
            return False
    return True


def _row_to_measurement(row) -> HealthMeasurement:
    from .database import load
    return HealthMeasurement(
        measurement_id=row["measurement_id"],
        metric=row["metric"], value=row["value"],
        unit=row["unit"], source=row["source"],
        provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
        observed_at=row["observed_at"],
        created_at=row["created_at"])


def list_measurements(*, metric: str = "", source: str = "",
                      since: str = "",
                      limit: int = 100) -> list[HealthMeasurement]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    if metric and metric not in METRICS:
        raise HealthRefusedError(
            f"Unknown metric '{metric}'")
    if source and source not in SOURCES:
        raise HealthRefusedError(f"Unknown source '{source}'")
    init_chat_database()
    clauses, params = [], []
    if metric:
        clauses.append("metric=?")
        params.append(metric)
    if source:
        clauses.append("source=?")
        params.append(source)
    if since:
        clauses.append("observed_at>?")
        params.append(since)
    where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            f"SELECT * FROM health_measurements {where} ORDER "
            f"BY observed_at DESC LIMIT ?",
            (*params, max(1, min(int(limit or 100), 500)))
        ).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_measurement(row) for row in rows]


def trend_for(metric: str, *, limit: int = 30) -> dict:
    """Transparent trend: raw points, min/max/avg, method and
    completeness. No interpretation, no advice."""
    points = list_measurements(metric=metric, limit=limit)
    values = [entry.value for entry in points]
    ordered = sorted(values)
    count = len(values)
    return {
        "metric": metric, "unit": METRICS[metric],
        "count": count,
        "points": [{"value": entry.value,
                    "observed_at": entry.observed_at,
                    "source": entry.source}
                   for entry in points],
        "min": ordered[0] if ordered else None,
        "max": ordered[-1] if ordered else None,
        "avg": round(sum(values) / count, 2) if count else None,
        "method": "observed values sorted oldest-first; avg "
                  "is the arithmetic mean of stored points",
        "completeness": f"{count} stored point(s); gaps mean "
                        "no data, never zero",
    }


def _dimension_ratio(metric: str, target: float | None,
                     direction: str) -> dict | None:
    points = list_measurements(metric=metric, limit=7)
    if not points:
        return None
    latest = sum(entry.value for entry in points) / len(points)
    if target is None or direction == "trend":
        return {"value": None, "method": f"{metric}: "
                f"latest-7d mean {round(latest, 2)} "
                f"{METRICS[metric]} shown as trend only, "
                "no target judged",
                "completeness": f"{len(points)}/7 days",
                "inputs": len(points)}
    if direction == "near":
        ratio = max(0.0, 1.0 - abs(latest - target)
                    / target) if target else 0.0
        method = f"{metric}: 1 - |mean-target|/target " \
                 f"(mean {round(latest, 2)}, target {target})"
    else:
        ratio = max(0.0, min(1.0, latest / target)) \
            if target else 0.0
        method = f"{metric}: min(1, mean/target) " \
                 f"(mean {round(latest, 2)}, target {target})"
    return {"value": round(ratio, 3), "method": method,
            "completeness": f"{len(points)}/7 days",
            "inputs": len(points)}


def personal_health_index() -> dict:
    """Per-dimension ratios with method + completeness. The
    overall is a plain mean of available dimensions, labelled
    with how many dimensions fed it. Nothing hidden."""
    dimensions = {}
    for name, specs in INDEX_DIMENSIONS.items():
        parts = []
        for metric, target, direction in specs:
            part = _dimension_ratio(metric, target, direction)
            if part is not None:
                parts.append(part)
        if not parts:
            dimensions[name] = {
                "value": None, "method": "no data",
                "completeness": "0 inputs", "inputs": 0}
            continue
        values = [part["value"] for part in parts
                  if part["value"] is not None]
        dimensions[name] = {
            "value": round(sum(values) / len(values), 3)
            if values else None,
            "method": "mean of: " + "; ".join(
                part["method"] for part in parts),
            "completeness": f"{len(parts)}/{len(specs)} "
                            "signals present",
            "inputs": sum(part["inputs"] for part in parts)}
    available = [info["value"] for info in dimensions.values()
                 if info["value"] is not None]
    return {
        "dimensions": dimensions,
        "overall": round(sum(available) / len(available), 3)
        if available else None,
        "overall_method": "plain mean of available dimension "
                          "ratios (no weights, no model)",
        "overall_completeness": f"{len(available)}/"
                                f"{len(dimensions)} dimensions",
        "warning": "tracking transparency only; not a "
                   "medical statement of any kind",
    }
</file>

"""Hermes NPC agents: one real agent per NPC identity.

Mos is the first: a genuine Hermes agent (own session, own
context) instead of a scripted hint list. ``HERMES_NPCS`` is the
extension point for later NPCs — same shape, own session key.

Design (all existing systems, no new engine):

- Identity + session: ``npc-{npc_id}-{play_session_id}`` as the
  ``X-Hermes-Session-Key``. Stable across refresh, unique per
  player session. Hermes converges same-key calls onto one live
  server-side session.
- History: every turn is also stored in the existing
  ``conversations``/``messages`` tables under a deterministic
  ``conv-hermes-<sha>`` id (roles user/agent). No new tables;
  the gateway session stays the live memory, the chat DB is
  the durable audit trail.
- Context: every call prefixes a compact, freshly-read world
  snapshot (position, inventory, builds, clock, missions waiting,
  open research/candidates, INVENTory projects/objects). The
  agent "sees" INVENTory because Mycelium injects it — never
  because the model claims access.
- Screen: only an explicit opt-in text summary from the local
  VLM ever reaches the prompt (``screen_summary`` caller-side).
  Raw pixels never leave the vision layer.
- Actions: the agent NEVER acts directly. It proposes in prose;
  the player executes through existing UI (write proposals +
  exact-YES approvals, candidates, research, quests). Consequen-
  tial actions always need human confirmation first.
- Honesty: TEST/SIMULATED/BLOCKED/UNAVAILABLE states are part
  of the system prompt; the agent must surface them, never
  invent execution.
- No new tables, no scheduler.
"""

def npc_session_key(npc_id: str, play_session_id: str | None) -> str:
    """Stable Hermes session key per NPC + player session."""
    npc = str(npc_id or "").strip()
    if npc not in HERMES_NPCS:
        raise HermesRefusedError(f"Unknown Hermes NPC '{npc}'")
    play = str(play_session_id or "").strip()[:80] or "shared"
    return f"npc-{npc}-{play}"


def hermes_conversation_id(session_key: str) -> str:
    """Deterministic chat-DB conversation per Hermes session key.

    No mapping table: the same session key always resolves to the
    same ``conv-hermes-<sha>`` id, so history survives refresh and
    restart while the gateway session stays the live memory."""
    import hashlib
    digest = hashlib.sha256(
        str(session_key or "").encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
    return f"conv-hermes-{digest}"


def _persist_hermes_turn(session_key: str, npc_key: str, npc_name: str,
                         user_text: str, reply_text: str) -> str:
    """Store one turn (user + agent) in conversations/messages.

    Best-effort by design: history must never break a chat turn,
    so every failure degrades to gateway-only memory. Reuses the
    existing tables and validation — no new schema. Returns the
    conversation id (stable per session key, even on failure)."""
    conversation_id = hermes_conversation_id(session_key)
    try:
        import datetime

        from .conversations import MAX_CONTENT_CHARS, new_message
        from .database import (
            chat_connection,
            dump,
            init_chat_database,
        )
        created = datetime.datetime.now(
            datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        # Creator marks the Hermes origin; role agent can never
        # claim human verification (enforced by new_message).
        from .conversations import default_provenance_for
        user_message = new_message(
            conversation_id, "user", str(user_text or "")[:MAX_CONTENT_CHARS],
            provenance=default_provenance_for("user", f"hermes-{npc_key}"))
        agent_message = new_message(
            conversation_id, "agent",
            str(reply_text or "")[:MAX_CONTENT_CHARS],
            provenance=default_provenance_for("agent", f"hermes-{npc_key}"))
        init_chat_database()
        with chat_connection() as db:
            db.execute(
                """INSERT INTO conversations
                (conversation_id, title, project_ref, created_at)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
                ON CONFLICT(conversation_id) DO NOTHING""",
                (conversation_id,
                 f"{npc_name} · {str(session_key or '')[:40]}"[:120],
                 "", created))
            for stored in (user_message, agent_message):
                db.execute(
                    """INSERT INTO messages
                    (message_id, conversation_id, role, content,
                     created_at, provenance, sources)
                    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                    (stored.message_id, conversation_id, stored.role,
                     stored.content, created,
                     dump(stored.provenance.model_dump(mode="json")),
                     dump([])))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return conversation_id


def hermes_history(session_key: str, limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
    """Durable turns for one Hermes session, oldest first. Never raises."""
    try:
        from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
        conversation_id = hermes_conversation_id(session_key)
        init_chat_database()
        with chat_connection() as db:
            rows = db.execute(
                """SELECT role, content, created_at FROM messages
                WHERE conversation_id=? ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT ?""",
                (conversation_id, max(1, min(int(limit or 50), 50)))
            ).fetchall()
        return [dict(row) for row in rows]
    except Exception:
        return []


def _inventory_objects_sample() -> str:
    """Echte obj_-records (max 5) via GET-only loopback. Dezelfde
    grenzen als de bestaande bridge; nooit een uitzondering, nooit
    verzonnen objecten."""
    try:
        import os

        import httpx

        from .inventory_read import _validate_base_url as _check_url
        base = _check_url(os.environ.get(
            "INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8080"))
        with httpx.Client(timeout=5.0,
                          follow_redirects=False) as client:
            response = client.get(f"{base}/api/v1/objects")
        if response.status_code != 200:
            return ""
        data = response.json()
        if not isinstance(data, list):
            return ""
        items = []
        for entry in data:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                continue
            oid = str(entry.get("id", ""))
            if not oid.startswith("obj_"):
                continue
            items.append(f"{entry.get('name', oid)} ({oid})")
            if len(items) >= 5:
                break
        if not items:
            return "INVENTory-objecten: geen (lege wereld)."
        return "INVENTory-objecten: " + "; ".join(items) + "."
    except Exception:
        return ""


def build_npc_context(play_session_id: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Compact world snapshot for the agent. Never raises: every
    section is best-effort so one offline backend never breaks
    the chat."""
    lines = []
    sid = str(play_session_id or "").strip()
    if sid:
        try:
            from .play_workshop import get_play_inventory
            inv = get_play_inventory(sid)
            items = inv.get("items", {}) or {}
            have = ", ".join(f"{item}x{qty}"
                             for item, qty in sorted(items.items())
                             if qty) or "leeg"
            lines.append(f"Speler-voorraad: {have}.")
            builds = inv.get("builds", []) or []
            kinds = {}
            for build in builds:
                kind = str(build.get("kind", "?"))
                kinds[kind] = kinds.get(kind, 0) + 1
            made = ", ".join(f"{kind}x{num}"
                             for kind, num in sorted(kinds.items()))
            lines.append(f"Gebouwd: {made or 'nog niets'}.")
        except Exception:
            lines.append("Speler-voorraad: onleesbaar.")
        try:
            from .play_workshop import get_play_flags
            flags = get_play_flags(sid).get("flags", []) or []
            lines.append(f"Wereld-voortgang: {', '.join(flags) or 'start'}.")
        except Exception:
            pass
    try:
        from .play_workshop import play_journal
        journal = play_journal()
        counts = journal.get("counts", {}) or {}
        lines.append(
            "Mycelium: "
            f"{counts.get('missions_active', 0)} actieve missies, "
            f"{counts.get('missions_waiting', 0)} wachtend op YES, "
            f"{counts.get('research_open', 0)} open onderzoeken, "
            f"{counts.get('candidates_open', 0)} open vondsten, "
            f"{counts.get('projects_open', 0)} INVENTory-projecten, "
            f"{counts.get('memories_remembered', 0)} herinneringen."
        )
        projects = [p.get("title", "?")
                    for p in (journal.get("projects", []) or [])[:5]]
        if projects:
            lines.append("INVENTory-projecten: " + "; ".join(projects) + ".")
        state = (journal.get("inventory", {}) or {}).get("state", "")
        if state and state != "ok":
            lines.append(f"INVENTory-backend: {state} (eerlijk, niets verzonnen).")
    except Exception:
        lines.append("Mycelium-overzicht: onleesbaar.")
    sample = _inventory_objects_sample()
    if sample:
        lines.append(sample)
    lines.append(_observations_sample())
    screen = _screen_state_sample()
    if screen:
        lines.append(screen)
    return "\n".join(line for line in lines if line)


def _screen_state_sample() -> str:
    """Latest screen observation as READ context: monitor/node/
    screenshot reference/timestamp. Reading only — the agent can
    never act on the screen through this context. Never raises."""
    try:
        from .world_observations import list_observations
        rows = list_observations(limit=20) or []
    except Exception:
        return ""
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        if str(row.get("source", "")) != "screen":
            continue
        provenance = row.get("provenance", {}) or {}
        detail = ""
        if isinstance(provenance, dict):
            detail = str(provenance.get("window", "")
                         or provenance.get("monitor", "") or "")[:80]
        return ("Schermstatus (alleen lezen, nooit handelen): "
                f"node {row.get('node_id', '?')}, "
                f"screenshot {row.get('media_ref', '?') or 'geen'}, "
                f"{row.get('created_at', '?')}"
                + (f", {detail}" if detail else "") + ".")
    return ""


def _observations_sample() -> str:
    """Recent world observations (max 5) as READ context. Many
    rows may share one entity_ref — that is converging evidence,
    never ownership. Never raises."""
    try:
        from .world_observations import list_observations
        rows = list_observations(limit=5) or []
    except Exception:
        return ""
    if not rows:
        return ""
    parts = []
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        entity = str(row.get("entity_ref", "") or "onbekend")
        parts.append(
            f"{entity} via {row.get('node_id', '?')}/"
            f"{row.get('source', '?')} "
            f"(zekerheid {row.get('confidence', '?')})"
        )
    if not parts:
        return ""
    return ("Waarnemingen (alleen lezen, geen eigendom): "
            + "; ".join(parts) + ".")


def npc_chat(npc_id: str, message: str,
             play_session_id: str | None = None,
             max_tokens: int = 500,
             screen_summary: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """One chat turn with a Hermes NPC. Returns the bridge result
    plus ``npc_id``, ``npc_name`` and the durable ``conversation_id``.

    ``screen_summary`` is caller-provided VLM text (opt-in only);
    raw pixels never reach this function. The turn is stored in
    conversations/messages best-effort — storage failure never
    breaks the reply."""
    npc_key = str(npc_id or "").strip()
    if npc_key not in HERMES_NPCS:
        raise HermesRefusedError(f"Unknown Hermes NPC '{npc_key}'")
    text = str(message or "")
    if not text.strip():
        raise HermesRefusedError("Message must be non-empty text")
    if len(text) > 2000:
        raise HermesRefusedError("Message exceeds 2000 characters")
    npc = HERMES_NPCS[npc_key]
    session_key = npc_session_key(npc_key, play_session_id)
    context = build_npc_context(play_session_id)
    extra = str(screen_summary or "").strip()[:1000]
    if extra:
        context = (context + "\n" + extra) if context else extra
    prompt = (
        f"[Systeem: {npc['system']}]\n"
        f"[Wereldcontext, zojuist gelezen:\n{context}]\n"
        f"[Speler zegt:]\n{text.strip()}"
    )
    bridge = HermesBridge()
    try:
        count = max(1, min(int(max_tokens or 500), 2000))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HermesRefusedError("max_tokens must be an integer")
    try:
        out = bridge.send(session_key, prompt,
                          max_tokens=count)
    except HermesRefusedError:
        raise
    except HermesUnavailable:
        raise
    out["npc_id"] = npc_key
    out["npc_name"] = npc["name"]
    reply = str(out.get("text", "") or "")
    out["conversation_id"] = _persist_hermes_turn(
        session_key, npc_key, npc["name"], text.strip(), reply)
    return out
</file>
