<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/interface.py">
"""Human-interface foundation for Mycelium (BIG #9).

Separates the HUMAN INTERFACE from the BRAIN (coordinator) and
from NODE EXECUTION. The interface is never a second
coordinator: adapters produce/consume structured messages and
events, while all decisions (intent, proposals, approvals,
routing, execution, verification) stay in the existing
coordinator machinery.

Pieces (all fail-closed, all bounded):

- InterfaceAdapter: text in, text/voice/notification/status
  out. TextInterface is real (drives the chat flow);
  VoiceInterface is architecture (STT in, TTS out) without any
  microphone/speaker library coupling.
- InterfaceMessage: envelope around one conversation turn with
  interface/session/node identity, input/output types and
  provenance. Converges voice and text as early as possible:
  after STT, a voice turn IS a text turn plus provenance.
- InterfaceSession: active/idle/expired/revoked lifecycle for
  one interface endpoint. A session is not a credential and
  never doubles as node identity.

Rules (tested):

- input/output types are closed literals; content is capped;
  no executable content travels through messages.
- voice transcription is interpretation input, never FACT and
  never authorization (see voice.py for the approval rules).
- sessions expire (default 24h, hard cap 7d); revoked and
  expired sessions refuse; session ids never authenticate nodes.
"""

import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

InterfaceKind = Literal["text", "voice"]
VALID_INTERFACE_KINDS = frozenset({"text", "voice"})

InputType = Literal["text", "voice", "image", "camera", "event",
                    "system"]
VALID_INPUT_TYPES = frozenset({"text", "voice", "image", "camera",
                               "event", "system"})

OutputType = Literal["text", "voice", "notification", "event",
                     "status"]
VALID_OUTPUT_TYPES = frozenset({"text", "voice", "notification",
                                "event", "status"})

SessionStatus = Literal["active", "idle", "expired", "revoked"]
VALID_SESSION_STATUSES = frozenset({"active", "idle", "expired",
                                    "revoked"})

MAX_CONTENT_CHARS = 4000
MAX_METADATA_KEYS = 20

SESSION_TTL_SECONDS = 24 * 3600
SESSION_MAX_TTL_SECONDS = 7 * 24 * 3600


class InterfaceRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was stored or sent."""


class InterfaceMessage(BaseModel):
    """One interface turn envelope. Structured, bounded,
    attributable — never executable."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    message_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    conversation_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    session_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    interface_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    node_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    role: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    content: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_CONTENT_CHARS)
    input_type: str = Field(default="text", max_length=20)
    output_type: str = Field(default="text", max_length=20)
    created_at: str = ""
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class InterfaceSession(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    session_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    interface_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    node_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    conversation_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    status: str = Field(default="active", max_length=20)
    created_at: str = ""
    last_seen: str = ""
    expires_at: str = ""


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_session_id() -> str:
    return f"sess-{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def generate_interface_id(kind: str = "text") -> str:
    if kind not in VALID_INTERFACE_KINDS:
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            f"Unknown interface kind '{kind}'")
    return f"iface-{kind}-{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def _check_metadata(metadata) -> dict:
    if metadata is None:
        return {}
    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
        raise InterfaceRefusedError("metadata must be an object")
    if len(metadata) > MAX_METADATA_KEYS:
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            f"at most {MAX_METADATA_KEYS} metadata keys")
    for key, value in metadata.items():
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip() \
                or len(key) > 80:
            raise InterfaceRefusedError(
                "metadata keys must be short text")
        if isinstance(value, str) and len(value) > 1000:
            raise InterfaceRefusedError(
                "metadata values are capped at 1000 chars")
    return dict(metadata)


def new_interface_message(message_id: str, conversation_id: str,
                          role: str, content: str, *,
                          session_id: str = "",
                          interface_id: str = "",
                          node_id: str = "",
                          input_type: str = "text",
                          output_type: str = "text",
                          provenance: Provenance | None = None,
                          metadata: dict | None = None
                          ) -> InterfaceMessage:
    """Build one validated interface envelope. Fail-closed on
    role/content/types/provenance."""
    from .conversations import Message
    try:
        Message.check_role(role)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    if not isinstance(content, str) or not content.strip():
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            "Interface content must be non-empty text")
    if len(content) > MAX_CONTENT_CHARS:
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            f"Interface content exceeds {MAX_CONTENT_CHARS} chars")
    if input_type not in VALID_INPUT_TYPES:
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            f"Unknown input type '{input_type}'")
    if output_type not in VALID_OUTPUT_TYPES:
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            f"Unknown output type '{output_type}'")
    if role in ("assistant", "agent") and provenance is not None \
            and provenance.human_verified:
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            "Assistant/agent turns must not claim human "
            "verification")
    return InterfaceMessage(
        message_id=message_id, conversation_id=conversation_id,
        session_id=session_id[:80], interface_id=interface_id[:80],
        node_id=node_id[:80], role=role, content=content.strip(),
        input_type=input_type, output_type=output_type,
        created_at=now(),
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type=("user-created" if role == "user"
                         else "ai-generated"),
            creator_id=interface_id or "interface",
            human_verified=(role == "user")),
        metadata=_check_metadata(metadata))


def new_session(interface_id: str, *, node_id: str = "",
                conversation_id: str = "",
                ttl_seconds: int = SESSION_TTL_SECONDS
                ) -> InterfaceSession:
    """Open one interface session. A session tracks presence, not
    permission: it never authenticates a node and never carries
    credentials."""
    if not isinstance(interface_id, str) or not interface_id.strip():
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            "Session needs an interface_id")
    try:
        ttl = int(ttl_seconds)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise InterfaceRefusedError("ttl must be an integer")
    if ttl <= 0 or ttl > SESSION_MAX_TTL_SECONDS:
        raise InterfaceRefusedError(
            f"ttl must be 1..{SESSION_MAX_TTL_SECONDS}")
    created = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    return InterfaceSession(
        session_id=generate_session_id(),
        interface_id=interface_id.strip()[:80],
        node_id=node_id[:80], conversation_id=conversation_id[:80],
        status="active", created_at=created.isoformat(),
        last_seen=created.isoformat(),
        expires_at=(created + timedelta(seconds=ttl)).isoformat())


def touch_session(session: InterfaceSession,
                  now_str: str | None = None) -> InterfaceSession:
    """Refresh presence. Expired or revoked sessions stay that way;
    touching never revives them."""
    if session.status in ("expired", "revoked"):
        return session
    stamp = now_str or now()
    try:
        expired = datetime.fromisoformat(
            session.expires_at) <= datetime.fromisoformat(stamp)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        expired = True
    if expired:
        return session.model_copy(update={"status": "expired"})
    return session.model_copy(update={"last_seen": stamp,
                                      "status": "active"})


def revoke_session(session: InterfaceSession) -> InterfaceSession:
    return session.model_copy(update={"status": "revoked"})


def session_usable(session: InterfaceSession,
                   now_str: str | None = None) -> bool:
    """True only for a live, unexpired, unrevoked session."""
    if session.status in ("expired", "revoked"):
        return False
    stamp = now_str or now()
    try:
        if datetime.fromisoformat(session.expires_at) <= \
                datetime.fromisoformat(stamp):
            return False
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return False
    return session.status in ("active", "idle")

def save_session(session: InterfaceSession) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO interface_sessions
        (session_id, interface_id, node_id, conversation_id,
         status, created_at, last_seen, expires_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
        node_id=excluded.node_id,
        conversation_id=excluded.conversation_id,
        status=excluded.status, last_seen=excluded.last_seen,
        expires_at=excluded.expires_at""",
                    (session.session_id, session.interface_id,
                     session.node_id, session.conversation_id,
                     session.status, session.created_at,
                     session.last_seen, session.expires_at))


def load_session(session_id: str) -> InterfaceSession | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM interface_sessions "
                         "WHERE session_id=?",
                         (session_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return InterfaceSession(**{key: row[key] for key in (
        "session_id", "interface_id", "node_id",
        "conversation_id", "status", "created_at", "last_seen",
        "expires_at")})


def list_sessions(interface_id: str = "",
                  limit: int = 50) -> list[InterfaceSession]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        if interface_id:
            rows = db.execute(
                """SELECT * FROM interface_sessions
                WHERE interface_id=? ORDER BY last_seen DESC
                LIMIT ?""",
                (interface_id, max(1, min(limit, 100)))).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = db.execute(
                """SELECT * FROM interface_sessions ORDER BY
                last_seen DESC LIMIT ?""",
                (max(1, min(limit, 100)),)).fetchall()
    return [InterfaceSession(**{key: row[key] for key in (
        "session_id", "interface_id", "node_id",
        "conversation_id", "status", "created_at", "last_seen",
        "expires_at")}) for row in rows]


class InterfaceAdapter:
    """Interface contract. Core logic never touches hardware."""

    kind = "base"

    def receive_input(self, raw: dict) -> InterfaceMessage:
        raise NotImplementedError

    def send_response(self, message: InterfaceMessage) -> dict:
        raise NotImplementedError


class TextInterface(InterfaceAdapter):
    """Real text adapter: validates raw turns into envelopes and
    renders answers back to bounded text."""

    kind = "text"

    def __init__(self, interface_id: str = ""):
        self.interface_id = interface_id or generate_interface_id(
            "text")

    def receive_input(self, raw: dict) -> InterfaceMessage:
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise InterfaceRefusedError("Input must be an object")
        for key in ("message_id", "conversation_id", "content"):
            if not isinstance(raw.get(key), str) \
                    or not raw[key].strip():
                raise InterfaceRefusedError(
                    f"Input needs '{key}' as non-empty text")
        return new_interface_message(
            raw["message_id"].strip()[:80],
            raw["conversation_id"].strip()[:80],
            str(raw.get("role", "user")),
            raw["content"],
            session_id=str(raw.get("session_id", "")),
            interface_id=self.interface_id,
            node_id=str(raw.get("node_id", "")),
            input_type=str(raw.get("input_type", "text")),
            output_type=str(raw.get("output_type", "text")),
            metadata=raw.get("metadata"))

    def send_response(self, message: InterfaceMessage) -> dict:
        if not isinstance(message, InterfaceMessage):
            raise InterfaceRefusedError(
                "Response needs an InterfaceMessage")
        return {"interface_id": self.interface_id,
                "message_id": message.message_id,
                "output_type": message.output_type,
                "content": message.content}


class VoiceInterface(InterfaceAdapter):
    """Voice architecture adapter: STT text in, TTS text out. No
    microphone/speaker coupling — audio lives in voice.py media
    handling, this layer only carries the converged text plus
    voice provenance."""

    kind = "voice"

    def __init__(self, interface_id: str = ""):
        self.interface_id = interface_id or generate_interface_id(
            "voice")

    def receive_input(self, raw: dict) -> InterfaceMessage:
        """Accept transcribed text (never raw audio). Audio
        references travel separately through voice media checks."""
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise InterfaceRefusedError("Input must be an object")
        text = raw.get("transcript", raw.get("content", ""))
        if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
            raise InterfaceRefusedError(
                "Voice input needs transcript text")
        if len(text) > MAX_CONTENT_CHARS:
            raise InterfaceRefusedError("Transcript too long")
        return new_interface_message(
            str(raw.get("message_id", "") or
                f"msg-{int(time.time() * 1000):x}"
                f"{secrets.token_hex(4)}")[:80],
            str(raw.get("conversation_id", ""))[:80] or "conv-voice",
            "user", text,
            session_id=str(raw.get("session_id", "")),
            interface_id=self.interface_id,
            node_id=str(raw.get("node_id", "")),
            input_type="voice", output_type="voice",
            provenance=Provenance(
                source_type="user-created",
                creator_id=f"voice:{self.interface_id}",
                human_verified=True,
                notes="spoken turn, transcribed; interpretation "
                      "still pending"),
            metadata={"stt_model": str(raw.get("stt_model", ""))[
                :80]})

    def send_response(self, message: InterfaceMessage) -> dict:
        if not isinstance(message, InterfaceMessage):
            raise InterfaceRefusedError(
                "Response needs an InterfaceMessage")
        return {"interface_id": self.interface_id,
                "message_id": message.message_id,
                "output_type": "voice",
                "content": message.content}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/knowledge.py">
"""Knowledge lifecycle (BIG #32): observations mature visibly.

OBSERVATION -> CANDIDATE -> SUPPORTED -> PROMOTED MEMORY
(and REJECTED as an explicit terminal state).

Candidates are the bridge between raw intake (conversation
findings, research questions, camera observations) and long-term
memory. Rules (tested, fail-closed):

- Nothing silently becomes a fact. Promotion is explicit, human
  authority is required for consequential tiers, and AI content
  verifies only through verify_memory() with a human approver.
- Provenance, source references, entity links, contradictions and
  the originating conversation/research/project survive promotion
  (carried in the memory's data/derived_from/refs).
- Verified existing memories are never overwritten: a promotion
  that overlaps a user_fact/verified memory refuses with the
  conflict list.
- Idempotent: promoting an already-promoted candidate returns the
  existing memory; re-supporting by the same supporter is a no-op.
- Concurrency safe: revision-checked updates (expected_revision);
  stale writers reload and retry explicitly.
- No numeric confidence is invented: support is a count of
  distinct sources/supporters, shown as-is.

Health content never enters candidates: health-flagged findings
refuse at creation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re as _re
import secrets as _secrets
import time as _time

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

CANDIDATE_TYPES = (
    "idea",
    "observation",
    "claim",
    "question",
    "connection",
    "task",
    "note",
)

CANDIDATE_STATES = (
    "observation",
    "candidate",
    "supported",
    "promoted",
    "rejected",
)

ACTIVE_STATES = ("observation", "candidate", "supported")

DEFAULT_TRUTH = {
    "idea": "ai_suggestion",
    "observation": "observed",
    "claim": "ai_inference",
    "question": "ai_suggestion",
    "connection": "ai_inference",
    "task": "ai_suggestion",
    "note": "ai_suggestion",
}

MEMORY_TYPE_FOR = {
    "idea": "fact",
    "observation": "observation",
    "claim": "fact",
    "question": "fact",
    "connection": "relationship",
    "task": "fact",
    "note": "episodic",
}

NON_FACT_TRUTHS = ("ai_suggestion", "ai_inference", "observed",
                   "external_source")
FACT_TRUTHS = ("verified", "user_fact")

MAX_TITLE_CHARS = 200
MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS = 2000
MAX_EVIDENCE_ITEMS = 10
MAX_REF_ITEMS = 20


class CandidateRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Lifecycle refused; nothing was stored."""


class Candidate(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    candidate_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_TITLE_CHARS)
    summary: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS)
    candidate_type: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    state: str = Field(default="candidate", max_length=20)
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)
    source_refs: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                    max_length=MAX_REF_ITEMS)
    evidence: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                 max_length=MAX_EVIDENCE_ITEMS)
    counter_evidence: list[dict] = Field(
        default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_EVIDENCE_ITEMS)
    entity_refs: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                   max_length=MAX_REF_ITEMS)
    project_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=100)
    contradictions: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                       max_length=10)
    support: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                max_length=20)
    promoted_to: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    revision: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""


def generate_candidate_id() -> str:
    return f"cand_{int(_time.time() * 1000):x}{_secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def _now() -> str:
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _check_evidence(items: list | None, label: str) -> list[dict]:
    cleaned: list[dict] = []
    for item in (items or [])[:MAX_EVIDENCE_ITEMS]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise CandidateRefusedError(
                f"{label} entries must be objects")
        text = str(item.get("text", "")).strip()
        if not text:
            continue
        cleaned.append({
            "text": text[:500],
            "source": str(item.get("source", ""))[:120],
        })
    return cleaned


def _check_refs(values: list | None) -> list[str]:
    cleaned: list[str] = []
    for ref in (values or [])[:MAX_REF_ITEMS]:
        text = str(ref or "").strip()
        if not text or len(text) > 120:
            raise CandidateRefusedError(
                "entity refs must be short text")
        if text not in cleaned:
            cleaned.append(text)
    return cleaned


def _check_source_refs(items: list | None) -> list[dict]:
    cleaned: list[dict] = []
    for item in (items or [])[:MAX_REF_ITEMS]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise CandidateRefusedError(
                "source refs must be objects")
        kind = str(item.get("kind", "")).strip()[:20]
        ident = str(item.get("id", "")).strip()[:100]
        if not kind or not ident:
            raise CandidateRefusedError(
                "source refs need kind + id")
        cleaned.append({
            "kind": kind,
            "id": ident,
            "label": str(item.get("label", ""))[:160],
        })
    return cleaned


def new_candidate(title: str, candidate_type: str, *,
                  summary: str = "",
                  state: str = "candidate",
                  provenance: Provenance | None = None,
                  source_refs: list | None = None,
                  evidence: list | None = None,
                  counter_evidence: list | None = None,
                  entity_refs: list | None = None,
                  project_ref: str = "",
                  contradictions: list | None = None
                  ) -> Candidate:
    """Build one validated candidate. Health-flagged content is the
    caller's responsibility to refuse (see candidate_from_finding)."""
    cleaned_type = str(candidate_type or "").strip()
    if cleaned_type not in CANDIDATE_TYPES:
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            f"Unknown candidate type '{candidate_type}'; expected "
            f"one of {list(CANDIDATE_TYPES)}")
    cleaned_state = str(state or "candidate").strip()
    if cleaned_state not in CANDIDATE_STATES:
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            f"Unknown candidate state '{state}'")
    if not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip():
        raise CandidateRefusedError("candidate title must be text")
    if len(title.strip()) > MAX_TITLE_CHARS:
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            f"candidate title exceeds {MAX_TITLE_CHARS} characters")
    if not isinstance(summary, str):
        raise CandidateRefusedError("candidate summary must be text")
    if len(summary) > MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS:
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            f"candidate summary exceeds {MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS} "
            "characters")
    stamp = _now()
    return Candidate(
        candidate_id=generate_candidate_id(),
        title=title.strip()[:MAX_TITLE_CHARS],
        summary=str(summary or "")[:MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS],
        candidate_type=cleaned_type, state=cleaned_state,
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="ai-generated", creator_id="knowledge",
            human_verified=False),
        source_refs=_check_source_refs(source_refs),
        evidence=_check_evidence(evidence, "evidence"),
        counter_evidence=_check_evidence(
            counter_evidence, "counter_evidence"),
        entity_refs=_check_refs(entity_refs),
        project_ref=str(project_ref or "")[:100],
        contradictions=[dict(item) for item in
                        (contradictions or [])[:10]
                        if isinstance(item, dict)],
        support=[], promoted_to="", revision=1,
        created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp)


def init_knowledge_tables() -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS knowledge_candidates (
            candidate_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'candidate',
            candidate_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            project_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_candidates_state
            ON knowledge_candidates(state, updated_at);
        """)


def save_candidate(entry: Candidate,
                   expected_revision: int | None = None) -> None:
    """Persist with optimistic revision fencing."""
    from .database import chat_connection, dump
    init_knowledge_tables()
    if expected_revision is not None:
        with chat_connection() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT revision FROM knowledge_candidates WHERE "
                "candidate_id=?", (entry.candidate_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is None or int(row["revision"]) != int(
                    expected_revision):
                raise CandidateRefusedError(
                    "candidate revision moved; reload and retry "
                    "explicitly")
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO knowledge_candidates
        (candidate_id, record, state, candidate_type, project_ref,
         revision, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET record=excluded.record,
        state=excluded.state, candidate_type=excluded.candidate_type,
        project_ref=excluded.project_ref,
        revision=excluded.revision, updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
                   (entry.candidate_id,
                    dump(entry.model_dump(mode="json")), entry.state,
                    entry.candidate_type, entry.project_ref,
                    entry.revision, entry.created_at,
                    entry.updated_at))


def _row_to_candidate(row) -> Candidate:
    from .database import load
    return Candidate.model_validate(load(row["record"]))


def get_candidate(candidate_id: str) -> Candidate | None:
    from .database import chat_connection
    init_knowledge_tables()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT record FROM knowledge_candidates WHERE "
            "candidate_id=?", (candidate_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return _row_to_candidate(row)


def list_candidates(*, state: str = "", candidate_type: str = "",
                    project_ref: str = "", limit: int = 50) -> list:
    from .database import chat_connection
    init_knowledge_tables()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 50), 200))
    query = "SELECT record FROM knowledge_candidates"
    clauses: list[str] = []
    params: list = []
    if state:
        if state not in CANDIDATE_STATES:
            raise CandidateRefusedError(
                f"Unknown candidate state '{state}'")
        clauses.append("state=?")
        params.append(state)
    if candidate_type:
        if candidate_type not in CANDIDATE_TYPES:
            raise CandidateRefusedError(
                f"Unknown candidate type '{candidate_type}'")
        clauses.append("candidate_type=?")
        params.append(candidate_type)
    if project_ref:
        clauses.append("project_ref=?")
        params.append(str(project_ref)[:100])
    if clauses:
        query += " WHERE " + " AND ".join(clauses)
    query += " ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT ?"
    params.append(count)
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(query, params).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_candidate(row) for row in rows]


def support_count(entry: Candidate) -> int:
    return len({str(item.get("by", "")) for item in entry.support
                if str(item.get("by", "")).strip()})


def support_candidate(candidate_id: str, supporter: str, *,
                      rationale: str = "") -> Candidate:
    """One human (or named flow) backs a candidate. Two distinct
    supporters move it to supported. Same supporter twice is a
    no-op. Terminal states refuse."""
    name = str(supporter or "").strip()[:80]
    if not name:
        raise CandidateRefusedError("support needs a supporter name")
    entry = get_candidate(candidate_id)
    if entry is None:
        raise CandidateRefusedError("Unknown candidate")
    if entry.state in ("promoted", "rejected"):
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            f"Candidate is {entry.state}; terminal states refuse "
            "support")
    if any(str(item.get("by", "")) == name for item in entry.support):
        return entry
    updated = entry.model_copy(update={
        "support": [*entry.support, {
            "by": name, "rationale": str(rationale or "")[:300],
            "at": _now()}],
        "revision": entry.revision + 1, "updated_at": _now()})
    if support_count(updated) >= 2 and updated.state in (
            "observation", "candidate"):
        updated = updated.model_copy(update={"state": "supported"})
    save_candidate(updated, expected_revision=entry.revision)
    return updated


def reject_candidate(candidate_id: str, *, reason: str = "",
                     decided_by: str = "") -> Candidate:
    entry = get_candidate(candidate_id)
    if entry is None:
        raise CandidateRefusedError("Unknown candidate")
    if entry.state in ("promoted", "rejected"):
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            f"Candidate is already {entry.state}")
    updated = entry.model_copy(update={
        "state": "rejected",
        "support": [*entry.support, {
            "by": str(decided_by or "human")[:80],
            "rationale": f"rejected: {str(reason or '')[:300]}",
            "at": _now()}],
        "revision": entry.revision + 1, "updated_at": _now()})
    save_candidate(updated, expected_revision=entry.revision)
    return updated


def touch_candidate(candidate_id: str) -> Candidate:
    """Keep candidate: refresh without changing state."""
    entry = get_candidate(candidate_id)
    if entry is None:
        raise CandidateRefusedError("Unknown candidate")
    if entry.state in ("promoted", "rejected"):
        return entry
    updated = entry.model_copy(update={"updated_at": _now()})
    save_candidate(updated, expected_revision=entry.revision)
    return updated


_WORD_RE = _re.compile(r"[a-zA-Z0-9]{4,}")


def _keywords(text: str) -> set[str]:
    return {word.lower() for word in _WORD_RE.findall(text or "")}


def conflicting_memories(entry: Candidate, limit: int = 10) -> list:
    """Verified/user_fact memories overlapping this candidate.
    Promotion refuses while any exist — they are never silently
    overwritten."""
    from .memory import retrieve_memories
    query = f"{entry.title} {entry.summary}"[:300]
    try:
        found = retrieve_memories(query, limit=limit * 2)
    except Exception:
        return []
    wanted = _keywords(query)
    conflicts = []
    for memory in found:
        truth = memory.get("truth", "") if isinstance(
            memory, dict) else getattr(memory, "truth", "")
        if truth not in ("user_fact", "verified"):
            continue
        title = memory.get("title", "") if isinstance(
            memory, dict) else getattr(memory, "title", "")
        content = memory.get("content", "") if isinstance(
            memory, dict) else getattr(memory, "content", "")
        overlap = wanted & _keywords(f"{title} {content}")
        if overlap:
            conflicts.append(memory)
        if len(conflicts) >= max(1, limit):
            break
    return conflicts


def promote_candidate(candidate_id: str, *, truth: str = "",
                      verified_by: str = "",
                      importance: float = 0.6) -> dict:
    """Promote a candidate to memory. Explicit, idempotent,
    conflict-safe.

    - truth defaults per candidate type (ai tiers); fact tiers
      need verified_by (human) and verify_memory() semantics.
    - overlapping verified/user_fact memories refuse with the
      conflict list.
    - provenance, sources, evidence, contradictions and origin
      survive inside the memory (data.origin + derived_from).
    - emits nothing by itself; callers emit the audit event.
    """
    entry = get_candidate(candidate_id)
    if entry is None:
        raise CandidateRefusedError("Unknown candidate")
    if entry.state == "promoted" and entry.promoted_to:
        from .memory import get_memory
        existing = get_memory(entry.promoted_to)
        if existing is not None:
            return {"memory_id": existing.memory_id,
                    "truth": existing.truth, "deduped": True}
    if entry.state == "rejected":
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            "Rejected candidates never promote; create a new one")
    wanted_truth = str(truth or "").strip() or DEFAULT_TRUTH[
        entry.candidate_type]
    if wanted_truth not in NON_FACT_TRUTHS + FACT_TRUTHS:
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            f"Unknown truth tier '{truth}'")
    conflicts = conflicting_memories(entry)
    if conflicts:
        def _conflict_id(memory) -> str:
            if isinstance(memory, dict):
                return str(memory.get("memory_id", "?"))
            return str(getattr(memory, "memory_id", "?"))
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            "Promotion refused: overlaps verified memory "
            f"({', '.join(_conflict_id(memory) for memory in conflicts[:5])}); "
            "resolve the conflict explicitly instead")
    from .memory import (MemoryRefusedError, get_memory, new_memory,
                         save_memory, verify_memory)
    provenance = Provenance(
        source_type=str(entry.provenance.source_type or "ai-generated"),
        creator_id=str(entry.provenance.creator_id or
                       "knowledge-promotion")[:120],
        human_verified=False,
        notes=f"promoted from {entry.candidate_id}; "
              f"{support_count(entry)} supporter(s); "
              "verification is separate")
    data = {
        "origin": {"candidate_id": entry.candidate_id,
                   "candidate_type": entry.candidate_type,
                   "state_at_promotion": entry.state,
                   "support": entry.support[:10],
                   "source_refs": entry.source_refs[:10],
                   "evidence": entry.evidence[:10],
                   "counter_evidence": entry.counter_evidence[:10],
                   "contradictions": entry.contradictions[:10]},
    }
    try:
        memory = new_memory(
            MEMORY_TYPE_FOR[entry.candidate_type], entry.title,
            truth=wanted_truth if wanted_truth in NON_FACT_TRUTHS
            else "ai_suggestion",
            content=entry.summary or entry.title,
            data=data, source=f"candidate:{entry.candidate_id}",
            provenance=provenance,
            project_ref=entry.project_ref,
            entity_refs=list(entry.entity_refs),
            derived_from=[entry.candidate_id],
            importance=max(0.0, min(1.0, float(importance))))
    except MemoryRefusedError as error:
        raise CandidateRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    if wanted_truth in FACT_TRUTHS:
        if not str(verified_by or "").strip():
            raise CandidateRefusedError(
                "Fact-tier promotion needs verified_by (a human)")
        proven = provenance.model_copy(update={
            "human_verified": True,
            "notes": provenance.notes + " | human-verified at "
                     "promotion"})
        memory = memory.model_copy(update={"provenance": proven})
        try:
            memory = verify_memory(
                memory, str(verified_by).strip()[:80])
        except MemoryRefusedError as error:
            raise CandidateRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    else:
        from .memory import content_fingerprint
        fingerprint = content_fingerprint(
            memory.title + "\n" + memory.content, memory.memory_type)
        from .memory import list_memories
        for known in list_memories(limit=5000):
            if known.fingerprint == fingerprint and \
                    known.status == "active":
                updated = entry.model_copy(update={
                    "state": "promoted",
                    "promoted_to": known.memory_id,
                    "revision": entry.revision + 1,
                    "updated_at": _now()})
                save_candidate(updated,
                               expected_revision=entry.revision)
                return {"memory_id": known.memory_id,
                        "truth": known.truth, "deduped": True}
    try:
        save_memory(memory)
    except MemoryRefusedError as error:
        raise CandidateRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    updated = entry.model_copy(update={
        "state": "promoted", "promoted_to": memory.memory_id,
        "revision": entry.revision + 1, "updated_at": _now()})
    save_candidate(updated, expected_revision=entry.revision)
    return {"memory_id": memory.memory_id, "truth": memory.truth,
            "deduped": False}


# -- intake helpers ------------------------------------------------------------

def candidate_from_finding(conversation_id: str, finding: dict,
                           *, state: str = "candidate") -> Candidate:
    """One conversation finding becomes a candidate. Health-flagged
    text refuses (health isolation); secrets were already redacted
    at import."""
    from .conversation_bridge import _HEALTH_RE as HEALTH_RE
    text = str(finding.get("text", ""))
    evidence = str(finding.get("evidence", ""))
    if HEALTH_RE.search(text) or HEALTH_RE.search(evidence):
        raise CandidateRefusedError(
            "Health-related findings never become candidates here; "
            "health stays explicitly scoped")
    kind = str(finding.get("finding_kind",
                           finding.get("kind", "")))
    type_map = {"idea": "idea", "todo": "task",
                "open_question": "question",
                "technical_claim": "claim",
                "decision": "claim", "proposed_action": "task",
                "project_mention": "connection",
                "entity_mention": "connection"}
    candidate_type = type_map.get(kind, "note")
    message_index = finding.get("message_index")
    entry = new_candidate(
        f"{kind}: {text[:140]}".strip(),
        candidate_type, summary=text[:1500], state=state,
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="imported",
            creator_id="conversation-analysis",
            human_verified=False,
            notes=f"from {conversation_id}"
                  + (f" message {message_index}"
                     if message_index is not None else "")),
        source_refs=[{"kind": "conversation", "id": conversation_id,
                      "label": f"message {message_index}"}],
        evidence=[{"text": evidence[:500],
                   "source": conversation_id}],
        entity_refs=([str(finding.get("entity_candidate", ""))]
                     if finding.get("entity_candidate") else []))
    save_candidate(entry)
    return entry

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/library_sources.py">
"""External 3D model libraries: search, gated download, import.

One vertical slice on top of existing flows:

    library source -> metadata -> ModelLicense/provenance
    -> explicit download/import -> existing proposal/write flow
    -> INVENTory file_ + workshop mdl_

Rules (fail-closed, tested):

- No second database, no second file registry, no new
  approval flow: models land in the existing library folder,
  records in workshop_models, proposals via
  ``propose_inventory_write`` + the existing YES/write gate.
- Search and download only run on explicit operator action
  (POST routes); nothing polls, syncs or auto-imports.
- "open"/"free"/"open source" never implies sellable or
  remixable: vague names and license-less external origins are
  refused by ``clean_library_license``; unknown terms block
  import until a human reads the actual license.
- Network posture mirrors the research transport: fixed
  per-source host allowlists, timeout <= 5s, byte caps,
  3D content-types only, no credentials, no cookies.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

FETCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5.0
MAX_API_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024

COMMONS_API_HOST = frozenset({"commons.wikimedia.org"})
COMMONS_FILE_HOSTS = frozenset({"upload.wikimedia.org"})
NIH_FILE_HOSTS = frozenset({"3d.nih.gov"})
NASA_FILE_HOSTS = frozenset({"science.nasa.gov"})

#: Hosts a downloaded model file may come from, per source.
SOURCE_FILE_HOSTS: dict[str, frozenset] = {
    "wikimedia-commons": COMMONS_FILE_HOSTS,
    "nih-3d": NIH_FILE_HOSTS,
    "nasa-3d": NASA_FILE_HOSTS,
}

#: Content-types accepted for model downloads. Generic
#: octet-stream stays allowed (many hosts serve STL that way);
#: HTML/text/JSON are refused so an error page never becomes
#: a "model".
MODEL_CONTENT_TYPES = frozenset({
    "model/stl",
    "model/obj",
    "model/mesh",
    "application/octet-stream",
    "application/sla",
})

INTENDED_USES = ("private", "commercial", "remix")


class LibraryRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Library search/download/import refused; nothing stored."""


LIBRARY_SOURCES: dict[str, dict] = {
    "wikimedia-commons": {
        "source_library": "wikimedia-commons",
        "name": "Wikimedia Commons",
        "portal_url": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/",
        "search": "commons-api",
        "formats": [".stl", ".obj"],
        "license_policy": ("per bestand via API "
                           "(LicenseShortName/UsageTerms)"),
        "automation": "supported",
        "limitations": ("multi-licenties handmatig controleren; "
                        "Artist is HTML; 20 MB-bestandscap"),
    },
    "nih-3d": {
        "source_library": "nih-3d",
        "name": "NIH 3D",
        "portal_url": "https://3d.nih.gov/discover",
        "search": "manual",
        "formats": [".stl", ".glb", ".x3d", ".wrl"],
        "license_policy": ("per entry op de modelpagina lezen; "
                           "varieert van public domain tot "
                           "restrictief"),
        "automation": "manual-only",
        "limitations": ("geen stabiele publieke zoek-API; "
                        "operator neemt licentie over"),
    },
    "nasa-3d": {
        "source_library": "nasa-3d",
        "name": "NASA 3D Resources",
        "portal_url": "https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/",
        "search": "manual",
        "formats": [".stl", ".glb", ".usdz"],
        "license_policy": ("uniform: free and without copyright "
                           "(US-overheidswerk); guidelines lezen"),
        "automation": "partial",
        "limitations": ("geen API; GitHub-mirror alleen handmatig"),
    },
}


def library_catalog() -> list[dict]:
    """Registered library sources. Read-only."""
    return [dict({"source_library": key}, **info)
            for key, info in LIBRARY_SOURCES.items()]


def _http_get(url: str, *, max_bytes: int) -> tuple:
    """GET one validated URL. Returns (status, headers, body).
    Separated for tests (monkeypatch this, not httpx)."""
    import httpx
    from .research_transport import validate_url
    canonical = validate_url(url)
    try:
        with httpx.Client(
                timeout=FETCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                follow_redirects=False,
                headers={"User-Agent": "MyceliumLibrary/1.0 "
                                      "(local-first; contact: "
                                      "operator)"}) as client:
            response = client.get(canonical,
                                  timeout=FETCH_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
    except Exception as error:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"ophalen mislukt ({type(error).__name__}; "
            f"offline is eerlijk UNAVAILABLE)") from error
    if response.status_code in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            "redirects worden niet gevolgd bij bibliotheek-zoeken")
    if response.status_code != 200:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"HTTP {response.status_code} bij bibliotheek-aanvraag")
    body = response.content[:max_bytes + 1]
    if len(body) > max_bytes:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"antwoord groter dan {max_bytes} bytes; geweigerd")
    return (response.status_code, dict(response.headers), body)


def _strip_html(text: str) -> str:
    import re as _re
    return _re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", "", str(text or "")).strip()[:200]


def parse_commons_hits(payload: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Parse Commons search JSON into candidate pointers. Pure."""
    items = ((payload.get("query", {}) or {}).get("search", [])
             or [])
    out: list[dict] = []
    for item in items:
        title = str(item.get("title", "") or "")
        if not title.startswith("File:"):
            continue
        out.append({
            "title": title,
            "page_url": ("https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/"
                         + title.replace(" ", "_")),
        })
    return out[:25]


def parse_commons_detail(title: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
    """Parse imageinfo+extmetadata into a license candidate. Pure.

    Raises LibraryRefusedError when the file has no usable
    license statement (never default to permissive).
    """
    from .workshop3d import clean_library_license, license_terms
    pages = (payload.get("query", {}) or {}).get("pages", {}) or {}
    info: dict = {}
    for page in pages.values():
        entries = page.get("imageinfo", []) or []
        if entries:
            info = entries[0]
            break
    if not info:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"geen bestandsinfo voor '{title[:80]}'")
    meta = info.get("extmetadata", {}) or {}

    def _field(name: str) -> str:
        return str((meta.get(name, {}) or {}).get("value", "")
                   or "").strip()

    license_name = _field("LicenseShortName") or _field("UsageTerms")
    if not license_name:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"'{title[:80]}' heeft geen machineleesbare licentie; "
            f"lees de bestandspagina en neem de voorwaarden over")
    author = _strip_html(_field("Artist"))
    candidate = {
        "source_library": "wikimedia-commons",
        "source_url": "https://commons.wikimedia.org/",
        "author": author,
        "license": license_name,
        "original_model_url": str(info.get("descriptionurl", "")
                                  or "")[:500],
        "commercial_use": None,
        "remix_allowed": None,
        "attribution_required": None,
    }
    required = str(_field("AttributionRequired")).lower()
    if required == "true":
        candidate["attribution_required"] = True
    cleaned = clean_library_license(candidate)
    terms = license_terms(cleaned.license)
    return {
        "title": title,
        "file_url": str(info.get("url", "") or "")[:500],
        "size_bytes": int(info.get("size", 0) or 0),
        "page_url": str(info.get("descriptionurl", "") or "")[:500],
        "preview_url": str(info.get("thumburl", "") or "")[:500],
        "author": cleaned.author,
        "license": cleaned.license,
        "license_url": _field("LicenseUrl")[:500],
        "commercial_use": cleaned.commercial_use,
        "remix_allowed": cleaned.remix_allowed,
        "attribution_required": cleaned.attribution_required,
        "terms_note": terms.get("note", ""),
        "original_model_url": cleaned.original_model_url,
    }


def search_commons(query: str, *, limit: int = 10) -> dict:
    """Search Wikimedia Commons for 3D files. Read-only metadata.

    Runs only on explicit operator action (POST route). Offline
    or API change -> honest refusal, never invented results.
    """
    import json as _json
    import urllib.parse as _urlparse
    from .research_transport import validate_url
    text = str(query or "").strip()
    if not text:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            "zoekopdracht is leeg; geweigerd")
    if len(text) > 120:
        raise LibraryRefusedError("zoekopdracht te lang")
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 10), 25))
    params = _urlparse.urlencode({
        "action": "query", "format": "json", "list": "search",
        "srsearch": text, "srnamespace": 6, "srlimit": count,
    })
    api_url = ("https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?"
               + params)
    validate_url(api_url, allow_hosts=COMMONS_API_HOST)
    _, _, body = _http_get(api_url, max_bytes=MAX_API_BYTES)
    try:
        payload = _json.loads(body.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
    except ValueError as error:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"Commons-antwoord onleesbaar ({error})") from error
    hits = parse_commons_hits(payload)
    results: list[dict] = []
    for hit in hits:
        detail_params = _urlparse.urlencode({
            "action": "query", "format": "json",
            "titles": hit["title"], "prop": "imageinfo",
            "iiprop": "url|size|extmetadata",
            "iiextmetadatafilter": ("Artist|LicenseShortName|"
                                    "LicenseUrl|UsageTerms|"
                                    "AttributionRequired"),
        })
        detail_url = ("https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?"
                      + detail_params)
        validate_url(detail_url, allow_hosts=COMMONS_API_HOST)
        try:
            _, _, detail_body = _http_get(
                detail_url, max_bytes=MAX_API_BYTES)
            detail = _json.loads(
                detail_body.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
            results.append(parse_commons_detail(
                hit["title"], detail))
        except (LibraryRefusedError, ValueError):
            continue
    return {"source": "wikimedia-commons", "query": text,
            "results": results}


def gate_import(license_value, *, intended_use: str) -> dict:
    """Decide whether an import proposal may be built.

    ``intended_use`` is private (print for self), commercial
    (sell) or remix (derive/share). Unknown terms block every
    use; NC blocks commercial; ND blocks remix. Vague or
    missing licenses never reach a proposal.
    """
    from .workshop3d import clean_library_license
    use = str(intended_use or "").strip().lower()
    if use not in INTENDED_USES:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"intended_use '{use}' onbekend; kies uit "
            f"{list(INTENDED_USES)}")
    cleaned = clean_library_license(license_value)
    if cleaned is None:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            "import zonder licentiegegevens is geweigerd")
    terms = {"commercial_use": cleaned.commercial_use,
             "remix_allowed": cleaned.remix_allowed,
             "attribution_required": cleaned.attribution_required}
    if any(value is None for value in terms.values()):
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"licentie '{cleaned.license}' is onbekend voor de "
            f"importketen: lees de voorwaarden en leg commercial_"
            f"use/remix/attributie expliciet vast")
    if use == "commercial" and cleaned.commercial_use is not True:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"commercieel gebruik geblokkeerd: licentie "
            f"'{cleaned.license}' staat verkoop niet toe")
    if use == "remix" and cleaned.remix_allowed is not True:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"remix geblokkeerd: licentie '{cleaned.license}' "
            f"staat afgeleiden niet toe")
    note = ""
    if cleaned.attribution_required:
        maker = cleaned.author or cleaned.source_library
        note = f"naamsvermelding verplicht ({maker})"
    return {"allowed": True, "intended_use": use,
            "license": cleaned.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "note": note}


def fetch_model_bytes(file_url: str, *, source: str) -> bytes:
    """Download one model file from its source host. Bounded."""
    from .research_transport import validate_url
    from .workshop3d import MODEL_SUFFIXES
    from .mesh3d import MAX_MESH_BYTES
    hosts = SOURCE_FILE_HOSTS.get(str(source or ""))
    if hosts is None:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"bron '{source}' onbekend; kies een geregistreerde "
            f"bibliotheek")
    canonical = validate_url(file_url, allow_hosts=hosts)
    lowered = canonical.lower()
    if not lowered.endswith(MODEL_SUFFIXES):
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            "alleen 3D-modelformaten (.stl/.obj/.3mf/.glb/.gltf); "
            "geen uitvoerbare of andere bestanden")
    _, headers, body = _http_get(canonical,
                                 max_bytes=MAX_MESH_BYTES + 1)
    if len(body) > MAX_MESH_BYTES:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"model is {len(body)} bytes (max {MAX_MESH_BYTES}); "
            f"geweigerd")
    content_type = str(headers.get("content-type", "")
                       or "").split(";")[0].strip().lower()
    if content_type and content_type not in MODEL_CONTENT_TYPES:
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"content-type '{content_type[:80]}' geweigerd; geen "
            f"modelbytes ontvangen")
    if not body:
        raise LibraryRefusedError("leeg bestand; geweigerd")
    return body


def import_downloaded(*, source: str, file_url: str,
                      filename: str = "",
                      license: dict | None = None,
                      intended_use: str = "private",
                      actor: str = "operator") -> dict:
    """Gated import: license gate -> download -> dedupe ->
    library folder -> mdl_ record -> file_ proposal fields.

    Creates the workshop record but no proposal and no
    INVENTory write: the route builds the proposal through the
    existing write flow (YES-gate untouched).
    """
    import os as _os
    from .workshop3d import (
        _check_library_relname,
        clean_library_license,
        known_model_shas,
        library_file_fields,
        library_scan_dir,
        register_library_model,
    )
    from .mesh3d import MAX_MESH_BYTES
    gated = gate_import(license, intended_use=intended_use)
    data = fetch_model_bytes(file_url, source=source)
    import hashlib as _hashlib
    digest = _hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if digest in known_model_shas():
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            "deze modelbytes zijn al geregistreerd; dubbele "
            "file wordt geweigerd")
    if filename:
        relname = _check_library_relname(filename)
    else:
        tail = file_url.split("?", 1)[0].rstrip("/").rsplit(
            "/", 1)[-1][:200]
        relname = _check_library_relname(tail)
    root = _os.path.abspath(library_scan_dir())
    if not _os.path.isdir(root):
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            "bibliotheekmap ontbreekt; richt eerst in via setup")
    target = _os.path.abspath(_os.path.join(root, relname))
    if target != root and not target.startswith(root + _os.sep):
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            "bestandsnaam ontsnapt aan de bibliotheekmap")
    if _os.path.exists(target):
        raise LibraryRefusedError(
            f"'{relname}' bestaat al in de bibliotheekmap; "
            f"hernoem of gebruik het bestaande model")
    if len(data) > MAX_MESH_BYTES:  # pragma: no cover - guarded
        raise LibraryRefusedError("model te groot; geweigerd")
    with open(target, "wb") as handle:
        handle.write(data)
    try:
        record = register_library_model(
            relname, actor=str(actor or "operator")[:40],
            license=gated["license"])
    except Exception:
        try:
            _os.remove(target)
        except OSError:
            pass
        raise
    return {"model": record,
            "fields": library_file_fields(record),
            "gate_note": gated.get("note", "")}
