<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/linux_node.py">
"""Linux node contract (BIG #30): old laptop -> Mycelium node.

Pull-only, no inbound ports, no remote shell. The coordinator never
sends commands; the node polls, claims a matching task, executes
within its advertised capabilities, and reports back.

Honest capability starter set (only what is really implemented):
  node.status, research.search, research.fetch, analysis.ollama,
  inventory.read, file.inspect

No wildcard, no shell capability, no arbitrary-command capability.
See docs/linux-node-setup.md for the 10-step runbook.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import platform as _platform
import sys as _sys

LINUX_CAPABILITIES = (
    "node.status",
    "research.search",
    "research.fetch",
    "analysis.ollama",
    "inventory.read",
    "file.inspect",
)

NODE_SETUP_STEPS = (
    "Check Python (>= 3.11)",
    "Install the node client (pip install -e .)",
    "Generate a node id (e.g. linux-laptop-1)",
    "Write the capability config (starter set only)",
    "Set the node token (MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN, never in git)",
    "Point at the coordinator URL (http://127.0.0.1:8000)",
    "Check the heartbeat (register + poll)",
    "Start the node (pull-only loop)",
    "Run the safe-task test (claim + complete)",
    "Troubleshoot (logs, staleness 60s, lease 300s x3)",
)


class LinuxNodeRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Bootstrap check refused."""


def check_capabilities(caps: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Fail-closed: only the starter set, no wildcards, no shell."""
    if not isinstance(caps, list) or not caps:
        raise LinuxNodeRefusedError("capabilities must be a non-empty list")
    cleaned: list[str] = []
    for cap in caps:
        text = str(cap or "").strip()[:80]
        if not text:
            raise LinuxNodeRefusedError("empty capability")
        if text in ("*", "all", "shell", "shell.exec", "exec",
                    "command.run", "remote.shell"):
            raise LinuxNodeRefusedError(
                f"capability '{text}' is never granted")
        if "*" in text:
            raise LinuxNodeRefusedError(
                f"wildcard capability '{text}' is refused")
        if text not in LINUX_CAPABILITIES:
            raise LinuxNodeRefusedError(
                f"capability '{text}' is not in the Linux starter set; "
                f"expected one of {list(LINUX_CAPABILITIES)}")
        if text not in cleaned:
            cleaned.append(text)
    if len(cleaned) > len(LINUX_CAPABILITIES):
        raise LinuxNodeRefusedError("too many capabilities")
    return cleaned


def bootstrap_check(*, python_version: str = "",
                    coordinator_url: str = "",
                    node_id: str = "",
                    capabilities: list[str] | None = None) -> dict:
    """Local pre-flight checks. Never installs or connects anything."""
    checks: dict[str, dict] = {}
    wanted = tuple(int(part) for part in
                   str(python_version or ".".join(
                       str(part) for part in _sys.version_info[:3])
                       ).split(".")[:3] if part.isdigit())
    current = (_sys.version_info.major, _sys.version_info.minor,
               _sys.version_info.micro)
    checks["python"] = {
        "ok": wanted >= (3, 11) if len(wanted) >= 2 else
        current >= (3, 11),
        "current": ".".join(str(part) for part in current),
        "detail": "Python >= 3.11 required",
    }
    url = str(coordinator_url or "").strip()
    checks["coordinator_url"] = {
        "ok": url.startswith(("http://127.0.0.1", "http://localhost",
                              "http://[::1]")),
        "value": url[:120],
        "detail": "loopback coordinator URL expected "
                  "(no remote control plane here)",
    }
    ident = str(node_id or "").strip()
    checks["node_id"] = {
        "ok": bool(ident) and len(ident) <= 80 and " " not in ident,
        "value": ident[:80],
        "detail": "fresh --node-id per machine; re-registration upserts",
    }
    try:
        caps = check_capabilities(list(capabilities or []))
        checks["capabilities"] = {"ok": True, "value": caps,
                                  "detail": "starter set only"}
    except LinuxNodeRefusedError as exc:
        checks["capabilities"] = {"ok": False, "value": [],
                                  "detail": str(exc)}
    checks["platform"] = {
        "ok": True,
        "value": f"{_platform.system()} {_platform.release()} "
                 f"{_platform.machine()}",
        "detail": "informational; any pull-only host works",
    }
    overall = all(check.get("ok") for check in checks.values())
    return {"ok": overall, "checks": checks,
            "steps": list(NODE_SETUP_STEPS)}
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/local_slicer.py">
"""Local subprocess slicer (M2/BIG57): real G-code, no mocks.

Runs a pinned local slicer binary headlessly (fixed argv
allow-list, shell=False, timeout, output caps, no network) and
returns the real bytes + sha256. Bambu Studio CLI is supported in
design but UNPROVEN on this build (all headless slice attempts
fail); prusa-slicer-console is the proven default.

NOTE on test_fab_security.py: the no-shell tripwire scans
mesh3d/slicer3d/printer3d/fab_flow only. Subprocess use lives
solely here (reviewed local runtime, exactly what
SlicerProvider.requirements() demands); the fab core stays
shell-free. This module never prints, never uploads, never
auto-executes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib as _hashlib
import os as _os
import shutil as _shutil
import subprocess as _subprocess

BAMBU_BIN_ENV_VAR = "BAMBU_STUDIO_BIN"
DEFAULT_BAMBU_BIN = (
    "C:/Program Files/Bambu Studio/bambu-studio.exe")
PRUSA_CONSOLE_ENV_VAR = "PRUSASLICER_CONSOLE_BIN"
DEFAULT_PRUSA_CONSOLE_BIN = (
    "E:/Mycelium/tools/prusa/PrusaSlicer-2.9.6/"
    "prusa-slicer-console.exe")

SLICE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 600.0
SMOKE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 20.0
MAX_STDOUT_BYTES = 1 << 20

#: Closed override allow-list for prusa-console (CLI keys only).
PRUSA_OVERRIDE_KEYS = frozenset({
    "layer-height", "fill-density", "support-material",
    "support-material-threshold", "temperature",
    "first-layer-temperature", "bed-temperature",
    "first-layer-bed-temperature", "nozzle-diameter",
    "filament-diameter", "perimeters", "top-layers",
    "bottom-layers", "brim", "bed-shape",
})

ENGINES = ("prusa", "bambu")


class LocalSlicerError(ValueError):
    """Local slicing refused or failed; nothing was produced."""


class LocalSlicerUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    """No working local slicer runtime."""


def resolve_console_binary(engine: str) -> str:
    """Pinned binary path for one engine. No PATH guessing beyond
    an explicit env override or the reviewed default."""
    cleaned = str(engine or "").strip().lower()
    if cleaned == "prusa":
        override = str(_os.environ.get(
            PRUSA_CONSOLE_ENV_VAR, "") or "").strip()
        binary = override or DEFAULT_PRUSA_CONSOLE_BIN
    elif cleaned == "bambu":
        override = str(_os.environ.get(
            BAMBU_BIN_ENV_VAR, "") or "").strip()
        binary = override or DEFAULT_BAMBU_BIN
    else:
        raise LocalSlicerError(
            f"unknown slicer engine '{engine}'; "
            f"expected one of {list(ENGINES)}")
    if not binary or not _os.path.isfile(binary):
        raise LocalSlicerUnavailable(
            f"{cleaned} binary not found at {binary[:120]}; "
            f"set the matching env var or install the slicer")
    return binary


def _check_overrides(overrides: dict) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(overrides, dict):
        raise LocalSlicerError("overrides must be an object")
    cleaned: dict[str, str] = {}
    for key, value in overrides.items():
        name = str(key or "").strip()
        if name not in PRUSA_OVERRIDE_KEYS:
            raise LocalSlicerError(
                f"override '{name[:40]}' not in the allow-list; "
                f"expected one of {sorted(PRUSA_OVERRIDE_KEYS)}")
        text = str(value if value is not None else "").strip()
        if not text or len(text) > 40:
            raise LocalSlicerError(
                f"override '{name}' must be 1..40 characters")
        if any(char in text for char in ";|&$`()<>\\\"'"):
            raise LocalSlicerError(
                f"override '{name}' carries shell characters; "
                f"refusing")
        cleaned[name] = text
    if len(cleaned) > 12:
        raise LocalSlicerError("at most 12 overrides")
    return cleaned


def _check_output_path(path: str, out_dir: str) -> str:
    name = str(path or "").strip().replace("\\", "/").split("/")[-1]
    if not name.lower().endswith(".gcode") or len(name) > 120:
        raise LocalSlicerError(
            "output must be a .gcode filename (<=120 chars)")
    if not name or name.startswith("."):
        raise LocalSlicerError("output filename invalid")
    root = _os.path.abspath(out_dir)
    full = _os.path.abspath(_os.path.join(root, name))
    if full != root and not full.startswith(root + _os.sep):
        raise LocalSlicerError("output escapes the output dir")
    return full


def slice_with_prusa(*, stl_path: str, output_path: str,
                     profile: dict, overrides: dict | None = None,
                     timeout: float = SLICE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                     extra_printer_keys: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Slice one STL with prusa-slicer-console. Real bytes out.

    ``profile`` is the coordinator profile dict (material, temps,
    layer, infill + M2 supports/speed keys); unknown keys are
    ignored, never passed. Returns paths + sha + argv for the
    record. Raises LocalSlicerError/Unavailable; writes nothing
    on failure except the (possibly partial) output file, which
    the caller owns.
    """
    from .slicer3d import MAX_GCODE_BYTES
    binary = resolve_console_binary("prusa")
    if not _os.path.isfile(stl_path):
        raise LocalSlicerError("model file not found; refusing")
    out_dir = _os.path.dirname(
        _os.path.abspath(output_path)) or _os.getcwd()
    _os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    out_file = _check_output_path(output_path, out_dir)
    clean_over = _check_overrides(overrides or {})
    settings = dict(profile or {})
    argv = [binary, "--export-gcode", "--output", out_file]
    material = str(settings.get("material", "") or "").strip()
    layer = str(settings.get("layer_mm", "") or "").strip()
    infill = str(settings.get("infill", "") or "").strip()
    nozzle_c = str(settings.get("nozzle_c", "") or "").strip()
    bed_c = str(settings.get("bed_c", "") or "").strip()
    if layer:
        argv += ["--layer-height", layer]
    if infill:
        dense = str(infill).strip()
        if not dense.endswith("%"):
            dense += "%"
        argv += ["--fill-density", dense]
    if nozzle_c:
        argv += ["--temperature", nozzle_c,
                 "--first-layer-temperature", nozzle_c]
    if bed_c:
        argv += ["--bed-temperature", bed_c,
                 "--first-layer-bed-temperature", bed_c]
    supports = settings.get("supports", False)
    if supports in (True, "true", "1", 1):
        argv += ["--support-material"]
        threshold = str(settings.get(
            "support_threshold_deg", "") or "").strip()
        if threshold:
            argv += ["--support-material-threshold", threshold]
    for key in sorted(clean_over):
        argv += [f"--{key}", clean_over[key]]
    for key, value in dict(extra_printer_keys or {}).items():
        name = str(key or "").strip()
        if name not in PRUSA_OVERRIDE_KEYS:
            raise LocalSlicerError(
                f"printer key '{name[:40]}' not in the allow-list")
        argv += [f"--{name}", str(value)[:40]]
    argv.append(stl_path)
    try:
        budget = min(float(timeout or SLICE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS),
                     SLICE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        budget = SLICE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    if budget <= 0:
        budget = SLICE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    try:
        proc = _subprocess.run(
            argv, shell=False, capture_output=True, timeout=budget,
            cwd=out_dir)
    except _subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
        raise LocalSlicerError(
            f"slicer timed out after {budget:g}s; killed") from error
    except OSError as error:
        raise LocalSlicerUnavailable(
            f"slicer could not start ({error})") from error
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        tail = ((proc.stderr or b"")[-500:] +
                (proc.stdout or b"")[-500:]).decode(
                    "utf-8", "replace")
        raise LocalSlicerError(
            f"slicer refused (exit {proc.returncode}): "
            f"{tail[:300]}")
    if not _os.path.isfile(out_file):
        raise LocalSlicerError(
            "slicer exited 0 but wrote no G-code; refusing")
    size = _os.path.getsize(out_file)
    if size <= 0 or size > MAX_GCODE_BYTES:
        raise LocalSlicerError(
            f"G-code size {size} out of bounds; refusing")
    digest = _hashlib.sha256()
    lines = 0
    with open(out_file, "rb") as handle:
        while True:
            chunk = handle.read(1 << 20)
            if not chunk:
                break
            digest.update(chunk)
            lines += chunk.count(b"\n")
    return {"gcode_path": out_file, "sha256": digest.hexdigest(),
            "size_bytes": size, "line_count": lines,
            "engine": "prusa",
            "argv": [argv[0]] + argv[1:-1] + ["<model>"]}


def canonical_gcode_name(mesh_filename: str, profile: str,
                         sha8: str) -> str:
    """Deterministic canonical G-code filename. Single source of
    truth used by both the slicer and the job record."""
    stem = "".join(
        char if char.isalnum() or char in ("-", "_") else "_"
        for char in str(mesh_filename or "").rsplit(".", 1)[0]
    )[:60] or "model"
    clean_profile = "".join(
        char if char.isalnum() or char in ("-", "_") else "_"
        for char in str(profile or ""))[:40] or "profile"
    clean_sha = "".join(
        char for char in str(sha8 or "").lower()
        if char in "0123456789abcdef")[:8] or "00000000"
    return f"{stem}-{clean_profile}-{clean_sha}.gcode"


def canonical_gcode_dir() -> str:
    """E:\\Mycelium\\gcode (created on use, never on probe)."""
    from .forge import library_root
    path = _os.path.join(library_root(), "gcode")
    _os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    return path


def run_help_smoke(binary: str, timeout: float = 20.0,
                  ) -> tuple[int | None, str]:
    """Run `<binary> --help` with a timeout; return (code, output).

    shell=False, fixed argv, capped output. None code means the
    process never answered (timeout/spawn failure). Shared by the
    forge readiness probes so console handling lives in exactly
    one reviewed place.
    """
    try:
        proc = _subprocess.run(
            [binary, "--help"], shell=False, capture_output=True,
            timeout=timeout)
    except Exception:
        return None, ""
    try:
        text = (proc.stdout or b"").decode("utf-8", "replace")
        text += (proc.stderr or b"").decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except Exception:
        text = ""
    return proc.returncode, text[:2000]


def canonical_gcode_dir() -> str:
    """E:\\Mycelium\\gcode (created on use, never on probe)."""
    from .forge import library_root
    path = _os.path.join(library_root(), "gcode")
    _os.makedirs(path, exist_ok=True)
    return path


#: 1x1 transparent PNG placeholder (68 bytes). Headless slicing
#: renders no thumbnails; references are required, pixels are not.
PLACEHOLDER_PNG = bytes.fromhex(
    "89504e470d0a1a0a0000000d49484452000000010000000108060000"
    "001f15c4890000000d49444154789c626001000000ffff030000060005"
    "1b5f090000000049454e44ae426082")

#: A1 mini model code (Bambu machine profiles). Never hard-fail on
#: unknown codes elsewhere; here it labels OUR printer honestly.
A1MINI_MODEL_ID = "N1"
A1MINI_NOZZLE_MM = "0.4"


def _slot_count_for(trays: int) -> int:
    try:
        count = max(1, min(int(trays or 0), 8))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        count = 1
    return count + 1 if count < 8 else count


def _pad_slots(values: list, count: int, fallback: str = "1") -> list:
    items = [str(value) for value in (values or [])]
    while len(items) < count:
        items.append(items[-1] if items else fallback)
    return items[:count]


def build_plate_3mf(gcode: bytes, *, profile_name: str,
                    material: str, color_hex: str = "#FFFFFF",
                    weight_g: float = 0.0, prediction_s: int = 0,
                    support_used: bool = False,
                    filament_type: str = "",
                    nozzle_diameter: str = A1MINI_NOZZLE_MM,
                    printer_model_id: str = A1MINI_MODEL_ID,
                    bed_type: str = "textured_plate",
                    plate_index: int = 1,
                    slot_count: int = 5,
                    base_settings: dict | None = None,
                    ) -> bytes:
    """Build a plate-sliced .gcode.3mf from real G-code (M4.2).

    Pure function: no I/O, no network. Layout follows the
    hardware-validated plate-sliced contract (empty 3dmodel,
    Metadata/plate_N.gcode + uppercase .md5, ordered
    model_settings/slice_info XML, full project_settings JSON).
    Values come from the caller (slicer footer + profile + spool);
    unknown filament preset degrades to generic honestly.
    Raises LocalSlicerError on empty G-code.
    """
    import hashlib as _hashlib
    import io as _io
    import json as _json
    import zipfile as _zip
    if not gcode:
        raise LocalSlicerError("no G-code bytes; refusing")
    slots = _slot_count_for(slot_count)
    gcode_name = f"Metadata/plate_{plate_index}.gcode"
    digest = _hashlib.md5(gcode).hexdigest().upper()
    filament_label = str(filament_type or material or "PLA")[:40]
    try:
        weight = round(float(weight_g or 0.0), 2)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        weight = 0.0
    try:
        prediction = max(0, int(prediction_s or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        prediction = 0
    maps = " ".join(["1"] * slots)
    zeros = " ".join(["0"] * slots)
    model_settings = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<config>\n'
        '  <plate>\n'
        '    <metadata key="plater_id" value="1"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="plater_name" value=""/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="locked" value="false"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="filament_map_mode" value="Auto For Flush"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="filament_maps" value="{maps}"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="filament_volume_maps" value="{zeros}"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="gcode_file" value="{gcode_name}"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="thumbnail_file" '
        'value="Metadata/plate_1.png"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="thumbnail_no_light_file" '
        'value="Metadata/plate_no_light_1.png"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="top_file" value="Metadata/top_1.png"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="pick_file" value="Metadata/pick_1.png"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="pattern_bbox_file" '
        'value="Metadata/plate_1.json"/>\n'
        '  </plate>\n</config>\n')
    color = str(color_hex or "#FFFFFF")[:7]
    if not color.startswith("#"):
        color = "#FFFFFF"
    slice_info = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n<config>\n'
        '  <header>\n'
        '    <header_item key="X-BBL-Client-Type" value="slicer"/>\n'
        '    <header_item key="X-BBL-Client-Version" '
        'value="02.05.00.66"/>\n'
        '  </header>\n'
        '  <plate>\n'
        '    <metadata key="index" value="1"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="extruder_type" value="0"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="nozzle_volume_type" value="0"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="printer_model_id" '
        f'value="{printer_model_id}"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="nozzle_diameters" value="{nozzle_diameter}"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="timelapse_type" value="0"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="prediction" value="{prediction}"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="weight" value="{weight}"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="outside" value="false"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="support_used" '
        f'value="{str(bool(support_used)).lower()}"/>\n'
        '    <metadata key="label_object_enabled" value="true"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="filament_maps" value="{maps}"/>\n'
        f'    <metadata key="limit_filament_maps" value="{zeros}"/>\n'
        f'    <filament id="1" tray_info_idx="GFL99" '
        f'type="{filament_label}" color="{color}" '
        f'used_m="0" used_g="{weight}" used_for_object="true" '
        f'used_for_support="false" group_id="0" '
        f'nozzle_diameter="{nozzle_diameter}" volume_type="Standard"/>\n'
        '  </plate>\n</config>\n')
    project_settings = dict(base_settings or {})
    project_settings.setdefault("printer_model_id",
                                printer_model_id)
    project_settings.setdefault("nozzle_diameter", nozzle_diameter)
    project_settings.setdefault("bed_type", bed_type)
    project_settings.setdefault(
        "slicer", "mycelium-prusa-console-plate")
    project_settings.setdefault("profile", profile_name)
    project_settings.setdefault("material", material)
    plate_json = _json.dumps({"bed_type": bed_type},
                             separators=(",", ":"))
    model_3d = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
        '<model unit="millimeter" xml:lang="en-US" '
        'xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/3dmanufacturing/core/'
        '2015/02"><resources/><build/></model>')
    content_types = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
        '<Types xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/'
        '2006/content-types">'
        '<Default Extension="rels" ContentType="application/vnd.'
        'openxmlformats-package.relationships+xml"/>'
        '<Default Extension="model" ContentType="application/vnd.'
        'ms-package.3dmanufacturing-3dmodel+xml"/>'
        '<Default Extension="config" ContentType="text/xml"/>'
        '<Default Extension="gcode" ContentType="text/plain"/>'
        '<Default Extension="md5" ContentType="text/plain"/>'
        '<Default Extension="json" ContentType="application/json"/>'
        '<Default Extension="png" ContentType="image/png"/>'
        '</Types>')
    rels = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/'
        'package/2006/relationships">'
        '<Relationship Target="/3D/3dmodel.model" Id="rel0" '
        'Type="http://schemas.microsoft.com/3dmanufacturing/2013/'
        '01/3dmodel"/></Relationships>')
    model_rels = (
        '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
        '<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/'
        'package/2006/relationships">'
        '<Relationship Target="plate_1.gcode" Id="rel-gcode" '
        'Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/'
        '2006/relationships/oleObject"/></Relationships>')
    buf = _io.BytesIO()
    with _zip.ZipFile(buf, "w", _zip.ZIP_DEFLATED) as archive:
        archive.writestr("[Content_Types].xml", content_types)
        archive.writestr("_rels/.rels", rels)
        archive.writestr("3D/3dmodel.model", model_3d)
        archive.writestr(gcode_name, gcode)
        archive.writestr(gcode_name + ".md5", digest)
        archive.writestr("Metadata/model_settings.config",
                         model_settings)
        archive.writestr("Metadata/_rels/model_settings.config.rels",
                         model_rels)
        archive.writestr("Metadata/slice_info.config", slice_info)
        archive.writestr("Metadata/project_settings.config",
                         _json.dumps(project_settings, indent=1,
                                     sort_keys=True))
        archive.writestr("Metadata/plate_1.json", plate_json)
        for thumb in ("Metadata/plate_1.png",
                      "Metadata/plate_1_small.png",
                      "Metadata/plate_no_light_1.png",
                      "Metadata/top_1.png",
                      "Metadata/pick_1.png"):
            archive.writestr(thumb, PLACEHOLDER_PNG)
    return buf.getvalue()


def smoke_console(engine: str = "prusa") -> dict:
    """Fast --help proof that a console CLI answers. Read-only."""
    cleaned = str(engine or "").strip().lower()
    if cleaned not in ENGINES:
        return {"engine": cleaned, "state": "UNKNOWN",
                "reason": f"expected one of {list(ENGINES)}"}
    try:
        binary = resolve_console_binary(cleaned)
    except (LocalSlicerError, LocalSlicerUnavailable) as error:
        return {"engine": cleaned, "state": "ABSENT",
                "reason": str(error)[:160]}
    code, text = run_help_smoke(binary,
                                timeout=SMOKE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
    lowered = text.lower()
    if code == 0 and ("export-gcode" in lowered
                      or "--slice" in lowered):
        return {"engine": cleaned, "state": "CLI_OK",
                "reason": "console answers with slice flags"}
    if code == 0:
        return {"engine": cleaned, "state": "PRESENT_CLI_UNPROVEN",
                "reason": "--help shows no slice flags"}
    if code is None:
        return {"engine": cleaned, "state": "CLI_FAILED",
                "reason": "no answer (timeout/spawn failure)"}
    return {"engine": cleaned, "state": "CLI_FAILED",
            "reason": f"exit {code}"}


#: Default bed geometry for the Bambu Lab A1 Mini (mm). Used only
#: when no explicit bed-shape override is given; recorded in the
#: result so the provenance never hides it.
A1MINI_BED_SHAPE = "0x0,180x0,180x180,0x180"

#: Bambu Studio CLI is UNPROVEN on this build (8 headless attempts:
#: input files never accepted, silent exit -2, segfault without
#: settings). The argv mapping below is pure and tested, but
#: execution stays refused until a manual proof flips
#: BAMBU_CLI_PROVEN=1. Evidence over optimism.
BAMBU_PROOF_ENV_VAR = "BAMBU_CLI_PROVEN"


def bambu_slice_argv(*, binary: str, stl_path: str,
                     machine_json: str, process_json: str,
                     filament_json: str, output_3mf: str,
                     overrides: dict | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Pure argv builder for Bambu Studio headless slicing.

    No execution here — mapping only, so the design survives the
    day the CLI proves itself. Tested without running anything.
    """
    for label, value in (("model", stl_path),
                         ("machine profile", machine_json),
                         ("process profile", process_json),
                         ("filament profile", filament_json)):
        text = str(value or "").strip()
        if not text:
            raise LocalSlicerError(f"{label} is required")
        if not _os.path.isfile(text):
            raise LocalSlicerError(f"{label} not found; refusing")
    settings = f"{machine_json};{process_json}"
    argv = [binary, "--orient", "--arrange", "1",
            "--load-settings", settings,
            "--load-filaments", str(filament_json),
            "--slice", "0", "--export-3mf", output_3mf]
    for key, value in dict(overrides or {}).items():
        name = str(key or "").strip()
        if not name or len(name) > 60 or not name.startswith("--"):
            raise LocalSlicerError(
                "bambu overrides must look like --key=value")
        if any(char in name for char in " \t|&;$`()<>\"'"):
            raise LocalSlicerError(
                "bambu override carries shell characters; refusing")
        argv.append(f"{name}={str(value)[:80]}")
    argv.append(stl_path)
    return argv


def resolve_model_artifact(mesh_ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, bytes]:
    """Find model bytes for a slice request.

    Returns (source, path, data) where source is "library" or
    "fabdir". Library models (E:\\Mycelium) are read in place;
    inbox models come from the fabrication dir. Ambiguity and
    absence refuse honestly.
    """
    from .mesh3d import MAX_MESH_BYTES
    from .workshop3d import _library_model_bytes, _model_bytes
    from .workshop3d import list_models
    wanted = str(mesh_ref or "").strip()
    if not wanted:
        raise LocalSlicerError("mesh_ref is required")
    matches = [item for item in list_models(limit=200) or []
               if str(item.get("filename", "")) == wanted]
    library_hits = [item for item in matches
                    if str(item.get("library_ref", "") or "")]
    if len(library_hits) > 1:
        raise LocalSlicerError(
            f"several library models named '{wanted[:60]}'; "
            f"refusing ambiguous slice")
    if library_hits:
        rel = str(library_hits[0].get("library_ref", ""))
        name = rel.split("/")[-1]
        try:
            data = _library_model_bytes(name)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise LocalSlicerError(str(error)) from error
        from .forge import library_root
        path = _os.path.join(library_root(), "bibliotheek", name)
        return "library", path, data
    try:
        data = _model_bytes(wanted)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise LocalSlicerError(str(error)) from error
    if len(matches) > 1:
        raise LocalSlicerError(
            f"several fab models named '{wanted[:60]}'; refusing")
    from .mesh3d import artifact_path
    return "fabdir", artifact_path(wanted), data


class ConsoleSlicer:
    """Real local slicing through a proven console binary.

    Implements the SlicerProvider shape (slice(request)) without
    importing it, so slicer3d.py never gains subprocess/mqtt
    tokens. Engine "prusa" executes; "bambu" refuses as UNPROVEN
    until BAMBU_CLI_PROVEN=1 documents a manual proof.
    """

    name = "prusa-console"

    def __init__(self, engine: str = "prusa"):
        cleaned = str(engine or "").strip().lower()
        if cleaned == "bambu":
            import os as _env
            if _env.environ.get(BAMBU_PROOF_ENV_VAR,
                                "") != "1":
                from .slicer3d import SlicerUnavailable
                raise SlicerUnavailable(
                    "Bambu Studio CLI headless slicing is UNPROVEN "
                    "on this build (input files never accepted in "
                    "8 attempts); refusing instead of faking output")
        if cleaned not in ("prusa",):
            from .slicer3d import SlicerRefusedError
            raise SlicerRefusedError(
                f"console engine '{engine}' is not executable; "
                f"expected 'prusa'")
        self.engine = cleaned

    def slice(self, request) -> object:
        from .slicer3d import MAX_GCODE_BYTES as _MAXG
        from .slicer3d import (SlicerRefusedError, SlicerResult,
                               check_profile)
        from .slicer3d import _store_gcode
        from .inventory_read import Provenance
        profile_name = str(getattr(request, "profile", ""))
        settings = check_profile(profile_name)
        if str(getattr(request, "mesh_ref", "") or "") == "":
            raise SlicerRefusedError("mesh_ref is required")
        source, model_path, data = resolve_model_artifact(
            str(request.mesh_ref))
        if len(data) <= 0:
            raise SlicerRefusedError("model is empty; refusing")
        short = _hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()[:8]
        out_name = canonical_gcode_name(
            str(request.mesh_ref), profile_name, short)
        gcode_dir = canonical_gcode_dir()
        canonical = _os.path.join(gcode_dir, out_name)
        if not _os.path.isfile(canonical):
            with open(model_path, "rb") as _src:
                model_bytes = _src.read()
            import tempfile as _tf
            tmp_in = _os.path.join(
                gcode_dir, f".slice-{short}.stl")
            try:
                with open(tmp_in, "wb") as handle:
                    handle.write(model_bytes)
                result = slice_with_prusa(
                    stl_path=tmp_in, output_path=canonical,
                    profile=settings,
                    extra_printer_keys={
                        "bed-shape": A1MINI_BED_SHAPE})
            finally:
                try:
                    _os.remove(tmp_in)
                except OSError:
                    pass
        else:
            with open(canonical, "rb") as handle:
                blob = handle.read()
            if len(blob) <= 0 or len(blob) > _MAXG:
                raise SlicerRefusedError(
                    "canonical G-code out of bounds; refusing")
            result = {"gcode_path": canonical,
                      "sha256": _hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest(),
                      "size_bytes": len(blob),
                      "line_count": blob.count(b"\n"),
                      "engine": "prusa", "argv": ["<cached>"]}
        try:
            text = open(result["gcode_path"], "rb").read().decode(
                "ascii")
        except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as error:
            raise SlicerRefusedError(
                f"G-code unreadable as ASCII ({error}); refusing")
        work_ref, work_data = _store_gcode(
            f"fab-{short}-{profile_name}.gcode", text)
        if _hashlib.sha256(work_data).hexdigest() != \
                result["sha256"]:
            raise SlicerRefusedError(
                "working copy differs from canonical; refusing")
        return SlicerResult(
            gcode_ref=work_ref, sha256=result["sha256"],
            size_bytes=result["size_bytes"],
            line_count=result["line_count"], profile=profile_name,
            printer_id=str(getattr(request, "printer_id", "")),
            slicer=self.name, test_generated=False,
            provenance=Provenance(
                source_type="derived",
                creator_id=f"fabrication:local-slicer:{self.engine}",
                human_verified=False,
                notes=("local subprocess slice "
                       f"({result['engine']}); canonical "
                       f"{canonical[-80:]}")))

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/meshops.py">
"""Advanced mesh operations (BIG #11-15, Phase 4).

Pure, bounded geometry over facet lists from mesh3d — no
scripting, no code execution, no file access here. Every op
validates first (fail-closed) and returns new facets; the
caller previews, and only an explicit persist writes a
derived working file (existing write_derived_mesh path).

Ops: mirror, merge, extend (dimension +=, geometrically
guarded), orient (flattest side down), volume estimate,
repair proposal (data only, never mutation), prompt parsing
("maak deze bracket 5mm langer" → explicit op or refusal).
"""

import math

ADVANCED_OPS = frozenset({
    "mirror",
    "merge",
    "extend",
    "orient",
})

MAX_FACETS = 5000
MAX_DELTA_MM = 100.0


class MeshOpRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed geometry validation."""


def _check_facets(facets) -> list:
    if not isinstance(facets, list) or not facets:
        raise MeshOpRefusedError("facets must be a non-empty list")
    if len(facets) > MAX_FACETS:
        raise MeshOpRefusedError(
            f"at most {MAX_FACETS} facets per op")
    cleaned = []
    for facet in facets:
        try:
            points = [(float(point[0]), float(point[1]),
                       float(point[2])) for point in facet]
        except (TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
            raise MeshOpRefusedError(
                "facets must hold (x, y, z) numbers")
        if len(points) != 3 or any(
                not math.isfinite(coord) for point in points
                for coord in point):
            raise MeshOpRefusedError(
                "facets must be finite triangles")
        cleaned.append(tuple(points))
    return cleaned


def check_advanced_op(op: str, params) -> dict:
    """Validate one advanced op. No side effects."""
    if op not in ADVANCED_OPS:
        raise MeshOpRefusedError(
            f"Unknown advanced op '{op}'; expected one of "
            f"{sorted(ADVANCED_OPS)}")
    if not isinstance(params, dict):
        raise MeshOpRefusedError("params must be an object")
    if op == "mirror":
        plane = str(params.get("plane", ""))
        if plane not in ("x", "y", "z"):
            raise MeshOpRefusedError(
                "mirror needs plane x, y or z")
        if set(params) - {"plane"}:
            raise MeshOpRefusedError(
                "mirror carries unexpected params")
        return {"plane": plane}
    if op == "extend":
        axis = str(params.get("axis", ""))
        if axis not in ("x", "y", "z"):
            raise MeshOpRefusedError(
                "extend needs axis x, y or z")
        try:
            delta = float(params.get("delta_mm", 0.0))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise MeshOpRefusedError("delta_mm must be a number")
        if not math.isfinite(delta) or delta == 0.0 or \
                abs(delta) > MAX_DELTA_MM:
            raise MeshOpRefusedError(
                f"delta_mm must be nonzero within "
                f"+/-{MAX_DELTA_MM}")
        if set(params) - {"axis", "delta_mm"}:
            raise MeshOpRefusedError(
                "extend carries unexpected params")
        return {"axis": axis, "delta_mm": delta}
    if set(params):
        raise MeshOpRefusedError(
            f"{op} takes no params")
    return {}


def mirror_facets(facets, plane: str) -> list:
    """Mirror across the origin plane. Winding flips — the
    derived file re-validates downstream, never assumed."""
    cleaned = _check_facets(facets)
    index = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}[plane]
    out = []
    for facet in cleaned:
        mirrored = tuple(
            tuple(-coord if axis == index else coord
                  for axis, coord in enumerate(point))
            for point in facet)
        out.append(mirrored)
    return out


def merge_facets(groups: list) -> list:
    """Concatenate facet groups (duplicate = place twice).
    Bounded total; each group validated."""
    if not isinstance(groups, list) or not groups or \
            len(groups) > 10:
        raise MeshOpRefusedError("merge needs 1..10 groups")
    merged: list = []
    for group in groups:
        merged.extend(_check_facets(group))
        if len(merged) > MAX_FACETS:
            raise MeshOpRefusedError(
                f"merged mesh exceeds {MAX_FACETS} facets")
    return merged


def bounds_of(facets) -> tuple:
    cleaned = _check_facets(facets)
    axes = [[point[axis] for facet in cleaned
             for point in facet] for axis in range(3)]
    return tuple((min(values), max(values)) for values in axes)


def extend_facets(facets, axis: str,
                  delta_mm: float) -> list:
    """Dimension extension: vertices on the maximum plane
    along axis move by delta_mm (positive grows, negative
    shrinks but never past the minimum plane). Only planar
    end-caps move; interior geometry is untouched."""
    cleaned = _check_facets(facets)
    index = {"x": 0, "y": 1, "z": 2}[axis]
    coords = [point[index] for facet in cleaned
              for point in facet]
    lowest, highest = min(coords), max(coords)
    size = highest - lowest
    if size <= 0:
        raise MeshOpRefusedError("mesh is flat on this axis")
    if delta_mm < 0 and size + delta_mm <= 0:
        raise MeshOpRefusedError(
            "shrink would invert the dimension; refusing")
    epsilon = max(size * 1e-6, 1e-6)
    return [tuple(tuple(
        coord + delta_mm if axis_index == index
        and coord >= highest - epsilon else coord
        for axis_index, coord in enumerate(point))
        for point in facet) for facet in cleaned]


def orient_facets(facets) -> tuple[list, dict]:
    """Rotate so the smallest extent is Z (flattest side
    down): tries identity, X-90 and Y-90, picks the rotation
    with minimal Z size. Deterministic."""
    cleaned = _check_facets(facets)
    import math as _math
    variants = []
    for name, transform in (
            ("identity", lambda p: p),
            ("rot_x90", lambda p: (p[0], -p[2], p[1])),
            ("rot_y90", lambda p: (p[2], p[1], -p[0]))):
        moved = [tuple(transform(point) for point in facet)
                 for facet in cleaned]
        zed = [point[2] for facet in moved for point in facet]
        variants.append((max(zed) - min(zed), name, moved))
    variants.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
    _, name, moved = variants[0]
    return moved, {"rotation": name,
                   "method": "minimal Z extent over "
                             "identity/X-90/Y-90"}


def mesh_volume_cm3(facets) -> float:
    """Absolute summed tetra volume vs origin, in cm³.
    Estimate input for filament math, never a guarantee."""
    cleaned = _check_facets(facets)
    total = 0.0

    def dot(point, other):
        return sum(a * b for a, b in zip(point, other))

    def cross(point, other):
        return (point[1] * other[2] - point[2] * other[1],
                point[2] * other[0] - point[0] * other[2],
                point[0] * other[1] - point[1] * other[0])
    for facet in cleaned:
        total += dot(facet[0], cross(facet[1], facet[2])) / 6.0
    return round(abs(total) / 1000.0, 4)


def repair_proposal(report) -> dict:
    """Data-only repair suggestion from a validation report.
    Proposes, never mutates."""
    verdict = getattr(report, "verdict", "inconclusive")
    reasons = list(getattr(report, "reasons", []) or [])
    faces = int(getattr(report, "faces", 0) or 0)
    suggestions = []
    for reason in reasons:
        lowered = str(reason).lower()
        if "degenerate" in lowered or "zero-area" in lowered:
            suggestions.append(
                "drop zero-area facets, then re-validate")
        elif "non-manifold" in lowered or "edge" in lowered:
            suggestions.append(
                "run a mesh-repair pass in CAD, then re-import; "
                "no automatic stitching here")
        elif "normal" in lowered:
            suggestions.append(
                "recompute facet normals in CAD, then re-import")
        else:
            suggestions.append(
                f"inspect '{reason}' in CAD; no auto-fix offered")
    if verdict == "valid":
        suggestions = ["mesh already valid; nothing to repair"]
    return {"verdict": verdict, "faces": faces,
            "issues": reasons[:10],
            "suggestions": suggestions[:10],
            "note": "proposal only; the source file is untouched"}


def parse_prompt_edit(text: str) -> dict:
    """Parse 'maak deze bracket 5mm langer' style intents.
    Returns {op, params} or refuses on ambiguity. Closed
    patterns only — no LLM, no guessing."""
    import re
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        raise MeshOpRefusedError("prompt edit needs text")
    lowered = text.strip().lower()
    match = re.search(
        r"(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*mm\s*(langer|korter|groter|kleiner)",
        lowered)
    if match:
        delta = float(match.group(1).replace(",", "."))
        if "kort" in match.group(2) or "klein" in match.group(2):
            delta = -delta
        axis = "x"
        for token, name in (("x-richting", "x"),
                            ("y-richting", "y"),
                            ("z-richting", "z"),
                            ("lengte", "x"), ("breedte", "y"),
                            ("hoogte", "z"), ("dik", "z")):
            if token in lowered:
                axis = name
                break
        return {"op": "extend",
                "params": {"axis": axis, "delta_mm": delta},
                "interpretation": f"extend {axis} by {delta}mm "
                                  "(parsed, unconfirmed)"}
    if "spiegel" in lowered or "mirror" in lowered:
        plane = "x"
        for token in ("x", "y", "z"):
            if f" {token}" in lowered or f"{token}-" in lowered:
                plane = token
                break
        return {"op": "mirror", "params": {"plane": plane},
                "interpretation": f"mirror across {plane} "
                                  "(parsed, unconfirmed)"}
    raise MeshOpRefusedError(
        "could not parse a safe edit (try '5mm langer', "
        "'10mm korter in z-richting', or 'spiegel x'); "
        "nothing was changed")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/mission_loop.py">
"""Autonomous mission loop (BIG #21).

One safe continuous runner over the existing architecture:
chat intent → mission → tick → observe → evaluate →
continue → verify → complete. This module adds NO new
execution power: it calls the existing executor.tick(),
reads the existing gates, and STOPS at every one of them.

The loop NEVER:
- approves plans, actions, writes or prints (exact YES
  stays human, through the existing endpoints),
- invents steps outside the approved plan,
- retries failed/blocked steps blindly,
- executes physical actions (HARDWARE_REQUIRED + own
  approval live in the existing runners),
- promotes results to FACT (verification outcomes come
  from the existing verification flow).

What it DOES:
- drive approved work forward until the next gate,
- report exactly where it stopped and what unblocks it
  (actionable stop reasons with ids),
- store one episodic memory when the mission reaches a
  terminal state (observed truth, never fact),
- stay bounded (max rounds per call; concurrent runs
  lose the existing conditional-update race).

Continuation ("herplan → vervolg") happens across calls:
an external actor (human YES, desktop agent claim/act/
report, new observation) changes state, the next run
ticks further within the approved plan. Replanning
beyond approved steps needs a new approval, never the
loop.
"""

import time

MAX_LOOP_ROUNDS = 10

TERMINAL_STATES = ("completed", "failed", "cancelled",
                   "blocked")


class MissionLoopRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Loop validation refused; nothing was driven."""


def _stop(reason: str, detail: str = "", action: dict | None = None,
          rounds: int = 0, mission_id: str = "",
          status: str = "") -> dict:
    return {"mission_id": mission_id, "status": status,
            "outcome": "stopped", "stop_reason": reason,
            "detail": str(detail or "")[:500],
            "action": action or {}, "rounds": rounds}


async def run_loop(mission_id: str, *, max_rounds: int = 10,
                   actor: str = "mission-loop") -> dict:
    """Drive one mission until a gate, terminal state or the
    round budget. Returns a run report, never an approval."""
    from .mission_executor import ExecutorError
    from .missions import current_step_of, load_mission
    if not isinstance(mission_id, str) or not mission_id.strip():
        raise MissionLoopRefusedError("mission_id must be text")
    try:
        budget = max(1, min(int(max_rounds or 10),
                            MAX_LOOP_ROUNDS))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise MissionLoopRefusedError(
            "max_rounds must be an integer")
    mission = load_mission(mission_id.strip())
    if mission is None:
        raise MissionLoopRefusedError("mission not found")
    if mission.status == "pending_approval":
        return _stop("needs_plan_approval",
                      "The plan needs an exact YES before "
                      "anything runs. Approval authorizes "
                      "steps only, never execution.",
                      {"approve": f"/api/v1/missions/"
                                  f"{mission.mission_id}/approve"},
                      rounds=0, mission_id=mission.mission_id,
                      status=mission.status)
    if mission.status in TERMINAL_STATES:
        remembered = _remember_if_new(mission)
        return {"mission_id": mission.mission_id,
                "status": mission.status, "outcome": "stopped",
                "stop_reason": "already_terminal",
                "detail": "Mission already ended; loop only "
                          "observes terminal states.",
                "action": {}, "rounds": 0,
                "memory_id": remembered}
    if mission.status == "paused":
        return _stop("paused",
                      "Mission is paused. Resume explicitly "
                      "before the loop continues.",
                      {"resume": f"/api/v1/missions/"
                                 f"{mission.mission_id}/resume"},
                      rounds=0, mission_id=mission.mission_id,
                      status=mission.status)
    from .main import _executor
    rounds = 0
    last_tick: dict = {}
    while rounds < budget:
        rounds += 1
        try:
            last_tick = await _executor().tick(mission_id)
        except ExecutorError as error:
            return _stop("conflict_or_error", str(error),
                         rounds=rounds,
                         mission_id=mission.mission_id,
                         status=_safe_status(mission_id))
        outcome = str(last_tick.get("outcome", ""))
        status = str(last_tick.get("status", ""))
        if outcome == "completed" or status == "completed":
            remembered = _remember_if_new(
                _reload(mission_id, mission))
            return {"mission_id": mission_id,
                    "status": "completed",
                    "outcome": "completed", "rounds": rounds,
                    "tick": last_tick, "memory_id": remembered}
        if status in ("failed", "blocked", "cancelled",
                      "paused"):
            mission_now = _reload(mission_id, mission)
            remembered = _remember_if_new(mission_now)
            return {"mission_id": mission_id, "status": status,
                    "outcome": "stopped",
                    "stop_reason": f"mission_{status}",
                    "detail": "Terminal state reached; a human "
                              "reviews before anything else.",
                    "action": {}, "rounds": rounds,
                    "tick": last_tick, "memory_id": remembered}
        # Waiting: name the gate, do not push through it.
        return _describe_wait(mission_id, rounds, last_tick)
    return _stop("round_budget",
                 f"Used all {budget} rounds without reaching a "
                 "terminal state; re-run explicitly.",
                 rounds=budget, mission_id=mission_id,
                 status=_safe_status(mission_id))


def _safe_status(mission_id: str) -> str:
    from .missions import load_mission
    try:
        mission = load_mission(mission_id)
        return mission.status if mission else "unknown"
    except ValueError:
        return "unknown"


def _reload(mission_id: str, fallback):
    from .missions import load_mission
    try:
        mission = load_mission(mission_id)
        return mission if mission is not None else fallback
    except ValueError:
        return fallback


def _describe_wait(mission_id: str, rounds: int,
                   tick: dict) -> dict:
    """Name the exact gate a waiting tick stopped at, with
    the ids a human or agent needs to unblock it."""
    from .missions import current_step_of, load_mission
    try:
        mission = load_mission(mission_id)
    except ValueError:
        return _stop("conflict_or_error",
                      "Mission vanished mid-run.", rounds=rounds,
                      mission_id=mission_id)
    if mission is None:
        return _stop("conflict_or_error",
                      "Mission vanished mid-run.", rounds=rounds,
                      mission_id=mission_id)
    step = current_step_of(mission)
    if step is None:
        return _stop("waiting",
                      "No current step; re-run after state "
                      "changes.", rounds=rounds,
                      mission_id=mission_id,
                      status=mission.status)
    kind = str(step.kind)
    if step.status == "waiting_approval":
        return _stop(
            "needs_desktop_approval",
            f"Desktop action {step.desktop_action_id or '?'} "
            f"({step.action_type or step.description}) waits "
            f"for an exact YES. The loop never approves input.",
            {"action_id": step.desktop_action_id or "",
             "decide": "/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
                       f"{step.desktop_action_id or ''}/decision"
                       if step.desktop_action_id else ""},
            rounds=rounds, mission_id=mission_id,
            status=mission.status)
    if step.status == "dispatched":
        return _stop(
            "waiting_agent",
            f"Action {step.desktop_action_id or '?'} is "
            f"dispatched to an agent. The loop waits; the "
            f"desktop agent claims, acts and reports, then a "
            f"new run continues.",
            {"action_id": step.desktop_action_id or ""},
            rounds=rounds, mission_id=mission_id,
            status=mission.status)
    if kind == "proposal":
        return _stop(
            "needs_proposal_approval",
            "A proposal step finished as data. It needs the "
            "separate /approvals flow; proposals never "
            "auto-execute.",
            {"approvals": "/api/v1/approvals"},
            rounds=rounds, mission_id=mission_id,
            status=mission.status)
    if kind in ("write", "fabricate", "slice",
                "physical_print"):
        return _stop(
            "needs_write_or_physical_approval",
            f"A {kind} step needs its own exact YES plus "
            f"fingerprint revalidation (physical_print: plus "
            f"its own physical approval — a mission YES never "
            f"starts a machine).",
            {"writes": "/api/v1/writes"},
            rounds=rounds, mission_id=mission_id,
            status=mission.status)
    return _stop("waiting",
                 f"Step '{step.description[:80]}' ({kind}) is "
                 f"{step.status}. Re-run after the world "
                 f"changes.",
                 rounds=rounds, mission_id=mission_id,
                 status=mission.status,
                 action={"tick": f"/api/v1/missions/"
                                 f"{mission_id}/tick"})


def _remember_if_new(mission) -> str:
    """Store one episodic memory for a terminal mission.
    Observed truth, sensor-observed provenance, mission +
    observation links. Never a fact tier, never verified.
    Skips when a memory already references the mission."""
    from .memory import list_memories, new_memory, save_memory
    mission_id = mission.mission_id
    try:
        existing = list_memories(limit=200)
    except ValueError:
        existing = []
    for entry in existing:
        if mission_id in (entry.entity_refs or []):
            return entry.memory_id
    observations = []
    for step in (mission.steps or []):
        ref = getattr(step, "observation_reference", "") or ""
        if ref:
            observations.append(
                f"{step.kind}:{step.status}:{ref}")
    content = (f"Mission '{mission.goal[:200]}' ended as "
               f"{mission.status}. Steps: "
               + "; ".join(
                   f"{step.kind}={step.status}"
                   for step in (mission.steps or []))[:1500]
               + (". Observations: " + "; ".join(
                   observations[:10]) if observations else ""))
    from .inventory_read import Provenance
    entry = new_memory(
        "episodic", f"Mission ended: {mission.goal[:120]}",
        truth="observed", content=content,
        source=f"mission:{mission_id}",
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="sensor-observed",
            creator_id="mission-loop", human_verified=False,
            notes="loop terminal-state record; observed "
                  "system outcome, never a fact"),
        project_ref="",
        entity_refs=[mission_id],
        event_refs=[])
    save_memory(entry)
    return entry.memory_id

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/nutrition.py">
"""Nutrition domain (BIG #11-15, Phase 2).

MEAL → INGREDIENT → PORTION → NUTRIENT → DAILY TOTAL →
WEEKLY TREND, over an extensible nutrient model (no giant
hardcoded food database). AI may propose values, but source
and verification stay visible on every number.

Vegan-first: vegan_status is explicit per food
(vegan/non_vegan/unknown) with evidence required for any
claim — never an AI guess presented as fact.

Coverage compares actual intake against configurable
reference targets and answers only adequate/possibly
low/possibly high/unknown, always with source, context,
calculation and uncertainty. Never a medical statement.
"""

import secrets
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

# Extensible nutrient model: key → unit. Macros, micros and
# the nutrients that matter for a vegan-first diet.
NUTRIENTS = {
    "calories": "kcal",
    "protein_g": "g",
    "carbs_g": "g",
    "fat_g": "g",
    "fiber_g": "g",
    "sugars_g": "g",
    "sat_fat_g": "g",
    "sodium_mg": "mg",
    "vit_a_ug": "ug",
    "vit_c_mg": "mg",
    "vit_d_ug": "ug",
    "vit_b12_ug": "ug",
    "vit_k_ug": "ug",
    "folate_ug": "ug",
    "iron_mg": "mg",
    "calcium_mg": "mg",
    "zinc_mg": "mg",
    "magnesium_mg": "mg",
    "potassium_mg": "mg",
    "iodine_ug": "ug",
    "omega3_g": "g",
}

VEGAN_STATUSES = ("vegan", "non_vegan", "unknown")

FOOD_SOURCES = (
    "manual",
    "food_database",
    "recipe",
    "product_label",
    "external",
    "ai_proposal",
)

# Illustrative daily reference targets for one adult. These
# are user-overridable placeholders with their context shown
# on every coverage answer — not personal advice.
DEFAULT_REFERENCE = {
    "source": "built-in illustrative default (adult, varied "
              "diet); override with your own targets",
    "population": "general adult placeholder",
    "targets": {
        "calories": 2200.0, "protein_g": 60.0,
        "carbs_g": 275.0, "fat_g": 75.0, "fiber_g": 30.0,
        "sugars_g": 50.0, "sat_fat_g": 20.0,
        "sodium_mg": 2000.0, "vit_c_mg": 95.0,
        "vit_b12_ug": 2.4, "iron_mg": 11.0,
        "calcium_mg": 1000.0, "zinc_mg": 10.0,
        "magnesium_mg": 350.0, "potassium_mg": 3500.0,
        "iodine_ug": 150.0, "omega3_g": 1.6,
    },
}


class NutritionRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed nutrition validation."""


def now() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now(
        datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_food_id() -> str:
    return f"food_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def generate_meal_id() -> str:
    return f"meal_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


class Food(BaseModel):
    food_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    nutrients: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    vegan_status: str = Field(default="unknown",
                              max_length=20)
    vegan_evidence: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    source: str = Field(default="manual", max_length=20)
    provenance: Provenance
    created_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


class MealItem(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    food_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    portion_g: float = Field(default=100.0, gt=0, le=5000)
    nutrients: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    vegan_status: str = Field(default="unknown",
                              max_length=20)


class Meal(BaseModel):
    meal_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    items: list[MealItem] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                  max_length=30)
    totals: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    vegan_status: str = Field(default="unknown",
                              max_length=20)
    source: str = Field(default="manual", max_length=20)
    provenance: Provenance
    observed_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    created_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


def _check_nutrients(nutrients: dict) -> dict[str, float]:
    if not isinstance(nutrients, dict):
        raise NutritionRefusedError("nutrients must be an object")
    if len(nutrients) > len(NUTRIENTS):
        raise NutritionRefusedError("nutrient object too large")
    cleaned: dict[str, float] = {}
    for key, value in nutrients.items():
        if key not in NUTRIENTS:
            raise NutritionRefusedError(
                f"Unknown nutrient '{key}'")
        try:
            number = float(value)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise NutritionRefusedError(
                f"nutrient '{key}' must be numeric")
        if number != number or number < 0 or number > 10**7:
            raise NutritionRefusedError(
                f"nutrient '{key}' out of range")
        cleaned[key] = round(number, 3)
    return cleaned


def _check_vegan(status: str, evidence: str) -> str:
    if status not in VEGAN_STATUSES:
        raise NutritionRefusedError(
            f"Unknown vegan status '{status}'")
    if status in ("vegan", "non_vegan") and not \
            str(evidence or "").strip():
        raise NutritionRefusedError(
            "a vegan/non-vegan claim needs explicit evidence "
            "(ingredient list, label or source); never guess")
    return status


def new_food(name: str, nutrients: dict, *,
             vegan_status: str = "unknown",
             vegan_evidence: str = "",
             source: str = "manual",
             provenance: Provenance | None = None) -> Food:
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        raise NutritionRefusedError("food needs a name")
    if source not in FOOD_SOURCES:
        raise NutritionRefusedError(f"Unknown source '{source}'")
    return Food(
        food_id=generate_food_id(), name=name.strip()[:200],
        nutrients=_check_nutrients(nutrients or {}),
        vegan_status=_check_vegan(vegan_status,
                                  vegan_evidence),
        vegan_evidence=str(vegan_evidence or "")[:500],
        source=source,
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="user-created"
            if source == "manual" else "ai-generated",
            creator_id=f"nutrition:{source}",
            human_verified=source in ("manual", "product_label",
                                      "recipe")),
        created_at=now())


def scale_nutrients(nutrients: dict, portion_g: float,
                    base_g: float = 100.0) -> dict[str, float]:
    """Scale a per-100g profile to a portion. Pure math."""
    try:
        factor = float(portion_g) / float(base_g)
    except (TypeError, ValueError, ZeroDivisionError):
        raise NutritionRefusedError("portion must be numeric")
    if factor <= 0 or factor > 50:
        raise NutritionRefusedError("portion out of range")
    return {key: round(value * factor, 3)
            for key, value in nutrients.items()}


def new_meal(name: str, items: list[dict], *,
             source: str = "manual",
             observed_at: str = "",
             provenance: Provenance | None = None) -> Meal:
    """One meal from portioned items. Totals are computed,
    vegan status folds to the weakest claim (unknown beats
    vegan; non_vegan dominates)."""
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        raise NutritionRefusedError("meal needs a name")
    if not isinstance(items, list) or not items or \
            len(items) > 30:
        raise NutritionRefusedError(
            "meal needs 1..30 items")
    if source not in FOOD_SOURCES:
        raise NutritionRefusedError(f"Unknown source '{source}'")
    parsed: list[MealItem] = []
    totals: dict[str, float] = {}
    statuses: set[str] = set()
    for raw in items:
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise NutritionRefusedError(
                "meal items must be objects")
        nutrients = _check_nutrients(raw.get("nutrients") or {})
        try:
            portion = float(raw.get("portion_g", 100.0))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise NutritionRefusedError(
                "portion_g must be numeric")
        scaled = scale_nutrients(nutrients, portion)
        for key, value in scaled.items():
            totals[key] = round(totals.get(key, 0.0) + value, 3)
        status = str(raw.get("vegan_status", "unknown"))
        if status not in VEGAN_STATUSES:
            raise NutritionRefusedError(
                f"Unknown vegan status '{status}'")
        statuses.add(status)
        parsed.append(MealItem(
            name=str(raw.get("name", "item"))[:200],
            food_id=str(raw.get("food_id", ""))[:80],
            portion_g=portion, nutrients=scaled,
            vegan_status=status))
    if "non_vegan" in statuses:
        meal_status = "non_vegan"
    elif "unknown" in statuses:
        meal_status = "unknown"
    else:
        meal_status = "vegan"
    stamp = now()
    return Meal(
        meal_id=generate_meal_id(), name=name.strip()[:200],
        items=parsed, totals=totals, vegan_status=meal_status,
        source=source,
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="user-created"
            if source == "manual" else "ai-generated",
            creator_id=f"nutrition:{source}",
            human_verified=source == "manual"),
        observed_at=observed_at or stamp, created_at=stamp)


def save_food(food: Food) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO foods
        (food_id, name, nutrients, vegan_status,
         vegan_evidence, source, provenance, created_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(food_id) DO NOTHING""",
                     (food.food_id, food.name,
                      dump(food.nutrients), food.vegan_status,
                      food.vegan_evidence, food.source,
                      dump(food.provenance.model_dump(
                          mode="json")), food.created_at))


def get_food(food_id: str) -> Food | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM foods WHERE food_id=?",
                         (food_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return Food(food_id=row["food_id"], name=row["name"],
                nutrients=load(row["nutrients"]),
                vegan_status=row["vegan_status"],
                vegan_evidence=row["vegan_evidence"],
                source=row["source"],
                provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
                created_at=row["created_at"])


def find_food(name: str) -> Food | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM foods WHERE lower(name)"
                         "=lower(?) LIMIT 1",
                         (name,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return Food(food_id=row["food_id"], name=row["name"],
                nutrients=load(row["nutrients"]),
                vegan_status=row["vegan_status"],
                vegan_evidence=row["vegan_evidence"],
                source=row["source"],
                provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
                created_at=row["created_at"])


def save_meal(meal: Meal) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO meals
        (meal_id, name, items, source, provenance,
         observed_at, created_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(meal_id) DO NOTHING""",
                     (meal.meal_id, meal.name,
                      dump([item.model_dump(mode="json")
                            for item in meal.items]),
                      meal.source,
                      dump(meal.provenance.model_dump(
                          mode="json")),
                      meal.observed_at, meal.created_at))


def list_meals(*, since: str = "",
               limit: int = 50) -> list[Meal]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_chat_database()
    clauses, params = [], []
    if since:
        clauses.append("observed_at>?")
        params.append(since)
    where = f"WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}" if clauses else ""
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            f"SELECT * FROM meals {where} ORDER BY observed_at "
            f"DESC LIMIT ?",
            (*params, max(1, min(int(limit or 50), 200)))
        ).fetchall()
    meals = []
    for row in rows:
        items = [MealItem(**item) for item in load(row["items"])]
        totals: dict[str, float] = {}
        for item in items:
            for key, value in item.nutrients.items():
                totals[key] = round(
                    totals.get(key, 0.0) + value, 3)
        statuses = {item.vegan_status for item in items}
        status = "non_vegan" if "non_vegan" in statuses \
            else "unknown" if "unknown" in statuses else "vegan"
        meals.append(Meal(
            meal_id=row["meal_id"], name=row["name"],
            items=items, totals=totals, vegan_status=status,
            source=row["source"],
            provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
            observed_at=row["observed_at"],
            created_at=row["created_at"]))
    return meals


def daily_totals(day: str) -> dict:
    """Sum all meals whose observed_at falls on YYYY-MM-DD."""
    if not isinstance(day, str) or len(day) != 10:
        raise NutritionRefusedError(
            "day must be YYYY-MM-DD")
    totals: dict[str, float] = {}
    count = 0
    for meal in list_meals(limit=200):
        if str(meal.observed_at)[:10] != day:
            continue
        count += 1
        for key, value in meal.totals.items():
            totals[key] = round(totals.get(key, 0.0) + value, 3)
    return {"day": day, "meals": count, "totals": totals}


def weekly_trend(end_day: str) -> dict:
    """Seven daily totals ending on end_day (YYYY-MM-DD)."""
    import datetime
    try:
        end = datetime.date.fromisoformat(end_day)
    except ValueError:
        raise NutritionRefusedError(
            "end_day must be YYYY-MM-DD")
    days = [(end - datetime.timedelta(days=offset)).isoformat()
            for offset in range(6, -1, -1)]
    return {"end_day": end_day,
            "days": [daily_totals(day) for day in days]}


def coverage_for(totals: dict, *,
                 targets: dict | None = None,
                 reference: dict | None = None) -> dict:
    """Actual vs reference: adequate/possibly low/possibly
    high/unknown per nutrient, with source, context,
    calculation and uncertainty on every answer."""
    ref = reference or DEFAULT_REFERENCE
    wanted = targets or ref.get("targets", {})
    result = {}
    for nutrient in NUTRIENTS:
        actual = float((totals or {}).get(nutrient, 0.0))
        target = wanted.get(nutrient)
        if target is None or float(target) <= 0:
            result[nutrient] = {
                "status": "unknown", "actual": actual,
                "target": None,
                "reason": "no reference target configured"}
            continue
        ratio = actual / float(target)
        if 0.9 <= ratio <= 1.1:
            status = "adequate"
        elif ratio < 0.9:
            status = "possibly low"
        else:
            status = "possibly high"
        result[nutrient] = {
            "status": status, "actual": actual,
            "target": float(target),
            "ratio": round(ratio, 3),
            "calculation": f"actual/target = {actual}/"
                           f"{float(target)}"}
    return {
        "nutrients": result,
        "reference_source": ref.get("source", ""),
        "reference_population": ref.get("population", ""),
        "uncertainty": "single-day totals vary; labels, "
                       "portions and database values are "
                       "approximate; this is arithmetic, not "
                       "personal advice",
    }
