<file path="mycelium-ai-main/node_client/bootstrap.py">
"""One-command Linux node bootstrap (BIG #31).

Generates everything a fresh laptop needs — nothing is installed
or started by this script itself:

- python mycelium-node-join.py --coordinator URL --node-id NAME
  --token ...  →  prints the exact install + run commands
- --write-systemd               →  prints a systemd --user unit
- --check                       →  runs the coordinator pre-flight
  (linux_node.bootstrap_check) without registering anything

Pull-only, no inbound ports, no shell/RCE. Capabilities stay
allow-listed (linux_node.LINUX_CAPABILITIES); the token travels
via env/flag, never into a file written here.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os as _os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, _os.path.dirname(
    _os.path.dirname(_os.path.abspath(__file__))))


def build_run_command(*, repo_dir: str, coordinator: str, node_id: str,
                      tier: str = "worker",
                      capabilities: list[str] | None = None,
                      poll_seconds: int = 10) -> str:
    from coordinator.app.linux_node import check_capabilities
    caps = check_capabilities(list(capabilities or ["node.status"]))
    parts = [f"cd {repo_dir}",
             "python3 -m venv .venv",
             "source .venv/bin/activate",
             "pip install -e .",
             "export MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN=...",
             "python -m node_client.main "
             f"--coordinator {coordinator} "
             f"--node-id {node_id} --tier {tier} "
             + " ".join(f"--capability {cap}" for cap in caps)
             + f" --poll-seconds {poll_seconds}"]
    return "\n".join(parts)


def build_systemd_unit(*, repo_dir: str, coordinator: str, node_id: str,
                       tier: str = "worker",
                       capabilities: list[str] | None = None) -> str:
    from coordinator.app.linux_node import check_capabilities
    caps = check_capabilities(list(capabilities or ["node.status"]))
    cap_flags = " ".join(f"--capability {cap}" for cap in caps)
    return f"""[Unit]
Description=Mycelium node {node_id} (pull-only, user service)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory={repo_dir}
Environment=MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN=%h/.config/mycelium/node-token
ExecStart={repo_dir}/.venv/bin/python -m node_client.main --coordinator {coordinator} --node-id {node_id} --tier {tier} {cap_flags} --poll-seconds 10
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
"""


def arguments() -> argparse.Namespace:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Mycelium Linux node one-command bootstrap")
    parser.add_argument("--coordinator",
                        default="http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    parser.add_argument("--node-id", default="linux-laptop-1")
    parser.add_argument("--tier", default="worker",
                        choices=["seed", "worker", "core"])
    parser.add_argument("--capability", action="append", default=[],
                        help="repeatable; starter set only")
    parser.add_argument("--token", default="",
                        help="only echoed as placeholder, never stored")
    parser.add_argument("--repo-dir", default="~/mycelium-ai-main")
    parser.add_argument("--poll-seconds", type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument("--write-systemd", action="store_true",
                        help="print a systemd --user unit instead")
    parser.add_argument("--check", action="store_true",
                        help="run pre-flight checks only")
    return parser.parse_args()


def main() -> int:
    config = arguments()
    caps = config.capability or ["node.status"]
    if config.check:
        import json as _json
        import urllib.request
        payload = _json.dumps({
            "python_version": ".".join(
                str(part) for part in sys.version_info[:3]),
            "coordinator_url": config.coordinator,
            "node_id": config.node_id,
            "capabilities": caps}).encode()
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            config.coordinator.rstrip("/") +
            "/api/v1/linux-nodes/check", data=payload,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            method="POST")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request,
                                        timeout=10) as response:
                print(_json.dumps(
                    _json.load(response), indent=1)[:2000])
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"pre-flight unreachable: {error}")
            print("Is the coordinator running? Start it first, "
                  "then re-run with --check.")
            return 1
        return 0
    if config.write_systemd:
        print(build_systemd_unit(
            repo_dir=config.repo_dir,
            coordinator=config.coordinator, node_id=config.node_id,
            tier=config.tier, capabilities=caps))
        print("# install: save as "
              "~/.config/systemd/user/mycelium-node.service, "
              "put the token in ~/.config/mycelium/node-token "
              "(chmod 600), then: systemctl --user daemon-reload && "
              "systemctl --user enable --now mycelium-node")
        return 0
    print("# 1. copy the repo to the laptop, then run:")
    print(build_run_command(
        repo_dir=config.repo_dir, coordinator=config.coordinator,
        node_id=config.node_id, tier=config.tier, capabilities=caps,
        poll_seconds=config.poll_seconds))
    print("# 2. replace export MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN=... with a real "
          "token (never commit it). First register binds it; "
          "later heartbeats must repeat it.")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/node_client/install.py">
"""Mycelium Linux node installer (P1 distribution layer).

This module DOES the install work; ``scripts/install_linux_node.sh``
is only a thin wrapper that prepares ``python3``/``venv`` and then
calls ``python -m node_client.install install``.

Everything here is stdlib-only (plus optional, guarded imports) so it
runs on a bare laptop with Python >= 3.11. No new queue, no new auth,
no new scheduler: identity, tokens, capabilities, registration,
heartbeat and task claiming all follow the existing coordinator
contract (``coordinator/app/nodes.py``, ``coordinator/app/linux_node.py``,
``coordinator/app/main.py``) and the existing pull-only
``node_client/main.py`` loop.

Subcommands::

    python -m node_client.install install [--coordinator URL ...]
    python -m node_client.install doctor [--config PATH]
    python -m node_client.install print-systemd [...]
    python -m node_client.install uninstall [...]

Secrets (``MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN``) live only in the local env file
(``~/.config/mycelium/node.env``, chmod 600) or the process
environment. They are never printed, never logged, never committed.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import platform
import re
import secrets
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from typing import Callable
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

INSTALLER_MARKER = (
    "# Generated by Mycelium node installer "
    "(node_client/install.py) - safe to replace."
)

DEFAULT_COORDINATOR_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8000"
DEFAULT_NODE_ID = "linux-laptop-1"
DEFAULT_TIER = "worker"
DEFAULT_POLL_SECONDS = 10.0
MIN_TOKEN_CHARS = 16  # mirrors coordinator.app.nodes.MIN_NODE_TOKEN_CHARS
VALID_TIERS = ("seed", "worker", "core")

CONFIG_KEYS = (
    "MYCELIUM_COORDINATOR_URL",
    "MYCELIUM_NODE_ID",
    "MYCELIUM_NODE_TIER",
    "MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN",
    "MYCELIUM_NODE_CAPABILITIES",
    "MYCELIUM_NODE_POLL_SECONDS",
)

# Local fallback for the Linux starter set. The coordinator contract
# (coordinator/app/linux_node.py LINUX_CAPABILITIES) wins whenever it
# can be imported; this list only keeps a bare laptop working.
FALLBACK_LINUX_CAPABILITIES = (
    "node.status",
    "research.search",
    "research.fetch",
    "analysis.ollama",
    "inventory.read",
    "file.inspect",
)

# Capabilities the existing node_client executors can honestly serve
# (node_client/main.py execute_safe_task): system_inventory and
# research.fetch_url always work; ollama-backed ones need `ollama`.
ALWAYS_CAPABILITIES = ("node.status", "research.fetch", "inventory.read")
OLLAMA_CAPABILITIES = ("analysis.ollama", "research.search")

NODE_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$")

SERVICE_NAME = "mycelium-node.service"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# secret handling
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_SECRET_PATTERNS = (
    re.compile(
        r"(?i)(MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN|MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY|node_token"
        r"|operator_key|password|passwd|secret)\s*([:=])\s*"
        r"([^\s,;'\"]+)"
    ),
    re.compile(r"(?i)(bearer\s+)([A-Za-z0-9\-._~+/=]{8,})"),
    re.compile(r"(?i)([?&]node_token=)([^&\s'\"]{8,})"),
)


def redact_secrets(text: str, known: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> str:
    """Redact credential-looking values from human-facing text."""
    redacted = str(text or "")

    def _sub_key(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        return f"{match.group(1)}{match.group(2)}***"

    redacted = _SECRET_PATTERNS[0].sub(_sub_key, redacted)
    redacted = _SECRET_PATTERNS[1].sub(r"\1***", redacted)
    redacted = _SECRET_PATTERNS[2].sub(r"\1***", redacted)
    for secret in known:
        value = str(secret or "").strip()
        if len(value) >= 8 and value in redacted:
            redacted = redacted.replace(value, "***")
    return redacted


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OS / hardware detection (all injectable for tests)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def parse_os_release(text: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Parse /etc/os-release content into a small dict."""
    info: dict[str, str] = {}
    for line in str(text or "").splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#") or "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
        info[key.strip()] = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")[:120]
    return info


def detect_os(
    system: str | None = None,
    release_text: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Detect OS name/arch/distro. Never raises; missing data is ''."""
    detected_system = system if system is not None else platform.system()
    machine = platform.machine() or ""
    distro = ""
    if release_text is None:
        try:
            with open("/etc/os-release", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                release_text = handle.read()
        except OSError:
            release_text = ""
    try:
        parsed = parse_os_release(release_text or "")
        distro = parsed.get("PRETTY_NAME", "") or " ".join(
            part
            for part in (parsed.get("NAME", ""), parsed.get("VERSION_ID", ""))
            if part
        )
    except Exception:
        distro = ""
    return {
        "system": detected_system,
        "machine": machine,
        "distro": distro[:120],
        "is_linux": detected_system == "Linux",
    }


def check_python_version(version: tuple[int, ...] | None = None) -> dict:
    """Python >= 3.11 is required (matches pyproject requires-python)."""
    current = version if version is not None else sys.version_info[:3]
    ok = len(current) >= 2 and (current[0], current[1]) >= (3, 11)
    return {
        "name": "Python",
        "status": "OK" if ok else "FAIL",
        "detail": (
            f"{current[0]}.{current[1]}.{current[2] if len(current) > 2 else 0} "
            f"({ 'meets' if ok else 'needs' } >= 3.11)"
        ),
    }


def default_runner(
    cmd: list[str], timeout: float = 5.0
) -> tuple[int, str]:
    """Run a command, return (returncode, stdout). Never raises."""
    try:
        proc = subprocess.run(
            cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout
        )
        return proc.returncode, (proc.stdout or "").strip()[:2000]
    except Exception:
        return 127, ""


Runner = Callable[[list[str], float], tuple[int, str]]


def check_git(runner: Runner = default_runner) -> dict:
    """Git is required to clone/update the repo; fatal when missing."""
    code, out = runner(["git", "--version"], 5.0)
    if code == 0 and out:
        return {"name": "Git", "status": "OK", "detail": out.splitlines()[0][:80]}
    return {
        "name": "Git",
        "status": "FAIL",
        "detail": "git not found (install with: sudo apt install -y git)",
    }


def check_ollama(runner: Runner = default_runner) -> dict:
    """Ollama is OPTIONAL: the node registers without it."""
    code, out = runner(["ollama", "list"], 5.0)
    if code != 0:
        return {
            "name": "Ollama",
            "status": "OPTIONAL",
            "detail": "not found (node still registers; "
            "ollama-backed capabilities stay off)",
        }
    models = [
        line.split()[0]
        for line in out.splitlines()[1:]
        if line.strip() and line.split()
    ][:20]
    detail = f"available ({len(models)} models)" if models else "available"
    return {"name": "Ollama", "status": "AVAILABLE", "detail": detail}


def check_nvidia(runner: Runner = default_runner) -> dict:
    """NVIDIA GPU is OPTIONAL: detected via nvidia-smi when present."""
    code, out = runner(["nvidia-smi", "-L"], 5.0)
    if code != 0 or not out:
        return {
            "name": "NVIDIA",
            "status": "OPTIONAL",
            "detail": "not detected (CPU-only node)",
        }
    first = out.splitlines()[0][:100]
    return {"name": "NVIDIA", "status": "AVAILABLE", "detail": first}


def memory_mb(
    meminfo_text: str | None = None, use_psutil: bool = True
) -> int:
    """Total RAM in MiB. psutil first, /proc/meminfo fallback, else 0."""
    if use_psutil:
        try:
            import psutil

            return int(psutil.virtual_memory().total // (1024 * 1024))
        except Exception:
            pass
    text = meminfo_text
    if text is None:
        try:
            with open("/proc/meminfo", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
                text = handle.read(4096)
        except OSError:
            return 0
    try:
        for line in str(text or "").splitlines():
            if line.startswith("MemTotal:"):
                kb = int(line.split()[1])
                return kb // 1024
    except (IndexError, ValueError):
        return 0
    return 0


def cpu_count() -> int:
    """Logical CPU count, at least 1."""
    try:
        return os.cpu_count() or 1
    except Exception:
        return 1


def system_info(runner: Runner = default_runner) -> dict:
    """One snapshot for the installer summary. Optional parts never fail."""
    info = detect_os()
    info["python"] = check_python_version()
    info["git"] = check_git(runner)
    info["ollama"] = check_ollama(runner)
    info["nvidia"] = check_nvidia(runner)
    info["memory_mb"] = memory_mb()
    info["cpu_count"] = cpu_count()
    return info


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# validation (mirrors coordinator fail-closed rules, no imports needed)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def validate_coordinator_url(url: str) -> dict:
    """Validate the coordinator URL. Loopback preferred; LAN allowed.

    Refused (fail-closed): empty, > 2000 chars, non-http(s) scheme,
    missing host, credentials embedded in the URL.
    """
    raw = str(url or "").strip()
    if not raw:
        return {"ok": False, "url": "", "scope": "", "error": "coordinator URL is required"}
    if len(raw) > 2000:
        return {"ok": False, "url": "", "scope": "", "error": "URL too long; refusing"}
    try:
        parsed = urlsplit(raw)
    except ValueError as error:
        return {"ok": False, "url": "", "scope": "", "error": f"URL unparsable: {error}"}
    if parsed.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https"):
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "url": "",
            "scope": "",
            "error": "https/http URLs only; refusing",
        }
    host = (parsed.hostname or "").lower().rstrip(".")
    if not host:
        return {"ok": False, "url": "", "scope": "", "error": "URL has no host; refusing"}
    if parsed.username or parsed.password or "@" in parsed.netloc.split("]")[-1]:
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "url": "",
            "scope": "",
            "error": "credentials in URLs are refused",
        }
    if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "url": "",
            "scope": "",
            "error": "base URL must not carry query or fragment",
        }
    if (
        host == "localhost"
        or host == "::1"
        or host == "127.0.0.1"
        or (host.startswith("127.") and host != "127.")
    ):
        scope = "loopback"
    else:
        scope = "lan"
    return {"ok": True, "url": raw.rstrip("/"), "scope": scope, "error": ""}


def validate_node_id(node_id: str) -> dict:
    """Mirror coordinator check_node_id: 1..80 chars of [a-zA-Z0-9._-]."""
    text = str(node_id or "").strip()
    if not text or len(text) > 80 or not NODE_ID_PATTERN.match(text):
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "error": "node_id must be 1..80 chars of [a-zA-Z0-9._-]",
        }
    return {"ok": True, "node_id": text, "error": ""}


def validate_poll_seconds(value: object) -> dict:
    """Poll interval must stay within 1..300 seconds."""
    try:
        seconds = float(str(value or "").strip() or DEFAULT_POLL_SECONDS)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "poll-seconds must be a number"}
    if not 1.0 <= seconds <= 300.0:
        return {"ok": False, "error": "poll-seconds must be 1..300"}
    return {"ok": True, "poll_seconds": seconds, "error": ""}


def check_capabilities(caps: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    """Fail-closed starter-set check. Coordinator contract wins."""
    try:
        from coordinator.app.linux_node import (
            check_capabilities as coordinator_check,
        )

        return coordinator_check(list(caps or []))
    except ImportError:
        pass
    if not isinstance(caps, list) or not caps:
        raise ValueError("capabilities must be a non-empty list")
    cleaned: list[str] = []
    for cap in caps:
        text = str(cap or "").strip()[:80]
        if not text:
            raise ValueError("empty capability")
        if text in ("*", "all", "shell", "shell.exec", "exec",
                    "command.run", "remote.shell") or "*" in text:
            raise ValueError(f"capability '{text}' is never granted")
        if text not in FALLBACK_LINUX_CAPABILITIES:
            raise ValueError(
                f"capability '{text}' is not in the Linux starter set"
            )
        if text not in cleaned:
            cleaned.append(text)
    return cleaned


def detect_capabilities(ollama_available: bool = False) -> list[str]:
    """Honest capability set: only what node_client can execute.

    Always: node.status, research.fetch, inventory.read (real executors
    in node_client/main.py). Ollama-backed research.search and
    analysis.ollama only when `ollama list` works. Never shell-like.
    """
    caps = list(ALWAYS_CAPABILITIES)
    if ollama_available:
        caps.extend(OLLAMA_CAPABILITIES)
    return check_capabilities(caps)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# local config (env file, chmod 600, identity preserving)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def default_config_path() -> str:
    """~/.config/mycelium/node.env (overridable via --config)."""
    base = os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "") or os.path.join(
        os.path.expanduser("~"), ".config"
    )
    return os.path.join(base, "mycelium", "node.env")


def load_env_file(path: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Read a KEY=VALUE env file. Missing file -> {}. Never raises."""
    values: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            content = handle.read()
    except OSError:
        return values
    for line in content.splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if not line or line.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if line.startswith("export "):
            line = line[len("export "):].strip()
        if "=" not in line:
            continue
        key, _, value = line.partition("=")
        key = key.strip()
        value = value.strip().strip('"').strip("'")
        if key and key in CONFIG_KEYS:
            values[key] = value
    return values


def write_env_file(path: str, values: dict[str, str]) -> bool:
    """Write KEY=VALUE env file with mode 600. Returns True if changed."""
    lines = [INSTALLER_MARKER]
    for key in CONFIG_KEYS:
        if key in values and str(values[key] or "") != "":
            value = str(values[key])
            if any(char in value for char in " \t\"'#"):
                value = '"' + value.replace('"', '\\"') + '"'
            lines.append(f"{key}={value}")
    content = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    existing = ""
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            existing = handle.read()
    except OSError:
        existing = ""
    if existing == content:
        _ensure_mode_600(path)
        return False
    parent = os.path.dirname(path)
    if parent:
        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(content)
    _ensure_mode_600(path)
    return True


def _ensure_mode_600(path: str) -> None:
    try:
        os.chmod(path, stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IWUSR)
    except OSError:
        pass


def ensure_token(existing: str | None = None) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    """Keep a strong existing token; generate otherwise.

    Returns (token, generated). Generation matches
    coordinator.app.nodes.generate_token (64 hex chars).
    """
    text = str(existing or "").strip()
    if len(text) >= MIN_TOKEN_CHARS:
        return text, False
    return secrets.token_hex(32), True


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# install orchestration (idempotent)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def install_node(
    *,
    config_path: str | None = None,
    coordinator: str = DEFAULT_COORDINATOR_URL,
    node_id: str = DEFAULT_NODE_ID,
    tier: str = DEFAULT_TIER,
    capabilities: list[str] | None = None,
    poll_seconds: float = DEFAULT_POLL_SECONDS,
    token: str | None = None,
    runner: Runner = default_runner,
) -> dict:
    """Idempotent local install. Never touches the network.

    - validates coordinator URL / node id / tier / caps / poll interval
    - keeps an existing node id + token (identity is never rotated here)
    - generates a token only when none (or a weak one) exists
    - writes the env file (chmod 600) only when content changed
    - optional Ollama/NVIDIA absence is informational, never fatal
    """
    path = config_path or default_config_path()
    url_check = validate_coordinator_url(coordinator)
    if not url_check["ok"]:
        return {"ok": False, "error": url_check["error"], "changed": False}
    id_check = validate_node_id(node_id)
    if not id_check["ok"]:
        return {"ok": False, "error": id_check["error"], "changed": False}
    if tier not in VALID_TIERS:
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "error": f"tier must be one of {list(VALID_TIERS)}",
            "changed": False,
        }
    poll_check = validate_poll_seconds(poll_seconds)
    if not poll_check["ok"]:
        return {"ok": False, "error": poll_check["error"], "changed": False}
    try:
        if capabilities:
            caps = check_capabilities(list(capabilities))
        else:
            ollama = check_ollama(runner)
            caps = detect_capabilities(
                ollama_available=ollama["status"] == "AVAILABLE"
            )
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(error), "changed": False}

    existing = load_env_file(path)
    # Identity preservation: an existing node id / token always wins
    # over installer flags (flags only fill gaps).
    final_id = existing.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_ID", "").strip() or id_check["node_id"]
    id_recheck = validate_node_id(final_id)
    if not id_recheck["ok"]:
        return {"ok": False, "error": id_recheck["error"], "changed": False}
    candidate_token = (
        token.strip()
        if isinstance(token, str) and token.strip()
        else os.environ.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN", "").strip()
        or existing.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN", "")
    )
    final_token, generated = ensure_token(candidate_token)

    values = {
        "MYCELIUM_COORDINATOR_URL": url_check["url"],
        "MYCELIUM_NODE_ID": final_id,
        "MYCELIUM_NODE_TIER": tier,
        "MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN": final_token,
        "MYCELIUM_NODE_CAPABILITIES": ",".join(caps),
        "MYCELIUM_NODE_POLL_SECONDS": str(poll_check["poll_seconds"]),
    }
    # Keep an existing tier/poll choice when flags carry defaults? No:
    # explicit installer flags are the operator's voice, except identity.
    changed = write_env_file(path, values)
    probes = {
        "ollama": check_ollama(runner),
        "nvidia": check_nvidia(runner),
    }
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "changed": changed,
        "config_path": path,
        "coordinator_url": url_check["url"],
        "coordinator_scope": url_check["scope"],
        "node_id": final_id,
        "tier": tier,
        "capabilities": caps,
        "poll_seconds": poll_check["poll_seconds"],
        "token_generated": generated,
        "identity_preserved": bool(existing.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN", "")),
        "probes": probes,
        "error": "",
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# systemd user service (least privilege, no root)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_systemd_unit(
    *,
    repo_dir: str,
    coordinator: str,
    node_id: str,
    tier: str = DEFAULT_TIER,
    capabilities: list[str] | None = None,
    poll_seconds: float = DEFAULT_POLL_SECONDS,
    env_file: str | None = None,
) -> str:
    """Render a systemd --user unit. Secrets come from EnvironmentFile."""
    caps = check_capabilities(list(capabilities or ["node.status"]))
    cap_flags = " ".join(f"--capability {cap}" for cap in caps)
    env = env_file or os.path.join(
        os.path.expanduser("~"), ".config", "mycelium", "node.env"
    )
    return f"""{INSTALLER_MARKER}
[Unit]
Description=Mycelium node {node_id} (pull-only, user service)
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory={repo_dir}
EnvironmentFile={env}
ExecStart={repo_dir}/.venv/bin/python -m node_client.main --coordinator {coordinator} --node-id {node_id} --tier {tier} {cap_flags} --poll-seconds {poll_seconds}
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=15
NoNewPrivileges=true
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
"""


def default_systemd_path() -> str:
    """~/.config/systemd/user/mycelium-node.service."""
    base = os.environ.get("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", "") or os.path.join(
        os.path.expanduser("~"), ".config"
    )
    return os.path.join(base, "systemd", "user", SERVICE_NAME)


def install_systemd_unit(
    unit_text: str, path: str | None = None
) -> dict:
    """Write the user unit file. Returns {ok, changed, path}."""
    target = path or default_systemd_path()
    parent = os.path.dirname(target)
    if parent:
        os.makedirs(parent, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        with open(target, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            existing = handle.read()
    except OSError:
        existing = ""
    if existing == unit_text:
        return {"ok": True, "changed": False, "path": target}
    with open(target, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(unit_text)
    return {"ok": True, "changed": True, "path": target}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# outbound-only coordinator calls (stdlib urllib, redirects never followed)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

class _NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
    """Refuse redirects: the loopback bridge never follows them."""

    def redirect_request(self, req, fp, code, msg, headers, newurl):  # type: ignore[override]
        raise urllib.error.HTTPError(
            newurl, code, "redirects are never followed; refusing",
            headers, fp,
        )


def _opener(timeout: float) -> urllib.request.OpenerDirector:
    return urllib.request.build_opener(_NoRedirect())


def http_post_json(
    url: str, payload: dict, timeout: float = 5.0
) -> tuple[int, dict | None, str]:
    """POST JSON, bounded. Returns (status, body-or-None, error)."""
    data = json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=data,
        headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with _opener(timeout).open(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            status = int(getattr(response, "status", 200) or 200)
            raw = response.read(65536).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return int(error.code or 0), None, f"HTTP {error.code}"
    except Exception as error:
        return 0, None, f"unreachable: {error}"
    try:
        body = json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else None
    except ValueError:
        body = None
    return status, body, ""


def http_get_json(
    url: str, timeout: float = 5.0
) -> tuple[int, dict | list | None, str]:
    """GET JSON, bounded. Returns (status, body-or-None, error)."""
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET")
    try:
        with _opener(timeout).open(request, timeout=timeout) as response:
            status = int(getattr(response, "status", 200) or 200)
            raw = response.read(65536).decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        return int(error.code or 0), None, f"HTTP {error.code}"
    except Exception as error:
        return 0, None, f"unreachable: {error}"
    try:
        body = json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else None
    except ValueError:
        body = None
    return status, body, ""


HttpPost = Callable[[str, dict, float], tuple[int, dict | None, str]]
HttpGet = Callable[[str, float], tuple[int, dict | list | None, str]]


def bootstrap_register(
    *,
    coordinator_url: str,
    node_id: str,
    tier: str = DEFAULT_TIER,
    capabilities: list[str] | None = None,
    token: str = "",
    poll_seconds: float = DEFAULT_POLL_SECONDS,
    post: HttpPost = http_post_json,
    get: HttpGet = http_get_json,
) -> dict:
    """One-time explicit bootstrap: register + heartbeat + verify.

    Uses ONLY the existing coordinator endpoints. The node loop itself
    repeats the same calls on every start; this is just the visible
    first run. Never called implicitly by install().
    """
    url_check = validate_coordinator_url(coordinator_url)
    if not url_check["ok"]:
        return {"ok": False, "error": url_check["error"]}
    id_check = validate_node_id(node_id)
    if not id_check["ok"]:
        return {"ok": False, "error": id_check["error"]}
    if len(str(token or "").strip()) < MIN_TOKEN_CHARS:
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "error": f"node token must be at least {MIN_TOKEN_CHARS} characters",
        }
    try:
        caps = check_capabilities(list(capabilities or ["node.status"]))
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(error)}
    base = url_check["url"].rstrip("/") + "/api/v1"
    secret = str(token).strip()
    registration = {
        "node_id": id_check["node_id"],
        "hostname": platform.node() or id_check["node_id"],
        "tier": tier if tier in VALID_TIERS else DEFAULT_TIER,
        "capabilities": caps,
        "cpu_cores": cpu_count(),
        "memory_mb": memory_mb(),
        "energy_source": "unknown",
        "node_token": secret,
    }
    status, _, error = post(f"{base}/nodes/register", registration, 5.0)
    if status not in (200, 201):
        hint = "new identities bind on first register; existing ones need the same token"
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "error": f"registration refused ({error or status}); {hint}",
        }
    beat_status, _, beat_error = post(
        f"{base}/nodes/{id_check['node_id']}/heartbeat",
        {"available": True, "node_token": secret},
        5.0,
    )
    if beat_status not in (200, 204):
        return {
            "ok": False,
            "error": f"registered but heartbeat refused ({beat_error or beat_status})",
        }
    node_status, node_body, _ = get(
        f"{base}/nodes/{id_check['node_id']}", 5.0
    )
    visible = node_status == 200
    return {
        "ok": True,
        "error": "",
        "node_id": id_check["node_id"],
        "coordinator_url": url_check["url"],
        "capabilities": caps,
        "visible_in_api": visible,
        "node": node_body if isinstance(node_body, dict) else {},
        "poll_seconds": poll_seconds,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# doctor (local diagnostics, secrets never shown)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def doctor(
    *,
    config_path: str | None = None,
    runner: Runner = default_runner,
    get: HttpGet = http_get_json,
) -> dict:
    """Local diagnostics for old laptops. Returns rows + overall ok."""
    path = config_path or default_config_path()
    rows: list[dict] = []
    detected = detect_os()
    rows.append({
        "name": "OS",
        "status": "OK" if detected["is_linux"] else "FAIL",
        "detail": (
            f"{detected['distro'] or detected['system']} "
            f"({detected['machine']})".strip()
        ),
    })
    rows.append(check_python_version())
    rows.append(check_git(runner))

    config = load_env_file(path)
    rows.append({
        "name": "Config",
        "status": "OK" if config else "FAIL",
        "detail": path if config else f"missing: {path} (run install first)",
    })
    stored_token = str(config.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN", "") or "")
    env_token = str(os.environ.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN", "") or "").strip()
    effective = stored_token.strip() or env_token
    if len(effective) >= MIN_TOKEN_CHARS:
        rows.append({
            "name": "Identity",
            "status": "OK",
            "detail": f"token present ({len(effective)} chars, value hidden)",
        })
    elif effective:
        rows.append({
            "name": "Identity",
            "status": "FAIL",
            "detail": f"token too short (needs >= {MIN_TOKEN_CHARS} chars)",
        })
    else:
        rows.append({
            "name": "Identity",
            "status": "FAIL",
            "detail": "no token (run install first)",
        })

    coordinator = str(config.get("MYCELIUM_COORDINATOR_URL", "") or "").strip()
    node_id = str(config.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_ID", "") or "").strip()
    url_check = validate_coordinator_url(coordinator) if coordinator else {"ok": False}
    if not coordinator or not url_check.get("ok"):
        rows.append({
            "name": "Coordinator",
            "status": "FAIL",
            "detail": "no valid coordinator URL in config",
        })
        rows.append({
            "name": "Registration",
            "status": "FAIL",
            "detail": "skipped (no coordinator URL)",
        })
        rows.append({
            "name": "Heartbeat",
            "status": "FAIL",
            "detail": "skipped (no coordinator URL)",
        })
    else:
        base = url_check["url"].rstrip("/") + "/api/v1"
        health_status, _, health_error = get(f"{base}/health", 5.0)
        if health_status == 200:
            rows.append({
                "name": "Coordinator",
                "status": "OK",
                "detail": f"reachable at {url_check['url']} "
                f"({url_check.get('scope', '')})",
            })
        else:
            rows.append({
                "name": "Coordinator",
                "status": "FAIL",
                "detail": f"unreachable ({health_error or health_status}); "
                "start the coordinator first",
            })
        if node_id and health_status == 200:
            node_status, _, node_error = get(f"{base}/nodes/{node_id}", 5.0)
            if node_status == 200:
                rows.append({
                    "name": "Registration",
                    "status": "OK",
                    "detail": f"{node_id} visible in Nodes API",
                })
                rows.append({
                    "name": "Heartbeat",
                    "status": "OK",
                    "detail": "node record exists; the running loop "
                    "refreshes it every poll interval",
                })
            elif node_status == 404:
                rows.append({
                    "name": "Registration",
                    "status": "FAIL",
                    "detail": f"{node_id} not registered yet "
                    "(run install --bootstrap once)",
                })
                rows.append({
                    "name": "Heartbeat",
                    "status": "FAIL",
                    "detail": "no heartbeat without registration",
                })
            else:
                rows.append({
                    "name": "Registration",
                    "status": "FAIL",
                    "detail": f"lookup failed ({node_error or node_status})",
                })
                rows.append({
                    "name": "Heartbeat",
                    "status": "FAIL",
                    "detail": "unknown (registration lookup failed)",
                })
        else:
            rows.append({
                "name": "Registration",
                "status": "FAIL",
                "detail": "skipped (coordinator unreachable or no node id)",
            })
            rows.append({
                "name": "Heartbeat",
                "status": "FAIL",
                "detail": "skipped (coordinator unreachable or no node id)",
            })

    ollama = check_ollama(runner)
    rows.append({
        "name": "Ollama",
        "status": ollama["status"],
        "detail": ollama["detail"],
    })
    nvidia = check_nvidia(runner)
    rows.append({
        "name": "NVIDIA",
        "status": nvidia["status"],
        "detail": nvidia["detail"],
    })
    try:
        raw_caps = [
            part.strip()
            for part in str(config.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_CAPABILITIES", "") or "").split(",")
            if part.strip()
        ]
        caps = check_capabilities(raw_caps) if raw_caps else []
        rows.append({
            "name": "Capabilities",
            "status": "OK" if caps else "FAIL",
            "detail": ", ".join(caps) if caps else "none configured",
        })
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
        rows.append({
            "name": "Capabilities",
            "status": "FAIL",
            "detail": str(error)[:120],
        })
    overall = all(
        row["status"] in ("OK", "AVAILABLE", "OPTIONAL") for row in rows
    )
    return {"ok": overall, "rows": rows, "config_path": path}


def uninstall_node(
    *,
    config_path: str | None = None,
    systemd_path: str | None = None,
    remove_config: bool = False,
    remove_venv: bool = False,
    repo_dir: str = "",
) -> dict:
    """Safe local uninstall. Server-side identity/audit is NEVER touched.

    Default removes only the user systemd unit. Config and venv removal
    are explicit opt-ins. Nothing here calls the coordinator.
    """
    path = config_path or default_config_path()
    unit = systemd_path or default_systemd_path()
    removed: list[str] = []
    kept: list[str] = []
    try:
        with open(unit, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            unit_text = handle.read()
    except OSError:
        unit_text = ""
    if unit_text:
        if INSTALLER_MARKER in unit_text or "mycelium" in unit_text.lower():
            try:
                os.remove(unit)
                removed.append(unit)
            except OSError as error:
                return {"ok": False, "removed": removed, "kept": kept,
                        "error": f"cannot remove service file: {error}"}
        else:
            kept.append(f"{unit} (foreign file, kept)")
    if remove_config:
        try:
            os.remove(path)
            removed.append(path)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            pass
        except OSError as error:
            return {"ok": False, "removed": removed, "kept": kept,
                    "error": f"cannot remove config: {error}"}
    else:
        kept.append(f"{path} (identity kept)")
    if remove_venv and repo_dir:
        venv_dir = os.path.join(repo_dir, ".venv")
        if os.path.isdir(venv_dir):
            import shutil

            try:
                shutil.rmtree(venv_dir)
                removed.append(venv_dir)
            except OSError as error:
                return {"ok": False, "removed": removed, "kept": kept,
                        "error": f"cannot remove venv: {error}"}
    kept.append("server-side node identity/audit (always kept)")
    return {"ok": True, "removed": removed, "kept": kept, "error": ""}

# CLI
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _add_common(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
    parser.add_argument("--coordinator", default=DEFAULT_COORDINATOR_URL)
    parser.add_argument("--node-id", default=DEFAULT_NODE_ID)
    parser.add_argument("--tier", default=DEFAULT_TIER,
                        choices=list(VALID_TIERS))
    parser.add_argument("--capability", action="append", default=[],
                        help="repeatable; Linux starter set only")
    parser.add_argument("--poll-seconds", type=float,
                        default=DEFAULT_POLL_SECONDS)
    parser.add_argument("--config", default="",
                        help="env file path (default ~/.config/mycelium/node.env)")
    parser.add_argument("--repo-dir", default="",
                        help="checkout dir (default: current directory)")


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="mycelium-node",
        description="Mycelium Linux node installer (pull-only, no root needed)",
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)
    install = sub.add_parser("install", help="idempotent local install")
    _add_common(install)
    install.add_argument("--token", default="",
                         help="node token (or MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN env)")
    install.add_argument("--with-systemd", action="store_true",
                         help="also install the systemd --user unit")
    install.add_argument("--bootstrap", action="store_true",
                         help="also register + heartbeat once (needs coordinator up)")
    doctor_p = sub.add_parser("doctor", help="local diagnostics")
    doctor_p.add_argument("--config", default="")
    sysd = sub.add_parser("print-systemd", help="print the user unit")
    _add_common(sysd)
    uninstall = sub.add_parser("uninstall", help="safe local removal")
    uninstall.add_argument("--config", default="")
    uninstall.add_argument("--remove-config", action="store_true")
    uninstall.add_argument("--remove-venv", action="store_true")
    uninstall.add_argument("--repo-dir", default="")
    return parser


def _print_rows(rows: list[dict], known: tuple[str, ...] = ()) -> None:
    width = max(len(row["name"]) for row in rows) if rows else 10
    for row in rows:
        print(f"{row['name']:<{width}}  {row['status']:<9}  "
              f"{redact_secrets(row['detail'], known)}")


def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:
    parser = build_parser()
    config = parser.parse_args(argv)
    cfg_path = getattr(config, "config", "") or None

    if config.command == "doctor":
        report = doctor(config_path=cfg_path)
        print("Mycelium Node Doctor\n")
        _print_rows(report["rows"])
        print(f"\nconfig: {report['config_path']}")
        return 0 if report["ok"] else 1

    if config.command == "print-systemd":
        try:
            unit = build_systemd_unit(
                repo_dir=config.repo_dir or os.getcwd(),
                coordinator=validate_coordinator_url(
                    config.coordinator)["url"],
                node_id=validate_node_id(config.node_id).get("node_id", "linux-laptop-1"),
                tier=config.tier,
                capabilities=config.capability or None,
                poll_seconds=validate_poll_seconds(
                    config.poll_seconds).get("poll_seconds",
                                             DEFAULT_POLL_SECONDS),
            )
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as error:
            print(f"refused: {error}")
            return 2
        print(unit)
        print("# install as ~/.config/systemd/user/mycelium-node.service, then:")
        print("#   systemctl --user daemon-reload && "
              "systemctl --user enable --now mycelium-node")
        return 0

    if config.command == "uninstall":
        report = uninstall_node(
            config_path=cfg_path,
            remove_config=config.remove_config,
            remove_venv=config.remove_venv,
            repo_dir=config.repo_dir or "",
        )
        for item in report["removed"]:
            print(f"removed: {item}")
        for item in report["kept"]:
            print(f"kept: {item}")
        if not report["ok"]:
            print(f"error: {redact_secrets(report['error'])}")
            return 1
        print("hint: systemctl --user disable --now mycelium-node "
              "(if the service was enabled)")
        return 0

    if config.command == "install":
        repo_dir = config.repo_dir or os.getcwd()
        result = install_node(
            config_path=cfg_path,
            coordinator=config.coordinator,
            node_id=config.node_id,
            tier=config.tier,
            capabilities=config.capability or None,
            poll_seconds=config.poll_seconds,
            token=config.token or None,
        )
        if not result["ok"]:
            print(f"install refused: {result['error']}")
            return 2
        token_value = load_env_file(result["config_path"]).get(
            "MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN", "")
        known = (token_value,) if token_value else ()
        print(f"coordinator : {result['coordinator_url']} "
              f"({result['coordinator_scope']})")
        print(f"node        : {result['node_id']} ({result['tier']})")
        print(f"capabilities: {', '.join(result['capabilities'])}")
        print(f"config      : {result['config_path']} "
              f"({'updated' if result['changed'] else 'unchanged'})")
        if result["token_generated"]:
            print("identity    : new token generated (stored chmod 600, "
                  "shown nowhere)")
        elif result["identity_preserved"]:
            print("identity    : existing token preserved")
        else:
            print("identity    : token stored from env/flag")
        for probe in ("ollama", "nvidia"):
            item = result["probes"][probe]
            print(f"{item['name'].lower():<12}: {item['status']} - "
                  f"{redact_secrets(item['detail'], known)}")
        if config.with_systemd:
            unit = build_systemd_unit(
                repo_dir=repo_dir,
                coordinator=result["coordinator_url"],
                node_id=result["node_id"],
                tier=result["tier"],
                capabilities=result["capabilities"],
                poll_seconds=result["poll_seconds"],
            )
            sysd_result = install_systemd_unit(unit)
            print(f"systemd     : {sysd_result['path']} "
                  f"({'written' if sysd_result['changed'] else 'unchanged'})")
            print("systemd     : run 'systemctl --user daemon-reload && "
                  "systemctl --user enable --now mycelium-node'")
        if config.bootstrap:
            stored = load_env_file(result["config_path"])
            boot = bootstrap_register(
                coordinator_url=result["coordinator_url"],
                node_id=result["node_id"],
                tier=result["tier"],
                capabilities=result["capabilities"],
                token=stored.get("MYCELIUM_NODE_TOKEN", ""),
                poll_seconds=result["poll_seconds"],
            )
            if not boot["ok"]:
                print(f"bootstrap   : refused: "
                      f"{redact_secrets(boot['error'], known)}")
                return 1
            print(f"bootstrap   : registered, heartbeat ok, "
                  f"API visible: {boot['visible_in_api']}")
        print("\nstart the node:")
        cap_flags = " ".join(
            f"--capability {cap}" for cap in result["capabilities"]
        )
        print(f"  source {result['config_path']} 2>/dev/null; "
              f"python -m node_client.main --coordinator "
              f"{result['coordinator_url']} --node-id {result['node_id']} "
              f"--tier {result['tier']} {cap_flags} --poll-seconds "
              f"{result['poll_seconds']}")
        print("check health: python -m node_client.install doctor")
        return 0

    parser.print_help()
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
