"""Take BIG #39 hardware-reality screenshots with Playwright.

Seeds tmp DBs via b39_shots.py, serves them on 127.0.0.1:8899
in a background thread, captures 6 PNGs into docs/r39-shots/.
No taskkill, no real DBs touched.
"""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

TMP = r"C:\Users\Jelles\AppData\Local\Temp\b39_shots"
PORT = 8899

os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(TMP, "shots.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(
    TMP, "shots-chat.db")

import uvicorn  # noqa: E402
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod  # noqa: E402


def run_server():
    uvicorn.run(main_mod.app, host="127.0.0.1", port=PORT,
                log_level="warning")


server_thread = threading.Thread(target=run_server, daemon=True)
server_thread.start()
time.sleep(3)

result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "scripts/b39_shots.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=".",
    env={**os.environ, "B39_SHOT_TMP": TMP})
print(result.stdout[-2000:])
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("Seed script failed:", result.stderr[-2000:])
    sys.exit(1)

print("Seed done, taking screenshots...")

SHOTS_DIR = Path("docs/r39-shots")
SHOTS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

import asyncio  # noqa: E402


async def take_screenshots():
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(channel="msedge",
                                            headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page(
            viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}"

        await page.goto(f"{base}/nodes", wait_until="networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
        await page.screenshot(
            path=str(SHOTS_DIR / "nodes-1440.png"),
            full_page=True)
        print("ok nodes-1440.png")

        await page.goto(
            f"{base}/nodes?check_cap=camera.snapshot",
            wait_until="networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        await page.screenshot(
            path=str(SHOTS_DIR / "routing-1440.png"),
            full_page=True)
        print("ok routing-1440.png")

        await page.goto(
            f"{base}/world?show=missions,nodes,hardware,compute",
            wait_until="networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        await page.screenshot(
            path=str(SHOTS_DIR / "world-1440.png"),
            full_page=True)
        print("ok world-1440.png")

        await page.goto(f"{base}/mobile", wait_until="networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        await page.screenshot(
            path=str(SHOTS_DIR / "mobile-1440.png"),
            full_page=True)
        print("ok mobile-1440.png")

        try:
            panel = await page.query_selector("#nodes")
            if panel is not None:
                await panel.scroll_into_view_if_needed()
                await page.wait_for_timeout(400)
                await panel.screenshot(
                    path=str(SHOTS_DIR / "hardware-1440.png"))
                print("ok hardware-1440.png")
            else:
                print("nodes panel missing, skipping hardware shot")
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"hardware shot failed: {error}")

        await page.goto(f"{base}/guide", wait_until="networkidle")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(800)
        await page.screenshot(
            path=str(SHOTS_DIR / "guide-1440.png"),
            full_page=True)
        print("ok guide-1440.png")

        await browser.close()


asyncio.run(take_screenshots())
print("All screenshots saved to docs/r39-shots/")

"""BIG #39 live smoke: hardware reality layer on tmp DBs.

Proves with real localhost HTTP (TestClient, no mocks):
register → heartbeat with telemetry/hardware/compute/energy →
node shows ONLINE with telemetry → telemetry-aware routing
matches/misses honestly → mobile nodes panel → hardware-aware
guide → notifications capability lists node types → pages
render → refusals stay fail-closed (unknown fields, bad
credentials, wildcards).
"""

import os
import sys

tmp = os.environ.get("B39_SMOKE_TMP", "")
assert tmp, "B39_SMOKE_TMP required"
os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(tmp, "smoke.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(
    tmp, "smoke-chat.db")

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN = "b39-smoke-token-123456"

TELEMETRY = {
    "hostname": "smoke-node",
    "os": "Linux",
    "platform": "Linux-5.15.0",
    "cpu_percent": 35.0,
    "cpu_count": 8,
    "memory_percent": 55.0,
    "memory_total_mb": 16384,
    "memory_available_mb": 7372,
    "disk_percent": 40.0,
    "disk_total_gb": 500.0,
    "disk_free_gb": 300.0,
    "uptime_seconds": 7200,
    "temperature_celsius": 44.0,
    "load_average": [1.1, 1.3, 1.6],
    "network_interfaces": ["eth0", "wlan0"],
    "boot_time": 1700000000,
}

HARDWARE = [
    {"kind": "camera", "identifier": "/dev/video0",
     "details": {"subsystem": "v4l2"}, "status": "connected",
     "connected_since": 1700000000},
    {"kind": "gpu", "identifier": "NVIDIA RTX 3080",
     "details": {"vendor": "nvidia"}, "status": "connected"},
]

COMPUTE = [
    {"capability": "ollama",
     "details": {"models": ["llama3"]},
     "status": "available", "since": 1700000000},
    {"capability": "gpu_available",
     "details": {"vendor": "nvidia"}, "status": "available"},
    {"capability": "cpu_inference", "details": {},
     "status": "available"},
]

ENERGY = {"source": "grid", "level_percent": 100,
          "charging": True, "details": {}}


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    line = f"{'OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    if not ok:
        sys.exit(1)


with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
    reg = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": "smoke-node", "hostname": "smoke-node",
        "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": ["research.fetch", "analysis.ollama"],
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    check("node registered", reg.status_code == 201,
          str(reg.status_code))

    beat = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/smoke-node/heartbeat",
                       json={"available": True,
                             "node_token": TOKEN,
                             "telemetry": TELEMETRY,
                             "hardware": HARDWARE,
                             "compute_capabilities": COMPUTE,
                             "energy_state": ENERGY})
    check("heartbeat with telemetry accepted",
          beat.status_code == 204, str(beat.status_code))

    node = client.get("/api/v1/nodes/smoke-node").json()
    check("node health ONLINE",
          node.get("health_status") == "ONLINE",
          node.get("health_status", "?"))
    check("telemetry stored",
          node.get("telemetry", {}).get("cpu_percent") == 35.0)
    check("telemetry timestamped",
          bool(node.get("telemetry_timestamp")))
    check("hardware stored",
          len(node.get("hardware", [])) == 2)
    check("compute stored",
          len(node.get("compute_capabilities", [])) == 3)
    check("energy stored",
          node.get("energy_state", {}).get("source") == "grid")

    matched = client.post("/api/v1/tasks/route", json={
        "requirements": {
            "required_capabilities": ["research.fetch"],
            "required_hardware": ["camera"],
            "required_compute": ["ollama"],
            "min_health": "ONLINE"},
        "policy": {}}).json()
    check("telemetry-aware routing matches",
          matched.get("selected_node_id") == "smoke-node")

    missed = client.post("/api/v1/tasks/route", json={
        "requirements": {
            "required_capabilities": ["research.fetch"],
            "required_hardware": ["printer_3d"]},
        "policy": {}}).json()
    check("routing misses honestly",
          missed.get("selected_node_id") is None)

    mobile = client.get("/api/v1/mobile/dashboard").json()
    panel = mobile.get("nodes", {}).get("nodes", [])
    entry = next((item for item in panel
                  if item.get("node_id") == "smoke-node"), {})
    check("mobile nodes panel carries telemetry",
          entry.get("health") == "ONLINE"
          and entry.get("telemetry", {}).get(
              "cpu_percent") == 35.0)
    check("mobile nodes panel carries hardware",
          "camera" in entry.get("hardware", {}).get("kinds", []))
    check("mobile nodes panel carries compute",
          "ollama" in entry.get("compute", {}).get(
              "capabilities", []))

    guide = client.get("/api/v1/guide").json()
    guide_text = " | ".join(
        item.get("what", "") for item in guide.get("items", []))
    check("guide is hardware-aware",
          "Ollama" in guide_text and "GPU" in guide_text)

    cap = client.get("/api/v1/notifications/capability").json()
    check("notification types list node kinds",
          "node_degraded" in cap.get("types", [])
          and "hardware_connected" in cap.get("types", []))
    check("web push stays UNAVAILABLE",
          cap.get("transports", {}).get("WEB_PUSH", {}).get(
              "state") == "UNAVAILABLE")

    for path in ("/nodes", "/mobile", "/guide", "/world"):
        page = client.get(path)
        check(f"page {path} renders",
              page.status_code == 200
              and "Mycelium" in page.text,
              str(page.status_code))

    bad_field = dict(TELEMETRY)
    bad_field["evil_metric"] = 1
    refused = client.post(
        "/api/v1/nodes/smoke-node/heartbeat",
        json={"available": True, "node_token": TOKEN,
              "telemetry": bad_field})
    check("unknown telemetry field refused",
          refused.status_code == 422, str(refused.status_code))

    refused_hw = client.post(
        "/api/v1/nodes/smoke-node/heartbeat",
        json={"available": True, "node_token": TOKEN,
              "hardware": [{"kind": "quantum",
                            "identifier": "q1"}]})
    check("unknown hardware kind refused",
          refused_hw.status_code == 422,
          str(refused_hw.status_code))

    bad_auth = client.post(
        "/api/v1/nodes/smoke-node/heartbeat",
        json={"available": True,
              "node_token": "wrong-token-123456",
              "telemetry": TELEMETRY})
    check("bad credential still refused",
          bad_auth.status_code == 403, str(bad_auth.status_code))

    wild = client.post(
        "/api/v1/nodes/smoke-node/heartbeat",
        json={"available": True, "node_token": TOKEN,
              "capabilities": ["*"]})
    check("wildcard capability still refused",
          wild.status_code == 422, str(wild.status_code))

    print("smoke done", flush=True)

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/scripts/b40_smoke.py">
"""BIG #40 live smoke: presence ecosystem on tmp DBs.

Proves with real localhost HTTP (TestClient, no mocks):
seed → node telemetry → mission waiting → desktop approval →
automation waiting → research finding (dossier path honest) →
candidate → task failure → hardware offline → node offline →
presence aggregation → mobile bands → guide afterwards →
notification fan-out + dedup → morning sections → world/pages
→ deep-link verification → triage → refusals.
"""

import os
import sys

tmp = os.environ.get("B40_SMOKE_TMP", "")
assert tmp, "B40_SMOKE_TMP required"
os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
# Fresh DBs every run: the smoke owns this tmp dir, so stale
# state from a previous run is removed first (reruns are then
# deterministic instead of UNIQUE-conflicting).
for name in ("smoke.db", "smoke-chat.db"):
    path = os.path.join(tmp, name)
    if os.path.exists(path):
        os.remove(path)
        print(f"cleared stale {name}", flush=True)
os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(tmp, "smoke.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(
    tmp, "smoke-chat.db")

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN = "b40-smoke-token-123456"


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    line = f"{'OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}"
    print(line, flush=True)
    if not ok:
        sys.exit(1)


def presence(client):
    return client.get("/api/v1/presence").json()


def by_id(snapshot, item_id):
    return next((item for item in snapshot["items"]
                 if item["id"] == item_id), None)


with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
    # Seed: capable node with telemetry + hardware + compute.
    reg = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": "smoke-node", "hostname": "smoke-node",
        "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": ["research.fetch", "analysis.ollama"],
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    check("node registered", reg.status_code == 201,
          str(reg.status_code))
    beat = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/smoke-node/heartbeat",
                       json={
                           "available": True, "node_token": TOKEN,
                           "telemetry": {
                               "hostname": "smoke-node",
                               "os": "Linux", "cpu_percent": 30.0,
                               "cpu_count": 8,
                               "memory_percent": 50.0,
                               "memory_total_mb": 16384,
                               "memory_available_mb": 8192,
                               "uptime_seconds": 3600},
                           "hardware": [{
                               "kind": "camera",
                               "identifier": "/dev/video0",
                               "details": {},
                               "status": "connected"},
                               {"kind": "usb",
                                "identifier": "1-1.9",
                                "details": {},
                                "status": "disconnected"}],
                           "compute_capabilities": [{
                               "capability": "ollama",
                               "details": {},
                               "status": "available"}],
                           "energy_state": {"source": "grid"}})
    check("telemetry heartbeat", beat.status_code == 204,
          str(beat.status_code))

    # Seed: offline node (stored offline, honestly derived).
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO nodes (node_id, hostname, tier, "
            "capabilities, cpu_cores, memory_mb, energy_source, "
            "last_seen, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, "
            "?, ?)",
            ("smoke-gone", "gone", "seed", "[]", 1, 0,
             "unknown", "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "offline"))

    snapshot = presence(client)
    check("presence aggregates",
          len(snapshot["items"]) >= 4,
          str(snapshot["counts"]))
    check("hardware available item",
          by_id(snapshot,
                "att_hw_available_smoke-node__dev_video0")
          is not None)
    check("hardware offline item",
          by_id(snapshot,
                "att_hw_offline_smoke-node_1-1.9") is not None)
    check("capability available item",
          by_id(snapshot,
                "att_cap_available_smoke-node_ollama")
          is not None)
    check("node offline item",
          by_id(snapshot, "att_node_offline_smoke-gone")
          is not None)

    # Mission waiting (pending approval = NEEDS YOU).
    chat = client.post("/api/v1/chat",
                       json={"message": "smoke quest"}).json()
    mission = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": chat["conversation_id"],
        "goal": "Smoke quest",
        "steps": [{"kind": "readout",
                   "description": "Read status",
                   "parameters": {"source": "project"}}]}).json()
    mission_id = mission["mission_id"]
    snapshot = presence(client)
    mission_item = by_id(
        snapshot, f"att_approval_mission_{mission_id}")
    check("mission waiting NEEDS YOU",
          mission_item is not None
          and mission_item["band"] == "needs")

    # Desktop approval.
    action = client.post("/api/v1/desktop/actions", json={
        "action_id": "dact-smoke-1", "action_type": "click",
        "parameters": {"x": 5, "y": 5}})
    check("desktop action proposed",
          action.status_code == 201, str(action.status_code))
    check("desktop approval NEEDS YOU",
          by_id(presence(client),
                "att_approval_desktop_dact-smoke-1") is not None)

    # Automation waiting for human.
    run = client.post("/api/v1/automation/runs", json={
        "goal": "Smoke chain",
        "steps": [
            {"kind": "mission_propose",
             "params": {"goal": "Smoke auto mission",
                        "conversation_id": chat[
                            "conversation_id"]}},
            {"kind": "wait",
             "params": {"reason": "plan YES first"}}]}).json()
    run_id = run["run_id"]
    driven = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/automation/runs/{run_id}/drive",
        json={"budget_steps": 10}).json()
    check("automation waiting for human",
          driven["state"] == "waiting_for_human",
          driven["state"])
    check("automation waiting item",
          by_id(presence(client),
                f"att_auto_waiting_{run_id}") is not None)

    # Candidate + task failure.
    candidate = client.post("/api/v1/candidates", json={
        "title": "Smoke candidate", "candidate_type": "note",
        "summary": "smoke review"})
    check("candidate created",
          candidate.status_code == 201,
          str(candidate.status_code))
    check("candidate DISCOVERED",
          by_id(presence(client),
                f"att_candidate_"
                f"{candidate.json()['candidate_id']}")
          is not None)
    from coordinator.app.events import new_event, save_event
    save_event(new_event("task.failed", "smoke boom",
                         task_id="99"))
    check("task failure NEEDS YOU",
          by_id(presence(client), "att_task_failed_99")
          is not None)

    # Node-aware research readiness names the capable node.
    readiness = presence(client)
    waiting = by_id(readiness, "att_research_waiting_nodes")
    check("research waits honestly or node serves",
          (waiting is None) or ("smoke" in waiting["reason"]
                                or "No eligible" in
                                waiting["reason"]))

    # Mobile bands + greeting.
    dash = client.get("/api/v1/mobile/dashboard").json()
    check("mobile greeting",
          dash.get("greeting") in ("GOOD MORNING", "NOW"))
    check("mobile bands complete",
          set(dash.get("presence", {}).get("bands", {})) == {
              "needs", "waiting", "available", "discovered",
              "offline"})

    # Guide explains afterwards.
    guide = client.get("/api/v1/guide").json()
    check("guide has items", len(guide.get("items", [])) > 0)
    check("guide explains afterwards",
          all(entry.get("after")
              for entry in guide["items"]))

    # Notification fan-out + dedup.
    first = client.post("/api/v1/presence/notify",
                        json={"limit": 5}).json()
    check("notify fan-out IN_APP",
          first["transport"] == "IN_APP"
          and first["web_push"] == "UNAVAILABLE"
          and len(first["sent"]) >= 1)
    for _ in range(4):
        drained = client.post("/api/v1/presence/notify",
                              json={"limit": 10}).json()
        if not drained["sent"]:
            break
    repeat = client.post("/api/v1/presence/notify",
                         json={"limit": 10}).json()
    check("notify deduplicates",
          repeat["sent"] == [] and repeat["skipped"] >= 1)

    # Morning answers why open Mycelium today.
    morning = client.get("/api/v1/reports/morning").json()
    titles = [block["title"] for block in morning["sections"]]
    for expected in ("Needs you", "Overnight changes",
                     "Discoveries", "Available resources",
                     "Blocked work",
                     "Offline and stale hardware",
                     "Suggested next actions"):
        check(f"morning has '{expected}'", expected in titles)

    # Pages render.
    for path in ("/presence", "/mobile", "/guide", "/nodes",
                 "/world", "/activity"):
        page = client.get(path)
        check(f"page {path} renders",
              page.status_code == 200
              and "Mycelium" in page.text,
              str(page.status_code))

    # Deep links resolve (no dead ends).
    hrefs = {item["open_href"]
             for item in presence(client)["items"]}
    check("deep links present", len(hrefs) > 0,
          str(len(hrefs)))
    for href in sorted(hrefs):
        response = client.get(href)
        check(f"deeplink {href} resolves",
              response.status_code == 200,
              str(response.status_code))

    # Triage: defer hides from needs, decides nothing.
    deferred = client.post("/api/v1/presence/defer",
                           json={"item_id":
                                 "att_approval_desktop_"
                                 "dact-smoke-1"})
    check("defer stored",
          deferred.status_code == 200
          and deferred.json()["status"] == "DEFERRED")
    snapshot = presence(client)
    check("deferred leaves needs band",
          all(entry["id"] != "att_approval_desktop_dact-smoke-1"
              for entry in snapshot["bands"]["needs"]))
    pending = client.get("/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
                         "dact-smoke-1").json()
    check("defer decided nothing",
          pending["status"] == "pending_approval")

    # Refusals stay fail-closed.
    fake = client.post("/api/v1/presence/defer",
                       json={"item_id": "att_approval_nope"})
    check("fake id refused", fake.status_code == 404,
          str(fake.status_code))
    wild = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": "smoke-liar", "hostname": "liar",
        "capabilities": ["*"], "node_token": TOKEN})
    check("wildcard still refused",
          wild.status_code in (403, 422),
          str(wild.status_code))

    print("smoke done", flush=True)

"""Take BIG #41 V2 screenshots with Playwright (Edge headless).

Seeds tmp DBs via b41_shots.py, serves them on 127.0.0.1:8899
in a background thread, captures 7 PNGs into docs/r41-shots/.
No real DBs touched.
"""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

TMP = r"C:\Users\Jelles\AppData\Local\Temp\b41_shots"
PORT = 8899

os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)
os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(TMP, "shots.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(
    TMP, "shots-chat.db")

import uvicorn  # noqa: E402
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod  # noqa: E402


def run_server():
    uvicorn.run(main_mod.app, host="127.0.0.1", port=PORT,
                log_level="warning")


server_thread = threading.Thread(target=run_server, daemon=True)
server_thread.start()
time.sleep(3)

result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "scripts/b41_shots.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=".",
    env={**os.environ, "B41_SHOT_TMP": TMP})
print(result.stdout[-2000:])
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("Seed script failed:", result.stderr[-2000:])
    sys.exit(1)

print("Seed done, taking screenshots...")

SHOTS_DIR = Path("docs/r41-shots")
SHOTS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

import asyncio  # noqa: E402


async def take_screenshots():
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(channel="msedge",
                                          headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page(
            viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}"

        async def full(name, path):
            await page.goto(f"{base}{path}",
                            wait_until="networkidle")
            await page.wait_for_timeout(900)
            await page.screenshot(
                path=str(SHOTS_DIR / name), full_page=True)
            print(f"ok {name}")

        await full("world-1440.png",
                   "/world?show=missions,nodes,hardware,compute")
        await full("guide-1440.png", "/guide")
        await full("nodes-1440.png", "/nodes")
        await full("mobile-1440.png", "/mobile")
        await full("craft-1440.png", "/craft")
        await full("symbiosis-1440.png", "/symbiosis")
        await full("presence-1440.png", "/presence")

        await browser.close()


asyncio.run(take_screenshots())
print("All screenshots saved to docs/r41-shots/")

"""BIG #41 live smoke: Mycelium V2 foundation on tmp DBs.

Proves with real localhost HTTP (TestClient, no mocks):

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

TOKEN_A = "b41-smoke-token-aaaaaaaa"
TOKEN_B = "b41-smoke-token-bbbbbbbb"


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    line = f"{'OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}"
    try:
        print(line, flush=True)
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        print(line.encode("ascii", "replace").decode("ascii"),
              flush=True)
    if not ok:
        sys.exit(1)


with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
    for node_id, caps, token in (
            ("v2-a", ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_A),
            ("v2-b", ["research.fetch", "research.fetch_url"],
             TOKEN_B)):

            "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id,
            "tier": "worker", "capabilities": caps,
            "node_token": token})
        check(f"node {node_id} registered",
              reg.status_code == 201, str(reg.status_code))
    beat = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/v2-b/heartbeat", json={
        "available": True, "node_token": TOKEN_B,
        "telemetry": {"hostname": "v2-b", "os": "Linux",
                      "cpu_percent": 22.0, "cpu_count": 8,
                      "memory_percent": 41.0,
                      "memory_total_mb": 16384,
                      "memory_available_mb": 9666,
                      "uptime_seconds": 5000},
        "hardware": [{"kind": "camera",
                      "identifier": "/dev/video0",
                      "details": {}, "status": "connected"}],
        "compute_capabilities": [{
            "capability": "ollama", "details": {},
            "status": "available"}],
        "energy_state": {"source": "grid"}})

          str(beat.status_code))

    # Routing 2.0 explainer: eligible + waiting + unavailable.
    preview = client.post("/api/v1/tasks/route", json={
        "requirements": {
            "required_capabilities": ["research.fetch"],
            "required_hardware": ["camera"]},
        "policy": {"prefer_idle": True}}).json()
    check("route preview explains",
          preview["selected_node_id"] == "v2-b"
          and preview["why"]["eligible"]
          and "selected" in preview["why"]["summary"])

    # Mesh preview: dry run creates nothing.
    tasks_before = len(client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json())
    dry = client.post("/api/v1/mesh/preview", json={
        "requesting_node": "v2-a", "target_node": "v2-b",

        "payload": {"url": "https://example.com/v2"}})

          dry.status_code == 200
          and dry.json()["created"] is False
          and len(client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json())
          == tasks_before, str(dry.status_code))

    # Delegate: queued + assigned + audited.

        "requesting_node": "v2-a", "node_token": TOKEN_A,
        "target_node": "v2-b",
        "task_kind": "research.fetch_url",
        "capability": "research.fetch",
        "payload": {"url": "https://example.com/v2",
                    "max_chars": 500},
        "reason": "v2 smoke delegation"})
    check("delegate creates pinned task",
          delegation.status_code == 201, delegation.text)
    receipt = delegation.json()
    task_id = receipt["task_id"]
    for key in ("what", "why", "where", "capability", "risk",
                "result_href", "activity_href"):
        check(f"receipt carries {key.upper()}", receipt[key])
    check("receipt risk honest", "no shell" in receipt["risk"])
    check("task detail resolves",
          client.get(receipt["result_href"]).status_code == 200)

    # Reality: trust levels + current task while assigned.
    reality = client.get("/api/v1/nodes/v2-b/reality").json()
    check("reality OBSERVED camera",
          any(item["kind"] == "camera"
              and item["trust"] == "OBSERVED"
              for item in reality["hardware"]))
    check("reality never auto-verifies",
          all(item["trust"] != "VERIFIED"
              for item in reality["hardware"]))

    # Pull model: target claims, requester cannot steal.
    claimed = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/v2-b?node_token={TOKEN_B}")
    check("target claims pinned task",

    check("requester cannot steal pin",
          client.post(

    busy = client.get("/api/v1/nodes/v2-b").json()

          (busy.get("current_task") or {}).get("task_id")
          == task_id, str(busy.get("current_task")))
    done = client.post(f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete",
                       json={"success": True,
                             "result": {"text": "v2 smoke"}})
    check("completion accepted", done.status_code == 204,
          str(done.status_code))

    # Ecosystem overview answers all eight questions.
    overview = client.get("/api/v1/ecosystem/overview").json()

                "blocked", "growing"):
        check(f"overview answers {key.upper()}",
              key in overview, key)

          overview["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False

    # Craft states + symbiosis 2.0 + guide unlock.
    craft = client.get(

          craft.status_code in (200, 503),

    from coordinator.app.symbiosis import (

    check("symbiosis research prefix",

              and "Mycelium" in page.text,

          "attention →" in client.get("/world").text)

    # Refusals: every V2 attack surface fails closed.
    refusing = [
        ("fake requesting node", {"requesting_node": "ghost",
                                  "node_token": TOKEN_A},
         (404, 422)),
        ("wrong credential", {"node_token": "wrong-token-1"},
         (403,)),
        ("shell kind", {"task_kind": "shell.exec"}, (422,)),
        ("wildcard cap", {"capability": "*"}, (422,)),
        ("unknown cap", {"capability": "evil.pwn"}, (422,)),

         {"payload": {"api_key": "shh"}}, (422,)),
        ("traversal target", {"target_node": "../v2-b"},
         (404, 422)),

    base = {"requesting_node": "v2-a", "node_token": TOKEN_A,

            "task_kind": "research.fetch_url",
            "capability": "research.fetch", "payload": {},

"""Take BIG #42 ecosystem screenshots with Playwright.

Seeds tmp DBs via b42_shots.py, serves them on 127.0.0.1:8898
in a background thread, captures the curated set into
docs/r42-shots/. No real DBs touched.
"""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

TMP = r"C:\Users\Jelles\AppData\Local\Temp\b42_shots"
PORT = 8898

os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)
os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(TMP, "shots.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(
    TMP, "shots-chat.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY"] = "b42-shot-operator"

import uvicorn  # noqa: E402
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod  # noqa: E402


def run_server():
    uvicorn.run(main_mod.app, host="127.0.0.1", port=PORT,
                log_level="warning")


server_thread = threading.Thread(target=run_server, daemon=True)
server_thread.start()
time.sleep(3)

result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "scripts/b42_shots.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=".",
    env={**os.environ, "B42_SHOT_TMP": TMP})
print(result.stdout[-2000:])
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("Seed script failed:", result.stderr[-2000:])
    sys.exit(1)

print("Seed done, taking screenshots...")

SHOTS_DIR = Path("docs/r42-shots")
SHOTS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

import asyncio  # noqa: E402


async def take_screenshots():
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(channel="msedge",
                                          headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page(
            viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}"

        async def full(name, path):
            await page.goto(f"{base}{path}",
                            wait_until="networkidle")
            await page.wait_for_timeout(900)
            await page.screenshot(
                path=str(SHOTS_DIR / name), full_page=True)
            print(f"ok {name}")

        await full("world-1440.png",
                   "/world?show=missions,nodes,hardware,compute")
        await full("nodes-reality-1440.png", "/hardware")
        await full("quest-1440.png", "/quests")
        await full("symbiosis-1440.png", "/symbiosis")
        await full("guide-1440.png", "/guide")
        await full("mobile-1440.png", "/mobile")
        await full("morning-1440.png", "/morning")

        await browser.close()


asyncio.run(take_screenshots())
print("All screenshots saved to docs/r42-shots/")

        f"/api/v1/hardware/links/{link_id}/verify",
        json={"verified_by": "jelles",
              "operator_key": OPERATOR})

          str(verified.status_code))
    reality = client.get(
        "/api/v1/nodes/eco-b/reality").json()

          unk.json()["amount_minor"] is None)

        "source": "solar", "kind": "production", "value": 410.5,
        "unit": "W", "project_ref": "proj_solar"})

          str(enr.status_code))

                       params={"project_ref": "proj_solar"}).json()

    ids = {entry["template_id"] for entry in templates}
    check("idea_to_verification template",
          "idea_to_verification" in ids)
    check("project_finance_energy template",
          "project_finance_energy" in ids)

    # 6. Quest trail: real progress.
    quest = client.post("/api/v1/quests", json={
        "title": "Build Solar Upgrade",
        "steps": [
            {"key": "money", "label": "Budget", "kind": "finance",
             "ref": fin_id},
            {"key": "power", "label": "Panels live",
             "kind": "energy", "ref": ""}]})
    check("quest created", quest.status_code == 201,
          str(quest.status_code))
    quest_id = quest.json()["quest_id"]
    check("quest starts 0/2",
          quest.json()["progress"] == "0/2",
          quest.json()["progress"])
    client.post(f"/api/v1/finance/records/{fin_id}/status",
                json={"status": "CONFIRMED"})
    refreshed = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/quests/{quest_id}/refresh").json()
    check("quest real progress 1/2",
          refreshed["progress"] == "1/2",
          refreshed["progress"])

    tasks_before = client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
    count_before = len(tasks_before if isinstance(

    preview = client.post("/api/v1/workflows/preview", json={
        "requesting_node": "eco-a", "node_token": TOKEN_A,
        "steps": [{"task_kind": "research.fetch_url",
                   "capability": "research.fetch",
                   "target_node": "eco-b",
                   "payload": {"url": "https://example.com/a"},
                   "reason": "smoke preview"}]})
    check("workflow preview", preview.status_code == 200,
          str(preview.status_code))
    tasks_after = client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()

    check("preview creates nothing",
          count_after == count_before)
    dispatch = client.post("/api/v1/workflows/dispatch", json={
        "requesting_node": "eco-a", "node_token": TOKEN_A,

             "payload": {"url": "https://example.com/b"},
             "reason": "more research on B"}]})
    check("workflow dispatch", dispatch.status_code == 201,

    check("workflow 2 steps",
          dispatch.json()["steps_dispatched"] == 2)

    dash = client.get("/api/v1/mobile/dashboard").json()

    check("overview finance", overview["finance"]["total"] == 2,

    check("overview quests", overview["quests"]["open"] == 1)

    check("guide ecosystem items", len(guide_items) > 0)

    titles = [section["title"] for section in
              morning.get("sections", [])]
    check("morning hardware section",
          "Hardware verification" in titles)
    check("morning quests section", "Quest trails" in titles)
    from coordinator.app.context_packet import build_packet_v2
    scoped = build_packet_v2(task="smoke",
                             project_id="proj_solar")
    generic = build_packet_v2(task="smoke")
    check("packet-v2 ecosystem section", "ecosystem" in scoped)
    scoped_amounts = [record.get("amount_minor") for record in
                      scoped["ecosystem"]["finance"]["records"]]
    generic_amounts = [record.get("amount_minor") for record in
                       generic["ecosystem"]["finance"]["records"]]
    check("scoped packet carries amount",
          50000 in scoped_amounts)
    check("generic packet hides amount",
          50000 not in generic_amounts)

    # 9. Pages render.
    for path in ("/hardware", "/finance", "/energy", "/quests",
                 "/world", "/mobile", "/morning"):
        page = client.get(path)
        check(f"page {path}", page.status_code == 200,
              str(page.status_code))

    # 10. Refusal probes.
    fake_verify = client.post(
        "/api/v1/hardware/links/hv_deadbeef/verify",
        json={"verified_by": "mallory",
              "operator_key": OPERATOR})
    check("fake link verify 404",
          fake_verify.status_code == 404,
          str(fake_verify.status_code))
    fake_fin = client.post("/api/v1/finance/records", json={
        "kind": "printing-money", "title": "Fake"})
    check("fake finance kind refused",
          fake_fin.status_code == 422,
          str(fake_fin.status_code))

        "source": "coal", "kind": "production"})
    check("fake energy source refused",
          fake_enr.status_code == 422,
          str(fake_enr.status_code))
    from coordinator.app.symbiosis import check_predicate
    try:
        check_predicate("owns")
        check("invalid predicate refused", False)
    except ValueError:
        check("invalid predicate refused", True)
    wild = client.post("/api/v1/workflows/dispatch", json={
        "requesting_node": "eco-a", "node_token": TOKEN_A,

                   "capability": "research.*",
                   "target_node": "eco-b", "payload": {}}]})
    check("workflow wildcard refused",
          wild.status_code == 422, str(wild.status_code))
    shell = client.post("/api/v1/workflows/dispatch", json={
        "requesting_node": "eco-a", "node_token": TOKEN_A,
        "steps": [{"task_kind": "exec.shell",
                   "capability": "research.fetch",
                   "target_node": "eco-b", "payload": {}}]})
    check("workflow shell refused",
          shell.status_code == 422, str(shell.status_code))
    secret = client.post("/api/v1/workflows/dispatch", json={
        "requesting_node": "eco-a", "node_token": TOKEN_A,
        "steps": [{"task_kind": "research.fetch_url",
                   "capability": "research.fetch",
                   "target_node": "eco-b",
                   "payload": {"api_key": "hunter2"}}]})
    check("workflow secret refused",
          secret.status_code == 422, str(secret.status_code))

    # 11. Revoke sticks at the end (keeps the store honest).
    revoked = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/hardware/links/{link_id}/revoke",
        json={"revoked_by": "jelles", "reason": "smoke done",
              "operator_key": OPERATOR})
    check("revoke at end", revoked.json()["status"] == "REVOKED")
    reverify = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/hardware/links/{link_id}/verify",
        json={"verified_by": "jelles",
              "operator_key": OPERATOR})
    check("revoked never re-verifies",
          reverify.status_code == 422,
          str(reverify.status_code))

print(f"SMOKE DONE: {sum(checks)}/{len(checks)} checks green",
      flush=True)

"""Take BIG #43 game-layer screenshots with Playwright.

Seeds tmp DBs via b43_shots.py, serves them on 127.0.0.1:8897
in a background thread, captures the curated set into
docs/r43-shots/. No real DBs touched.
"""

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

TMP = r"C:\Users\Jelles\AppData\Local\Temp\b43_shots"
PORT = 8897

os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)
os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(TMP, "shots.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(
    TMP, "shots-chat.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY"] = "b43-shot-operator"

import uvicorn  # noqa: E402
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod  # noqa: E402


def run_server():
    uvicorn.run(main_mod.app, host="127.0.0.1", port=PORT,
                log_level="warning")


server_thread = threading.Thread(target=run_server, daemon=True)
server_thread.start()
time.sleep(3)

result = subprocess.run(
    [sys.executable, "scripts/b43_shots.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=".",
    env={**os.environ, "B43_SHOT_TMP": TMP})
print(result.stdout[-2000:])
if result.returncode != 0:
    print("Seed script failed:", result.stderr[-2000:])
    sys.exit(1)

print("Seed done, taking screenshots...")

SHOTS_DIR = Path("docs/r43-shots")
SHOTS_DIR.mkdir(exist_ok=True)

import asyncio  # noqa: E402


async def take_screenshots():
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(channel="msedge",
                                          headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page(
            viewport={"width": 1440, "height": 900})
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}"

        async def full(name, path):
            await page.goto(f"{base}{path}",
                            wait_until="networkidle")
            await page.wait_for_timeout(900)
            await page.screenshot(
                path=str(SHOTS_DIR / name), full_page=True)
            print(f"ok {name}")

        await full("world-1440.png",
                   "/world?show=missions,nodes,hardware,compute")
        await full("game-1440.png", "/game")
        await full("campaign-1440.png", "/campaigns")
        await full("quest-1440.png", "/quests")
        await full("craft-1440.png", "/craft")
        await full("symbiosis-1440.png", "/symbiosis")
        await full("guide-1440.png", "/guide")
        await full("mobile-1440.png", "/mobile")
        await full("morning-1440.png", "/morning")

        await browser.close()


asyncio.run(take_screenshots())
print("All screenshots saved to docs/r43-shots/")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/scripts/b43_smoke.py">
"""BIG #43 live smoke: living game layer on tmp DBs.

Proves with real localhost HTTP (TestClient, no mocks):
quest x2 -> campaign create (counts, current quest, next
action, evidence) -> campaign refresh -> game state (10
sections, honesty, provenance) -> guide companion card ->
mobile campaign panel -> morning campaign section (absent
before, present after) + game headers -> pages (/campaigns,
/game, /quests, /craft, /symbiosis, /guide, /mobile,
/morning, /world) -> quest progress moves campaign counts ->
deleted quest marks MISSING -> refusal probes (fake quest,
malformed id, empty, duplicate, fake campaign, game POST
405, traversal).
"""

import os
import sys

tmp = os.environ.get("B43_SMOKE_TMP", "")
assert tmp, "B43_SMOKE_TMP required"
os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
for name in ("smoke.db", "smoke-chat.db"):
    path = os.path.join(tmp, name)
    if os.path.exists(path):
        os.remove(path)
        print(f"cleared stale {name}", flush=True)
os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(tmp, "smoke.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(
    tmp, "smoke-chat.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY"] = "b43-smoke-operator"

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN_A = "b43-smoke-token-aaaaaaaa"
TOKEN_B = "b43-smoke-token-bbbbbbbb"

checks = []


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    line = f"{'OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}"
    try:
        print(line, flush=True)
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        print(line.encode("ascii", "replace").decode("ascii"),
              flush=True)
    checks.append(bool(ok))
    if not ok:
        sys.exit(1)


with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
    for node_id, caps, token in (
            ("play-a", ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_A),
            ("play-b", ["research.fetch", "research.fetch_url"],
             TOKEN_B)):
        reg = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id,
            "tier": "worker", "capabilities": caps,
            "node_token": token})
        check(f"node {node_id} registered",
              reg.status_code == 201, str(reg.status_code))
    beat = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/play-b/heartbeat", json={
        "available": True, "node_token": TOKEN_B,
        "telemetry": {"cpu_percent": 22.0},
        "hardware": [{"kind": "gpu", "identifier": "gpu-0",
                      "details": {}, "status": "connected"}]})
    check("telemetry heartbeat", beat.status_code == 204,
          str(beat.status_code))

    # Quest chain: energy audit + hardware inspection.
    fin = client.post("/api/v1/finance/records", json={
        "kind": "budget", "title": "Solar pot",
        "amount_minor": 1000, "project_ref": "proj_solar"})
    check("finance record", fin.status_code == 201)
    fin_id = fin.json()["record_id"]
    quest1 = client.post("/api/v1/quests", json={
        "title": "Understand current energy",
        "steps": [{"key": "money", "label": "Budget",
                   "kind": "finance", "ref": fin_id}]}).json()
    quest2 = client.post("/api/v1/quests", json={
        "title": "Inspect available hardware",
        "steps": [{"key": "look", "label": "Look",
                   "kind": "note", "ref": ""}]}).json()
    check("quests created",
          quest1["quest_id"].startswith("qst_") and
          quest2["quest_id"].startswith("qst_"))

    # Campaign over the chain.
    created = client.post("/api/v1/campaigns", json={
        "title": "Solar Workshop",
        "description": "Grow the solar workshop.",
        "quest_ids": [quest1["quest_id"],
                      quest2["quest_id"]]})
    check("campaign created", created.status_code == 201,
          str(created.status_code))
    campaign = created.json()
    campaign_id = campaign["campaign_id"]
    check("campaign counts",
          campaign["total_count"] == 2 and
          campaign["completed_count"] == 0,
          f"{campaign['completed_count']}/"
          f"{campaign['total_count']}")
    check("current quest",
          campaign["current_quest"]["quest_id"] ==
          quest1["quest_id"])
    check("next action",
          bool(campaign["next_action"].get("href")),
          campaign["next_action"].get("step", ""))
    check("evidence links",
          len(campaign["evidence"]) == 2)

    # Game state: 10 sections + honesty.
    game = client.get("/api/v1/game/state")
    check("game state", game.status_code == 200,
          str(game.status_code))
    sections = game.json()["sections"]
    for key in ("world", "campaigns", "current_quest",
                "presence", "craft", "symbiosis", "nodes",
                "energy", "workshop", "discoveries"):
        check(f"game section {key}", key in sections)
    check("game honesty",
          "database" in game.json()["honesty"])
    check("game provenance",
          game.json()["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False)

    # Guide companion card for the campaign.
    guide = client.get("/api/v1/guide").json()
    items = guide.get("items", [])
    cards = [item for item in items
             if item.get("glyph") == "\U0001F5FA"]
    check("guide campaign card", len(cards) > 0)
    check("companion evidence",
          bool(cards[0].get("evidence")))

    # Mobile campaign panel.
    dash = client.get("/api/v1/mobile/dashboard").json()
    check("mobile campaigns panel", "campaigns" in dash)
    check("mobile next href",
          bool(dash["campaigns"]["campaigns"][0]["next_href"]))

    # Morning: absent before finance? (campaign exists now).
    morning = client.get("/api/v1/reports/morning").json()
    titles = [section["title"] for section in
              morning.get("sections", [])]
    check("morning campaign section",
          "Current campaign" in titles)
    morning_page = client.get("/morning")
    check("morning game header",
          "Current campaign" in morning_page.text and
          "World state" in morning_page.text)

    # Pages render.
    for path in ("/campaigns", "/game", "/quests", "/craft",
                 "/symbiosis", "/guide", "/mobile", "/morning",
                 "/world"):
        page = client.get(path)
        check(f"page {path}", page.status_code == 200,
              str(page.status_code))

    # Real progress moves the campaign.
    client.post(f"/api/v1/finance/records/{fin_id}/status",
                json={"status": "CONFIRMED"})
    refreshed = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/campaigns/{campaign_id}/refresh").json()
    check("campaign real progress",
          refreshed["completed_count"] == 1 and
          refreshed["current_quest"]["quest_id"] ==
          quest2["quest_id"],
          f"{refreshed['completed_count']}/"
          f"{refreshed['total_count']}")

    # Deleted quest marks MISSING, never vanishes silently.
    client.delete(f"/api/v1/quests/{quest2['quest_id']}")
    after_delete = client.get(
        f"/api/v1/campaigns/{campaign_id}").json()
    check("deleted quest MISSING",
          after_delete["quests"][1]["state"] == "MISSING")

    # Refusal probes.
    fake = client.post("/api/v1/campaigns", json={
        "title": "Fake", "quest_ids": ["qst_deadbeef1234"]})
    check("fake quest refused", fake.status_code == 422,
          str(fake.status_code))
    malformed = client.post("/api/v1/campaigns", json={
        "title": "Fake", "quest_ids": ["../evil"]})
    check("malformed quest refused",
          malformed.status_code == 422,
          str(malformed.status_code))
    empty = client.post("/api/v1/campaigns", json={
        "title": "Empty", "quest_ids": []})
    check("empty campaign refused", empty.status_code == 422,
          str(empty.status_code))
    dupe = client.post("/api/v1/campaigns", json={
        "title": "Dupe",
        "quest_ids": [quest1["quest_id"],
                      quest1["quest_id"]]})
    check("duplicate quest refused", dupe.status_code == 422,
          str(dupe.status_code))
    missing = client.get("/api/v1/campaigns/cmp_nope")
    check("fake campaign 404", missing.status_code == 404,
          str(missing.status_code))
    post_game = client.post("/api/v1/game/state")
    check("game state POST refused",
          post_game.status_code == 405,
          str(post_game.status_code))
    wild = client.post("/api/v1/campaigns", json={
        "title": "Wild", "quest_ids": ["qst_*"]})
    check("wildcard quest refused", wild.status_code == 422,
          str(wild.status_code))

      flush=True)

DBs touched.

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time
from pathlib import Path

TMP = r"C:\Users\Jelles\AppData\Local\Temp\b44_shots"
PORT = 8896

os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)
os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(TMP, "shots.db")
os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = os.path.join(
    TMP, "shots-chat.db")

import uvicorn  # noqa: E402
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod  # noqa: E402


def run_server():
    uvicorn.run(main_mod.app, host="127.0.0.1", port=PORT,
                log_level="warning")

    [sys.executable, "scripts/b44_shots.py"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=".",
    env={**os.environ, "B44_SHOT_TMP": TMP})

    print("Seed script failed:", result.stderr[-2000:])

import asyncio  # noqa: E402


async def take_screenshots():
    from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(channel="msedge",
                                          headless=True)
        base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}"

        async def full(name, path, width=1440, height=900):
            page = await browser.new_page(
                viewport={"width": width, "height": height})
            await page.goto(f"{base}{path}",
                            wait_until="networkidle")
            await page.wait_for_timeout(900)
            await page.screenshot(
                path=str(SHOTS_DIR / name), full_page=True)
            print(f"ok {name}")
            await page.close()

        await full("world-1440.png",
                   "/world?show=missions,nodes,hardware,compute")
        await full("world-mobile-390.png", "/world", width=390,
                   height=844)
        await full("campaign-1440.png", "/campaigns")
        await full("craft-1440.png", "/craft")
        await full("symbiosis-1440.png", "/symbiosis")
        await full("nodes-1440.png", "/nodes")
        await full("hardware-1440.png", "/hardware")
        await full("presence-1440.png", "/presence")
        await full("guide-1440.png", "/guide")
        await full("morning-1440.png", "/morning")

        await browser.close()


asyncio.run(take_screenshots())
print("All screenshots saved to docs/r44-shots/")

checks = []


def check(name, ok, detail=""):
    line = f"{'OK  ' if ok else 'FAIL'} {name} {detail}"
    try:
        print(line, flush=True)
    except UnicodeEncodeError:
        print(line.encode("ascii", "replace").decode("ascii"),
              flush=True)
    checks.append(bool(ok))
    if not ok:
        sys.exit(1)


with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
    for node_id, caps, token in (
            ("grove-a", ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_A),

              reg.status_code == 201, str(reg.status_code))

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/scripts/install_linux_node.sh">
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Mycelium Linux node installer (P1).
#
# Usage:
#   ./scripts/install_linux_node.sh [--coordinator URL] [--node-id ID]
#       [--tier seed|worker|core] [--capability CAP]... [--poll-seconds N]
#       [--token ...] [--with-systemd] [--bootstrap]
#
# What it does (idempotent, safe to re-run):
#   1. checks OS / Python >= 3.11 / git (git fatal, rest advisory)
#   2. creates .venv when missing (never deletes anything)
#   3. installs the project (pip install -e .) incl. psutil for node_client
#   4. runs: python -m node_client.install install "$@" (writes local config,
#      preserves existing node identity, chmod 600, no network by default)
#
# What it never does: sudo, root services, inbound ports, secrets in output,
# Docker, cloud accounts. Outbound-only: the node polls the coordinator.
set -euo pipefail

REPO_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$REPO_DIR"

say() { printf '%s\n' "$*"; }
warn() { printf 'warning: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
die() { printf 'error: %s\n' "$*" >&2; exit 1; }

# --- 1. OS -----------------------------------------------------------------
if [ "$(uname -s)" != "Linux" ]; then
  die "this installer targets Linux (found: $(uname -s)). On Windows use the README PowerShell flow."
fi
if [ -f /etc/os-release ]; then
  # shellcheck disable=SC1091
  . /etc/os-release
  say "OS: ${PRETTY_NAME:-${NAME:-Linux}} ($(uname -m))"
else
  say "OS: Linux ($(uname -m))"
fi

# --- 2. Python --------------------------------------------------------------
if ! command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  die "python3 not found. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y python3 python3-venv git"
fi
PY_OK="$(python3 -c 'import sys; print("yes" if sys.version_info >= (3, 11) else "no")')"
if [ "$PY_OK" != "yes" ]; then
  die "Python >= 3.11 required (found: $(python3 --version 2>&1))."
fi
say "Python: $(python3 --version 2>&1) OK"

# --- 3. git (required to keep the checkout updated) --------------------------
if command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  say "Git: $(git --version) OK"
else
  die "git not found. Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install -y git"
fi

# --- 4. optional probes (never fatal) ----------------------------------------
if command -v ollama >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  say "Ollama: AVAILABLE (ollama-backed capabilities enabled)"
else
  say "Ollama: OPTIONAL / NOT FOUND (node still registers)"
fi
if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  say "NVIDIA: AVAILABLE ($(nvidia-smi -L 2>/dev/null | head -n 1))"
else
  say "NVIDIA: OPTIONAL / NOT FOUND (CPU-only node)"
fi

# --- 5. venv (created once, reused afterwards) --------------------------------
if [ ! -f "$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/python" ]; then
  say "creating .venv ..."
  python3 -m venv "$REPO_DIR/.venv" || die "python3 -m venv failed; Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install -y python3-venv"
else
  say ".venv: exists (reusing)"
fi
VENV_PY="$REPO_DIR/.venv/bin/python"
"$VENV_PY" -m pip install --upgrade pip >/dev/null 2>&1 || warn "pip upgrade failed, continuing"

# --- 6. project install (idempotent) ------------------------------------------
say "installing mycelium-ai into .venv ..."
"$VENV_PY" -m pip install -e "$REPO_DIR" || die "pip install -e . failed"
# node_client imports psutil (telemetry); keep it present even on minimal images.
if ! "$VENV_PY" -c "import psutil" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  say "installing psutil (node telemetry) ..."
  "$VENV_PY" -m pip install "psutil>=5.9" || warn "psutil install failed; node telemetry will degrade"
fi

# --- 7. node config (the Python installer owns this; idempotent) --------------
say "configuring node ..."
"$VENV_PY" -m node_client.install install --repo-dir "$REPO_DIR" "$@"

say ""
say "done. Next:"
say "  - start:   .venv/bin/python -m node_client.main --coordinator <url> --node-id <id> --tier worker --poll-seconds 10"
say "             (exact command was printed above; token comes from the local config, never from output)"
say "  - check:   .venv/bin/python -m node_client.install doctor"
say "  - service: re-run with --with-systemd, then: systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now mycelium-node"
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/scripts/register-startup.ps1">
# Registers a USER-level logon task (no admin). The coordinator
# starts on loopback only; nothing clicks, prints, or moves hardware.
$TaskName = "MyceliumCoordinator"
$Project = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot "..")).Path
$Python = (Get-Command python).Source

$Action = New-ScheduledTaskAction -Execute $Python `
    -Argument "-m uvicorn coordinator.app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" `
    -WorkingDirectory $Project
$Trigger = New-ScheduledTaskTrigger -AtLogOn
$Settings = New-ScheduledTaskSettingsSet `
    -StartWhenAvailable -StopIfGoingOnBatteries:$false `
    -ExecutionTimeLimit (New-TimeSpan -Hours 12)
$Principal = New-ScheduledTaskPrincipal `
    -UserId "$env:USERDOMAIN\$env:USERNAME" -LogonType Interactive

Register-ScheduledTask -TaskName $TaskName -Action $Action `
    -Trigger $Trigger -Settings $Settings -Principal $Principal -Force
Write-Output "Registered '$TaskName'. Disable via Task Scheduler or unregister-startup.ps1."
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/scripts/start-mycelium.ps1">
# Mycelium coordinator launcher (Windows, no admin needed).
# Starts uvicorn on loopback only. Pass -Agent to also start the
# desktop agent in safe (observe-only) mode.
param([switch]$Agent)

$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$Root = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path
$Project = Split-Path -Parent $Root
Set-Location $Project

if (-not (Test-Path $Project)) {
    throw "Project dir missing: $Project"
}

$coordinator = Start-Process python `
    -ArgumentList "-m", "uvicorn", "coordinator.app.main:app",
        "--host", "127.0.0.1", "--port", "8000" `
    -WorkingDirectory $Project -PassThru
Write-Output "Coordinator PID $($coordinator.Id) on 127.0.0.1:8000"

if ($Agent) {
    $agent = Start-Process python `
        -ArgumentList "-m", "desktop_agent.main", "--read-only" `
        -WorkingDirectory $Project -PassThru
    Write-Output "Desktop agent PID $($agent.Id) (read-only mode)"
}

Write-Output "Health: http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health"
Write-Output "Stop with Ctrl+C in each window or Stop-Process."
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/scripts/tick_mycelium.py">
"""Mycelium tick loop: give the coordinator time without adding logic.

Calls ONLY existing read-only/report endpoints, in a fixed order:
health gate -> lease sweep -> jobs -> optional mission tick ->
ownership snapshot.
Fail-closed: an unhealthy coordinator aborts before any other call.
The sweep calls only the existing expiry rules (requeue below
MAX_ATTEMPTS, fail at the limit, block physical-uncertain work);
it creates nothing, executes nothing, extends no lease.
No scheduler inside the coordinator, no new endpoints, no model calls,
no approvals, no physical actions. Idempotent via date-based run_key
(the server revalidates job names itself).

Usage:
    python scripts/tick_mycelium.py --once
    python scripts/tick_mycelium.py --repeat-seconds 600 --max-ticks 144
    python scripts/tick_mycelium.py --with-mission-tick --once
"""

import argparse
import datetime
import json
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import urllib.error

# Read-only/report jobs only. health_import excluded: its default
# mock provider writes synthetic samples. memory_consolidation and
# skill_discover without params are honest no-ops; excluded to keep
# every tick side-effect-light (morning_report + job_runs rows only).
TICK_JOBS = (
    "watcher_scan",
    "device_health",
    "inventory_reconcile",
    "research_process",
    "morning_report",
)

RUNNABLE_MISSION_STATUS = "running"


class TickRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local policy refused a tick step; nothing was sent."""


def utc_date_key(now=None):
    moment = now or datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    return moment.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")


def http_call(base_url, timeout):
    """Build the default urllib transport. Returns call(method, path, body)."""
    base = str(base_url or "").rstrip("/")

    def call(method, path, body=None):
        if not str(path or "").startswith("/api/v1/"):
            raise TickRefusedError(
                f"tick only calls /api/v1/*, refusing {path!r}")
        data = None
        headers = {}
        if body is not None:
            data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
            headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            base + path, data=data, headers=headers, method=method)
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(
                    request, timeout=int(timeout)) as response:
                raw = response.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            raise TickRefusedError(
                f"{method} {path} -> HTTP {error.code}") from error
        except OSError as error:
            raise TickRefusedError(
                f"{method} {path} unreachable: {error}") from error
        if not raw.strip():
            return None
        try:
            return json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise TickRefusedError(
                f"{method} {path} returned non-JSON") from error

    return call


def check_health(call):
    """Fail-closed gate: only a healthy coordinator gets ticked."""
    try:
        body = call("GET", "/api/v1/health")
    except TickRefusedError:
        return False
    return isinstance(body, dict) and body.get("status") == "healthy"


def run_tick_jobs(call, date_key):
    """Run the fixed read-only job set. One job failing never
    blocks the others; every outcome is reported honestly."""
    results = []
    for job in TICK_JOBS:
        try:
            outcome = call("POST", "/api/v1/jobs/run", {
                "job_name": job,
                "params": {},
                "run_key": f"tick-{date_key}-{job}",
            })
            results.append({"job": job, "ok": True,
                            "summary": outcome if isinstance(
                                outcome, dict) else {"raw": outcome}})
        except TickRefusedError as error:
            results.append({"job": job, "ok": False,
                            "error": str(error)[:300]})
    return results


def sweep_leases(call):
    """Recover expired leases via the maintenance endpoint (same
    rules as the claim path). A coordinator without the endpoint
    reports an error instead of failing the whole tick."""
    try:
        outcome = call("POST", "/api/v1/maintenance/sweep-leases")
    except TickRefusedError as error:
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(error)[:300]}
    if not isinstance(outcome, dict):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "unexpected shape"}
    return {"ok": True, "tasks": outcome.get("tasks"),
            "desktop_actions": outcome.get("desktop_actions")}


def select_runnable_mission(missions):
    """First mission with status 'running' in API order, else None.
    Draft/paused/terminal missions are never ticked by the loop."""
    if not isinstance(missions, list):
        return None
    for entry in missions:
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        if entry.get("status") == RUNNABLE_MISSION_STATUS:
            mission_id = str(entry.get("mission_id", "")).strip()
            if mission_id:
                return mission_id
    return None


def tick_mission(call, mission_id):
    try:
        outcome = call(
            "POST", f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
    except TickRefusedError as error:
        return {"ticked": mission_id, "ok": False,
                "error": str(error)[:300]}
    return {"ticked": mission_id, "ok": True,
            "summary": outcome if isinstance(outcome, dict)
            else {"raw": outcome}}


def ownership_snapshot(call):
    """Read-only task ownership from the existing list endpoint:
    id/kind/status/owner/attempts/lease. No mission link exists on
    the tasks table, so none is reported (never invented)."""
    try:
        rows = call("GET", "/api/v1/tasks")
    except TickRefusedError as error:
        return {"ok": False, "error": str(error)[:300], "tasks": []}
    if not isinstance(rows, list):
        return {"ok": False, "error": "unexpected shape",
                "tasks": []}
    items = []
    for row in rows:
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            continue
        items.append({
            "id": row.get("id"),
            "kind": row.get("kind"),
            "status": row.get("status"),
            "assigned_node_id": row.get("assigned_node_id"),
            "attempt_count": row.get("attempt_count", 0),
            "lease_until": row.get("lease_until"),
        })
    return {"ok": True, "tasks": items}


def run_tick(call, date_key, with_mission_tick=False):
    """One bounded tick pass. Pure orchestration over the injected
    transport; safe to unit-test with a fake callable."""
    if not check_health(call):
        return {"ok": False, "aborted": "coordinator not healthy",
                "sweep": None, "jobs": [], "mission_tick": None,
                "ownership": {"ok": False, "tasks": []}}
    swept = sweep_leases(call)
    jobs = run_tick_jobs(call, date_key)
    mission_tick = None
    if with_mission_tick:
        try:
            missions = call("GET", "/api/v1/missions")
        except TickRefusedError as error:
            missions = None
            mission_tick = {"ticked": None, "ok": False,
                            "error": str(error)[:300]}
        if missions is not None:
            mission_id = select_runnable_mission(missions)
            if mission_id is None:
                mission_tick = {"ticked": None, "ok": True,
                                "note": "no running mission"}
            else:
                mission_tick = tick_mission(call, mission_id)
    ownership = ownership_snapshot(call)
    errors = [job for job in jobs if not job["ok"]]
    if not swept["ok"]:
        errors.append(swept)
    if mission_tick is not None and not mission_tick["ok"]:
        errors.append(mission_tick)
    if not ownership["ok"]:
        errors.append(ownership)
    return {"ok": not errors, "aborted": None, "sweep": swept,
            "jobs": jobs, "mission_tick": mission_tick,
            "ownership": ownership}


def arguments(argv=None):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Mycelium tick loop (time only, no logic)")
    parser.add_argument("--coordinator",
                        default="http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=30)
    parser.add_argument("--once", action="store_true",
                        help="Single tick pass, then exit (default)")
    parser.add_argument("--repeat-seconds", type=float, default=0.0,
                        help="Loop with this pause; requires --max-ticks")
    parser.add_argument("--max-ticks", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--with-mission-tick", action="store_true",
                        help="Also tick the first running mission "
                             "(off by default)")
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv=None):
    config = arguments(argv)
    call = http_call(config.coordinator, config.timeout)
    if config.repeat_seconds and config.repeat_seconds > 0:
        if config.max_ticks < 1:
            print(json.dumps({"ok": False,
                              "error": "--repeat-seconds needs "
                                       "--max-ticks >= 1"}))
            return 1
        passes = []
        for _ in range(min(config.max_ticks, 10000)):
            summary = run_tick(
                call, utc_date_key(),
                with_mission_tick=config.with_mission_tick)
            passes.append(summary)
            if len(passes) >= config.max_ticks:
                break
            time.sleep(config.repeat_seconds)
        ok = all(item["ok"] for item in passes)
        print(json.dumps({"ok": ok, "passes": len(passes),
                          "ticks": passes}))
        return 0 if ok else 1
    summary = run_tick(call, utc_date_key(),
                       with_mission_tick=config.with_mission_tick)
    print(json.dumps(summary))
    return 0 if summary["ok"] else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

"""Tests for the M6.1 adapter data contracts (no execution surface).

No network, no subprocess, no filesystem writes, no hardware. The reference
adapter runs in-process and must prove it performs no I/O besides returning
a proposal object.
"""
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError

from coordinator.app.adapter_contracts import AdapterProposal, AdapterRequest
from coordinator.app.adapters import (
    Adapter,
    ReferenceNoopAdapter,
    REFERENCE_ADAPTER_ID,
)

PROV = {"source_type": "user-created", "creator_id": "tester",
        "human_verified": True}


def make_request(**overrides):
    payload = {"request_id": "req-1", "adapter_id": REFERENCE_ADAPTER_ID,
               "input": {"object_id": "obj_abc"}, "provenance": dict(PROV)}
    payload.update(overrides)
    return AdapterRequest.model_validate(payload)


# --- contract validation ---------------------------------------------------------

def test_valid_request_and_ids():
    req = make_request(model_id="mod_x", node_id="node-1", task_id="task_9")
    assert req.model_id == "mod_x"
    assert req.task_id == "task_9"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("field,value", [
    ("model_id", "proj_x"), ("model_id", "model-x"), ("model_id", ""),
    ("task_id", "mod_x"), ("task_id", "task"), ("task_id", ""),
    ("node_id", "a"), ("node_id", "node/x"), ("node_id", ""),
    ("request_id", ""), ("request_id", "ab"), ("request_id", "req/x"),
    ("adapter_id", ""), ("adapter_id", "ref/noop"),
])
def test_invalid_ids_refused(field, value):
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        make_request(**{field: value})


def test_missing_required_fields_refused():
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        AdapterRequest.model_validate({"adapter_id": REFERENCE_ADAPTER_ID})
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        AdapterProposal.model_validate({"request_id": "req-1"})


def test_proposal_requires_approval_always():
    base = {"proposal_id": "prop-1", "request_id": "req-1",
            "adapter_id": REFERENCE_ADAPTER_ID,
            "proposed_action": "do nothing", "provenance": {
                "source_type": "ai-generated", "creator_id": "adapter:x",
                "human_verified": False}}
    ok = AdapterProposal.model_validate(base)
    assert ok.requires_approval is True
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        AdapterProposal.model_validate({**base, "requires_approval": False})
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        AdapterProposal.model_validate({**base, "provenance": {
            "source_type": "ai-generated", "creator_id": "adapter:x",
            "human_verified": True}})
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        AdapterProposal.model_validate({**base, "proposed_action": ""})

    first = adapter.propose(make_request())
    second = adapter.propose(make_request())
    assert first == second
    assert first.adapter_id == REFERENCE_ADAPTER_ID
    assert first.request_id == "req-1"
    assert first.requires_approval is True
    assert first.expected_output and first.risks
    assert first.provenance.source_type == "ai-generated"
    assert first.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert "user-created/tester" in (first.provenance.notes or "")


def test_reference_adapter_rejects_foreign_adapter_id():
    adapter = ReferenceNoopAdapter()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        adapter.propose(make_request(adapter_id="other-adapter"))


def test_no_execute_surface():
    for name in ("execute", "act", "run", "infer", "fetch", "download",
                 "read", "write", "shell"):
        assert not hasattr(Adapter, name), f"Adapter must not offer {name}"
        assert not hasattr(ReferenceNoopAdapter, name), (
            f"ReferenceNoopAdapter must not offer {name}")


def test_adapter_modules_contain_no_io():
    for module in ("adapter_contracts.py", "adapters.py"):

                  / "coordinator" / "app" / module).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        for forbidden in ("subprocess", "os.system", "socket", "httpx",
                          "requests", "urllib", "open(", "pathlib",
                          "shutil", "threading", "asyncio", "torch",
                          "transformers", "ollama", "cv2", "serial",
                          "inference", "download"):
            assert forbidden not in source, f"{module} must not use {forbidden}"


def test_reference_adapter_performs_no_filesystem_writes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    before = set(tmp_path.iterdir())
    ReferenceNoopAdapter().propose(make_request())
    assert set(tmp_path.iterdir()) == before
