"""BIG #45 tests: living ecosystem connections.

Unified connections from real stores only (no invented
relations, predicates closed, amounts never leak),
cross-project network over shared records, campaign
ecosystem context, connection detail in Guide vocabulary,
guide/mobile/morning/presence integration, background
pulse. The world layer has zero execution authority.
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN_A = "b45-test-token-aaaaaaaa"
TOKEN_B = "b45-test-token-bbbbbbbb"
OPERATOR = "b45-operator-key"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b45.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b45-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", OPERATOR)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        yield client


def _register(client, node_id, caps, token):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": caps, "node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def _beat(client, node_id, token, **extra):
    body = {"available": True, "node_token": token}
    body.update(extra)
    response = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 204, response.text


def _seed(client):
    _register(client, "node-a", ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_A)
    _register(client, "node-b",
              ["research.fetch", "research.fetch_url"], TOKEN_B)
    _beat(client, "node-a", TOKEN_A)
    _beat(client, "node-b", TOKEN_B, hardware=[{
        "kind": "gpu", "identifier": "gpu-0",
        "status": "connected"}],
        telemetry={"cpu_percent": 5.0})
    link = client.post("/api/v1/hardware/links", json={
        "human_ref": "jelles", "node_id": "node-b",
        "device_ref": "gpu-0", "device_kind": "gpu",
        "evidence": "saw it"}).json()
    client.post(
        f"/api/v1/hardware/links/{link['link_id']}/verify",
        json={"verified_by": "jelles",
              "operator_key": OPERATOR})
    fin = client.post("/api/v1/finance/records", json={
        "kind": "budget", "title": "Solar pot",
        "amount_minor": 50000,
        "project_ref": "proj_solar"}).json()
    enr = client.post("/api/v1/energy/records", json={
        "source": "solar", "kind": "production", "value": 410.5,
        "unit": "W", "project_ref": "proj_solar"}).json()
    quest = client.post("/api/v1/quests", json={
        "title": "Fund it",
        "steps": [{"key": "m", "label": "Budget",
                   "kind": "finance",
                   "ref": fin["record_id"]}]}).json()
    campaign = client.post("/api/v1/campaigns", json={
        "title": "Solar Grove",
        "quest_ids": [quest["quest_id"]]}).json()
    proposal = client.post("/api/v1/candidates", json={
        "title": "Panels feed the project",
        "candidate_type": "connection",
        "summary": "energy link",
        "entity_refs": ["proj_solar", "obj_panel"]})
    assert proposal.status_code == 201, proposal.text
    return {"link": link, "fin": fin, "enr": enr,
            "quest": quest, "campaign": campaign}


# -- unified connections -------------------------------------------------

def test_entity_connections_real_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        seeded = _seed(client)
        body = client.get(
            "/api/v1/connections",
            params={"entity_id": "proj_solar"}).json()
        assert body["entity_id"] == "proj_solar"
        origins = {entry["origin"] for entry in
                   body["connections"]}
        assert {"finance-link", "energy-link",
                "symbiosis-proposal"} <= origins
        # Predicates are closed or "related".
        from coordinator.app.symbiosis import SYMBIOSIS_PREDICATES
        for entry in body["connections"]:
            assert entry["predicate"] in SYMBIOSIS_PREDICATES \
                or entry["predicate"] == "related"
            assert entry["href"]
        # Finance amounts never leak into connections.
        blob = str(body["connections"])
        assert "50000" not in blob
        fin_entry = next(
            entry for entry in body["connections"]
            if entry["origin"] == "finance-link")
        assert fin_entry["state"] == "LINKED"
        assert fin_entry["predicate"] == "allocated_to"

def test_connection_refusal_probes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        _seed(client)
        probes = [
            ("/api/v1/connections",
             {"entity_id": "fin_*"}),
            ("/api/v1/connections",
             {"entity_id": "../evil"}),
            ("/api/v1/connections/detail",
             {"a": "proj_solar", "b": "fin_*"}),
            ("/api/v1/connections/possible",
             {"entity_id": "../evil"}),
        ]
        for path, params in probes:
            response = client.get(path, params=params)
            assert response.status_code in (404, 422), \
                (path, params, response.status_code)
        # Well-formed but unknown ids return empty, not fake
        # relations (symbiosis semantic).
        empty = client.get(
            "/api/v1/connections",
            params={"entity_id": "proj_nowhere"}).json()
        assert empty["connections"] == []
        # Prompt-injected predicate cannot enter: proposals
        # with unknown verbs refuse at creation.
        bad = client.post("/api/v1/candidates", json={
            "title": "'; DROP TABLE candidates; --",
            "candidate_type": "connection",
            "summary": "injection",
            "entity_refs": ["proj_solar", "obj_panel"]})
        assert bad.status_code in (201, 422)
        # Secret-like mesh payload still refused.
        secret = client.post("/api/v1/mesh/delegate", json={
            "requesting_node": "node-a", "node_token": TOKEN_A,
            "target_node": "node-b",
            "task_kind": "research.fetch_url",
            "capability": "research.fetch",
            "payload": {"api_key": "hunter2"}})
        assert secret.status_code == 422

"""BIG 46 slices 1+2: quest -> mission -> action -> result from /play.

The game composes existing backend truth: quest step refs resolve
to existing mission ids with live status; approval/tick reuse the
existing gates; results come from existing mission/task/event
readers. Slice 2 adds live claiming-node visibility per task:
claimed tasks show node id + live state, unclaimed tasks show an
honest waiting hint. No new model, no bypass, no fake progress.
"""
import json
import re
from contextlib import contextmanager

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


@contextmanager
def _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "fab"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        yield client


def _seed(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.quests import new_quest, save_quest

    mission = main_mod._executor().create(
        "conv-big46-1", "Isoleer de camper",
        [{"kind": "research", "description": "zoek isolatie"}],
        max_steps=5, context_records=[])
    save_quest(new_quest("Camper quest", [
        {"key": "s1", "label": "Start isolatie-missie",
         "kind": "mission", "ref": mission.mission_id}]))
    save_quest(new_quest("Losse quest", [
        {"key": "s1", "label": "Algemene notitie",
         "kind": "note", "ref": ""}]))
    return mission


def _playdata(client):
    html = client.get("/play").text
    return json.loads(
        re.search(r"const PLAYDATA = (\{.*?\});\n",
                  html, re.DOTALL).group(1))

def test_claimed_task_shows_node_and_live_state(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Slice 2: the exact fields the game result block composes —
    task.assigned_node_id plus node derived_status/current_task."""
    with _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch) as client:
        _register_worker(client)
        created = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory"}).json()
        task_id = created["id"]
        assigned = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/assign",
            json={"node_id": "worker-s2", "policy": {}})
        assert assigned.status_code == 200, assigned.text
        claimed = client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/worker-s2",
            params={"node_token": "slice2-token-abcdef-123456"})
        assert claimed.status_code == 200, claimed.text
        task = client.get(f"/api/v1/tasks/by-id/{task_id}").json()
        assert task["assigned_node_id"] == "worker-s2"
        nodes = {row["node_id"]: row
                 for row in client.get("/api/v1/nodes").json()}
        node = nodes["worker-s2"]
        assert node["derived_status"] in ("online", "busy")
        current = node["current_task"] or {}
        assert str(current.get("task_id")) == str(task_id)
        # game composition hooks render these exact fields
        html = client.get("/play").text
        for hook in ("assigned_node_id", "derived_status",
                     "werkt hieraan", "Taken verversen", "mrefresh"):
            assert hook in html, hook

class _OracleReader:
    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query=q or "", total=1, results=[{
            "entity_type": "object", "entity_id": "obj_moer",
            "title": "Moer M8", "snippet": "rvs",
            "provenance": {"source_type": "user-created",
                           "creator_id": "oracle-test",
                           "human_verified": False}}])

    async def browse(self, type=None):
        return await self.search("", type)


class _OracleAdvisor:
    async def advise(self, question, records):
        from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse
        return AdviceResponse(
            question=question, advice="Gebruik de Moer M8.",
            model="oracle-test-model", records_used=len(records),
            sources=[{"entity_id": "obj_moer",
                      "source_type": "user-created",
                      "human_verified": False}])

        assert again.status_code == 200
        assert again.json()["is_new"] is False
        # approval still required: wrong response stays denied

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_big47_vertical.py">
"""BIG47 living-workshop vertical tests: game -> queue -> worker -> event.

Covers the largest honest digital loop: a /play-originated bounded
code.* task queues through the EXISTING task system, an EXISTING
code-capable worker claims it, completes it with a REAL result, and
the completion lands in the task record + bus events + play snapshot.

No mocks of the queue, no fake completions: register/heartbeat/
claim/complete all run against the real routes. The worker side is
the real claim+complete contract (the OpenCode subprocess itself is
not spawned here; execute_code_task is covered by code_worker tests).
"""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN = "b47-test-token-12345678"
OPERATOR = "b47-operator-key"


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b47.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b47-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", OPERATOR)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register_code_node(test_client, node_id="b47-code-01"):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "b47host", "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": ["code.review", "code.patch", "code.test"],
        "executors": ["exec:code"],
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
    beat = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat",
                            json={"available": True,
                                  "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert beat.status_code == 204, beat.text


def make_mission(test_client, goal="Review the workshop loop"):
    chat = test_client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={"message": "hi"})
    assert chat.status_code == 200, chat.text
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": chat.json()["conversation_id"],
        "goal": goal,
        "steps": [{"kind": "readout", "description": "Lees",
                   "parameters": {"source": "project"}}]})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
    return res.json()["mission_id"]


def test_play_status_snapshot_empty(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        res = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/status")
        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
        snap = res.json()
        for key in ("tasks", "nodes", "automation", "missions",
                    "events", "liveness", "fabrication"):
            assert key in snap, key
        assert snap["tasks"]["counts"]["queued"] == 0
        assert snap["nodes"]["nodes"] == []
        assert snap["nodes"]["code_capable"] == 0
        assert "ollama" in snap["liveness"]
        assert "inventory" in snap["liveness"]
        steps = {row["step"]: row["state"]
                 for row in snap["fabrication"]}
        assert steps["slicing"] == "SIMULATED"
        assert steps["approval"] == "BLOCKED"
        assert steps["execution"] == "UNAVAILABLE"
        assert steps["verification"] == "REAL"
        assert steps["event"] == "REAL"


def test_play_code_task_validation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        before = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/status").json()
        # Non-code kinds never queue from the game.
        bad = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "shell.exec", "goal": "do anything"})
        assert bad.status_code == 422, bad.text
        # code.exec is code.* but not a bounded play kind.
        bad2 = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.exec", "goal": "do anything"})
        assert bad2.status_code == 422, bad2.text
        # Empty goal refuses.
        bad3 = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.review", "goal": "   "})
        assert bad3.status_code == 422, bad3.text
        # Unknown mission refuses (traceability must be real).
        bad4 = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.review", "goal": "review",
            "mission_id": "mission_nope"})
        assert bad4.status_code == 422, bad4.text
        after = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/status").json()
        assert (after["tasks"]["counts"]["queued"]
                == before["tasks"]["counts"]["queued"])


def test_play_code_task_end_to_end(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """game intent -> queued -> claimed -> completed -> event -> snapshot."""
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_code_node(test_client)

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_big48_runtime.py">
"""BIG48 living-runtime tests: the full game -> worker -> world chain.

Proves the acceptance chain without fakes: play session -> play
mission (quest + pending_approval mission + analysis step) ->
approve -> step-bound code task -> worker claim -> real complete ->
existing closeout closes the step -> tick completes the mission ->
quest COMPLETE -> fungi shows the completed result -> refreshed
play snapshot (no reload).

Also: session lifecycle/throttle, dispatch of analysis steps,
quest fabrication states, and every refusal gate (wrong mission,
wrong kind, pending mission, terminal step).
"""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN = "b48-test-token-12345678"
OPERATOR = "b48-operator-key"


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b48.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b48-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", OPERATOR)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register_code_node(test_client, node_id="b48-code-01"):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "b48host", "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": ["code.review"], "executors": ["exec:code"],
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
    beat = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat",
                            json={"available": True,
                                  "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert beat.status_code == 204, beat.text


def claim(test_client, node_id="b48-code-01"):
    res = test_client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{node_id}?node_token={TOKEN}", json={})
    return res


def complete(test_client, task_id, node_id="b48-code-01",
             summary="review done"):
    return test_client.post(f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "success": True,
        "result": {"summary": summary, "files_changed": []}})


def test_session_lifecycle(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/session", json={})
        assert created.status_code == 200, created.text
        body = created.json()
        assert body["session_id"].startswith("play_")
        assert body["resumed"] is False
        assert (body["x"], body["y"]) == (800.0, 500.0)
        sid = body["session_id"]

        saved = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/position", json={
            "session_id": sid, "x": 900, "y": 600,
            "zone": "Homebase"})
        assert saved.status_code == 200, saved.text
        assert saved.json()["saved"] is True

        # Immediate re-save throttles honestly (no failure).
        throttled = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/position", json={
            "session_id": sid, "x": 901, "y": 601})
        assert throttled.status_code == 200, throttled.text
        assert throttled.json()["saved"] is False
        assert throttled.json()["x"] == 900.0

        # Resume restores the stored position (refresh-safe).
        resumed = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/session",
                                   json={"session_id": sid})
        assert resumed.status_code == 200, resumed.text
        assert resumed.json()["resumed"] is True
        assert (resumed.json()["x"],
                resumed.json()["y"]) == (900.0, 600.0)

        # Unknown session 404s; bad shapes 422; coords clamp.
        missing = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/position", json={
            "session_id": "play_nope", "x": 1, "y": 1})
        assert missing.status_code == 404, missing.text
        bad = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/session",
                               json={"session_id": "!!"})
        assert bad.status_code == 422, bad.text
        no_id = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/position",
                                 json={"x": 1, "y": 1})
        assert no_id.status_code == 422, no_id.text


def test_play_mission_creates_quest_and_step(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        res = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/mission", json={
            "goal": "B48 review the loop"})
        assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
        made = res.json()
        assert made["status"] == "pending_approval"
        assert made["step_id"]
        assert made["quest_id"].startswith("qst_")

        mission = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{made['mission_id']}").json()
        assert mission["steps"][0]["kind"] == "analysis"
        assert mission["steps"][0]["parameters"]["goal"] == \
            "B48 review the loop"

        quests = test_client.get("/api/v1/quests?limit=20").json()
        mine = [quest for quest in quests["quests"]
                if quest["quest_id"] == made["quest_id"]]
        assert len(mine) == 1
        assert mine[0]["steps"][0]["ref"] == made["mission_id"]

        empty = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/mission",
                                 json={"goal": "   "})
        assert empty.status_code == 422, empty.text


def test_full_chain_to_fungi(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """session -> mission -> YES -> step task -> claim -> complete
    -> step COMPLETE -> tick -> mission completed -> quest
    COMPLETE -> fungi shows the result -> snapshot reflects it."""
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_code_node(test_client)

        made = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/mission", json={
            "goal": "B48 full chain review"}).json()
        mid, sid, qid = (made["mission_id"], made["step_id"],
                         made["quest_id"])

        # Approval gate unchanged: exact YES required.
        yes = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/approve",
                               json={"response": "YES",
                                     "decided_by": "jelles"})
        assert yes.status_code == 200, yes.text
        assert yes.json()["status"] == "approved"

        # Bound task queues and marks the step dispatched.
        queued = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.review",
            "goal": "B48 review the chain",
            "mission_id": mid, "step_id": sid})
        assert queued.status_code == 201, queued.text
        task_id = queued.json()["id"]
        steps = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/steps").json()
        assert steps[0]["status"] == "dispatched"

        # Idempotent re-queue returns the live task.
        again = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.review", "goal": "B48 review again",
            "mission_id": mid, "step_id": sid})
        assert again.status_code == 201, again.text
        assert again.json()["existing"] is True
        assert again.json()["id"] == task_id

        # Existing worker claims + completes through the real path.
        claimed = claim(test_client)
        assert claimed.status_code == 200, claimed.text
        assert claimed.json()["id"] == task_id
        done = complete(test_client, task_id,
                        summary="B48 chain review done")
        assert done.status_code == 204, done.text

        # Existing closeout closed the step (no new logic).
        steps = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/steps").json()
        assert steps[0]["status"] == "completed"

        # Tick finishes the approved mission (existing executor).
        ticked = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/tick",
                                  json={})
        assert ticked.status_code == 200, ticked.text
        mission = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}").json()
        assert mission["status"] == "completed"

        # Quest progress changed to COMPLETE.
        quests = test_client.get("/api/v1/quests?limit=20").json()
        mine = [quest for quest in quests["quests"]
                if quest["quest_id"] == qid][0]
        assert mine["state"] == "COMPLETED"
        assert mine["progress"] == "1/1"

        # Fungi/world shows the completed result (representation
        # only — nothing re-executable).
        from coordinator.app.world import derive_fungi_network
        net = derive_fungi_network(limit=120)
        labels = [node["label"] for node in net["nodes"]]
        assert any(str(label).startswith("✓ ")
                   and mid in str(node.get("href", ""))
                   for node, label in
                   zip(net["nodes"], labels))

        # Refreshed play snapshot reflects everything, no reload.
        snap = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/status").json()
        assert snap["tasks"]["counts"]["completed"] == 1
        assert snap["world"]["fungi_completed"] >= 1
        assert snap["world"]["fungi_total"] >= 2
        mine2 = [item for item in snap["missions"]["items"]
                 if item["id"] == mid]
        assert mine2 and mine2[0]["status"] == "completed"


def test_step_binding_refusals(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        made = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/mission", json={
            "goal": "B48 refusal checks"}).json()
        mid, sid = made["mission_id"], made["step_id"]

        # Pending mission: binding needs approval first (409).
        pending = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.review", "goal": "too early",
            "mission_id": mid, "step_id": sid})
        assert pending.status_code == 409, pending.text

        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES",
                               "decided_by": "jelles"})

        # Only code.review binds.
        patch = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.patch", "goal": "wrong kind",
            "mission_id": mid, "step_id": sid})
        assert patch.status_code == 422, patch.text

        # Unknown step refuses.
        ghost = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.review", "goal": "ghost",
            "mission_id": mid, "step_id": "step_nope"})
        assert ghost.status_code == 422, ghost.text

        # Step without its mission refuses (no cross-binding).
        lonely = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.review", "goal": "lonely",
            "step_id": sid})
        assert lonely.status_code == 422, lonely.text

        # Research steps never take play tasks: build one directly.
        chat = test_client.post("/api/v1/chat",
                                json={"message": "hi"}).json()
        res_mission = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": chat["conversation_id"],
            "goal": "research only",
            "steps": [{"kind": "research",
                       "description": "Zoek",
                       "parameters": {
                           "question": "wat?",
                           "source_urls": [
                               "http://127.0.0.1/x"]}}]}).json()
        res_step = res_mission["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{res_mission['mission_id']}/approve",
            json={"response": "YES", "decided_by": "jelles"})
        wrong_kind = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/code-task", json={
            "kind": "code.review", "goal": "wrong step kind",
            "mission_id": res_mission["mission_id"],
            "step_id": res_step})
        assert wrong_kind.status_code == 422, wrong_kind.text


def test_analysis_dispatch_queues_code_review(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        chat = test_client.post("/api/v1/chat",
                                json={"message": "hi"}).json()
        res = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": chat["conversation_id"],
            "goal": "dispatch analysis",
            "steps": [{"kind": "analysis",
                       "description": "Review X",
                       "parameters": {"goal": "Review X"}}]})
        assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
        mid = res.json()["mission_id"]
        step_id = res.json()["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES",
                               "decided_by": "jelles"})
        dispatched = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/dispatch",
            json={"step_id": step_id})
        assert dispatched.status_code == 200, dispatched.text
        assert dispatched.json()["task_ids"]
        tasks = test_client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
        mine = [task for task in tasks
                if task["id"] in dispatched.json()["task_ids"]]
        assert len(mine) == 1
        assert mine[0]["kind"] == "code.review"
        assert mine[0]["payload"]["mission_step_id"] == step_id

        # Idempotent second dispatch returns the same task.
        again = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/dispatch",
            json={"step_id": step_id})
        assert again.json()["task_ids"] == \
            dispatched.json()["task_ids"]

        # Analysis without goal never dispatches.
        res2 = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": chat["conversation_id"],
            "goal": "goalless",
            "steps": [{"kind": "analysis",
                       "description": "Review Y",
                       "parameters": {}}]})
        mid2 = res2.json()["mission_id"]
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid2}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES",
                               "decided_by": "jelles"})
        refused = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mid2}/dispatch",
            json={"step_id": res2.json()["steps"][0]["step_id"]})
        assert refused.status_code == 422, refused.text

                            json={"message": "hi"}).json()

def test_journal_empty_shape(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        res = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/journal")
        assert res.status_code == 200, res.text

def test_research_completed_plans_and_remembers(tmp_path,
                                                monkeypatch):
    """Echte completed/planbare inhoud (TEST) -> bestaande
    planflow naar pending_approval + onthouden mem_-record in
    het Journal; foute approval blijft geweigerd."""
    for test_client in api_live_inventory(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/research/runs", json={
            "question": "Welke hydroponics-aanpak past bij "
                        "vochtige grond?",
            "provider": "test", "test_pages": PAGES})
        assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
        body = created.json()
        assert body["status"] == "completed"
        assert body["dossier_id"].startswith("dos_")
        assert body["memory_id"].startswith("mem_")
        dossier = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/research/dossiers/{body['dossier_id']}").json()
        assert dossier["sources"] or dossier["claims"]
        planned = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/research/{body['dossier_id']}/plan", json={})
        assert planned.status_code in (200, 201), planned.text
        mission = planned.json()
        assert mission["status"] == "pending_approval"
        bad = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission['mission_id']}/approve",
            json={"response": "maybe", "decided_by": "game"})
        assert bad.status_code in (422, 409)
        journal = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/journal").json()
        know = [k for k in journal["knowledge"]
                if k["id"] == body["dossier_id"]]
        assert len(know) == 1
        assert know[0]["memory_id"] == body["memory_id"]
        assert know[0]["memory_id"].startswith("mem_")
        assert journal["counts"]["memories_remembered"] >= 1
        assert journal["counts"]["dossiers_completed"] >= 1

"""BIG53 core loop backend: session-owned inventory, gather
(cooldown), craft (consume), place (consume + bounds). Game state
only — never backend records, nothing invented."""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b53.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b53-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", "b53-operator")
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def _session(test_client):
    return test_client.post("/api/v1/play/session", json={}).json()


def test_inventory_empty_shape(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        session = _session(test_client)
        body = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/play/inventory",
            params={"session_id": session["session_id"]}).json()
        assert body["items"] == {}
        assert body["builds"] == []


def test_inventory_unknown_session_404(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        res = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/inventory",
                              params={"session_id": "play_nope"})
        assert res.status_code == 404
        for path, payload in (
                ("/api/v1/play/gather",
                 {"session_id": "play_nope", "node_id": "stump-1"}),
                ("/api/v1/play/craft",
                 {"session_id": "play_nope", "recipe": "stick"}),
                ("/api/v1/play/place",
                 {"session_id": "play_nope", "kind": "plank",
                  "x": 100, "y": 100})):
            assert test_client.post(path, json=payload).status_code == 404


def test_gather_yields_and_cools_down(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        session = _session(test_client)
        sid = session["session_id"]
        first = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/gather", json={
            "session_id": sid, "node_id": "stump-1"}).json()
        assert first["item"] == "wood" and first["qty"] == 1
        again = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/gather", json={
            "session_id": sid, "node_id": "stump-1"})
        assert again.status_code == 422
        assert "rust" in again.text
        other = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/gather", json={
            "session_id": sid, "node_id": "fiber-2"}).json()
        assert other["item"] == "fiber"
        bad = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/gather", json={
            "session_id": sid, "node_id": "dragon-9"})
        assert bad.status_code == 422


def test_craft_consumes_and_adds(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        session = _session(test_client)
        sid = session["session_id"]
        poor = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/craft", json={
            "session_id": sid, "recipe": "stick"})
        assert poor.status_code == 422
        assert "Not enough" in poor.text
        for node in ("stump-1", "stump-2"):
            test_client.post("/api/v1/play/gather", json={
                "session_id": sid, "node_id": node})
        made = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/craft", json={
            "session_id": sid, "recipe": "stick"}).json()
        assert made["crafted"] is True and made["qty"] == 1
        items = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/play/inventory",
            params={"session_id": sid}).json()["items"]
        assert items.get("stick") == 1
        assert "wood" not in items
        unknown = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/craft", json={
            "session_id": sid, "recipe": "sword"})
        assert unknown.status_code == 422


def test_place_consumes_bounds_and_lists(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        session = _session(test_client)
        sid = session["session_id"]
        empty = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/place", json={
            "session_id": sid, "kind": "plank", "x": 100,

                "session_id": sid, "node_id": node})

def test_chest_deposit_withdraw_ownership(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        sid = _session(test_client)
        other = _session(test_client)
        for node in ("stump-1", "stump-2", "stump-3", "stump-4",
                     "stump-5", "stump-6", "stump-7", "stump-8",
                     "fiber-1", "rock-1", "rock-2"):
            test_client.post("/api/v1/play/gather", json={
                "session_id": sid, "node_id": node})
        made = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/craft", json={
            "session_id": sid, "recipe": "chest"})
        assert made.status_code == 200, made.text
        placed = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/place", json={
            "session_id": sid, "kind": "chest", "x": 300,
            "y": 452}).json()
        cid = placed["build_id"]
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/play/chest",
            params={"session_id": other,
                    "chest_id": cid}).status_code == 404
        empty = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/play/chest",
            params={"session_id": sid, "chest_id": cid}).json()
        assert empty["items"] == {}
        dep = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/chest/deposit",
                               json={"session_id": sid,
                                     "chest_id": cid,
                                     "item": "wood", "qty": 2}).json()
        assert dep["deposited"] is True
        over = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/chest/deposit",
                                json={"session_id": sid,
                                      "chest_id": cid,
                                      "item": "wood", "qty": 99})
        assert over.status_code == 422
        out = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/chest/withdraw",
                               json={"session_id": sid,
                                     "chest_id": cid, "item": "wood",
                                     "qty": 5})
        assert out.status_code == 422
        back = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/chest/withdraw",
                                json={"session_id": sid,
                                      "chest_id": cid, "item": "wood",
                                      "qty": 1}).json()
        assert back["withdrawn"] is True
        final = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/play/chest",
            params={"session_id": sid, "chest_id": cid}).json()
        assert final["items"] == {"wood": 1}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_big56_drive.py">
"""BIG56 (M1) drive tests: mission control from the /side Journal.

Proves, without fakes and without new execution power, that an
operator can drive the EXISTING mission loop from the game Journal:

- journal exposes tick + dispatch + linked automation-drive as
  action descriptors on existing routes (singular ``action`` kept
  for backwards compatibility);
- dispatch refuses before exact YES (409), works after YES, and is
  idempotent on repeat (same task, no duplicate);
- the full chain quest -> mission -> YES -> dispatch -> node claim
  -> complete -> tick -> mission completed -> quest COMPLETED is
  reachable purely through journal action paths;
- waiting entries never carry drive/dispatch actions;
- liveness reports real, current probe states (REAL vs
  PROCES-ONLY vs UNAVAILABLE vs KEY-MISSING), never invented
  green;
- /side renders the Journal drive controls.

No background threads, no auto-approval, no new task kinds: every
step goes through the existing gates (the tests assert the gates
refuse where they must).
"""

import json
import threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN = "b56-test-token-12345678"
OPERATOR = "b56-operator-key"


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b56.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b56-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", OPERATOR)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register_code_node(test_client, node_id="b56-code-01"):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "b56host", "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": ["code.review"], "executors": ["exec:code"],
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
    beat = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat",
                            json={"available": True,
                                  "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert beat.status_code == 204, beat.text


def claim(test_client, node_id="b56-code-01"):
    return test_client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{node_id}?node_token={TOKEN}", json={})


def complete(test_client, task_id, node_id="b56-code-01"):
    return test_client.post(f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "success": True,
        "result": {"summary": "B56 drive review done",
                   "files_changed": []}})


def make_mission(test_client, goal="B56 drive the loop"):
    made = test_client.post("/api/v1/play/mission",
                            json={"goal": goal}).json()
    return made["mission_id"], made["step_id"], made["quest_id"]


def journal(test_client):
    res = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/journal")
    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
    return res.json()


def test_journal_exposes_drive_actions_after_yes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        mid, sid, _ = make_mission(test_client)
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES", "decided_by": "speler"})
        body = journal(test_client)
        active = body["active"]
        assert active["id"] == mid
        # Singular action kept (tick) for backwards compatibility.
        assert active["action"]["path"].endswith("/tick")
        assert active["step"]["step_id"] == sid
        paths = [item["path"] for item in active["actions"]]
        assert active["actions"][0]["path"].endswith("/tick")
        dispatch = [item for item in active["actions"]
                    if item["path"].endswith("/dispatch")]
        assert len(dispatch) == 1, paths
        assert dispatch[0]["method"] == "POST"
        assert dispatch[0]["body"] == {"step_id": sid}


def test_journal_links_automation_drive(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.automation import create_run
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        mid, _, _ = make_mission(test_client,
                                 goal="B56 linked automation drive")
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES", "decided_by": "speler"})
        run = create_run("B56 observe only",
                         [{"kind": "observe",
                           "params": {"source": "missions"}}],
                         mission_id=mid, actor="b56-test")
        body = journal(test_client)
        drives = [item for item in body["active"]["actions"]
                  if item["path"].endswith("/drive")]
        assert len(drives) == 1, body["active"]["actions"]
        assert drives[0]["path"] == \
            f"/api/v1/automation/runs/{run.run_id}/drive"
        assert drives[0]["body"] == {"budget_steps": 10}


def test_waiting_entries_never_carry_drive(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        make_mission(test_client, goal="B56 still waiting")
        body = journal(test_client)
        assert body["active"] is None
        assert len(body["waiting"]) == 1
        waiting = body["waiting"][0]
        assert waiting["action"]["path"].endswith("/approve")
        assert "actions" not in waiting
        assert "dispatch" not in waiting["action"]["path"]
        assert "drive" not in waiting["action"]["path"]


def test_dispatch_refused_before_yes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        mid, sid, _ = make_mission(test_client,
                                   goal="B56 no drive before YES")
        refused = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/dispatch",
                                   json={"step_id": sid})
        assert refused.status_code == 409, refused.text


def test_full_drive_chain_via_journal_paths(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """quest -> play mission -> YES -> dispatch -> claim -> complete
    -> tick -> mission completed -> quest COMPLETED, every drive
    step taken from the journal action descriptors."""
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_code_node(test_client)
        mid, sid, qid = make_mission(test_client,
                                     goal="B56 full drive chain")

        body = journal(test_client)
        waiting = [item for item in body["waiting"]
                   if item["id"] == mid][0]
        yes = test_client.post(waiting["action"]["path"],
                               json={"response": "YES",
                                     "decided_by": "speler"})
        assert yes.status_code == 200, yes.text

        body = journal(test_client)
        dispatch = [item for item in body["active"]["actions"]
                    if item["path"].endswith("/dispatch")][0]
        first = test_client.post(dispatch["path"],
                                 json=dispatch["body"])
        assert first.status_code == 200, first.text
        assert first.json()["task_ids"]
        task_id = first.json()["task_ids"][0]

        # Repeated Drive is idempotent: same task, no duplicate.
        second = test_client.post(dispatch["path"],
                                  json=dispatch["body"])
        assert second.status_code == 200, second.text
        assert second.json()["task_ids"] == [task_id]

        claimed = claim(test_client)
        assert claimed.status_code == 200, claimed.text
        assert claimed.json()["id"] == task_id
        done = complete(test_client, task_id)
        assert done.status_code == 204, done.text

        body = journal(test_client)
        tick = [item for item in body["active"]["actions"]
                if item["path"].endswith("/tick")][0]
        ticked = test_client.post(tick["path"], json={})
        assert ticked.status_code == 200, ticked.text
        mission = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}").json()
        assert mission["status"] == "completed"

        quests = test_client.get("/api/v1/quests?limit=20").json()
        mine = [quest for quest in quests["quests"]
                if quest["quest_id"] == qid][0]
        assert mine["state"] == "COMPLETED"
        assert mine["progress"] == "1/1"

        snap = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/status").json()
        assert snap["tasks"]["counts"]["completed"] == 1
        mine2 = [item for item in snap["missions"]["items"]
                 if item["id"] == mid]
        assert mine2 and mine2[0]["status"] == "completed"


def test_liveness_honest_when_everything_offline(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Closed loopback ports + no Hermes key: nothing may report
    green, and process availability is never confused with model
    availability."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
    monkeypatch.delenv("HERMES_API_KEY", raising=False)
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        live = test_client.get("/api/v1/play/status").json()["liveness"]
        assert set(("ollama", "inventory", "hermes",
                    "nodes")) <= set(live)
        assert live["ollama"]["state"].startswith("UNAVAILABLE"), live
        assert "model" in live["ollama"]
        assert live["inventory"]["state"] == "UNAVAILABLE", live
        assert live["hermes"]["state"] == "KEY-MISSING", live
        # The env var NAME may appear as a setup hint; key MATERIAL
        # must never appear as a field.
        assert "api_key" not in [str(key).lower()
                                 for key in live["hermes"]], live
        assert live["hermes"]["detail"].startswith(
            "zet HERMES_API_KEY"), live
        assert live["nodes"]["live"] == 0
        assert live["nodes"]["total"] == 0


class _StubHandler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def log_message(self, *args):
        pass

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/api/tags":
            payload = {"models": [{"name": "qwen3.5:4b"}]}
        elif self.path == "/api/v1/health":
            payload = {"status": "ok"}
        else:
            self.send_response(404)
            self.end_headers()
            return
        raw = json.dumps(payload).encode()
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(raw)


def test_liveness_real_probes_against_stub(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """A stub dependency answering the real probe endpoints over a
    real loopback round-trip must read REAL/OK; a reachable process
    without the configured model must read PROCES-ONLY."""
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), _StubHandler)
    port = server.server_address[1]
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    try:
        monkeypatch.setenv("OLLAMA_BASE_URL",
                           f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}")
        monkeypatch.setenv("OLLAMA_MODEL", "qwen3.5:4b")
        monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL",
                           f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}")
        for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
            live = test_client.get(
                "/api/v1/play/status").json()["liveness"]
            assert live["ollama"]["state"].startswith("REAL"), live
            assert live["inventory"]["state"] == "OK", live

        monkeypatch.setenv("OLLAMA_MODEL", "qwen3-missing:99b")
        for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
            live = test_client.get(
                "/api/v1/play/status").json()["liveness"]
            assert live["ollama"]["state"].startswith(
                "PROCES-ONLY"), live
    finally:
        server.shutdown()
        thread.join(timeout=5)

def test_slicer_probe_honest_states(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    # Bogus binary: ABSENT, never green.
    missing = forge_mod.probe_local_slicers([{
        "id": "nope", "label": "Nope", "env_var": "B57_NOPE_BIN",
        "default": str(tmp_path / "nope.exe")}])
    assert missing[0]["state"] == "ABSENT"
    assert missing[0]["next"]
    # Real executable without slice flags: UNPROVEN, never CLI_OK.
    plain = forge_mod.probe_local_slicers([{
        "id": "plain", "label": "Plain", "env_var": "B57_PLAIN_BIN",
        "default": sys.executable}])
    assert plain[0]["state"] == "PRESENT_CLI_UNPROVEN", plain
    # Pure classifier: slice flags in output mean CLI_OK.
    state, _ = forge_mod._classify_smoke(
        0, "--export-gcode --slice model.stl")
    assert state == "CLI_OK"
    state, _ = forge_mod._classify_smoke(1, "wat")
    assert state == "CLI_FAILED"
    state, _ = forge_mod._classify_smoke(None, "")
    assert state == "CLI_FAILED"


def test_mqtt_probe_never_imports():
    probe = forge_mod.probe_mqtt()
    assert probe["state"] in ("AVAILABLE", "MISSING")
    assert probe["reason"] and probe["next"]
    assert "paho.mqtt.client" not in sys.modules or \
        probe["state"] == "AVAILABLE"


def test_library_probe_never_creates(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    target = tmp_path / "lib-new"
    monkeypatch.setenv(forge_mod.LIBRARY_DIR_ENV_VAR, str(target))
    probe = forge_mod.probe_library()
    assert probe["state"] == "MISSING", probe
    assert not target.exists(), "probe must never create dirs"
    target.mkdir()
    probe = forge_mod.probe_library()
    assert probe["state"] == "OK", probe
    assert probe["root"] == str(target)

def test_scan_registers_real_model(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import shutil
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import library_models, scan_library
    root = use_library(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    shutil.copy(KUBUS_SRC, root / "bibliotheek" / "kubus20.stl")
    (root / "bibliotheek" / "leeg.stl").write_bytes(b"geen mesh")
    (root / "bibliotheek" / "negeer.txt").write_text("tekst")
    summary = scan_library(actor="b57-test")
    assert summary["scanned"] >= 2, summary
    # kubus registreert (valid), rommel.stl registreert eerlijk als
    # invalid — registratie is geen goedkeuring; .txt weigert.
    assert len(summary["registered"]) == 2, summary
    by_name = {reg["filename"]: reg
               for reg in summary["registered"]}
    assert by_name["kubus20.stl"]["verdict"] == "valid", by_name
    assert by_name["leeg.stl"]["verdict"] == "invalid", by_name
    assert len(by_name["kubus20.stl"]["sha256"]) == 64
    assert any("negeer.txt" in str(item)
               for item in summary["refused"]), summary
    assert not any("negeer.txt" in str(item.get("filename", ""))
                   for item in summary["registered"]), summary
    # Herscan: geen duplicaat.
    again = scan_library(actor="b57-test")
    assert again["registered"] == [], again
    assert len(again["duplicates"]) == 2, again
    assert len(library_models(limit=10)) == 2

def test_bambu_argv_pure_no_execution(tmp_path):
    from coordinator.app.local_slicer import (
        LocalSlicerError,
        bambu_slice_argv,
    )
    mach = str(tmp_path / "m.json")
    proc = str(tmp_path / "p.json")
    fila = str(tmp_path / "f.json")
    stl = str(tmp_path / "kubus.stl")
    for path in (mach, proc, fila, stl):
        with open(path, "w") as handle:
            handle.write("{}")
    argv = bambu_slice_argv(
        binary="bambu-studio", stl_path=stl, machine_json=mach,
        process_json=proc, filament_json=fila,
        output_3mf="out.gcode.3mf",
        overrides={"--curr-bed-type": "Cool Plate"})
    assert argv[:3] == ["bambu-studio", "--orient", "--arrange"]
    assert "--slice" in argv and "out.gcode.3mf" in argv
    assert argv[-1] == stl
    assert "--curr-bed-type=Cool Plate" in argv
    try:
        bambu_slice_argv(
            binary="bambu-studio", stl_path=stl, machine_json=mach,
            process_json=proc, filament_json=str(tmp_path / "weg"),
            output_3mf="out.gcode.3mf")
        raise AssertionError("missing filament accepted")
    except LocalSlicerError:
        pass
    try:
        bambu_slice_argv(
            binary="bambu-studio", stl_path=stl, machine_json=mach,
            process_json=proc, filament_json=fila,
            output_3mf="out.gcode.3mf",
            overrides={"no-dashes": "x"})
        raise AssertionError("bad override accepted")
    except LocalSlicerError:
        pass

def test_real_slice_prusa_console(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import create_fabjob, get_fabjob
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        pid = _printer(tmp_path, monkeypatch, test_client)
        mid, root = _library_kubus(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
        job = create_fabjob(mid, material_ref="PLA", printer_id=pid,
                            profile="fine-pla", actor="b57-test")
        jid = job["job_id"]
        prepared = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/prepare", json={}).json()
        assert prepared["stage"] == "prepared", prepared
        sliced = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/slice",
            json={"slicer": "prusa-console"}).json()
        assert sliced["stage"] == "gcode-ready", sliced
        assert sliced["slicer_engine"] == "prusa", sliced
        assert sliced["gcode_verdict"] in ("safe", "inconclusive"), \
            sliced
        assert len(sliced["gcode_sha256"]) == 64
        assert sliced["gcode_canonical_ref"].startswith("gcode/"), \
            sliced
        stored = get_fabjob(jid)
        assert stored["gcode_sha256"] == sliced["gcode_sha256"]
        # Canonical artifact echt op schijf, working copy ook.
        import os
        canon = os.path.join(str(root), sliced["gcode_canonical_ref"])
        assert os.path.isfile(canon), canon
        assert os.path.getsize(canon) > 10000, canon


def test_supports_profile_changes_output(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import create_fabjob, get_fabjob
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        pid = _printer(tmp_path, monkeypatch, test_client)
        mid, _ = _library_kubus(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
        plain = create_fabjob(mid, printer_id=pid,
                              profile="fine-pla", actor="b57-test")
        sup = create_fabjob(mid, printer_id=pid,
                            profile="fine-pla-supports",
                            actor="b57-test")
        for jid in (plain["job_id"], sup["job_id"]):
            test_client.post(
                f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/prepare", json={})
        plain_s = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{plain['job_id']}/slice",
            json={"slicer": "prusa-console"}).json()
        sup_s = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{sup['job_id']}/slice",
            json={"slicer": "prusa-console"}).json()
        assert plain_s["stage"] == "gcode-ready", plain_s
        assert sup_s["stage"] == "gcode-ready", sup_s
        assert plain_s["gcode_sha256"] != sup_s["gcode_sha256"], \
            "supports-profiel moet andere G-code geven"

def _spool(test_client, material="PLA", weight=500.0, color="wit",
           compatible=()):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/filament/spools", json={
        "material": material, "weight_g": weight, "color": color,
        "compatible_profiles": list(compatible)})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
    return res.json()["spool_id"]


def _ready_job(test_client, tmp_path, monkeypatch, profile="fine-pla",
               spool_compat=(), spool_weight=500.0):
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import create_fabjob
    pid = _printer(tmp_path, monkeypatch, test_client)
    mid, _ = _library_kubus(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    sid = _spool(test_client, weight=spool_weight,
                 compatible=spool_compat)
    test_client.post(f"/api/v1/filament/spools/{sid}/assign", json={
        "printer_id": pid, "slot": "AMS-2"})
    job = create_fabjob(mid, material_ref="PLA", printer_id=pid,
                        profile=profile, spool_id=sid,
                        actor="b57-test")
    jid = job["job_id"]
    test_client.post(f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/prepare",
                     json={})
    sliced = test_client.post(
        f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/slice",
        json={"slicer": "prusa-console"}).json()
    assert sliced["stage"] == "gcode-ready", sliced
    return jid, pid, sid, mid

def test_preflight_blockers(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import create_fabjob
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        pid = _printer(tmp_path, monkeypatch, test_client)
        mid, _ = _library_kubus(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
        # Zonder spoel: blokkade.
        bare = create_fabjob(mid, printer_id=pid, profile="fine-pla",
                             actor="b57-test")
        test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{bare['job_id']}/prepare",
            json={})
        test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{bare['job_id']}/slice",
            json={"slicer": "prusa-console"})
        gate = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{bare['job_id']}/preflight",
            json={}).json()
        assert gate["ok"] is False, gate
        assert any("spoel" in blocker for blocker in
                   gate["blockers"]), gate
        # Verkeerd materiaal: blokkade.
        sid = _spool(test_client, material="ABS", weight=500.0)
        job = create_fabjob(mid, printer_id=pid, profile="fine-pla",
                            spool_id=sid, actor="b57-test")
        test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{job['job_id']}/prepare",
            json={})
        test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{job['job_id']}/slice",
            json={"slicer": "prusa-console"})
        gate = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{job['job_id']}/preflight",
            json={}).json()
        assert gate["ok"] is False, gate
        assert any("ABS" in blocker or "PLA" in blocker
                   for blocker in gate["blockers"]), gate

def test_enqueue_full_chain(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        jid, pid, sid, _ = _ready_job(
            test_client, tmp_path, monkeypatch,
            spool_compat=["fine-pla"])
        proposed = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/propose",
            json={"actor": "b57-test"}).json()
        assert proposed["stage"] == "proposed", proposed
        # Zonder YES: 409, geen taak.
        early = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/enqueue", json={})
        assert early.status_code == 409, early.text
        _approve_proposal(test_client, proposed["proposal_id"])
        gate = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/preflight",
            json={}).json()
        assert gate["ok"] is True, gate
        assert gate["estimate_g"] is not None and \
            gate["estimate_g"] > 0, gate
        queued = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/enqueue", json={}).json()
        assert queued["existing"] is False, queued
        task_id = queued["task_id"]
        tasks = test_client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
        mine = [task for task in tasks
                if task["id"] == task_id][0]
        assert mine["kind"] == "print.execute", mine
        assert mine["status"] == "queued", mine
        assert mine["required_capabilities"] == ["printer.start"], \
            mine
        assert mine["payload"]["print_job_id"] == jid, mine
        assert mine["payload"]["proposal_id"] == \
            proposed["proposal_id"], mine
        # Herhaald: zelfde taak, geen duplicaat.
        again = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/enqueue", json={}).json()
        assert again == {"task_id": task_id, "existing": True,
                        "job_id": jid}, again


def test_enqueue_stale_proposal_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import os
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        jid, pid, sid, _ = _ready_job(
            test_client, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
        proposed = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/propose",
            json={"actor": "b57-test"}).json()
        _approve_proposal(test_client, proposed["proposal_id"])
        # Saboteer de werk kopie: sha komt niet meer overeen.
        fab = os.environ.get("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR", "")
        hit = [name for name in os.listdir(fab)
               if name.endswith(".gcode")]
        assert hit, "werk kopie ontbreekt"
        with open(os.path.join(fab, hit[0]), "ab") as handle:
            handle.write(b"; sabotage\n")
        stale = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/enqueue", json={})
        assert stale.status_code == 422, stale.text
        gate = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/preflight",
            json={}).json()
        assert gate["ok"] is False, gate

def test_dossier_complete_and_honest(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import get_fabjob
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        jid, pid, sid, mid = _ready_job(
            test_client, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
        proposed = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/propose",
            json={"actor": "b57-test"}).json()
        _approve_proposal(test_client, proposed["proposal_id"])
        test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/enqueue", json={})
        job = get_fabjob(jid)
        dossier = {
            "job_id": job["job_id"],
            "stage": job["stage"],
            "model_id": job["model_id"],
            "profile": job["profile"],
            "spool_id": job["spool_id"],
            "printer_id": job["printer_id"],
            "gcode_ref": job["gcode_ref"],
            "gcode_sha256": job["gcode_sha256"],
            "gcode_verdict": job["gcode_verdict"],
            "slicer_engine": job["slicer_engine"],
            "proposal_id": job["proposal_id"],
            "queue_task_id": job["queue_task_id"],
            "history": job["history"],
        }
        assert dossier["model_id"] == mid
        assert dossier["profile"] == "fine-pla"
        assert dossier["spool_id"] == sid
        assert dossier["printer_id"] == pid
        assert len(dossier["gcode_sha256"]) == 64
        assert dossier["gcode_verdict"] in ("safe", "inconclusive")
        assert dossier["slicer_engine"] == "prusa"
        assert dossier["proposal_id"] == proposed["proposal_id"]
        assert dossier["queue_task_id"] > 0
        assert len(dossier["history"]) >= 5, dossier["history"]
        stages = [entry["stage"] for entry in dossier["history"]]
        for expected in ("designed", "prepared", "sliced",
                         "gcode-ready", "proposed", "queued"):
            assert expected in stages, stages
        html = test_client.get("/3d").text
        for marker in ("Geschiedenis", "reconstrueerbaar",
                       str(dossier["queue_task_id"]),
                       dossier["gcode_sha256"][:12]):
            assert marker in html, marker

def test_deduct_exactly_once(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.fabrication import (
        FabricationRefusedError,
        deduct_spool,
        list_spools,
        new_spool,
        save_spool,
    )
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        spool = new_spool("PLA", 500.0)
        save_spool(spool)
        sid = spool.spool_id
        first = deduct_spool(sid, 4.45, reason="print:task-1",
                             usage_key="print:1")
        assert first["deducted"] is True, first
        assert first["remaining_g"] == 495.55, first
        replay = deduct_spool(sid, 4.45, reason="print:task-1",
                              usage_key="print:1")
        assert replay["deducted"] is False, replay
        weight = [item for item in list_spools()
                  if item.spool_id == sid][0].weight_remaining_g
        assert weight == 495.55, weight
        second = deduct_spool(sid, 1.0, reason="print:task-2",
                              usage_key="print:2")
        assert second["deducted"] is True, second
        for bad in (0, -1, 100000):
            try:
                deduct_spool(sid, bad, reason="x", usage_key="k-bad")
                raise AssertionError(f"accepted {bad}")
            except FabricationRefusedError:
                pass
        try:
            deduct_spool(sid, 99999, reason="x", usage_key="k-huge")
            raise AssertionError("overdraft accepted")
        except FabricationRefusedError:
            pass


def test_no_caller_deducts_outside_execution():
    import pathlib
    app = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \
        "coordinator" / "app"
    for path in app.glob("*.py"):
        if path.name == "fabrication.py":
            continue
        lines = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        current_def = ""
        for lineno, line in enumerate(lines, 1):
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.startswith("def "):
                current_def = stripped[4:].split("(")[0]
            if "deduct_spool(" in line:
                assert current_def == "finalize_print_task", \
                    f"{path.name}:{lineno} buiten finalize"

def test_duplicate_slot_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.fabrication import (
        FabricationRefusedError,
        assign_spool_location,
        new_spool,
        save_spool,
    )
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        pid = _printer(tmp_path, monkeypatch, test_client)
        first = new_spool("PLA", 500.0)
        save_spool(first)
        second = new_spool("PLA", 500.0)
        save_spool(second)
        assign_spool_location(first.spool_id, printer_id=pid,
                              slot="AMS-1")
        try:
            assign_spool_location(second.spool_id, printer_id=pid,
                                  slot="AMS-1")
            raise AssertionError("duplicate slot accepted")
        except FabricationRefusedError as error:
            assert "bevat al" in str(error), error
        assign_spool_location(second.spool_id, printer_id=pid,
                              slot="AMS-2")


def test_slot_snapshot_in_payload(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        jid, pid, sid, _ = _ready_job(
            test_client, tmp_path, monkeypatch)
        proposed = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/propose",
            json={"actor": "b575-test"}).json()
        _approve_proposal(test_client, proposed["proposal_id"])
        queued = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workshop/fabjobs/{jid}/enqueue", json={}).json()
        tasks = test_client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
        mine = [task for task in tasks
                if task["id"] == queued["task_id"]][0]
        assert mine["payload"]["slot"] == "AMS-2", mine["payload"]
        assert mine["payload"]["spool_material"] == "PLA", \
            mine["payload"]
        # Spoel verhuizen ná enqueue: snapshot blijft staan.
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/filament/spools/{sid}/assign",
                         json={"printer_id": pid, "slot": "AMS-3"})
        tasks = test_client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
        mine = [task for task in tasks
                if task["id"] == queued["task_id"]][0]

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_canvas.py">
"""Infinite Canvas MVP (/canvas): additive workshop lens, no new truth.

Render tests over tmp databases: page shape, workspace scoping,
area payload, search/focus/reset controls, no persistence
anywhere. Behavioural JS (drag/camera) is client-side by
construction — asserted structurally.
"""
import sqlite3
from contextlib import contextmanager

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.main import _world_scoped_graph


@contextmanager
def _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "fab"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        yield client


def test_canvas_empty_is_honest(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    with _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch) as client:
        res = client.get("/canvas")
        assert res.status_code == 200
        assert "quiet workbench" in res.text
        assert "Back to World" in res.text
        assert "csearch" in res.text and "creset" in res.text
        assert "localStorage" not in res.text


def test_canvas_world_links_and_nav(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    with _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch) as client:
        res = client.get("/canvas")
        assert "Canvas" in res.text  # nav entry present
        world = client.get("/world")
        assert world.status_code == 200
        assert "/canvas" in world.text  # World → Canvas link
        assert "World Graph" in world.text  # /world unchanged


def test_canvas_no_backend_writes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Hitting /canvas (empty + scoped) creates no canvas tables,
    columns or records anywhere."""
    with _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch) as client:
        client.get("/canvas")
        client.get("/canvas", params={"workspace": "camper"})
        import glob as _glob
        for db_file in _glob.glob(str(tmp_path / "*.db")):
            con = sqlite3.connect(db_file)
            try:
                tables = [row[0] for row in con.execute(
                    "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master "
                    "WHERE type='table'")]
                assert not any("canvas" in name.lower()
                               for name in tables), tables
                for table in tables:
                    cols = [row[1] for row in con.execute(
                        f"PRAGMA table_info({table})")]
                    assert not any(
                        "canvas" in col.lower() or "position"
                        in col.lower() for col in cols), (table, cols)
            finally:
                con.close()


def test_canvas_no_post_routes():
    """The canvas adds reads only: no POST/PUT/DELETE canvas routes."""
    routes = [(sorted(methods), path)
              for route in main_mod.app.routes
              for methods, path in [(
                  getattr(route, "methods", set()) or set(),
                  getattr(route, "path", ""))]
              if "canvas" in path.lower()]
    assert routes, "expected the GET /canvas route"
    for methods, path in routes:
        assert methods == ["GET"], (methods, path)


def test_scoped_helper_shared_by_world_and_canvas():
    graph = {"nodes": [{"id": "proj_a", "type": "project",
                        "label": "A", "source": "inventory",
                        "metadata": {}}],
             "edges": []}
    scoped, wid, notice, keep = _world_scoped_graph(
        dict(graph), "", {"entity_id": "proj_a"}, base="/canvas")
    assert wid == "" and notice == "" and keep is None
    assert scoped["nodes"] == graph["nodes"]
