<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_capability_matching.py">
"""Tests for M6.2 deterministic capability matching (data only).

No network, no subprocess, no filesystem writes, no hardware. Matching is
pure: the same inputs always yield the same verdicts.
"""
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from pydantic import ValidationError

from coordinator.app.adapters import ReferenceNoopAdapter
from coordinator.app.capability_matching import (
    AdapterRegistry,
    MatchVerdict,
    ModelInfo,
    NodeInfo,
    TaskIntent,
    default_registry,
    match_task,
    propose_for_match,
)
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance


def registry():
    return default_registry()


def model(model_id="mod_cam", model_type="vision", capabilities=("ocr", "detect")):
    return ModelInfo(model_id=model_id, model_type=model_type,
                     capabilities=list(capabilities))


def task(requirements=("ocr",), task_id="task_1"):
    return TaskIntent(task_id=task_id, requirements=list(requirements))


def node(node_id="node-1", capabilities=()):
    return NodeInfo(node_id=node_id, capabilities=list(capabilities))


# --- matching --------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_exact_match_yields_candidate():
    verdicts = match_task(task(), [model()], registry())
    assert len(verdicts) == 1
    verdict = verdicts[0]
    assert verdict.compatible is True
    assert verdict.matched_requirements == ["ocr"]
    assert verdict.missing_requirements == []
    assert verdict.model_id == "mod_cam"
    assert verdict.adapter_id == "reference-noop"
    assert verdict.task_id == "task_1"
    assert verdict.reasons == []


def test_missing_capability_denies():
    verdicts = match_task(task(("ocr", "thermal")), [model()], registry())
    assert len(verdicts) == 1
    verdict = verdicts[0]
    assert verdict.compatible is False
    assert verdict.matched_requirements == ["ocr"]
    assert verdict.missing_requirements == ["thermal"]
    assert any("thermal" in reason for reason in verdict.reasons)


def test_multiple_candidates_deterministic_order():
    models = [model("mod_b"), model("mod_a")]
    first = match_task(task(), models, registry())
    second = match_task(task(), list(reversed(models)), registry())
    assert [v.model_id for v in first] == ["mod_a", "mod_b"]
    assert first == second


def test_empty_requirements_match_all_by_policy():
    verdicts = match_task(task(requirements=()), [model()], registry())
    assert len(verdicts) == 1
    assert verdicts[0].compatible is True
    assert verdicts[0].matched_requirements == []


def test_unknown_model_has_no_verdict():
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        ModelInfo(model_id="proj_x", model_type="vision", capabilities=["ocr"])
    verdicts = match_task(task(), [{"model_id": "proj_x"}], registry())
    assert verdicts == []


def test_unknown_adapter_has_no_verdicts():
    verdicts = match_task(task(), [model()], registry(), adapter_id="ghost")
    assert verdicts == []


def test_capability_mismatch_and_normalization():
    verdicts = match_task(task(("OCR", " Lidar ")), [model()], registry())
    assert verdicts[0].compatible is False
    assert verdicts[0].missing_requirements == ["lidar"]
    verdicts = match_task(task(("OCR",)), [model()], registry())
    assert verdicts[0].compatible is True


def test_model_type_and_node_gates():
    reg = AdapterRegistry()
    reg.register(ReferenceNoopAdapter(), model_types={"ocr"},
                 required_node_capabilities={"camera"})
    verdicts = match_task(task(("ocr",)), [model("mod_x", "vision", ("ocr",))],
                          reg, node=node())
    assert verdicts[0].compatible is False
    assert any("vision" in reason for reason in verdicts[0].reasons)
    verdicts = match_task(task(("ocr",)), [model("mod_x", "ocr", ("ocr",))],
                          reg, node=node())
    assert verdicts[0].compatible is False
    assert verdicts[0].missing_node_capabilities == ["camera"]
    verdicts = match_task(task(("ocr",)), [model("mod_x", "ocr", ("ocr",))],
                          reg, node=node(capabilities=["camera"]))
    assert verdicts[0].compatible is True
    assert verdicts[0].node_id == "node-1"


# --- proposals ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_compatible_verdict_proposes_with_approval():
    verdicts = match_task(task(), [model()], registry())
    proposal = propose_for_match(
        verdicts[0], registry(), "mreq-1",
        provenance=Provenance(source_type="user-created", creator_id="tester",
                              human_verified=True))
    assert proposal.requires_approval is True
    assert proposal.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert proposal.provenance.source_type == "ai-generated"
    assert "user-created/tester" in (proposal.provenance.notes or "")
    assert proposal.model_id == "mod_cam"
    assert proposal.task_id == "task_1"


def test_incompatible_verdict_never_proposes():
    verdicts = match_task(task(("thermal",)), [model()], registry())
    assert verdicts[0].compatible is False
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        propose_for_match(verdicts[0], registry(), "mreq-1")


# --- absence of execution ---------------------------------------------------------------

EXECUTION_ATTRS = ("execute", "act", "run", "infer", "fetch", "download",
                   "shell", "perform", "dispatch", "invoke")


def test_no_execution_attributes():
    import coordinator.app.capability_matching as matching_mod
    for name in dir(matching_mod):
        if name.startswith("__"):
            continue
        assert name.lower() not in EXECUTION_ATTRS, f"module must not offer {name}"
    for cls in (AdapterRegistry, MatchVerdict, ModelInfo, NodeInfo, TaskIntent):
        for name in dir(cls):
            assert name.lower() not in EXECUTION_ATTRS


def test_implementation_has_no_io_tokens():
    source = (Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
              / "coordinator" / "app" / "capability_matching.py").read_text(
                  encoding="utf-8")
    for token in ("subprocess", "os.system", "socket", "httpx", "requests",
                  "torch", "transformers", "ollama", "serial", "GPIO",
                  "threading", "asyncio", "pathlib", "shutil", "open(",
                  "execute", "infer", "fetch", "download"):
        assert token not in source, f"matching layer must not use {token}"

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_capture_probe.py">
"""Capture probe tests: isolated enumeration verdicts, all via
mocked subprocess — the real SetupDi walk never runs in tests."""

import json
import subprocess

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.capture_probe as probe_mod
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "probe.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "probe-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", "probe-operator")
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


class _Done:
    def __init__(self, returncode=0, stdout="", stderr=""):
        self.returncode = returncode
        self.stdout = stdout
        self.stderr = stderr


def _payload(devices):
    return json.dumps({"supported": True, "devices": devices,
                       "reason": ""})


def test_probe_found_and_none(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    calls = []

    def fake_run(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append(kwargs)
        return _Done(0, _payload([{"name": "Insta360 Link",
                                   "path": "usb\\vid_1234"}]))
    monkeypatch.setattr(probe_mod.subprocess, "run", fake_run)
    out = probe_mod.run_probe(timeout=10)
    assert out["state"] == "found"
    assert out["devices"][0]["name"] == "Insta360 Link"
    assert out["elapsed_ms"] >= 0

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe_mod.subprocess, "run",
        lambda *a, **k: _Done(0, _payload([])))
    out = probe_mod.run_probe()
    assert out["state"] == "none_found"
    assert out["devices"] == []


def test_probe_timeout_crash_error(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    def fake_timeout(*args, **kwargs):
        raise subprocess.TimeoutExpired(cmd="x", timeout=1)
    monkeypatch.setattr(probe_mod.subprocess, "run", fake_timeout)
    out = probe_mod.run_probe(timeout=5)
    assert out["state"] == "timeout"

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe_mod.subprocess, "run",
        lambda *a, **k: _Done(-1073741819, "", "boom"))
    out = probe_mod.run_probe()
    assert out["state"] == "crashed"

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe_mod.subprocess, "run",
        lambda *a, **k: _Done(0, "not-json{{{"))
    out = probe_mod.run_probe()
    assert out["state"] == "error"

    def fake_oserror(*args, **kwargs):
        raise OSError("noexec")
    monkeypatch.setattr(probe_mod.subprocess, "run", fake_oserror)
    out = probe_mod.run_probe()
    assert out["state"] == "error"

    out = probe_mod.run_probe(timeout="veel")
    assert out["state"] == "error"


def test_probe_never_claims_capture(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe_mod.subprocess, "run",
        lambda *a, **k: _Done(0, _payload([{"name": "Cam"}])))
    out = probe_mod.run_probe()
    assert "captur" not in str(out).lower()
    assert out["state"] == "found"


def test_probe_route_and_validation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe_mod.subprocess, "run",
        lambda *a, **k: _Done(0, _payload([])))
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ok = test_client.post("/api/v1/cameras/probe", json={})
        assert ok.status_code == 200, ok.text
        assert ok.json()["state"] == "none_found"
        ok2 = test_client.post("/api/v1/cameras/probe",
                               json={"timeout": 5})
        assert ok2.status_code == 200
        bad = test_client.post("/api/v1/cameras/probe",
                               json={"timeout": 9999})
        assert bad.status_code == 422
        bad2 = test_client.post("/api/v1/cameras/probe",
                                json={"timeout": "lang"})
        assert bad2.status_code == 422

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_cockpit.py">
"""Workspace development cockpit (E2E over existing stores).

The workspace detail page works as a cockpit: ACTIVE WORKSTREAMS
with OPEN deep-links into existing routes, a MAIN conversation
tree from proven fork bookkeeping only, PENDING HUMAN ACTIONS
pointing at existing gates, ACTIVITY from existing events, and
SHARED RESOURCES (workers, Forge, research, INVENTory) with
fail-soft UNAVAILABLE. No new table, queue, bus, scheduler,
engine or approval flow anywhere in this pass.

World reads and providers are faked; the worker socket is mocked
at the httpx boundary only. No INVENTory server runs here, so the
shared INVENTory panel must honestly read UNAVAILABLE.
"""

import httpx

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
import node_client.main as node_main
from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

WS = "cockpit-ws"
QUESTION = "Is hennepvezel geschikt als isolatie voor een camper?"
SEED = "https://example.com/hennep-cockpit"
TOKEN_1 = "cockpit-token-1-abcdef-123456"
TOKEN_2 = "cockpit-token-2-abcdef-123456"
NODE_1 = "linux-1"
NODE_2 = "linux-2"
FETCHED_TEXT = "Hennepvezel isoleert goed en is dampopen."


class FakeReader:
    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query=q, results=[], total=0)

    async def browse(self, type=None):
        return await self.search("", type)


class FakeProvider:
    async def advise(self, question, records):
        return AdviceResponse(
            question=question, advice="advies zonder voorstel",
            model="fake-local", records_used=len(records), sources=[])


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat-state.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "fab"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader",
                        lambda: FakeReader())
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "get_provider",
                        lambda name=None, **k: FakeProvider())
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register(client, node_id, caps, token):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": caps, "node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def chat(client, message, project_ref=WS):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={
        "message": message, "project_ref": project_ref})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()


def mock_socket(monkeypatch, text=FETCHED_TEXT):
    def handler(request):
        return _FakeResponse(
            200, {"content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8"},
            text.encode("utf-8"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        httpx, "Client", lambda *a, **k: _MockClient(handler))


class _FakeResponse:
    def __init__(self, status_code, headers, content):
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.headers = headers
        self.content = content


class _MockClient:
    def __init__(self, handler):
        self._handler = handler

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        return False

    def get(self, url, headers=None):
        from unittest.mock import Mock
        request = Mock(url=url, headers=headers or {})
        return self._handler(request)


def build_cockpit(client):
    """Research stream + plain mission + fabricate mission. Returns ids."""
    register(client, NODE_1, ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_1)
    register(client, NODE_2, ["system_inventory"], TOKEN_2)
    conv_a = chat(client, "draad A")["conversation_id"]
    conv_b = chat(client, "draad B")["conversation_id"]
    forked = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_b}/fork", json={}).json()
    started = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/research", json={
            "question": QUESTION, "route": "node-first",
            "seed_urls": [SEED], "conversation_id": conv_a,
            "max_sources": 6})
    assert started.status_code == 201, started.text
    started = started.json()
    mission_b = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": conv_b,
        "goal": "Werkplaats inventariseren",
        "steps": [{"kind": "readout",
                   "description": "lees git status",
                   "parameters": {"source": "git-status"}}],
        "max_steps": 5})
    assert mission_b.status_code == 201, mission_b.text
    mission_b = mission_b.json()
    mission_c = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": forked["conversation_id"],
        "goal": "Forge bracket 20mm",
        "steps": [{"kind": "fabricate",
                   "description": "genereer test-bracket",
                   "parameters": {"description": "test bracket",
                                  "method": "procedural-test"}}],
        "max_steps": 3})
    assert mission_c.status_code == 201, mission_c.text
    mission_c = mission_c.json()
    return {
        "conv_a": conv_a, "conv_b": conv_b,
        "conv_fork": forked["conversation_id"],
        "mission_a": started["mission_id"],
        "run_a": started["run_id"],
        "task_a": started["task_ids"][0],
        "mission_b": mission_b["mission_id"],
        "mission_c": mission_c["mission_id"],
    }


def test_a_all_conversations_shown(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ids = build_cockpit(client)
        view = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/workstreams").json()
        assert {ids["conv_a"], ids["conv_b"],
                ids["conv_fork"]} <= {
            item["conversation_id"]
            for item in view["conversations"]}
        page = client.get(f"/workspaces/{WS}").text
        assert page.count("convtree") >= 1
        for cid in (ids["conv_a"], ids["conv_b"],
                    ids["conv_fork"]):
            assert cid[:20] in page or cid in page


def test_b_multiple_workstreams_shown(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        ids = build_cockpit(client)

            f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/workstreams").json()
        by_id = {stream["mission_id"]: stream
                 for stream in view["workstreams"]}

                ids["mission_c"]} <= set(by_id)
        page = client.get(f"/workspaces/{WS}").text
        assert "ACTIVE WORKSTREAMS" in page
        assert "Werkplaats inventariseren" in page
        assert "Forge bracket 20mm" in page


def test_c_streams_stay_independent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ids = build_cockpit(client)
        # Forge stream approves + ticks while research waits.
        approved = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{ids['mission_c']}/approve",
            json={"response": "YES", "decided_by": "human"})
        assert approved.status_code == 200, approved.text
        ticked = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{ids['mission_c']}/tick")
        assert ticked.status_code == 200, ticked.text
        mission_a = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{ids['mission_a']}").json()
        mission_b = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{ids['mission_b']}").json()

        assert mission_b["status"] == "pending_approval"
        mission_c = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{ids['mission_c']}").json()
        assert mission_c["steps"][0]["status"] == "completed"
        # Research stream still claims independently afterwards.
        claimed = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{NODE_1}",
            params={"node_token": TOKEN_1}).json()
        assert claimed["id"] == ids["task_a"]

def test_e_original_untouched_by_fork(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conv = chat(client, "origineel")["conversation_id"]
        before = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}").json()
        forked = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}/fork", json={}).json()
        assert forked["conversation_id"] != conv
        after = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}").json()

def test_m_no_new_database_or_tables(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import pathlib
    import sqlite3
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ids = build_cockpit(client)
        _ = ids
        client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/workstreams")
        client.get(f"/workspaces/{WS}")
        tables: set[str] = set()
        for name in ("queue.db", "chat-state.db"):
            path = tmp_path / name
            assert path.exists()
            db = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
            try:
                tables.update(
                    row[0] for row in db.execute(
                        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master "
                        "WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE "
                        "'sqlite_%'"))
            finally:
                db.close()
        sources = list(pathlib.Path("coordinator/app").glob("*.py"))
        declared: dict[str, str] = {}
        for source in sources:
            text = source.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
            for line in text.splitlines():
                upper = line.upper()
                if "CREATE TABLE" in upper:
                    for table in tables:
                        if table.lower() in line.lower():
                            declared.setdefault(table,
                                                source.name)
        assert "CREATE TABLE" not in pathlib.Path(
            "coordinator/app/workspaces.py").read_text(
            encoding="utf-8")
        undeclared = tables - set(declared)
        assert not undeclared, undeclared


def test_n_no_new_queue_bus_or_scheduler(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import pathlib
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ids = build_cockpit(client)

        from coordinator.app.database import (
            chat_connection as _chat_conn,
        )
        from coordinator.app.database import connection as _conn
        with _conn() as db:
            tasks_before = db.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks").fetchone()["n"]
        with _chat_conn() as db:
            bus_before = db.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM interface_events"
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            stored_before = db.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM conversation_events"
            ).fetchone()["n"]
        client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/workstreams")
        client.get(f"/workspaces/{WS}")
        with _conn() as db:
            tasks_after = db.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks").fetchone()["n"]
        with _chat_conn() as db:
            bus_after = db.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM interface_events"
            ).fetchone()["n"]
            stored_after = db.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM conversation_events"
            ).fetchone()["n"]
        assert tasks_after == tasks_before
        assert bus_after == bus_before
        assert stored_after == stored_before
        text = pathlib.Path(
            "coordinator/app/workspaces.py").read_text(
            encoding="utf-8")
        for banned in ("threading", "BackgroundTasks",
                       "create_task", "asyncio", "sched",
                       "INSERT INTO tasks", "INSERT INTO missions"):
            assert banned not in text, banned

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_concurrency.py">
"""FASE 1 tests (BIG #16): SQLite concurrency foundation.

WAL + busy_timeout must let concurrent local writers
serialize instead of failing with "database is locked".
Threads share nothing except the database files; every
thread opens its own short-lived connection.
"""

import sqlite3
import threading

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.database import BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS, connection
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance


def setup_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "conc.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "conc-chat.db"))


def pragmas(path):
    db = sqlite3.connect(str(path))
    try:
        journal = db.execute(
            "PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0]
        timeout = db.execute(
            "PRAGMA busy_timeout").fetchone()[0]
    finally:
        db.close()
    return journal.lower(), timeout


def test_connection_uses_wal_and_busy_timeout(tmp_path,
                                              monkeypatch):
    setup_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    from coordinator.app.database import (
        _open_db, chat_database_path)
    from coordinator.app.database import database_path
    db = _open_db(database_path())
    try:
        assert db.execute(
            "PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0] == "wal"
        assert db.execute(
            "PRAGMA busy_timeout").fetchone()[0] == \
            BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS
    finally:
        db.close()
    chat = _open_db(chat_database_path())
    try:
        assert chat.execute(
            "PRAGMA journal_mode").fetchone()[0] == "wal"
        assert chat.execute(
            "PRAGMA busy_timeout").fetchone()[0] == \
            BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS
    finally:
        chat.close()
    # WAL persists on the file itself (visible to any reader).
    journal, _ = pragmas(tmp_path / "conc.db")
    assert journal == "wal"


def test_concurrent_claim_single_winner(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    setup_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        for node_id in ("conc-a", "conc-b"):
            assert client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
                "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "h",
                "capabilities": [
                    "exec:system_inventory"],
                "node_token": f"conc-token-{node_id}-123"}
            ).status_code == 201
        task = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": [
                "exec:system_inventory"]}).json()
    barrier = threading.Barrier(2)
    results = {}
    errors = []

    def claim(node_id):
        try:
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
            results[node_id] = main_mod._claim_task(
                node_id, main_mod.now(),
                node_token=f"conc-token-{node_id}-123")
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            errors.append(error)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=claim, args=(node_id,))
               for node_id in ("conc-a", "conc-b")]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join(timeout=30)
    assert not errors, errors
    winners = [node_id for node_id, claimed in results.items()
               if claimed is not None]
    assert len(winners) == 1
    assert winners[0] in ("conc-a", "conc-b")
    with connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT status, assigned_node_id FROM "
                         "tasks WHERE id=?", (task["id"],)).fetchone()
    assert row["status"] == "assigned"
    assert row["assigned_node_id"] == winners[0]


def test_concurrent_event_writes_no_lock(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    setup_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    barrier = threading.Barrier(8)
    errors = []

    def write(index):
        try:
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
            main_mod.emit_event("conc.write", f"event {index}")
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            errors.append(error)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=write, args=(index,))
               for index in range(8)]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join(timeout=30)
    assert not errors, errors


def test_concurrent_sync_apply_converges(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    setup_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    from coordinator.app.diststate import (
        DistEnvelope, apply_envelope)
    envelope = DistEnvelope(
        event_id="dsevt_conc1", origin_node_id="conc-a",

        payload={"note": "x"},
        provenance=Provenance(source_type="sensor-observed",
                              creator_id="conc",
                              human_verified=False),
        epoch=0)
    barrier = threading.Barrier(4)
    outcomes = []
    errors = []

    def apply():
        try:
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
            outcomes.append(apply_envelope(envelope)["status"])
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            errors.append(error)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=apply) for _ in range(4)]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join(timeout=30)
    assert not errors, errors
    assert sorted(outcomes).count("applied") == 1
    assert sorted(outcomes).count("duplicate") == 3

                             limit=200)) == 6

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_controlled_writes.py">
"""Controlled-write foundation tests (BIG #5).

The generic proposal/approval/result layer: allow-listed mutations,
exact-YES binding, fingerprint revalidation, staleness, and the
approval-is-not-verification rule.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import (
    decide_write,
    is_stale,
    propose_write,
    request_write_approval,
    revalidate,
    write_fingerprint,
)
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance


def ai_provenance() -> Provenance:
    return Provenance(source_type="ai-generated", creator_id="qwen",
                      human_verified=False)


def make_proposal(proposal_id="wrt-test1"):
    return propose_write(
        proposal_id, "inventory.create", "inventory:object",
        {"entity_type": "object",
         "fields": {"name": "Testonderdeel"}},
        actor="mycelium-test", provenance=ai_provenance())


def test_valid_proposal_is_inert_and_fingerprinted():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    assert proposal.mutation_type == "inventory.create"
    assert proposal.provenance.human_verified is False
    fingerprint = write_fingerprint(proposal)
    assert len(fingerprint) == 64
    # Deterministic for identical content (round-trip stable) ...
    assert write_fingerprint(proposal.model_copy()) == fingerprint
    assert write_fingerprint(
        proposal.model_validate(proposal.model_dump())) == fingerprint
    # ... and unique per proposal instance (created_at binds it).
    assert write_fingerprint(make_proposal()) != fingerprint


def test_unknown_mutation_type_refused():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown mutation type"):
        propose_write("wrt-x", "database.drop_table", "inventory:object",
                      {}, actor="mycelium-test",
                      provenance=ai_provenance())


def test_free_form_mutations_not_expressible():
    for bad in ("shell.exec", "python.eval", "sql.raw", "http.post",
                "inventory.delete", "git.push", "git.force_push"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unknown mutation type"):
            propose_write("wrt-x", bad, "target", {},
                          actor="mycelium-test",
                          provenance=ai_provenance())


def test_proposal_never_claims_human_verification():
    bad = Provenance(source_type="ai-generated", creator_id="qwen",
                     human_verified=True)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="never claim human verification"):
        propose_write("wrt-x", "inventory.create", "inventory:object",
                      {}, actor="mycelium-test", provenance=bad)


def test_exact_yes_approves_anything_else_denies():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    approved = decide_write(request, proposal, "YES",
                            decided_by="jelles")
    assert approved.approved is True
    assert approved.decision == "approved"
    assert approved.fingerprint == write_fingerprint(proposal)
    for response in ("yes", "Yes", "NO", "OK", "", "JA"):
        denied = decide_write(request, proposal, response)
        assert denied.approved is False
        assert denied.decision == "rejected"


def test_approval_binds_exact_content():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    tampered = proposal.model_copy(
        update={"payload": {"entity_type": "object",
                            "fields": {"name": "Ander onderdeel"}}})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="differs from the approved"):
        decide_write(request, tampered, "YES")


def test_approval_binds_proposal_id():
    proposal = make_proposal("wrt-a")
    other = make_proposal("wrt-b")
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="does not match"):
        decide_write(request, other, "YES")


def test_stale_proposal_refuses():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    # Far future: expired long ago.
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="stale"):
        decide_write(request, proposal, "YES",
                     now_str="2999-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
    assert is_stale(proposal, "2999-01-01T00:00:00+00:00") is True
    assert is_stale(proposal) is False


def test_revalidate_is_the_pre_execution_gate():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    approval = decide_write(request, proposal, "YES")
    assert revalidate(proposal, approval) == approval.fingerprint
    # Rejected approval never executes.
    rejected = decide_write(request, proposal, "NO")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Only an approved"):
        revalidate(proposal, rejected)
    # Stale at execution time refuses even with a fresh approval.
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="stale"):
        revalidate(proposal, approval,
                   now_str="2999-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")


def test_capability_names_are_dotted():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    assert proposal.capability() == "inventory.write.create"
    git = propose_write("wrt-git", "git.commit", "git:/repo",
                        {"repository": "/repo"}, actor="mycelium-test",
                        provenance=ai_provenance())
    assert git.capability() == "git.write.commit"

Roles, content bounds, provenance rules, ID shapes. Storage is

    assert "credential" not in message.model_dump()

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_decisions.py">
"""BIG #24 tests: deterministic step decisions.

decide() is pure: same outcome, same decision, never a
mutation, never an approval. Failed read-only steps retry
bounded, then replan; gated steps wait for a human.
"""

from coordinator.app.decisions import (
    DECISIONS,
    MAX_ATTEMPTS,
    StepOutcome,
    decide,
)


def test_states_closed():
    assert set(DECISIONS) == {
        "CONTINUE", "RETRY", "REPLAN", "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN",
        "WAITING_FOR_AGENT", "BLOCKED", "FAILED", "COMPLETED",
        "CANCELLED"}


def test_success_continues():
    decision = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="readout", step_status="completed", ok=True))
    assert decision.state == "CONTINUE"


def test_pending_readonly_continues():
    decision = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="analysis", step_status="pending"))
    assert decision.state == "CONTINUE"


def test_pending_gated_waits_for_human():
    for kind in ("desktop", "write", "physical_print", "proposal"):
        decision = decide(StepOutcome(
            kind=kind, step_status="pending"))
        assert decision.state == "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN", kind
        assert decision.needs.get("gate") == kind


def test_waiting_approval_names_gate():
    decision = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="desktop", step_status="waiting_approval",
        waiting_detail="dact-123"))
    assert decision.state == "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN"
    assert "dact-123" in decision.reason or \
        decision.needs.get("detail") == "dact-123"


def test_dispatched_waits_for_agent():
    decision = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="desktop", step_status="dispatched",
        waiting_detail="dact-9"))
    assert decision.state == "WAITING_FOR_AGENT"


def test_failed_readonly_retries_bounded():
    first = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="readout", step_status="failed", error="timeout",
        attempts=0))
    assert first.state == "RETRY"
    assert first.retry_in_seconds > 0
    last = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="readout", step_status="failed", error="timeout",
        attempts=MAX_ATTEMPTS))
    assert last.state == "REPLAN"
    assert last.needs.get("gate") == "plan_approval"


def test_failed_gated_never_retries():
    decision = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="write", step_status="failed", error="no YES",
        attempts=0))
    assert decision.state == "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN"


def test_failure_never_fails_mission_directly():
    decision = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="analysis", step_status="failed", error="boom",
        attempts=0))
    assert decision.state in ("RETRY", "REPLAN")
    assert decision.state not in ("FAILED", "COMPLETED")


def test_terminal_mirrors_only():
    assert decide(StepOutcome(
        mission_status="cancelled").__class__(
            kind="readout", step_status="completed", ok=True,
            mission_status="cancelled")).state == "CANCELLED"
    assert decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="readout", step_status="pending",
        mission_status="completed")).state == "COMPLETED"
    assert decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="readout", step_status="pending",
        mission_status="failed")).state == "FAILED"
    assert decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="readout", step_status="pending",
        mission_status="blocked")).state == "BLOCKED"


def test_unknown_status_blocks():
    decision = decide(StepOutcome(
        kind="readout", step_status="teleporting"))
    assert decision.state == "BLOCKED"


def test_pure_no_mutation():
    outcome = StepOutcome(
        kind="readout", step_status="failed", attempts=1)
    first = decide(outcome)
    second = decide(outcome)
    assert first == second
    assert outcome.attempts == 1

"""Desktop contracts tests (Fase E/F/H/J/Q).

ComputerAction validation, unknown-action rejection, capability
mapping, screen observations and action results. Side-effect-free:
no backend is constructed here.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.agent_results import new_result
from coordinator.app.computer_actions import (
    KEYBOARD_PRESS,
    KEYBOARD_TYPE,
    MOUSE_CLICK,
    MOUSE_MOVE,
    MOUSE_SCROLL,
    SCREEN_READ,
    approval_required_for,
    capability_for,
    new_action,
    validate_parameters,
)
from coordinator.app.observations import new_observation


def test_all_action_types_validate():
    assert validate_parameters("screenshot", {}) == {}
    assert validate_parameters("move_mouse", {"x": 10, "y": 20}) == {
        "x": 10, "y": 20}
    assert validate_parameters("click", {"x": 1, "y": 2})["button"] == "left"
    assert validate_parameters("double_click",
                               {"x": 1, "y": 2, "button": "RIGHT"}) == {
                                   "x": 1, "y": 2, "button": "right"}
    assert validate_parameters("type_text", {"text": "hallo"}) == {
        "text": "hallo"}
    assert validate_parameters("key_press", {"key": "Enter"}) == {
        "key": "enter"}
    assert validate_parameters("hotkey", {"keys": ["ctrl", "S"]}) == {
        "keys": ["ctrl", "s"]}
    assert validate_parameters("scroll", {"dy": -120}) == {"dx": 0,
                                                           "dy": -120}
    assert validate_parameters("wait", {"ms": 500}) == {"ms": 500}


def test_unknown_action_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("run_shell", {"cmd": "whoami"})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("exec_python", {"code": "1+1"})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_action("dact-1", "open_url", {})


def test_unknown_parameter_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("click", {"x": 1, "y": 2, "cmd": "evil"})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("screenshot", {"path": "/tmp/x"})


def test_coordinates_bounded():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("move_mouse", {"x": -1, "y": 0})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("move_mouse", {"x": 99999, "y": 0})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("move_mouse", {"x": True, "y": 0})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("click", {"x": 1})


def test_text_strict():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("type_text", {"text": "   "})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("type_text", {"text": "x" * 501})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("type_text", {"text": "a\x07b"})


def test_keys_allow_listed_only():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("key_press", {"key": "rm -rf"})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("hotkey", {"keys": ["ctrl"]})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("hotkey", {"keys": ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"]})


def test_scroll_and_wait_bounded():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("scroll", {"dx": 0, "dy": 0})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_parameters("wait", {"ms": 999999})


def test_capability_mapping():
    assert capability_for("screenshot") == SCREEN_READ
    assert capability_for("move_mouse") == MOUSE_MOVE
    assert capability_for("click") == MOUSE_CLICK
    assert capability_for("double_click") == MOUSE_CLICK
    assert capability_for("type_text") == KEYBOARD_TYPE
    assert capability_for("key_press") == KEYBOARD_PRESS
    assert capability_for("hotkey") == KEYBOARD_PRESS
    assert capability_for("scroll") == MOUSE_SCROLL
    assert capability_for("wait") is None
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        capability_for("run_shell")


def test_approval_policy_input_needs_yes():
    assert approval_required_for("click") is True
    assert approval_required_for("type_text") is True
    assert approval_required_for("key_press") is True
    assert approval_required_for("screenshot") is False
    assert approval_required_for("wait") is False
    assert new_action("dact-1", "click",
                      {"x": 1, "y": 1}).requires_approval is True
    assert new_action("dact-2", "screenshot", {}).requires_approval is False


def test_observation_contract():
    observation = new_observation("obs-1", 1920, 1080,
                                  image_ref="obs-1.bmp",
                                  active_window="Mycelium")

    assert observation.provenance.human_verified is False

        new_observation("obs-4", 100, 100, image_ref="../x.bmp")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_observation("obs-5", 100, 100, image_ref="C:\\x.bmp")


def test_no_shell_or_code_surface():
    import coordinator.app.computer_actions as module

    for token in ("subprocess", "os.system", "shell=true", "eval(",
                  "exec(", "socket", "urllib"):

def test_result_contract():
    done = new_result("dact-1", "completed")
    assert done.status == "completed" and done.error == ""
    failed = new_result("dact-1", "failed", error="knop niet gevonden")

        new_result("dact-1", "failed")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_result("dact-1", "completed", error="te veel")

                      error="x").provenance.human_verified is False

        new_result("dact-1", "failed", error="x",
                   observation_reference="not-an-obs")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_desktop_hands.py">
"""BIG #22 tests: desktop agent hands.

Claim → revalidate → act → report over HTTP, lease +
attempt bounds, agent-offline visibility, mission
continuation after desktop results, and the hard
boundaries (no shell, no physical via desktop, no
credential leaks).
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN = "hands-token-1234567890"
CAPS = ["agent:desktop", "desktop.screen.read",
        "desktop.mouse.click", "desktop.keyboard.type",
        "desktop.mouse.move", "desktop.keyboard.press",
        "desktop.screen.wait"]


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "hands.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "hands-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register(client, node_id="hands-01", capabilities=None):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "pc",
        "capabilities": capabilities or CAPS,
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def propose(client, action_type, parameters=None,
            action_id=None):
    body = {"action_type": action_type,
            "parameters": parameters or {}}
    if action_id:
        body["action_id"] = action_id
    response = client.post("/api/v1/desktop/actions",
                           json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()


def claim(client, node_id="hands-01"):
    return client.post("/api/v1/desktop/actions/next",
                       json={"node_id": node_id,
                             "node_token": TOKEN}).json()


def test_screenshot_success_end_to_end(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        proposed = propose(client, "screenshot", {})
        assert proposed["status"] == "approved"
        claimed = claim(client)
        assert claimed is not None
        assert claimed["lease_until"] != ""
        assert claimed["attempt_count"] == 1
        reported = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
            f"{proposed['action_id']}/result",
            json={"status": "completed",
                  "observation_reference": "obs-shot-1"})
        assert reported.status_code == 200, reported.text
        stored = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
            f"{proposed['action_id']}").json()
        assert stored["status"] == "completed"


def test_click_type_wait_require_approval_flow(tmp_path,
                                               monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        for action_type, params in (
                ("click", {"x": 10, "y": 10}),
                ("type_text", {"text": "hello"})):
            proposed = propose(client, action_type, params)
            assert proposed["status"] == "pending_approval"
            # Not claimable before approval.
            assert claim(client) is None
            decided = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
                f"{proposed['action_id']}/decision",
                json={"response": "YES",
                      "decided_by": "tester"})
            assert decided.status_code == 200
            claimed = claim(client)
            assert claimed is not None
            assert claimed["action_id"] == proposed["action_id"]
            assert client.post(
                f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
                f"{proposed['action_id']}/result",
                json={"status": "completed",
                      "observation_reference": "obs-1"}
            ).status_code == 200
        # Read-only wait is approved by policy, never by
        # human: directly claimable, still bounded.
        waiting = propose(client, "wait", {"ms": 100})
        assert waiting["status"] == "approved"
        assert claim(client)["action_id"] == waiting["action_id"]


def test_wrong_or_missing_approval(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        proposed = propose(client, "click", {"x": 1, "y": 2})
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
            f"{proposed['action_id']}/decision",
            json={"response": "maybe",
                  "decided_by": "tester"}).json()[
                      "status"] == "rejected"
        assert claim(client) is None
        proposed2 = propose(client, "click", {"x": 1, "y": 2})
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
            f"{proposed2['action_id']}/decision",
            json={"response": "YES",
                  "decided_by": ""}).status_code == 422
        assert claim(client) is None


def test_stale_action_lease_expiry_and_attempt_cap(tmp_path,
                                                   monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.database import chat_connection
    from coordinator.app.main import expire_desktop_leases
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        proposed = propose(client, "screenshot", {})
        claimed = claim(client)
        assert claimed is not None
        action_id = proposed["action_id"]
        # Agent dies: backdate the lease, expire, recover.
        with chat_connection() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT record FROM desktop_actions WHERE "
                "action_id=?", (action_id,)).fetchone()
            import json
            record = json.loads(row["record"])
            record["lease_until"] = "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
            db.execute("UPDATE desktop_actions SET record=? "
                       "WHERE action_id=?",
                       (json.dumps(record), action_id))
        summary = expire_desktop_leases("2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
        assert summary == {"recovered": 1, "blocked": 0}
        stored = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}").json()
        assert stored["status"] == "approved"
        assert stored["attempt_count"] == 1
        # Exhaust attempts: dispatch twice more, expire again.
        for _ in range(2):
            assert claim(client) is not None
            with chat_connection() as db:
                row = db.execute(
                    "SELECT record FROM desktop_actions WHERE "
                    "action_id=?", (action_id,)).fetchone()
                record = json.loads(row["record"])
                record["lease_until"] = \
                    "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
                db.execute(
                    "UPDATE desktop_actions SET record=? WHERE "
                    "action_id=?",
                    (json.dumps(record), action_id))
            expire_desktop_leases("2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
        stored = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}").json()
        assert stored["status"] == "blocked"
        assert stored["attempt_count"] == 3
        assert claim(client) is None


def test_agent_revalidate_refuses_expired_lease(tmp_path,
                                                monkeypatch):
    from desktop_agent.agent import ApprovalInvalid, DesktopAgent
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        proposed = propose(client, "screenshot", {})
        claimed = claim(client)
        agent = DesktopAgent(
            base_url="http://127.0.0.1:9", node_id="hands-01",
            capabilities=list(CAPS), node_token=TOKEN)
        expired = dict(claimed)
        expired["lease_until"] = "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"
        with pytest.raises(ApprovalInvalid):
            agent.revalidate(expired)


def test_agent_offline_visible_as_waiting(tmp_path,
                                          monkeypatch):

        register(client)
        proposed = propose(client, "screenshot", {})
        claimed = claim(client)
        assert claimed is not None
        # No agent process acts: the mission loop would see

        status = client.get("/api/v1/agent/status").json()
        assert status["current_action"] is not None
        stored = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
            f"{proposed['action_id']}").json()
        assert stored["status"] == "dispatched"
        assert stored["dispatched_by"] == "hands-01"


def test_result_returns_to_mission_and_loop_continues(
        tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        conversation = client.post(
            "/api/v1/chat", json={"message": "hi"}).json()[
                "conversation_id"]
        mission_id = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": conversation,
            "goal": "take a look",
            "steps": [{"kind": "desktop",
                       "description": "Look",
                       "action_type": "screenshot",
                       "parameters": {}}]}).json()["mission_id"]
        client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
                    json={"response": "YES",
                          "decided_by": "tester"})
        first = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/run",
            json={"max_rounds": 10}).json()
        assert first["outcome"] == "stopped"
        assert first["stop_reason"] == "waiting_agent"
        action_id = first["action"]["action_id"]
        claimed = claim(client)
        assert claimed["action_id"] == action_id
        client.post(f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}/result",
                    json={"status": "completed",
                          "observation_reference": "obs-m-1"})
        done = client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/run",
                           json={"max_rounds": 10}).json()
        assert done["outcome"] == "completed", done
        assert done.get("memory_id", "").startswith("mem_")

def test_desktop_shell_subprocess_scan():
    import pathlib
    import re
    app = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \
        "coordinator" / "app"
    agent = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / \
        "desktop_agent"
    for path in (app / "desktop_runtime.py",
                 app / "agent_loop.py", app / "computer_actions.py",
                 agent / "agent.py", agent / "main.py"):
        code = []
        in_docstring = False
        for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.startswith('"""'):
                if stripped.count('"""') == 1:
                    in_docstring = not in_docstring
                continue
            if in_docstring or stripped.startswith("#"):
                continue
            code.append(re.sub(r'"[^"]*"|\'[^\']*\'', '""',
                              line))
        blob = "\n".join(code)
        for token in ("subprocess", "os.system", "os.popen",
                      "os.exec", "eval(", "__import__",
                      "importlib"):
            assert token not in blob, f"{path.name}: {token}"


def test_credentials_never_leaked(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        proposed = propose(client, "screenshot", {})
        blob = ""
        blob += str(client.get("/api/v1/nodes").json())
        blob += str(client.get(
            "/api/v1/nodes/hands-01").json())
        blob += str(client.get("/api/v1/agent/status").json())
        blob += str(client.get("/api/v1/desktop/actions").json())
        blob += str(client.get(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/"
            f"{proposed['action_id']}").json())
        assert TOKEN not in blob
        assert "auth_token_hash" not in blob

"""Desktop runtime tests (Fase G/Q).

Dry-run backend (validates, executes nothing), BMP writer roundtrip,
observation pruning, and the dispatched-only execution gate. Real
input is never performed here: MYCELIUM_DESKTOP_DRYRUN forces the
safe backend, and the Windows backend is only touched for a
read-only screenshot.
"""

import os
import struct

import pytest

from coordinator.app.agent_loop import (
    decide,
    dispatch,
    propose,
)
from coordinator.app.computer_actions import new_action
from coordinator.app.desktop_runtime import (
    BackendUnavailable,
    DryRunDesktopBackend,
    get_backend,
    observation_dir,
    prune_observations,
    run_approved_action,
    write_bmp_24,
)


def test_dryrun_blocks_input_without_side_effects(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DESKTOP_DRYRUN", "1")
    backend = get_backend()
    assert isinstance(backend, DryRunDesktopBackend)
    result = backend.execute(new_action("dact-1", "click",
                                        {"x": 10, "y": 10}))
    assert result.status == "blocked"
    assert "Dry-run" in result.error


def test_dryrun_screenshot_raises_instead_of_faking(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DESKTOP_DRYRUN", "1")
    with pytest.raises(BackendUnavailable):
        get_backend().screenshot()


def test_dryrun_rejects_garbage_action():
    backend = DryRunDesktopBackend()
    result = backend.execute("not-an-action")
    assert result.status == "blocked"


def test_get_backend_defaults_to_dryrun_off_windows(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DESKTOP_DRYRUN", "1")
    assert isinstance(get_backend(), DryRunDesktopBackend)


def test_bmp_writer_produces_readable_bitmap(tmp_path):
    path = str(tmp_path / "shot.bmp")
    pixels = b"\xff\x00\x00" * 4 + b"\x00\xff\x00" * 4
    write_bmp_24(path, 4, 2, pixels)
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read()
    assert data[:2] == b"BM"
    file_size, _, _, offset = struct.unpack("<IHHI", data[2:14])
    assert file_size == len(data) and offset == 54
    width, height, _, bits = struct.unpack("<iiHH", data[18:30])
    assert (width, height, bits) == (4, 2, 24)


def test_prune_keeps_latest_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import coordinator.app.desktop_runtime as runtime
    monkeypatch.setattr(runtime, "observation_dir", lambda: str(tmp_path))
    directory = runtime.observation_dir()
    for index in range(8):
        open(os.path.join(directory, f"obs-{index:04d}.bmp"),
             "wb").write(b"x")
    removed = prune_observations(keep=5)
    assert removed == 3
    remaining = sorted(os.listdir(directory))
    assert len(remaining) == 5


def test_run_refuses_anything_not_dispatched():
    backend = DryRunDesktopBackend()
    pending = propose(new_action("dact-1", "click", {"x": 1, "y": 1}))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run_approved_action(pending, backend)
    approved = decide(pending, "dact-1", "YES")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run_approved_action(approved, backend)


def test_run_dispatched_reports_blocked_on_dryrun():
    backend = DryRunDesktopBackend()
    record = dispatch(decide(
        propose(new_action("dact-9", "type_text", {"text": "hoi"})),
        "dact-9", "YES"), "dact-9")
    closed = run_approved_action(record, backend)
    assert closed.status == "blocked"
    assert closed.result is not None


def test_no_shell_code_or_network_surface():
    import coordinator.app.desktop_runtime as runtime
    source = open(runtime.__file__, encoding="utf-8").read()
    lowered = source.lower()
    for token in ("import subprocess", "from subprocess", "os.system",
                  "shell=true", "eval(", "import socket", "import httpx",
                  "import urllib", "import requests"):
        assert token not in lowered
    assert "SendInput" in source  # real input path exists
    assert "BitBlt" in source  # real capture path exists


def test_windows_screenshot_stays_local():
    import sys
    if sys.platform != "win32" or os.environ.get(
            "MYCELIUM_DESKTOP_DRYRUN") == "1":
        pytest.skip("Windows screenshot only on real Windows")
    from coordinator.app.desktop_runtime import WindowsDesktopBackend

"""VERTICAL SLICE 1 tests: physical digital world (NODE -> DISPLAY).

Covers the task's Fase H contract:

A node zonder display metadata werkt
B node met een display werkt
C node met meerdere displays werkt
D onbekende fysieke afmetingen blijven null
E onbekende positie blijft null
F UI rendert nodes
G UI rendert displays
H selectie werkt (stable ids + selectie-plumbing in de UI)
I drag werkt alleen in UI-state (geen writes, geen fetch/POST)
J reset layout werkt (reset-knop + handler wist UI-state)
K offline node degradeert
L bestaande worker flow blijft groen
M bestaande Forge flow blijft groen (pagina + JSON leven nog)

def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "dw.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "dw-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        yield client


def register(client, node_id="node-dw", token=TOKEN):
    body = {"node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id,
            "tier": "worker",
            "capabilities": ["research.fetch"],
            "node_token": token}
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def heartbeat(client, node_id="node-dw", token=TOKEN, **fields):
    body = {"available": True, "node_token": token}
    body.update(fields)
    return client.post(f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat",
                       json=body)

def _world_script(page: str) -> str:
    start = page.index("const DWDATA")
    end = page.index("</script>", start)
    return page[start:end]

    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)

        assert 'id="dw-details"' in page
        assert 'id="dw-stage"' in page
        script = _world_script(page)
        # selectie-functie + stabiele ids per display
        assert "function select(" in script
        assert "data-display" in script
        # JSON-snapshot draagt de stabiele ids voor selectie
        world = client.get("/api/v1/digital-world").json()
        assert world["nodes"][0]["displays"][0]["id"] == "HDMI-1"


def test_i_drag_is_ui_state_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import re
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        assert heartbeat(client, displays=ONE_DISPLAY).status_code == 204
        page = client.get("/nodes").text
        panel = page[page.index("Digital World"):page.index(
            "Gerapporteerde nodes")]
        # geen enkel formulier/POST in het game-panel
        assert "<form" not in panel
        assert "method=\"post\"" not in panel
        script = _world_script(page)
        # layout/select/drag/pan/zoom/reset zijn netwerkvrij: de
        # enige fetch-aanroepen zitten in de expliciete
        # remote-control handlers (CONNECT/DISCONNECT/input/pad/
        # clipboard), nooit in render/layout/drag-state.
        layout = re.sub(
            r"function dw(Connect|Disconnect|PadMove|Input|ClipRequest)\(.*?"""
            r"\n\}",
            "", script, flags=re.DOTALL)
        assert "fetch(" not in layout
        assert "XMLHttpRequest" not in layout
        assert "postJSON" not in layout
        assert 'state.ui' in script
        # expliciet gelabeld als niet-fysiek
        assert "niet fysiek" in page

def test_k_offline_node_degrades(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

                         displays=ONE_DISPLAY).status_code == 204

        db = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        db.execute(
            "UPDATE nodes SET last_seen='2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' "

        db.close()
        world = client.get("/api/v1/digital-world").json()

        # displays blijven zichtbaar (laatst bekende state), status eerlijk

        page = client.get("/nodes").text
        assert "dim-offline" in page

def test_n_world_rendering_performs_no_writes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        register(client)
        assert heartbeat(client, displays=TWO_DISPLAYS).status_code == 204

        def snapshot_db():
            db = sqlite3.connect(str(tmp_path / "dw.db"))
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM nodes ORDER BY node_id").fetchall()
            db.close()
            return rows

        before = snapshot_db()
        first = client.get("/api/v1/digital-world").json()
        second = client.get("/api/v1/digital-world").json()
        page = client.get("/nodes").text
        assert page.status_code == 200 if hasattr(page, "status_code") \
            else True
        after = snapshot_db()
        assert first == second
        assert before == after

def test_derive_digital_world_sorted_bounded_and_safe():

        {"node_id": "b-node", "hostname": "b",
         "derived_status": "online", "telemetry": {"os": "Linux"},
         "hardware": [], "displays": "corrupt"},
        {"node_id": "a-node", "hostname": "a",
         "derived_status": "stale", "telemetry": {},
         "hardware": [{"kind": "gpu", "identifier": "GTX",
                       "status": "connected"}],

HDMI-1 connected primary 1920x1080+0+0 (normal left inverted right x axis y axis) 477mm x 268mm
   1920x1080     60.00*+  50.00    59.94
   1680x1050     59.88
DP-1 disconnected (normal left inverted right x axis y axis)
eDP-1 connected 1920x1080+1920+0 (normal left inverted right x axis y axis) 344mm x 193mm
   1920x1080     60.02*+  48.00
   1280x720      60.00
VGA-1 connected (normal left inverted right x axis y axis)
"""


def test_xrandr_parser_honest_no_fake_data():
    displays = parse_xrandr_query(XRANDR_SAMPLE)
    by_id = {d["id"]: d for d in displays}
    # disconnected output wordt nooit gerapporteerd
    assert "DP-1" not in by_id
    hdmi = by_id["HDMI-1"]
    assert (hdmi["width"], hdmi["height"]) == (1920, 1080)
    assert hdmi["primary"] is True
    assert (hdmi["x"], hdmi["y"]) == (0, 0)
    assert hdmi["refresh_rate"] == pytest.approx(60.0)
    assert (hdmi["physical_width_mm"],
            hdmi["physical_height_mm"]) == (477, 268)
    laptop = by_id["eDP-1"]
    assert (laptop["x"], laptop["y"]) == (1920, 0)
    assert laptop["primary"] is False
    # connected zonder actieve modus: geen resolutie verzinnen
    vga = by_id["VGA-1"]
    assert vga["width"] is None
    assert vga["height"] is None
    assert vga["refresh_rate"] is None
    assert vga["physical_width_mm"] is None
    # schaal is via xrandr niet betrouwbaar: altijd None
    assert all(d["scale"] is None for d in displays)

    assert parse_xrandr_query("") == []
    assert parse_xrandr_query("garbage\nmore garbage\n") == []

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_diststate.py">
"""Distributed state tests (BIG #10, deel 1).

Envelope validation, stable ids, idempotent apply, duplicate
and out-of-order safety, revision conflicts, provenance,
cursor reads, bounded batches.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.diststate import (
    DistStateRefusedError,
    apply_envelope,
    detect_conflict,
    entity_history,
    known_event_ids,
    list_conflicts,
    mergeable_update,
    new_conflict,
    new_envelope,
    payload_hash,
    read_log,
    resolve_conflict,
    save_conflict,
    save_envelope,
)
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance


def use_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "ds.db"))


def make_envelope(**overrides):
    record = {
        "origin_node_id": "node-a",
        "entity_id": "obj_1",
        "entity_type": "object",
        "event_type": "entity.observed",
        "entity_revision": "rev-1",
        "base_revision": "",
        "payload": {"note": "saw it"},
    }
    record.update(overrides)
    return new_envelope(**record)


def test_envelope_validation():
    envelope = make_envelope()
    assert envelope.event_id.startswith("dsevt_")
    assert envelope.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert envelope.epoch == 0
    for bad in ({"event_type": "nuke"},
                {"entity_id": ""},
                {"entity_type": ""},
                {"origin_node_id": ""},
                {"payload": {"command": "rm"}},
                {"payload": {"x": "y" * 1001}},
                {"payload": "not-a-dict"},
                {"epoch": -1}):
        with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
            make_envelope(**bad)
    assert payload_hash({"a": 1}) == payload_hash({"a": 1})
    assert payload_hash({"a": 1}) != payload_hash({"a": 2})


def test_idempotent_apply_and_duplicates(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    envelope = make_envelope()
    assert apply_envelope(envelope)["status"] == "applied"
    assert apply_envelope(envelope)["status"] == "duplicate"
    assert known_event_ids([envelope.event_id]) == {
        envelope.event_id}
    assert known_event_ids(["dsevt_missing"]) == set()
    history = entity_history("obj_1")
    assert len(history) == 1
    assert history[0].event_id == envelope.event_id


def test_out_of_order_safe(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    first = make_envelope(entity_revision="rev-1")
    second = make_envelope(entity_revision="rev-2",
                           base_revision="rev-1",
                           payload={"note": "later"})
    assert apply_envelope(second)["status"] == "applied"
    assert apply_envelope(first)["status"] == "applied"
    assert len(entity_history("obj_1")) == 2


def test_conflict_detected_and_preserved(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    base = make_envelope(entity_revision="rev-1")
    assert apply_envelope(base)["status"] == "applied"
    mine = make_envelope(origin_node_id="node-a",
                         entity_revision="rev-2a",
                         base_revision="rev-1",
                         payload={"color": "red"})
    theirs = make_envelope(origin_node_id="node-b",
                           entity_revision="rev-2b",
                           base_revision="rev-1",
                           payload={"color": "blue"})
    assert apply_envelope(mine)["status"] == "applied"
    outcome = apply_envelope(theirs)
    assert outcome["status"] == "conflict"
    conflicts = list_conflicts()
    assert len(conflicts) == 1
    conflict = conflicts[0]
    assert conflict.status == "open"
    assert conflict.first_origin == "node-a"
    assert conflict.second_origin == "node-b"
    # Both versions preserved, neither rewritten.
    history = entity_history("obj_1")
    assert len(history) == 3
    assert resolve_conflict(conflict.conflict_id, "resolved") is True
    assert resolve_conflict(conflict.conflict_id, "resolved") is False
    assert list_conflicts(status="open") == []
    with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
        resolve_conflict(conflict.conflict_id, "merge")
    with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
        list_conflicts(status="bogus")


def test_same_payload_no_conflict(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    apply_envelope(make_envelope(entity_revision="rev-1"))
    echo = make_envelope(origin_node_id="node-b",
                         entity_revision="rev-1",
                         payload={"note": "saw it"})
    assert apply_envelope(echo)["status"] == "applied"
    assert list_conflicts() == []


def test_mergeable_metadata_only():
    current = {"cursor": "5", "last_seen": "t"}
    merged = mergeable_update(
        current, {"cursor": "9", "last_seen": "t2"})
    assert merged == {"cursor": "9", "last_seen": "t2"}
    assert mergeable_update(current, {"color": "red"}) is None
    assert mergeable_update(current, "nope") is None


def test_cursor_read_bounded(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    for index in range(3):
        apply_envelope(make_envelope(
            entity_id=f"obj_{index}", payload={"n": index}))
    items, latest = read_log(after_rowid=0, limit=2)
    assert len(items) == 2
    assert latest == 3
    rest, _ = read_log(after_rowid=2, limit=100)
    assert len(rest) == 1
    assert rest[0]["entity_id"] == "obj_2"
    with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
        read_log(after_rowid="nope")
    with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
        apply_envelope("not-an-envelope")


def test_conflict_record_shape(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    conflict = new_conflict("obj_9", "rev-1", "dsevt_a",
                            "dsevt_b", "node-a", "node-b")
    assert conflict.conflict_id.startswith("dscon_")
    assert conflict.status == "open"
    save_conflict(conflict)
    assert len(list_conflicts()) == 1
    # No history yet: nothing to conflict with.
    assert detect_conflict(make_envelope(
        entity_id="obj_fresh")) is None

"""Event bus + notification tests (BIG #9).

Closed types, non-executable payloads, cursor polling,
notifications as information-only, retention bounds.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.events import (
    EventRefusedError,
    list_events,
    list_notifications,
    mark_notification_read,
    new_event,
    new_notification,
    prune_events,
    save_event,
    save_notification,
)


def use_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "bus.db"))


def test_event_types_closed():
    event = new_event("task.completed", "Task 1 klaar", task_id="1")
    assert event.event_type == "task.completed"
    assert event.created_at != ""
    with pytest.raises(EventRefusedError):
        new_event("task.launch_missiles", "x")


def test_payload_never_executable():
    for key in ("command", "exec", "execute", "shell", "code",
                "url", "approved", "decision", "execute_now"):
        with pytest.raises(EventRefusedError, match="executable"):

    event = new_event("node.online", "Node up",

def test_poll_cursor_and_filter(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        list_events(event_type="nope")
    assert prune_events(keep=2) == 1
    assert len(list_events(limit=50)) == 2

"""Tests for the M7.3 executor registry (pure discovery, no execution).

No servers, no nodes, no database, no network. Every test is a pure
function call; nothing here can start, approve, or complete anything.
"""
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from coordinator.app.executor_registry import (
    EXEC_NAMESPACE,
    ExecutorRegistry,
    ExecutorSpec,
    default_executor_registry,
    resolve_executor,
    supports_node,
)


@pytest.fixture()
def registry():
    return default_executor_registry()


def spec(**overrides):
    payload = {"executor_id": "system_inventory", "kind": "system_inventory",
               "capability": "exec:system_inventory"}
    payload.update(overrides)
    return ExecutorSpec.model_validate(payload)


# --- registry contents ---------------------------------------------------------------

def test_default_registry_holds_only_system_inventory(registry):
    assert registry.kinds() == ["system_inventory"]
    assert registry.executor_ids() == ["system_inventory"]
    entry = resolve_executor(registry, "system_inventory")
    assert entry.capability == "exec:system_inventory"
    assert entry.executor_id == "system_inventory"
    assert entry.allowed_side_effects == []


def test_known_kind_resolves(registry):
    entry = resolve_executor(registry, "system_inventory")
    assert isinstance(entry, ExecutorSpec)
    assert entry.kind == "system_inventory"


@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", [None, "", 123, "unknown_kind", "SYSTEM_INVENTORY",
                                  "system_inventory ", " exec:system_inventory",
                                  "system_inventory_extra", "system_inventor"])
def test_unknown_malformed_kinds_deny(registry, kind):
    assert resolve_executor(registry, kind) is None


# --- node capability matching ----------------------------------------------------------

def test_matching_capability(registry):
    entry = resolve_executor(registry, "system_inventory")
    assert supports_node(entry, ["exec:system_inventory"]) is True
    assert supports_node(entry, ["other", "EXEC:SYSTEM_INVENTORY"]) is True


@pytest.mark.parametrize("caps", [
    [], ["system_inventory"], ["exec:unknown"], ["exec:system_inventory_extra"],
    ["exec:system"], ["exec:"], ["xexec:system_inventory"], "exec:system_inventory",
    None, [123], [""],
])
def test_non_matching_capabilities_deny(registry, caps):
    entry = resolve_executor(registry, "system_inventory")
    assert supports_node(entry, caps) is False


def test_no_prefix_or_substring_matching(registry):
    entry = resolve_executor(registry, "system_inventory")
    assert supports_node(entry, ["exec:system_inventory_v2"]) is False
    assert supports_node(entry, ["my-exec:system_inventory-x"]) is False


# --- registry integrity ------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_duplicates_impossible():
    registry = ExecutorRegistry()
    registry.register(spec())
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        registry.register(spec())
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        registry.register(spec(executor_id="other", capability="exec:other"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        registry.register(spec(executor_id="other", kind="other"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        registry.register("not-a-spec")


def test_deterministic_output():
    first = default_executor_registry()
    second = default_executor_registry()
    assert first.kinds() == second.kinds()
    assert (first.kinds(), first.executor_ids()
            ) == (second.kinds(), second.executor_ids())


def test_namespace_constant():
    assert EXEC_NAMESPACE == "exec:"


# --- no execution, no side effects ------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_match_causes_nothing():
    registry = default_executor_registry()
    entry = resolve_executor(registry, "system_inventory")
    assert supports_node(entry, ["exec:system_inventory"]) is True
    assert registry.kinds() == ["system_inventory"]


def test_no_execution_attributes():
    import coordinator.app.executor_registry as module
    for name in dir(module):
        if name.startswith("__"):
            continue
        lowered = name.lower()
        for token in ("execute", "dispatch", "assign", "claim", "complete",
                      "run", "approve", "perform"):
            assert token not in lowered, f"registry must not offer {name}"

    source = (Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
              / "coordinator" / "app" / "executor_registry.py").read_text(

                  "serial", "driver", "inference", "download",
                  "filesystem execution", "threading", "asyncio", "pathlib",
                  "shutil", "open("):
        assert token not in source, f"registry must not use {token}"
