<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_failover_race.py">
"""FASE 3 tests (BIG #16): atomic campaign.

Invariant: two simultaneous campaigners can never both
become valid holders of the same resulting epoch. Same
node racing itself on an expired lease converges on one
epoch, one holder, one fencing token.
"""

import threading
from datetime import datetime, timezone

import pytest

from coordinator.app import failover


def fresh_nodes(*node_ids):
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    return [{"node_id": node_id, "status": "online",
             "last_seen": now, "coordinator_capable": True}
            for node_id in node_ids]


def test_concurrent_same_node_campaign_converges(tmp_path,
                                                monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "race.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "race-chat.db"))
    first = failover.campaign(
        "node-r1", lambda: fresh_nodes("node-r1"))
    assert first["epoch"] == 1
    assert failover.release("node-r1") is True
    barrier = threading.Barrier(2)
    results = []
    errors = []

    def run():
        try:
            barrier.wait(timeout=10)
            results.append(failover.campaign(
                "node-r1", lambda: fresh_nodes("node-r1")))
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            errors.append(error)

    threads = [threading.Thread(target=run) for _ in range(2)]
    for thread in threads:
        thread.start()
    for thread in threads:
        thread.join(timeout=30)
    assert not errors, errors
    assert len(results) == 2
    # One holder, one epoch, one fencing token.
    assert {item["epoch"] for item in results} == {2}
    assert {item["node_id"] for item in results} == {"node-r1"}
    assert len({item["fencing_token"]
                for item in results}) == 1
    lease = failover.read_lease()
    assert lease["epoch"] == 2
    assert lease["holder_node_id"] == "node-r1"
    assert lease["fencing_token"] == results[0]["fencing_token"]


def test_renewal_keeps_token_and_epoch(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "race2.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "race2-chat.db"))
    first = failover.campaign(
        "node-r1", lambda: fresh_nodes("node-r1"))
    second = failover.campaign(
        "node-r1", lambda: fresh_nodes("node-r1"))
    assert second["mode"] == "renewed"
    assert second["epoch"] == first["epoch"] == 1
    assert second["fencing_token"] == first["fencing_token"]


def test_deterministic_order_still_refuses(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "race3.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "race3-chat.db"))
    with pytest.raises(failover.ElectionRefusedError):
        failover.campaign(
            "node-r9",
            lambda: fresh_nodes("node-r1", "node-r9"))

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_fencing.py">
"""FASE 2 tests (BIG #16): global fencing.

Invariant: a writer holding an old fencing epoch cannot
perform coordinator-owned mutations. No lease yet means
bootstrap: epoch-0 writers pass unchanged.
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.failover import (
    FencingError,
    require_writer_epoch,
)


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "fence.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "fence-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register(client, node_id):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "h",
        "capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"],
        "coordinator_capable": True,
        "node_token": f"fencing-token-{node_id}-123"})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def claim_as(client, node_id):
    return client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{node_id}",
        params={"node_token": f"fencing-token-{node_id}-123"}).json()


def envelope(event_id, epoch):
    return {"event_id": event_id,
            "origin_node_id": "node-a",
            "entity_id": "obj_9", "entity_type": "object",
            "entity_revision": "rev-1", "base_revision": "",
            "event_type": "entity.observed", "timestamp": "",
            "payload": {"note": "x"}, "provenance": {},
            "epoch": epoch}


def test_no_lease_bootstrap_unchanged(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert require_writer_epoch(0) == 0
        applied = client.post("/api/v1/sync/apply", json={
            "items": [envelope("dsevt_f0", 0)]}).json()
        assert applied["applied"] == 1


def test_stale_epoch_envelope_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client, "node-f1")
        assert client.post("/api/v1/coordinator/campaign",
                           json={"node_id": "node-f1"}
                           ).status_code == 200
        with pytest.raises(FencingError):
            require_writer_epoch(0)
        assert require_writer_epoch(1) == 1
        outcome = client.post("/api/v1/sync/apply", json={
            "items": [envelope("dsevt_f1", 0)]}).json()
        assert outcome["failed"] == 1
        assert outcome["applied"] == 0
        current = client.post("/api/v1/sync/apply", json={
            "items": [envelope("dsevt_f2", 1)]}).json()
        assert current["applied"] == 1


def test_complete_fenced_after_epoch_change(tmp_path,
                                            monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client, "node-f1")
        task = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": [
                "exec:system_inventory"]}).json()
        assigned = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task['id']}/assign",
            json={"policy": {
                "require_authenticated": False}}).json()
        assert assigned["routing"]["epoch"] == 0
        claimed = claim_as(client, "node-f1")
        assert claimed["id"] == task["id"]
        client.post("/api/v1/coordinator/campaign",
                    json={"node_id": "node-f1"})
        # Completing the old-epoch assignment refuses loudly.
        response = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task['id']}/complete",
            params={"node_id": "node-f1"},
            json={"success": True})
        assert response.status_code == 409
        # Fresh work under the live epoch completes fine.
        task2 = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": [
                "exec:system_inventory"]}).json()
        assigned2 = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task2['id']}/assign",
            json={"policy": {
                "require_authenticated": False}}).json()
        assert assigned2["routing"]["epoch"] == 1
        claimed2 = claim_as(client, "node-f1")
        assert claimed2["id"] == task2["id"]
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task2['id']}/complete",
            params={"node_id": "node-f1"},
            json={"success": True}).status_code == 204

def cube_scene(size=20.0, dx=0.0, part_id="part_1_cube"):
    return [{
        "id": part_id,
        "kind": "cube",
        "size": {"w": size, "h": size, "d": size},
        "pos": {"x": dx, "y": 0.0, "z": 0.0},
        "rot": {"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "z": 0.0},
        "scale": {"x": 1.0, "y": 1.0, "z": 1.0},
        "material": "PLA",
    }]


def two_cube_scene():
    first = cube_scene(20.0, 0.0, "part_1_cube")
    second = cube_scene(20.0, 50.0, "part_2_cube")
    return first + second


def seed_workshop_model(client):
    from coordinator.app.mesh3d import ProceduralTestGenerator
    generated = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {})
    reg = client.post("/api/v1/workshop/models", json={
        "filename": generated.artifact_ref, "source": "generated"})
    assert reg.status_code == 201, reg.text
    return reg.json()


def fab_file_count(tmp_path):
    fab = tmp_path / "forge3-fab"
    if not fab.exists():
        return 0
    return len([entry for entry in os.listdir(fab)])


def test_no_model_session_and_save_refuse(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """A: Forge werkt zonder model; lege save weigert."""
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert client.get("/forge").status_code == 200
        session = client.get("/api/v1/forge/session").json()
        assert session["session"]["dirty"] is False
        assert client.post("/api/v1/forge/save",
                           json={"design_name": "x",
                                 "parts": []}).status_code == 422
        library = client.get("/api/v1/forge/library").json()
        assert set(library) >= {"workshop", "inventory",
                                "local", "external"}
        assert library["external"]["state"] == "NOT_CONNECTED"


def test_workshop_model_opens(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """B: bestaand workshop-model opent als derived editor-part."""
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        model = seed_workshop_model(client)
        opened = client.post(
            "/api/v1/forge/open",
            json={"source": "workshop",
                  "ref": model["model_id"]})
        assert opened.status_code == 200, opened.text
        body = opened.json()
        assert body["status"] == "OPENED"
        assert len(body["parts"]) == 1
        part = body["parts"][0]
        assert part["kind"] == "derived"
        assert len(part["tris"]) > 0
        assert body["provenance"]["source"] == "workshop"
        assert body["provenance"]["source_ref"] == \
            model["model_id"]
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/forge/open",
            json={"source": "workshop",
                  "ref": "mdl_nope_nope"}).status_code == 422

        assert "proposal" in body
        assert client.get(
            "/api/v1/workshop/models").json()["models"] == \
            before_models
        assert fab_file_count(tmp_path) == before_files


def _apply_patch(parts, patch):
    for part_id, update in (patch.get("update") or {}).items():
        part = next(item for item in parts
                    if item.get("id") == part_id)
        for key in ("size", "pos", "rot"):
            if key in update:
                part[key] = update[key]
        if "tris" in update:
            part["tris"] = update["tris"]
    doomed = set(patch.get("remove") or [])
    parts[:] = [item for item in parts
                if item.get("id") not in doomed]
    return parts


def test_preview_applies_to_editor(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """K: APPLY-patch op editor state == backend-preview."""
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        parts = cube_scene()
        proposal = client.post(
            "/api/v1/forge/propose",
            json={"selection": ["part_1_cube"],
                  "prompt": "maak deze 5mm langer",
                  "parts": parts}).json()["proposal"]
        applied = _apply_patch([dict(item) for item in parts],
                               proposal["preview"]["patch"])
        rebuilt = build_scene_facets(clean_scene_parts(
            applied, need_ids=True))
        preview = proposal["preview"]["tris"]
        assert len(rebuilt) == len(preview) == \
            proposal["preview"]["total_tris"]
        worst = max(abs(got - want)
                    for got_tri, want_tri in zip(
                        [[[float(v) for v in pt]
                           for pt in facet]
                          for facet in rebuilt], preview)
                    for got_pt, want_pt in zip(got_tri,
                                               want_tri)
                    for got, want in zip(got_pt, want_pt))
        assert worst < 1e-9

def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

def cube_parts(size=20.0, dx=0.0):
    return [{
        "kind": "cube",
        "size": {"w": size, "h": size, "d": size},
        "pos": {"x": dx, "y": 0.0, "z": 0.0},
        "rot": {"x": 0.0, "y": 0.0, "z": 0.0},
        "scale": {"x": 1.0, "y": 1.0, "z": 1.0},
        "material": "PLA",
    }]


def save(client, parts, name="bracket", forked=None):
    return client.post("/api/v1/forge/save", json={
        "design_name": name, "parts": parts,
        "forked_from": forked or {}})

            == 422

                                             monkeypatch):

def test_file_payload_contract(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """D: payload volgt exact het bestaande file-contract."""

        body = save(client, cube_parts(), forked={
            "source": "mdl_demo"}).json()

                                "mime_type", "sha256",

        assert payload["status"] == "available"

        assert "/" not in payload["metadata"]["artifact_ref"]
        assert "\\" not in payload["metadata"]["artifact_ref"]

def test_reload_after_save(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """I + J: reload via de bestaande preview levert dezelfde
    geometry terug (tolerantie voor .3f-afronding)."""
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        parts = cube_parts(20.0)
        saved = save(client, parts).json()
        preview = client.get(
            "/api/v1/fab/mesh/preview",
            params={"artifact_ref": saved["derived_ref"],
                    "max_tris": 5000}).json()
        assert preview["total_tris"] == saved["total_tris"]
        assert preview["format"] == "stl-ascii"
        expected = build_editor_facets(parts)
        assert len(preview["tris"]) == len(expected)
        worst = 0.0
        for got_tri, want_tri in zip(preview["tris"],
                                     expected):
            for got_pt, want_pt in zip(got_tri, want_tri):
                for got, want in zip(got_pt, want_pt):
                    worst = max(worst, abs(got - want))
        assert worst < 0.002

    """M: failed proposal muteert de canonieke state niet;
    herhaalde execute is idempotent."""

        assert first["result"]["outcome"] == "failed"
        assert second["verification"] is None

"""Forge vertical-slice tests: tweede volledige slice IN /play.

Volgt hetzelfde patroon als Luma, maar met de echte testconditie
dat de fysieke A1 Mini NIET verbonden is:

- rendering: volledige flow zichtbaar zonder redirects
- data: abilities/tools/missions uit echte backend-state
- model -> inspect -> assess -> slice -> proposal-preview
- approval: exact YES, fingerprint, bestaande route, geen shortcut
- hardware gate stopt eerlijk (blocked, nooit fake success)
- quest-evidence uitsluitend uit bestaande derivatie
- fungi/guide: afgeleid, read-only, geen fake progressie
- node --check op gerenderde JS

import os
import re

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "forge.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "forge-chat.db"))

                       str(tmp_path / "forge-fab"))

        yield client


def _page(client) -> str:
    response = client.get("/play")
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.text


def _playdata(html: str) -> dict:
    match = re.search(r"const PLAYDATA = (\{.*?\});", html,
                      re.DOTALL)
    assert match, "PLAYDATA niet gevonden"
    return json.loads(match.group(1))


def test_forge_flow_markers_in_game(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        html = _page(client)
        for marker in (
                "Help mij iets te printen",
                "Missie-evidence",
                "Printability controleren",
                "Test-slice uitvoeren",
                "Printvoorstel bekijken",
                "Printvoorstel",
                "MODEL", "PRINTABILITY", "SLICER", "PRINTER",
                "RISICO / REQUIREMENTS", "PROPOSAL",
                "YES", "Annuleren",
                "Sessie:", "Model", "Analyse", "Voorstel",
                "Approval", "Hardware", "Uitvoering",
                "Verificatie",
                "Missie-evidence", "Fabrication-records",
                "Ververs wereld",
                "bestaande records tellen"):
            assert marker in html, marker


def test_forge_hardware_honesty_markers(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        assert "NIET VERBONDEN" in html

        assert "Meer informatie" in html

        # Geen fake succesclaims in de game-shell.

        assert "printer connected" not in html
        assert "Print geslaagd" not in html


def test_forge_data_matches_backend(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.campaigns import (
        ensure_fabrication_seeds,
    )
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ensure_fabrication_seeds()

        assert {"models", "printers", "missions", "profiles",
                "quests", "fabrecords"} <= set(forge)
        assert isinstance(forge["profiles"], list)
        assert "draft-pla" in forge["profiles"]
        goals = [m["goal"] for m in forge["missions"]]
        assert "Maak je eerste digitale prototype" in goals
        titles = [q["title"] for q in forge["quests"]]
        assert ("Missie: Maak je eerste digitale prototype"
                in titles)
        npcs = {n["id"]: n for n in data["npcs"]}
        panel = npcs["forge"]["panel"]
        for ability in panel["abilities"]:
            assert ability["type"] in ("DIGITAL", "PHYSICAL",
                                       "HYBRID")
            assert ability["available"]
            assert ability["via"]
        for tool in panel["tools"]:
            assert tool["state"]
            assert tool["detail"]
        names = [t["name"] for t in panel["tools"]]
        assert {"3D-modellen", "Slicer/workbench", "Printers",
                "INVENTory hardware"} <= set(names)
        names = [a["name"] for a in panel["abilities"]]
        assert "Print uitvoeren (fysiek)" in names
        phys = next(a for a in panel["abilities"]
                    if a["name"] == "Print uitvoeren (fysiek)")
        assert phys["type"] == "PHYSICAL"
        # Zonder printer: eerlijk onbeschikbaar, nooit AVAILABLE.
        assert phys["available"] in ("NOT_CONNECTED",
                                     "HARDWARE_REQUIRED")
        assert npcs["forge"]["familiar"]["id"].startswith("fam_")


def _seed_model_and_slice(client):
    from coordinator.app.mesh3d import ProceduralTestGenerator
    generated = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {})
    reg = client.post("/api/v1/workshop/models", json={
        "filename": generated.artifact_ref, "source": "generated"})

    model = reg.json()
    insp = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/workshop/models/{model['model_id']}/inspect")
    assert insp.status_code == 200, insp.text

                         params={"mesh_ref":
                                 generated.artifact_ref})

    sliced = client.post("/api/v1/fab/slice", json={
        "artifact_ref": generated.artifact_ref,
        "profile": "draft-pla", "printer_id": "prt-forge1"})
    assert sliced.status_code == 201, sliced.text
    return model, insp.json(), assess.json(), sliced.json()

                                               "inconclusive")


def test_forge_proposal_approval_hardware_gate(tmp_path,
                                               monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        # Zonder printer-record: voorstel geweigerd (eerste gate).
        missing = client.post("/api/v1/prints/propose", json={
            "printer_id": "prt-spook", "gcode_ref": "fab-x.gcode",
            "gcode_sha256": "0" * 64, "profile": "draft-pla",
            "actor": "game-jelles"})
        assert missing.status_code == 404
        _model, _insp, _assess, sliced = \
            _seed_model_and_slice(client)
        reg = client.post("/api/v1/printers/register", json={
            "printer_id": "prt-forge1", "name": "A1 Mini (test)",
            "capabilities": ["printer.status",
                             "printer.start"]})
        assert reg.status_code == 201, reg.text
        prop = client.post("/api/v1/prints/propose", json={
            "printer_id": "prt-forge1",
            "gcode_ref": sliced["slice"]["gcode_ref"],
            "gcode_sha256": sliced["slice"]["sha256"],
            "profile": "draft-pla", "actor": "game-jelles"})
        assert prop.status_code == 201, prop.text
        pid = (prop.json().get("proposal_id")
               or prop.json()["proposal"]["proposal_id"])
        # Geen shortcut: alles behalve exact YES wordt geweigerd
        # (bestaande semantiek: denied approval, status rejected).
        for wrong in ("yes", "Yes", "NO", "Y"):
            trial = client.post("/api/v1/prints/propose", json={
                "printer_id": "prt-forge1",
                "gcode_ref": sliced["slice"]["gcode_ref"],
                "gcode_sha256": sliced["slice"]["sha256"],
                "profile": "draft-pla", "actor": "game-jelles"})
            assert trial.status_code == 201, trial.text
            tid = (trial.json().get("proposal_id")
                   or trial.json()["proposal"]["proposal_id"])
            denied = client.post(f"/api/v1/writes/{tid}/approve",
                                 json={"response": wrong,
                                       "decided_by": "jelles"})
            assert denied.status_code == 200, wrong
            assert denied.json()["status"] == "rejected", wrong
            assert denied.json()["status"] != "approved", wrong
            blocked = client.post(f"/api/v1/writes/{tid}/execute")
            assert blocked.status_code == 409, wrong
        ok = client.post(f"/api/v1/writes/{pid}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES",
                               "decided_by": "jelles"})
        assert ok.status_code == 200, ok.text
        assert ok.json()["status"] == "approved"
        # Printer-record zonder adapter: execution stopt eerlijk.
        ex = client.post(f"/api/v1/writes/{pid}/execute")
        assert ex.status_code == 200, ex.text
        body = ex.json()
        assert body["status"] == "blocked"
        assert body["status"] != "executed"
        assert "adapter" in (body["result"].get("error")
                             or "").lower()
        # Verificatie kan nooit slagen zonder uitvoering.
        ver = client.post(f"/api/v1/writes/{pid}/verify")
        assert ver.status_code == 200, ver.text
        assert ver.json()["verification"]["outcome"] != "passed"

def test_forge_node_syntax(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import shutil
    import subprocess
    import tempfile
    node = shutil.which("node")
    if node is None:
        pytest.skip("node niet beschikbaar")
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        html = _page(client)
        scripts = re.findall(r"<script>(.*?)</script>", html,
                             re.DOTALL)
        game = [s for s in scripts if "PLAYDATA" in s]
        assert len(game) == 1
        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
                "w", suffix=".js", delete=False,
                encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(game[0])
            path = handle.name
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(
                [node, "--check", path], capture_output=True,
                timeout=60)
            assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr.decode(
                "utf-8", "replace")[:500]
        finally:
            try:
                os.remove(path)
            except OSError:
                pass

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_git_commit.py">
"""Git controlled-commit tests (BIG #5).

Boundary enforcement, approval binding, commit execution with
fixed argv only, and readback verification. Uses disposable
local repositories; nothing is pushed anywhere.
"""

import hashlib
import os
import subprocess

import pytest

from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import (
    decide_write,
    request_write_approval,
    write_fingerprint,
)
from coordinator.app.git_commit import (
    GitWriteFailedError,
    GitWriteRefusedError,
    execute_git_commit,
    propose_git_commit,
    read_commit_state,
    verify_git_commit,
)
from coordinator.app.verification import (
    is_verified,
    new_verification_request,
)


def git(*args, cwd):
    completed = subprocess.run(
        ["git", *args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True,
        timeout=30)
    assert completed.returncode == 0, completed.stderr
    return completed.stdout.strip()


def make_repo(tmp_path, name="repo"):
    repo = tmp_path / name
    repo.mkdir()
    git("init", cwd=str(repo))
    git("config", "user.email", "test@local", cwd=str(repo))
    git("config", "user.name", "test", cwd=str(repo))
    (repo / "notes.txt").write_text("basis\n", encoding="utf-8")
    git("add", "--", "notes.txt", cwd=str(repo))
    git("commit", "-m", "basis", cwd=str(repo))
    return str(repo)


def diff_fingerprint(repo):
    diff = subprocess.run(
        ["git", "-C", repo, "diff", "--stat"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30).stdout
    return hashlib.sha256(diff.encode()).hexdigest()


def approve(proposal):
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    return decide_write(request, proposal, "YES", decided_by="jelles")


def test_propose_valid_commit(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    branch = git("branch", "--show-current", cwd=repo)
    proposal = propose_git_commit(
        "wrt-git1", repo, branch, head, "testcommit",
        ["notes.txt"], changeset_fingerprint="0" * 64,
        actor="t", allow_list=[repo])
    assert proposal.mutation_type == "git.commit"
    assert proposal.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert len(write_fingerprint(proposal)) == 64


def test_repository_outside_allow_list_refused(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    branch = git("branch", "--show-current", cwd=repo) or "main"
    with pytest.raises(GitWriteRefusedError, match="allow-list"):
        propose_git_commit(
            "wrt-gitx", repo, branch, head, "x", ["notes.txt"],
            changeset_fingerprint="0" * 64, actor="t",
            allow_list=[str(tmp_path / "elsewhere")])


def test_empty_allow_list_refuses_everything(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_GIT_WRITE_REPOS", "")
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    with pytest.raises(GitWriteRefusedError, match="allow-list"):
        propose_git_commit(
            "wrt-gity", repo, "main", head, "x", ["notes.txt"],
            changeset_fingerprint="0" * 64, actor="t")


@pytest.mark.parametrize("evil", [
    "../buiten.txt", "/absoluut/pad.txt", "..\\windows.txt",
    "sub/../../ontsnapt.txt",
])
def test_path_traversal_refused(tmp_path, evil):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    with pytest.raises(GitWriteRefusedError,
                       match="escapes|outside|plain"):
        propose_git_commit(
            "wrt-gitz", repo, "main", head, "x", [evil],
            changeset_fingerprint="0" * 64, actor="t",
            allow_list=[repo])


def test_successful_commit_and_verification(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    branch = git("branch", "--show-current", cwd=repo)
    (open(os.path.join(repo, "nieuw.txt"), "w",
          encoding="utf-8")).write("hallo mycelium\n")
    fingerprint = diff_fingerprint(repo)
    proposal = propose_git_commit(
        "wrt-git2", repo, branch, head, "voeg nieuw bestand toe",
        ["nieuw.txt"], changeset_fingerprint=fingerprint,
        actor="t", allow_list=[repo])
    result = execute_git_commit(
        proposal, approve(proposal), allow_list=[repo])
    assert result.outcome == "executed"
    assert result.after["commit_sha"]
    new_head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    assert new_head == result.after["commit_sha"]
    # Independent verification passes.
    request = new_verification_request(
        proposal.proposal_id, result.fingerprint, "git.readback",
        {"kind": "commit", "repository": repo, "branch": branch,
         "parent": head})
    verification = verify_git_commit(request, result,
                                     allow_list=[repo])
    assert verification.outcome == "passed"
    assert is_verified(verification) is True


def test_expected_head_mismatch_blocked(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    branch = git("branch", "--show-current", cwd=repo)
    proposal = propose_git_commit(
        "wrt-git3", repo, branch, "0" * 40, "oude head",
        ["notes.txt"], changeset_fingerprint="0" * 64,
        actor="t", allow_list=[repo])
    result = execute_git_commit(
        proposal, approve(proposal), allow_list=[repo])
    assert result.outcome == "blocked"
    assert "HEAD moved" in result.error


def test_unexpected_worktree_changes_blocked(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    branch = git("branch", "--show-current", cwd=repo)
    (open(os.path.join(repo, "goedgekeurd.txt"), "w",
          encoding="utf-8")).write("ok\n")
    (open(os.path.join(repo, "stiekem.txt"), "w",
          encoding="utf-8")).write("niet goedgekeurd\n")
    proposal = propose_git_commit(
        "wrt-git4", repo, branch, head, "alleen goedgekeurd",
        ["goedgekeurd.txt"],
        changeset_fingerprint=diff_fingerprint(repo),
        actor="t", allow_list=[repo])
    result = execute_git_commit(
        proposal, approve(proposal), allow_list=[repo])
    assert result.outcome == "blocked"
    assert "Unexpected" in result.error
    # Nothing was committed.
    assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo) == head


def test_wrong_branch_blocked(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    proposal = propose_git_commit(
        "wrt-git5", repo, "niet-deze-branch", head, "x",
        ["notes.txt"], changeset_fingerprint="0" * 64,
        actor="t", allow_list=[repo])
    result = execute_git_commit(
        proposal, approve(proposal), allow_list=[repo])
    assert result.outcome == "blocked"
    assert "Branch" in result.error


def test_commit_without_approval_raises(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    branch = git("branch", "--show-current", cwd=repo)
    proposal = propose_git_commit(
        "wrt-git6", repo, branch, head, "x", ["notes.txt"],
        changeset_fingerprint="0" * 64, actor="t",
        allow_list=[repo])
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    rejected = decide_write(request, proposal, "NO")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Only an approved"):
        execute_git_commit(proposal, rejected, allow_list=[repo])


def test_verification_detects_history_change(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    branch = git("branch", "--show-current", cwd=repo)
    (open(os.path.join(repo, "a.txt"), "w",
          encoding="utf-8")).write("a\n")
    proposal = propose_git_commit(
        "wrt-git7", repo, branch, head, "commit a", ["a.txt"],
        changeset_fingerprint=diff_fingerprint(repo),
        actor="t", allow_list=[repo])
    result = execute_git_commit(
        proposal, approve(proposal), allow_list=[repo])
    assert result.outcome == "executed"
    # Expectation names a parent that never existed.
    request = new_verification_request(
        proposal.proposal_id, result.fingerprint, "git.readback",
        {"kind": "commit", "repository": repo, "branch": branch,
         "parent": "f" * 40})
    verification = verify_git_commit(request, result,
                                     allow_list=[repo])
    assert verification.outcome == "failed"
    assert is_verified(verification) is False


def test_no_push_force_or_arbitrary_command_exists():
    import coordinator.app.git_commit as module
    import pathlib
    source = pathlib.Path(module.__file__).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for token in ('"push"', "'push'", '"fetch"', '"checkout"',
                  '"merge"', '"remote"', '"clone"', '"--force"',
                  "shell=True", "os.system", "eval(", "exec("):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"
    assert "shell=False" in source


def test_read_commit_state_is_read_only(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path)
    head = git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo)
    state = read_commit_state(repo, allow_list=[repo])
    assert state["head"] == head
    assert state["changed_files"] == []
    assert git("rev-parse", "HEAD", cwd=repo) == head

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_git_context.py">
"""Git read-only context tests (Fase M/Q).

Status/branch/diff from a scratch repo; missing paths refused;
no push/merge/commit surface exists anywhere in the module.
"""

import subprocess

import pytest

from coordinator.app import git_context
from coordinator.app.git_context import git_branch, git_diff, git_status

try:
    subprocess.run(["git", "--version"], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
    GIT_AVAILABLE = True
except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
    GIT_AVAILABLE = False

needs_git = pytest.mark.skipif(not GIT_AVAILABLE, reason="git missing")


def make_repo(path):
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    subprocess.run(["git", "init"], cwd=str(path), capture_output=True,
                   check=True, timeout=30)
    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.email", "t@t.t"], cwd=str(path),
                   capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
    subprocess.run(["git", "config", "user.name", "t"], cwd=str(path),
                   capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
    (path / "a.txt").write_text("een\n", encoding="utf-8")
    subprocess.run(["git", "add", "."], cwd=str(path), capture_output=True,
                   check=True, timeout=30)
    subprocess.run(["git", "commit", "-m", "init"], cwd=str(path),
                   capture_output=True, check=True, timeout=30)
    (path / "a.txt").write_text("een\ntwee\n", encoding="utf-8")
    return str(path)


@needs_git
def test_status_branch_diff_readonly(tmp_path):
    repo = make_repo(tmp_path / "repo")
    status = git_status(repo)
    assert any("a.txt" in line for line in status["lines"])
    branch = git_branch(repo)
    assert branch["branch"]
    diff = git_diff(repo)
    assert "a.txt" in diff["diff"]


@needs_git
def test_non_git_directory_unavailable(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        git_status(str(tmp_path))


def test_missing_path_refused(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        git_status(str(tmp_path / "bestaat-niet"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        git_branch("")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        git_diff(str(tmp_path / "file.txt"))


def test_no_write_surface_in_module():
    names = set(dir(git_context))
    for banned in ("push", "merge", "commit", "checkout", "pull",
                   "reset", "execute", "run_command"):
        assert banned not in names
    source = open(git_context.__file__, encoding="utf-8").read()
    assert "shell=True" not in source
    assert '"push"' not in source and "'push'" not in source
    assert '"checkout"' not in source and "'checkout'" not in source

"""FASE 9/10 tests (BIG #16): provenance defaults + save invariants.

Machine-created records never default to human_verified;
function-level saves enforce stage/evidence/revision rules
so future callers cannot bypass route checks.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance


def test_machine_defaults_not_verified():
    from coordinator.app import cad, drones, familiars
    from coordinator.app import fabrication, robots, skills
    assert robots.new_robot(
        "R", capabilities=["robot.status"]).provenance.human_verified is False
    assert drones.new_drone(
        "D", capabilities=["drone.observe"]).provenance.human_verified is False
    assert familiars.new_familiar(
        "F", "digital").provenance.human_verified is False
    document = cad.new_document("Doc")
    assert document.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert fabrication.new_spool(
        "PLA", 100).provenance.human_verified is False
    assert skills.new_skill(
        "Soldering").provenance.human_verified is False
    # Explicit human provenance still accepted.
    human = Provenance(source_type="user-created",
                       creator_id="jelles", human_verified=True,
                       verified_by="jelles")
    assert robots.new_robot("R2", provenance=human
                            ).provenance.human_verified is True


def test_save_skill_rejects_unevidenced_stages(tmp_path,
                                               monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "h.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "h-chat.db"))
    from coordinator.app.skills import (
        Skill, SkillRefusedError, generate_skill_id, now,
        save_skill)
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance as Prov
    base = dict(skill_id=generate_skill_id(), name="X",
                category="", description="", prerequisites=[],
                related_skills=[], proficiency="unknown",
                evidence=[], source="",
                provenance=Prov(source_type="user-created",
                                creator_id="t",
                                human_verified=False),
                project_refs=[], created_at=now(),
                updated_at=now())
    with pytest.raises(SkillRefusedError):
        save_skill(Skill(**{**base, "stage": "applied"}))
    with pytest.raises(SkillRefusedError):
        save_skill(Skill(**{**base, "stage": "mastered"}))
    # Evidenced but unverified top stage still refuses.
    from coordinator.app.skills import SkillEvidence
    evidenced = Skill(**{
        **base, "stage": "demonstrated",
        "evidence": [SkillEvidence(kind="project", ref="p1"),
                     SkillEvidence(kind="print", ref="p2")]})
    with pytest.raises(SkillRefusedError):
        save_skill(evidenced)
    verified = evidenced.model_copy(update={
        "provenance": Prov(
            source_type="user-created", creator_id="t",
            human_verified=True, verified_by="t")})
    save_skill(verified)  # passes


def test_save_memory_revision_conflict(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "h2.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "h2-chat.db"))
    from coordinator.app.memory import (
        MemoryRefusedError, get_memory, new_memory, save_memory)
    entry = new_memory("fact", "Revision guard",
                       truth="user_fact",
                       provenance=Provenance(
                           source_type="user-created",
                           creator_id="t", human_verified=True,
                           verified_by="t"))
    save_memory(entry)
    stored = get_memory(entry.memory_id)
    moved = stored.model_copy(update={
        "revision": stored.revision + 1,
        "content": "moved on"})
    save_memory(moved)
    with pytest.raises(MemoryRefusedError):
        save_memory(moved, expected_revision=1)
    save_memory(moved, expected_revision=2)


def test_payload_unified_bans(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.diststate import (
        DistStateRefusedError, new_envelope)
    from coordinator.app.events import (
        EventRefusedError, new_event)
    from coordinator.app.payloads import (
        BANNED_PAYLOAD_KEYS, check_payload)
    assert {"sql", "query", "command", "shell", "exec",
            "url", "callback"} <= set(BANNED_PAYLOAD_KEYS)
    # Top-level bans on both paths.
    for banned in ("command", "shell", "sql", "query", "url",
                   "approved", "execute_now", "COMMAND"):
        with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
            new_envelope("node-a", "obj_1", "object",
                         "entity.observed",
                         payload={banned: "x"})
        with pytest.raises(EventRefusedError):
            new_event("task.queued", "summary",
                      payload={banned: "x"})
    # Nested bans refuse too.
    with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
        new_envelope("node-a", "obj_1", "object",
                     "entity.observed",
                     payload={"outer": {"exec": "rm"}})
    with pytest.raises(EventRefusedError):
        new_event("task.queued", "summary",
                  payload={"items": [{"sql": "select"}]})
    # Depth cap refuses hostile nesting.
    deep = {}
    cursor = deep
    for _ in range(10):
        cursor["next"] = {}
        cursor = cursor["next"]
    with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
        new_envelope("node-a", "obj_1", "object",
                     "entity.observed", payload=deep)
    # Oversized values and key counts refuse.
    with pytest.raises(EventRefusedError):
        new_event("task.queued", "summary",
                  payload={"note": "x" * 501})
    with pytest.raises(DistStateRefusedError):
        new_envelope("node-a", "obj_1", "object",
                     "entity.observed",
                     payload={f"key{i}": i for i in range(31)})
    # Legit nested metadata still passes.
    kept = check_payload({"a": {"b": ["x", 1, None]}},
                         max_keys=20, max_value_chars=500,
                         error=EventRefusedError)
    assert kept == {"a": {"b": ["x", 1, None]}}

def test_health_measure_trend_index(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        # Unknown metric refuses; out-of-range refuses.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/health/measurements",
                                json={"metric": "nope",
                                      "value": 1}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/health/measurements",
                                json={"metric": "sleep_hours",
                                      "value": 99}).status_code == 422
        first = test_client.post("/api/v1/health/measurements",
                                 json={"metric": "sleep_hours",
                                       "value": 7.5,
                                       "source": "manual",
                                       "observed_at":
                                       "2026-09-10T22:00:00+00:00"}
                                 ).json()
        assert first["stored"] is True
        assert first["unit"] == "h"
        # Same metric/source/moment dedups.
        again = test_client.post("/api/v1/health/measurements",
                                 json={"metric": "sleep_hours",
                                       "value": 7.5,
                                       "source": "manual",
                                       "observed_at":
                                       "2026-09-10T22:00:00+00:00"}
                                 ).json()
        assert again["duplicate"] is True
        trend = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/health/trends/sleep_hours").json()
        assert trend["count"] == 1
        assert trend["avg"] == 7.5
        assert "method" in trend and "completeness" in trend
        index = test_client.get("/api/v1/health/index").json()
        assert index["dimensions"]["sleep"]["value"] is not None
        assert index["dimensions"]["training"]["value"] is None
        assert "overall_method" in index
        assert "overall_completeness" in index
        listed = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/health/measurements",
            params={"metric": "sleep_hours"}).json()
        assert len(listed) == 1

def test_nutrition_meal_totals_vegan_coverage(tmp_path,
                                              monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        # Vegan claim without evidence refuses.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/nutrition/foods", json={
            "name": "X", "nutrients": {"protein_g": 10},
            "vegan_status": "vegan"}).status_code == 422
        oats = test_client.post("/api/v1/nutrition/foods", json={
            "name": "Havermout",
            "nutrients": {"calories": 389, "protein_g": 13,
                          "fiber_g": 10, "iron_mg": 4.7},
            "vegan_status": "vegan",
            "vegan_evidence": "ingredients: whole grain oats"}).json()
        assert oats["food_id"].startswith("food_")
        # Unknown nutrient refuses.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/nutrition/foods", json={
            "name": "Y",
            "nutrients": {"frobnicate": 1}}).status_code == 422
        meal = test_client.post("/api/v1/nutrition/meals", json={
            "name": "Ontbijt",
            "items": [{"name": "Havermout",
                       "food_id": oats["food_id"],
                       "portion_g": 80,
                       "nutrients": oats["nutrients"],
                       "vegan_status": "vegan"},
                      {"name": "Banaan", "portion_g": 120,
                       "nutrients": {"calories": 89,
                                     "carbs_g": 23},
                       "vegan_status": "unknown"}],
            "observed_at": "2026-09-16T08:00:00+00:00"}).json()
        assert meal["totals"]["calories"] == round(
            389 * 0.8 + 89 * 1.2, 3)
        # Weakest vegan claim wins: unknown present.
        assert meal["vegan_status"] == "unknown"
        daily = test_client.get("/api/v1/nutrition/daily",
                                params={
                                    "day": "2026-09-16"}).json()
        assert daily["totals"]["meals"] == 1
        coverage = daily["coverage"]
        assert coverage["nutrients"]["protein_g"]["status"] in (
            "adequate", "possibly low", "possibly high",
            "unknown")
        assert coverage["reference_source"]
        assert "uncertainty" in coverage
        weekly = test_client.get("/api/v1/nutrition/weekly",
                                 params={
                                     "end_day": "2026-09-16"}).json()
        assert len(weekly["days"]) == 7
        assert weekly["days"][-1]["meals"] == 1

        assert first["provider_state"] == "MOCK"

            "/api/v1/integrations/garmin/import",
            json={"provider": "mock", "limit": 6}).json()
        assert second["imported"] == 0
        assert second["duplicates"] == 6
        # Imported values land in health with wearable source.
        steps = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/health/measurements",
            params={"metric": "steps",
                    "source": "wearable"}).json()
        assert len(steps) == 2
        assert steps[0]["provenance"]["source_type"] == \
            "external-source"

"""Hermes all-NPC + durable history + opt-in screen summary tests.

Fake bridge and fake vision only: live Hermes/Ollama never needed.
Tmp databases via monkeypatch (no os.environ leaks).
"""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.hermes_npc as npc_mod
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.hermes_bridge import HermesUnavailable

ALL_NPCS = ("mos", "oracle", "smid", "archivaris", "voorman",
            "seinwachter")


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "hall.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "hall-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", "hall-operator")
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
    monkeypatch.setenv("OLLAMA_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


class _FakeBridge:
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.calls = []

    def send(self, session_key, message, max_tokens=500):
        self.calls.append((session_key, message, max_tokens))
        return {"session_key": session_key, "message_id": "m1",
                "model": "hermes-agent", "text": "Hallo, ik luister.",
                "finish_reason": "stop"}


def _fake_factory(store):
    def factory(*args, **kwargs):
        fake = _FakeBridge()
        store.append(fake)
        return fake
    return factory


def test_all_npcs_known_and_chat_200(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    fakes = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(npc_mod, "HermesBridge", _fake_factory(fakes))
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        for npc in ALL_NPCS:
            assert npc_mod.npc_session_key(npc, "play_x") == \
                f"npc-{npc}-play_x"
            res = test_client.post("/api/v1/hermes/chat", json={
                "npc_id": npc, "message": f"Hoi {npc}!",
                "session_id": "play_x"})
            assert res.status_code == 200, (npc, res.text)
            body = res.json()
            assert body["npc_id"] == npc
            assert body["npc_name"] == npc_mod.HERMES_NPCS[npc]["name"]
            assert body["session_key"] == f"npc-{npc}-play_x"
            assert body["conversation_id"].startswith("conv-hermes-")
        assert len(fakes) == len(ALL_NPCS)


def test_history_persists_across_turns(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    fakes = []
    monkeypatch.setattr(npc_mod, "HermesBridge", _fake_factory(fakes))
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        first = test_client.post("/api/v1/hermes/chat", json={
            "npc_id": "oracle", "message": "eerste vraag",
            "session_id": "play_hist"}).json()
        conv = first["conversation_id"]
        second = test_client.post("/api/v1/hermes/chat", json={
            "npc_id": "oracle", "message": "tweede vraag",
            "session_id": "play_hist"}).json()
        assert second["conversation_id"] == conv
        hist = test_client.get("/api/v1/hermes/history", params={
            "npc_id": "oracle", "session_id": "play_hist"})
        assert hist.status_code == 200, hist.text
        body = hist.json()
        assert body["conversation_id"] == conv
        assert body["session_key"] == "npc-oracle-play_hist"
        roles = [t["role"] for t in body["turns"]]
        assert roles == ["user", "agent", "user", "agent"]
        texts = [t["content"] for t in body["turns"]]
        assert "eerste vraag" in texts[0]
        assert "tweede vraag" in texts[2]
        # Other NPC, same play session: separate durable thread.
        other = test_client.post("/api/v1/hermes/chat", json={
            "npc_id": "smid", "message": "smid vraag",
            "session_id": "play_hist"}).json()
        assert other["conversation_id"] != conv

def test_include_screen_vlm_text_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app import vision_provider as vp_mod

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_hermes_bridge.py">
"""Hermes bridge tests: validation refuses locally, transport
errors surface as HermesUnavailable. Live server never needed
(mock transport only)."""

import httpx
import pytest

from coordinator.app.hermes_bridge import (
    HermesBridge,
    HermesRefusedError,
    HermesUnavailable,
)


def _ok_transport():
    def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        assert request.headers["Authorization"] == "Bearer test-key"
        assert request.headers["X-Hermes-Session-Key"] == "game-1"
        return httpx.Response(200, json={
            "id": "chatcmpl-1", "model": "hermes-agent",
            "choices": [{"message": {"role": "assistant",
                                     "content": "hi"},
                         "finish_reason": "stop"}]})
    return httpx.MockTransport(handler)


def test_send_roundtrip():
    bridge = HermesBridge(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8642",
                          api_key="test-key",
                          transport=_ok_transport())
    out = bridge.send("game-1", "hello")
    assert out["text"] == "hi"
    assert out["session_key"] == "game-1"
    assert out["message_id"] == "chatcmpl-1"
    assert out["finish_reason"] == "stop"


def test_refuses_non_loopback():
    with pytest.raises(HermesRefusedError):
        HermesBridge(base_url="http://192.168.1.10:8642",
                     api_key="test-key")


def test_refuses_missing_key(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("HERMES_API_KEY", raising=False)
    with pytest.raises(HermesRefusedError):
        HermesBridge(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8642")


def test_refuses_bad_input():
    bridge = HermesBridge(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8642",
                          api_key="test-key",
                          transport=_ok_transport())
    with pytest.raises(HermesRefusedError):
        bridge.send("", "hello")
    with pytest.raises(HermesRefusedError):
        bridge.send("game-1", "   ")
    with pytest.raises(HermesRefusedError):
        bridge.send("game-1", "x" * 64_001)


def test_auth_failure_is_unavailable():
    def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        return httpx.Response(401, json={"error": "nope"})
    bridge = HermesBridge(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8642",
                          api_key="bad-key",
                          transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler))
    with pytest.raises(HermesUnavailable):
        bridge.send("game-1", "hello")


def test_timeout_is_unavailable():
    def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        raise httpx.ConnectError("refused")
    bridge = HermesBridge(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8642",
                          api_key="test-key",
                          transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler))
    with pytest.raises(HermesUnavailable):
        bridge.send("game-1", "hello")


def test_health_roundtrip():
    def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"ok": True})
    bridge = HermesBridge(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8642",
                          api_key="test-key",

class _FakeBridge:
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.calls = []

    def send(self, session_key, message, max_tokens=500):
        self.calls.append((session_key, message, max_tokens))
        assert "Mos" in message or "mos" in session_key
        return {"session_key": session_key, "message_id": "m1",
                "model": "hermes-agent", "text": "Hoi, ik ben Mos.",
                "finish_reason": "stop"}

        "npc-mos-play_abc"

    try:
        npc_mod.npc_session_key("dragon", "play_abc")
    except HermesRefusedError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("unknown npc must refuse")

def test_chat_route_uses_bridge(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        fake = _FakeBridge()
        fakes.append(fake)
        return fake

    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

"""SP Home Base 3D (/homebase): procedureel Three.js-pand.

@contextmanager
def _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

def test_homebase_page_shape(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

def test_homebase_building_markers():

        assert marker in js, marker

def test_homebase_no_mutation_routes():
    for route in main_mod.app.routes:
        path = getattr(route, "path", "")
        if path.startswith("/homebase"):
            methods = getattr(route, "methods", set()) or set()
            assert methods <= {"GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"}, methods


def test_homebase_no_backend_writes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    with _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch) as client:
        before = {}
        import glob as _glob
        for db_file in _glob.glob(str(tmp_path / "*.db")):
            con = sqlite3.connect(db_file)
            try:
                before[db_file] = {
                    row[0]: con.execute(
                        f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{row[0]}"').fetchone()[0]
                    for row in con.execute(
                        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master "
                        "WHERE type='table'")}
            finally:
                con.close()
        client.get("/homebase")
        import glob as _glob2
        for db_file in _glob2.glob(str(tmp_path / "*.db")):
            con = sqlite3.connect(db_file)
            try:
                tables = [row[0] for row in con.execute(
                    "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master "
                    "WHERE type='table'")]
                assert not any(
                    key in name.lower() for name in tables
                    for key in ("homebase", "house", "building")), tables
                for table in tables:
                    if table in before.get(db_file, {}):
                        now = con.execute(
                            f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "{table}"').fetchone()[0]
                        assert now == before[db_file][table], (table, now)
            finally:
                con.close()

def test_simulated_printer_badged(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import (
        SimulatedPrinterAdapter,
        adapter_for_printer,

        unregister_printer,
    )

        client.post("/api/v1/printers/register", json={
            "printer_id": "prt-sim", "name": "Sim",
            "capabilities": ["printer.status"]})
        from coordinator.app.printer3d import list_stored_printers
        device = next(item for item in list_stored_printers()

def test_voice_refuses_physical_writes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        robot = client.post("/api/v1/robots", json={
            "name": "R", "robot_type": "robotic_arm",
            "capabilities": ["robot.move"]}).json()
        proposed = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot['robot_id']}/propose",
            json={"action": "robot.move",
                  "actor": "jelles"}).json()
        proposal_id = proposed["proposal"]["proposal_id"]
        # Physical mutations never resolve by voice.
        assert client.post("/api/v1/voice/approval-requests",
                           json={"kind": "write",
                                 "target_id": proposal_id}
                           ).status_code == 422
        # Unknown kinds never resolve either.
        assert client.post("/api/v1/voice/approval-requests",
                           json={"kind": "physical",
                                 "target_id": "x"}
                           ).status_code == 422


def test_voice_allows_desktop_interface(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.voice_approval import (
        VoiceApprovalRefusedError,
        VoiceApprovalRequest,
        now,
        resolve_voice_approval,
    )
    request = VoiceApprovalRequest(
        approval_id="vapr-test", kind="desktop",
        target_id="act_1", fingerprint="",
        created_at=now(),
        expires_at="2999-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
    outcome = resolve_voice_approval(
        [request], "ja", kind="desktop", target_ok=True)
    assert outcome == {"approved": True, "response": "YES",
                       "approval_id": "vapr-test",
                       "reason": "exactly one active request, "
                                 "unexpired, binding intact, "
                                 "explicit YES word"}
    with pytest.raises(VoiceApprovalRefusedError):
        resolve_voice_approval([request], "ja", kind="physical",
                               target_ok=True)

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_insta360.py">
"""Insta360 grab runtime: label-validatie, child-snippet guards,
parent-verificatie met gemockte subprocess (echte ffmpeg/camera
draait nooit in pytest), route-mapping voor source=insta360.
"""

import json
import os
from contextlib import contextmanager
from types import SimpleNamespace

import coordinator.app.capture_probe as probe_mod
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.capture_probe import (
    _GRAB_SNIPPET,

    run_grab,

@contextmanager
def _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

def _register(client, device_id="cam-insta1", kinds=None, source="insta360"):

        "device_id": device_id, "name": "Insta360 X3",
        "kinds": kinds or ["snapshot"], "source": source})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()


def test_insta360_label_defaults_and_validation(monkeypatch):

    assert insta360_label() == "Insta360 X3"
    monkeypatch.setenv("INSTA360_DSHOW_NAME", "Cam (front)")
    assert insta360_label() == "Cam (front)"
    for bad in ["a;b", "x|y", "../../e", "a" * 81, "", "cam$dollar"]:
        monkeypatch.setenv("INSTA360_DSHOW_NAME", bad)

    assert "shell=True" not in _GRAB_SNIPPET
    assert "shell =" not in _GRAB_SNIPPET

def test_run_grab_insta360_unavailable(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """ffmpeg-mislukking in child -> benoemde verdict, geen bytes."""
    def fake_run(*args, **kwargs):
        return SimpleNamespace(
            returncode=0, stderr="",
            stdout=json.dumps({"state": "unavailable",
                               "reason": "ffmpeg not on PATH"}))
    monkeypatch.setattr(probe_mod.subprocess, "run", fake_run)
    result = run_grab({"grabber": "insta360"}, timeout=5)
    assert result["state"] == "unavailable"
    assert "ffmpeg" in result["reason"]


def test_run_grab_insta360_frame_verifies_parent_side(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Ouder verifieert bestand + sha zelf; child-woord is niet genoeg."""
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    payload = b"\xff\xd8fake-jpeg-bytes\xff\xd9" * 100
    digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    name = "cam-insta360-pytest.jpg"
    path = os.path.join(camera_dir(), name)
    with open(path, "wb") as handle:
        handle.write(payload)
    try:
        def fake_run(*args, **kwargs):
            return SimpleNamespace(
                returncode=0, stderr="",
                stdout=json.dumps({"state": "frame_acquired",
                                   "media_ref": name, "sha256": digest,
                                   "size_bytes": len(payload),
                                   "width": 1920, "height": 1080,
                                   "reason": "fake child"}))
        monkeypatch.setattr(probe_mod.subprocess, "run", fake_run)
        result = run_grab({"grabber": "insta360"}, timeout=5)
        assert result["state"] == "frame_acquired"
        assert result["media_ref"] == name
        assert result["width"] == 1920 and result["height"] == 1080
        # Geknoei met de hash -> ouder weigert.
        def fake_tampered(*args, **kwargs):
            return SimpleNamespace(
                returncode=0, stderr="",
                stdout=json.dumps({"state": "frame_acquired",
                                   "media_ref": name, "sha256": "0" * 64,
                                   "size_bytes": len(payload),
                                   "width": 1, "height": 1,
                                   "reason": "fake child"}))
        monkeypatch.setattr(probe_mod.subprocess, "run", fake_tampered)
        tampered = run_grab({"grabber": "insta360"}, timeout=5)
        assert tampered["state"] == "error"
        assert "hash" in tampered["reason"]
    finally:
        if os.path.isfile(path):
            os.remove(path)


def test_probe_grab_insta360_route_maps_source(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """source=insta360 -> grabber insta360; frame wordt observatie."""
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    payload = b"\xff\xd8route-bytes\xff\xd9" * 100
    digest = hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest()
    name = "cam-insta360-route.jpg"
    path = os.path.join(camera_dir(), name)
    with open(path, "wb") as handle:
        handle.write(payload)
    try:
        def fake_grab(spec, timeout=30.0):
            assert spec == {"grabber": "insta360"}
            return {"state": "frame_acquired", "media_ref": name,
                    "sha256": digest, "size_bytes": len(payload),
                    "width": 1280, "height": 720,
                    "reason": "fake grab", "elapsed_ms": 3}
        monkeypatch.setattr(probe_mod, "run_grab", fake_grab)
        with _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch) as client:
            _register(client)
            res = client.post("/api/v1/cameras/cam-insta1/probe-grab",
                              json={"timeout": 5})
            assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
            body = res.json()
            assert body["camera_observation"]["media_ref"] == name
            assert body["camera_observation"]["width"] == 1280
            notes = body["camera_observation"]["provenance"]["notes"]
            assert "grabber=insta360" in notes
    finally:
        if os.path.isfile(path):
            os.remove(path)

def test_observation_image_serves_stored_frame(tmp_path,
                                              monkeypatch):
    """1-klik beeld: opgeslagen frame als bytes; onbekend 404,
    ongeldig id 422, zonder media 409. Echte JPEG leest via
    de allow-listed camera-dir (OS-temp, geen echte camera)."""

        camera_dir, new_observation, save_observation)
    with _client(tmp_path, monkeypatch) as client:
        missing = client.get(

            "/api/v1/cameras/observations/obs-empty1/image")

        assert res.headers["content-type"].startswith(

"""INTEGRATION PASS end-to-end tests (flows A-H).

Every flow runs against the real backend on tmp DBs through the real
HTTP API + real UI pages. No hardware, no desktop actions, no shell,
no model downloads: safe digital kinds only (system_inventory).

FLOW A  UI -> mission -> task -> agent -> completion -> event
FLOW B  inventory bridge -> worldgraph -> world UI (honest offline)
FLOW C  research/memory -> provenance -> context packet
FLOW D  mission -> task -> context packet -> code_worker gate
FLOW E  agent ownership -> completion authorization
FLOW F  scheduler (on-demand jobs) -> sweep -> event -> UI
FLOW G  /play -> backend state -> visible result
FLOW H  approval -> gated action -> audit event
PLUS    new integration-pass routes (tasks/approvals/system/SSE/router)
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from code_worker.main import check_call, WorkerRefusedError

TOKEN_A = "integ-token-node-a-123456"
TOKEN_B = "integ-token-node-b-123456"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "integ.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "integ-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register(client, node_id, caps, token):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "seed",
        "capabilities": caps, "node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def heartbeat(client, node_id, token):
    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat",
                           json={"available": True,
                                 "node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 204, response.text


def make_mission(client, goal="integration mission"):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": "conv-integ",
        "goal": goal,
        "steps": [{"kind": "readout", "description": "read git status",
                   "parameters": {"source": "git-status"}}]})
    assert response.status_code in (200, 201), response.text
    body = response.json()
    assert body["status"] == "pending_approval"
    return body["mission_id"]


def approve_mission(client, mission_id):
    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
                           json={"response": "YES",
                                 "decided_by": "integ-test"})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    assert response.json()["status"] == "approved"

def test_flow_a_mission_task_agent_completion_event(tmp_path,
                                                    monkeypatch):

        heartbeat(client, "node-a", TOKEN_A)
        mission_id = make_mission(client)
        approve_mission(client, mission_id)

            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": ["system_inventory"],
            "mission_id": mission_id})

        task_id = created.json()["id"]

        claimed = client.post("/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-a",
                              params={"node_token": TOKEN_A})
        assert claimed.status_code == 200, claimed.text
        assert claimed.json()["id"] == task_id

        done = client.post(f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete", json={
            "success": True, "result": {"operating_system": "Linux"},
            "node_id": "node-a"})
        assert done.status_code == 204, done.text

        events = client.get("/api/v1/events?type=task.completed&limit=50")
        assert events.status_code == 200
        assert any(entry["task_id"] == str(task_id)
                   for entry in events.json())

        assert detail.status_code == 200
        assert "completed" in detail.text
        assert mission_id[:24] in detail.text

        mission_page = client.get(f"/missions/{mission_id}")
        assert mission_page.status_code == 200
        assert f"/tasks/{task_id}" in mission_page.text

"""Interface adapter + message + session tests (BIG #9).

Text/voice convergence, closed types, bounded content, session
lifecycle (never credentials), adapter contracts.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.interface import (
    InterfaceRefusedError,
    TextInterface,
    VoiceInterface,
    generate_interface_id,
    list_sessions,
    load_session,
    new_interface_message,
    new_session,
    revoke_session,
    save_session,
    session_usable,
    touch_session,
)


def test_text_interface_roundtrip():
    adapter = TextInterface()
    message = adapter.receive_input({
        "message_id": "msg-1", "conversation_id": "conv-1",
        "content": "Wat ligt er op mijn werkbank?"})
    assert message.role == "user"
    assert message.input_type == "text"
    rendered = adapter.send_response(message)
    assert rendered["content"] == message.content
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        adapter.receive_input({"message_id": "msg-1"})
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        adapter.receive_input({"message_id": "m", "conversation_id": "c",
                               "content": "x", "input_type": "sms"})


def test_voice_converges_to_text_turn():
    adapter = VoiceInterface()
    message = adapter.receive_input({
        "message_id": "msg-v1", "conversation_id": "conv-1",
        "transcript": "zet de camera aan",
        "stt_model": "test-only"})
    assert message.role == "user"
    assert message.input_type == "voice"
    assert message.content == "zet de camera aan"
    assert "transcribed" in message.provenance.notes
    rendered = adapter.send_response(message)
    assert rendered["output_type"] == "voice"
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        adapter.receive_input({"content": "   "})


def test_message_bounds_and_roles():
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        new_interface_message("msg-1", "conv-1", "robot", "hoi")
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        new_interface_message("msg-1", "conv-1", "user", "   ")
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        new_interface_message("msg-1", "conv-1", "user", "x" * 4001)
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        new_interface_message("msg-1", "conv-1", "user", "x",
                              output_type="exec")
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        new_interface_message(
            "msg-1", "conv-1", "assistant", "advies",
            provenance=Provenance(source_type="ai-generated",
                                  creator_id="m",
                                  human_verified=True))
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        generate_interface_id("hologram")


def test_session_lifecycle(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "iface.db"))
    session = new_session("iface-text-1", node_id="node-phone1")
    assert session.status == "active"
    assert session_usable(session) is True
    assert session_usable(session,
                          "2999-01-01T00:00:00+00:00") is False
    assert load_session(session.session_id) is None
    save_session(session)
    assert load_session(session.session_id).status == "active"
    touched = touch_session(session)
    assert touched.status == "active"
    revoked = revoke_session(session)
    save_session(revoked)
    assert session_usable(load_session(
        session.session_id)) is False
    assert load_session("sess-missing") is None
    assert len(list_sessions("iface-text-1")) == 1
    expired = touch_session(
        session, "2999-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
    assert expired.status == "expired"
    assert touch_session(expired).status == "expired"
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        new_session("")
    with pytest.raises(InterfaceRefusedError):
        new_session("iface-x", ttl_seconds=10**9)

"""INVENTory controlled-write tests (BIG #5).

Payload validation, approval binding, execution with before/after,
and failure semantics. HTTP is faked with httpx.MockTransport;
no real INVENTory is touched.
"""

import asyncio
import json

import httpx
import pytest

from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import (
    decide_write,
    request_write_approval,
)
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import InventoryReader, Provenance
from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import (
    InventoryWriteFailedError,
    InventoryWriteRefusedError,
    InventoryWriter,
    build_create_payload,
    build_relationship_payload,
    build_update_payload,
    capability_for,
    execute_inventory_write,
    propose_inventory_write,
)


def run(coro):
    return asyncio.run(coro)


def ai_provenance() -> Provenance:
    return Provenance(source_type="ai-generated", creator_id="mycelium",
                      human_verified=False)


# -- payload validation -------------------------------------------------

def test_create_object_valid():
    body = build_create_payload(
        "object", {"name": "M3 bout", "quantity": 40})
    assert body["name"] == "M3 bout"
    assert body["quantity"] == 40
    assert body["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False


def test_create_unknown_entity_refused():
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError, match="not a controlled"):
        build_create_payload("sensor", {"name": "x"})


def test_create_unauthorized_fields_refused():
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError,
                       match="unauthorized fields"):
        build_create_payload(
            "object", {"name": "x", "price": 10, "owner": "y"})


def test_create_bad_status_refused():
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError, match="unknown"):
        build_create_payload(
            "project", {"name": "x", "status": "flying"})


def test_update_empty_and_unknown_fields_refused():
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError,
                       match="non-empty object"):
        build_update_payload("object", {})
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError,
                       match="unauthorized fields"):
        build_update_payload("object", {"name": "x", "sql": "DROP"})


def test_human_verified_smuggling_refused():
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError,
                       match="human_verified"):
        build_create_payload(
            "object", {"name": "x",
                       "provenance": {"source_type": "ai-generated",
                                      "creator_id": "qwen",
                                      "human_verified": True}})


def test_relationship_validation():
    body = build_relationship_payload(
        {"from_id": "obj_abc", "predicate": "part_of",
         "to_id": "proj_def"})
    assert body["predicate"] == "part_of"
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError, match="must differ"):
        build_relationship_payload(
            {"from_id": "obj_abc", "predicate": "uses",
             "to_id": "obj_abc"})
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError, match="unknown"):
        build_relationship_payload(
            {"from_id": "obj_abc", "predicate": "loves",
             "to_id": "proj_def"})
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError, match="unknown prefix"):
        build_relationship_payload(
            {"from_id": "xyz_abc", "predicate": "uses",
             "to_id": "proj_def"})


def test_propose_update_prefix_mismatch_refused():
    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError, match="does not match"):
        propose_inventory_write(
            "wrt-x", "update", "object", {"name": "y"},
            entity_id="proj_wrong", actor="mycelium-test",
            provenance=ai_provenance())


def test_capabilities_are_dotted_per_collection():
    create = propose_inventory_write(
        "wrt-c", "create", "object", {"name": "x"},
        actor="t", provenance=ai_provenance())
    assert capability_for(create) == "inventory.objects.write"
    update = propose_inventory_write(
        "wrt-u", "update", "project", {"status": "active"},
        entity_id="proj_abc", actor="t",
        provenance=ai_provenance())
    assert capability_for(update) == "inventory.projects.write"
    relate = propose_inventory_write(

        {"from_id": "obj_a", "predicate": "uses",
         "to_id": "hw_b"}, actor="t",
        provenance=ai_provenance())
    assert capability_for(relate) == "inventory.relationships.write"

    with pytest.raises(InventoryWriteRefusedError, match="loopback"):
