# -- execution ----------------------------------------------------------

def approved(proposal):
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    return decide_write(request, proposal, "YES", decided_by="jelles")


class FakeStore:
    """Minimal in-memory INVENTory behind a MockTransport."""

    def __init__(self):
        self.objects: dict = {}
        self.relationships: list = []
        self.counter = 0

    def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        path = request.url.path
        if request.method == "POST" and path == "/api/v1/objects":
            body = json.loads(request.content.decode())
            self.counter += 1
            entity_id = f"obj_test{self.counter:03d}"
            record = {"id": entity_id, "name": body["name"],
                      "description": body.get("description", ""),
                      "quantity": body.get("quantity", 1),
                      "provenance": body.get("provenance", {}),
                      "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                      "updated_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"}
            self.objects[entity_id] = record
            return httpx.Response(201, json=record)
        if request.method == "GET" and path.startswith("/api/v1/objects/"):
            entity_id = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            record = self.objects.get(entity_id)
            if record is None:
                return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "not found"})
            return httpx.Response(200, json=record)
        if request.method == "PATCH" and path.startswith("/api/v1/objects/"):
            entity_id = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            record = self.objects.get(entity_id)
            if record is None:
                return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "not found"})
            body = json.loads(request.content.decode())
            for key in ("name", "description", "quantity"):
                if key in body:
                    record[key] = body[key]
            return httpx.Response(200, json=record)
        if request.method == "POST" and path == "/api/v1/relationships":
            body = json.loads(request.content.decode())
            self.counter += 1
            record = {"id": f"rel_test{self.counter:03d}",
                      "from_id": body["from_id"],
                      "predicate": body["predicate"],
                      "to_id": body["to_id"],
                      "metadata": body.get("metadata", {}),
                      "provenance": body.get("provenance", {}),
                      "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"}
            self.relationships.append(record)
            return httpx.Response(201, json=record)
        return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "no route"})


def make_reader_writer(store: FakeStore):
    transport = httpx.MockTransport(store.handler)
    reader = InventoryReader(transport=transport)
    writer = InventoryWriter(transport=transport)
    return reader, writer


def test_execute_create_roundtrip():
    store = FakeStore()
    reader, writer = make_reader_writer(store)
    proposal = propose_inventory_write(
        "wrt-create1", "create", "object",
        {"name": "M3 bout", "quantity": 40},
        actor="mycelium-test", provenance=ai_provenance())

    assert result.before == {}
    assert result.after["entity_id"].startswith("obj_")
    assert result.after["title"] == "M3 bout"
    assert result.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert result.error == ""


def test_execute_update_captures_before_after():

        create, approved(create), reader=reader, writer=writer))

    assert result.after["details"]["quantity"] == 42

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_live_integration.py">
"""Phase 6 tests (BIG #11-15): Live integration, jobs, UI."""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "p6.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "p6-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def open_session(test_client, caps, scope=None):
    body = {"interface": "web", "actor": "jelles",
            "capabilities": caps}
    if scope:
        body["context_scope"] = scope
    return test_client.post("/api/v1/live/sessions",
                            json=body).json()["session_id"]


def test_live_new_sections_gated(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "fact", "title": "Oat milk",
            "content": "prefers oat milk",
            "truth": "user_fact",
            "provenance": {"source_type": "user-created",
                           "creator_id": "jelles",
                           "human_verified": True,
                           "verified_by": "jelles"}})
        test_client.post("/api/v1/skills", json={
            "name": "Python", "stage": "practicing"})
        # Unknown new caps refuse at session open.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/live/sessions", json={
            "interface": "web", "actor": "jelles",
            "capabilities": ["mind.read"]}).status_code == 422
        full = open_session(
            test_client,
            ["memory.read", "skills.read", "health.read",
             "research.read", "workshop.read",
             "fabrication.read", "twin.read", "watcher.read"],
            {"include_health": True})
        package = test_client.post("/api/v1/live/context",
                                   json={
                                       "session_id": full,
                                       "query": "oat milk",
                                       "budget": 8000}).json()
        assert "memory" in package["sections"]
        assert "skills" in package["sections"]
        assert "health" in package["sections"]
        # Health without explicit scope stays out.
        scoped = open_session(test_client, ["health.read"])
        bare = test_client.post("/api/v1/live/context", json={
            "session_id": scoped}).json()
        assert "health" not in bare["sections"]
        # Minimal session sees none of the new sections.
        minimal = open_session(test_client, ["task.read"])
        package = test_client.post("/api/v1/live/context",
                                   json={
                                       "session_id": minimal}).json()
        for section in ("memory", "health", "research",
                        "skills", "workshop", "fabrication",
                        "twin", "findings"):
            assert section not in package["sections"]


def test_jobs_bounded_observable_idempotent(tmp_path,
                                            monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        jobs = test_client.get("/api/v1/jobs").json()
        assert {item["job_name"] for item in jobs} == {
            "watcher_scan", "memory_consolidation",
            "morning_report", "health_import",
            "research_process", "skill_discover",
            "inventory_reconcile", "device_health"}
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/jobs/run", json={
            "job_name": "nope"}).status_code == 422
        first = test_client.post("/api/v1/jobs/run", json={
            "job_name": "watcher_scan",
            "run_key": "smoke-key-1"}).json()
        assert first["status"] == "completed"
        assert "findings" in first["summary"]
        # Same key returns the existing run (idempotent).
        again = test_client.post("/api/v1/jobs/run", json={
            "job_name": "watcher_scan",
            "run_key": "smoke-key-1"}).json()
        assert again["run_id"] == first["run_id"]
        report = test_client.post("/api/v1/jobs/run", json={
            "job_name": "morning_report"}).json()
        assert report["summary"]["sections"] >= 1
        health = test_client.post("/api/v1/jobs/run", json={
            "job_name": "health_import",
            "params": {"provider": "mock", "limit": 3}}).json()
        assert health["summary"]["imported"] == 3
        runs = test_client.get("/api/v1/jobs/runs").json()
        assert len(runs) >= 3
        # Synchronous runs finish at once: nothing to cancel.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/jobs/runs/{first['run_id']}/cancel").json()[
                "cancelled"] is False


def test_living_workshop_pages_render(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        for page in ("/morning", "/memory", "/health",
                     "/skills", "/research", "/devices",
                     "/watcher"):
            response = test_client.get(page)
            assert response.status_code == 200, page
            assert "Mycelium" in response.text or \
                "mycelium" in response.text.lower(), page
        assert "Memory" in test_client.get("/").text or \
            "/memory" in test_client.get("/").text

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_maintenance_sweep.py">
"""Lease-sweep endpoint tests: POST /api/v1/maintenance/sweep-leases.

Drives the full HTTP path (register/claim/propose/decide/dispatch),
moves only lease clocks directly in the test databases, then sweeps.
No worker runs, nothing is ever completed or executed by these tests.
"""

import json

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.main import MAX_ATTEMPTS

TOKEN = "sweep-token-1234"
PAST = "2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sweep.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sweep-state.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register(test_client, node_id="sweep-node"):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "sweep", "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": ["code.patch"], "executors": ["exec:code"],
        "cpu_cores": 4, "memory_mb": 8192, "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text


def queue(test_client, kind="code.patch", goal="Fix it"):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
        "kind": kind, "required_capabilities": ["code.patch"],
        "payload": {"goal": goal}})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
    return res.json()["id"]


def claim(test_client, node_id="sweep-node"):
    res = test_client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{node_id}?node_token={TOKEN}")
    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
    return res.json()


def task_row(task_id):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        return db.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id=?",
                          (task_id,)).fetchone()


def set_lease(task_id, lease_until=None, attempts=None):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        if attempts is None:
            db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET lease_until=? WHERE id=?",
                       (lease_until, task_id))
        else:
            db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET lease_until=?, "
                       "attempt_count=? WHERE id=?",
                       (lease_until, attempts, task_id))


def sweep(test_client):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/maintenance/sweep-leases")
    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
    return res.json()


def test_expired_task_lease_requeued(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(test_client)
        task_id = queue(test_client)
        assert claim(test_client)["id"] == task_id
        assert task_row(task_id)["status"] == "assigned"
        set_lease(task_id, PAST)
        body = sweep(test_client)
        assert body["tasks"]["requeued"] == 1
        assert set(body["tasks"]) == {"requeued", "failed",
                                      "blocked"}
        stored = task_row(task_id)
        assert stored["status"] == "queued"
        assert stored["assigned_node_id"] is None
        assert stored["result"] is None  # never executed


def test_active_task_lease_untouched(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(test_client)
        task_id = queue(test_client)
        assert claim(test_client)["id"] == task_id
        body = sweep(test_client)
        assert body["tasks"] == {"requeued": 0, "failed": 0,
                                 "blocked": 0}
        assert task_row(task_id)["status"] == "assigned"


def test_exhausted_task_lease_fails_not_requeued(tmp_path,
                                                 monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(test_client)
        task_id = queue(test_client)
        assert claim(test_client)["id"] == task_id
        set_lease(task_id, PAST, attempts=MAX_ATTEMPTS)
        body = sweep(test_client)
        assert body["tasks"]["failed"] == 1
        assert body["tasks"]["requeued"] == 0
        assert task_row(task_id)["status"] == "failed"


def test_expired_desktop_lease_recovered(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        created = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/desktop/actions",
            json={"action_type": "click",
                  "parameters": {"x": 10, "y": 10},
                  "action_id": "dact-sweep"})
        assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
        decided = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/desktop/actions/dact-sweep/decision",
            json={"response": "YES", "decided_by": "sweep"})
        assert decided.json()["status"] == "approved"
        dispatched = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/desktop/actions/dact-sweep/dispatch")
        assert dispatched.json()["status"] == "dispatched"
        _expire_desktop_lease("dact-sweep")
        body = sweep(test_client)
        assert body["desktop_actions"]["recovered"] == 1
        assert set(body["desktop_actions"]) == {"recovered",
                                                "blocked"}
        again = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/desktop/actions/dact-sweep")
        assert again.json()["status"] == "approved"


def test_active_desktop_lease_untouched(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        created = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/desktop/actions",
            json={"action_type": "click",
                  "parameters": {"x": 10, "y": 10},

        assert created.status_code == 201, created.text

                                           "blocked": 0}
        again = test_client.get(

def test_exhausted_desktop_lease_blocked(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        created = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/desktop/actions",
            json={"action_type": "click",

        assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
        test_client.post(

        assert again.json()["status"] == "blocked"


def test_sweep_summary_shape_and_no_side_tasks(tmp_path,
                                               monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        body = sweep(test_client)
        assert set(body) == {"tasks", "desktop_actions"}
        assert body["tasks"] == {"requeued": 0, "failed": 0,
                                 "blocked": 0}
        assert body["desktop_actions"] == {"recovered": 0,
                                           "blocked": 0}
        listed = test_client.get("/api/v1/tasks")
        assert listed.json() == []


def _expire_desktop_lease(action_id, attempts=None):
    """Test-only clock move: backdate lease_until inside the stored
    desktop-action record (chat DB). Production code untouched."""
    from coordinator.app.database import chat_connection
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT record FROM desktop_actions "
                         "WHERE action_id=?", (action_id,)).fetchone()
        assert row is not None
        record = json.loads(row["record"])
        record["lease_until"] = PAST
        if attempts is not None:
            record["attempt_count"] = attempts
        db.execute("UPDATE desktop_actions SET record=? "
                   "WHERE action_id=?",
                   (json.dumps(record), action_id))

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_mission_closeout.py">
"""H3 close-out: completed H1-task -> mission-step completed.

H1 auto-dispatch stages research.fetch_url queue tasks and marks the
step dispatched; H3 adds only the missing feedback: when the linked
task(s) complete successfully, the reloaded step moves
dispatched -> completed via the existing conditional save, with the
existing step_completed mission event. No auto-advance (tick stays
responsible), no approval change, no new tables.

Real coordinator routes + tmp DBs throughout; no network.
"""

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

TOKEN = "closeout-token-abcdef-123456"
URL1 = "https://example.com/onderzoek-1"
URL2 = "https://example.com/onderzoek-2"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "closeout-queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "closeout-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def make_conversation(client):
    return client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={
        "message": "closeout keten", "project_ref": "closeout-ws"}).json()[
        "conversation_id"]


def make_mission(client, conv, steps, max_steps=3):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": conv, "goal": "Closeout keten",
        "steps": steps, "max_steps": max_steps})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()["mission_id"]


def research_step(urls, dispatch=True):
    params = {"question": "Wat is mycelium?",
              "source_urls": list(urls)}
    if dispatch:
        params["dispatch"] = True
    return {"kind": "research", "description": "haal bron op",
            "parameters": params}


def approve(client, mission_id):
    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
                           json={"response": "YES"})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text


def mission_state(client, mission_id):
    return client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()


def mission_events(client, mission_id):
    return client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/events").json()


def step_completed_events(client, mission_id, step_id):
    return [row for row in mission_events(client, mission_id)
            if row.get("event_type") == "step_completed"
            and row.get("step_id") == step_id]


def register_worker(client, node_id="worker-1", caps=None):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": caps or ["research.fetch"], "cpu_cores": 2,
        "memory_mb": 4000, "energy_source": "grid",
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def dispatch(client, mission_id, step_id):
    response = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/dispatch",
        json={"step_id": step_id})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()["task_ids"]


def claim(client, node_id="worker-1"):
    response = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{node_id}",
        params={"node_token": TOKEN})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()


def complete(client, task_id, node_id="worker-1", success=True):
    body = {"success": success, "node_id": node_id}
    if success:
        body["result"] = {"url": URL1, "chars": 128}
    else:
        body["error"] = "fetch failed"
    done = client.post(f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete",
                       params={"node_id": node_id}, json=body)
    assert done.status_code == 204, done.text


def task_status(client, task_id):
    rows = {row["id"]: row for row in client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()}
    return rows[task_id]["status"]


def test_1_dispatched_task_completed_closes_step(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_worker(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client),
            [research_step([URL1])])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        task_id = dispatch(client, mission_id, step_id)[0]
        assert claim(client)["id"] == task_id
        complete(client, task_id)
        assert task_status(client, task_id) == "completed"
        state = mission_state(client, mission_id)
        assert state["steps"][0]["status"] == "completed"
        assert len(step_completed_events(
            client, mission_id, step_id)) == 1


def test_2_two_tasks_close_only_when_all_done(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_worker(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client),
            [research_step([URL1, URL2])])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        task_ids = dispatch(client, mission_id, step_id)
        assert len(task_ids) == 2
        first = claim(client)
        assert first["id"] in task_ids
        complete(client, first["id"])
        assert task_status(client, first["id"]) == "completed"
        # First done, second still open: step stays dispatched.
        assert mission_state(client, mission_id)[
            "steps"][0]["status"] == "dispatched"
        assert step_completed_events(
            client, mission_id, step_id) == []
        second = claim(client)
        assert second["id"] in task_ids and second["id"] != first["id"]
        complete(client, second["id"])
        assert mission_state(client, mission_id)[
            "steps"][0]["status"] == "completed"
        assert len(step_completed_events(
            client, mission_id, step_id)) == 1


def test_3_failed_sibling_keeps_step_dispatched(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_worker(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client),
            [research_step([URL1, URL2])])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        task_ids = dispatch(client, mission_id, step_id)
        assert len(task_ids) == 2
        failed = claim(client)
        complete(client, failed["id"], success=False)
        assert task_status(client, failed["id"]) == "failed"
        other = claim(client)
        complete(client, other["id"], success=True)
        assert task_status(client, other["id"]) == "completed"
        state = mission_state(client, mission_id)
        assert state["steps"][0]["status"] == "dispatched"
        assert step_completed_events(
            client, mission_id, step_id) == []


def test_4_task_without_step_link_changes_nothing(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_worker(client, caps=["research.fetch", "code.patch"])
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client),
            [research_step([URL1])])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        before = mission_state(client, mission_id)["steps"][0]
        res = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "code.patch",
            "required_capabilities": ["code.patch"],
            "payload": {"goal": "los werk zonder H1-metadata"}})
        assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
        task_id = res.json()["id"]
        assert claim(client)["id"] == task_id
        complete(client, task_id)
        assert task_status(client, task_id) == "completed"
        after = mission_state(client, mission_id)["steps"][0]
        assert after == before
        assert step_completed_events(
            client, mission_id, step_id) == []

def test_7_conflict_no_silent_overwrite(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.missions import MissionConflictError
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_worker(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client),
            [research_step([URL1])])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        task_id = dispatch(client, mission_id, step_id)[0]
        assert claim(client)["id"] == task_id

        def _refuse(*args, **kwargs):
            raise MissionConflictError("injected race")

        original_save = main_mod.save_mission
        monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "save_mission", _refuse)
        done = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete",
            params={"node_id": "worker-1"},
            json={"success": True, "result": {"url": URL1},
                  "node_id": "worker-1"})
        # Completion itself never crashes on a mission race.
        assert done.status_code == 204, done.text
        # Restore only the patched symbol (undo() would also drop
        # the tmp-DB env vars while the client still needs them).
        monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "save_mission", original_save)
        assert task_status(client, task_id) == "completed"
        # No blind overwrite: the step is untouched.
        assert mission_state(client, mission_id)[
            "steps"][0]["status"] == "dispatched"
        assert step_completed_events(
            client, mission_id, step_id) == []

        assert rows[0]["status"] == "queued"
        assert claim(client)["id"] == task_id
        complete(client, task_id)
        assert task_status(client, task_id) == "completed"

            "steps"][0]["status"] == "completed"

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_mission_loop.py">
"""BIG #21 tests: autonomous mission loop.

The loop drives approved work to the next gate and stops
with an actionable reason. It never approves, never
invents steps, never executes beyond the executor.
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "loop.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "loop-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def make_conversation(client):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/chat",
                           json={"message": "hi"})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()["conversation_id"]


def make_mission(client, conversation, goal, steps):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": conversation, "goal": goal,
        "steps": steps})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()["mission_id"]


def approve_plan(client, mission_id):
    response = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
        json={"response": "YES", "decided_by": "tester"})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text


def run(client, mission_id, max_rounds=10):
    response = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/run",
        json={"max_rounds": max_rounds})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()


def readout_steps():
    return [{"kind": "readout", "description": "Read project",
             "parameters": {"source": "project"}}]


def test_loop_runs_readout_mission_to_completion(tmp_path,
                                                 monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, conversation, "survey the project",
            readout_steps())
        approve_plan(client, mission_id)
        report = run(client, mission_id)
        assert report["outcome"] == "completed"
        assert report["status"] == "completed"
        assert report["rounds"] >= 1
        memory_id = report.get("memory_id", "")
        assert memory_id.startswith("mem_")
        stored = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/memory/{memory_id}").json()
        assert stored["memory_type"] == "episodic"
        assert stored["truth"] == "observed"
        assert stored["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False
        assert mission_id in stored["entity_refs"]
        # Re-running a terminal mission only observes it.
        again = run(client, mission_id)
        assert again["stop_reason"] == "already_terminal"
        assert again.get("memory_id", "") == memory_id


def test_loop_stops_for_plan_approval(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, conversation, "unapproved plan",
            readout_steps())
        report = run(client, mission_id)
        assert report["outcome"] == "stopped"
        assert report["stop_reason"] == "needs_plan_approval"
        assert "approve" in report["action"]
        state = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert state["status"] == "pending_approval"


def test_loop_stops_for_desktop_approval_then_continues(
        tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, conversation, "click something",
            [{"kind": "desktop", "description": "Click",
              "action_type": "click",
              "parameters": {"x": 10, "y": 10},
              "requires_approval": True}])
        approve_plan(client, mission_id)
        stopped = run(client, mission_id)
        assert stopped["outcome"] == "stopped"
        assert stopped["stop_reason"] == \
            "needs_desktop_approval"
        action_id = stopped["action"]["action_id"]
        assert action_id
        # Human approves through the existing endpoint.
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}/decision",
            json={"response": "YES",
                  "decided_by": "tester"}).status_code == 200
        # A node acts through the existing claim/act/report
        # chain (simulated here over HTTP).
        assert client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "loop-agent-01", "hostname": "pc",
            "capabilities": ["agent:desktop",
                             "desktop.mouse.click"],
            "node_token": "loop-token-1234567890"}
        ).status_code == 201
        claimed = client.post("/api/v1/desktop/actions/next",
                              json={
                                  "node_id": "loop-agent-01",
                                  "node_token":
                                  "loop-token-1234567890"}).json()
        assert claimed is not None
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}/result",
            json={"status": "completed",
                  "observation_reference": "obs-loop-1"}
        ).status_code in (200, 201, 204)
        done = run(client, mission_id)
        assert done["outcome"] == "completed", done
        assert done.get("memory_id", "").startswith("mem_")


def test_loop_drafts_proposal_without_executing(tmp_path,
                                                monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, conversation, "propose something",
            [{"kind": "proposal",
              "description": "Draft a change"}])
        approve_plan(client, mission_id)
        report = run(client, mission_id)
        # Drafting is data, not execution: the mission may
        # complete while the proposal itself still needs the
        # separate /approvals flow. Nothing auto-executes.
        assert report["outcome"] == "completed", report
        state = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert state["status"] == "completed"
        assert state["steps"][0]["status"] == "completed"


def test_loop_never_starts_physical_print(tmp_path,
                                          monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, conversation, "print the bracket",
            [{"kind": "physical_print",
              "description": "Print it",
              "parameters": {"proposal_id": "wrt-loop-1"}}])
        approve_plan(client, mission_id)
        report = run(client, mission_id)
        assert report["outcome"] == "stopped"
        assert report["stop_reason"] in (
            "needs_write_or_physical_approval", "waiting",
            "mission_blocked", "mission_failed")
        state = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert state["status"] != "completed"


def test_loop_bounds_and_validation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert client.post("/api/v1/missions/nope/run",
                           json={"max_rounds": 10}
                           ).status_code == 422
        conversation = make_conversation(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, conversation, "bounded",
            readout_steps())
        approve_plan(client, mission_id)
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/run",
            json={"max_rounds": 99}).status_code == 422
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/run",
            json={"max_rounds": 0}).status_code == 422
        report = run(client, mission_id, max_rounds=1)
        assert report["rounds"] <= 1


def test_loop_has_no_shell_or_network_surface():
    import pathlib
    source = (pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent /
              "coordinator" / "app" / "mission_loop.py"
              ).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for token in ("subprocess", "os.system", "eval(",
                  "import sqlite3", "https://", "httpx",
                  "requests", "0.0.0.0"):
        assert token not in source, f"mission_loop.py: {token}"

"""Mission -> task binding tests: traceability only, never execution.

mission_id on a queue task must reference a real mission, survive
claim/lease/complete untouched, and never cause any automatic
execution. Tasks without mission_id keep working unchanged.
"""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN = "bind-token-123456"


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "bind.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "bind-state.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register(test_client, node_id="bind-node"):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "bind", "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": ["code.patch"], "executors": ["exec:code"],
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text


def make_mission(test_client, goal="Bind the trace"):
    chat = test_client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={"message": "hi"})
    assert chat.status_code == 200, chat.text
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": chat.json()["conversation_id"],
        "goal": goal,
        "steps": [{"kind": "readout", "description": "Lees",
                   "parameters": {"source": "project"}}]})
    assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
    return res.json()["mission_id"]


def queue(test_client, body):
    res = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json=body)
    return res


def task_row(task_id):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        return db.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id=?",
                          (task_id,)).fetchone()


def test_mission_task_carries_mission_id(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        mission_id = make_mission(test_client)
        res = queue(test_client, {
            "kind": "code.patch",
            "required_capabilities": ["code.patch"],
            "payload": {"goal": "Patch it"},
            "mission_id": mission_id})
        assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
        task_id = res.json()["id"]
        assert task_row(task_id)["mission_id"] == mission_id
        listed = test_client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
        assert listed[0]["mission_id"] == mission_id
        single = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/by-id/{task_id}").json()
        assert single["mission_id"] == mission_id


def test_general_task_without_mission_id_still_works(tmp_path,
                                                     monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(test_client)
        res = queue(test_client, {
            "kind": "code.patch",
            "required_capabilities": ["code.patch"],
            "payload": {"goal": "General work"}})
        assert res.status_code == 201, res.text
        task_id = res.json()["id"]
        assert task_row(task_id)["mission_id"] is None
        claimed = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/bind-node?node_token={TOKEN}")
        assert claimed.status_code == 200, claimed.text
        assert claimed.json()["id"] == task_id


def test_unknown_mission_id_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        res = queue(test_client, {
            "kind": "code.patch",
            "required_capabilities": ["code.patch"],
            "payload": {"goal": "Orphan"},
            "mission_id": "mission_does_not_exist"})
        assert res.status_code == 422, res.text
        assert test_client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json() == []


def test_mission_id_survives_claim_and_complete(tmp_path,
                                                monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(test_client)
        mission_id = make_mission(test_client)

        stored = task_row(task_id)

        assert stored["mission_id"] == mission_id

        assert swept.json()["tasks"]["requeued"] == 1
        stored = task_row(task_id)
        assert stored["status"] == "queued"
        assert stored["mission_id"] == mission_id


def test_mission_id_alone_causes_no_execution(tmp_path,

        assert stored["assigned_node_id"] is None
        assert stored["result"] is None

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_mokerpass.py">
"""MOKERPASS click-path tests (items A-I).

Every test drives the real UI bridge (/web/*) onto the real backend
endpoint and asserts gates still hold. No hardware, no shell,
no model calls: safe digital paths only.
"""


def _moker_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import os
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "moker.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "moker-chat.db"))
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
    import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def _moker_node(client, node_id="moker-node"):
    token = f"moker-token-{node_id}-123456"
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "seed",
        "capabilities": ["system_inventory"], "node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat",
                           json={"available": True,
                                 "node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 204, response.text
    return token


def test_moker_a_system_job_run(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in _moker_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        page = client.get("/system")
        assert page.status_code == 200
        assert "watcher_scan" in page.text
        assert "/web/jobs/run" in page.text
        run = client.post("/web/jobs/run", data={"job_name": "watcher_scan"},
                          follow_redirects=False)
        assert run.status_code == 303
        assert run.headers["location"] == "/system"
        runs = client.get("/api/v1/jobs/runs",
                          params={"job_name": "watcher_scan"})
        assert runs.status_code == 200
        assert len(runs.json()) >= 1
        bad = client.post("/web/jobs/run", data={"job_name": "nope"},
                          follow_redirects=False)
        assert bad.status_code == 303
        empty = client.post("/web/jobs/run", data={"job_name": ""},
                            follow_redirects=False)
        assert empty.status_code == 303


def test_moker_b_writes_execute_verify_gates(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in _moker_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
        from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import propose_write
        main_mod._write_save(propose_write(
            "wrt-moker1", "inventory.create", "object",
            {"name": "Moker"}, actor="t"), "proposed")
        # Execute before approval: gate refuses, status unchanged.
        blocked = client.post("/web/writes/wrt-moker1/execute",
                              follow_redirects=False)
        assert blocked.status_code == 303
        assert main_mod._write_load("wrt-moker1")["status"] == "proposed"
        # Verify before result: gate refuses, status unchanged.
        early = client.post("/web/writes/wrt-moker1/verify",
                            follow_redirects=False)
        assert early.status_code == 303
        assert main_mod._write_load("wrt-moker1")["status"] == "proposed"
        # Exact YES approves through the existing gate.
        yes = client.post("/web/writes/wrt-moker1/approve",
                          data={"response": "YES"},
                          follow_redirects=False)
        assert yes.status_code == 303
        assert main_mod._write_load("wrt-moker1")["status"] == "approved"
        # Execute with INVENTory down: backend 502, bridge redirects,
        # status stays approved (no bypass, no crash, no fake success).
        executed = client.post("/web/writes/wrt-moker1/execute",
                               follow_redirects=False)
        assert executed.status_code == 303
        assert main_mod._write_load("wrt-moker1")["status"] == "approved"
        page = client.get("/writes")
        assert page.status_code == 200
        assert "Execute" in page.text and "Verify" in page.text

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_n8n_workflows.py">
"""BIG #18: n8n workflow artifacts are safe to commit.

Committed workflows must stay secret-free, localhost-only,
key-injected via env, and limited to known jobs/labels —
so importing them into a real n8n instance cannot leak or
execute anything unexpected.
"""

import json
import pathlib
import re

N8N_DIR = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "n8n"

WORKFLOWS = [
    "workflow-a-schedule-morning-report.json",
    "workflow-b-outbox-notify.json",
]

KNOWN_JOBS = {
    "watcher_scan",
    "memory_consolidation",
    "morning_report",
    "health_import",
    "research_process",
    "skill_discover",
    "inventory_reconcile",
    "device_health",
}

KNOWN_TARGETS = {"notify"}


def load(name):
    return json.loads((N8N_DIR / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def string_values(node):
    found = []

    def walk(value):
        if isinstance(value, str):
            found.append(value)
        elif isinstance(value, dict):
            for item in value.values():
                walk(item)
        elif isinstance(value, list):
            for item in value:
                walk(item)

    walk(node)
    return found


def test_workflows_parse_and_link():
    for name in WORKFLOWS:
        flow = load(name)
        assert flow["name"]
        assert flow["active"] is False
        names = {node["name"] for node in flow["nodes"]}
        for node in flow["nodes"]:
            for key in ("id", "name", "type", "typeVersion",
                        "position", "parameters"):
                assert key in node, (name, node.get("name"))
        for source, outputs in flow["connections"].items():
            assert source in names, (name, source)
            for branch in outputs["main"]:
                for link in branch:
                    assert link["node"] in names, (name, link)


def test_workflows_localhost_only_and_secret_free():
    for name in WORKFLOWS:
        flow = load(name)
        blob = json.dumps(flow)
        assert not re.search(r"\b[0-9a-f]{64}\b", blob), name
        assert "sk-" not in blob, name
        for value in string_values(flow):
            lowered = value.lower()
            if "http://" in lowered or "https://" in lowered:
                assert "127.0.0.1" in value, (name, value)
                assert "tunnel" not in lowered, (name, value)
            assert "password" not in lowered, (name, value)
            assert "passwd" not in lowered, (name, value)
            assert "private_key" not in lowered, (name, value)
            assert "refresh_token" not in lowered, (name, value)


def test_workflow_a_triggers_one_known_job():
    flow = load(WORKFLOWS[0])
    by_name = {node["name"]: node for node in flow["nodes"]}
    assert "Schedule Trigger" in by_name
    http = by_name["Trigger Morning Report"]
    assert http["parameters"]["method"] == "POST"
    body = http["parameters"]["jsonBody"]
    assert '"job_name": "morning_report"' in body
    assert "$env.MYCELIUM_N8N_KEY" in body or any(
        "$env.MYCELIUM_N8N_KEY" in value
        for value in string_values(http))
    for banned in ("command", "shell", "code", "exec",
                   "arbitrary"):
        assert banned not in body.lower(), banned
    headers = http["parameters"]["headerParameters"][
        "parameters"]
    assert any(item["name"] == "X-Integration-Key" and
               "$env.MYCELIUM_N8N_KEY" in item["value"]
               for item in headers)


def test_workflow_b_outbox_loop_is_closed():
    flow = load(WORKFLOWS[1])
    by_name = {node["name"]: node for node in flow["nodes"]}
    for required in ("Schedule Trigger", "Poll Outbox",
                     "Has Pending Items", "Loop Over Outbox",
                     "Test Notification Log", "Ack Delivery"):
        assert required in by_name, required
    # Empty outbox ends at the IF node; items loop back.
    loop_links = flow["connections"]["Loop Over Outbox"][
        "main"]
    assert loop_links[0] == []
    assert [link["node"] for link in loop_links[1]] == [
        "Test Notification Log"]
    assert flow["connections"]["Ack Delivery"]["main"] == [
        [{"node": "Loop Over Outbox", "type": "main",
          "index": 0}]]
    # No external messaging: the only sink is a local log.
    assert not any("smtp" in node["type"].lower() or
                   "discord" in node["type"].lower() or
                   "slack" in node["type"].lower() or
                   "emailSend" in node["type"]
                   for node in flow["nodes"])

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_node_auth.py">
"""FASE 7 tests (BIG #16): node-auth hardening.

Identity is cryptographically bound to its token:
- new identities require a non-trivial token (403 without)
- choosing an existing node_id alone gains nothing
  (legacy freeze; token bind needs operator rotation)
- rotation needs the current token (bound) or the
  operator key (legacy)
- enable/disable need the operator key
- only token-bound identities may campaign
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

OPERATOR_KEY = "op-key-node-auth-123"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "auth.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "auth-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", OPERATOR_KEY)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_first_registration_requires_token(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-new", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": []}).status_code == 403
        # Trivial tokens refuse as well.
        assert client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-new", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": [], "node_token": "short"}
        ).status_code == 422
        assert client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-new", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"],
            "node_token": "first-token-123456"}
        ).status_code == 201


def test_identity_squat_gains_nothing(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        # Pre-existing legacy identity with real capabilities.
        with connection() as db:
            db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO nodes (node_id, hostname, tier, "
                "capabilities, cpu_cores, memory_mb, "
                "energy_source, last_seen, status) VALUES (?, "
                "?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                ("node-victim", "h", "seed",
                 '["exec:system_inventory"]', 1, 0, "unknown",
                 "2026-09-16T00:00:00+00:00", "online"))
        # Attacker re-registers the id with hostile caps and a
        # token, but no operator key: refused.
        assert client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-victim", "hostname": "evil",
            "capabilities": ["exec:everything"],
            "node_token": "attacker-token-123456"}
        ).status_code == 403
        # Tokenless re-register "works" but changes nothing.
        assert client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-victim", "hostname": "evil",
            "capabilities": ["exec:everything"]}
        ).status_code == 201
        stored = client.get(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-victim").json()
        assert stored["hostname"] == "h"
        assert stored["capabilities"] == ["exec:system_inventory"]
        # Operator rotation binds a token to the legacy id.
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-victim/rotate-token",
            json={"new_token": "victim-token-123456",
                  "operator_key": "wrong-key"}).status_code == 403
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-victim/rotate-token",
            json={"new_token": "victim-token-123456",
                  "operator_key": OPERATOR_KEY}).json()[
                      "bound"] is True
        # Rotation without the current token now refuses.
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-vision-rotate/rotate-token",
            json={"new_token": "x" * 20}).status_code == 404
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-victim/rotate-token",
            json={"current_token": "wrong-current-token-1",
                  "new_token": "another-token-123456"}
        ).status_code == 403
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-victim/rotate-token",
            json={"current_token": "victim-token-123456",
                  "new_token": "victim-token-789012"}
        ).json()["bound"] is True
        # Old token dead, new token live.
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-victim/heartbeat",
            json={"available": True,
                  "node_token": "victim-token-123456"}
        ).status_code == 403
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-victim/heartbeat",
            json={"available": True,
                  "node_token": "victim-token-789012"}
        ).status_code == 204


def test_enable_disable_need_operator(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={

            "/api/v1/nodes/node-op/enable",

                "status"] == "online"

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_pass1_inventory_link.py">
"""PASS 1: workspace <-> INVENTory project linking (read-only).

Linkage comes from existing rows only: the workspace id itself
when it IS a proj_ id, proj_ ids in mission context_records, and
proj_ ids in research run linked_entities. Resolution uses the
existing single-GET bridge with provenance intact. No writes,
no new tables, no name-similarity guessing.

INVENTory HTTP is faked with httpx.MockTransport (established
pattern); no real INVENTory server, no real model.
"""

import httpx

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import InventoryReader
from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PROJECTS = {
    "proj_cafe01": {
        "id": "proj_cafe01", "name": "Camper verbouwen",
        "description": "camper ombouwen", "status": "active",
        "provenance": {"source_type": "user-created",
                       "creator_id": "jelles",
                       "human_verified": True},
    },
    "proj_tuin": {
        "id": "proj_tuin", "name": "Moestuin",
        "description": "voedsel verbouwen", "status": "planned",
        "provenance": {"source_type": "user-created",
                       "creator_id": "jelles",
                       "human_verified": False},
    },
}


def inventory_handler(request):
    path = request.url.path
    if path == "/api/v1/projects":
        return httpx.Response(200, json=list(PROJECTS.values()))
    for pid, payload in PROJECTS.items():
        if path == f"/api/v1/projects/{pid}":
            return httpx.Response(200, json=payload)
    if path.startswith("/api/v1/projects/"):
        return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "not found"})
    if path.startswith("/api/v1/"):
        return httpx.Response(200, json=[])
    return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "not found"})


class FakeProvider:
    async def advise(self, question, records):
        return AdviceResponse(
            question=question, advice="advies zonder voorstel",
            model="fake-local", records_used=len(records), sources=[])


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat-state.db"))
    reader = InventoryReader(
        transport=httpx.MockTransport(inventory_handler))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader", lambda: reader)
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "get_provider",
                        lambda name=None, **k: FakeProvider())
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def chat(client, message, project_ref):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={
        "message": message, "project_ref": project_ref})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()

            chat_connection as _chat_conn,
        )
        from coordinator.app.database import connection as _conn
        with _conn() as db:
            tasks_before = db.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks").fetchone()["n"]
        with _chat_conn() as db:
            counts_before = {
                table: db.execute(
                    f"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM {table}").fetchone()["n"]
                for table in ("conversations", "messages", "missions",
                              "conversation_events",
                              "interface_events", "write_proposals")}
        client.get("/api/v1/workspaces/proj_cafe01/inventory-projects")
        client.get("/workspaces/proj_cafe01")
        client.get("/api/v1/workspaces/proj_cafe01/workstreams")
        with _conn() as db:
            tasks_after = db.execute(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM tasks").fetchone()["n"]
        with _chat_conn() as db:
            counts_after = {
                table: db.execute(
                    f"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM {table}").fetchone()["n"]
                for table in counts_before}
        assert tasks_after == tasks_before
        assert counts_after == counts_before

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_pass3_worker_loop.py">
"""PASS 3: research worker loop over the existing worker route.

Covers what the research slice assumed but never pinned: lease
isolation between two workers (no double execution), stale nodes
never receiving work, and unsafe task kinds refused end-to-end
(claimed, then refused by the real executor, then failed without
side effects). Real coordinator routes + real node_client
executor throughout; no new infrastructure.
"""

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from node_client.main import execute_safe_task

TOKEN_A = "pass3-token-a-abcdef-123456"
TOKEN_B = "pass3-token-b-abcdef-123456"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat-state.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register(client, node_id, caps, token):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": caps, "cpu_cores": 2, "memory_mb": 4000,
        "energy_source": "grid", "node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def make_mission(client):
    conv = client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={
        "message": "onderzoek", "project_ref": "pass3-ws"}).json()[
        "conversation_id"]
    mission = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": conv, "goal": "Onderzoek isolatie",
        "steps": [{"kind": "readout", "description": "lees status",
                   "parameters": {"source": "git-status"}}],
        "max_steps": 3})
    assert mission.status_code == 201, mission.text
    return mission.json()["mission_id"]


def make_fetch_task(client, mission_id, url):
    made = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
        "kind": "research.fetch_url",
        "payload": {"url": url, "max_chars": 4096},
        "required_capabilities": ["research.fetch"],
        "mission_id": mission_id})
    assert made.status_code == 201, made.text
    return made.json()["id"]


def claim(client, node_id, token):
    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{node_id}",
                           params={"node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()


def test_lease_isolates_two_workers(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client, "worker-a", ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_A)
        register(client, "worker-b", ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_B)
        mission_id = make_mission(client)
        task_id = make_fetch_task(
            client, mission_id, "https://example.com/een")
        assert claim(client, "worker-a", TOKEN_A)["id"] == task_id
        # B cannot take the leased task: exactly one holder.
        assert claim(client, "worker-b", TOKEN_B) is None
        # Lease expiry requeues (attempt 2), never duplicates.
        from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
        future = (datetime.now(timezone.utc)
                  + timedelta(seconds=3600)).isoformat()
        assert main_mod.expire_leases(future)["requeued"] >= 1
        assert claim(client, "worker-b", TOKEN_B)["id"] == task_id
        tasks = {row["id"]: row
                 for row in client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()}
        assert tasks[task_id]["assigned_node_id"] == "worker-b"


def test_stale_worker_receives_nothing(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client, "worker-old", ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_A)
        mission_id = make_mission(client)
        make_fetch_task(client, mission_id, "https://example.com/x")
        from coordinator.app.database import (
            connection as _conn,
        )
        with _conn() as db:
            db.execute("UPDATE nodes SET last_seen=? WHERE node_id=?",
                       ("2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "worker-old"))
        assert claim(client, "worker-old", TOKEN_A) is None
        tasks = client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
        assert tasks[0]["status"] == "queued"


def test_unsafe_kind_refused_end_to_end(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client, "worker-a", ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_A)
        mission_id = make_mission(client)
        # Capability matches so the worker CAN pull it; execution
        # must still refuse desktop input (existing gate).
        made = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "desktop_click",
            "payload": {"x": 10, "y": 10},
            "required_capabilities": ["research.fetch"],
            "mission_id": mission_id})
        assert made.status_code == 201, made.text
        task_id = made.json()["id"]
        claimed = claim(client, "worker-a", TOKEN_A)
        assert claimed["id"] == task_id
        ok, output, error = execute_safe_task(claimed)
        assert ok is False
        assert output == {}
        assert "approval" in (error or "").lower()
        done = client.post(f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete",
                           params={"node_id": "worker-a"}, json={
                               "success": False, "result": {},
                               "error": error})
        assert done.status_code == 204, done.text
        tasks = {row["id"]: row
                 for row in client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()}
        assert tasks[task_id]["status"] == "failed"
        mission = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert mission["status"] == "pending_approval"
        assert mission["steps"][0]["status"] == "pending"

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_pass4_parallelism.py">
"""PASS 4: conversation parallelism over existing fork/attach.

Main + Forge + Artwork + NPC + Research conversations in one
workspace, each with its own mission, progressing independently
and re-linkable through the existing attach/provenance path. No
new conversation database, chat engine or message store — the
test only drives existing routes and reads existing rows.
"""

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

WS = "atelier-ws"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat-state.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def chat(client, message, project_ref=WS, conversation_id=None):
    body = {"message": message, "project_ref": project_ref}
    if conversation_id:
        body["conversation_id"] = conversation_id
    response = client.post("/api/v1/chat", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()


def make_mission(client, conversation_id, goal):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": conversation_id, "goal": goal,
        "steps": [{"kind": "readout", "description": "lees status",
                   "parameters": {"source": "git-status"}}],
        "max_steps": 3})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()


def build_atelier(client):
    main = chat(client, "hoofdlijn atelier")["conversation_id"]
    branches = {}
    for name in ("forge", "artwork", "npc", "research"):
        forked = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{main}/fork", json={}).json()
        branches[name] = forked["conversation_id"]
        chat(client, f"vervolg {name}",
             conversation_id=forked["conversation_id"])
    missions = {}
    for name, conv in [("main", main)] + sorted(branches.items()):
        missions[name] = make_mission(
            client, conv, f"Missie {name}")["mission_id"]
    return main, branches, missions


def test_parallel_tree_with_own_missions(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        main, branches, missions = build_atelier(client)
        view = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/workstreams").json()
        assert len(view["conversations"]) == 5
        assert len(view["workstreams"]) == 5
        tree = view["tree"]
        assert set(tree["children"][main]) == set(branches.values())
        for conv in branches.values():
            assert tree["nodes"][conv]["parent"] == main
        # Every conversation kept its own messages.
        for name, conv in [("main", main)] + sorted(branches.items()):
            detail = client.get(
                f"/api/v1/conversations/{conv}").json()
            assert detail["project_ref"] == WS
            assert len(detail["messages"]) >= 2


def test_branches_progress_without_waiting(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        main, branches, missions = build_atelier(client)
        # Forge approves, NPC cancels, rest wait: all independent.
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{missions['forge']}/approve",
            json={"response": "YES",
                  "decided_by": "human"}).status_code == 200
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{missions['npc']}/cancel").status_code \
            == 200
        states = {name: client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}").json()["status"]
            for name, mid in missions.items()}
        assert states == {"main": "pending_approval",
                          "forge": "approved",
                          "artwork": "pending_approval",
                          "npc": "cancelled",
                          "research": "pending_approval"}


def test_result_relinks_to_workspace(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        main, branches, missions = build_atelier(client)
        before = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{missions['artwork']}").json()
        moved = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/missions/"
            f"{missions['artwork']}/attach",
            json={"conversation_id": main})
        assert moved.status_code == 200, moved.text
        assert moved.json()["moved"] is True
        after = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{missions['artwork']}").json()
        assert after["conversation_id"] == main
        assert after["mission_id"] == missions["artwork"]
        # Siblings byte-identical.
        for name in ("forge", "npc", "research"):
            current = client.get(
                f"/api/v1/missions/{missions[name]}").json()
            assert current["status"] == "pending_approval"
        events = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/workstreams").json()["events"]
        assert any(missions["artwork"] in
                   (item.get("mission_id", "")) for item in events)
        _ = before

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_pass6_forge_readiness.py">
"""PASS 6: Forge multi-workstream readiness via the cockpit.

One workspace holds a Forge conversation (fabricate mission),
an artwork conversation, a research conversation and a
write-bound mission. The cockpit links, tracks and gates each
through existing routes only: fabricate tick, write
propose/approve/execute/verify, research report. No cross-write,
no merge, no Forge or engine changes — readiness proof.

INVENTory HTTP is faked with httpx.MockTransport (established
pattern for the write path).
"""

import httpx
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

WS = "forge-ws"


class FakeStore:
    def __init__(self):
        self.objects: dict = {}
        self.counter = 0

    def handler(self, request):
        import json
        path = request.url.path
        if request.method == "POST" and path == "/api/v1/objects":
            body = json.loads(request.content.decode())
            self.counter += 1
            entity_id = f"obj_p6_{self.counter:03d}"
            record = {"id": entity_id, "name": body["name"],
                      "description": body.get("description", ""),
                      "quantity": body.get("quantity", 1),
                      "provenance": body.get("provenance", {}),
                      "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                      "updated_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"}
            self.objects[entity_id] = record
            return httpx.Response(201, json=record)
        if path.startswith("/api/v1/objects/"):
            record = self.objects.get(path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1])
            if record is None:
                return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "no"})
            return httpx.Response(200, json=record)
        if request.method == "GET":
            return httpx.Response(200, json=[])
        return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "no route"})


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    store = FakeStore()
    transport = httpx.MockTransport(store.handler)
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat-state.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "fab"))
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import InventoryReader
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import InventoryWriter
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader",
                        lambda: InventoryReader(transport=transport))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "InventoryWriter",
                        lambda *a, **k: InventoryWriter(
                            transport=transport))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def chat(client, message, conversation_id=None):
    body = {"message": message, "project_ref": WS}
    if conversation_id:
        body["conversation_id"] = conversation_id
    response = client.post("/api/v1/chat", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_perf.py">
"""FASE 15/16 tests (BIG #16): pagination bounds + perf sanity.

Pagination is bounded everywhere (no unbounded retrieval);
hot paths complete in sane wall-clock time on local tmp
databases. Bounds are generous by design: this pins
against pathological blowups, not for benchmarking.
"""

import time

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

PERF_BUDGET_SECONDS = 15.0


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "perf.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "perf-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_pagination_bounds_enforced(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        page = client.get("/api/v1/sync/changes",
                          params={"after": 0,
                                  "limit": 500}).json()
        assert len(page["items"]) <= 100
        memories = client.get(
            "/api/v1/memory",
            params={"limit": 500}).json()
        assert len(memories) <= 200
        try:
            from coordinator.app.memory import list_memories
            assert len(list_memories(limit=10**6)) <= 200
        except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
            raise AssertionError(error)
        health = client.get(
            "/api/v1/health/measurements",
            params={"limit": 5000}).json()
        assert len(health) <= 500


def test_perf_sanity_hot_paths(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    timings = {}
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-perf", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"],
            "node_token": "perf-token-123456"})
        for _ in range(50):
            client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
                "kind": "system_inventory",
                "required_capabilities": [
                    "exec:system_inventory"]})
        for index in range(100):
            client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
                "memory_type": "fact",
                "title": f"perf fact {index}",
                "content": "perf content",
                "truth": "observed"})
        for index in range(200):
            main_mod.emit_event("perf.tick", f"tick {index}")

        def timed(name, func):
            start = time.perf_counter()
            func()
            took = time.perf_counter() - start
            timings[name] = round(took, 3)
            assert took < PERF_BUDGET_SECONDS, (name, took)

        timed("claim", lambda: client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-perf",
            params={"node_token": "perf-token-123456"}))
        timed("event_poll", lambda: client.get(
            "/api/v1/events/poll", params={"after": 0}))
        timed("memory_retrieve", lambda: client.post(
            "/api/v1/memory/retrieve",
            json={"query": "perf", "limit": 10}))
        timed("watcher", lambda: client.get(
            "/api/v1/watcher/scan"))
        timed("morning", lambda: client.get(
            "/api/v1/reports/morning"))
        timed("sync_status", lambda: client.get(
            "/api/v1/sync/status", params={"cursor": 0}))
    assert set(timings) == {"claim", "event_poll",
                            "memory_retrieve", "watcher",
                            "morning", "sync_status"}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_pipeline3d.py">
"""3D-pipeline contract tests (Fase O/Q).

Stage validation, feasibility advice, generation requests with the
local-only method rule. Anything cloud/printer/gcode-shaped is
refused; no geometry is ever produced here.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.pipeline3d import (
    new_feasibility,
    new_generation_request,
    new_stage_record,
)


def test_stage_lifecycle_records():
    record = new_stage_record("r3d-1", "photo_import", "done",
                              references={"file_id": "file_abc"})
    assert record.stage == "photo_import"
    assert record.provenance.human_verified is False
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_stage_record("r3d-2", "teleport", "done")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_stage_record("r3d-3", "preview", "shipped")


def test_feasibility_is_advice_not_release():
    feasible = new_feasibility("obj_abc", True, concerns=["overhang"])
    assert feasible.printable is True
    assert feasible.concerns == ["overhang"]
    assert feasible.provenance.human_verified is False


def test_generation_local_only():
    request = new_generation_request("req-1", "obj_abc", "local-template")
    assert request.method == "local-template"


def test_physical_methods_refused():
    for method in ("cloud", "printer", "gcode", "direct-print", "auto",
                   "remote", "quantum-print"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            new_generation_request("req-1", "obj_abc", method)


def test_physical_parameters_refused():
    for banned in ("gcode", "printer", "port", "device", "execute",
                   "auto_print", "cloud_key"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            new_generation_request("req-1", "obj_abc", "local-template",
                                   parameters={banned: "x"})


def test_extra_fields_forbidden():
    from pydantic import ValidationError
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        from coordinator.app.pipeline3d import Generation3DRequest
        Generation3DRequest(request_id="req-1", object_id="obj_abc",
                            method="local-template", parameters={},
                            cloud_key="x")


def test_no_geometry_or_hardware_in_module():
    import coordinator.app.pipeline3d as module
    source = open(module.__file__, encoding="utf-8").read().lower()
    for token in ("subprocess", "socket", "import serial", "from serial",
                  "import numpy", "import trimesh", "import PIL",
                  "from PIL", "printer_ip", "serial_port"):
        assert token not in source
