<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_plans.py">
"""Planning contract tests (Fase D/Q).

Plan validation, capability union, conversion into AdapterProposal
for the existing approval gate, and the no-second-mechanism rule.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.adapter_contracts import AdapterProposal
from coordinator.app.plans import (
    Plan,
    PlanStep,
    plan_capabilities,
    plan_to_proposal,
    validate_plan,
)


def make_plan(**overrides):
    data = {
        "plan_id": "plan-1",
        "goal": "Verbeter de Mycelium UI",
        "summary": "kleine stappen",
        "steps": [
            {"step_id": "s1", "description": "Open projectdirectory",
             "required_capabilities": ["desktop.screen.read"],
             "requires_approval": False},
            {"step_id": "s2", "description": "Klik op Chat",
             "required_capabilities": ["desktop.mouse.click"],
             "requires_approval": True},
        ],
        "risks": ["verkeerde knop"],
    }
    data.update(overrides)
    steps = [step if isinstance(step, PlanStep) else PlanStep(**step)
             for step in data["steps"]]
    data["steps"] = steps
    return Plan(**data)


def test_valid_plan_passes():
    assert validate_plan(make_plan()).plan_id == "plan-1"


def test_empty_steps_refused():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        make_plan(steps=[])


def test_too_many_steps_refused():
    steps = [{"step_id": f"s{i}", "description": "x"} for i in range(21)]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        make_plan(steps=steps)


def test_duplicate_step_ids_refused():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_plan(make_plan(steps=[
            {"step_id": "s1", "description": "een"},
            {"step_id": "s1", "description": "twee"},
        ]))


def test_plan_claiming_no_approval_with_needy_steps_refused():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_plan(make_plan(requires_approval=False))


def test_plan_claiming_human_verified_refused():
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance
    plan = make_plan()
    plan.provenance = Provenance(source_type="ai-generated",
                                 creator_id="p", human_verified=True)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        validate_plan(plan)


def test_capability_union_sorted_unique():
    assert plan_capabilities(make_plan()) == [
        "desktop.mouse.click", "desktop.screen.read"]


def test_plan_to_proposal_reuses_approval_gate():
    proposal = plan_to_proposal(make_plan(), adapter_id="mycelium-plan",
                                request_id="req-plan-1")
    assert isinstance(proposal, AdapterProposal)
    assert proposal.requires_approval is True
    assert proposal.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert proposal.request_id == "req-plan-1"
    assert "Verbeter de Mycelium UI" in proposal.proposed_action
    assert "Klik op Chat" in proposal.proposed_action


def test_plan_to_proposal_needs_caller_ids():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        plan_to_proposal(make_plan(), adapter_id=" ", request_id="r")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        plan_to_proposal(make_plan(), adapter_id="a", request_id=" ")


def test_proposal_from_plan_passes_existing_approval_gate():
    from coordinator.app.approval import decide, request_approval
    proposal = plan_to_proposal(make_plan(), adapter_id="mycelium-plan",
                                request_id="req-plan-2")
    request = request_approval(proposal)
    assert decide(request, proposal, "YES").approved is True
    assert decide(request, proposal, "maybe").approved is False

def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "play.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "play-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        yield client


def _page(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> str:
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        response = client.get("/play")
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        return response.text
    raise AssertionError("no client")

def test_play_inbox_facts_route(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import os as _os
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    name = "loop-facts-probe.jpg"
    path = _os.path.join(camera_dir(), name)
    try:
        with open(path, "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(b"\xff\xd8\xff\xe0" + bytes(2000))
        for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
            ok = client.get(f"/api/v1/inbox/{name}/facts",
                            params={"device_id": "cam-loop"})
            assert ok.status_code == 200, ok.text
            body = ok.json()
            assert body["media"]["sha256"]
            assert body["file_payload"]["sha256"] == \
                body["media"]["sha256"]
            missing = client.get("/api/v1/inbox/loop-niet.jpg/facts")
            assert missing.status_code == 422
            evil = client.get("/api/v1/inbox/../loop-facts-probe.jpg/facts")
            assert evil.status_code in (404, 422)
    finally:
        try:
            _os.remove(path)
        except OSError:
            pass

def test_play_node_syntax(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import re as _re
    import shutil
    import subprocess
    import tempfile
    node = shutil.which("node")
    if node is None:
        pytest.skip("node niet beschikbaar")
    html = _page(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    scripts = _re.findall(r"<script>(.*?)</script>", html,
                          _re.DOTALL)
    game = [s for s in scripts if "PLAYDATA" in s]
    assert len(game) == 1
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(
            "w", suffix=".js", delete=False,
            encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(game[0])
        path = handle.name
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            [node, "--check", path], capture_output=True,
            timeout=60)
        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr.decode(
            "utf-8", "replace")[:500]
    finally:
        try:
            os.remove(path)
        except OSError:
            pass

def test_play_js_has_no_escaped_quotes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Regressie: Python-escaped quotes (\\\") in het game-script
    breken de JS-parser en laten een leeg canvas achter."""
    import re as _re
    html = _page(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    scripts = _re.findall(r"<script>(.*?)</script>", html,
                          _re.DOTALL)
    game = [s for s in scripts if "PLAYDATA" in s]
    assert len(game) == 1
    assert 'class=\\"' not in game[0]
    assert 'href=\\"' not in game[0]
    assert 'id=\\"' not in game[0]

def test_play_npc_panels_use_real_data(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import json as _json
    import re as _re
    from coordinator.app.campaigns import (
        ensure_fabrication_seeds,
        ensure_mission_seeds,
    )
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ensure_mission_seeds()
        ensure_fabrication_seeds()
        html = client.get("/play").text
        assert "placeholder in Fase" not in html
        match = _re.search(r"const PLAYDATA = (\{.*?\});", html,
                          _re.DOTALL)
        npcs = {n["id"]: n
                for n in _json.loads(match.group(1))["npcs"]}
        luma, forge = npcs["luma"], npcs["forge"]
        assert luma["familiar"]["id"].startswith("fam_")
        assert forge["familiar"]["id"].startswith("fam_")
        for ability in (luma["panel"]["abilities"]
                        + forge["panel"]["abilities"]):
            assert ability["type"] in ("DIGITAL", "PHYSICAL",
                                       "HYBRID")
            assert ability["available"]
            assert ability["via"]
        for tool in (luma["panel"]["tools"]
                     + forge["panel"]["tools"]):
            assert tool["state"]
            assert tool["detail"]
        luma_goals = [m["goal"] for m in
                      luma["panel"]["missions"]]
        assert "Documenteer één object" in luma_goals
        forge_goals = [m["goal"] for m in
                       forge["panel"]["missions"]]
        assert "Maak je eerste digitale prototype" in \
            forge_goals
        future = [m for m in luma["panel"]["missions"]
                  if "FUTURE" in m["goal"]]
        assert len(future) == 1
        assert future[0]["status"] == "draft"
        metas = [m.get("meta", m.get("status", ""))
                 for m in luma["mission"]["items"]]
        assert "beschikbaar" in metas

# WORLD REPRESENTATION v1 ---------------------------------------------------


def _rep_records():
    return [
        {"entity_type": "hardware", "entity_id": "hw_a1",
         "title": "A1 Mini", "snippet": "printer",
         "provenance": {"source_type": "sensor-observed",
                        "creator_id": "seed-01",
                        "human_verified": False}},
        {"entity_type": "object", "entity_id": "obj_cube",
         "title": "Kubus", "snippet": "testobject",
         "provenance": {"source_type": "user",
                        "creator_id": "jelles",
                        "human_verified": True}},
        {"entity_type": "project", "entity_id": "proj_hydro",
         "title": "Hydro", "snippet": "",
         "provenance": {}},
        {"entity_type": "location", "entity_id": "loc_base",
         "title": "Homebase", "snippet": "",
         "provenance": {"source_type": "ai-generated",
                        "creator_id": "x",
                        "human_verified": False}},
    ]


def test_world_reps_from_real_records():
    from coordinator.app.world import derive_world_representations
    reps = derive_world_representations(_rep_records())
    assert len(reps) == 4
    by_source = {r["source_id"]: r for r in reps}
    # source_id bestaat en wijst terug naar het bronrecord.
    assert set(by_source) == {"hw_a1", "obj_cube", "proj_hydro",
                              "loc_base"}
    for rep in reps:
        assert rep["id"] == f"wrld-{rep['source_id']}"
        assert rep["source_type"] == "inventory"
        assert f"/world?entity_id={rep['source_id']}" == rep["href"]
        assert rep["interaction"] == "inspect"
        assert rep["zone"] == "homebase-workshop"
        assert set(rep) == {"id", "source_type", "source_id",
                            "entity_type", "kind", "zone", "x", "y",
                            "glyph", "label", "interaction", "href",
                            "status", "detail"}
    # Eerlijke statusafleiding uit provenance.
    assert by_source["hw_a1"]["status"] == "OBSERVED"
    assert by_source["hw_a1"]["kind"] == "MACHINE"
    assert by_source["obj_cube"]["status"] == "VERIFIED"
    assert by_source["obj_cube"]["kind"] == "OBJECT"
    assert by_source["proj_hydro"]["status"] == "REAL"
    assert by_source["proj_hydro"]["kind"] == "PROJECT"
    assert by_source["loc_base"]["status"] == "PROPOSED"
    assert by_source["loc_base"]["kind"] == "LOCATION"
    # Deterministisch: zelfde input, zelfde posities, binnen wereld.
    again = derive_world_representations(list(reversed(
        _rep_records())))
    assert [(r["x"], r["y"]) for r in again] == [
        (r["x"], r["y"]) for r in reps]
    for rep in reps:
        assert 40 <= rep["x"] <= 1600 - 40
        assert 40 <= rep["y"] <= 1000 - 20


def test_world_reps_refuse_and_dedupe():
    from coordinator.app.world import derive_world_representations
    assert derive_world_representations(None) == []
    assert derive_world_representations([]) == []
    recs = _rep_records() + [
        {"entity_type": "object", "entity_id": "obj_cube",
         "title": "DUPLICAAT", "snippet": "",
         "provenance": {}},
        {"entity_type": "drone", "entity_id": "drn_1",
         "title": "Niet op whitelist", "snippet": "",
         "provenance": {}},
        {"entity_type": "object", "entity_id": "zonderprefix",
         "title": "Geen prefix", "snippet": "",
         "provenance": {}},
        {"entity_type": "object", "entity_id": "xx_fake",
         "title": "Onbekend prefix", "snippet": "",
         "provenance": {}},
        "geen dict",
    ]
    reps = derive_world_representations(recs)
    assert len(reps) == 4

            [r["label"] for r in reps])

def test_loop_mission_gates_in_game(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        chat = client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={
            "message": "hallo"})
        assert chat.status_code == 200, chat.text
        conversation = chat.json()["conversation_id"]
        made = client.post("/api/v1/missions/from-template", json={
            "template_id": "investigate_inventory",
            "conversation_id": conversation,
            "goal": "Verkenning vanuit de game"})
        assert made.status_code == 201, made.text
        mid = made.json()["mission_id"]
        assert made.json()["status"] == "pending_approval"
        wrong = client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/approve",
                            json={"response": "ja misschien",
                                  "decided_by": "jelles"})
        assert wrong.status_code == 422
        ok = client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES",
                               "decided_by": "jelles"})
        assert ok.status_code == 200, ok.text
        assert ok.json()["status"] == "approved"
        ticked = client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mid}/tick")
        assert ticked.status_code == 200, ticked.text
        # Tracker toont de echte toestand na refresh.
        listed = client.get("/api/v1/missions").json()
        assert isinstance(listed, list)
        states = {m["mission_id"]: m["status"] for m in listed}
        assert states[mid] in ("approved", "running",
                               "completed", "blocked",
                               "failed", "paused")
        html = client.get("/play").text
        match = re.search(r"const PLAYDATA = (\{.*?\});", html,
                          re.DOTALL)
        tracks = {t["id"]: t for t in
                  json.loads(match.group(1))["tracker"]}
        assert tracks[mid]["status"] == states[mid]
        assert tracks[mid]["glyph"] in ("○", "◷", "…", "⏸",
                                        "✓", "!")

def test_verdant_awakened_with_real_signals():
    from coordinator.app.world import verdant_state_from
    state = verdant_state_from({
        "inventory": [
            {"entity_type": "project", "entity_id": "proj_hydro",
             "title": "Hydroponics-proef"}],
        "solar": 3,
        "research": [{"dossier_id": "dossier_1",
                      "title": "Compost-onderzoek"}]})
    assert state["state"] == "AWAKENED"
    assert state["count"] == 3

    assert "/world?entity_id=proj_hydro" in hrefs
    assert "/energy" in hrefs
    assert "/research/dossier_1" in hrefs
    # Deterministisch en begrensd.
    again = verdant_state_from({
        "inventory": [
            {"entity_type": "project", "entity_id": "proj_hydro",
             "title": "Hydroponics-proef"}],
        "solar": 3,
        "research": [{"dossier_id": "dossier_1",
                      "title": "Compost-onderzoek"}]})
    assert again == state

        {"quest_completed": True})["luma"]["state"] == \
        "completed"

def test_fungi_mission_parent_is_causal(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import types as _types
    import coordinator.app.campaigns as _camps
    import coordinator.app.missions as _missions
    from coordinator.app.world import derive_fungi_network
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "f.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "f-chat.db"))
    mission = _types.SimpleNamespace(
        mission_id="mission_verdant",
        goal="Hydroponics-verkenning", status="approved")
    quest_view = {"quest_id": "qst_verdant",
                  "title": "Missie: Hydroponics",
                  "state": "ACTIVE",
                  "href": "/quests/qst_verdant",
                  "steps": [{"kind": "mission",
                             "ref": "mission_verdant"}]}
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        _camps, "list_campaign_details",
        lambda limit=10: [{"campaign_id": "cmp_eco",
                           "title": "Eco",
                           "completed_count": 0,
                           "quests": [quest_view]}])
    monkeypatch.setattr(_missions, "list_missions",
                        lambda limit=50: [mission])
    net = derive_fungi_network(limit=120)
    by_id = {n["id"]: n for n in net["nodes"]}
    assert by_id["fungi-mission-mission_verdant"]["parent"] == \
        "fungi-quest-qst_verdant"
    assert by_id["fungi-quest-qst_verdant"]["parent"] == \
        "fungi-camp-cmp_eco"
    assert net == derive_fungi_network(limit=120)

def test_verdant_rep_from_signal():
    from coordinator.app.world import (VERDANT_RECT,
                                       verdant_rep_from)
    assert verdant_rep_from(None) is None
    assert verdant_rep_from([]) is None
    signals = [
        {"kind": "energy", "label": "2 solar-meting(en)",
         "href": "/energy", "detail": "energy_records"},
        {"kind": "inventory", "source_id": "proj_hydro",
         "entity_type": "project", "title": "Hydroponics",
         "label": "Hydroponics", "href": "/world?entity_id=",
         "detail": "project"}]
    rep = verdant_rep_from(signals)
    assert rep is not None
    assert rep["id"] == "wrld-proj_hydro"
    assert rep["source_id"] == "proj_hydro"
    assert rep["entity_type"] == "project"
    assert rep["kind"] == "PROJECT"
    assert rep["zone"] == "verdant"
    assert (rep["x"], rep["y"]) == (VERDANT_RECT["cx"],
                                    VERDANT_RECT["cy"])
    assert rep["href"] == "/world?entity_id=proj_hydro"
    assert rep["interaction"] == "inspect"
    # Geen dubbele als het record al op de plank staat.
    assert verdant_rep_from(signals,
                            shelf_ids={"proj_hydro"}) is None
    # Niet-whitelist-typen worden nooit een representatie.
    assert verdant_rep_from([{
        "kind": "inventory", "source_id": "idea_1",
        "entity_type": "idea", "label": "Idee",
        "href": "/world?entity_id=idea_1",
        "detail": "idea"}]) is None

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_probe_grab.py">
"""Probe-grab tests: out-of-process frame grab to CameraObservation
+ WorldObservation. The child process is ALWAYS mocked — no USB
enumeration, no hardware, no spawning in unit tests."""

import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.capture_probe as probe_mod
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "grab.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "grab-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", "grab-operator")
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


class _Done:
    def __init__(self, returncode=0, stdout="", stderr=""):
        self.returncode = returncode
        self.stdout = stdout
        self.stderr = stderr


def _register(test_client, device_id="cam-grab1", kinds=None,
              source="manual"):
    response = test_client.post("/api/v1/cameras/register", json={
        "device_id": device_id, "name": f"Grab {device_id}",
        "kinds": kinds or ["snapshot"], "source": source})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return device_id


def _real_frame(filename="cam-grabframe.bmp"):
    """A real BMP in the real camera dir (test-written, hashed)."""
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    from coordinator.app.desktop_runtime import write_bmp_24
    path = os.path.join(camera_dir(), filename)
    write_bmp_24(path, 16, 12, b"\x10\x20\x30" * (16 * 12))
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(handle.read()).hexdigest()
    return filename, digest, os.path.getsize(path)


def _frame_stdout(filename, digest, size, width=16, height=12):
    return json.dumps({"state": "frame_acquired",
                       "media_ref": filename, "sha256": digest,
                       "size_bytes": size, "width": width,
                       "height": height, "reason": "mocked child"})


# -- A. successful grab ------------------------------------------------

def test_probe_grab_success_creates_both_observations(
        tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app import vision_ingest as _ingest
    from coordinator.app.vision_ingest import SyntheticTestAdapter
    filename, digest, size = _real_frame()
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe_mod.subprocess, "run",
        lambda *a, **k: _Done(0, _frame_stdout(filename, digest,
                                               size)))
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        _register(test_client)
        _ingest.register_adapter("cam-grab1",
                                 SyntheticTestAdapter())
        try:
            response = test_client.post(
                "/api/v1/cameras/cam-grab1/probe-grab", json={})
            assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
            body = response.json()
            # G. CameraObservation stored + hash verified
            cam = body["camera_observation"]
            assert cam["device_id"] == "cam-grab1"
            assert cam["media_ref"] == filename
            assert cam["observation_id"].startswith("obs-")
            assert "probe-grab" in cam["provenance"]["notes"]
            assert "test-origin" in cam["provenance"]["notes"]
            assert body["grab"]["sha256"] == digest
            stored = test_client.get(
                "/api/v1/cameras/cam-grab1/observations").json()
            assert any(entry["observation_id"] ==
                       cam["observation_id"] for entry in stored)
            # H+I. WorldObservation stored, no entity without vision
            listed = test_client.get(
                "/api/v1/world/observations",
                params={"node_id": "cam-grab1"}).json()
            assert listed["total"] >= 1
            wobs = body["world_observation"]
            assert wobs["entity_ref"] == ""
            assert wobs["confidence"] == 0.0
            assert wobs["x"] is None and wobs["z"] is None
            assert wobs["media_ref"] == filename
            assert wobs["provenance"]["sha256"] == digest
            assert wobs["provenance"]["camera_observation_id"] == \
                cam["observation_id"]
        finally:
            _ingest.clear_adapters()


# -- B..F. failure verdicts, nothing stored ----------------------------

def _grab_with_child(tmp_path, monkeypatch, fake_run,
                     device_id="cam-grab1"):
    from coordinator.app import vision_ingest as _ingest
    from coordinator.app.vision_ingest import SyntheticTestAdapter
    monkeypatch.setattr(probe_mod.subprocess, "run", fake_run)
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        _register(test_client, device_id=device_id)
        _ingest.register_adapter(device_id, SyntheticTestAdapter())
        try:
            before = test_client.get(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/observations").json()
            response = test_client.post(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/probe-grab", json={})
            after = test_client.get(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/observations").json()
            # K. parent survives: endpoint answers after the failure
            assert test_client.get("/api/v1/health").status_code \
                == 200

def test_grab_analyze_full_chain(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

    from coordinator.app.vision_ingest import SyntheticTestAdapter
    filename, digest, size = _real_frame("cam-grabanalyse.bmp")
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        probe_mod.subprocess, "run",
        lambda *a, **k: _Done(0, _frame_stdout(filename, digest,
                                               size)))
    _mock_provider(monkeypatch)
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        _register(test_client)
        _ingest.register_adapter("cam-grab1",
                                 SyntheticTestAdapter())

            response = test_client.post(
                "/api/v1/vision/grab-analyze",
                json={"device_id": "cam-grab1",
                      "provider": "test-only"})
            assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
            body = response.json()

                body["analysis"]["analysis_id"]

                "/api/v1/world/observations",
                params={"node_id": "cam-grab1"}).json()
            assert listed["total"] >= 2  # frame presence + VLM
            # no INVENTory object was created from the detection
            assert "proposal" not in body
        finally:
            _ingest.clear_adapters()

"""Product loop tests: "Documenteer één object".

Poll → ingest → observation → VLM → candidates → IN_APP review,
JPG allowlist, write/verify gates (bestaand, onaangeroerd),
task-based Quest 1, campaign seeds, pure level derive.
"""

import os

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

TOKEN = "loop-test-token-aaaaaaaa"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "loop.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "loop-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        yield client


def _register_node(client, node_id="loop-node"):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "seed",
        "capabilities": ["system_inventory"], "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return node_id


def _register_cam(client, name="Loop cam"):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/cameras/register", json={
        "name": name, "kinds": ["snapshot"], "source": "phone"})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()["device_id"]


def _write_inbox(filename: str, payload: bytes) -> str:
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    path = os.path.join(camera_dir(), filename)
    with open(path, "wb") as handle:
        handle.write(payload)
    return filename


def _bmp_bytes(seed: int = 0x20) -> bytes:
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir, write_bmp_24
    import tempfile
    tmp = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "loop-probe.bmp")
    write_bmp_24(tmp, 8, 8,
                 bytes([(seed + index) % 256 for index in
                        range(8 * 8 * 3)]))
    with open(tmp, "rb") as handle:
        return handle.read()


def _clean_inbox(*filenames: str) -> None:
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    for filename in filenames:
        try:
            os.remove(os.path.join(camera_dir(), filename))
        except OSError:
            pass


def _stash_foreign_inbox() -> str:
    """Move non-loop inbox files aside (shared temp dir): poll
    counts stay deterministic without ever deleting another
    operator's files. Returns the backup dir."""
    import os as _os
    import shutil as _shutil
    import tempfile as _tempfile
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    from coordinator.app.vision_ingest import MEDIA_SUFFIXES
    backup = _tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="loop-inbox-stash-")
    try:
        entries = _os.listdir(camera_dir())
    except OSError:
        return backup
    for entry in entries:
        if entry.lower().endswith(MEDIA_SUFFIXES) \
                and not entry.startswith("loop-"):
            try:
                _shutil.move(_os.path.join(camera_dir(), entry),
                             _os.path.join(backup, entry))
            except OSError:
                pass
    return backup


def _restore_foreign_inbox(backup: str) -> None:
    """Move stashed foreign inbox files back. Best-effort."""
    import os as _os
    import shutil as _shutil
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    try:
        entries = _os.listdir(backup)
    except OSError:
        return
    for entry in entries:
        try:
            _shutil.move(_os.path.join(backup, entry),
                         _os.path.join(camera_dir(), entry))
        except OSError:
            pass
    try:
        _os.rmdir(backup)
    except OSError:
        pass


def _link_quest_task(quest_id: str, task_id: int) -> None:
    """Link a quest's first step to a real task (empty refs stay
    MISSING until then). save_quest path: no fake progress."""
    from coordinator.app.quests import get_quest, save_quest
    quest = get_quest(quest_id)
    assert quest is not None
    quest.steps[0].ref = str(task_id)
    save_quest(quest)

def test_poll_new_file_ingested_once(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        _stash = _stash_foreign_inbox()
        _register_node(client)
        device_id = _register_cam(client)
        name = "loop-once.jpg"
        _write_inbox(name, b"\xff\xd8\xff\xe0" + bytes(2000))
        try:
            first = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/poll-inbox")
            assert first.status_code == 200, first.text
            body = first.json()
            assert body["session_id"]
            assert len(body["ingested"]) == 1
            assert body["ingested"][0]["filename"] == name
            assert body["ingested"][0]["observation_id"]
            obs = client.get(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/observations").json()
            assert any(item["observation_id"] ==
                       body["ingested"][0]["observation_id"]
                       for item in obs)
            second = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/poll-inbox")
            assert second.status_code == 200, second.text
            again = second.json()
            assert again["ingested"] == []
            assert again["session_id"] == ""
            assert name in again["duplicates"]
        finally:
            _restore_foreign_inbox(_stash)
            _clean_inbox(name)


def test_poll_duplicate_sha_across_names_skipped(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        _stash = _stash_foreign_inbox()
        _register_node(client)
        device_id = _register_cam(client)
        blob = b"\xff\xd8\xff\xe0" + bytes(range(256)) * 8
        first_name, second_name = "loop-dup-a.jpg", "loop-dup-b.jpg"
        _write_inbox(first_name, blob)
        try:
            one = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/poll-inbox").json()
            assert len(one["ingested"]) == 1
            _write_inbox(second_name, blob)
            two = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/poll-inbox").json()
            assert two["ingested"] == []
            assert second_name in two["duplicates"]
        finally:
            _restore_foreign_inbox(_stash)
            _clean_inbox(first_name, second_name)


def test_poll_caps_at_eight(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        _stash = _stash_foreign_inbox()
        _register_node(client)
        device_id = _register_cam(client)
        names = [f"loop-cap-{index}.jpg" for index in range(9)]
        try:

            body = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/poll-inbox").json()
            assert len(body["ingested"]) == 8
            rest = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/poll-inbox").json()

        finally:
            _restore_foreign_inbox(_stash)
            _clean_inbox(*names)

def test_poll_real_analysis_yields_in_app_review(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        VisionAnalysisRecord,
        save_analysis,
    )
    from coordinator.app.vision_provider import VisionRequest, build_result
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        _stash = _stash_foreign_inbox()
        node_id = _register_node(client)
        device_id = _register_cam(client)
        name = "loop-real.jpg"
        try:
            _write_inbox(name, b"\xff\xd8\xff\xe0" + bytes(2000))
            body = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/cameras/{device_id}/poll-inbox").json()
            observation_id = body["ingested"][0]["observation_id"]
            request = VisionRequest(
                observation_id=observation_id, device_id=device_id,
                media_ref=name, question="Wat zie je?")
            result = build_result(
                request, "label: moer (0.8)\nEen metalen moer.",
                "test-only")

                analysis_id=result.analysis_id,
                observation_id=observation_id, device_id=device_id,
                result=result.model_dump(mode="json"),
                created_at=result.observed_at))
            proposed = client.post(
                f"/api/v1/observations/{observation_id}/propose-candidates")
            assert proposed.status_code == 201, proposed.text
            assert proposed.json()["candidates"]
            notes = client.get("/api/v1/notifications",
                               params={"node_id": node_id}).json()
            # Bestaand contract: de kind reist in titel/body, type
            # is de severity (approval_required voor
            # candidate_waiting). IN_APP is het kanaal.
            assert any("candidate" in note["title"].lower()
                       for note in notes)
            assert any(note["type"] == "approval_required"
                       for note in notes)
        finally:
            _restore_foreign_inbox(_stash)
            _clean_inbox(name)

def test_media_allowlist_and_mime():
    from coordinator.app.observations import check_image_ref
    from coordinator.app.vision_ingest import MEDIA_SUFFIXES, _mime_for
    for accepted in ("a.bmp", "a.png", "a.jpg", "a.jpeg",
                     "FOTO.JPG", "scan.JPEG"):
        assert check_image_ref(accepted) == accepted.strip()
    assert set(MEDIA_SUFFIXES) == {".bmp", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg"}
    assert _mime_for("a.jpg") == "image/jpeg"
    assert _mime_for("a.jpeg") == "image/jpeg"
    assert _mime_for("a.png") == "image/png"
    assert _mime_for("a.bmp") == "image/bmp"
    for rejected in ("a.heic", "a.mp4", "a.mov", "a.stl", "a.exe",
                     "a.png.exe", "../x.jpg", "/abs/x.jpg",
                     "C:\\w\\x.jpg", "sub/dir/x.jpg", "x",
                     "http://x/y.jpg"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            check_image_ref(rejected)


def test_media_vision_mime_and_gates(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.vision_ingest import MAX_MEDIA_BYTES, media_facts
    from coordinator.app.vision_provider import read_vision_media
    for _ in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
        jpg = os.path.join(camera_dir(), "loop-mime.jpg")
        with open(jpg, "wb") as handle:
            handle.write(b"\xff\xd8\xff\xe0" + bytes(500))
        try:
            assert media_facts("loop-mime.jpg").mime_type == \
                "image/jpeg"
            _, mime = read_vision_media("loop-mime.jpg")
            assert mime == "image/jpeg"
            for evil in ("../loop-mime.jpg", "/abs/loop-mime.jpg",
                         "C:\\w\\loop-mime.jpg", "sub/x.jpg"):
                with pytest.raises(Exception):
                    media_facts(evil)
            big = os.path.join(camera_dir(), "loop-big.jpg")
            with open(big, "wb") as handle:
                handle.write(b"\xff" * (MAX_MEDIA_BYTES + 8))
            try:
                with pytest.raises(Exception):
                    media_facts("loop-big.jpg")
            finally:
                try:
                    os.remove(big)
                except OSError:
                    pass
        finally:
            try:
                os.remove(jpg)
            except OSError:
                pass


# -- SECURITY (bestaande gates, onaangeroerd) -----------------------------

def _ai_provenance():
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance
    return Provenance(source_type="ai-generated", creator_id="qwen",
                      human_verified=False)


def test_security_exact_yes_and_fingerprint():
    from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import (
        decide_write,
        revalidate,
        request_write_approval,
    )
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import propose_inventory_write
    proposal = propose_inventory_write(
        "wrt-loop-obj", "create", "object", {"name": "moer"})
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    approved = decide_write(request, proposal, "YES",
                            decided_by="jelles")
    assert approved.approved is True
    for response in ("yes", "Yes", "NO", "JA", "", "OK"):
        denied = decide_write(
            request_write_approval(proposal), proposal, response)
        assert denied.approved is False
    tampered = proposal.model_copy(
        update={"payload": dict(proposal.payload, extra=True)})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        revalidate(tampered, approved)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        revalidate(proposal, approved.model_copy(
            update={"fingerprint": "0" * 64}))


def test_security_ttl_and_revalidate_required():
    import asyncio
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
    from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import (
        decide_write,
        is_stale,
        revalidate,
        request_write_approval,
    )
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import (
        InventoryWriteRefusedError,
        execute_inventory_write,
        propose_inventory_write,
    )
    proposal = propose_inventory_write(
        "wrt-loop-ttl", "create", "object", {"name": "moer"})
    assert is_stale(proposal) is False
    future = (datetime.now(timezone.utc)
              + timedelta(seconds=7200)).isoformat()
    assert is_stale(proposal, future) is True
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        decide_write(request_write_approval(proposal), proposal,
                     "YES", now_str=future)
    rejected = decide_write(request_write_approval(proposal),
                            proposal, "NO")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        revalidate(proposal, rejected)
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, InventoryWriteRefusedError,
                        TypeError)):
        asyncio.run(execute_inventory_write(
            proposal, rejected, reader=None, writer=None))


def test_security_object_file_independent():
    from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import (
        decide_write,
        revalidate,
        request_write_approval,
    )
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import propose_inventory_write
    obj = propose_inventory_write(
        "wrt-loop-o", "create", "object", {"name": "moer"})
    fil = propose_inventory_write(
        "wrt-loop-f", "create", "file",
        {"name": "moer.jpg", "file_kind": "image",
         "mime_type": "image/jpeg", "sha256": "a" * 64,
         "size_bytes": 12})
    obj_ok = decide_write(request_write_approval(obj), obj, "YES")
    fil_ok = decide_write(request_write_approval(fil), fil, "YES")
    assert revalidate(obj, obj_ok)
    assert revalidate(fil, fil_ok)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        revalidate(obj, fil_ok)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        revalidate(fil, obj_ok)


def test_security_verification_needs_readback():
    from coordinator.app.vision_flow import verify_observation
    from coordinator.app.verification import is_verified
    from coordinator.app.vision_flow import (
        new_observation_verification_request,
    )
    from coordinator.app.cameras import new_observation
    observation = new_observation(
        "obs-loop1", "cam-loop1", "snapshot", media_ref="a.jpg")
    request = new_observation_verification_request(
        "wrt-loop1", "f" * 64, observation)
    missing = verify_observation(request, None, media_exists=False)
    assert missing.outcome == "inconclusive"
    assert is_verified(missing) is False
    gone = verify_observation(request, observation, media_exists=False)
    assert gone.outcome == "failed"
    assert is_verified(gone) is False
    passed = verify_observation(request, observation, media_exists=True)
    assert passed.outcome == "passed"
    assert is_verified(passed) is True


def test_security_ai_generated_stays_unverified():
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import build_create_payload
    body = build_create_payload("object", {"name": "moer"})
    assert body["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False
    from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import propose_write

                                  proposal_id="wrt-loop9")

def _complete_task(client, kind="documenteer-object"):
    created = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
        "kind": kind, "payload": {}}).json()
    task_id = created["id"]
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE tasks SET status='completed', "
                   "completed_at='2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' "
                   "WHERE id=?", (task_id,))
    return task_id


def test_quest_task_completes_entity_waits(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.quests import (
        derive_step_state,
        get_quest,
        new_quest,
        quest_detail,
        save_quest,
    )
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        task_id = _complete_task(client)
        quest = new_quest("Q taak", [{
            "key": "doc", "label": "Documenteer", "kind": "task",
            "ref": ""}])
        save_quest(quest)
        _link_quest_task(quest.quest_id, task_id)
        detail = quest_detail(get_quest(quest.quest_id))
        assert detail["state"] == "COMPLETED"
        entity = new_quest("Q entity", [{
            "key": "link", "label": "Koppel obj_x", "kind": "entity",
            "ref": "obj_demo"}])
        save_quest(entity)
        step = derive_step_state(entity.steps[0])
        assert step["state"] == "WAITING"

# -- LEVEL -----------------------------------------------------------------

def test_level_pure_deterministic_unknown():
    from coordinator.app.game import derive_level
    first = derive_level(verified_objects=1, verified_files=1,
                         completed_quests=0)
    assert first == derive_level(verified_objects=1,
                                 verified_files=1,
                                 completed_quests=0)
    assert first["level"] == "ROOTED"
    assert first["provenance"] == "derived"
    assert derive_level()["level"] == "SEEDLING"
    grove = derive_level(verified_objects=5, verified_files=5,
                         completed_quests=2)
    assert grove["level"] == "GROVE"
    unknown = derive_level(verified_objects=None,
                           verified_files=0, completed_quests=0)
    assert unknown["level"] == "SEEDLING"
    assert any("UNKNOWN" in line for line in unknown["evidence"])
    zero = derive_level(verified_objects=0, verified_files=0,
                        completed_quests=0)
    assert zero["level"] == "SEEDLING"
    assert zero["evidence"] != unknown["evidence"]


def test_level_has_no_side_effects(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.game import derive_level
    from coordinator.app.quests import list_quests
    for _ in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        before = len(list_quests(limit=100))
        derive_level(verified_objects=3, verified_files=3,
                     completed_quests=1)
        derive_level(verified_objects=None)
        assert len(list_quests(limit=100)) == before

"""Project context tests (Fase L/Q).

Explicit contexts validate directories; the default resolves from
environment or cwd without hardcoding one project.
"""

import os

import pytest

from coordinator.app.project_context import default_context, new_context


def test_explicit_context_needs_real_dirs(tmp_path):
    context = new_context("prj-camper", "Camper", str(tmp_path))
    assert context.repository == str(tmp_path).replace("\\", "\\")
    assert context.working_directory
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_context("prj-x", "X", str(tmp_path / "missing"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_context("prj-x", "  ", str(tmp_path))


def test_default_context_from_env(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_PROJECT_ROOT", str(tmp_path))
    context = default_context()
    assert context.repository == os.path.abspath(str(tmp_path))
    assert context.name


def test_default_context_falls_back_to_cwd(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.delenv("MYCELIUM_PROJECT_ROOT", raising=False)
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    context = default_context()
    assert context.repository == os.path.abspath(str(tmp_path))


def test_default_context_refuses_missing_root(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_PROJECT_ROOT",
                       str(tmp_path / "missing"))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        default_context()


def test_context_carries_no_secrets():
    context = new_context("prj-a", "A", os.getcwd())
    assert "secret" not in context.model_dump()
    assert context.provenance.human_verified is True

"""Project-aware context package tests (BIG #5).

Bounded, read-only projection: no file contents, no secrets, no
absolute sensitive paths, provenance preserved, lexical fallback
when semantic retrieval is unavailable.
"""

import asyncio

import pytest

from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance, SearchResult
from coordinator.app.project_context import ProjectContext
from coordinator.app.project_package import (
    assemble_project_package,
    build_project_package,
    redact_path,
    summarize_for_chat,
)


def run(coro):
    return asyncio.run(coro)


def make_project(tmp_path):
    return ProjectContext(
        project_id="prj-test", name="Testproject",
        repository=str(tmp_path), working_directory=str(tmp_path),
        provenance=Provenance(source_type="user-created",
                              creator_id="human",
                              human_verified=True))


def make_record(entity_id="obj_abc", title="Bout"):
    return {"entity_type": "object", "entity_id": entity_id,
            "title": title, "snippet": "M3 bout in lade",
            "match_type": "lexical",
            "provenance": {"source_type": "user-created",
                           "human_verified": True}}


class FakeReader:
    def __init__(self, results=None):
        self._results = results or []

    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(
            query=q,
            results=[SearchResult(
                entity_type="object", entity_id="obj_abc",
                title="Bout", snippet="M3",
                provenance=Provenance(
                    source_type="user-created",
                    creator_id="human", human_verified=True),
                details={})],
            total=1)

    async def browse(self, type=None):
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query="", results=[], total=0)

    async def graph(self, entity_id, depth=1):
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import GraphResponse
        return GraphResponse(entity_id=entity_id, depth=depth,
                             nodes=[], edges=[])


def test_package_is_bounded(tmp_path):
    project = make_project(tmp_path)
    package = build_project_package(
        project,
        entities=[make_record(f"obj_{index:03d}") for index in range(50)],
        missions=[{"mission_id": f"mission_{index}",
                   "goal": f"doel {index}", "status": "running",
                   "steps": []} for index in range(20)],
        events=[{"event_type": "note", "message": f"m{index}"}
                for index in range(40)],
        git={"branch": "main", "lines": [f"M f{i}" for i in range(5)]},
        files=[{"name": f"bestand{index}.txt",
                "contents": "GEHEIM"}
               for index in range(30)])
    assert len(package["entities"]) == 10
    assert len(package["missions"]) == 5
    assert len(package["events"]) == 10
    assert len(package["files"]) == 10
    # Files are listed by name only — never contents.
    assert all(set(item) == {"name"} for item in package["files"])


def test_no_secrets_and_no_absolute_paths(tmp_path):
    project = make_project(tmp_path)
    home = str(tmp_path)
    package = build_project_package(
        project,
        entities=[{**make_record(),
                   "snippet": f"ligt in {home}/geheim",
                   "api_key": "SUPERGEHEIM"}],
        git={"branch": "main", "lines": [f"M {home}/x.txt"]})
    text = str(package)
    assert "SUPERGEHEIM" not in text
    assert home not in text
    assert "$PROJECT" in text or "$HOME" in text


def test_redact_path():
    import os
    assert redact_path("/home/jelles/x", "/home/jelles") == "$PROJECT/x"
    home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    assert "$HOME" in redact_path(home + "/x")


def test_provenance_flows_through(tmp_path):
    project = make_project(tmp_path)
    package = build_project_package(
        project, entities=[make_record()])
    provenance = package["entities"][0]["provenance"]
    assert provenance["source_type"] == "user-created"
    assert provenance["human_verified"] is True
    assert package["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False


def test_summary_answers_what_are_we_building(tmp_path):
    project = make_project(tmp_path)
    package = build_project_package(
        project, entities=[make_record()],
        missions=[{"mission_id": "mission_1",
                   "goal": "Werkbank opruimen",
                   "status": "running", "steps": []}],
        git={"branch": "main", "lines": []})
    summary = summarize_for_chat(package)
    assert "Testproject" in summary
    assert "Bout" in summary
    assert "Werkbank opruimen" in summary
    assert "geen toestemming" in summary


def test_assemble_uses_lexical_fallback(tmp_path):
    project = make_project(tmp_path)
    package = run(assemble_project_package(
        project, FakeReader(), query="bout", mode="hybrid"))
    assert package["retrieval_mode"] == "lexical"
    assert len(package["entities"]) == 1
    assert package["entities"][0]["entity_id"] == "obj_abc"


def test_assemble_empty_query_never_fails(tmp_path):
    project = make_project(tmp_path)
    package = run(assemble_project_package(
        project, FakeReader(), query=""))
    assert package["entities"] == []
    assert package["name"] == "Testproject"


class BrokenEmbedder:

    async def embed(self, texts):

def test_assemble_semantic_outage_falls_back(tmp_path):

"""Provider layer tests (Fase C/Q).

Contract, Ollama compatibility, unavailable-provider and fail-closed
behaviour. Ollama HTTP is faked with httpx.MockTransport; no real
model is ever contacted. Async providers run via asyncio.run (no
extra test dependency).
"""

import asyncio

import httpx
import pytest

from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse
from coordinator.app.providers import (
    ExternalProvider,
    OllamaProvider,
    ProviderRefusedError,
    ProviderUnavailable,
    get_provider,
)


def ok_handler(request):
    return httpx.Response(200, json={"response": "advies-tekst"})


def make_ollama(**kwargs):
    kwargs.setdefault("transport", httpx.MockTransport(ok_handler))
    return OllamaProvider(**kwargs)


def test_ollama_provider_returns_shared_advice_shape():
    answered = asyncio.run(make_ollama().advise(
        "Wat kan ik maken?", [{"entity_id": "obj_x", "title": "t",
                                "snippet": "s", "provenance": {}}]))
    assert isinstance(answered, AdviceResponse)
    assert answered.advice == "advies-tekst"
    assert answered.records_used == 1


def test_ollama_provider_unavailable_fails_closed():
    def fail(request):
        raise httpx.ConnectError("down")

    provider = OllamaProvider(transport=httpx.MockTransport(fail))
    with pytest.raises(ProviderUnavailable):
        asyncio.run(provider.advise("vraag?", []))


def test_ollama_provider_refused_input_fails_closed():
    with pytest.raises(ProviderRefusedError):
        asyncio.run(make_ollama().advise("   ", []))


def test_ollama_provider_bad_url_refused():
    with pytest.raises(ProviderRefusedError):
        OllamaProvider(base_url="http://example.com:11434")


def test_external_provider_always_unavailable():
    provider = ExternalProvider(provider="openai", config={"region": "eu"})
    with pytest.raises(ProviderUnavailable) as caught:
        asyncio.run(provider.advise("vraag?", []))
    assert "not configured" in str(caught.value)


def test_external_provider_rejects_credentials():
    with pytest.raises(ProviderRefusedError):
        ExternalProvider(provider="x", config={"api_key": "secret"})
    with pytest.raises(ProviderRefusedError):
        ExternalProvider(provider="x", config={"TOKEN": "secret"})
    with pytest.raises(ProviderRefusedError):
        ExternalProvider(provider="x", config={"password": "p"})


def test_external_provider_needs_name():
    with pytest.raises(ProviderRefusedError):
        ExternalProvider(provider="  ")


def test_get_provider_defaults_to_ollama():
    assert isinstance(get_provider(None), OllamaProvider)
    assert isinstance(get_provider("ollama"), OllamaProvider)
    assert isinstance(get_provider("external"), ExternalProvider)


def test_get_provider_unknown_name_refused():
    with pytest.raises(ProviderRefusedError):
        get_provider("chatgpt-direct")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_push_off.py">
"""Push-off sweep tests: bounds, travel-only output, safe
verdict through the real validator. Local artifacts only."""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.push_off import (
    PushOffRefusedError,
    build_push_sweep,
    store_push_gcode,
)


def test_builder_defaults_kubus():
    text = build_push_sweep()
    assert "G28" in text
    assert "M84" in text
    assert "F300" in text


def test_builder_refuses_out_of_bounds():
    with pytest.raises(PushOffRefusedError):
        build_push_sweep(part_x=5.0)
    with pytest.raises(PushOffRefusedError):
        build_push_sweep(part_y=200.0)
    with pytest.raises(PushOffRefusedError):
        build_push_sweep(push_z=1.0)
    with pytest.raises(PushOffRefusedError):
        build_push_sweep(push_z=25.0, part_h=20.0)
    with pytest.raises(PushOffRefusedError):
        build_push_sweep(direction="up")


def test_output_is_travel_only():
    text = build_push_sweep()
    assert "M104" not in text
    assert "M109" not in text
    assert "M140" not in text
    assert "M190" not in text
    for line in text.splitlines():
        stripped = line.split(";")[0]
        assert " E" not in f" {stripped} "


def test_prime_variant_stays_bounded_and_safe(tmp_path,
                                              monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.slicer3d import validate_gcode
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    text = build_push_sweep(prime=True)
    assert "M104 S170" in text
    assert "M140" not in text
    reference, _ = store_push_gcode(
        "fab-push-prime-test.gcode", text)
    assessment = validate_gcode(reference)
    assert assessment.verdict == "safe", assessment.findings
    with pytest.raises(PushOffRefusedError):
        build_push_sweep(prime=True, prime_temp_c=250.0)


def test_stored_sweep_validates_safe(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.slicer3d import validate_gcode
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    reference, data = store_push_gcode(

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_recovery.py">
"""BIG #25 tests: persistent mission recovery.

assess() reconstructs state without mutating; scan() reports
counts. Stale approvals are never reused, agent actions never
re-dispatched, gated steps always need a fresh human YES.
"""

from coordinator.app.missions import new_mission
from coordinator.app.recovery import assess, scan


def _mission(status, kinds, step_statuses=None):
    steps = []
    for kind in kinds:
        data = {"kind": kind, "description": f"step {kind}",
                "parameters": _params(kind)}
        if kind == "desktop":
            data.update({
                "action_type": "screenshot",
                "requires_approval": False,
                "required_capabilities": ["desktop.screen.read"]})
        steps.append(data)
    mission = new_mission(
        "mission_test1", "conv-1", "test goal", steps,
        status="pending_approval")
    statuses = step_statuses or ["pending"] * len(kinds)
    steps_done = []
    for step, wanted in zip(mission.steps, statuses):
        steps_done.append(step.model_copy(update={
            "status": wanted,
            "desktop_action_id": ("dact-1" if step.kind == "desktop"
                                  and wanted in ("dispatched",
                                                 "waiting_approval")
                                  else "")}))
    mission = mission.model_copy(update={
        "status": status, "steps": steps_done})
    return mission


def _params(kind):
    if kind == "desktop":
        return {}
    if kind == "write":
        return {"proposal_id": "prop-123"}
    if kind == "camera_observe":
        return {"device_id": "cam-1"}
    if kind == "fabricate":
        return {"description": "test box"}
    if kind == "slice":
        return {"artifact_ref": "a", "profile": "p",
                "printer_id": "printer-1"}
    if kind == "physical_print":
        return {"proposal_id": "print-1"}
    if kind == "readout":
        return {"source": "project"}
    return {}


def test_terminal_observed_only():
    mission = _mission("completed", ["readout"], ["completed"])
    verdict = assess(mission)
    assert verdict.verdict == "terminal"


def test_unapproved_needs_reapproval():
    mission = _mission("pending_approval", ["readout"])
    verdict = assess(mission)
    assert verdict.verdict == "needs_reapproval"


def test_readonly_safe_to_resume():
    mission = _mission("approved", ["readout", "analysis"])
    verdict = assess(mission)
    assert verdict.verdict == "safe_to_resume"
    assert verdict.remaining == 2


def test_desktop_pending_needs_fresh_yes():
    mission = _mission(
        "approved", ["readout", "desktop"],
        ["completed", "pending"])
    # desktop pending without action id: still gated
    mission = mission.model_copy(update={
        "steps": [mission.steps[0],
                  mission.steps[1].model_copy(update={
                      "action_type": "screenshot"})]})
    verdict = assess(mission)
    assert verdict.verdict == "needs_reapproval"
    assert "desktop" in verdict.gated_pending


def test_waiting_approval_never_reused():
    mission = _mission("running", ["desktop"], ["waiting_approval"])
    verdict = assess(mission, {"dact-1": ("mission_test1",
                                          mission.steps[0].step_id)})
    assert verdict.verdict == "needs_reapproval"


def test_dispatched_with_binding_waits_for_agent():
    mission = _mission("running", ["desktop"], ["dispatched"])
    step_id = mission.steps[0].step_id
    verdict = assess(mission,
                     {"dact-1": ("mission_test1", step_id)})
    assert verdict.verdict == "waiting_agent"


def test_dispatched_without_binding_needs_review():
    mission = _mission("running", ["desktop"], ["dispatched"])
    verdict = assess(mission, {})
    assert verdict.verdict == "needs_reapproval"


def test_write_step_needs_fresh_yes():
    mission = _mission("approved", ["write"])
    verdict = assess(mission)
    assert verdict.verdict == "needs_reapproval"


def test_bad_pointer_needs_review():
    mission = _mission("approved", ["readout"])
    mission = mission.model_copy(update={"current_step": 99})
    verdict = assess(mission)
    assert verdict.verdict == "needs_reapproval"


def test_scan_counts():
    missions = [
        _mission("approved", ["readout"]),
        _mission("pending_approval", ["readout"]),
        _mission("completed", ["readout"], ["completed"]),
    ]
    report = scan(missions)
    assert report["total"] == 3
    assert report["counts"]["safe_to_resume"] == 1
    assert report["counts"]["needs_reapproval"] == 1
    assert report["counts"]["terminal"] == 1

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_remote_control.py">
"""REMOTE CONTROL SLICE 2 tests: click/keyboard/scroll/drag/clipboard.

Matrix (taak A–R):

A capability discovery (derive markeert per capability)
B unsupported capability weigert
C session required (input zonder sessie / move-route analogue)
D stale node weigert
E disconnect weigert
F invalid payload weigert
G extra payload fields weigeren
H session expiry
I click execution (fake adapter + contract)
J keyboard execution (fake adapter + allow-list)
K scroll execution (fake adapter, verticaal-only)
L drag lifecycle (down/move/up + fifo-volgorde)
M clipboard (set + request/read, text-only)
N disconnect tijdens actieve actie (410 + emergency release)
O bestaande mouse blijft werken
P Digital World blijft werken (per-capability UI)
Q Forge blijft werken
R workspaces blijven werken

Plus pure unit tests en node-adapter tests (fake backend).
Echte OS-executie gebeurt in FASE F (live Windows).
"""

import os
import sqlite3

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.remote_input import (
    REGISTRY,
    RemoteInputGoneError,
    RemoteInputRefusedError,
    capability_for_kind,
    check_clipboard_text,
    check_input_action,
    open_session,
    queue_action,
)
from node_client import remote_mouse
from node_client.remote_mouse import (
    ButtonTracker,
    MouseUnavailableError,
    execute_remote_action,
    probe_capabilities,
)

TOKEN = "remote-control-test-token-123456789"
ALL_CAPS = ["desktop.mouse.move", "desktop.mouse.click",
            "desktop.keyboard.type", "desktop.keyboard.press",
            "desktop.mouse.scroll", "desktop.clipboard.write",
            "desktop.clipboard.read"]


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def clean_registry():
    REGISTRY.clear()
    yield
    REGISTRY.clear()


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "rc.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "rc-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        yield client


def register(client, node_id="node-rc", capabilities=None,
             token=TOKEN):
    body = {"node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id,
            "tier": "worker",
            "capabilities": capabilities if capabilities is not None
            else list(ALL_CAPS),
            "node_token": token}
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def heartbeat(client, node_id="node-rc", token=TOKEN):
    return client.post(f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat",
                       json={"available": True, "node_token": token})


def connect(client, node_id="node-rc"):
    return client.post("/api/v1/remote-input/sessions",
                       json={"node_id": node_id})


def send_input(client, session_id, kind, params):
    return client.post(
        f"/api/v1/remote-input/sessions/{session_id}/input",
        json={"kind": kind, "params": params})


def poll(client, node_id="node-rc", token=TOKEN, extra=None):
    body = {"node_id": node_id, "node_token": token}
    if extra:
        body.update(extra)
    return client.post("/api/v1/remote-input/poll", json=body)


def stale_node(tmp_path, node_id="node-rc"):
    db = sqlite3.connect(str(tmp_path / "rc.db"))
    db.execute(
        "UPDATE nodes SET last_seen='2000-01-01T00:00:00+00:00' "
        "WHERE node_id=?", (node_id,))
    db.commit()
    db.close()


# -- A: capability discovery ------------------------------------------------------

def test_a_capability_discovery(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client, capabilities=["desktop.mouse.move"])
        assert heartbeat(client).status_code == 204
        world = client.get("/api/v1/digital-world").json()
        entry = world["nodes"][0]
        assert entry["remote_mouse"] == "supported"
        assert "desktop.mouse.move" in entry["capabilities"]
        page = client.get("/nodes").text
        for cap in ("Mouse", "Click", "Keyboard", "Scroll",
                    "Drag", "Clipboard"):
            assert cap in page


# -- B: unsupported capability weigert -----------------------------------------------

@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind,params,caps", [
    ("click", {"x": 10, "y": 10},
     ["desktop.mouse.move"]),
    ("key_press", {"key": "enter"},
     ["desktop.mouse.move", "desktop.mouse.click"]),
    ("hotkey", {"keys": ["ctrl", "c"]},
     ["desktop.mouse.move"]),
    ("type_text", {"text": "hi"},
     ["desktop.mouse.move"]),
    ("scroll", {"dx": 0, "dy": 120},
     ["desktop.mouse.move"]),
    ("mouse_down", {"x": 1, "y": 1},
     ["desktop.mouse.move"]),
    ("clipboard_set", {"text": "hi"},
     ["desktop.mouse.move", "desktop.mouse.click"]),
])
def test_b_unsupported_capability_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch,
                                          kind, params, caps):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client, capabilities=caps)
        assert heartbeat(client).status_code == 204
        # CONNECT slaagt (move-cap aanwezig), de input-gate
        # weigert per kind (ontbrekende capability).
        session_id = connect(client).json()["session_id"]
        response = send_input(client, session_id, kind, params)
        assert response.status_code == 403, (kind, response.text)


def test_b_click_needs_click_cap(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client, capabilities=["desktop.mouse.move",
                                       "desktop.mouse.click"])
        assert heartbeat(client).status_code == 204
        session_id = connect(client).json()["session_id"]
        # click-cap aanwezig: click mag door
        assert send_input(client, session_id, "click",
                          {"x": 5, "y": 5}).status_code == 204
        # keyboard-cap ontbreekt: key weigert
        assert send_input(client, session_id, "key_press",
                          {"key": "enter"}).status_code == 403

def test_c_input_needs_session(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

            "/api/v1/remote-input/sessions/deadbeef/input",
            json={"kind": "click",
                  "params": {"x": 1}}).status_code == 404

def test_d_stale_node_refuses_input(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        assert heartbeat(client).status_code == 204
        session_id = connect(client).json()["session_id"]
        stale_node(tmp_path)
        assert send_input(client, session_id, "click",
                          {"x": 1, "y": 1}).status_code == 403
        assert send_input(client, session_id, "key_press",
                          {"key": "a"}).status_code == 403


def test_e_disconnect_refuses_input(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        assert heartbeat(client).status_code == 204
        session_id = connect(client).json()["session_id"]

            f"/api/v1/remote-input/sessions/{session_id}/close"
            ).status_code == 200
        assert send_input(client, session_id, "click",
                          {"x": 1, "y": 1}).status_code in (403, 410)
        assert poll(client).status_code == 410

# -- I/J/K: execution via fake adapter ------------------------------------------------------------

class FakeInput:
    name = "fake"
    can_move = True
    can_click = True
    can_key = True
    can_scroll = True
    can_clipboard_write = True
    can_clipboard_read = True

    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []
        self.clipboard = ""

    def move(self, x, y):
        self.calls.append(("move", x, y))

    def click(self, x, y, button):
        self.calls.append(("click", x, y, button))

    def button(self, down, x, y, button):
        self.calls.append(("button", down, x, y, button))

    def release(self, button):
        self.calls.append(("release", button))

    def scroll(self, dy):
        self.calls.append(("scroll", dy))

    def key_press(self, key):
        self.calls.append(("key_press", key))

    def hotkey(self, keys):
        self.calls.append(("hotkey", tuple(keys)))

    def type_text(self, text):
        self.calls.append(("type_text", text))

    def clipboard_write(self, text):
        self.calls.append(("clipboard_write", text))
        self.clipboard = text

    def clipboard_read(self):
        self.calls.append(("clipboard_read",))
        return self.clipboard or "node-text"


def test_i_click_execution():
    fake = FakeInput()
    receipt = execute_remote_action(
        "click", {"x": 11, "y": 22, "button": "right"},
        adapter=fake)
    assert receipt["button"] == "right"
    assert fake.calls == [("click", 11, 22, "right")]
    with pytest.raises(MouseUnavailableError):
        execute_remote_action(
            "click", {"x": 1, "y": 1},
            adapter=remote_mouse.UnavailableMouseAdapter())


def test_j_keyboard_execution():
    fake = FakeInput()
    assert execute_remote_action(
        "key_press", {"key": "Enter"},
        adapter=fake)["key"] == "enter"
    assert execute_remote_action(
        "hotkey", {"keys": ["CTRL", "c"]},
        adapter=fake)["keys"] == ["ctrl", "c"]
    assert execute_remote_action(
        "type_text", {"text": "hello"},
        adapter=fake)["chars"] == 5
    assert fake.calls == [("key_press", "enter"),
                          ("hotkey", ("ctrl", "c")),
                          ("type_text", "hello")]
    with pytest.raises(MouseUnavailableError):
        execute_remote_action("key_press", {"key": "rm"},
                              adapter=fake)
    with pytest.raises(MouseUnavailableError):
        execute_remote_action("unknown_kind", {},
                              adapter=fake)


def test_k_scroll_execution_vertical_only():
    fake = FakeInput()
    assert execute_remote_action(
        "scroll", {"dx": 0, "dy": -240},
        adapter=fake)["dy"] == -240
    assert fake.calls == [("scroll", -240)]
    with pytest.raises(MouseUnavailableError):
        execute_remote_action("scroll", {"dx": 3, "dy": 120},
                              adapter=fake)
    with pytest.raises(MouseUnavailableError):
        execute_remote_action("scroll", {"dx": 0, "dy": 0},
                              adapter=fake)


def test_no_shell_in_extended_adapter():
    import pathlib
    src = pathlib.Path(remote_mouse.__file__).read_text(
        encoding="utf-8")
    assert "import subprocess" not in src
    assert "shell=True" not in src
    assert "os.system" not in src
    assert "eval(" not in src
    # allow-listed methoden bestaan, niets daarbuiten
    for name in ("click", "button", "release", "scroll",
                 "key_press", "hotkey", "type_text",
                 "clipboard_write", "clipboard_read"):
        assert hasattr(remote_mouse.WindowsMouseAdapter, name)
    for name in ("shell", "exec", "command", "run", "open_url",
                 "download", "upload"):
        assert not hasattr(remote_mouse.WindowsMouseAdapter, name)
    assert probe_capabilities(
        adapter=remote_mouse.UnavailableMouseAdapter()) == {
            "move": False, "click": False, "keyboard": False,
            "scroll": False, "drag": False,
            "clipboard_write": False, "clipboard_read": False}


@pytest.mark.skipif(os.name != "nt",
                    reason="Windows INPUT layout only")
def test_windows_input_struct_union_size():
    """Regressie: keyboard-INPUT moet even groot zijn als
    mouse-INPUT (echte 40-byte union op x64) — een key-only
    32-byte struct laat SendInput elke toets weigeren."""
    mouse_size, key_size = remote_mouse.windows_input_size()
    assert mouse_size == key_size == 40

def test_l_drag_lifecycle_order(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

def test_l_drag_executes_in_order_with_tracker():
    fake = FakeInput()
    tracker = ButtonTracker()
    execute_remote_action("mouse_down", {"x": 1, "y": 2},
                          adapter=fake, tracker=tracker)

    execute_remote_action("mouse_up", {"x": 3, "y": 4},
                          adapter=fake, tracker=tracker)
    assert tracker.held is None
    assert fake.calls == [("button", True, 1, 2, "left"),
                          ("button", False, 3, 4, "left")]


def test_tracker_emergency_release_without_moving():

    tracker = ButtonTracker()

    tracker.press("right")
    receipt = tracker.emergency_release(adapter=fake)
    assert receipt["emergency"] is True
    assert receipt["button"] == "right"
    # release beweegt de cursor NIET (alleen button-up)
    assert fake.calls == [("release", "right")]
    assert tracker.held is None


# -- M: clipboard ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_m_clipboard_set_roundtrip(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        assert heartbeat(client).status_code == 204
        session_id = connect(client).json()["session_id"]
        assert send_input(client, session_id, "clipboard_set",
                          {"text": "hello node"}).status_code == 204
        data = poll(client).json()
        assert data["actions"][0]["kind"] == "clipboard_set"
        assert data["actions"][0]["text"] == "hello node"


def test_m_clipboard_request_read_flow(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        assert heartbeat(client).status_code == 204
        session_id = connect(client).json()["session_id"]
        # lezen zonder tekst: null (geen fake)
        empty = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/remote-input/sessions/{session_id}/clipboard")
        assert empty.status_code == 200
        assert empty.json() == {"text": None}
        # request zetten
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/remote-input/sessions/{session_id}"
            f"/clipboard/request").status_code == 204
        # node ziet de vlag in de poll
        data = poll(client).json()
        assert data is not None
        assert data.get("clipboard_request") is True
        # node levert tekst bij de volgende poll
        delivered = poll(client, extra={"clipboard_text": "from-node"})
        assert delivered.status_code == 200
        # browser leest eenmalig
        got = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/remote-input/sessions/{session_id}/clipboard")
        assert got.json() == {"text": "from-node"}
        again = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/remote-input/sessions/{session_id}/clipboard")
        assert again.json() == {"text": None}


def test_m_unsolicited_clipboard_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register(client)
        assert heartbeat(client).status_code == 204
        connect(client)
        response = poll(client, extra={"clipboard_text": "sneaky"})
        assert response.status_code == 422


def test_check_clipboard_text_gate():
    assert check_clipboard_text("a\nb\rc\td") == "a\nb\rc\td"
    for bad in ["", "x" * 65537, "bad\x00", "bad\x07", 42, None]:
        try:
            check_clipboard_text(bad)
        except RemoteInputRefusedError:
            continue
        raise AssertionError(f"accepted {bad!r}"[:60])


def test_capability_for_kind_closed():
    from coordinator.app.remote_input import (
        CLIPBOARD_READ_CAPABILITY, CLIPBOARD_WRITE_CAPABILITY,
        CLICK_CAPABILITY, KEYBOARD_PRESS_CAPABILITY,
        KEYBOARD_TYPE_CAPABILITY, MOUSE_CAPABILITY,
        SCROLL_CAPABILITY,
    )
    assert capability_for_kind("click") == {CLICK_CAPABILITY}
    assert capability_for_kind("scroll") == {SCROLL_CAPABILITY}
    assert capability_for_kind("type_text") == {
        KEYBOARD_TYPE_CAPABILITY}
    assert capability_for_kind("key_press") == {
        KEYBOARD_PRESS_CAPABILITY}
    assert capability_for_kind("mouse_down") == {
        MOUSE_CAPABILITY, CLICK_CAPABILITY}
    assert capability_for_kind("clipboard_set") == {
        CLIPBOARD_WRITE_CAPABILITY}
    assert CLIPBOARD_READ_CAPABILITY.startswith("desktop.")
    try:
        capability_for_kind("rm -rf")
    except RemoteInputRefusedError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("open kind accepted")


def test_check_input_action_uses_existing_contracts():
    assert check_input_action(
        "click", {"x": 1, "y": 2})["button"] == "left"
    assert check_input_action(
        "key_press", {"key": "F5"}) == {"kind": "key_press",
                                        "key": "f5"}
    assert check_input_action(
        "scroll", {"dx": 0, "dy": 120})["dy"] == 120
    assert check_input_action(
        "mouse_down",
        {"x": 3, "y": 4}) == {"kind": "mouse_down", "x": 3,
                              "y": 4, "button": "left"}
    for bad_kind, bad_params in [
            ("click", {"x": 1, "y": 2, "button": "side"}),
            ("scroll", {"dx": 1, "dy": 1}),
            ("mouse_down", {"x": 1}),
            ("mouse_up", {"x": 1, "y": 1, "button": "x"}),
            ("clipboard_set", {"text": ""}),
            ("clipboard_set", {"x": 1}),
            ("nope", {}), ("click", []),
    ]:
        try:
            check_input_action(bad_kind, bad_params)
        except RemoteInputRefusedError:
            continue
        raise AssertionError(f"accepted {bad_kind}")

"""REMOTE INPUT SLICE 1 tests: real remote mouse movement.

E2E over the real API on tmp DBs (Fase H):

A node zonder remote.mouse -> refused
B offline node -> refused
C supported node -> connect
D invalid coordinate -> refused
E valid movement -> node ontvangt input (poll)
F movement gebruikt alleen allow-listed input operation
G geen shell/subprocess/arbitrary command in de node-adapter
H disconnect stopt verdere input
I onbekende node -> refused
J bestaande node/worker flow blijft groen (regressie apart)
K Digital World blijft werken
L Forge/workspace/research blijven leven (regressie apart)

Plus pure unit tests (sessie/expiry/latest-wins/consume) en een
live Windows-adaptertest die de cursor niet verplaatst (leest de
positie en beweegt erheen terug: echte SetCursorPos, geen effect).
"""

import asyncio
import os
import sqlite3

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.remote_input import (
    REGISTRY,
    RemoteInputGoneError,

)
