<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_voice_approval.py">
"""Voice approval safety tests (BIG #9).

Spoken words decide nothing by themselves: exactly one active
request, unexpired, target still pending with intact binding,
allowed word — and physical kinds never resolve by voice.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.voice_approval import (
    VOICE_APPROVABLE_KINDS,
    VoiceApprovalRefusedError,
    VoiceApprovalRequest,
    load_voice_request,
    mark_voice_resolved,
    normalize_transcript,
    pending_voice_requests,
    resolve_voice_approval,
    save_voice_request,
)


def make_request(**overrides):
    record = {
        "approval_id": "vapr-1", "kind": "write",
        "target_id": "wrt-1", "fingerprint": "ab" * 32,
        "summary": "test", "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
        "expires_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00+00:00",
        "status": "pending",
    }
    record.update(overrides)
    return VoiceApprovalRequest(**record)


def test_exact_yes_word_approves():
    outcome = resolve_voice_approval(
        [make_request()], "YES", kind="write", target_ok=True,
        now_str="2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00")
    assert outcome == {"approved": True, "response": "YES",
                       "approval_id": "vapr-1",
                       "reason": outcome["reason"]}
    outcome = resolve_voice_approval(
        [make_request()], "ja.", kind="mission", target_ok=True,
        now_str="2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00")
    assert outcome["approved"] is True
    outcome = resolve_voice_approval(
        [make_request()], "nee", kind="desktop", target_ok=True,
        now_str="2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00")
    assert outcome == {"approved": False, "response": "NO",
                       "approval_id": "vapr-1",
                       "reason": outcome["reason"]}


def test_casual_speech_never_approves():
    for transcript in ("doe maar", "oke", "ja toch?", "YES PLEASE",
                       "yep", "", "   ", "YES YES"):
        with pytest.raises(VoiceApprovalRefusedError):
            resolve_voice_approval(
                [make_request()], transcript, kind="write",
                target_ok=True,
                now_str="2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00")


def test_no_competing_or_missing_requests():
    with pytest.raises(VoiceApprovalRefusedError,
                       match="no active"):
        resolve_voice_approval([], "YES", kind="write",
                               target_ok=True)
    with pytest.raises(VoiceApprovalRefusedError,
                       match="competing"):
        resolve_voice_approval(
            [make_request(), make_request(approval_id="vapr-2")],
            "YES", kind="write", target_ok=True)


def test_expiry_and_target_binding():
    with pytest.raises(VoiceApprovalRefusedError, match="expired"):
        resolve_voice_approval(
            [make_request()], "YES", kind="write", target_ok=True,
            now_str="2026-02-01T00:00:00+00:00")
    with pytest.raises(VoiceApprovalRefusedError,
                       match="target changed"):
        resolve_voice_approval(
            [make_request()], "YES", kind="write",
            target_ok=False,
            now_str="2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00")


def test_physical_never_by_voice():
    assert "physical" not in VOICE_APPROVABLE_KINDS
    for kind in ("physical", "printer", "shell", ""):
        with pytest.raises(VoiceApprovalRefusedError):
            resolve_voice_approval(
                [make_request(kind="write")], "YES", kind=kind,
                target_ok=True,
                now_str="2026-01-01T12:00:00+00:00")


def test_store_roundtrip(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "vapr.db"))
    assert pending_voice_requests() == []
    assert load_voice_request("vapr-missing") is None
    save_voice_request(make_request())
    assert len(pending_voice_requests()) == 1
    assert load_voice_request("vapr-1").target_id == "wrt-1"
    mark_voice_resolved("vapr-1", "resolved")
    assert pending_voice_requests() == []
    assert load_voice_request("vapr-1").status == "resolved"
    with pytest.raises(VoiceApprovalRefusedError):
        mark_voice_resolved("vapr-1", "shipped")


def test_normalize():
    assert normalize_transcript("  YES. ") == "YES"
    assert normalize_transcript(None) == ""
    assert normalize_transcript(42) == ""

"""Voice tests (BIG #9): STT/TTS abstractions, audio security,
capture sessions, no fabricated audio, no cloud.
"""

import asyncio
import os

import httpx
import pytest

from coordinator.app.voice import (
    LocalSTTProvider,
    TestSTTProvider,
    TestTTSProvider,
    UnavailableSTTProvider,
    UnavailableTTSProvider,
    VoiceRefusedError,
    VoiceUnavailable,
    audio_dir,
    audio_facts,
    check_audio_ref,
    clear_capture_sessions,
    close_capture_session,
    delete_audio,
    get_capture_session,
    get_stt_provider,
    get_tts_provider,
    open_capture_session,
    prune_audio,
    read_audio_bytes,
)


def run(coro):
    return asyncio.run(coro)


def make_clip(name="aud-test1.wav", body=b"RIFF-FAKE\n"):
    path = os.path.join(audio_dir(), name)
    with open(path, "wb") as handle:
        handle.write(body)
    return name


def test_audio_ref_security():
    assert check_audio_ref("aud-x.wav") == "aud-x.wav"
    for evil in ("../x.wav", "..\\x.wav", "/abs/x.wav",
                 "C:\\w\\x.wav", "\\\\host\\x.wav", "x.mp4",
                 "x.txt", "", "x" * 201):
        with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError):
            check_audio_ref(evil)
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError):
        read_audio_bytes("aud-missing.wav")


def test_audio_facts_and_retention():
    ref = make_clip()
    facts = audio_facts(ref)
    assert facts["size_bytes"] > 0
    assert len(facts["sha256"]) == 64
    assert delete_audio(ref) is True
    assert delete_audio(ref) is False
    assert prune_audio() >= 0


def test_oversized_audio_refused():
    from coordinator.app.voice import MAX_AUDIO_BYTES
    path = os.path.join(audio_dir(), "aud-big.wav")
    with open(path, "wb") as handle:
        handle.write(b"\x00" * (MAX_AUDIO_BYTES + 1))
    try:
        with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError, match="max"):
            read_audio_bytes("aud-big.wav")
    finally:
        os.remove(path)


def test_unavailable_providers_refuse():
    with pytest.raises(VoiceUnavailable, match="no automatic"):
        run(get_stt_provider("unavailable").transcribe("aud-x.wav"))
    with pytest.raises(VoiceUnavailable, match="no automatic"):
        run(get_tts_provider("unavailable").synthesize("hoi"))
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError, match="Unknown STT"):
        get_stt_provider("cloud-stt")
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError, match="Unknown TTS"):
        get_tts_provider("cloud-tts")


def test_test_providers_are_marked():
    ref = make_clip("aud-stt1.wav")
    try:
        result = run(TestSTTProvider(
            text="zet de camera aan").transcribe(ref))
        assert result.text == "zet de camera aan"
        assert result.confidence == 0.5
        assert result.provenance.human_verified is False
        assert "test-origin" in result.provenance.notes
        assert "never authorization" in result.provenance.notes
        with pytest.raises(VoiceUnavailable, match="synthetic"):
            run(TestSTTProvider(fail=True).transcribe(ref))
        synthesis = run(TestTTSProvider().synthesize("Hallo Jelles"))
        assert synthesis.audio_ref.endswith(".wav")
        assert synthesis.provenance.human_verified is False
        assert "test-origin" in synthesis.provenance.notes
        with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError):
            run(TestTTSProvider().synthesize("   "))
    finally:
        delete_audio(ref)
        delete_audio("aud-stt1.wav")


def test_local_stt_loops_back():
    ref = make_clip("aud-local1.wav")
    try:
        def handler(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
            assert request.url.path == "/api/transcribe"
            return httpx.Response(200, json={
                "text": "werkbank is rommelig",
                "language": "nl", "confidence": 0.8})

        provider = LocalSTTProvider(
            base_url="http://127.0.0.1:19999", model="test-mdl",
            transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler))
        result = run(provider.transcribe(ref))
        assert result.text == "werkbank is rommelig"
        assert result.language == "nl"
        assert result.provenance.human_verified is False

        def empty(request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"text": "  "})

        with pytest.raises(VoiceUnavailable, match="usable text"):
            run(LocalSTTProvider(
                base_url="http://127.0.0.1:19999", model="m",
                transport=httpx.MockTransport(empty)).transcribe(
                    ref))
    finally:
        delete_audio(ref)


def test_local_stt_boundaries():
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError, match="loopback"):
        LocalSTTProvider(base_url="http://192.168.1.9:9000")
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError, match="set text"):
        LocalSTTProvider(base_url="")
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError, match="Unknown STT"):
        get_stt_provider("Deepgram")


def test_capture_sessions_explicit_only():
    clear_capture_sessions()
    session = open_capture_session("node-phone1", max_seconds=30)
    assert session.status == "open"
    assert get_capture_session(session.session_id) is not None
    ref = make_clip("aud-cap1.wav")
    try:
        closed = close_capture_session(session.session_id, ref)
        assert closed.status == "closed"
        assert closed.audio_ref == ref
        assert close_capture_session(
            session.session_id).status == "closed"
    finally:
        delete_audio(ref)
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError, match="unknown"):
        close_capture_session("cap-missing")
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError):
        open_capture_session("node-phone1", max_seconds=10**9)
    with pytest.raises(VoiceRefusedError):
        open_capture_session("not a node id!!", max_seconds=10)
    clear_capture_sessions()
    assert get_capture_session(session.session_id) is None


def test_no_cloud_or_shell_surface():

                  "pyaudio", "sounddevice", "speech_recognition"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"
    assert "LOOPBACK" in source
    assert "follow_redirects=False" in source

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app import ui as ui_mod


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

                       str(tmp_path / "ui.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_workspaces.py">
"""Project workspaces, vertical slice 1 (E2E).

One project holds many conversations, a conversation forks and each
fork continues on its own, and conversations/missions re-link later —
all on the existing conversations/messages/missions/event tables.
World reads and providers are faked; nothing reaches INVENTory or a
real model.
"""

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance, SearchResult
from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient


class FakeReader:
    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query=q, results=[], total=0)

    async def browse(self, type=None):
        return await self.search("", type)


class FakeProvider:
    async def advise(self, question, records):
        return AdviceResponse(
            question=question, advice="advies zonder voorstel",
            model="fake-local", records_used=len(records), sources=[])


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat-state.db"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader",
                        lambda: FakeReader())
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "get_provider",
                        lambda name=None, **k: FakeProvider())
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def chat(client, message, project_ref="", conversation_id=None):
    body = {"message": message, "project_ref": project_ref}
    if conversation_id:
        body["conversation_id"] = conversation_id
    response = client.post("/api/v1/chat", json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()


def test_one_project_holds_many_conversations(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        first = chat(client, "eerste draad", project_ref="mycelium-ai")
        second = chat(client, "tweede draad", project_ref="mycelium-ai")
        assert first["conversation_id"] != second["conversation_id"]

        response = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces/mycelium-ai")
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        detail = response.json()
        ids = {item["conversation_id"]
               for item in detail["conversations"]}
        assert first["conversation_id"] in ids
        assert second["conversation_id"] in ids
        assert detail["package_href"].startswith(
            "/api/v1/project/package")
        assert detail["context_href"].startswith(
            "/api/v1/context/packet")


def test_fork_continues_independently(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        origin = chat(client, "oorsprong", project_ref="mycelium-ai")
        origin_id = origin["conversation_id"]

        response = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{origin_id}/fork", json={})
        assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
        fork = response.json()
        fork_id = fork["conversation_id"]
        assert fork_id != origin_id
        assert fork["forked_from"] == origin_id
        assert fork["messages_carried"] == 2  # user + assistant

        before = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{origin_id}").json()
        chat(client, "vervolg in fork", conversation_id=fork_id)

        after_origin = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{origin_id}").json()
        after_fork = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{fork_id}").json()
        assert len(after_origin["messages"]) == len(before["messages"])
        assert len(after_fork["messages"]) == len(
            before["messages"]) + 2
        # Provenance survives the fork unchanged (no new claims).
        roles = [item["role"] for item in after_fork["messages"]]
        assert "user" in roles and "assistant" in roles


def test_conversation_relinks_to_same_project(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        home = chat(client, "thuis", project_ref="mycelium-ai")
        stray = chat(client, "verdwaald")
        assert stray["conversation_id"] not in {
            item["conversation_id"] for item in client.get(
                "/api/v1/workspaces/mycelium-ai").json()["conversations"]}

        response = client.post(
            "/api/v1/workspaces/mycelium-ai/conversations/"
            f"{stray['conversation_id']}/attach")
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        assert response.json()["moved"] is True

        ids = {item["conversation_id"] for item in client.get(
            "/api/v1/workspaces/mycelium-ai").json()["conversations"]}
        assert stray["conversation_id"] in ids
        assert home["conversation_id"] in ids

        # Re-attaching to the same workspace is a no-op, not an error.
        again = client.post(
            "/api/v1/workspaces/mycelium-ai/conversations/"
            f"{stray['conversation_id']}/attach")
        assert again.status_code == 200, again.text
        assert again.json()["moved"] is False


def test_mission_relinks_with_unchanged_id(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        first = chat(client, "werk", project_ref="mycelium-ai")
        second = chat(client, "vervolg", project_ref="mycelium-ai")
        created = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": first["conversation_id"],
            "goal": "Onderzoek de werkplaats",
            "steps": [{"kind": "readout",
                       "description": "lees git status",
                       "parameters": {"source": "git-status"}}],
            "max_steps": 5})
        assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
        mission_id = created.json()["mission_id"]

        moved = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workspaces/mycelium-ai/missions/{mission_id}/attach",
            json={"conversation_id": second["conversation_id"]})
        assert moved.status_code == 200, moved.text
        body = moved.json()
        assert body["mission_id"] == mission_id
        assert body["conversation_id"] == second["conversation_id"]
        assert body["workspace_id"] == "mycelium-ai"

        fetched = client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert fetched["conversation_id"] == second["conversation_id"]

        # Wrong workspace in the path refuses: the target lives
        # in mycelium-ai, not in forge-studio.
        refused = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/workspaces/forge-studio/missions/{mission_id}/attach",
            json={"conversation_id": second["conversation_id"]})
        assert refused.status_code == 422, refused.text


def test_seeds_existing_views_and_fail_closed(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        listed = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces").json()
        ids = {item["workspace_id"] for item in listed}
        assert {"mycelium-ai", "inventory", "forge-studio"} <= ids

        forge = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces/forge-studio").json()
        assert forge["href"] == "/forge"
        assert forge["view"]
        inventory = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces/inventory").json()
        assert inventory["href"] == "/projects"

        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/conversations/conv-nope/fork",
            json={}).status_code == 404
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/workspaces/!!-bad/conversations/conv-nope/attach"
        ).status_code in (404, 422)
        bad_mission = client.post(
            "/api/v1/workspaces/mycelium-ai/missions/mission_nope/attach",
            json={"conversation_id": "conv-nope"})
        assert bad_mission.status_code == 404

        # Fork/attach facts land on the existing interface bus.
        origin = chat(client, "ping", project_ref="mycelium-ai")
        client.post(f"/api/v1/conversations/"
                    f"{origin['conversation_id']}/fork", json={})
        events = client.get("/api/v1/events",
                            params={"limit": 50}).json()
        assert any("forked" in item.get("summary", "").lower()
                   for item in events)

        detail = client.get("/workspaces/mycelium-ai")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_workstream.py">
"""Multi-workstream, vertical slice 1 (E2E over existing chain).

One workspace runs independent workstreams side by side: a research
stream (workspace -> conversation -> mission -> fetch task -> worker
-> dossier -> report) next to a Forge stream (conversation fork ->
fabricate mission -> approve -> tick), each claimed/approved/
reported without touching the other. The workstreams view is a
read-only aggregation; workers and the Forge registry are shared
and labelled as such.

World reads and providers are faked; the worker socket is mocked
at the httpx boundary only. Nothing reaches INVENTory, Wikipedia,
Ollama or a real model.
"""

import httpx

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
import node_client.main as node_main
from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

WS = "multi-ws"
QUESTION_A = "Is hennepvezel geschikt als isolatie voor een camper?"
SEED_A = "https://example.com/hennep-multi"
TOKEN_1 = "multi-token-1-abcdef-123456"
TOKEN_2 = "multi-token-2-abcdef-123456"
NODE_1 = "linux-1"
NODE_2 = "linux-2"
FETCHED_TEXT = (
    "Hennepvezel isoleert goed en is dampopen. "
    "Natuurlijk materiaal met hoge warmtecapaciteit.")


class FakeReader:
    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query=q, results=[], total=0)

    async def browse(self, type=None):
        return await self.search("", type)


class FakeProvider:
    async def advise(self, question, records):
        return AdviceResponse(
            question=question, advice="advies zonder voorstel",
            model="fake-local", records_used=len(records), sources=[])


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "chat-state.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "fab"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader",
                        lambda: FakeReader())
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "get_provider",
                        lambda name=None, **k: FakeProvider())
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def register(client, node_id, caps, token):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": caps, "node_token": token})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def chat(client, message, project_ref=WS):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={
        "message": message, "project_ref": project_ref})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
    return response.json()


def mock_socket(monkeypatch, text=FETCHED_TEXT):
    def handler(request):
        return _FakeResponse(
            200, {"content-type": "text/plain; charset=utf-8"},
            text.encode("utf-8"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        httpx, "Client", lambda *a, **k: _MockClient(handler))


class _FakeResponse:
    def __init__(self, status_code, headers, content):
        self.status_code = status_code
        self.headers = headers
        self.content = content


class _MockClient:
    def __init__(self, handler):
        self._handler = handler

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *args):
        return False

    def get(self, url, headers=None):
        from unittest.mock import Mock
        request = Mock(url=url, headers=headers or {})
        return self._handler(request)


def build_two_streams(client):
    """A: research stream. B: conversation + mission + task. Returns ids."""
    register(client, NODE_1, ["research.fetch"], TOKEN_1)
    register(client, NODE_2, ["system_inventory", "research.fetch"],
             TOKEN_2)
    conv_a = chat(client, "draad A")["conversation_id"]
    conv_b = chat(client, "draad B")["conversation_id"]
    forked = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conv_b}/fork", json={}).json()
    # B. Two independent missions in two conversations.
    started = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/research", json={
            "question": QUESTION_A, "route": "node-first",
            "seed_urls": [SEED_A], "conversation_id": conv_a,
            "max_sources": 6})
    assert started.status_code == 201, started.text
    started = started.json()
    mission_b = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": conv_b,
        "goal": "Werkplaats inventariseren",
        "steps": [
            {"kind": "readout", "description": "lees git status",
             "parameters": {"source": "git-status"}},
            {"kind": "proposal",
             "description": "stel opruimplan voor",
             "parameters": {"proposal": "ruim de werkplaats op"}}],
        "max_steps": 5})
    assert mission_b.status_code == 201, mission_b.text
    mission_b = mission_b.json()
    task_b = client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
        "kind": "system_inventory", "payload": {"goal": "inventaris"},
        "required_capabilities": ["system_inventory"],
        "mission_id": mission_b["mission_id"]})
    assert task_b.status_code == 201, task_b.text
    return {
        "conv_a": conv_a, "conv_b": conv_b,
        "conv_fork": forked["conversation_id"],
        "mission_a": started["mission_id"],
        "run_a": started["run_id"],
        "task_a": started["task_ids"][0],
        "mission_b": mission_b["mission_id"],
        "task_b": task_b.json()["id"],
    }


def test_a_workspace_holds_many_conversations(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ids = build_two_streams(client)
        view = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/workspaces/{WS}/workstreams").json()
        assert view["workspace_id"] == WS
        assert {ids["conv_a"], ids["conv_b"],
                ids["conv_fork"]} <= {
            item["conversation_id"]
            for item in view["conversations"]}

def test_e_research_stream_works(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        ids = build_two_streams(client)

        done = client.post(

                    for stream in view["workstreams"]}[ids["mission_a"]]

def test_f_forge_stream_runs_beside_research(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        page = client.get(f"/workspaces/{WS}").text

def test_g_events_show_both_streams(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_world_areas.py">
"""Area grouping derivation for /world (contains/part_of only).

Pure-function tests over graph payloads: no database, no server,
no coordinates invented. Direction, filtering and bounds only.
"""
from coordinator.app.main import (
    MAX_AREAS,
    MAX_AREA_MEMBERS,
    _world_areas,
)


def _node(id, label="", type="object"):
    return {"id": id, "type": type, "label": label or id,
            "source": "inventory", "metadata": {}}


def _edge(frm, predicate, to):
    return {"from": frm, "predicate": predicate, "to": to,
            "provenance": {}}


def test_contains_flows_area_to_member():
    graph = {"nodes": [_node("loc_a", "Werkplaats", "location"),
                       _node("obj_1", "Moer")],
             "edges": [_edge("loc_a", "contains", "obj_1")]}
    assert _world_areas(graph) == [
        {"id": "loc_a", "label": "Werkplaats", "members": ["obj_1"]}]


def test_part_of_flows_member_to_area():
    graph = {"nodes": [_node("loc_a", "Werkplaats", "location"),
                       _node("obj_1", "Moer")],
             "edges": [_edge("obj_1", "part_of", "loc_a")]}
    assert _world_areas(graph) == [
        {"id": "loc_a", "label": "Werkplaats", "members": ["obj_1"]}]


def test_other_predicates_never_become_areas():
    graph = {"nodes": [_node("obj_1", "Moer"), _node("obj_2", "Bout")],
             "edges": [_edge("obj_1", "related_to", "obj_2"),
                       _edge("obj_1", "uses", "obj_2"),
                       _edge("obj_2", "led_to", "obj_1")]}
    assert _world_areas(graph) == []


def test_unknown_members_self_loops_and_empty_drop_out():
    graph = {"nodes": [_node("loc_a", "Werkplaats", "location"),
                       _node("obj_1", "Moer")],
             "edges": [_edge("loc_a", "contains", "obj_ghost"),
                       _edge("loc_a", "contains", "loc_a"),
                       _edge("loc_empty", "contains", "obj_ghost")]}
    assert _world_areas(graph) == []
    assert _world_areas({"nodes": [], "edges": []}) == []
    assert _world_areas({}) == []


def test_label_falls_back_to_id_and_output_bounded():
    nodes = [_node(f"obj_{i}") for i in range(5)]
    edges = [_edge("loc_x", "contains", f"obj_{i}") for i in range(5)]
    areas = _world_areas({"nodes": nodes, "edges": edges})
    assert areas[0]["label"] == "loc_x"[:24]
    big = {"nodes": [_node(f"m_{i}") for i in range(MAX_AREA_MEMBERS + 10)],
           "edges": [_edge("loc_big", "contains", f"m_{i}")
                     for i in range(MAX_AREA_MEMBERS + 10)]}
    assert len(_world_areas(big)[0]["members"]) == MAX_AREA_MEMBERS
    many = {"nodes": [_node("obj_1")],
            "edges": [_edge(f"loc_{i}", "contains", "obj_1")
                      for i in range(MAX_AREAS + 10)]}
    assert len(_world_areas(many)) == MAX_AREAS

"""World observations: multi-node perception without ownership.
Create/list/validation, confidence bounds, prefix refusal, two
nodes sharing one entity, observations in Hermes context, spatial
z, screen observations."""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.hermes_npc as npc_mod
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


def api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "wobs.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "wobs-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", "wobs-operator")
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:9")
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_create_and_list(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        made = test_client.post("/api/v1/world/observations", json={
            "node_id": "seed-01", "source": "camera",
            "entity_ref": "obj_abc123", "x": 100.5, "y": 200.0,
            "confidence": 0.8, "note": "soldeerbout op werkbank",
            "provenance": {"by": "mos"}})
        assert made.status_code == 201, made.text
        body = made.json()
        assert body["obs_id"].startswith("wobs_")
        assert body["node_id"] == "seed-01"
        assert body["entity_ref"] == "obj_abc123"
        assert body["confidence"] == 0.8
        listed = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/world/observations").json()
        assert listed["total"] == 1
        assert listed["observations"][0]["obs_id"] == body["obs_id"]


def test_validation(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        base = {"node_id": "seed-01", "source": "camera"}
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            json={**base}).status_code == 201  # minimal ok
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            json={"source": "camera"}).status_code == 422  # no node
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            json={"node_id": "seed-01"}).status_code == 422  # no source
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            json={**base, "source": "telepathy"}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            json={**base, "confidence": 1.5}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            json={**base, "confidence": -0.1}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            json={**base, "x": 1}).status_code == 422  # half position
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            json={**base, "note": "x" * 501}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations", json="nope").status_code == 422


def test_invalid_entity_prefix_refused_unknown_allowed(tmp_path,
                                                       monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        bad = test_client.post("/api/v1/world/observations", json={
            "node_id": "seed-01", "source": "node",
            "entity_ref": "dragon-9"})
        assert bad.status_code == 422
        # unknown but well-formed ref is fine: the world is

        ok = test_client.post("/api/v1/world/observations", json={
            "node_id": "seed-01", "source": "node",
            "entity_ref": "obj_nonexistent000"})
        assert ok.status_code == 201, ok.text


def test_two_nodes_share_one_entity_no_ownership(tmp_path,
                                                 monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        first = test_client.post("/api/v1/world/observations",
                                 json={"node_id": "seed-01",
                                       "source": "camera",
                                       "entity_ref": "obj_shared1",
                                       "confidence": 0.6}).json()
        second = test_client.post("/api/v1/world/observations",
                                  json={"node_id": "seed-02",
                                        "source": "screen",
                                        "entity_ref": "obj_shared1",
                                        "confidence": 0.9}).json()
        assert first["obs_id"] != second["obs_id"]
        shared = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            params={"entity_ref": "obj_shared1"}).json()
        assert shared["total"] == 2
        nodes = {row["node_id"] for row in shared["observations"]}
        assert nodes == {"seed-01", "seed-02"}
        # no owner field anywhere
        for row in shared["observations"]:
            assert "owner" not in row
        only_one = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            params={"node_id": "seed-02"}).json()
        assert only_one["total"] == 1

def test_spatial_z_optional_but_needs_xy(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ok = test_client.post("/api/v1/world/observations", json={
            "node_id": "seed-01", "source": "node",
            "entity_ref": "obj_room1", "x": 1.5, "y": 2.5,
            "z": 0.75})

        assert ok.json()["z"] == 0.75

        assert bad.status_code == 422


def test_screen_observation_uses_existing_image_rule(tmp_path,
                                                     monkeypatch):
    for test_client in api(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ok = test_client.post("/api/v1/world/observations/screen",
                              json={"node_id": "laptop-01",
                                    "width": 1920, "height": 1080,
                                    "image_ref": "obs-abc.bmp",
                                    "active_window": "editor",
                                    "entity_ref": "obj_desk1",
                                    "confidence": 0.6,
                                    "note": "soldering station"})
        assert ok.status_code == 201, ok.text
        body = ok.json()
        assert body["source"] == "screen"
        assert body["media_ref"] == "obs-abc.bmp"
        assert body["provenance"]["active_window"] == "editor"
        # no pixels uploaded: paths, URLs and schemes refuse
        for bad_ref in ("../evil.bmp", "http://x/y.png",
                        "C:\\win\\a.bmp", "shot.tiff", ""):
            bad = test_client.post(
                "/api/v1/world/observations/screen",
                json={"node_id": "laptop-01", "width": 10,
                      "height": 10, "image_ref": bad_ref})
            assert bad.status_code == 422, bad_ref
        # width/height must be real integers
        bad_dims = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/world/observations/screen",
            json={"node_id": "laptop-01", "width": "veel",
                  "height": 10, "image_ref": "obs-abc.bmp"})
        assert bad_dims.status_code == 422
        # screen rows list through the same endpoint
        listed = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/world/observations",
            params={"node_id": "laptop-01"}).json()
        assert listed["total"] >= 1
        assert listed["observations"][0]["source"] == "screen"

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_world_proxy.py">
"""Tests for the M5.2 read-only world proxy (coordinator world routes).

The InventoryReader is replaced with fakes; no real INVENTory server, no real
network. Coordinator database tables must stay untouched by world routes.
"""
import os

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import (
    EntityRecord,
    GraphResponse,
    InventoryRefusedError,
    InventoryUnavailable,
    SearchResponse,
)

PROV = {"source_type": "sensor-observed", "creator_id": "bridge-test",
        "human_verified": False}


class FakeReader:
    """Stand-in for InventoryReader; records delegated calls."""

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.calls = []
        self.behavior = "ok"

    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        self.calls.append(("search", q, type))
        if self.behavior == "unavailable":
            raise InventoryUnavailable("down")
        if self.behavior == "refused":
            raise InventoryRefusedError("nope")
        return SearchResponse(query=q, total=1, results=[{
            "entity_type": "object", "entity_id": "obj_1", "title": "Moer",
            "snippet": "rvs", "provenance": PROV}])

    async def get(self, entity_type, entity_id):
        self.calls.append(("get", entity_type, entity_id))
        if self.behavior == "unavailable":
            raise InventoryUnavailable("down")
        if self.behavior == "refused":
            raise InventoryRefusedError("nope")
        if self.behavior == "missing":
            return None
        return EntityRecord(entity_type=entity_type, entity_id=entity_id,
                            title="Moer", provenance=PROV,
                            details={"quantity": 2})

    async def graph(self, entity_id, depth=1):
        self.calls.append(("graph", entity_id, depth))
        if self.behavior == "unavailable":
            raise InventoryUnavailable("down")
        if self.behavior == "refused":
            raise InventoryRefusedError("nope")
        return GraphResponse(entity_id=entity_id, depth=depth, nodes=[{
            "entity_type": "object", "entity_id": entity_id,
            "title": "Moer", "provenance": PROV}], edges=[{
            "id": "rel_1", "from_id": entity_id, "predicate": "used_in",
            "to_id": "proj_1", "metadata": {}, "provenance": PROV}])


@pytest.fixture()
def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "proxy.db")
    fake = FakeReader()
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "InventoryReader", lambda *a, **k: fake)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        test_client.fake_reader = fake
        yield test_client


def test_world_search_delegates(client):
    res = client.get("/api/v1/world/search", params={"q": "moer", "type": "objects"})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert client.fake_reader.calls == [("search", "moer", "objects")]
    data = res.json()
    assert data["total"] == 1
    assert data["results"][0]["entity_id"] == "obj_1"
    assert data["results"][0]["provenance"]["source_type"] == "sensor-observed"
    assert data["results"][0]["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False


def test_world_entity_delegates(client):
    res = client.get("/api/v1/world/entity/project/proj_9")
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert client.fake_reader.calls == [("get", "project", "proj_9")]
    data = res.json()
    assert data["entity_id"] == "proj_9"
    assert data["details"] == {"quantity": 2}


def test_world_entity_missing_is_404(client):
    client.fake_reader.behavior = "missing"
    res = client.get("/api/v1/world/entity/object/obj_nope")
    assert res.status_code == 404


def test_world_graph_delegates(client):
    res = client.get("/api/v1/world/graph",
                     params={"entity_id": "obj_1", "depth": 2})
    assert res.status_code == 200
    assert client.fake_reader.calls == [("graph", "obj_1", 2)]
    data = res.json()
    assert len(data["nodes"]) == 1
    assert data["edges"][0]["predicate"] == "used_in"
    assert data["edges"][0]["provenance"]["source_type"] == "sensor-observed"

    assert client.get("/api/v1/world/entity/object/obj_1").status_code == 422

    """Real reader validation still guards the proxy (non-loopback env)."""

        assert db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tasks").fetchone()[0] == 0

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_world_workspace.py">
"""Workspace scoping for /world (roots + 1-hop closure, no model).

Pure filter tests need no database. Store-backed tests use tmp
databases: workspace roots come from existing conversations,
missions, context records and research links only.
"""
import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.main import (
    _world_quest_trails_html,
    _world_workspace_filter,
    _world_workspace_roots,
)


def _node(id, type="object", label="", project_ref=""):
    metadata = {}
    if project_ref:
        metadata["project_ref"] = project_ref
    return {"id": id, "type": type, "label": label or id,
            "source": "inventory", "metadata": metadata}


def _edge(frm, predicate, to):
    return {"from": frm, "predicate": predicate, "to": to,
            "provenance": {}}


def _graph():
    return {
        "nodes": [_node("proj_camper", "project", "Camper"),
                  _node("obj_moer", "object", "Moer"),
                  _node("loc_werk", "location", "Werkplaats"),
                  _node("obj_far", "object", "Far"),
                  _node("mem_1", "memory", "Notitie",
                         project_ref="camper")],
        "edges": [_edge("loc_werk", "contains", "obj_moer"),
                  _edge("proj_camper", "part_of", "loc_werk"),
                  _edge("obj_far", "related_to", "obj_moer"),
                  _edge("mem_1", "remembers", "obj_moer")],
    }


def test_filter_keeps_roots_and_closure():
    out = _world_workspace_filter(_graph(), "camper", {"proj_camper"})
    ids = {node["id"] for node in out["nodes"]}
    assert "proj_camper" in ids  # root
    assert "loc_werk" in ids  # neighbour via part_of edge
    assert "mem_1" in ids  # metadata.project_ref == wid
    assert "obj_moer" in ids  # neighbour via mem_1 remembers edge
    assert "obj_far" not in ids  # only reachable past kept nodes


def test_filter_project_ref_overlay_is_root():
    out = _world_workspace_filter(_graph(), "camper", set())
    ids = {node["id"] for node in out["nodes"]}
    assert "mem_1" in ids
    assert "obj_moer" in ids  # neighbour via remembers edge
    assert "proj_camper" not in ids
    assert "loc_werk" not in ids
    assert "obj_far" not in ids


def test_filter_edges_need_both_ends():
    out = _world_workspace_filter(_graph(), "camper", {"proj_camper"})
    pairs = {(edge["from"], edge["to"]) for edge in out["edges"]}
    assert ("proj_camper", "loc_werk") in pairs
    assert not any("obj_far" in pair for pair in pairs)
    # original dict untouched
    assert len(_graph()["edges"]) == 4


def test_filter_empty_graph_and_empty_roots():
    assert _world_workspace_filter(
        {"nodes": [], "edges": []}, "camper", set()) == {
            "nodes": [], "edges": []}
    out = _world_workspace_filter(_graph(), "camper", set())
    # only project_ref overlay root + its neighbour
    assert {node["id"] for node in out["nodes"]} == {
        "mem_1", "obj_moer"}


def _seed_quests():
    from coordinator.app.quests import new_quest, save_quest
    save_quest(new_quest("Inside quest", [
        {"key": "s1", "label": "Pak moer", "kind": "entity",
         "ref": "obj_moer"}]))
    save_quest(new_quest("Outside quest", [
        {"key": "s1", "label": "Pak ver ding", "kind": "entity",

"""World-graph foundation tests (BIG #4, §21).

Uniform node/edge projection, type allow-lists, depth bounds,
mission/agent overlay, caps, and the HTTP endpoint.
"""

import os

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import (
    GraphEdge, GraphNode, Provenance,
)
from coordinator.app.worldgraph import build_world_graph


def run(coro):
    import asyncio
    return asyncio.run(coro)


class FakeReader:
    def __init__(self, nodes=None, edges=None, fail=None):
        self._nodes = nodes or []
        self._edges = edges or []
        self._fail = fail

    async def graph(self, entity_id, depth=1):
        if self._fail:
            raise self._fail
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import GraphResponse
        return GraphResponse(entity_id=entity_id, depth=depth,
                             nodes=list(self._nodes),
                             edges=list(self._edges))


def node(entity_id, kind="object", title="Ding"):
    return GraphNode(entity_type=kind, entity_id=entity_id, title=title,
                     provenance=Provenance(human_verified=True))


def test_projection_and_type_filter():
    reader = FakeReader(
        nodes=[node("obj_1"), node("weird", kind="quantum")],
        edges=[GraphEdge(id="rel_1", from_id="obj_1", predicate="used_in",
                         to_id="proj_2", provenance=Provenance())])
    graph = run(build_world_graph(reader, "obj_1", 1))
    ids = {entry["id"] for entry in graph["nodes"]}
    assert "obj_1" in ids and "weird" not in ids
    assert graph["edges"][0]["predicate"] == "used_in"
    assert graph["nodes"][0]["source"] == "inventory"
    assert graph["nodes"][0]["metadata"]["human_verified"] is True


def test_depth_bounded_and_unavailable_propagates():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run(build_world_graph(FakeReader(), "obj_1", 9))
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import InventoryUnavailable
    with pytest.raises(InventoryUnavailable):
        run(build_world_graph(
            FakeReader(fail=InventoryUnavailable("down")), "obj_1", 1))


def test_mission_and_agent_overlay(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "g.db"))
    from coordinator.app.missions import new_mission, save_mission
    mission = new_mission("mission_g", "conv-1", "doel", [
        {"kind": "readout", "description": "x",
         "parameters": {"source": "project"}}],
        context_records=[{"entity_id": "obj_1"}])
    save_mission(mission)
    reader = FakeReader(nodes=[node("obj_1")])
    graph = run(build_world_graph(
        reader, "obj_1", 1, include_missions=True,
        agent_nodes=[{"node_id": "desktop_1",
                      "capabilities": ["agent:desktop"]},
                     {"node_id": "", "capabilities": []}]))
    by_id = {entry["id"]: entry for entry in graph["nodes"]}
    assert by_id["mission_g"]["type"] == "mission"
    assert by_id["mission_g"]["source"] == "mycelium"
    assert by_id["desktop_1"]["type"] == "agent"
    assert any(edge["predicate"] == "uses_context"
               for edge in graph["edges"])


def test_graph_endpoint(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "g.db")
    os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "g-chat.db")

    class EndpointReader(FakeReader):
        async def graph(self, entity_id, depth=1):
            from coordinator.app.inventory_read import (
                GraphResponse, InventoryRefusedError)
            if not entity_id.startswith("obj_"):
                raise InventoryRefusedError("bad prefix")
            return GraphResponse(
                entity_id=entity_id, depth=depth,
                nodes=[node("obj_1")], edges=[])

    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "InventoryReader",
                        lambda *a, **k: EndpointReader())
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        ok_response = test_client.get("/api/v1/graph",
                                      params={"entity_id": "obj_1"})
        assert ok_response.status_code == 200, ok_response.text
        assert ok_response.json()["nodes"][0]["id"] == "obj_1"
        assert test_client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={
            "entity_id": "obj_1", "depth": 9}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={
            "entity_id": "nope"}).status_code == 422

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_write_api.py">
"""Write/verify HTTP API tests (BIG #5).

Full chain over the coordinator routes with a faked INVENTory:
propose -> approve -> execute -> verify, plus gate enforcement
(409/422) and the project package endpoint.
"""

import json
import os

import httpx
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


class FakeStore:
    def __init__(self):
        self.objects: dict = {}
        self.counter = 0

    def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        path = request.url.path
        if request.method == "POST" and path == "/api/v1/objects":
            body = json.loads(request.content.decode())
            self.counter += 1
            entity_id = f"obj_api{self.counter:03d}"
            record = {"id": entity_id, "name": body["name"],
                      "description": body.get("description", ""),
                      "quantity": body.get("quantity", 1),
                      "provenance": body.get("provenance", {}),
                      "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                      "updated_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"}
            self.objects[entity_id] = record
            return httpx.Response(201, json=record)
        if path.startswith("/api/v1/objects/"):
            entity_id = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            record = self.objects.get(entity_id)
            if record is None:
                return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "no"})
            if request.method == "PATCH":
                body = json.loads(request.content.decode())
                for key in ("name", "description", "quantity"):
                    if key in body:
                        record[key] = body[key]
            return httpx.Response(200, json=record)
        if request.method == "GET":
            return httpx.Response(200, json=[])
        return httpx.Response(404, json={"detail": "no route"})


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    store = FakeStore()
    transport = httpx.MockTransport(store.handler)
    os.environ["MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(tmp_path / "w.db")
    os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"] = str(
        tmp_path / "w-chat.db")
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import InventoryReader
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import InventoryWriter
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader",
                        lambda: InventoryReader(transport=transport))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "InventoryWriter",
                        lambda *a, **k: InventoryWriter(
                            transport=transport))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_full_chain_propose_approve_execute_verify(tmp_path,
                                                   monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/inventory", json={
            "proposal_id": "wrt-api1", "mutation": "create",
            "entity_type": "object",
            "fields": {"name": "API bout", "quantity": 7}})
        assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
        assert created.json()["status"] == "proposed"
        assert len(created.json()["fingerprint"]) == 64

        # Execute before approval is refused.
        early = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/wrt-api1/execute")
        assert early.status_code == 409

        approved = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-api1/approve",
            json={"response": "YES", "decided_by": "jelles"})
        assert approved.status_code == 200, approved.text
        assert approved.json()["status"] == "approved"

        # Second decision is refused (exactly-once approval).
        again = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-api1/approve",
            json={"response": "YES"})
        assert again.status_code == 409

        executed = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/wrt-api1/execute")
        assert executed.status_code == 200, executed.text
        body = executed.json()
        assert body["status"] == "executed"
        assert body["result"]["after"]["title"] == "API bout"
        assert body["result"]["provenance"]["human_verified"] is False

        verified = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/wrt-api1/verify")
        assert verified.status_code == 200, verified.text
        vbody = verified.json()
        assert vbody["verification"]["outcome"] == "passed"

        # Repeat calls are idempotent reads, not re-executions.
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-api1/execute").status_code == 200
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-api1/verify").status_code == 200


def test_rejection_blocks_execution(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/inventory", json={
            "proposal_id": "wrt-api2", "mutation": "create",
            "entity_type": "object", "fields": {"name": "x"}})
        assert created.status_code == 201
        denied = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-api2/approve",
            json={"response": "nee"})
        assert denied.json()["status"] == "rejected"
        refused = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/wrt-api2/execute")
        assert refused.status_code == 409


def test_invalid_mutation_refused_at_proposal(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        response = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/inventory", json={
            "proposal_id": "wrt-api3", "mutation": "delete",
            "entity_type": "object", "fields": {}})
        assert response.status_code == 422
        smuggled = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/inventory", json={
            "proposal_id": "wrt-api4", "mutation": "create",
            "entity_type": "object",
            "fields": {"name": "x",
                       "provenance": {"source_type": "ai-generated",
                                      "creator_id": "qwen",
                                      "human_verified": True}}})
        assert smuggled.status_code == 422


def test_verify_before_execute_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/inventory", json={
            "proposal_id": "wrt-api5", "mutation": "create",
            "entity_type": "object", "fields": {"name": "x"}})
        test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/wrt-api5/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES"})
        response = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/wrt-api5/verify")
        assert response.status_code == 409


def test_unknown_proposal_is_404(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-missing").status_code == 404


def test_project_package_endpoint(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        response = test_client.get("/api/v1/project/package",
                                   params={"q": "bout"})

        assert body["name"]
        assert "entities" in body

        assert len(body["entities"]) <= 10

"""Mission write-step tests (BIG #5).

Write steps bind to exactly one stored write proposal. The
executor never writes itself: without a wired capability the
step BLOCKs; unapproved writes BLOCK; executed-but-unverified
writes complete the step WITHOUT verification; verified writes
complete WITH it.
"""

import asyncio

import pytest

from coordinator.app.mission_executor import ExecutorDeps, MissionExecutor
from coordinator.app.missions import (
    new_event,
    new_mission,
    save_mission,
)


def run(coro):
    return asyncio.run(coro)


def ai_provenance() -> Provenance:
    return Provenance(source_type="ai-generated", creator_id="t",
                      human_verified=False)


def make_deps(run_write=None):
    async def _advise(question, records):
        raise AssertionError("no advisor in write tests")

    async def _search(query):
        return []

    return ExecutorDeps(
        propose_desktop=lambda *a: (_ for _ in ()).throw(
            AssertionError("no desktop in write tests")),
        load_desktop=lambda action_id: None,
        post_message=lambda *a: "msg-1",
        advise=_advise,
        inventory_search=_search,
        git_read=lambda source: {},
        project_read=lambda: {},
        run_write=run_write,
    )


def make_mission(tmp_path, monkeypatch, proposal_id="wrt-m1"):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "missions.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "missions-chat.db"))
    mission = new_mission(
        "mission_write1", "conv-1", "Leg een bout vast",
        [{"kind": "write", "description": "Maak object aan",
          "parameters": {"proposal_id": proposal_id}}])
    # Approve the plan so tick() may run.
    from coordinator.app.missions import approve_mission
    mission = approve_mission(mission, "YES")
    mission = mission.model_copy(update={"status": "running"})
    save_mission(mission)
    return mission


def test_write_step_kind_validates_proposal_binding():
    mission = new_mission(
        "mission_x", "conv-1", "doel",
        [{"kind": "write", "description": "x",
          "parameters": {"proposal_id": "wrt-1"}}])
    assert mission.steps[0].kind == "write"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="proposal_id"):
        new_mission("mission_y", "conv-1", "doel",
                    [{"kind": "write", "description": "x",
                      "parameters": {}}])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="only proposal_id"):
        new_mission("mission_z", "conv-1", "doel",
                    [{"kind": "write", "description": "x",
                      "parameters": {"proposal_id": "wrt-1",
                                     "sql": "DROP"}}])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="step-level approval"):
        new_mission("mission_w", "conv-1", "doel",
                    [{"kind": "write", "description": "x",
                      "parameters": {"proposal_id": "wrt-1"},
                      "requires_approval": True}])


def test_write_step_without_capability_blocks(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    mission = make_mission(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    executor = MissionExecutor(make_deps(run_write=None))
    summary = run(executor.tick(mission.mission_id))
    assert summary["status"] == "blocked"

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_write_security.py">
"""Cross-cutting security tests for BIG #5.

Each test pins one architectural rule from the BIG brief. They
are intentionally redundant with the module tests: security
properties deserve their own tripwire file.
"""

import pathlib

import pytest

APP = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "coordinator" / "app"


def source_of(*names: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join(
        (APP / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8") for name in names)


def test_no_shell_or_process_execution_in_write_layer():
    source = source_of("controlled_writes.py", "inventory_writes.py",
                       "verification.py", "project_package.py")
    for token in ("subprocess", "os.system", "os.popen", "shell=True",
                  "eval(", "exec(", "__import__"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_no_sql_in_write_layer():
    source = source_of("controlled_writes.py", "inventory_writes.py",
                       "verification.py", "project_package.py",
                       "git_commit.py")
    for token in ("sqlite3", "SELECT ", "INSERT ", "UPDATE ", "DELETE ",
                  "DROP ", "ALTER "):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_no_direct_database_writes_from_mycelium():
    """Mycelium never imports INVENTory database code."""
    source = source_of("controlled_writes.py", "inventory_writes.py",
                       "verification.py", "git_commit.py",
                       "project_package.py", "main.py")
    assert "inventory.app" not in source
    # The write path reaches INVENTory exclusively over HTTP.
    assert "httpx" in source_of("inventory_writes.py")


def test_git_module_has_no_push_or_remote_capability():
    source = source_of("git_commit.py")
    for token in ('"push"', "'push'", "clone", "remote",
                  "getpass", "keyring",
                  "shell=True", "os.system", "eval(",
                  "Authorization", "credential.helper"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_ai_cannot_set_human_verified_anywhere():
    from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import propose_write
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import propose_inventory_write
    ai_claim = Provenance(source_type="ai-generated",
                          creator_id="model",
                          human_verified=True)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        propose_write("wrt-s1", "inventory.create", "t", {},
                      actor="m", provenance=ai_claim)
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        propose_inventory_write(
            "wrt-s2", "create", "object", {"name": "x"}, actor="m",
            provenance=ai_claim)

        decide_write,

        VerificationResult,

def test_no_credential_handling_in_new_modules():
    source = source_of("controlled_writes.py", "inventory_writes.py",
                       "verification.py", "git_commit.py",
                       "project_package.py")
    for token in ("Authorization", "Bearer ", "getpass", "keyring",
                  "client_secret", "private_key"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_project_package_drops_secret_like_keys(tmp_path):
    from coordinator.app.project_context import ProjectContext
    from coordinator.app.project_package import build_project_package
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance
    project = ProjectContext(
        project_id="prj-s", name="s", repository=str(tmp_path),
        working_directory=str(tmp_path),
        provenance=Provenance(source_type="user-created",
                              creator_id="human",
                              human_verified=True))
    package = build_project_package(
        project,
        entities=[{"entity_type": "object", "entity_id": "obj_1",
                   "title": "t", "snippet": "s",
                   "api_token": "LEK",
                   "provenance": {"source_type": "user-created",
                                  "human_verified": True}}])
    assert "LEK" not in str(package)
