<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/agent_loop.py">
"""Desktop-agent task loop: observe -> propose -> approve -> act (Fase I).

The loop is deliberately slow and explicit. A ComputerAction starts as
pending_approval (or approved-by-policy for read-only actions),
waits for an exact human YES, may then be dispatched exactly once,
and closes with exactly one AgentActionResult. The operator can stop
the loop at any moment: cancel works from pending_approval and from
approved, and a dispatched action that never reports back stays
visible as dispatched — never silently completed.

This module is pure: transitions validate and return new records,
they never touch the database, the clock beyond an injected stamp,
or any desktop. Storage lives in the coordinator ``desktop_actions``
table (see database.py); HTTP mapping lives in main.py.

States: pending_approval -> approved -> dispatched ->
         completed | failed | blocked
         pending_approval -> rejected | cancelled
         approved -> cancelled

Rules (all tested, all fail-closed):

- only exact "YES" approves and only exact "NO" deliberately rejects
  (same words as the M6.3 gate, reused constants, no second dialect).
- decisions bind to one action_id; mismatches are refused.
- dispatch requires status approved; results require dispatched.
- exactly one terminal state; terminal records never transition.
- results reuse agent_results validation, so completed/false-error
  and error-less failure combinations are impossible.
"""

from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .agent_results import AgentActionResult, new_result
from .approval import APPROVE_TEXT, REJECT_TEXT
from .computer_actions import ComputerAction
from .inventory_read import Provenance

ActionStatus = Literal[
    "pending_approval", "approved", "rejected", "cancelled",
    "dispatched", "completed", "failed", "blocked",
]
TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset(
    {"rejected", "cancelled", "completed", "failed", "blocked"})

#: Desktop dispatch lease, mirroring the task queue: a
#: dispatched action must report back inside this window or
#: lose the lease (expiry returns it to approved while
#: attempts remain, blocks it when exhausted).
DESKTOP_LEASE_SECONDS = 300
DESKTOP_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3


class DesktopActionRecord(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    action: ComputerAction
    status: str = "pending_approval"
    decided_by: str = ""
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    result: AgentActionResult | None = None
    dispatched_by: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    dispatched_at: str = ""
    lease_until: str = ""
    attempt_count: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)


def propose(action: ComputerAction) -> DesktopActionRecord:
    """Open the loop for one validated action.

    Read-only actions (screenshot/wait) arrive pre-approved by policy;
    every input action waits for a human YES.
    """
    if not isinstance(action, ComputerAction):
        raise ValueError("Agent loop needs a ComputerAction")
    if action.requires_approval:
        status = "pending_approval"
        decided = ""
    else:
        status = "approved"
        decided = "policy:read-only-local"
    return DesktopActionRecord(
        action=action,
        status=status,
        decided_by=decided,
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="ai-generated" if action.requires_approval
            else "user-created",
            creator_id="desktop-agent-loop",
            human_verified=False,
        ),
    )


def _bind(record: DesktopActionRecord, action_id: str) -> None:
    if record.action.action_id != action_id:
        raise ValueError("Decision does not belong to this action")


def decide(record: DesktopActionRecord, action_id: str, response: str,
           decided_by: str = "human") -> DesktopActionRecord:
    """Resolve raw human input: exact YES approves, anything else denies."""
    _bind(record, action_id)
    if record.status != "pending_approval":
        raise ValueError(
            f"Action is {record.status}; only pending actions decide")
    if not isinstance(decided_by, str) or not decided_by.strip():
        raise ValueError("decided_by must be non-empty text")
    if response == APPROVE_TEXT:
        return record.model_copy(update={
            "status": "approved", "decided_by": decided_by.strip(),
            "note": ""})
    if response == REJECT_TEXT:
        return record.model_copy(update={
            "status": "rejected", "decided_by": decided_by.strip(),
            "note": "human answered NO"})
    return record.model_copy(update={
        "status": "rejected", "decided_by": decided_by.strip(),
        "note": "unrecognized response; default deny"})


def cancel(record: DesktopActionRecord, action_id: str,
           decided_by: str = "human") -> DesktopActionRecord:
    """Stop boundary: works from pending_approval, approved AND
    dispatched (lease revocation). Terminal records never cancel.

    Cancelling a dispatched action revokes the lease: the agent's
    pre-execution revalidation sees it and BLOCKS, and a late result
    is refused by the conditional update. An already-performed input
    cannot be un-done — cancellation prevents the NEXT input.
    """
    _bind(record, action_id)
    if record.status not in ("pending_approval", "approved", "dispatched"):
        raise ValueError(
            f"Action is {record.status}; only waiting or dispatched "
            "actions cancel")
    if not isinstance(decided_by, str) or not decided_by.strip():
        raise ValueError("decided_by must be non-empty text")
    return record.model_copy(update={
        "status": "cancelled", "decided_by": decided_by.strip(),
        "note": "stopped by operator"})


def dispatch(record: DesktopActionRecord, action_id: str,
             by: str = "", at: str = "") -> DesktopActionRecord:
    """Release one approved action to one local runtime. Exactly once.

    ``by`` pins the lease holder (node/agent id). An empty holder
    means a manual local dispatch with no remote owner; the standalone
    agent only executes actions dispatched to itself. Dispatch stamps
    a lease deadline (DESKTOP_LEASE_SECONDS past ``at``) and counts
    the attempt; exhausted records refuse re-dispatch and must be
    blocked by expiry instead.
    """
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
    _bind(record, action_id)
    if record.status != "approved":
        raise ValueError(
            f"Action is {record.status}; only approved actions dispatch")
    if by and (not isinstance(by, str) or len(by) > 80):
        raise ValueError("dispatch owner must be 0..80 characters")
    if record.attempt_count >= DESKTOP_MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Action used all {DESKTOP_MAX_ATTEMPTS} attempts; "
            "it stays blocked, never silently retried")
    try:
        moment = datetime.fromisoformat(at) if at else \
            datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        if moment.tzinfo is None:
            moment = moment.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        raise ValueError("dispatch needs a readable timestamp")
    lease_until = (moment + timedelta(
        seconds=DESKTOP_LEASE_SECONDS)).isoformat()
    return record.model_copy(update={"status": "dispatched",
                                     "dispatched_by": by or "",
                                     "dispatched_at": moment.isoformat(),
                                     "lease_until": lease_until,
                                     "attempt_count":
                                     record.attempt_count + 1})


def record_result(record: DesktopActionRecord, action_id: str,
                  status: str, *,
                  error: str = "",
                  observation_reference: str = "") -> DesktopActionRecord:
    """Close a dispatched action with exactly one validated result."""
    _bind(record, action_id)
    if record.status != "dispatched":
        raise ValueError(
            f"Action is {record.status}; only dispatched actions close")
    result = new_result(action_id, status, error=error,
                        observation_reference=observation_reference)
    terminal = {"completed": "completed", "failed": "failed",
                "blocked": "blocked", "cancelled": "cancelled"}[status]
    return record.model_copy(update={"status": terminal, "result": result})


def describe(record: DesktopActionRecord) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Operator-facing summary: what the agent wants / does / did."""
    return {
        "action_id": record.action.action_id,
        "action_type": record.action.action_type,
        "parameters": record.action.parameters,
        "status": record.status,
        "decided_by": record.decided_by,
        "note": record.note,
        "dispatched_by": record.dispatched_by,
        "dispatched_at": record.dispatched_at,
        "lease_until": record.lease_until,
        "attempt_count": record.attempt_count,
        "result": (record.result.model_dump(mode="json")
                   if record.result else None),
    }
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/cad.py">
"""CAD foundation (BIG #11-15, Phase 4).

CadDocument → parts → parametric operations → derived mesh.
External CAD executors (OpenSCAD/FreeCAD/Blender) exist as
adapters with explicit requirements — UNAVAILABLE until a
reviewed local runtime exists. The only executing adapter is
the procedural box builder (pure math → facets → the
existing derived-mesh path).

External executor boundary (when one ever lands):
allow-list → proposal → approval → sandbox → result →
verification. This module spawns no external processes.
"""

import secrets
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

CAD_OPS = (
    "box",
    "cylinder",
    "transform",
    "advanced",
)

CAD_ADAPTERS = {
    "procedural": "IMPLEMENTED",
    "openscad": "UNAVAILABLE",
    "freecad": "UNAVAILABLE",
    "blender": "UNAVAILABLE",
}

CAD_ADAPTER_REQUIREMENTS = {
    "procedural": "built in; pure-math box/cylinder facets, "
                   "no external binary",
    "openscad": "reviewed local runtime required: pinned "
                 "binary, fixed argv allow-list, bounded stdout "
                 "capture, no network. Not present.",
    "freecad": "reviewed local runtime required (see openscad). "
                "Not present.",
    "blender": "reviewed local runtime required (see openscad). "
                "Not present.",
}


class CadRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed CAD validation."""


def now() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now(
        datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_document_id() -> str:
    return f"cad_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


class CadParameter(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    value: float
    unit: str = Field(default="mm", max_length=10)


class CadOperation(BaseModel):
    op_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    op: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    params: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
    adapter: str = Field(default="procedural", max_length=20)
    created_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


class CadPart(BaseModel):
    part_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    operations: list[CadOperation] = Field(
        default_factory=list, max_length=50)
    derived_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    derived_sha256: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


class CadDocument(BaseModel):
    document_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    parts: list[CadPart] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                 max_length=20)
    parameters: dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    status: str = Field(default="draft", max_length=20)
    provenance: Provenance
    created_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    updated_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


def new_document(name: str, *,
                 provenance: Provenance | None = None
                 ) -> CadDocument:
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        raise CadRefusedError("document needs a name")
    stamp = now()
    return CadDocument(
        document_id=generate_document_id(),
        name=name.strip()[:200], parts=[], parameters={},
        status="draft",
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="user-created", creator_id="cad",
            human_verified=False),
        created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp)


def _check_box_params(params: dict) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
    try:
        dims = tuple(float(params.get(key, 0.0))
                     for key in ("w", "h", "d"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise CadRefusedError(
            "box needs numeric w/h/d in mm")
    if any(not 0.1 <= dim <= 1000.0 for dim in dims):
        raise CadRefusedError("box dims must be 0.1..1000mm")
    if set(params) - {"w", "h", "d"}:
        raise CadRefusedError("box carries unexpected params")
    return dims


def _check_cylinder_params(params: dict) -> tuple[float, float]:
    try:
        radius = float(params.get("r", 0.0))
        height = float(params.get("h", 0.0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise CadRefusedError(
            "cylinder needs numeric r/h in mm")
    if not 0.1 <= radius <= 500.0 or not 0.1 <= height <= 1000.0:
        raise CadRefusedError(
            "cylinder r must be 0.1..500mm, h 0.1..1000mm")
    if set(params) - {"r", "h", "segments"}:
        raise CadRefusedError(
            "cylinder carries unexpected params")
    try:
        segments = int(params.get("segments", 24))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise CadRefusedError("segments must be an integer")
    if not 6 <= segments <= 96:
        raise CadRefusedError("segments must be 6..96")
    return radius, height, segments


def add_part(document: CadDocument, name: str) -> CadDocument:
    if len(document.parts) >= 20:
        raise CadRefusedError("at most 20 parts per document")
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        raise CadRefusedError("part needs a name")
    part = CadPart(
        part_id=f"part_{len(document.parts) + 1}_{secrets.token_hex(3)}",
        name=name.strip()[:200], operations=[])
    return document.model_copy(update={
        "parts": [*document.parts, part], "updated_at": now()})


def add_operation(document: CadDocument, part_id: str, op: str,
                  params: dict, *,
                  adapter: str = "procedural") -> CadDocument:
    """Append one validated operation. External adapters
    refuse (UNAVAILABLE); procedural box/cylinder validate
    params now and build facets on execute."""
    if op not in CAD_OPS:
        raise CadRefusedError(f"Unknown CAD op '{op}'")
    if adapter not in CAD_ADAPTERS:
        raise CadRefusedError(
            f"Unknown CAD adapter '{adapter}'")
    if adapter != "procedural":
        raise CadRefusedError(
            f"adapter '{adapter}' is "
            f"{CAD_ADAPTERS[adapter]}: "
            f"{CAD_ADAPTER_REQUIREMENTS[adapter]}")
    if op == "box":
        _check_box_params(params or {})
    elif op == "cylinder":
        _check_cylinder_params(params or {})
    elif op in ("transform", "advanced"):
        from .meshops import check_advanced_op
        from .mesh3d import check_transform
        raw = dict(params or {})
        sub = str(raw.pop("sub_op", ""))
        if op == "transform":
            try:
                check_transform(sub, raw)
            except Exception as error:
                raise CadRefusedError(f"bad transform: {error}")
        else:
            try:
                check_advanced_op(sub, raw)
            except Exception as error:
                raise CadRefusedError(
                    f"bad advanced op: {error}")
        params = {"sub_op": sub, **raw}
    parts = []
    found = False
    for part in document.parts:
        if part.part_id == part_id:
            if len(part.operations) >= 50:
                raise CadRefusedError(
                    "at most 50 operations per part")
            found = True
            part = part.model_copy(update={
                "operations": [*part.operations, CadOperation(
                    op_id=f"op_{len(part.operations) + 1}_"
                          f"{secrets.token_hex(3)}",
                    op=op, params=dict(params or {}),
                    adapter=adapter, created_at=now())]})
        parts.append(part)
    if not found:
        raise CadRefusedError("part not found")
    return document.model_copy(update={
        "parts": parts, "updated_at": now()})


def box_facets(width: float, height: float,
               depth: float) -> list:
    """Twelve facets of an origin-centred box. Pure math."""
    hx, hy, hz = width / 2.0, height / 2.0, depth / 2.0
    corners = [(-hx, -hy, -hz), (hx, -hy, -hz),
               (hx, hy, -hz), (-hx, hy, -hz),
               (-hx, -hy, hz), (hx, -hy, hz),
               (hx, hy, hz), (-hx, hy, hz)]
    # Outward-wound quads (right-hand rule): consistent
    # orientation keeps the signed-volume math exact.
    quads = [(0, 3, 2, 1), (4, 5, 6, 7), (0, 1, 5, 4),
             (2, 3, 7, 6), (0, 4, 7, 3), (1, 2, 6, 5)]
    facets = []
    for quad in quads:
        points = [corners[index] for index in quad]
        facets.append((points[0], points[1], points[2]))
        facets.append((points[0], points[2], points[3]))
    return facets


def cylinder_facets(radius: float, height: float,
                    segments: int = 24) -> list:
    """Side + caps of a Z-centred cylinder. Pure math."""
    import math
    half = height / 2.0
    ring = [(radius * math.cos(2 * math.pi * index / segments),
             radius * math.sin(2 * math.pi * index / segments))
            for index in range(segments)]
    facets = []
    for index in range(segments):
        first, second = ring[index], ring[(index + 1) % segments]
        facets.append(((first[0], first[1], -half),
                       (second[0], second[1], -half),
                       (first[0], first[1], half)))
        facets.append(((second[0], second[1], -half),
                       (second[0], second[1], half),
                       (first[0], first[1], half)))
        facets.append(((0.0, 0.0, half), first + (half,),
                       second + (half,)))
        facets.append(((0.0, 0.0, -half), second + (-half,),
                       first + (-half,)))
    return facets


def execute_document(document: CadDocument) -> CadDocument:
    """Build every part's facets through its operation stack
    (procedural only) and persist each part as a derived mesh
    working file. Returns the document with derived refs."""
    from .mesh3d import transform_facets, write_derived_mesh
    from .meshops import (extend_facets, mirror_facets,
                          orient_facets)
    parts = []
    for part in document.parts:
        facets: list | None = None
        for operation in part.operations:
            if operation.op == "box":
                width, height, depth = _check_box_params(
                    operation.params)
                facets = box_facets(width, height, depth)
            elif operation.op == "cylinder":
                radius, height, segments = \
                    _check_cylinder_params(operation.params)
                facets = cylinder_facets(radius, height,
                                         segments)
            elif operation.op == "transform":
                if facets is None:
                    raise CadRefusedError(
                        "transform needs a base shape first")
                from .mesh3d import check_transform
                sub = operation.params["sub_op"]
                cleaned = check_transform(
                    sub, {key: value for key, value in
                          operation.params.items()
                          if key != "sub_op"})
                facets = transform_facets(facets, sub, cleaned)
            else:
                if facets is None:
                    raise CadRefusedError(
                        "advanced op needs a base shape first")
                from .meshops import check_advanced_op
                sub = operation.params["sub_op"]
                cleaned = check_advanced_op(
                    sub, {key: value for key, value in
                          operation.params.items()
                          if key != "sub_op"})
                if sub == "mirror":
                    facets = mirror_facets(
                        facets, cleaned["plane"])
                elif sub == "extend":
                    facets = extend_facets(
                        facets, cleaned["axis"],
                        cleaned["delta_mm"])
                else:
                    facets, _ = orient_facets(facets)
        if facets is None:
            parts.append(part)
            continue
        ref, digest, _ = write_derived_mesh(
            document.document_id, "cad", facets)
        parts.append(part.model_copy(update={
            "derived_ref": ref, "derived_sha256": digest}))
    return document.model_copy(update={
        "parts": parts, "status": "built", "updated_at": now()})


def save_document(document: CadDocument) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO cad_documents
        (document_id, name, parts, parameters, operations,
         status, provenance, created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(document_id) DO UPDATE SET
         parts=excluded.parts,
         parameters=excluded.parameters,
         operations=excluded.operations,
         status=excluded.status, updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
                     (document.document_id, document.name,
                      dump([part.model_dump(mode="json")
                            for part in document.parts]),
                      dump(document.parameters),
                      dump([]),
                      document.status,
                      dump(document.provenance.model_dump(
                          mode="json")),
                      document.created_at, document.updated_at))


def _row_to_document(row) -> CadDocument:
    from .database import load
    return CadDocument(
        document_id=row["document_id"], name=row["name"],
        parts=[CadPart(**item) for item in load(row["parts"])],
        parameters=load(row["parameters"]),
        status=row["status"],
        provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
        created_at=row["created_at"],
        updated_at=row["updated_at"])


def get_document(document_id: str) -> CadDocument | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM cad_documents WHERE "
                         "document_id=?", (document_id,)).fetchone()
    return _row_to_document(row) if row is not None else None


def adapter_status() -> list[dict]:
    return [{"adapter": name, "state": state,
             "requirements": CAD_ADAPTER_REQUIREMENTS[name]}
            for name, state in CAD_ADAPTERS.items()]

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/camera_ecosystem.py">
"""Camera ecosystem (BIG #34): files become living world input.

The full chain, reusing every existing safety layer:

    FILE → INGEST SESSION → OBSERVATION → VLM (or honest
    fallback) → CANDIDATE → POSSIBLE MATCH → LINK PROPOSAL
    (YES) → SYMBIOSIS → CRAFT → GUIDE → MEMORY (if allowed)

Rules (fail-closed, tested):

- The camera is never authority. Observations and VLM output
  are OBSERVATION/CANDIDATE until the existing truth flow
  (support → promote, human YES) says otherwise.
- Multi-file sessions are bounded (≤8 files, each through the
  existing FileIngestAdapter validation: plain filename,
  inside the camera dir, known suffix, capped size).
- Dedupe by sha256: the same bytes never create a second
  observation in any session. Replays are reported as
  duplicates, never re-ingested.
- VLM honesty: Ollama loopback provider when reachable
  (vlm_state REAL, analysis stored); otherwise an explicit
  extractive fallback (vlm_state UNAVAILABLE, no labels, no
  confidences, no invented description). Fallback never
  claims a VLM ran.
- Candidate proposals come only from REAL VLM labels, one
  per label, idempotent per (observation, label). No
  auto-promotion, no auto-merge, no auto-relation: links are
  connection candidates (PROPOSED in the symbiosis layer)
  until Jelles decides via the existing knowledge flow.
- Entity matching is substring evidence over a bounded
  inventory browse — POSSIBLE MATCH, never a merge.
- No new event types (observation.created,
  candidate.observed, relation.proposed reused). IN_APP
  notifications go to registered nodes only (bounded).
- No shell, no subprocess, no eval, no URLs, no credentials.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import secrets as _secrets
import time as _time

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

#: Hard cap per ingest session. Large videos are never
#: processed whole: the operator extracts stills first.
MAX_SESSION_FILES = 8

LINK_PREDICATES = (
    "used_in",
    "component_of",
    "related_to",
    "stored_at",
    "supports",
    "evidence_for",
    "part_of",
)

VLM_STATES = ("REAL", "UNAVAILABLE")


class EcosystemRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Camera ecosystem validation refused; nothing was stored."""


class SessionItem(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    filename: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    state: str = Field(default="queued", max_length=20)
    observation_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    sha256: str = Field(default="", max_length=64)
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=300)


class IngestSession(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    session_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    device_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    state: str = Field(default="open", max_length=20)
    items: list[SessionItem] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                     max_length=MAX_SESSION_FILES)
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""


def generate_session_id() -> str:
    return f"cing_{int(_time.time() * 1000):x}{_secrets.token_hex(3)}"


def _now() -> str:
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def init_ecosystem_tables() -> None:
    """Additive session table in the chat DB. Idempotent."""
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS camera_ingest_sessions (
            session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cing_device
            ON camera_ingest_sessions(device_id, created_at);
        """)


def check_session_id(value: str) -> str:
    cleaned = str(value or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned.startswith("cing_") or len(cleaned) < 8:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            "session_id must be a cing_ ingest session id")
    if any(char not in
           "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_"
           for char in cleaned):
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("session_id has illegal characters")
    return cleaned


def check_filenames(values) -> list[str]:
    """Filenames only: the existing check_image_ref decides."""
    from .observations import check_image_ref
    if not isinstance(values, (list, tuple)) or not values:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            "ingest needs 1..8 inbox filenames")
    if len(values) > MAX_SESSION_FILES:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            f"ingest takes at most {MAX_SESSION_FILES} files per "
            "session; extract stills first")
    cleaned: list[str] = []
    for entry in values:
        try:
            reference = check_image_ref(entry)
        except ValueError as error:
            raise EcosystemRefusedError(str(error)) from error
        if not reference:
            raise EcosystemRefusedError(
                "empty filename refused")
        if reference in cleaned:
            raise EcosystemRefusedError(
                f"duplicate filename in request: {reference}")
        cleaned.append(reference)
    return cleaned


def save_session(session: IngestSession) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_ecosystem_tables()
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            """INSERT INTO camera_ingest_sessions
            (session_id, device_id, record, created_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(session_id) DO UPDATE SET
            record=excluded.record""",
            (session.session_id, session.device_id,
             dump(session.model_dump(mode="json")),
             session.created_at or _now()))


def load_session(session_id: str) -> IngestSession | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_ecosystem_tables()
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT record FROM camera_ingest_sessions "
                         "WHERE session_id=?",
                         (check_session_id(session_id),)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return IngestSession.model_validate(load(row["record"]))


def list_sessions(device_id: str = "", limit: int = 20
                  ) -> list[IngestSession]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_ecosystem_tables()
    init_chat_database()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 20), 50))
    with chat_connection() as db:
        if device_id:
            rows = db.execute(
                """SELECT record FROM camera_ingest_sessions
                WHERE device_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?""",
                (str(device_id)[:80], count)).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = db.execute(
                """SELECT record FROM camera_ingest_sessions
                ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?""",
                (count,)).fetchall()
    return [IngestSession.model_validate(load(row["record"]))
            for row in rows]


def known_shas(limit_sessions: int = 20) -> set[str]:
    """sha256 digests already ingested (any recent session)."""
    known: set[str] = set()
    for session in list_sessions(limit=limit_sessions):
        for item in session.items:
            if item.sha256:
                known.add(item.sha256)
    return known


def create_session(device_id: str, filenames) -> IngestSession:
    """Validate and store one open multi-file ingest session."""
    from .cameras import get_device
    cleaned_device = str(device_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if get_device(cleaned_device) is None:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("Camera not found")
    files = check_filenames(filenames)
    stamp = _now()
    session = IngestSession(
        session_id=generate_session_id(),
        device_id=cleaned_device, state="open",
        items=[SessionItem(filename=name) for name in files],
        created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp)
    save_session(session)
    return session


def _notify_nodes(kind: str, title: str, body: str = "",
                  related_entity: str = "") -> None:
    """Best-effort IN_APP fan-out to registered nodes (bounded).
    Notification failure never breaks ingest."""
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        from .notify_center import send as _send
        nodes = _main.list_nodes()[:10]
    except Exception:
        return
    for row in nodes:
        node_id = str(row.get("node_id", ""))
        if not node_id:
            continue
        try:
            _send(node_id, kind, title[:200], body[:1000],
                  related_entity=related_entity[:100])
        except Exception:
            continue


def run_session(session_id: str) -> IngestSession:
    """Ingest every queued file: dedupe → observation → events.

    Idempotent: already-observed items are skipped, duplicates
    across sessions refuse with a duplicate mark. No VLM here;
    describe_observation() is the explicit next step per item.
    """
    from .cameras import get_device, save_observation
    from .events import new_event as _bus_new
    from .events import save_event as _bus_save
    from .vision_ingest import (FileIngestAdapter, IngestRefusedError,
                                ingest_snapshot, media_facts)
    session = load_session(check_session_id(session_id))
    if session is None:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("ingest session not found")
    device = get_device(session.device_id)
    if device is None:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            "camera for this session no longer exists")
    seen = known_shas()
    changed = False
    observed = 0
    for item in session.items:
        if item.state in ("observed", "duplicate"):
            continue
        try:
            media = media_facts(item.filename)
        except IngestRefusedError as error:
            item.state = "refused"
            item.note = str(error)[:300]
            changed = True
            continue
        if media.sha256 in seen:
            item.state = "duplicate"
            item.sha256 = media.sha256
            item.note = ("same bytes already ingested; replay "
                         "refused, no second observation")
            changed = True
            continue
        try:
            adapter = FileIngestAdapter(item.filename)
            result = ingest_snapshot(device, adapter)
        except IngestRefusedError as error:
            item.state = "refused"
            item.note = str(error)[:300]
            changed = True
            continue
        save_observation(result.observation)
        item.state = "observed"
        item.observation_id = result.observation.observation_id
        item.sha256 = media.sha256
        item.note = ""
        seen.add(media.sha256)
        observed += 1
        changed = True
        try:
            _bus_save(_bus_new(
                "observation.created",
                f"Session {session.session_id}: observation "
                f"{item.observation_id} from {item.filename} "
                f"via {session.device_id}",
                node_id=session.device_id))
        except Exception:
            pass
    if changed:
        session.updated_at = _now()
        session.state = ("complete"
                         if all(item.state in ("observed", "duplicate",
                                               "refused")
                                for item in session.items)
                         else "open")
        save_session(session)
    if observed:
        _notify_nodes(
            "new_observation",
            f"Session {session.session_id}: {observed} new "
            "observation(s)",
            "Files became observations. VLM description and "
            "candidates are explicit next steps.",
            related_entity=session.device_id)
    return session


def poll_inbox(device_id: str,
               limit: int = MAX_SESSION_FILES) -> dict:
    """Explicit operator/n8n poll: inbox → session → observation →
    VLM → candidates. Synchronous, no thread/scheduler.

    Uses only existing blocks: list_inbox_files, known_shas,
    create_session, run_session, describe_observation,
    propose_candidates. Never writes to INVENTory itself.

    - second poll of the same file = duplicate-skip (SHA dedupe,
      restart-safe);
    - at most MAX_SESSION_FILES per poll, the rest stays put;
    - refused files already refused in recent sessions are not
      re-ingested while unchanged (existing session history,
      no new persistence);
    - VLM runs only for newly observed items without an
      existing REAL analysis (existing analyses/markers reused;
      propose stays idempotent).
    """
    from .cameras import get_device
    from .vision_ingest import IngestRefusedError, list_inbox_files
    cleaned_device = str(device_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if get_device(cleaned_device) is None:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("Camera not found")
    try:
        cap = max(1, min(int(limit or MAX_SESSION_FILES),
                         MAX_SESSION_FILES))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        cap = MAX_SESSION_FILES
    try:
        inbox = list_inbox_files(limit=100)
    except Exception:
        inbox = []
    known = known_shas()
    refused_history: set[str] = set()
    try:
        for session in list_sessions(limit=20):
            for item in session.items:
                if item.state == "refused" and item.filename:
                    refused_history.add(item.filename)
    except Exception:
        refused_history = set()
    # Lazy import: media facts + analysis listing only.
    from .vision_ingest import media_facts as _facts
    from .vision_flow import list_analyses as _analyses
    candidates: list[str] = []
    duplicates: list[str] = []
    refused: list[dict] = []
    for entry in inbox:
        filename = str((entry or {}).get("filename", ""))
        if not filename or filename in candidates:
            continue
        if filename in refused_history:
            refused.append({"filename": filename,
                            "reason": "previously refused; unchanged"})
            continue
        try:
            media = _facts(filename)
        except IngestRefusedError as error:
            refused.append({"filename": filename,
                            "reason": str(error)[:200]})
            continue
        except Exception as error:
            refused.append({"filename": filename,
                            "reason": str(error)[:200]})
            continue
        if media.sha256 in known:
            duplicates.append(filename)
            continue
        candidates.append(filename)
        if len(candidates) >= cap:
            break
    if not candidates:
        return {"session_id": "", "ingested": [],
                "duplicates": duplicates, "refused": refused}
    session = create_session(cleaned_device, candidates)
    session = run_session(session.session_id)
    ingested: list[dict] = []
    for item in session.items:
        if item.state == "duplicate":
            if item.filename not in duplicates:
                duplicates.append(item.filename)
        elif item.state == "refused":
            refused.append({"filename": item.filename,
                            "reason": item.note[:200]})
        elif item.state == "observed" and item.observation_id:
            try:
                analyses = _analyses(item.observation_id, limit=5)
            except Exception:
                analyses = []
            has_real = any(
                isinstance(getattr(entry, "result", None), dict)
                and entry.result.get("model")
                for entry in analyses)
            if not has_real:
                try:
                    describe_observation(item.observation_id)
                except EcosystemRefusedError:
                    pass
                except Exception:
                    pass
            try:
                propose_candidates(item.observation_id)
            except EcosystemRefusedError:
                pass
            except Exception:
                pass
            ingested.append({"filename": item.filename,
                             "observation_id": item.observation_id,
                             "sha256": item.sha256})
            known.add(item.sha256)
    return {"session_id": session.session_id,
            "ingested": ingested, "duplicates": duplicates,
            "refused": refused}


def session_observations(session_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    """Stored observations for one session (metadata only)."""
    from .cameras import list_observations
    session = load_session(check_session_id(session_id))
    if session is None:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("ingest session not found")
    wanted = {item.observation_id for item in session.items
              if item.observation_id}
    out = []
    try:
        for observation in list_observations(session.device_id,
                                             limit=50):
            if observation.observation_id in wanted:
                out.append(observation.model_dump(mode="json"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return out


# -- VLM layer ---------------------------------------------------------------

def describe_observation(observation_id: str, *,
                         question: str = "",
                         provider: str = "auto") -> dict:
    """Run VLM over one stored observation — or an honest fallback.

    REAL: Ollama loopback analysis stored via save_analysis,
    labels + confidences + description + uncertainty.
    UNAVAILABLE: extractive fallback (filename, size, sha,
    device, timestamp) with empty labels and an explicit
    uncertainty note. The fallback is stored with model=""
    so callers can tell them apart; it never invents pixels.
    """
    from .cameras import list_observations
    from .vision_flow import save_analysis, VisionAnalysisRecord
    from .vision_ingest import media_facts
    from .vision_provider import (VisionRefusedError, VisionRequest,
                                  VisionResult, VisionUnavailable)
    cleaned = str(observation_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("observation_id is required")
    observation = None
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        observation = _main._observation_load(cleaned)
    except Exception:
        observation = None
    if observation is None:
        # Fall back to a device scan (bounded).
        try:
            from .cameras import list_devices
            for device in list_devices()[:20]:
                for candidate in list_observations(
                        device.device_id, limit=50):
                    if candidate.observation_id == cleaned:
                        observation = candidate
                        break
                if observation is not None:
                    break
        except Exception:
            observation = None
    if observation is None:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("observation not found")
    if not observation.media_ref:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            "observation carries no local media; refusing")
    asked = str(question or "Wat zie je op deze foto?")[:500]
    if str(provider or "auto") != "auto":
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            "only the automatic local provider chain is supported")
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        vision_provider = _main.get_vision_provider("ollama")
        request = VisionRequest(
            observation_id=observation.observation_id,
            device_id=observation.device_id,
            media_ref=observation.media_ref, question=asked)
        import anyio as _anyio
        result = _anyio.run(vision_provider.analyze, request)
        record = VisionAnalysisRecord(
            analysis_id=result.analysis_id,
            observation_id=observation.observation_id,
            device_id=observation.device_id,
            result=result.model_dump(mode="json"),
            created_at=result.observed_at)
        save_analysis(record)
        _notify_nodes(
            "camera_ready",
            f"VLM analysis ready for {observation.observation_id}",
            f"{len(result.labels)} label(s), "
            f"{len(result.detected_objects)} detected object(s). "
            "Advice only — review decides.",
            related_entity=observation.device_id)
        return {"vlm_state": "REAL",
                "analysis": result.model_dump(mode="json")}
    except (VisionUnavailable, VisionRefusedError,
            Exception) as error:
        try:
            media = media_facts(
                observation.media_ref, width=observation.width,
                height=observation.height)
            media_note = (f"{media.mime_type}, {media.size_bytes} "
                          f"bytes, sha256 {media.sha256[:16]}…")
        except Exception:
            media_note = "media facts unavailable"
        fallback = VisionResult(
            analysis_id=f"vlm-fallback-{observation.observation_id[:40]}",
            observation_id=observation.observation_id,
            device_id=observation.device_id,
            labels=[], detected_objects=[],
            description=(f"No VLM ran for {observation.media_ref} "
                         f"({media_note}). File facts only."),
            ocr_text="",
            uncertainty=("VLM UNAVAILABLE: "
                         + (str(error)[:300] if not isinstance(
                             error, Exception) or "Vision" in type(
                             error).__name__ else str(error)[:300])),
            raw_text="", model="",
            observed_at=_now())
        try:
            record = VisionAnalysisRecord(
                analysis_id=fallback.analysis_id,
                observation_id=observation.observation_id,
                device_id=observation.device_id,
                result=fallback.model_dump(mode="json"),
                created_at=fallback.observed_at)
            save_analysis(record)
        except Exception:
            pass
        return {"vlm_state": "UNAVAILABLE",
                "analysis": fallback.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "reason": str(error)[:300]}


# -- observation → candidate ---------------------------------------------------

def propose_candidates(observation_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    """One candidate per REAL VLM label. Idempotent per
    (observation, label); fallback analyses yield nothing."""
    from .events import new_event as _bus_new
    from .events import save_event as _bus_save
    from .inventory_read import Provenance
    from .knowledge import (CandidateRefusedError, list_candidates,
                            new_candidate, save_candidate)
    from .vision_flow import VisionAnalysisRecord, list_analyses
    cleaned = str(observation_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("observation_id is required")
    try:
        analyses = list_analyses(cleaned, limit=5)
    except Exception:
        analyses = []
    latest_real = None
    for entry in analyses:
        result = entry.result if isinstance(entry.result, dict) \
            else {}
        if result.get("model"):
            latest_real = entry
            break
    if latest_real is None:
        return []
    result = latest_real.result
    seen_labels: list[tuple[str, float]] = []
    for detected in result.get("detected_objects", [])[:10]:
        if not isinstance(detected, dict):
            continue
        label = str(detected.get("label", "")).strip()[:120]
        if not label:
            continue
        try:
            score = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(
                detected.get("confidence", 0.0))))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            score = 0.0
        if label not in [seen[0] for seen in seen_labels]:
            seen_labels.append((label, score))
    for label in result.get("labels", [])[:10]:
        text = str(label or "").strip()[:120]
        if text and text not in [seen[0] for seen in seen_labels]:
            seen_labels.append((text, 0.0))
    try:
        existing = list_candidates(limit=200)
    except Exception:
        existing = []
    have = set()
    for entry in existing:
        try:
            data = entry.model_dump(mode="json")
        except Exception:
            continue
        refs = data.get("source_refs") or []
        labels = [str(ref.get("id", "")) for ref in refs
                  if isinstance(ref, dict)
                  and ref.get("kind") == "camera-label"]
        for text in labels:
            have.add(text)
    created: list[dict] = []
    for label, score in seen_labels[:8]:
        marker = f"{cleaned}::{label}"
        if marker in have:
            continue
        summary = (f"Camera observation {cleaned}: the VLM suggests "
                   f"this may show '{label}' (model confidence "
                   f"{score:.2f}). OBSERVATION, not a fact — needs "
                   "your review before it becomes anything.")
        try:
            entry = new_candidate(
                f"mogelijk {label} ({cleaned[:24]})",
                "observation", summary=summary,
                state="observation",
                provenance=Provenance(
                    source_type="ai-generated",
                    creator_id="camera-vlm", human_verified=False,
                    notes="VLM label; pictured identity unconfirmed"),
                source_refs=[{"kind": "camera-observation",
                              "id": cleaned,
                              "label": f"observation {cleaned}"},
                             {"kind": "camera-label", "id": marker,
                              "label": label}],
                evidence=[{"text": f"VLM label '{label}' "
                                   f"(confidence {score:.2f})",
                           "source": cleaned}])
            save_candidate(entry)
        except CandidateRefusedError:
            continue
        try:
            _bus_save(_bus_new(
                "candidate.observed",
                f"Camera candidate {entry.candidate_id}: mogelijk "
                f"{label[:80]}"))
        except Exception:
            pass
        created.append({"candidate_id": entry.candidate_id,
                        "label": label, "confidence": score})
    if created:
        _notify_nodes(
            "candidate_waiting",
            f"{len(created)} camera candidate(s) wait for review",
            "VLM labels became candidates. Nothing promotes "
            "itself — support, research or reject.",
            related_entity=cleaned)
    return created


# -- entity matching (POSSIBLE MATCH, never merge) ------------------------------

def possible_matches(label: str, limit: int = 5) -> list[dict]:
    """Substring evidence over a bounded inventory browse."""
    from . import main as _main
    words = [word.lower() for word in str(label or "").split()
             if len(word) >= 3][:6]
    if not words:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            "matching needs a label with real words")
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 5), 10))
    reader = _main._world_reader()
    import anyio as _anyio

    async def _browse(kind: str) -> list:
        try:
            found = await reader.browse(kind)
            return found.results or []
        except Exception:
            return []

    async def _all() -> list:
        out = []
        for kind in ("objects", "projects", "ideas"):
            out.extend(await _browse(kind))
        return out

    try:
        records = _anyio.run(_all)
    except Exception:
        return []
    matches: list[dict] = []
    for record in records[:120]:
        entity_id = str(record.entity_id)
        details = record.details \
            if isinstance(record.details, dict) else {}
        haystack = " ".join(
            str(details.get(key, "")) for key in
            ("name", "title", "goal", "description")).lower()
        hits = [word for word in words if word in haystack]
        if not hits:
            continue
        title = entity_id
        for key in ("name", "title", "goal"):
            if details.get(key):
                title = str(details[key])[:80]
                break
        matches.append({"entity_id": entity_id, "title": title,
                        "matched_words": hits[:4],
                        "why": f"label words {hits[:4]} appear in "
                               "this record; confirm visually before "
                               "linking"})
        if len(matches) >= count:
            break
    return matches


# -- symbiosis proposals (PROPOSED until YES) ------------------------------------

def suggest_link(observation_id: str, entity_id: str,
                 predicate: str) -> dict:
    """Propose observation → entity as a connection candidate.

    Surfaces as PROPOSED in the symbiosis layer. YES/NO/REVIEW
    run through the existing knowledge support/promote/reject
    flow — this function only proposes."""
    from .events import new_event as _bus_new
    from .events import save_event as _bus_save
    from .inventory_read import Provenance
    from .knowledge import (CandidateRefusedError, new_candidate,
                            save_candidate)
    from .symbiosis import clean_entity
    cleaned_obs = str(observation_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned_obs:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError("observation_id is required")
    try:
        target = clean_entity(entity_id)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    verb = str(predicate or "").strip()[:20]
    if verb not in LINK_PREDICATES:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            f"predicate must be one of {list(LINK_PREDICATES)}")
    try:
        entry = new_candidate(
            f"camera {cleaned_obs[:24]} {verb} {target[:40]}",
            "connection",
            summary=(f"Possible relation: camera observation "
                     f"{cleaned_obs} {verb} {target}. PROPOSED — "
                     "needs your YES before it means anything."),
            state="candidate",
            provenance=Provenance(
                source_type="sensor-observed",
                creator_id="camera-ecosystem", human_verified=False,
                notes="operator/VLM-suggested link; unconfirmed"),
            source_refs=[{"kind": "camera-observation",
                          "id": cleaned_obs,
                          "label": f"observation {cleaned_obs}"}],
            entity_refs=[cleaned_obs, target])
        save_candidate(entry)
    except CandidateRefusedError as error:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    try:
        _bus_save(_bus_new(
            "relation.proposed",
            f"Camera link proposed: {cleaned_obs} {verb} {target}"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    _notify_nodes(
        "new_connection",
        f"Possible link: camera observation → {target[:60]}",
        f"Predicate {verb}. Review in /knowledge, decide with YES.",
        related_entity=target)
    return {"candidate_id": entry.candidate_id,
            "observation_id": cleaned_obs, "entity_id": target,
            "predicate": verb, "state": "PROPOSED"}


# -- timeline (existing bus + notifications, no second system) --------------------

def timeline(device_id: str = "", observation_id: str = "",
             limit: int = 30) -> list[dict]:
    """Camera timeline from the shared event bus + notifications."""
    from . import main as _main
    needles = [part for part in
               (str(device_id or "").strip(),
                str(observation_id or "").strip()) if part]
    if not needles:
        raise EcosystemRefusedError(
            "timeline needs a device_id or observation_id")
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 30), 60))
    items: list[dict] = []
    try:
        events = _main.bus_events(limit=200)
    except Exception:
        events = []
    for event in events:
        blob = (f"{getattr(event, 'summary', '')} "
                f"{getattr(event, 'node_id', '')} "
                f"{getattr(event, 'mission_id', '')}")
        if not any(needle in blob for needle in needles):
            continue
        items.append({
            "at": getattr(event, "created_at", ""),
            "kind": "event",
            "type": getattr(event, "event_type", ""),
            "text": getattr(event, "summary", "")[:200],
        })
        if len(items) >= count:
            break
    try:
        notes = _main.list_notifications_for_report(limit=50)
        for note in notes:
            blob = (f"{getattr(note, 'title', '')} "
                    f"{getattr(note, 'body', '')} "
                    f"{getattr(note, 'related_entity', '')}")
            if not any(needle in blob for needle in needles):
                continue
            items.append({
                "at": getattr(note, "created_at", ""),
                "kind": "notification",
                "type": getattr(note, "type", ""),
                "text": getattr(note, "title", "")[:200],
            })
            if len(items) >= count:
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    items.sort(key=lambda entry: entry.get("at", ""))
    return items[:count]

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/campaigns.py">
"""Quest campaigns (BIG #43).

A campaign groups existing quests into one meaningful
progression — e.g. "Solar Workshop" chains energy audit →
hardware inspection → research → materials → fabrication →
observation → verification → improvement.

A campaign stores ONLY its def (title, description, ordered
quest ids). Everything else derives live from the quest
trails layer (which itself derives from missions, tasks,
finance, energy, hardware links):

- per-quest state via quests.quest_detail
- completed / total / blocked / waiting counts
- current quest (first non-completed)
- next actionable item (first WAITING/MISSING/BLOCKED step
  across the chain, with its real href)
- evidence links (quest + step hrefs)

No XP. No fictional rewards. No independent game truth.
Creating a campaign with an unknown quest id refuses (fake
quests cannot enter). Deleting a quest leaves a MISSING
marker in the chain — never silently dropped, never
invented.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re as _re
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

MAX_QUESTS_PER_CAMPAIGN = 12

_QUEST_ID_RE = _re.compile(r"^qst_[0-9a-f]+$")


class CampaignRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was stored."""


class Campaign(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    campaign_id: str = Field(min_length=4, max_length=80)
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    quest_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                 max_length=MAX_QUESTS_PER_CAMPAIGN)
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_campaign_id() -> str:
    return f"cmp_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def init_campaign_tables(db) -> None:
    db.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaigns (
            campaign_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            quest_ids TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        """)


def _ensure(db) -> None:
    init_campaign_tables(db)


def _check_quest_id(value: str) -> str:
    cleaned = str(value or "").strip()[:80]
    if not _QUEST_ID_RE.match(cleaned):
        raise CampaignRefusedError(
            f"Malformed quest id '{str(value)[:40]}'")
    return cleaned


def new_campaign(title: str, quest_ids: list,
                 description: str = "") -> Campaign:
    cleaned_title = str(title or "").strip()
    if not cleaned_title:
        raise CampaignRefusedError("Campaign needs a title")
    if len(cleaned_title) > 200:
        raise CampaignRefusedError("Campaign title is too long")
    if not isinstance(quest_ids, list) or not quest_ids:
        raise CampaignRefusedError(
            "Campaign needs at least one quest")
    if len(quest_ids) > MAX_QUESTS_PER_CAMPAIGN:
        raise CampaignRefusedError(
            f"Campaign has at most {MAX_QUESTS_PER_CAMPAIGN} "
            "quests")
    cleaned_ids: list[str] = []
    for raw in quest_ids:
        cleaned = _check_quest_id(raw)
        if cleaned in cleaned_ids:
            raise CampaignRefusedError(
                f"Duplicate quest '{cleaned}'")
        cleaned_ids.append(cleaned)
    # Every quest must really exist — fake quests refuse.
    from .quests import get_quest
    for quest_id in cleaned_ids:
        try:
            quest = get_quest(quest_id)
        except Exception:
            quest = None
        if quest is None:
            raise CampaignRefusedError(
                f"Unknown quest '{quest_id}'")
    stamp = now()
    return Campaign(
        campaign_id=generate_campaign_id(),
        title=cleaned_title[:200],
        description=str(description or "").strip()[:1000],
        quest_ids=cleaned_ids,
        created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp)


def save_campaign(campaign: Campaign) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        db.execute(
            """INSERT INTO campaigns
            (campaign_id, title, description, quest_ids,
             created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(campaign_id) DO UPDATE SET
             title=excluded.title,
             description=excluded.description,
             quest_ids=excluded.quest_ids,
             updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
            (campaign.campaign_id, campaign.title,
             campaign.description,
             dump(campaign.quest_ids),
             campaign.created_at, campaign.updated_at))
    _audit("campaign.created",
           f"Campaign '{campaign.title}' defined",
           payload={"campaign_id": campaign.campaign_id,
                    "quests": len(campaign.quest_ids)})


def _row_to_campaign(row) -> Campaign:
    from .database import load
    try:
        quest_ids = load(row["quest_ids"])
    except Exception:
        quest_ids = []
    if not isinstance(quest_ids, list):
        quest_ids = []
    return Campaign(
        campaign_id=row["campaign_id"],
        title=row["title"] or "",
        description=row["description"] or "",
        quest_ids=[str(entry) for entry in quest_ids
                   if isinstance(entry, str)][
            :MAX_QUESTS_PER_CAMPAIGN],
        created_at=row["created_at"] or "",
        updated_at=row["updated_at"] or "")


def get_campaign(campaign_id: str) -> Campaign | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    cleaned = str(campaign_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned:
        return None
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM campaigns WHERE campaign_id=?",
            (cleaned,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return _row_to_campaign(row)


def list_campaigns(limit: int = 50) -> list[Campaign]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 50), 100))
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM campaigns ORDER BY updated_at DESC "
            "LIMIT ?", (count,)).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_campaign(row) for row in rows]


def delete_campaign(campaign_id: str) -> bool:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        changed = db.execute(
            "DELETE FROM campaigns WHERE campaign_id=?",
            (str(campaign_id or "").strip()[:80],)).rowcount
    return bool(changed)


# -- live derivation (view only, no stored game truth) ------------------

def campaign_detail(campaign: Campaign) -> dict:
    """Full derived campaign view: per-quest states, counts,
    current quest, next actionable item, evidence links."""
    from .quests import get_quest, quest_detail
    quest_views: list[dict] = []
    for quest_id in campaign.quest_ids:
        try:
            quest = get_quest(quest_id)
        except Exception:
            quest = None
        if quest is None:
            quest_views.append({
                "quest_id": quest_id, "title": "(quest removed)",
                "state": "MISSING", "done": 0, "total": 0,
                "progress": "0/0", "steps": [],
                "href": "/quests"})
            continue
        try:
            detail = quest_detail(quest)
        except Exception:
            detail = {"quest_id": quest_id,
                      "title": quest.title, "state": "WAITING",
                      "done": 0, "total": len(quest.steps),
                      "progress": f"0/{len(quest.steps)}",
                      "steps": []}
        detail["href"] = f"/quests#{quest_id}"
        quest_views.append(detail)
    completed = sum(1 for view in quest_views
                    if view.get("state") == "COMPLETED")
    blocked = sum(1 for view in quest_views
                  if view.get("state") in ("BLOCKED", "FAILED"))
    waiting = sum(1 for view in quest_views
                  if view.get("state") in ("WAITING", "MISSING"))
    current = next((view for view in quest_views
                    if view.get("state") not in
                    ("COMPLETED",)), {})
    next_action: dict = {}
    for view in quest_views:
        if view.get("state") in ("COMPLETED",):
            continue
        for step in view.get("steps", []):
            if step.get("state") in (
                    "WAITING", "MISSING", "BLOCKED", "FAILED",
                    "ACTIVE"):
                next_action = {
                    "quest_id": view.get("quest_id", ""),
                    "quest_title": view.get("title", "")[:120],
                    "step": step.get("label", "")[:120],
                    "href": step.get("href", "/quests"),
                    "readiness": step.get("readiness", ""),
                    "readiness_reason": step.get(
                        "readiness_reason", "")[:200],
                }
                break
        if next_action:
            break
    if completed and completed == len(quest_views):
        level = "COMPLETED"
    elif blocked:
        level = "BLOCKED"
    elif any(view.get("state") == "ACTIVE"
             for view in quest_views):
        level = "ACTIVE"
    elif waiting or not quest_views:
        level = "WAITING"
    else:
        level = "READY"
    return {
        "campaign_id": campaign.campaign_id,
        "title": campaign.title,
        "description": campaign.description,
        "state": level,
        "quests": quest_views,
        "current_quest": {
            "quest_id": current.get("quest_id", ""),
            "title": current.get("title", "")[:120],
            "state": current.get("state", ""),
            "progress": current.get("progress", "0/0"),
            "href": current.get("href", "/quests"),
        } if current else {},
        "completed_count": completed,
        "total_count": len(quest_views),
        "blocked_count": blocked,
        "waiting_count": waiting,
        "next_action": next_action,
        "evidence": [
            {"label": f"{view.get('title', '')[:80]} "
                      f"({view.get('progress', '0/0')})",
             "href": view.get("href", "/quests")}
            for view in quest_views],
        "provenance": {"source_type": "derived",
                       "creator_id": "quest-campaigns",
                       "human_verified": False},
    }


def list_campaign_details(limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
    return [campaign_detail(campaign)
            for campaign in list_campaigns(limit=limit)]


# -- foundation seeds (data-only, idempotent) ---------------------------
#
# First real product loop: "Documenteer één object".
# Quests reference REAL work only and claim no progress: every
# step starts unlinked (MISSING/WAITING) until a real record
# exists. Completion derives live via quests.quest_detail /
# campaign_detail — no stored progress, no XP.
#
# Quest 1 uses a task-kind step as completion source (never an
# entity-step: those stay WAITING by design). The obj_/file_
# records are evidence, not a forced entity-completion.

FOUNDATION_QUEST_TITLES = (
    "Documenteer één object",
    "Repareer/hergebruik iets + foto-bewijs",
    "Inbox legen via poll",
    "Observatie beschrijven",
    "Kandidaat reviewen",
    "Mycelium D: documenteer",
    "Mycelium E: verifieer",
    "Mycelium F: kweek",
    "Mycelium G: oogst",
    "Mycelium H: deel",
)

FOUNDATION_CAMPAIGN_TITLES = (
    "🌱 Solar Punk Foundation",
    "👁 Observation Inbox",
    "🧠 Improve Mycelium D–H",
)


def _find_quest_by_title(title: str):
    from .quests import list_quests
    for quest in list_quests(limit=100):
        if quest.title == title:
            return quest
    return None


def _find_campaign_by_title(title: str):
    for campaign in list_campaigns(limit=100):
        if campaign.title == title:
            return campaign
    return None


def ensure_foundation_seeds() -> dict:
    """Create (or reuse) the foundation quests + campaigns.

    Idempotent by title: re-runs return the existing defs.
    Every quest holds task-kind steps with empty refs — no
    fake progress. Callers link a step to a real completed
    task (via quests.get_quest/save_quest) to derive
    COMPLETE honestly.
    """
    from .quests import new_quest, save_quest
    quest_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
    for title in FOUNDATION_QUEST_TITLES:
        existing = _find_quest_by_title(title)
        if existing is not None:
            quest_ids[title] = existing.quest_id
            continue
        key = title.lower().replace(" ", "-")[:40]
        quest = new_quest(title, [{
            "key": key or "stap",
            "label": title,
            "kind": "task",
            "ref": "",
        }])
        save_quest(quest)
        quest_ids[title] = quest.quest_id
    campaign_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
    groups = {
        FOUNDATION_CAMPAIGN_TITLES[0]: [
            "Documenteer één object",
            "Repareer/hergebruik iets + foto-bewijs",
        ],
        FOUNDATION_CAMPAIGN_TITLES[1]: [
            "Inbox legen via poll",
            "Observatie beschrijven",
            "Kandidaat reviewen",
        ],
        FOUNDATION_CAMPAIGN_TITLES[2]: [
            "Mycelium D: documenteer",
            "Mycelium E: verifieer",
            "Mycelium F: kweek",
            "Mycelium G: oogst",
            "Mycelium H: deel",
        ],
    }
    for title, quest_titles in groups.items():
        existing = _find_campaign_by_title(title)
        if existing is not None:
            campaign_ids[title] = existing.campaign_id
            continue
        campaign = new_campaign(
            title, [quest_ids[name] for name in quest_titles],
            description=f"Foundation seed: {title}")
        save_campaign(campaign)
        campaign_ids[title] = campaign.campaign_id
    return {"quests": quest_ids, "campaigns": campaign_ids}

     "(research/code/test/documentatie). Geen autonome shell-acties.",
     "READY"),
)

MISSION_SEED_CAMPAIGN = "🧭 Beschikbare missies"


def ensure_mission_seeds() -> dict:
    """Create (or reuse) draft-missies + koppelquests + campaign.

    Idempotent op exact goal/titel. Draft-missies claimen geen
    voortgang; quests derivieren WAITING tot echt werk loopt.
    """
    from .missions import (generate_mission_id, list_missions,
                           new_mission, save_mission)
    from .mission_templates import instantiate
    from .quests import get_quest, new_quest, save_quest
    try:
        existing = {str(m.goal): str(m.mission_id)
                    for m in list_missions(limit=200) or []}
    except Exception:
        existing = {}
    mission_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
    for title, template_id, context, _state in MISSION_SEEDS:
        if title in existing:
            mission_ids[title] = existing[title]
            continue
        steps, max_steps = instantiate(template_id, title)
        mission = new_mission(
            generate_mission_id(), "seed-content", title,
            steps, max_steps=max_steps,
            context_records=[{"note": context[:500]}],
            status="draft")
        save_mission(mission)
        mission_ids[title] = mission.mission_id
    quest_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
    for title, _template_id, _context, _state in MISSION_SEEDS:
        quest_title = f"Missie: {title}"
        found = _find_quest_by_title(quest_title)
        if found is not None:
            quest_ids[title] = found.quest_id
            continue
        quest = new_quest(quest_title, [{
            "key": "missie",
            "label": quest_title,
            "kind": "mission",
            "ref": mission_ids[title],
        }])
        save_quest(quest)
        quest_ids[title] = quest.quest_id
    campaign_title = MISSION_SEED_CAMPAIGN
    campaign_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
    found_camp = _find_campaign_by_title(campaign_title)
    if found_camp is not None:
        campaign_ids[campaign_title] = found_camp.campaign_id
    else:
        campaign = new_campaign(
            campaign_title,
            [quest_ids[title] for title, _t, _c, _s in
             MISSION_SEEDS],
            description="Beschikbare missies als speelbare content; "
                        "draft = beschikbaar, geen voortgang.")
        save_campaign(campaign)
        campaign_ids[campaign_title] = campaign.campaign_id
    return {"missions": mission_ids, "quests": quest_ids,
            "campaigns": campaign_ids}
