<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/command.py">
"""Natural-language command router (BIG #23).

The Command Center (/world) accepts plain Dutch/English text and
routes it through ONE brain — the existing chat endpoint — into
one of:

- a status answer built from live state (missions, morning,
  health, agenda),
- a new mission built from an existing safe template
  (inspect_project, investigate_inventory, analyze_problem,
  prepare_build_plan — never new execution power),
- mission control (stop / resume an owned mission),
- a help answer listing what Mycelium can do.

Rules (fail-closed):

- Deterministic keyword routing only; the LLM advises, it never
  routes, never creates missions, never mutates state.
- Unknown text falls back to ``chat`` (normal advice turn),
  never to a guessed mission.
- Research missions are read-only templates; desktop INPUT
  steps are never generated from a command.
- ``stop``/``resume`` name an explicit mission id (or the
  single active mission); the router never cancels blindly.
- Confidence is reported honestly: ``high`` (explicit verb +
  target), ``medium`` (verb only), ``low`` (fallback chat).
"""

import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

INTENTS = (
    "research_project",
    "inventory_status",
    "project_overview",
    "morning_report",
    "mission_status",
    "mission_stop",
    "mission_resume",
    "agenda_today",
    "help",
    "chat",
)

#: intent -> safe template used to build the mission.
INTENT_TEMPLATES = {
    "research_project": "research_topic",
    "inventory_status": "investigate_inventory",
    "project_overview": "inspect_project",
}

_RESEARCH = re.compile(
    r"(onderzoek|research|onderzocht|zoek|verdiep|analyseer|analyse|"
    r"bekijk|kijk|inventariseer|uitzoek|controleer|check|toon|lijst|"
    r"nieuw|nieuwe|update|vertel .* (over|overzicht)|"
    r"wat .* (open|loopt|speelt)|overzicht|status|voortgang)",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_MORNING = re.compile(
    r"(vannacht|vanacht|vanmorgen|vanochtend|ochtend|morning|"
    r"wat heb je (gedaan|gevonden)|nachtrapport|overnight)",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_MISSIONS = re.compile(
    r"(missie|mission|missies|missions|taken|task)", re.IGNORECASE)
_STOP = re.compile(
    r"\b(stop|stoppen|annuleer|afbreken|cancel|pauzeer|pauze|halt)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_RESUME = re.compile(
    r"\b(ga verder|verder|hervat|resume|doorgaan|ga door|pak op)\b",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_AGENDA = re.compile(
    r"(agenda|afspraak|afspraken|kalender|planning|calendar)",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_HELP = re.compile(
    r"(wat kan je|wat kun je|help|hoe werkt|voorbeelden|commando)",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_INVENTORY = re.compile(
    r"(inventory|inventaris|voorraad|onderdelen|spullen|spullenlijst)",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_SPECIFIC_DOMAIN = re.compile(
    r"(camper|umz|ozfk|led|kostuum|costume|printer|3d|"
    r"inventaris|mycelium|solarpunk|solorpunk|freerun|arduino|"
    r"bambu|workshopplan|distributieriem|luifel)",
    re.IGNORECASE)
_PROJECTS = re.compile(
    r"(projecten|project|workshop|camper|umz|ozfk|led|kostuum|printer|"
    r"3d|solorpunk|solarpunk|mycelium ai)",
    re.IGNORECASE)

EXAMPLE_COMMANDS = [
    "Onderzoek mijn camper.",
    "Kijk wat er nog openstaat voor INVENTory.",
    "Maak een overzicht van mijn lopende projecten.",
    "Wat heb je vannacht gevonden?",
    "Controleer mijn openstaande missions.",
    "Wat staat er vandaag op mijn agenda?",
    "Stop deze missie.",
    "Ga verder met het belangrijkste veilige onderzoek.",
]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Command:
    """One parsed user command. Data only."""

    intent: str = "chat"
    raw: str = ""
    target: str = ""
    mission_id: str = ""
    confidence: str = "low"
    reply_hint: str = ""
    template_id: str = ""
    extra: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def parse_command(text: str) -> Command:
    """Parse NL/EN command text into an intent. Pure function."""
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        raise ValueError("Command needs non-empty text")
    raw = text.strip()[:500]

    mission_hit = re.search(r"mission_[0-9a-f]{4,40}", raw)
    mission_id = mission_hit.group(0) if mission_hit else ""

    if _STOP.search(raw) and _MISSIONS.search(raw):
        return Command(
            "mission_stop", raw, mission_id=mission_id,
            confidence="high" if mission_id else "medium",
            reply_hint="stop")
    if _RESUME.search(raw):
        return Command(
            "mission_resume", raw, mission_id=mission_id,
            confidence="high" if mission_id else "medium",
            reply_hint="resume")
    if _MORNING.search(raw):
        return Command("morning_report", raw, confidence="high",
                       reply_hint="morning")
    if _AGENDA.search(raw):
        return Command("agenda_today", raw, confidence="high",
                       reply_hint="agenda")
    if _HELP.search(raw):
        return Command("help", raw, confidence="high",
                       reply_hint="help")
    if _MISSIONS.search(raw) and _RESEARCH.search(raw):
        return Command("mission_status", raw, confidence="high",
                       reply_hint="missions")
    if _INVENTORY.search(raw) and _RESEARCH.search(raw):
        target = _target_after(raw) or "INVENTory"
        return Command(
            "inventory_status", raw, target=target, confidence="high",
            reply_hint="inventory",
            template_id=INTENT_TEMPLATES["inventory_status"])
    if _RESEARCH.search(raw) and _PROJECTS.search(raw):
        target = _target_after(raw) or "projecten"
        if _SPECIFIC_DOMAIN.search(raw):
            return Command(
                "research_project", raw, target=target,
                confidence="high",
                reply_hint="research",
                template_id=INTENT_TEMPLATES["research_project"])
        return Command(
            "project_overview", raw, target=target,
            confidence="medium", reply_hint="overview",
            template_id=INTENT_TEMPLATES["project_overview"])
    if _RESEARCH.search(raw) or "overzicht" in raw.lower():
        target = _target_after(raw) or "projecten"
        return Command(
            "project_overview", raw, target=target,
            confidence="medium", reply_hint="overview",
            template_id=INTENT_TEMPLATES["project_overview"])
    return Command("chat", raw, confidence="low", reply_hint="chat")


def _target_after(raw: str) -> str:
    """Take the noun phrase after a preposition as research target."""
    match = re.search(
        r"(mijn|m'n|de|het|over|voor|van)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9\- ]{2,60})",
        raw)
    if not match:
        return ""
    target = match.group(2).strip().rstrip(" .?!")
    stopwords = {"projecten", "project", "nog", "wat", "er", "een",
                 "aan", "op", "uit"}
    words = [word for word in target.split()
             if word.lower() not in stopwords]
    return " ".join(words[:6])[:80]

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/conversation_bridge.py">
"""Conversation bridge (BIG #30): external AI chats become Mycelium context.

Jelles talks to ChatGPT / Codex / OpenCode / Ollama / Claude / Gemini /
Antigravity / Google AI Studio / ... — those conversations live outside.
This module imports them as data, never as authority:

- parse pasted text / TXT / Markdown / JSON / safe HTML export
- store as conv_... conversation with msg rows (imported provenance)
- deterministic analysis -> OBSERVATION / CANDIDATE findings with evidence
- missed-item detection ("what did we miss?"), each with evidence refs
- NEVER auto-promotes to memory/FACT; NEVER executes imported instructions
- NEVER fetches URLs; NEVER stores credentials (redacted)

Security (fail-closed, tested):
- HTML is stripped to text (no scripts, no forms, no javascript: URLs)
- prompt-injection: imported text is data; analysis prefixes state labels
- fake entity IDs: mentions are candidates, never resolved as truth
- health content is flagged; context packets exclude it unless scoped
- node tokens / api keys are redacted before storage
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import html as _html
import json as _json
import re as _re
import secrets as _secrets
import time as _time
from html.parser import HTMLParser as _HTMLParser
from typing import Any

SUPPORTED_FORMATS = frozenset({"plain", "markdown", "txt", "json", "html"})

KNOWN_PLATFORMS = (
    "chatgpt", "codex", "opencode", "ollama", "chatgpt-live",
    "google-ai-studio", "antigravity", "claude", "gemini", "other",
)

MAX_RAW_CHARS = 200_000
MAX_MESSAGES = 200
MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS = 4000
MAX_TITLE_CHARS = 120

IMPORT_SOURCE_TYPE = "imported"
EXECUTION_STATE_IMPORTED = "IMPORTED"


class BridgeRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Import/analysis refused; nothing was stored."""


# -- ids -------------------------------------------------------------------

def generate_import_id() -> str:
    return f"conv_{int(_time.time() * 1000):x}{_secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def generate_import_message_id() -> str:
    return f"msg_{int(_time.time() * 1000):x}{_secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def content_hash(raw: str) -> str:
    normalized = "\n".join(
        line.strip() for line in str(raw or "").splitlines())
    return hashlib.sha256(normalized.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


# -- sanitizing --------------------------------------------------------------

_PLATFORM_RE = _re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9 _.\-]{1,40}$")
_SECRET_RE = _re.compile(
    r"(?i)(token|bearer|api[_-]?key|secret|password|passwd|auth[_-]?token)"
    r"\s*[:=]\s*\S+")
_URL_RE = _re.compile(r"https?://[^\s<>\"]{1,300}")
_ENTITY_RE = _re.compile(
    r"\b(obj|proj|idea|rel|evt|hw|sns|cam|loc|mod|task|act|file|mem|"
    r"mission|conv)_[A-Za-z0-9._\-]{1,60}\b")
_HEALTH_RE = _re.compile(
    r"(?i)\b(gezondheid|health|garmin|gewicht|weight|slaap|sleep|"
    r"hartslag|heart.?rate|bloeddruk|calorie|voeding|nutrition|"
    r"diagnose|diagnosis|medic|dokter|doctor|ziekte|disease)\b")


def check_platform(platform: str) -> str:
    cleaned = str(platform or "").strip().lower()[:40]
    if not cleaned:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("source_platform is required")
    if not _PLATFORM_RE.match(cleaned):
        raise BridgeRefusedError(
            "source_platform must be 1..40 chars [A-Za-z0-9 _.-]")
    return cleaned


def check_format(fmt: str) -> str:
    cleaned = str(fmt or "").strip().lower()
    if cleaned not in SUPPORTED_FORMATS:
        raise BridgeRefusedError(
            f"Unsupported format '{fmt}'; expected one of "
            f"{sorted(SUPPORTED_FORMATS)}")
    return cleaned


def redact_secrets(text: str) -> str:
    return _SECRET_RE.sub(
        lambda m: m.group(0).split(":")[0].split("=")[0] + "=[REDACTED]",
        str(text or ""))


def _strip_controls(text: str) -> str:
    out = []
    for char in str(text or ""):
        if char in ("\n", "\t"):
            out.append(char)
        elif ord(char) < 32:
            out.append(" ")
        else:
            out.append(char)
    return "".join(out)


_TAG_BLOCK_RE = _re.compile(
    r"<\s*(script|style|iframe|object|embed|form)\b.*?"
    r"<\s*/\s*\1\s*>",
    _re.IGNORECASE | _re.DOTALL)
_TAG_RE = _re.compile(r"</?[A-Za-z][^>]{0,200}>")


def _neutralize_markup(text: str) -> str:
    """Strip active markup from pasted text. Stored imports keep
    words, never live tags: script/style/form blocks are removed
    wholesale, remaining tags collapse to spaces. Plain comparisons
    like 'a < b' (no letter-tag shape) survive untouched."""
    cleaned = _TAG_BLOCK_RE.sub(" ", str(text or ""))
    return _TAG_RE.sub(" ", cleaned)


class _TextExtractor(_HTMLParser):
    """Text-only HTML extraction. Drops scripts/styles/forms/inputs."""

    _DROP = frozenset({
        "script", "style", "iframe", "object", "embed", "form",
        "input", "button", "select", "textarea", "noscript", "canvas",
    })

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        super().__init__(convert_charrefs=True)
        self._depth = 0
        self._parts: list[str] = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag: str, attrs: list) -> None:
        if tag.lower() in self._DROP:
            self._depth += 1

    def handle_endtag(self, tag: str) -> None:
        if tag.lower() in self._DROP and self._depth:
            self._depth -= 1
        if tag.lower() in ("p", "br", "div", "li", "tr", "h1", "h2",
                           "h3", "h4") and not self._depth:
            self._parts.append("\n")

    def handle_data(self, data: str) -> None:
        if not self._depth:
            self._parts.append(data)

    def text(self) -> str:
        raw = "".join(self._parts)
        raw = _html.unescape(raw)
        raw = _re.sub(r"javascript\s*:", "", raw, flags=_re.IGNORECASE)
        return raw


def html_to_text(raw_html: str) -> str:
    if len(str(raw_html or "")) > MAX_RAW_CHARS:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("HTML export exceeds size limit")
    parser = _TextExtractor()
    try:
        parser.feed(str(raw_html or "")[:MAX_RAW_CHARS])
    except Exception as exc:
        raise BridgeRefusedError(
            f"HTML could not be parsed safely: {exc}") from exc
    return parser.text()


# -- parsing -----------------------------------------------------------------

_ROLE_PREFIX_RE = _re.compile(
    r"^\s*(user|jelles|human|you|assistant|chatgpt|gpt|codex|opencode|"
    r"ollama|qwen|claude|gemini|gemini-live|chatgpt-live|antigravity|"
    r"ai|bot|system|agent)\s*[:\u2013\u2014\-]\s*(.*)$",
    _re.IGNORECASE)

_ROLE_MAP = {
    "user": "user", "jelles": "user", "human": "user", "you": "user",
    "assistant": "assistant", "chatgpt": "assistant", "gpt": "assistant",
    "codex": "assistant", "opencode": "assistant", "ollama": "assistant",
    "qwen": "assistant", "claude": "assistant", "gemini": "assistant",
    "gemini-live": "assistant", "chatgpt-live": "assistant",
    "antigravity": "assistant", "ai": "assistant", "bot": "assistant",
    "system": "system", "agent": "agent",
}


def _split_plain(text: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    messages: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    current_role = ""
    current_lines: list[str] = []
    participants: list[str] = []

    def flush() -> None:
        if current_role and "".join(current_lines).strip():
            messages.append({
                "role": current_role,
                "content": "\n".join(current_lines).strip(),
                "speaker": participants[-1] if participants else current_role,
            })

    for line in str(text or "").splitlines():
        match = _ROLE_PREFIX_RE.match(line)
        if match:
            flush()
            speaker = match.group(1).strip().lower()
            role = _ROLE_MAP.get(speaker, "user")
            current_role = role
            participants.append(speaker)
            current_lines = [match.group(2)]
        elif current_role:
            current_lines.append(line)
        elif line.strip():
            current_role = "user"
            participants.append("pasted")
            current_lines = [line]
    flush()
    if not messages and str(text or "").strip():
        messages.append({"role": "user", "content": str(text).strip(),
                         "speaker": "pasted"})
    return messages


def _split_json(raw: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    try:
        data = _json.loads(raw)
    except Exception as exc:
        raise BridgeRefusedError(
            f"JSON could not be parsed: {exc}") from exc
    items: Any = data
    if isinstance(data, dict):
        for key in ("messages", "turns", "conversation", "items"):
            if isinstance(data.get(key), list):
                items = data[key]
                break
        else:
            raise BridgeRefusedError(
                "JSON needs a messages/turns/conversation list")
    if not isinstance(items, list) or not items:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("JSON holds no messages")
    messages: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for entry in items[:MAX_MESSAGES]:
        if isinstance(entry, str):
            messages.append({"role": "user", "content": entry,
                             "speaker": "json"})
            continue
        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
            continue
        role_raw = str(entry.get("role", entry.get("speaker",
                                                  entry.get("author",
                                                            "user")))
                         ).strip().lower()
        role = _ROLE_MAP.get(role_raw, "user")
        content = entry.get("content", entry.get("text", entry.get(
            "message", "")))
        if isinstance(content, list):
            content = "\n".join(str(part.get("text", part))
                                if isinstance(part, dict) else str(part)
                                for part in content)
        content = str(content or "").strip()
        if not content:
            continue
        messages.append({"role": role, "content": content,
                         "speaker": role_raw[:40] or "json"})
    if not messages:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("JSON holds no usable message text")
    return messages


def parse_import_content(raw: str, fmt: str) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
    """Parse raw import to [{role, content, speaker}]. Fail-closed."""
    fmt = check_format(fmt)
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
        raise BridgeRefusedError("Nothing to import: empty content")
    if len(raw) > MAX_RAW_CHARS:
        raise BridgeRefusedError(
            f"Content exceeds {MAX_RAW_CHARS} characters")
    cleaned = _neutralize_markup(
        _strip_controls(redact_secrets(raw)))
    if fmt == "json":
        parsed = _split_json(cleaned)
    elif fmt == "html":
        parsed = _split_plain(html_to_text(cleaned))
    else:
        parsed = _split_plain(cleaned)
    if not parsed:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("No messages found in this import")
    if len(parsed) > MAX_MESSAGES:
        raise BridgeRefusedError(
            f"Too many messages ({len(parsed)} > {MAX_MESSAGES})")
    out: list[dict[str, str]] = []
    for item in parsed:
        content = str(item.get("content", "")).strip()
        if not content:
            continue
        role = str(item.get("role", "user")).strip().lower()
        if role not in ("user", "assistant", "system", "agent"):
            role = "user"
        if len(content) > MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS:
            for start in range(0, len(content), MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS):
                chunk = content[start:start + MAX_MESSAGE_CHARS]
                if chunk.strip():
                    out.append({"role": role, "content": chunk.strip(),
                                "speaker": str(item.get("speaker",
                                                        role))[:40]})
        else:
            out.append({"role": role, "content": content,
                        "speaker": str(item.get("speaker", role))[:40]})
        if len(out) >= MAX_MESSAGES:
            break
    if not out:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("No importable messages remain")
    return out[:MAX_MESSAGES]


# -- persistence ---------------------------------------------------------------

def init_bridge_tables() -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_imports (
            conversation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            source_platform TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            imported_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            participants TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            message_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            content_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            execution_state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'IMPORTED',
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_analyses (
            conversation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        );
        """)


def _now() -> str:
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def import_conversation(title: str, raw: str, fmt: str,
                        platform: str) -> dict:
    """Parse + persist an external conversation. Returns import record."""
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    fmt = check_format(fmt)
    platform = check_platform(platform)
    title = str(title or "").strip()[:MAX_TITLE_CHARS]
    if not title:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("A title is required")
    messages = parse_import_content(raw, fmt)
    digest = content_hash(raw)
    init_bridge_tables()
    init_chat_database()
    conversation_id = generate_import_id()
    created = _now()
    participants = sorted({str(item.get("speaker", item["role"]))
                           for item in messages})[:20]
    with chat_connection() as db:
        dup = db.execute(
            "SELECT conversation_id FROM conversation_imports "
            "WHERE content_hash=?", (digest,)).fetchone()
        if dup is not None:
            raise BridgeRefusedError(
                "This exact content was already imported as "
                f"{dup['conversation_id']}")
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO conversations
        (conversation_id, title, project_ref, created_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(conversation_id) DO NOTHING""",
                   (conversation_id, title, "", created))
        for item in messages:
            db.execute("""INSERT INTO messages
            (message_id, conversation_id, role, content, created_at,
             provenance, sources) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                       (generate_import_message_id(), conversation_id,
                        item["role"], item["content"], created,
                        dump({"source_type": IMPORT_SOURCE_TYPE,
                              "creator_id": f"conversation-import:"
                                            f"{platform}",
                              "human_verified": False,
                              "notes": "external import; data, never "
                                       "authority"}),
                        "[]"))
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO conversation_imports
        (conversation_id, source_platform, imported_at, title,
         participants, message_count, content_hash, execution_state,
         provenance) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
                   (conversation_id, platform, created, title,
                    dump(participants), len(messages), digest,
                    EXECUTION_STATE_IMPORTED,
                    dump({"source_type": IMPORT_SOURCE_TYPE,
                          "creator_id": f"conversation-import:{platform}",
                          "human_verified": False})))
    return {"conversation_id": conversation_id,
            "source_platform": platform, "imported_at": created,
            "title": title, "participants": participants,
            "message_count": len(messages), "content_hash": digest,
            "execution_state": EXECUTION_STATE_IMPORTED,
            "provenance": {"source_type": IMPORT_SOURCE_TYPE,
                           "creator_id": f"conversation-import:{platform}",
                           "human_verified": False}}


def get_import(conversation_id: str) -> dict | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, load
    init_bridge_tables()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM conversation_imports WHERE conversation_id=?",
            (conversation_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        data = dict(row)
        data["participants"] = load(data.get("participants") or "[]")
        data["provenance"] = load(data.get("provenance") or "{}")
        return data


def list_imports(limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
    from .database import chat_connection, load
    init_bridge_tables()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 50), 100))
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM conversation_imports ORDER BY imported_at "
            "DESC LIMIT ?", (count,)).fetchall()
    out = []
    for row in rows:
        data = dict(row)
        data["participants"] = load(data.get("participants") or "[]")
        data["provenance"] = load(data.get("provenance") or "{}")
        out.append(data)
    return out


def import_messages(conversation_id: str) -> list[dict]:
    from .database import chat_connection
    init_bridge_tables()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM messages WHERE conversation_id=? "
            "ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 200",
            (conversation_id,)).fetchall()
    return [dict(row) for row in rows]


# -- analysis ------------------------------------------------------------------

_SENT_RE = _re.compile(r"(?<=[.!?\u2026])\s+|\n+")


def _sentences(text: str) -> list[str]:
    return [part.strip() for part in _SENT_RE.split(str(text or ""))
            if part.strip()][:60]


_FINDING_RULES: list[tuple[str, _re.Pattern[str], str]] = [
    ("decision", _re.compile(
        r"(?i)\b(besloten|besluit|decided|decision|akkoord|agreed|"
        r"gaan we doen|we kiezen|conclusie|conclusion)\b"), "CANDIDATE"),
    ("todo", _re.compile(
        r"(?i)\b(todo|action item|actiepunt|moet nog|moeten nog|"
        r"nog doen|afspraak|deadline|vervolgactie|follow.?up)\b"),
     "CANDIDATE"),
    ("open_question", _re.compile(r"\?\s*$"), "OBSERVATION"),
    ("open_question", _re.compile(
        r"(?i)\b(open vraag|open question|onduidelijk|unclear|"
        r"nog uitzoeken|to be determined|tbd|weet (ik|we) niet)\b"),
     "OBSERVATION"),
    ("idea", _re.compile(
        r"(?i)\b(idee|idea|voorstel|proposal|suggestie|suggestion|"
        r"wat als|what if|zouden we|could we|misschien|maybe we)\b"),
     "CANDIDATE"),
    ("technical_claim", _re.compile(
        r"(?i)\b(werkt|works|bewering|claim|feit|fact|meting|measurement|"
        r"\d+\s?(mm|cm|m\b|km|ms|s\b|min|uur|hour|watt|volt|amp|gb|mb|"
        r"ghz|mhz|rpm|gram|kg)\b)"), "OBSERVATION"),
    ("proposed_action", _re.compile(
        r"(?i)\b(stel voor|propose|adviseer|recommend|aanrader|"
        r"je zou moeten|you should|probeer|try)\b"), "CANDIDATE"),
    ("project_mention", _re.compile(
        r"(?i)\b(project|camper|werkplaats|workshop|printer|insta360|"
        r"linux|laptop|node|mission|research|inventory)\b"), "OBSERVATION"),
]


def analyze_import(conversation_id: str) -> dict:
    """Deterministic analysis. Findings are OBSERVATION/CANDIDATE only."""
    from .database import chat_connection, dump
    meta = get_import(conversation_id)
    if meta is None:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("Unknown imported conversation")
    messages = import_messages(conversation_id)
    if not messages:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("Imported conversation has no messages")
    findings: list[dict] = []
    seen_sentences: dict[str, list[int]] = {}
    for index, message in enumerate(messages):
        role = str(message.get("role", "user"))
        for sentence in _sentences(str(message.get("content", ""))):
            norm = _re.sub(r"\s+", " ", sentence.strip().lower())[:200]
            if norm:
                seen_sentences.setdefault(norm, []).append(index)
            for kind, pattern, state in _FINDING_RULES:
                if pattern.search(sentence):
                    findings.append({
                        "kind": kind, "state": state,
                        "text": sentence[:280],
                        "message_index": index,
                        "message_role": role,
                        "message_id": str(message.get("message_id", "")),
                        "evidence": sentence[:200],
                        "conversation_id": conversation_id})
                    break
            for entity in _ENTITY_RE.findall(sentence):
                pass
            for match in _ENTITY_RE.finditer(sentence):
                findings.append({
                    "kind": "entity_mention", "state": "CANDIDATE",
                    "text": f"Mogelijke entity-verwijzing: {match.group(0)}",
                    "message_index": index, "message_role": role,
                    "message_id": str(message.get("message_id", "")),
                    "evidence": sentence[:200],
                    "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                    "entity_candidate": match.group(0)})
            for match in _URL_RE.finditer(sentence):
                findings.append({
                    "kind": "source_reference", "state": "OBSERVATION",
                    "text": f"Bronverwijzing (niet opgehaald): "
                            f"{match.group(0)[:120]}",
                    "message_index": index, "message_role": role,
                    "message_id": str(message.get("message_id", "")),
                    "evidence": sentence[:200],
                    "conversation_id": conversation_id})
                break
    repeats: list[dict] = []
    for norm, indices in seen_sentences.items():
        unique = sorted(set(indices))
        if len(unique) >= 2 and len(norm) > 24:
            repeats.append({
                "kind": "repeated_topic", "state": "OBSERVATION",
                "text": f"Herhaald onderwerp ({len(unique)}x): "
                        f"{norm[:180]}",
                "message_index": unique[0],
                "message_role": "",
                "message_id": "",
                "evidence": f"messages {unique[:6]}",
                "conversation_id": conversation_id})
    contradictions: list[dict] = []
    lowered = [(idx, str(msg.get("content", "")).lower())
               for idx, msg in enumerate(messages)]
    for word in ("printer", "camera", "node", "printer", "research",
                 "project", "inventory"):
        positive = [idx for idx, text in lowered
                    if f" {word}" in f" {text}" and "werkt" in text]
        negative = [idx for idx, text in lowered
                    if word in text and ("niet" in text or "geen" in text
                                         or "not " in text)]
        if positive and negative:
            contradictions.append({
                "kind": "possible_contradiction", "state": "CANDIDATE",
                "text": f"Mogelijke tegenspraak over '{word}': "
                        f"positief in message {positive[0]}, "
                        f"negatief in message {negative[0]}",
                "message_index": negative[0],
                "message_role": "",
                "message_id": "",
                "evidence": f"messages {positive[0]} vs {negative[0]}",
                "conversation_id": conversation_id})
            if len(contradictions) >= 5:
                break
    contains_health = any(
        _HEALTH_RE.search(str(msg.get("content", "")))
        for msg in messages)
    record = {
        "conversation_id": conversation_id,
        "created_at": _now(),
        "message_count": len(messages),
        "contains_health": bool(contains_health),
        "findings": (findings[:120] + repeats[:10]
                     + contradictions[:5])[:140],
        "counts": {
            "findings": len(findings),
            "repeated_topics": len(repeats),
            "possible_contradictions": len(contradictions)},
        "note": "Deterministische extractie. Alles is OBSERVATION of "
                "CANDIDATE; niets is als feit opgeslagen. Promotie naar "
                "memory loopt via de bestaande provenance-flow.",
        "provenance": {"source_type": "ai-generated",
                       "creator_id": "conversation-analysis",
                       "human_verified": False},
    }
    init_bridge_tables()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO conversation_analyses
        (conversation_id, record, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(conversation_id) DO UPDATE SET record=excluded.record,
        created_at=excluded.created_at""",
                   (conversation_id, dump(record), record["created_at"]))
    return record


def load_analysis(conversation_id: str) -> dict | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, load
    init_bridge_tables()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT record FROM conversation_analyses WHERE "
            "conversation_id=?", (conversation_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return load(row["record"])


# -- missed items --------------------------------------------------------------

_INVENTORY_HINT_RE = _re.compile(
    r"(?i)\b(object|spullen|voorraad|inventory|obj_|hardware|sensor|"
    r"onderdeel|parts?)\b")
_FAB_HINT_RE = _re.compile(
    r"(?i)\b(3d|print|slic|stl|gcode|g-code|filament|mesh|printer)\b")


def missed_items(conversation_id: str,
                 analysis: dict | None = None) -> list[dict]:
    """'What did we miss?' — only evidence-backed suggestions."""
    record = analysis or load_analysis(conversation_id)
    if record is None:
        record = analyze_import(conversation_id)
    findings = record.get("findings", [])
    messages = import_messages(conversation_id)
    full_text = "\n".join(str(msg.get("content", ""))
                          for msg in messages)
    entity_mentions = {str(item.get("entity_candidate", ""))
                       for item in findings
                       if item.get("kind") == "entity_mention"}
    entity_mentions.discard("")
    has_url = any(item.get("kind") == "source_reference"
                  for item in findings)
    missed: list[dict] = []

    def add(kind: str, text: str, evidence: str,
            message_index: int | None) -> None:
        missed.append({"kind": kind, "state": "CANDIDATE", "text": text,
                       "evidence": evidence[:220],
                       "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                       "message_index": message_index})

    for item in findings:
        if item.get("kind") in ("idea", "todo", "open_question",
                                "proposed_action") \
                and not entity_mentions \
                and item.get("kind") != "open_question":
            add("unlinked_topic",
                "Dit onderwerp werd besproken maar is niet gekoppeld "
                "aan een project of entity.",
                str(item.get("evidence", "")), item.get("message_index"))
            break
    for item in findings:
        if item.get("kind") == "idea":
            add("idea_without_task",
                "Dit idee werd genoemd maar heeft nog geen task of "
                "missie.",
                str(item.get("evidence", "")), item.get("message_index"))
            break
    claims = [item for item in findings
              if item.get("kind") == "technical_claim"]
    if claims and not has_url:
        first = claims[0]
        add("claim_without_source",
            "Deze technische claim heeft nog geen bron.",
            str(first.get("evidence", "")), first.get("message_index"))
    if _INVENTORY_HINT_RE.search(full_text) and not entity_mentions:
        add("inventory_gap",
            "Dit onderdeel lijkt relevant voor INVENTory maar heeft "
            "geen entity-koppeling.",
            full_text[_INVENTORY_HINT_RE.search(full_text).start()  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                      - 60:_INVENTORY_HINT_RE.search(full_text).start()  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                      + 120], None)
    if _FAB_HINT_RE.search(full_text) and not entity_mentions:
        add("fabrication_gap",
            "Dit gesprek noemt een 3D/print-workflow die nog niet aan "
            "een model of file is gekoppeld.",
            full_text[_FAB_HINT_RE.search(full_text).start()  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                      - 60:_FAB_HINT_RE.search(full_text).start()  # type: ignore[union-attr]
                      + 120], None)
    for item in findings:
        if item.get("kind") == "open_question":
            add("open_question",
                "Dit gesprek bevat een open vraag die nog wacht op een "
                "antwoord.",
                str(item.get("evidence", "")), item.get("message_index"))
            break
    return missed[:10]


# -- cross-import archaeology (BIG #31) ----------------------------------------

_COMPARE_WORD_RE = _re.compile(r"[a-zA-Z0-9]{4,}")


def _compare_key(sentence: str) -> str:
    words = sorted({word.lower() for word in
                    _COMPARE_WORD_RE.findall(sentence or "")})
    return " ".join(words[:12])


def compare_imports(limit: int = 10) -> dict:
    """Compare all imported conversations: repeated topics across
    imports, shared platforms, shared entity candidates. Every
    comparison carries evidence (which conversations, which
    messages). Deterministic, read-only."""
    metas = list_imports(limit=20)
    analyses: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for meta in metas:
        conversation_id = meta["conversation_id"]
        try:
            analyses[conversation_id] = (
                load_analysis(conversation_id)
                or analyze_import(conversation_id))
        except BridgeRefusedError:
            continue
    by_sentence: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
    for conversation_id, record in analyses.items():
        for item in record.get("findings", []):
            if item.get("kind") not in (
                    "idea", "todo", "open_question", "decision",
                    "technical_claim", "proposed_action"):
                continue
            key = _compare_key(str(item.get("text", "")))
            if len(key) < 12:
                continue
            by_sentence.setdefault(key, []).append({
                "conversation_id": conversation_id,
                "message_index": item.get("message_index"),
                "kind": item.get("kind", ""),
                "text": str(item.get("text", ""))[:180],
            })
    repeated = [
        {"topic": key[:160], "state": "OBSERVATION",
         "occurrences": occurrences}
        for key, occurrences in by_sentence.items()
        if len({occ["conversation_id"] for occ in occurrences}) >= 2
    ][: max(1, min(int(limit or 10), 20))]
    platforms: dict[str, int] = {}
    for meta in metas:
        platform = str(meta.get("source_platform", "other"))
        platforms[platform] = platforms.get(platform, 0) + 1
    shared_entities: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for conversation_id, record in analyses.items():
        for item in record.get("findings", []):
            candidate = str(item.get("entity_candidate", ""))
            if candidate:
                shared_entities.setdefault(candidate, []).append(
                    conversation_id)
    shared = {entity: sorted(set(conversations))
              for entity, conversations in shared_entities.items()
              if len(set(conversations)) >= 2}
    return {"imports_compared": len(analyses),
            "repeated_across_imports": repeated,
            "platforms": platforms,
            "shared_entity_candidates": dict(list(shared.items())[:20]),
            "note": "Herhaling over gesprekken heen is een OBSERVATION "
                    "met evidence; koppeling aan projecten blijft "
                    "mensenwerk."}


def render_import_markdown(conversation_id: str) -> str:
    """One import as portable Markdown (OPEN AS MARKDOWN): messages,
    analysis states, missed items, provenance. For reading and
    re-importing elsewhere — never authority."""
    meta = get_import(conversation_id)
    if meta is None:
        raise BridgeRefusedError("Unknown imported conversation")
    messages = import_messages(conversation_id)
    analysis = load_analysis(conversation_id) or {}
    lines = [f"# {meta.get('title', conversation_id)}", "",
             f"source_platform: {meta.get('source_platform', '')}",
             f"imported_at: {meta.get('imported_at', '')}",
             f"messages: {meta.get('message_count', 0)}",
             f"execution_state: {meta.get('execution_state', '')}",
             "provenance: imported / human_verified=false", "",
             "## Messages", ""]
    for message in messages:
        lines.append(f"### {message.get('role', 'user')}")
        lines.append(str(message.get("content", ""))[:3500])
        lines.append("")
    lines.append("## Analysis (OBSERVATION / CANDIDATE — never fact)")
    lines.append("")
    for item in analysis.get("findings", [])[:60]:
        lines.append(
            f"- [{item.get('state', '')}] {item.get('kind', '')}: "
            f"{str(item.get('text', ''))[:220]} "
            f"(evidence: {str(item.get('evidence', ''))[:140]})")
    if not analysis.get("findings"):
        lines.append("- (not analyzed yet)")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("## What was missed")
    lines.append("")
    for item in missed_items(conversation_id, analysis or None)[:10]:
        lines.append(
            f"- {item.get('kind', '')}: "
            f"{str(item.get('text', ''))[:220]}")
    return "\n".join(lines)[:60000]

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/craft.py">
"""Craft Tree (BIG #33): from idea to made thing, on real records.

Stages (presentational order, every node clickable to its real
record):

    IDEA -> PROJECT -> REQUIREMENTS -> MATERIALS -> COMPONENTS
    -> MACHINES -> 3D MODEL -> FABRICATION -> RESULT
    -> OBSERVATION -> IMPROVEMENT -> NEW PROJECT

Nothing is invented: each stage lists entities that explicitly
reference the focus entity (inventory neighborhood, linked
research dossiers, missions using it as context, files,
observations, fabrications). Gaps name what is missing and
where to act ("No 3D model linked yet — open the 3D
workshop"), never fake nodes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from .symbiosis import clean_entity

#: Presentational stage order with the growth glyph per stage.
STAGES = (
    ("idea", "🌱", "Idea"),
    ("project", "🌿", "Project"),
    ("requirements", "📋", "Requirements"),
    ("materials", "🪵", "Materials"),
    ("components", "🔩", "Components"),
    ("machines", "⚙️", "Machines"),
    ("model_3d", "🧊", "3D model"),
    ("fabrication", "🛠", "Fabrication"),
    ("result", "🎁", "Result"),
    ("observation", "👁", "Observation"),
    ("improvement", "🌱", "Improvement"),
    ("new_project", "🌳", "New project"),
)

_IDEAS = ("idea",)
_PROJECTS = ("project",)
_MATERIALS = ("object", "file")
_COMPONENTS = ("object", "hardware", "sensor", "actuator")
_MACHINES = ("hardware", "node", "printer", "device")
_MODELS = ("file", "model", "artifact")
_FABRICATION = ("print_job", "artifact", "fabrication")
_OBSERVATIONS = ("observation", "event", "memory", "candidate")


def _bucket(node_type: str) -> str:
    kind = str(node_type or "").lower()
    if kind in _IDEAS:
        return "idea"
    if kind in _PROJECTS:
        return "project"
    if kind in _MATERIALS and kind == "file":
        return "materials"
    if kind in _COMPONENTS:
        return "components"
    if kind in _MACHINES:
        return "machines"
    if kind in _MODELS:
        return "model_3d"
    if kind in _FABRICATION:
        return "fabrication"
    if kind in _OBSERVATIONS:
        return "observation"
    if kind in ("mission", "research", "conversation"):
        return "requirements"
    if kind == "object":
        return "materials"
    return "requirements"


def _node_link(node: dict) -> dict:
    ident = str(node.get("id", ""))
    kind = str(node.get("type", node.get("kind", "")))
    label = str(node.get("label", ident))[:80]
    source = str(node.get("source", ""))
    if ident.startswith(("obj_", "proj_", "idea_", "loc_",
                         "hw_", "file_")):
        href = f"/world?entity_id={ident}"
    elif ident.startswith("mem_"):
        href = "/memory"
    elif ident.startswith("mission_"):
        href = f"/missions/{ident}"
    elif ident.startswith("conv_"):
        href = f"/conversations/{ident}"
    elif ident.startswith("cand_"):
        href = "/knowledge"
    else:
        href = "/world"
    return {"id": ident, "kind": kind, "label": label,
            "source": source, "href": href}


async def craft_tree(entity_id: str, depth: int = 1) -> dict:
    """Build the craft tree around one focus entity."""
    from .ecosystem import entity_context
    cleaned = clean_entity(entity_id)
    context = await entity_context(
        cleaned, depth if depth in (1, 2) else 1)
    stages: dict[str, list[dict]] = {
        key: [] for key, _, _ in STAGES
    }
    entity_node = context.get("entity") or {}
    if entity_node:
        bucket = _bucket(entity_node.get("type"))
        stages[bucket].append(_node_link({
            "id": cleaned,
            "type": entity_node.get("type", ""),
            "label": entity_node.get("label", cleaned),
            "source": entity_node.get("source", "inventory"),
        }))
    graph_nodes: dict[str, dict] = {}
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        graph, _ = await _main._graph_data(
            cleaned, depth if depth in (1, 2) else 1,
            {"missions", "nodes", "research", "observations",
             "printers", "memory", "candidates",
             "conversations"})
        for node in graph.get("nodes", []):
            if str(node.get("id")) == cleaned:
                continue
            graph_nodes[str(node.get("id"))] = node
    except Exception:
        graph_nodes = {}
    for node in graph_nodes.values():
        link = _node_link(node)
        bucket = _bucket(node.get("type", node.get("kind")))
        if len(stages[bucket]) < 12:
            stages[bucket].append(link)
    gaps: list[dict] = []
    if not stages["idea"]:
        gaps.append({"missing": "idea",
                     "hint": "No seed idea linked yet.",
                     "href": "/conversations"})
    if not stages["project"]:
        gaps.append({"missing": "project",
                     "hint": "No project carries this yet.",
                     "href": "/projects"})
    if not stages["components"] and not stages["materials"]:
        gaps.append({"missing": "materials",
                     "hint": "No materials or components linked.",
                     "href": "/search"})
    if not stages["machines"]:
        gaps.append({"missing": "machines",
                     "hint": "No machine or node can build this yet.",
                     "href": "/nodes"})
    if not stages["model_3d"]:
        gaps.append({"missing": "model_3d",
                     "hint": "No 3D model linked yet.",
                     "href": "/workshop/3d"})
    if not stages["fabrication"]:
        gaps.append({"missing": "fabrication",
                     "hint": "Nothing fabricated from this yet.",
                     "href": "/fabrication"})
    if not stages["observation"]:
        gaps.append({"missing": "observation",
                     "hint": "No observation feeds back yet.",
                     "href": "/cameras"})
    present = sum(1 for key in stages if stages[key])
    if present >= 10:
        growth = "bloom"
    elif present >= 6:
        growth = "growing"
    elif present >= 3:
        growth = "sprout"
    else:
        growth = "seed"
    ordered = [{"key": key, "glyph": glyph, "title": title,
                "nodes": stages[key]}
               for key, glyph, title in STAGES]
    return {
        "entity_id": cleaned,
        "stages": ordered,
        "gaps": gaps,
        "growth": growth,
        "stages_present": present,
        "error": context.get("error", ""),
        "honesty": "Every node is a real record that references "
                   "this entity. Gaps are missing links, not "
                   "predictions.",
    }


#: Chain states (BIG #41 craft foundation). COMPLETE means
#: linked evidence is present (never "work finished");
#: ACTIVE means linked work is in flight; BLOCKED means a
#: linked record failed or blocked; MISSING means the stage
#: is empty. Evidence ids are always listed.
STAGE_STATE_GLYPHS = {
    "complete": "✓",
    "active": "●",
    "missing": "○",
    "blocked": "!",
}

_MISSION_ACTIVE = ("approved", "running", "paused",
                   "pending_approval")
_MISSION_BLOCKED = ("failed", "blocked")
_FABJOB_ACTIVE = ("observed", "verifying")
_FABJOB_BLOCKED = ("blocked", "failed")
_FAB_ACTIVE = ("proposed", "approved", "ready", "waiting")
_FAB_BLOCKED = ("failed", "blocked")


def _live_work_status() -> tuple[dict, dict, dict]:
    """Live work statuses keyed by record id. Best-effort:
    empty maps on any failure (stages then show evidence-only
    states, never blocked/active without proof)."""
    missions: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        from .missions import list_missions
        for mission in list_missions(limit=100):
            missions[str(mission.mission_id)] = str(
                mission.status or "")
    except Exception:
        pass
    jobs: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        from .workshop3d import list_fabjobs
        for job in list_fabjobs(limit=100):
            if isinstance(job, dict) and job.get("job_id"):
                jobs[str(job["job_id"])] = str(
                    job.get("stage", ""))
    except Exception:
        pass
    fabs: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        for record in _main.list_fabrications(50):
            fab_id = str(getattr(
                record, "fabrication_id",
                getattr(record, "job_id", "")))
            if fab_id:
                fabs[fab_id] = str(getattr(record, "status",
                                           ""))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return missions, jobs, fabs


def stage_states(tree: dict) -> list[dict]:
    """Annotate craft-tree stages with chain states. Pure
    derivation over a craft_tree() result + live work maps."""
    missions, jobs, fabs = _live_work_status()
    gaps = {str(gap.get("missing", "")): gap
            for gap in (tree.get("gaps", []) or [])
            if isinstance(gap, dict)}
    annotated: list[dict] = []
    for stage in tree.get("stages", []) or []:
        key = str(stage.get("key", ""))
        nodes = [node for node in (stage.get("nodes", []) or [])
                 if isinstance(node, dict)]
        if not nodes:
            annotated.append({
                "key": key, "state": "missing",
                "glyph": STAGE_STATE_GLYPHS["missing"],
                "evidence": [],
                "missing": gaps.get(key, {})})
            continue
        evidence: list[str] = []
        blocked: list[str] = []
        active: list[str] = []
        for node in nodes:
            ident = str(node.get("id", ""))
            if not ident:
                continue
            status = missions.get(ident, jobs.get(
                ident, fabs.get(ident, "")))
            if not status:
                evidence.append(ident)
                continue
            if status in _MISSION_BLOCKED + _FABJOB_BLOCKED + \
                    _FAB_BLOCKED:
                blocked.append(f"{ident} [{status}]")
            elif status in _MISSION_ACTIVE + _FABJOB_ACTIVE + \
                    _FAB_ACTIVE:
                active.append(f"{ident} [{status}]")
            else:
                evidence.append(f"{ident} [{status}]")
        if blocked:
            state = "blocked"
        elif active:
            state = "active"
        else:
            state = "complete"
        annotated.append({
            "key": key, "state": state,
            "glyph": STAGE_STATE_GLYPHS[state],
            "evidence": (blocked + active + evidence)[:12],
            "missing": gaps.get(key, {})})
    return annotated
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/decisions.py">
"""Deterministic step decisions (BIG #24).

Upgrades the BIG #21 loop ``plan -> step -> result -> next`` to
``plan -> execute -> observe -> evaluate -> decide`` where the
decision passes deterministic policy validation.

Decision states (closed): CONTINUE, RETRY, REPLAN,
WAITING_FOR_HUMAN, WAITING_FOR_AGENT, BLOCKED, FAILED,
COMPLETED, CANCELLED.

Rules (fail-closed, all tested):

- This module NEVER mutates mission state. It reads a step
  outcome and returns a decision; the caller (loop/executor)
  applies it through the existing validated transitions.
- The LLM never decides: provider advice is input evidence at
  most, never a state transition.
- A failed step never fails the whole mission by itself: retry
  while attempts remain, then REPLAN (human approves the new
  plan), then BLOCKED.
- RETRY is bounded (MAX_ATTEMPTS) with backoff seconds; when
  the budget is exhausted the decision becomes REPLAN for
  safe kinds and BLOCKED for gated kinds.
- Anything requiring human authority (approvals, writes,
  physical, publish, credentials) decides WAITING_FOR_HUMAN
  and names the exact gate — never a vague "approval required".
- Dispatched-but-unclaimed agent work decides WAITING_FOR_AGENT.
- COMPLETED/CANCELLED only mirror terminal states the
  executor already reached; this module never declares them
  from a non-terminal step.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

DECISIONS = (
    "CONTINUE",
    "RETRY",
    "REPLAN",
    "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN",
    "WAITING_FOR_AGENT",
    "BLOCKED",
    "FAILED",
    "COMPLETED",
    "CANCELLED",
)

#: Step kinds the loop may retry or continue on its own. Anything
#: gated (desktop input, writes, physical) always waits for a human.
SAFE_KINDS = frozenset({"readout", "analysis", "camera_observe",
                         "research"})

#: Kinds that always need an explicit human YES somewhere.
GATED_KINDS = frozenset(
    {"desktop", "write", "proposal", "fabricate", "slice",
     "physical_print"})

MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS = (5, 30, 120)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class StepOutcome:
    """What the executor observed for one step. Plain data."""

    kind: str = "readout"
    step_status: str = "pending"
    ok: bool = False
    error: str = ""
    attempts: int = 0
    waiting_detail: str = ""
    mission_status: str = "running"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Decision:
    """The validated next move. Data only — never an approval."""

    state: str = "BLOCKED"
    reason: str = ""
    retry_in_seconds: int = 0
    needs: dict = field(default_factory=dict)


def decide(outcome: StepOutcome) -> Decision:
    """Evaluate one step outcome into a decision. Pure function."""
    if not isinstance(outcome, StepOutcome):
        raise ValueError("decide needs a StepOutcome")
    kind = str(outcome.kind or "")
    step_status = str(outcome.step_status or "")
    mission_status = str(outcome.mission_status or "")

    if mission_status == "cancelled":
        return Decision("CANCELLED", "Mission was cancelled; loop stops.")
    if mission_status == "completed":
        return Decision("COMPLETED", "Mission already completed.")
    if mission_status in ("failed", "blocked"):
        state = "FAILED" if mission_status == "failed" else "BLOCKED"
        return Decision(
            state, f"Mission is {mission_status}; a human reviews.")

    if step_status == "completed" and outcome.ok:
        return Decision(
            "CONTINUE",
            f"Step ({kind or 'unknown'}) succeeded; next step is safe "
            "to evaluate.")

    if step_status == "waiting_approval":
        return Decision(
            "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN",
            "Desktop input waits for an exact human YES. The loop "
            "never approves input.",
            needs={"gate": "desktop_action_decision",
                   "detail": outcome.waiting_detail[:200]})
    if step_status == "dispatched":
        return Decision(
            "WAITING_FOR_AGENT",
            "Action is dispatched to a desktop agent; the loop waits "
            "for its report, then continues.",
            needs={"gate": "agent_report",
                   "detail": outcome.waiting_detail[:200]})
    if step_status == "skipped":
        return Decision(
            "CONTINUE", "Step was skipped by policy; evaluate the next.")

    if step_status in ("failed", "blocked"):
        return _on_failure(kind, outcome)

    if step_status == "pending":
        if kind in GATED_KINDS:
            return Decision(
                "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN",
                f"A {kind} step needs its own explicit approval "
                "before it runs.",
                needs={"gate": kind,
                       "detail": outcome.waiting_detail[:200]})
        return Decision(
            "CONTINUE",
            f"Step ({kind or 'unknown'}) is pending and read-only; "
            "safe to tick.")

    return Decision(
        "BLOCKED",
        f"Unknown step status '{step_status[:40]}'; refusing to guess.")


def _on_failure(kind: str, outcome: StepOutcome) -> Decision:
    attempts = outcome.attempts
    try:
        attempts = int(attempts)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        attempts = MAX_ATTEMPTS
    if attempts < 0:
        attempts = 0
    if kind in SAFE_KINDS and attempts < MAX_ATTEMPTS:
        wait = RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS[
            min(attempts, len(RETRY_BACKOFF_SECONDS) - 1)]
        return Decision(
            "RETRY",
            f"Read-only step failed (attempt {attempts + 1}/"
            f"{MAX_ATTEMPTS}); retry with backoff, mission continues.",
            retry_in_seconds=wait)
    if kind in SAFE_KINDS:
        return Decision(
            "REPLAN",
            "Read-only step exhausted its retries; the mission needs "
            "a revised plan (new human approval), it does not fail "
            "silently.",
            needs={"gate": "plan_approval"})
    return Decision(
        "WAITING_FOR_HUMAN" if kind in GATED_KINDS else "BLOCKED",
        f"Step ({kind or 'unknown'}) {outcome.step_status}; "
        f"{outcome.error[:200] or 'no detail'}. A human decides "
        "whether to replan or stop.",
        needs={"gate": kind or "review",
               "detail": outcome.error[:200]})
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/diststate.py">
"""Durable distributed state foundation (BIG #10, deel 1).

Event/change-log based synchronization instead of database
copies: origins emit small envelopes, receivers apply them
idempotently, conflicts become explicit records. No blind
last-write-wins for important state.

Envelope fields:

- event_id (stable, ``dsevt_`` + time-hex + randomness)
- origin_node_id (who emitted; never trusted blindly)
- entity_id / entity_type (what it concerns)
- entity_revision (opaque revision supplied by the origin,
  e.g. INVENTory ``updated_at``; compared as text)
- base_revision (revision this change was built on; empty
  means "create/unknown")
- event_type (closed set below)
- timestamp (origin clock, ISO)
- payload (small capped dict, never executable content)
- provenance (preserved end to end)
- epoch (coordinator fencing epoch when relevant, else 0)

Apply semantics (all fail-closed):

- unknown event_id → record + apply, advance cursor;
- known event_id → acknowledge as duplicate, no second
  mutation (idempotent);
- same entity + same base_revision + different payload hash
  from another origin → conflict record, neither version
  silently changed, both provenances preserved;
- same entity + newer-or-equal base already applied with
  identical payload hash → duplicate, no mutation;
- out-of-order arrival is safe: ordering never decides truth,
  only base_revision matching does.

Deterministic merge exists ONLY for the whitelisted
technical-metadata keys below (cursor positions, last-seen
hints); everything else conflicts explicitly.

INVENTory stays source of truth for world entities: these
envelopes carry change notifications and coordinator state,
never a second copy of world rows. Mycelium never opens the
INVENTory SQLite file; the bridge stays HTTP.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

DistEventType = Literal[
    "entity.observed",
    "entity.proposed",
    "task.state",
    "node.presence",
    "coordinator.epoch",
    "sync.cursor",
    "sync.conflict",
    "sync.resolved",
]
VALID_DIST_EVENT_TYPES = frozenset({
    "entity.observed",
    "entity.proposed",
    "task.state",
    "node.presence",
    "coordinator.epoch",
    "sync.cursor",
    "sync.conflict",
    "sync.resolved",
})

#: Payload keys eligible for deterministic technical merge.
#: Everything else conflicts explicitly on concurrent change.
MERGEABLE_METADATA_KEYS = frozenset({
    "cursor",
    "last_seen",
    "attempt_count_hint",
})

MAX_DIST_PAYLOAD_KEYS = 30
MAX_DIST_PAYLOAD_VALUE_CHARS = 1000
MAX_ENTITY_ID_CHARS = 100
MAX_REVISION_CHARS = 120
SYNC_BATCH_LIMIT = 100


class DistStateRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was recorded or applied."""


class DistEnvelope(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    event_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    origin_node_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    entity_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_ENTITY_ID_CHARS)
    entity_type: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    entity_revision: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_REVISION_CHARS)
    base_revision: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_REVISION_CHARS)
    event_type: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    timestamp: str = ""
    payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)
    epoch: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)


class DistConflict(BaseModel):
    """Explicit conflict record. Both versions preserved, neither
    silently changed; resolution happens later by a human or an
    approved flow, never automatically."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    conflict_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    entity_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_ENTITY_ID_CHARS)
    base_revision: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_REVISION_CHARS)
    first_event_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    second_event_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    first_origin: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    second_origin: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    status: str = Field(default="open", max_length=20)
    created_at: str = ""
    notes: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_dist_event_id() -> str:
    return f"dsevt_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def generate_conflict_id() -> str:
    return f"dscon_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def payload_hash(payload: dict) -> str:
    canonical = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True,
                           separators=(",", ":"))
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _check_payload(payload) -> dict:
    """Envelope payloads: shared security rules, envelope
    limits. Raises DistStateRefusedError (callers unchanged)."""
    from .payloads import check_payload
    return check_payload(
        payload, max_keys=MAX_DIST_PAYLOAD_KEYS,
        max_value_chars=MAX_DIST_PAYLOAD_VALUE_CHARS,
        error=DistStateRefusedError)


def new_envelope(origin_node_id: str, entity_id: str,
                 entity_type: str, event_type: str, *,
                 entity_revision: str = "",
                 base_revision: str = "",
                 payload: dict | None = None,
                 provenance: Provenance | None = None,
                 epoch: int = 0) -> DistEnvelope:
    """Build one validated envelope. Fail-closed on every field."""
    if not isinstance(origin_node_id, str) or not origin_node_id.strip():
        raise DistStateRefusedError("origin_node_id must be text")
    if not isinstance(entity_id, str) or not entity_id.strip() \
            or len(entity_id) > MAX_ENTITY_ID_CHARS:
        raise DistStateRefusedError("entity_id must be 1..100 chars")
    if not isinstance(entity_type, str) or not entity_type.strip() \
            or len(entity_type) > 40:
        raise DistStateRefusedError("entity_type must be 1..40 chars")
    if event_type not in VALID_DIST_EVENT_TYPES:
        raise DistStateRefusedError(
            f"Unknown distributed event type '{event_type}'")
    try:
        clean_epoch = int(epoch)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise DistStateRefusedError("epoch must be an integer")
    if clean_epoch < 0:
        raise DistStateRefusedError("epoch must be >= 0")
    return DistEnvelope(
        event_id=generate_dist_event_id(),
        origin_node_id=origin_node_id.strip()[:80],
        entity_id=entity_id.strip(),
        entity_type=entity_type.strip(),
        entity_revision=str(entity_revision or "")[
            :MAX_REVISION_CHARS],
        base_revision=str(base_revision or "")[:MAX_REVISION_CHARS],
        event_type=event_type,
        timestamp=now(),
        payload=_check_payload(payload),
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="sensor-observed",
            creator_id=f"dist:{origin_node_id.strip()[:80]}",
            human_verified=False,
            notes="distributed change envelope; application is "
                  "idempotent and never auto-verified"),
        epoch=clean_epoch)


def new_conflict(entity_id: str, base_revision: str,
                 first_id: str, second_id: str,
                 first_origin: str = "",
                 second_origin: str = "",
                 notes: str = "") -> DistConflict:
    return DistConflict(
        conflict_id=generate_conflict_id(),
        entity_id=entity_id, base_revision=base_revision,
        first_event_id=first_id, second_event_id=second_id,
        first_origin=first_origin[:80],
        second_origin=second_origin[:80],
        created_at=now(), notes=str(notes or "")[:1000])


def mergeable_update(current: dict, incoming: dict) -> dict | None:
    """Deterministic merge for whitelisted technical metadata.
    Returns the merged dict, or None when the incoming payload
    carries anything outside the mergeable set (→ conflict)."""
    if not isinstance(current, dict) or not isinstance(incoming,
                                                       dict):
        return None
    if any(key not in MERGEABLE_METADATA_KEYS for key in incoming):
        return None
    merged = dict(current)
    for key in MERGEABLE_METADATA_KEYS:
        if key in incoming:
            merged[key] = incoming[key]
    return merged


# -- durable log (chat DB; queue DB untouched, INVENTory untouched) --

def save_envelope(envelope: DistEnvelope) -> bool:
    """Record one envelope. Returns True when newly applied,
    False when it was already known (idempotent duplicate).
    The insert is conflict-atomic so concurrent duplicates
    converge instead of raising."""
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        cursor = db.execute("""INSERT INTO dist_events
        (event_id, origin_node_id, entity_id, entity_type,
         entity_revision, base_revision, event_type, timestamp,
         payload, provenance, epoch, payload_hash, applied_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO NOTHING""",
                            (envelope.event_id,
                             envelope.origin_node_id,
                             envelope.entity_id,
                             envelope.entity_type,
                             envelope.entity_revision,
                             envelope.base_revision,
                             envelope.event_type,
                             envelope.timestamp,
                             dump(envelope.payload),
                             dump(envelope.provenance.model_dump(
                                 mode="json")),
                             envelope.epoch,
                             payload_hash(envelope.payload),
                             now()))
    return cursor.rowcount > 0


def known_event_ids(event_ids: list[str]) -> set[str]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    known: set[str] = set()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        for event_id in list(event_ids or [])[:SYNC_BATCH_LIMIT * 2]:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT event_id FROM dist_events WHERE event_id=?",
                (event_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is not None:
                known.add(event_id)
    return known


def entity_history(entity_id: str,
                   limit: int = 50) -> list[DistEnvelope]:
    """Applied envelopes for one entity, oldest first."""
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            """SELECT * FROM dist_events WHERE entity_id=?
            ORDER BY rowid ASC LIMIT ?""",
            (entity_id, max(1, min(limit, SYNC_BATCH_LIMIT)))).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_envelope(row, load) for row in rows]


def _row_to_envelope(row, load) -> DistEnvelope:
    from .inventory_read import Provenance as Prov
    raw_prov = load(row["provenance"]) if row["provenance"] else {}
    try:
        provenance = Prov.model_validate(
            raw_prov if isinstance(raw_prov, dict) else {})
    except ValueError:
        provenance = Prov()
    return DistEnvelope(
        event_id=row["event_id"],
        origin_node_id=row["origin_node_id"],
        entity_id=row["entity_id"],
        entity_type=row["entity_type"],
        entity_revision=row["entity_revision"] or "",
        base_revision=row["base_revision"] or "",
        event_type=row["event_type"],
        timestamp=row["timestamp"],
        payload=load(row["payload"]) if row["payload"] else {},
        provenance=provenance,
        epoch=row["epoch"] or 0)


def detect_conflict(envelope: DistEnvelope) -> DistConflict | None:
    """Compare one incoming envelope against applied history for
    the same entity. Returns a conflict when another origin
    changed the same base revision differently; None otherwise
    (including pure duplicates, handled by save_envelope)."""
    history = entity_history(envelope.entity_id,
                             limit=SYNC_BATCH_LIMIT)
    incoming_hash = payload_hash(envelope.payload)
    for applied in history:
        if applied.event_id == envelope.event_id:
            return None
        if payload_hash(applied.payload) == incoming_hash:
            continue
        if (envelope.base_revision
                and applied.base_revision == envelope.base_revision
                and applied.origin_node_id != envelope.origin_node_id):
            return new_conflict(
                envelope.entity_id, envelope.base_revision,
                applied.event_id, envelope.event_id,
                applied.origin_node_id, envelope.origin_node_id,
                notes="concurrent change of the same base "
                      "revision; both versions preserved")
    return None


def apply_envelope(envelope: DistEnvelope) -> dict:
    """Idempotent apply: fencing first (stale-epoch writers
    refuse), then payload revalidation; duplicate →
    acknowledged, conflict → recorded (envelope still stored
    for audit, never silently merged), else applied."""
    if not isinstance(envelope, DistEnvelope):
        raise DistStateRefusedError("apply needs a DistEnvelope")
    from .failover import require_writer_epoch
    require_writer_epoch(envelope.epoch)
    # Re-validate pulled payloads: they bypass new_envelope(), so
    # banned keys (shell/command/exec/...) must refuse here too.
    _check_payload(envelope.payload)
    conflict = detect_conflict(envelope)
    if conflict is not None:
        save_envelope(envelope)
        save_conflict(conflict)
        return {"status": "conflict",
                "event_id": envelope.event_id,
                "conflict_id": conflict.conflict_id}
    if not save_envelope(envelope):
        return {"status": "duplicate",
                "event_id": envelope.event_id}
    return {"status": "applied", "event_id": envelope.event_id}


def save_conflict(conflict: DistConflict) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO dist_conflicts
        (conflict_id, entity_id, base_revision, first_event_id,
         second_event_id, first_origin, second_origin, status,
         created_at, notes) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(conflict_id) DO NOTHING""",
                    (conflict.conflict_id, conflict.entity_id,
                     conflict.base_revision, conflict.first_event_id,
                     conflict.second_event_id, conflict.first_origin,
                     conflict.second_origin, conflict.status,
                     conflict.created_at, conflict.notes))


def list_conflicts(status: str = "", limit: int = 50
                   ) -> list[DistConflict]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        if status:
            if status not in ("open", "resolved"):
                raise DistStateRefusedError(
                    f"Unknown conflict status '{status}'")
            rows = db.execute(
                """SELECT * FROM dist_conflicts WHERE status=?
                ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?""",
                (status, max(1, min(limit, 100)))).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = db.execute(
                """SELECT * FROM dist_conflicts ORDER BY created_at
                DESC LIMIT ?""",
                (max(1, min(limit, 100)),)).fetchall()
    return [DistConflict(**{key: row[key] for key in (
        "conflict_id", "entity_id", "base_revision",
        "first_event_id", "second_event_id", "first_origin",
        "second_origin", "status", "created_at",
        "notes")}) for row in rows]


def resolve_conflict(conflict_id: str, resolution: str) -> bool:
    """Mark one conflict resolved (human/approved flow only).
    The versions themselves are never rewritten here."""
    if resolution not in ("resolved",):
        raise DistStateRefusedError(
            "conflicts resolve only as 'resolved'")
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        changed = db.execute(
            "UPDATE dist_conflicts SET status='resolved' WHERE "
            "conflict_id=? AND status='open'",
            (conflict_id,)).rowcount
    return changed == 1


def read_log(after_rowid: int = 0,
             limit: int = SYNC_BATCH_LIMIT) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
    """Bounded cursor read over the durable log. Returns
    (envelopes-as-dicts, latest rowid). No dumps."""
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_chat_database()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or SYNC_BATCH_LIMIT),
                       SYNC_BATCH_LIMIT))
    try:
        cursor = max(0, int(after_rowid or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise DistStateRefusedError("cursor must be an integer")
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            """SELECT rowid, * FROM dist_events WHERE rowid>?
            ORDER BY rowid ASC LIMIT ?""",
            (cursor, count)).fetchall()
        latest = db.execute(
            "SELECT MAX(rowid) AS m FROM dist_events").fetchone()
    items = []
    for row in rows:
        record = dict(row)
        record.pop("rowid", None)
        try:
            record["payload"] = load(record.get("payload") or "{}")
        except ValueError:
            record["payload"] = {}
        items.append(record)
    return items, (latest["m"] or 0) if latest else 0
