    <style>.forge-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px minmax(0,1fr) 250px;gap:var(--space-2)}
    @media (max-width:1080px){.forge-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}</style>
    <script>
    const ForgeSession = {selected_model:"",selected_part:"",selection:[],ai_edits:[],camera:{rot_x:0.5,rot_y:0.6,scale:1.0,ox:0.0,oy:0.0},parts:[],parameters:{},dirty:false,project_id:"",model_id:"",forked_from:{}};
    let FORGE_PRIMS = {}, FORGE_DATA = {}, FORGE_SEQ = 0, FORGE_PROPOSAL = null;
    const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
    function forgeLog(msg){ const li=document.createElement("li"); li.textContent=new Date().toISOString().slice(11,19)+" "+msg; $("forge-log").prepend(li); }
    function setDirty(d, why){ ForgeSession.dirty=d; const c=$("forge-dirty"); c.textContent=d?"DIRTY":"CLEAN"; if(d&&why) forgeLog(why); try{ persistLine(); }catch(e){} }
    function boxTris(w,h,d){ const hx=w/2,hy=h/2,hz=d/2;
      const c=[[-hx,-hy,-hz],[hx,-hy,-hz],[hx,hy,-hz],[-hx,hy,-hz],[-hx,-hy,hz],[hx,-hy,hz],[hx,hy,hz],[-hx,hy,hz]];
      const q=[[0,3,2,1],[4,5,6,7],[0,1,5,4],[2,3,7,6],[0,4,7,3],[1,2,6,5]]; const t=[];
      q.forEach(f=>{ const p=f.map(i=>c[i]); t.push([p[0],p[1],p[2]]); t.push([p[0],p[2],p[3]]); }); return t; }
    function partTris(p){ if(p.kind==="derived") return (p.tris||[]);
      if(p.kind==="cube") return boxTris(p.size.w,p.size.h,p.size.d);
      const base = (FORGE_PRIMS.cylinder && FORGE_PRIMS.cylinder.tris) || [];
      const sx=p.size.w/20, sy=p.size.h/20, sz=p.size.d/20;
      return base.map(t=>t.map(pt=>[pt[0]*sx,pt[1]*sy,pt[2]*sz])); }
    function xform(p, pt){ let [x,y,z]=pt;
      const r=p.rot||{x:0,y:0,z:0}, s=p.scale||{x:1,y:1,z:1};
      x*=s.x; y*=s.y; z*=s.z;
      const rad=d=>d*Math.PI/180; let a=rad(r.x),b=rad(r.y),g=rad(r.z);
      let y1=y*Math.cos(a)-z*Math.sin(a), z1=y*Math.sin(a)+z*Math.cos(a); y=y1; z=z1;
      let x1=x*Math.cos(b)+z*Math.sin(b); z1=-x*Math.sin(b)+z*Math.cos(b); x=x1; z=z1;
      x1=x*Math.cos(g)-y*Math.sin(g); y1=x*Math.sin(g)+y*Math.cos(g); x=x1; y=y1;
      const q=p.pos||{x:0,y:0,z:0}; return [x+q.x,y+q.y,z+q.z]; }
    function draw(){ const cv=$("forge-view"), ctx=cv.getContext("2d");
      ctx.clearRect(0,0,640,420); const cam=ForgeSession.camera;
      const proj=p=>{ const cx=Math.cos(cam.rot_y),sx=Math.sin(cam.rot_y),cy=Math.cos(cam.rot_x),sy=Math.sin(cam.rot_x);
        const x1=p[0]*cx-p[2]*sx, z1=p[0]*sx+p[2]*cx, y1=p[1]*cy-z1*sy;
        return [320+x1*cam.scale+cam.ox, 210-y1*cam.scale+cam.oy]; };
      ForgeSession.parts.forEach(p=>{ const sel=ForgeSession.selection.includes(p.id);
        ctx.strokeStyle=sel?"#d9a441":"#a5c48a"; ctx.lineWidth=sel?2:1; ctx.beginPath();
        partTris(p).forEach(t=>{ const a=t.map(q=>proj(xform(p,q)));
          ctx.moveTo(a[0][0],a[0][1]); ctx.lineTo(a[1][0],a[1][1]); ctx.lineTo(a[2][0],a[2][1]); ctx.closePath(); });
        ctx.stroke(); }); }
    function renderParts(){ const ul=$("forge-parts"); ul.innerHTML="";
      ForgeSession.parts.forEach(p=>{ const li=document.createElement("li");
        const sel=ForgeSession.selection.includes(p.id);
        li.innerHTML="<span class='"+(sel?"q-now":"q-todo")+"'>"+(sel?"●":"○")+"</span> ";
        const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href="#"; a.textContent=p.name+" ("+p.kind+")";
        a.onclick=e=>{e.preventDefault(); selectPart(p.id, e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey);}; li.appendChild(a); ul.appendChild(li); });
      if(!ForgeSession.parts.length) ul.innerHTML="<li>○ No parts — add a primitive.</li>"; }
    function selectPart(id, toggle){ const at=ForgeSession.selection.indexOf(id);
      if(toggle){ if(at>=0) ForgeSession.selection.splice(at,1); else ForgeSession.selection.push(id); }
      else ForgeSession.selection=[id];
      ForgeSession.selected_part=ForgeSession.selection[0]||"";
      const p=ForgeSession.parts.find(q=>q.id===id); renderParts(); renderProps(); draw(); selLine();
      if(p){ forgeLog((toggle?"part toggled: ":"part selected: ")+p.name); } }
    function selLine(){ const el=$("forge-selection");
      if(el) el.textContent=ForgeSession.selection.length?ForgeSession.selection.join(", "):"none"; }
    function renderProps(){ const p=ForgeSession.parts.find(q=>q.id===ForgeSession.selected_part);
      const box=$("forge-props"), hint=$("forge-design-hint");
      if(!p){ box.innerHTML="<p class='muted'>Select a part.</p>"; hint.innerHTML="<p class='muted'>No part selected.</p>"; return; }
      if(p.kind==="derived"){ const num=(id,val)=>"<label>"+id+" <input type='number' step='0.5' id='fp-"+id+"' value='"+val+"' style='width:4.2rem' aria-label='"+id+"'></label>";
        box.innerHTML="<b>"+p.name+"</b> <span class='muted'>imported geometry ("+(p.tris||[]).length+" tris, "+(p.validation||"?")+"), transform editable — dimensions read-only (source: "+String((p.source||{}).source||"?")+").</span><br>"
        +num("pos.x",p.pos.x)+num("pos.y",p.pos.y)+num("pos.z",p.pos.z)+"<br>"
        +num("rot.x",p.rot.x)+num("rot.y",p.rot.y)+num("rot.z",p.rot.z)+"<br>"
        +num("scale.x",p.scale.x)+num("scale.y",p.scale.y)+num("scale.z",p.scale.z);
        hint.innerHTML="<p>Imported part <b>"+p.name+"</b> — transform stays in ForgeSession until Save.</p>";
        box.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(inp=>{ inp.onchange=()=>{ applyProps(); }; }); return; }
      const num=(id,val)=>"<label>"+id+" <input type='number' step='0.5' id='fp-"+id+"' value='"+val+"' style='width:4.2rem' aria-label='"+id+"'></label>";
      box.innerHTML="<b>"+p.name+"</b> <span class='muted'>"+p.kind+"</span><br>"
        +num("pos.x",p.pos.x)+num("pos.y",p.pos.y)+num("pos.z",p.pos.z)+"<br>"
        +num("rot.x",p.rot.x)+num("rot.y",p.rot.y)+num("rot.z",p.rot.z)+"<br>"
        +num("scale.x",p.scale.x)+num("scale.y",p.scale.y)+num("scale.z",p.scale.z)+"<br>"
        +num("dim.w",p.size.w)+num("dim.h",p.size.h)+num("dim.d",p.size.d)+"<br>"
        +"<label>material <input type='text' id='fp-material' value='"+p.material+"' style='width:8rem' aria-label='Material'></label>";
      hint.innerHTML="<p>Editing <b>"+p.name+"</b> — changes stay in ForgeSession until Save.</p>";
      box.querySelectorAll("input").forEach(inp=>{ inp.onchange=()=>{ applyProps(); }; }); }
    function applyProps(){ const p=ForgeSession.parts.find(q=>q.id===ForgeSession.selected_part); if(!p) return;
      const g=id=>parseFloat($("fp-"+id).value)||0;
      p.pos={x:g("pos.x"),y:g("pos.y"),z:g("pos.z")}; p.rot={x:g("rot.x"),y:g("rot.y"),z:g("rot.z")};
      p.scale={x:g("scale.x")||1,y:g("scale.y")||1,z:g("scale.z")||1};
      if(p.kind!=="derived"){ p.size={w:Math.max(0.1,g("dim.w")||20),h:Math.max(0.1,g("dim.h")||20),d:Math.max(0.1,g("dim.d")||20)};
        p.material=$("fp-material").value.slice(0,80); }
      ForgeSession.parameters[p.id]={pos:p.pos,rot:p.rot,scale:p.scale,size:p.size,material:p.material};
      setDirty(true,"part changed: "+p.name); draw(); slicerEstimate(); }
    function addPart(kind, fromRegistry){ FORGE_SEQ+=1;
      const base=(FORGE_PRIMS[kind]&&FORGE_PRIMS[kind].tris)||[];
      const p={id:"part_"+FORGE_SEQ+"_"+kind,name:(fromRegistry||kind)+" #"+FORGE_SEQ,kind:kind,
        size:{w:20,h:20,d:20},pos:{x:0,y:0,z:0},rot:{x:0,y:0,z:0},scale:{x:1,y:1,z:1},material:"PLA",registry:fromRegistry||""};
      if(!base.length&&kind!=="cube"){ $("forge-status").textContent="Primitive '"+kind+"' unavailable."; return; }
      ForgeSession.parts.push(p); selectPart(p.id); setDirty(true,"part added: "+p.name); }
    function slicerEstimate(){ const p=ForgeSession.parts.find(q=>q.id===ForgeSession.selected_part);
      const box=$("sl-estimate"); if(!p){ box.innerHTML="<p class='muted'>Select a part for an estimate.</p>"; return; }
      const layer=parseFloat($("sl-layer").value)||0.28, infill=parseFloat($("sl-infill").value)||15;
      const vol=p.size.w*p.size.h*p.size.d/1000, layers=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(p.size.d/layer));
      const grams=(vol*1.24*(0.2+0.8*infill/100)).toFixed(1), mins=Math.round(layers*0.8);
      const warn=p.size.w>220||p.size.h>220||p.size.d>250?"<br><b>WARNING: exceeds 220x220x250mm build volume.</b><br>No overhang analysis — validator only.":"<br>No overhang analysis — validator only.";
      box.innerHTML="<p><b>SIMULATED estimate</b> (TEST slicer heuristics, never G-code): layers ~"+layers
        +", volume ~"+vol.toFixed(1)+"cm3, filament ~"+grams+"g PLA, time ~"+mins+"min."+warn+"</p>"; }
    async function loadSession(){ try{
        const r=await fetch("/api/v1/forge/session"); if(!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+r.status);
        FORGE_DATA=await r.json(); FORGE_PRIMS=FORGE_DATA.primitives||{};
        if(!ForgeSession.parts.length&&FORGE_PRIMS.cube){ addPart("cube"); setDirty(false); }
        renderInventory(); renderSlicer(); renderFabjobs(); renderPipeline(); loadEvents(); loadLibrary(); selLine();
        const id=(FORGE_DATA.identity||{}).name||"Forge";
        $("forge-status").textContent="Session live — "+ForgeSession.parts.length+" part(s), identity: "+id+".";
        try{ persistLine(); }catch(e){}
        forgeLog("model opened: default cube primitive (procedural)");
      }catch(e){ $("forge-status").textContent="Session failed: "+e+". Backend required."; } }
    function renderInventory(){ const inv=FORGE_DATA.inventory||{state:"UNAVAILABLE",results:[]};
      let html="<h3>Inventory</h3>";
      if(inv.state!=="REAL"||!inv.results.length){ html+="<p class='muted'>INVENTory: "+inv.state+" — editor model until Save. "+((inv.note||""))+"</p>"; }
      else{ html+="<ul>"; inv.results.slice(0,6).forEach(it=>{
          html+="<li><code>"+it.entity_id+"</code> <b>"+String(it.title||"").slice(0,50)+"</b><br><span class='muted'>"+it.entity_type+" · provenance "+String((it.provenance||{}).source_type||"?")+(it.provenance&&it.provenance.human_verified?" · VERIFIED":"")+"</span></li>"; });
        html+="</ul><p class='muted'>Provenance + status shown; Save wordt pas canoniek via /writes.</p>"; }
      const mods=(FORGE_DATA.workshop&&FORGE_DATA.workshop.models)||[];
      if(mods.length){ html+="<h3>Workshop models</h3><ul>"+mods.slice(0,5).map(m=>"<li><code>"+m.model_id+"</code> "+String(m.filename||"").slice(0,40)+" ["+m.status+"]</li>").join("")+"</ul>"; }
      $("forge-inventory").innerHTML=html; }
    function renderSlicer(){ const sl=FORGE_DATA.slicer||{};
      const pr=$("sl-printer"); pr.innerHTML="";
      (FORGE_DATA.printers||[]).forEach(p=>{ const o=document.createElement("option"); o.value=p.printer_id; o.textContent=p.name+" ["+p.state+"]"; pr.appendChild(o); });
      const sim=document.createElement("option"); sim.value=""; sim.textContent="Simulated (TEST slicer)"; pr.appendChild(sim);
      const prod=document.createElement("option"); prod.value="production"; prod.disabled=true;
      prod.textContent="Production [UNAVAILABLE]"; pr.appendChild(prod);
      const mat=$("sl-material"); mat.innerHTML="";
      ((FORGE_DATA.workshop&&FORGE_DATA.workshop.materials)||[{name:"PLA"},{name:"PETG"}]).slice(0,8).forEach(m=>{ const o=document.createElement("option"); o.textContent=m.name; mat.appendChild(o); });
      const prof=$("sl-profile"); prof.innerHTML="";
      (sl.profiles||["draft-pla"]).forEach(p=>{ const o=document.createElement("option"); o.textContent=p; prof.appendChild(o); });
      ["sl-printer","sl-material","sl-profile","sl-layer","sl-infill","sl-supports"].forEach(id=>{ $(id).onchange=slicerEstimate; });
      slicerEstimate(); }
    function forgeAct(jobId, action, fields, done){
      var body=new URLSearchParams();
      var f=fields||{};
      for(var k in f){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(f,k))body.append(k,f[k]);}
      fetch("/web/workshop/fabjobs/"+encodeURIComponent(jobId)+"/"+action,{method:"POST",body:body}).then(function(){loadSession();},function(){loadSession();});
    }
    function renderFabjobs(){ const jobs=((FORGE_DATA.workshop||{}).fabjobs)||[];
      if(!jobs.length){$("forge-fabjobs").innerHTML="<p class='muted'>No fab jobs — start one in <a href='/3d'>/3d</a>.</p>";return;}
      $("forge-fabjobs").innerHTML="<ul>"+jobs.slice(0,6).map(function(j){
        var h="<li><code>"+j.job_id+"</code> ["+j.stage+"] model "+String(j.model_id||"").slice(0,16)+" ";
        var b=function(act,label){return " <button type='button' data-job='"+j.job_id+"' data-act='"+act+"'>"+label+"</button>";};
        if(j.stage==="designed"){h+=b("prepare","Prepare");}
        else if(j.stage==="prepared"){h+=" <select data-slicer='"+j.job_id+"' aria-label='Slicer'><option value='test-slicer'>Slice (TEST)</option><option value='prusa-console'>Slice (lokaal)</option></select>"+b("slice","Slicen");}
        else if(j.stage==="gcode-ready"){h+=b("propose","Propose print (needs YES)")+b("preflight","Pre-flight");}
        else if(j.stage==="proposed"){h+=b("preflight","Pre-flight")+b("enqueue","In wachtrij plaatsen")+" <span class='muted'>YES via <a href='/writes'>Writes</a></span>";}
        else{h+=b("sync","Sync");}
        return h+"</li>";
      }).join("")+"</ul>";
      $("forge-fabjobs").querySelectorAll("button[data-job]").forEach(function(btn){
        btn.onclick=function(){
          var job=btn.getAttribute("data-job"),act=btn.getAttribute("data-act"),fields={};
          if(act==="slice"){var sel=$("forge-fabjobs").querySelector("select[data-slicer='"+job+"']");fields.slicer=sel?sel.value:"test-slicer";}
          btn.disabled=true;
          forgeAct(job,act,fields);
        };
      });
    }
    function renderPipeline(){ const stages=[["DESIGN",ForgeSession.parts.length?"done":"now"],["VALIDATE",""],["SLICE",""],["APPROVAL",ForgeSession.dirty?"now":""],["PRINT","blocked"]];
      $("forge-pipeline").innerHTML=stages.map(s=>"<span class='step "+s[1]+"'>"+s[0]+"</span>").join("<span class='arrow'>→</span>")
        +"<p class='muted'>Alleen DESIGN is vrij editeerbaar. SLICE = TEST (SIMULATED). PRINT = HARDWARE_REQUIRED via /writes.</p>"; }
    async function loadEvents(){ try{ const r=await fetch("/api/v1/events?limit=20"); const ev=await r.json();
        $("forge-events").innerHTML=ev.slice(-12).reverse().map(e=>"<li><small>"+String(e.created_at||"").slice(0,19)+"</small> <b>"+String(e.event_type||"")+"</b> — "+String(e.summary||"").slice(0,120)+"</li>").join("")||"<li>No events.</li>";
      }catch(e){ $("forge-events").innerHTML="<li>Events unavailable.</li>"; } }
    document.querySelectorAll("[data-forge-tab]").forEach(b=>{ b.onclick=()=>{ ["design","slice","build","history","mycelium"].forEach(t=>{ $("forge-tab-"+t).hidden=(t!==b.dataset.forgeTab); }); }; });
    $("forge-add-cube").onclick=()=>addPart("cube");
    $("forge-add-cylinder").onclick=()=>addPart("cylinder");
    $("forge-add-component").onclick=()=>{ const mods=((FORGE_DATA.workshop||{}).models)||[];
      if(!mods.length){ $("forge-status").textContent="No registry models — register one in /3d first."; return; }
      ForgeSession.selected_model=mods[0].model_id; addPart("cube",mods[0].model_id); forgeLog("component linked: "+mods[0].model_id+" (reference only)"); };
    (function(){ const cv=$("forge-view"); let drag=null,pan=false;
      cv.addEventListener("pointerdown",e=>{ drag=[e.clientX,e.clientY]; pan=e.shiftKey; cv.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); });
      cv.addEventListener("pointerup",()=>drag=null);
      cv.addEventListener("pointermove",e=>{ if(!drag) return; const dx=e.clientX-drag[0],dy=e.clientY-drag[1];
        if(pan){ ForgeSession.camera.ox+=dx; ForgeSession.camera.oy+=dy; } else { ForgeSession.camera.rot_y+=dx*0.01; ForgeSession.camera.rot_x+=dy*0.01; }
        drag=[e.clientX,e.clientY]; draw(); });
      cv.addEventListener("wheel",e=>{ e.preventDefault(); ForgeSession.camera.scale*=e.deltaY<0?1.1:0.9; draw(); },{passive:false}); })();
    $("forge-fork").onclick=async ()=>{ if(!ForgeSession.parts.length){ $("forge-status").textContent="Nothing to fork."; return; }
      const src=ForgeSession.selected_model||ForgeSession.model_id||"editor";
      ForgeSession.forked_from={source:src,at:new Date().toISOString()};
      setDirty(true,"model forked from "+src);
      $("forge-status").textContent="Forked from "+src+" — editor-local until Save.";
      if(ForgeSession.selected_model&&ForgeSession.project_id){ try{
          const r=await fetch("/api/v1/workshop/links",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},
            body:JSON.stringify({workshop_id:ForgeSession.selected_model,entity_id:ForgeSession.project_id,predicate:"generated_from"})});
          forgeLog(r.ok?"fork link proposed (PROPOSED symbiosis)":"fork link refused: HTTP "+r.status); }catch(e){ forgeLog("fork link failed: "+e); } }
      else forgeLog("fork is editor-local: no mdl_/proj_ pair selected (no dedicated fork record — see Save)"); };
    function persistLine(){ const f=ForgeSession.forked_from||{};
      $("forge-persist").textContent="MODEL: "+($("forge-design-name").value||"Forge design")
        +" · GEOMETRY: "+ForgeSession.parts.length+" part(s)"+(ForgeSession.dirty?" (dirty)":" (clean)")
        +" · PERSISTENCE: "+(ForgeSession.saved||"unsaved")
        +" · HISTORY: "+(f.source?("forked from "+f.source):"no fork")
        +(ForgeSession.ai_edits.length?(" · AI: "+ForgeSession.ai_edits.length+" edit(s) (ai-generated, unverified)"):""); }
    function editorParts(){ return ForgeSession.parts.filter(p=>p.kind==="cube"||p.kind==="cylinder")
      .map(p=>({kind:p.kind,size:p.size,pos:p.pos,rot:p.rot,scale:p.scale,material:p.material})); }
    function sceneParts(){ return ForgeSession.parts.map(p=>{
      if(p.kind==="derived") return {id:p.id,kind:"derived",tris:p.tris||[],pos:p.pos,rot:p.rot,scale:p.scale,material:p.material||"—",source:p.source||{}};
      return {id:p.id,kind:p.kind,size:p.size,pos:p.pos,rot:p.rot,scale:p.scale,material:p.material}; }); }
    let FORGE_LIB = {workshop:[],inventory:{results:[]},local:[],external:{}};
    async function loadLibrary(){ try{
        const r=await fetch("/api/v1/forge/library"); if(!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+r.status);
        FORGE_LIB=await r.json(); renderLibrary();
      }catch(e){ $("forge-lib-list").innerHTML="<li>○ Library unavailable.</li>";
        $("forge-lib-honesty").textContent="Library failed: "+e; } }
    function libEntries(){ const q=($("forge-lib-search").value||"").toLowerCase();
      const all=[];
      (FORGE_LIB.workshop||[]).forEach(m=>all.push({group:"WORKSHOP",id:m.id,name:m.name,sub:(m.triangles||"?")+" tris · "+(m.mesh_verdict||"?"),open:{source:"workshop",ref:m.id}}));
      ((FORGE_LIB.inventory||{}).results||[]).forEach(m=>all.push({group:"INVENTORY",id:m.id,name:m.name||m.id,sub:m.type+" · provenance "+((m.provenance||{}).source_type||"?"),open:{source:"inventory",entity_type:m.type,ref:m.id}}));
      (FORGE_LIB.local||[]).forEach(m=>all.push({group:"LOCAL",id:m.id,name:m.name,sub:(m.type||"mesh")+" · unregistered",open:{source:"local",ref:m.id}}));
      const ext=FORGE_LIB.external||{};
      $("forge-lib-honesty").textContent="Sources: WORKSHOP ("+(FORGE_LIB.workshop||[]).length+") · INVENTORY ("+(((FORGE_LIB.inventory||{}).results||[]).length)+", "+((FORGE_LIB.inventory||{}).state||"?")+") · LOCAL ("+(FORGE_LIB.local||[]).length+") · EXTERNAL ("+(ext.state||"NOT_CONNECTED")+").";
      return all.filter(e=>!q||(e.name+e.group+e.id).toLowerCase().includes(q)); }
    function renderLibrary(){ const ul=$("forge-lib-list"); const items=libEntries().slice(0,20);
      ul.innerHTML=items.length?"":"<li>○ No models — register one in <a href='/3d'>/3d</a>.</li>";
      items.forEach(e=>{ const li=document.createElement("li");
        li.innerHTML="<span class='q-todo'>○</span> ";
        const b=document.createElement("button"); b.type="button"; b.textContent="Open";
        b.onclick=()=>openLibraryModel(e.open, e.name);
        li.appendChild(b); li.appendChild(document.createTextNode(" ["+e.group+"] "+e.name+" "));
        const s=document.createElement("span"); s.className="muted"; s.textContent=e.sub; li.appendChild(s);
        ul.appendChild(li); }); }
    async function openLibraryModel(open, name){ $("forge-status").textContent="Opening "+name+"… (read-only import, nothing stored)";
      try{ const r=await fetch("/api/v1/forge/open",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(open)});
        const j=await r.json();
        if(!r.ok){ $("forge-status").textContent="Import refused: "+JSON.stringify(j).slice(0,300); return; }
        if(!(j.parts||[]).length){ $("forge-status").textContent="Opened metadata ("+(j.title||j.ref||"?")+"): "+((j.geometry||{}).note||"no geometry — nothing imported."); forgeLog("inventory record opened (metadata only): "+(j.ref||"?")); return; }

          ForgeSession.parts.push({id:"part_"+FORGE_SEQ+"_derived",name:(name||"imported").slice(0,60)+" #"+FORGE_SEQ,kind:"derived",

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/game.py">
"""Living game layer view (BIG #43).

`game_state()` is a READ-ONLY derived view over the existing
ecosystem — quests, campaigns, presence, craft, symbiosis,
nodes, energy, fabrications, discoveries. It aggregates; it
never stores game truth, never approves, never executes.

Presentation mapping (semantics preserved, never renamed):
- presence NEEDS → player decisions (approvals, blocked work)
- WAITING → quests waiting on something real
- AVAILABLE → resources the workshop offers
- DISCOVERED → discoveries / knowledge opportunities
- OFFLINE → sleeping, quiet nodes

Every entry keeps its real href. No XP, no rewards, no
fabricated statistics: counts come from the stores, empty
stores render as explicit empty.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

BAND_GAME_LABEL = {
    "needs": "needs you — player decisions",
    "waiting": "waiting — quests held by something real",
    "available": "available — workshop resources",
    "discovered": "discovered — knowledge opportunities",
    "offline": "quiet — sleeping nodes",
}


def symbiosis_progression(limit: int = 12) -> dict:
    """Symbiosis as progression: verified connections read as
    strong, supported as growing, proposed as seedlings.
    Display only — states come from the stores."""
    try:
        from .symbiosis import proposed
        open_proposals = proposed(limit=limit)
    except Exception:
        open_proposals = []
    return {
        "open": [{
            "title": str(prop.get("title", ""))[:120],
            "entities": prop.get("entities", [])[:4],
            "state": "PROPOSED",
            "strength": "seedling",
            "href": prop.get("link", "/symbiosis"),
        } for prop in open_proposals],
        "honesty": "PROPOSED links are seedlings (uncertain); "
                   "SUPPORTED/VERIFIED edges in the symbiosis "
                   "view read as growing/strong. Nothing is "
                   "promoted here.",
    }


def craft_progression(entity_id: str = "",
                      limit: int = 5) -> list[dict]:
    """Craft chains as gameplay progress for entities linked to
    open quests. Evidence-backed states only."""
    chains: list[dict] = []
    refs: list[str] = []
    if entity_id:
        refs = [str(entity_id)[:100]]
    else:
        try:
            from .quests import list_quests
            for quest in list_quests(limit=10):
                for step in quest.steps:
                    if step.kind == "entity" and step.ref:
                        refs.append(step.ref)
        except Exception:
            refs = []
    seen: set = set()
    for ref in refs:
        if ref in seen or len(chains) >= max(1, min(
                int(limit or 5), 10)):
            continue
        seen.add(ref)
        try:
            from .craft import craft_tree, stage_states
            tree = craft_tree(ref, 1)
            states = stage_states(tree)
        except Exception:
            continue
        done = sum(1 for stage in states
                   if stage.get("state") == "complete")
        chains.append({
            "entity_id": ref,
            "growth": tree.get("growth", "seed"),
            "done": done,
            "total": len(states),
            "stages": [{
                "key": stage.get("key", ""),
                "state": stage.get("state", ""),
                "glyph": stage.get("glyph", "○"),
            } for stage in states],
            "href": f"/craft?entity_id={ref}",
        })
    return chains


def presence_as_stakes(limit: int = 60) -> dict:
    """Presence bands translated to game-readable stakes. Same
    items, same hrefs, same priority — only the framing words
    change, and the original band name stays on each item."""
    try:
        from .presence import attention_snapshot
        snapshot = attention_snapshot(limit=limit)
    except Exception:
        return {"bands": {}, "labels": BAND_GAME_LABEL}
    bands: dict = {}
    for band, items in (snapshot.get("bands", {}) or {}).items():
        framed = []
        for item in items[:12]:
            framed.append({
                "id": item.get("id", ""),
                "title": item.get("title", "")[:140],
                "reason": item.get("reason", "")[:240],
                "band": band,
                "reads_as": BAND_GAME_LABEL.get(band, band),
                "href": item.get("open_href", "/presence"),
                "priority": item.get("priority", 0),
            })
        bands[band] = framed
    return {"bands": bands, "counts": snapshot.get("counts", {}),
            "labels": BAND_GAME_LABEL}


#: Closed growth levels. Presentation only — derived, never
#: stored, never a permission, never an execution gate.
LEVELS = ("SEEDLING", "ROOTED", "GROVE")


def derive_level(*, verified_objects: int | None = 0,
                 verified_files: int | None = 0,
                 completed_quests: int | None = 0) -> dict:
    """Derive one growth level from verified counts only.

    Pure: no database, no I/O, no persistence, no side
    effects, deterministic. UNVERIFIED and REVOKED records
    must never reach these inputs (callers count verified
    outcomes only). UNKNOWN (None) is not zero: it caps the
    level at SEEDLING with explicit unknown evidence.
    """
    inputs = {"verified_objects": verified_objects,
              "verified_files": verified_files,
              "completed_quests": completed_quests}
    evidence: list[str] = []
    unknown = [key for key, value in inputs.items()
               if value is None]
    if unknown:
        for key in sorted(unknown):
            evidence.append(f"{key}: UNKNOWN (not 0)")
        return {"level": "SEEDLING", "inputs": inputs,
                "evidence": evidence,
                "provenance": "derived"}
    try:
        objects = max(0, int(verified_objects or 0))
        files = max(0, int(verified_files or 0))
        quests = max(0, int(completed_quests or 0))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return {"level": "SEEDLING", "inputs": inputs,
                "evidence": ["inputs unreadable; treating as "
                             "UNKNOWN, not 0"],
                "provenance": "derived"}
    evidence.append(f"{objects} verified object(s)")
    evidence.append(f"{files} verified file(s)")
    evidence.append(f"{quests} completed quest(s)")
    if objects >= 5 and files >= 5 and quests >= 2:
        level = "GROVE"
    elif (objects >= 1 and files >= 1) or quests >= 1:
        level = "ROOTED"
    else:
        level = "SEEDLING"
    return {"level": level, "inputs": inputs,
            "evidence": evidence, "provenance": "derived"}


def game_state() -> dict:
    """One derived game-state view. Best-effort per section:
    failing sources degrade to explicit empty, never invented."""
    out: dict = {"sections": {}, "warnings": []}

    def _put(key, value, source):
        out["sections"][key] = {"data": value, "source": source}

    try:
        from .living_state import current_state
        state = current_state()
        _put("world",
             {"state": state.get("state", "?"),
              "line": state.get("line", ""),
              "glyph": state.get("glyph", "")},
             "living_state.current_state")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("world", {}, f"unavailable ({error})")
        out["warnings"].append("living state unavailable")
    try:
        from .campaigns import list_campaign_details
        campaigns = list_campaign_details(limit=20)
        _put("campaigns", campaigns,
             "campaign defs + live quest derivation")
    except Exception as error:
        campaigns = []
        _put("campaigns", [], f"unavailable ({error})")
        out["warnings"].append("campaigns unavailable")
    try:
        current_quest: dict = {}
        for campaign in campaigns:
            nxt = campaign.get("current_quest", {}) or {}
            if nxt.get("quest_id"):
                current_quest = {
                    **nxt,
                    "campaign_id": campaign.get(
                        "campaign_id", ""),
                    "campaign_title": campaign.get(
                        "title", "")[:120],
                }
                break
        if not current_quest:
            from .quests import list_quest_details
            for quest in list_quest_details(limit=10):
                if quest.get("state") not in ("COMPLETED",):
                    current_quest = {
                        "quest_id": quest.get("quest_id", ""),
                        "title": quest.get("title", "")[:120],
                        "state": quest.get("state", ""),
                        "progress": quest.get("progress",
                                              "0/0"),
                        "href": f"/quests#{quest.get('quest_id', '')}",
                    }
                    break
        _put("current_quest", current_quest,
             "first open quest (campaign first)")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("current_quest", {}, f"unavailable ({error})")
    try:
        _put("presence", presence_as_stakes(limit=60),
             "presence engine (same items, game framing)")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("presence", {"bands": {}, "labels": BAND_GAME_LABEL},
             f"unavailable ({error})")
    try:
        _put("craft", craft_progression(limit=5),
             "craft trees of quest-linked entities")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("craft", [], f"unavailable ({error})")
    try:
        _put("symbiosis", symbiosis_progression(limit=12),
             "open symbiosis proposals")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("symbiosis", {"open": []}, f"unavailable ({error})")
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        nodes = []
        for record in _main.list_nodes():
            nodes.append({
                "node_id": str(record.get("node_id", "")),
                "status": str(record.get("derived_status",
                                         "unknown")),
                "health": str(record.get("health_status",
                                         "UNKNOWN")),
                "reads_as": "quiet"
                if str(record.get("derived_status", ""))
                not in ("online", "busy") else "awake",
                "current_task": record.get("current_task"),
                "href": f"/nodes#{record.get('node_id', '')}",
            })
            if len(nodes) >= 15:
                break
        _put("nodes", nodes, "node registry")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("nodes", [], f"unavailable ({error})")
    try:
        from .energy import summarize as _energy_sum
        _put("energy", _energy_sum(), "energy records")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("energy", {}, f"unavailable ({error})")
    try:
        from . import main as _main2
        fabs = _main2.list_fabrications(10)
        workshop = []
        for item in fabs:
            try:
                data = item.model_dump(mode="json") \
                    if hasattr(item, "model_dump") else dict(item)
            except Exception:
                continue
            status = str(data.get("status", ""))
            workshop.append({
                "fabrication_id": str(data.get(
                    "fabrication_id", ""))[:40],
                "status": status,
                "reads_as": "workshop activity"
                if status in ("started", "approved", "ready",
                              "waiting") else "workshop record",
            })
        _put("workshop", workshop, "fabrication records")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("workshop", [], f"unavailable ({error})")
    try:
        from .ecosystem import discoveries
        found = discoveries(limit=6)
        _put("discoveries",
             {"items": found.get("items", [])[:6],
              "imports_considered": found.get(
                  "imports_considered", 0)},
             "conversation discoveries")
    except Exception as error:
        _put("discoveries", {"items": []},
             f"unavailable ({error})")
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    out["generated_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    out["provenance"] = {"source_type": "derived",
                         "creator_id": "living-game-layer",
                         "human_verified": False}
    out["honesty"] = ("A view, not a database. Every entry "
                      "links to its real record; empty stores "
                      "render empty. No XP, no rewards.")
    return out

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/hermes_bridge.py">
"""Minimal Hermes agent bridge for the Mycelium coordinator.

Speaks to a local Hermes gateway's OpenAI-compatible API server
(http://127.0.0.1:8642 by default). Deliberately small:

- send one message, receive one response (chat completions);
- agent/session identity via ``X-Hermes-Session-Key`` (the gateway
  converges same-key first requests onto one live session);
- bounded time (default 60s, max 120s — agent runs take longer
  than inventory reads);
- clear error states, never raw tracebacks.

Safety properties (mirror inventory_read.py, all covered by tests):

- HTTP POST only to the two chat endpoints. No other methods.
- Loopback-only base URL (127.0.0.1, localhost, ::1). Anything
  else is refused before any socket is opened. Redirects never
  followed.
- Bounded inputs: session key <= 256 chars (gateway cap),
  message <= 64_000 chars, model <= 120 chars.
- API key via ``HERMES_API_KEY`` env (or explicit arg), never
  logged, never committed. Missing key -> HermesRefusedError
  before any socket is opened.
- Connection problems and timeouts surface as
  :class:`HermesUnavailable`, never as raw tracebacks.

NOT wired to any route, game, scheduler or worker. Callers
opt in explicitly. No INVENTory writes, no approvals touched.
"""

import os
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

import httpx

DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8642"
BASE_URL_ENV_VAR = "HERMES_API_URL"
API_KEY_ENV_VAR = "HERMES_API_KEY"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 60.0
MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120.0
MAX_SESSION_KEY_LENGTH = 256
MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 64_000
MAX_MODEL_LENGTH = 120
LOOPBACK_HOSTS = frozenset({"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"})
DEFAULT_MODEL = "hermes-agent"


class HermesUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    """Hermes could not be reached or answered with an error."""


class HermesRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused the request; nothing was sent."""


def _validate_base_url(raw) -> str:
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
        raise HermesRefusedError("Hermes base URL must be non-empty text")
    try:
        parts = urlsplit(raw.strip())
    except ValueError as error:
        raise HermesRefusedError(f"Invalid Hermes base URL: {error}") from error
    if parts.scheme != "http":
        raise HermesRefusedError("Hermes base URL must use http")
    if parts.username or parts.password:
        raise HermesRefusedError("Hermes base URL must not contain credentials")
    host = (parts.hostname or "").lower()
    if host not in LOOPBACK_HOSTS:
        raise HermesRefusedError(
            f"Hermes host '{host or '?'}' is not loopback; refusing"
        )
    if not parts.port:
        return f"http://{parts.hostname}"
    return f"http://{parts.hostname}:{parts.port}"


def _check_session_key(key) -> str:
    if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
        raise HermesRefusedError("Session key must be non-empty text")
    clean = key.strip()
    if len(clean) > MAX_SESSION_KEY_LENGTH:
        raise HermesRefusedError(
            f"Session key exceeds {MAX_SESSION_KEY_LENGTH} characters"
        )
    return clean


def _check_message(message) -> str:
    if not isinstance(message, str) or not message.strip():
        raise HermesRefusedError("Message must be non-empty text")
    if len(message) > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH:
        raise HermesRefusedError(
            f"Message exceeds {MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH} characters"
        )
    return message


def _check_model(model) -> str:
    if not isinstance(model, str) or not model.strip():
        raise HermesRefusedError("Model must be non-empty text")
    clean = model.strip()
    if len(clean) > MAX_MODEL_LENGTH:
        raise HermesRefusedError(
            f"Model exceeds {MAX_MODEL_LENGTH} characters"
        )
    return clean


class HermesBridge:
    """Minimal send/receive client for one Hermes agent."""

    def __init__(self, base_url=None, api_key=None,
                 timeout=DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, transport=None):
        raw = base_url if base_url is not None else os.environ.get(
            BASE_URL_ENV_VAR, DEFAULT_BASE_URL
        )
        self.base_url = _validate_base_url(raw)
        key = api_key if api_key is not None else os.environ.get(
            API_KEY_ENV_VAR, ""
        )
        if not isinstance(key, str) or not key.strip():
            raise HermesRefusedError(
                f"Hermes API key missing: set {API_KEY_ENV_VAR}"
            )
        self._api_key = key.strip()
        try:
            self.timeout = min(float(timeout), MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self.timeout = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        if self.timeout <= 0:
            self.timeout = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        self._transport = transport

    def _client(self) -> httpx.Client:
        return httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            timeout=self.timeout,
            follow_redirects=False,
            trust_env=False,
            transport=self._transport,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {self._api_key}"},
        )

    def send(self, session_key, message, model=DEFAULT_MODEL,
             max_tokens=500) -> dict:
        """Send one message, return the assistant text + ids.

        Returns ``{"session_key", "message_id", "model", "text",
        "finish_reason"}``. Raises :class:`HermesRefusedError` on
        bad input, :class:`HermesUnavailable` on transport/API
        errors.
        """
        key = _check_session_key(session_key)
        text = _check_message(message)
        clean_model = _check_model(model)
        try:
            count = max(1, min(int(max_tokens or 500), 4000))
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            raise HermesRefusedError("max_tokens must be an integer")
        payload = {
            "model": clean_model,
            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": text}],
            "max_tokens": count,
        }
        try:
            with self._client() as client:
                response = client.post(
                    "/v1/chat/completions",
                    json=payload,
                    headers={"X-Hermes-Session-Key": key},
                )
        except httpx.TimeoutException as error:
            raise HermesUnavailable(f"Hermes timed out: {error}") from error
        except httpx.HTTPError as error:
            raise HermesUnavailable(f"Hermes unreachable: {error}") from error
        if response.status_code in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
            raise HermesUnavailable("Hermes redirect refused")
        if response.status_code == 401:
            raise HermesUnavailable(
                "Hermes refused the API key (401)"
            )
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise HermesUnavailable(
                f"Hermes answered with HTTP {response.status_code}"
            )
        try:
            data = response.json()
        except ValueError as error:
            raise HermesUnavailable(
                "Hermes answered with invalid JSON") from error
        try:
            choice = data["choices"][0]
            content = choice["message"]["content"]
        except (KeyError, IndexError, TypeError) as error:
            raise HermesUnavailable(
                "Hermes answer has no usable choice") from error
        return {
            "session_key": key,
            "message_id": str(data.get("id", "")),
            "model": str(data.get("model", clean_model)),
            "text": str(content),
            "finish_reason": str(choice.get("finish_reason", "")),
        }

    def health(self) -> dict:
        """Unauthenticated liveness probe. Returns raw dict."""
        try:
            with self._client() as client:
                response = client.get("/health")
        except httpx.TimeoutException as error:
            raise HermesUnavailable(f"Hermes timed out: {error}") from error
        except httpx.HTTPError as error:
            raise HermesUnavailable(f"Hermes unreachable: {error}") from error
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise HermesUnavailable(
                f"Hermes health answered HTTP {response.status_code}"
            )
        try:
            data = response.json()
        except ValueError:
            return {}
        return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/inventory_writes.py">
"""INVENTory controlled-write capability (BIG #5).

The ONLY write path from Mycelium to INVENTory. The read bridge
(``inventory_read.py``) stays untouched and read-only; this module
is a separate, explicitly approved capability.

Supported mutations (closed — anything else is refused):

- ``inventory.create`` — POST one of object/project/idea/file
- ``inventory.update`` — PATCH one existing object/project/idea/file
- ``inventory.create_relationship`` — POST one relationship

Deletes, events and every M3+ entity type beyond the curated
ones are out of scope and refused: the writer only covers the
entity shapes whose API/database semantics were verified
against ``inventory/app/main.py`` + ``schemas.py`` (files added
in BIG #6 for camera-media registration: FileCreate needs a
name, a file_kind, a sha256 and a size).

Safety properties (enforced by construction, tested):

- HTTP POST/PATCH only, to an allow-listed route derived from the
  validated mutation — never from free text.
- Loopback-only base URL, timeout clamped to 5s, redirects never
  followed (same posture as the read bridge).
- Every execution needs a bound, non-stale WriteApproval over the
  exact proposal content (``controlled_writes.revalidate``).
- Payloads are schema-validated here AND by INVENTory itself;
  unknown fields, bad enums and ``human_verified=True`` from AI
  output are refused before anything is sent.
- ``before``/``after`` snapshots come from independent reads so
  the audit trail shows what was, what was proposed and what
  actually changed.
"""

import os
from typing import Any

import httpx

from .controlled_writes import (
    WriteApproval,
    WriteProposal,
    WriteResult,
    now,
    revalidate,
)
from .inventory_read import (
    ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES,
    LOOPBACK_HOSTS,
    MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    InventoryReader,
    Provenance,
)

BASE_URL_ENV_VAR = "INVENTORY_BASE_URL"
DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"

#: Entity types with verified create/update semantics. Maps the
#: proposal entity_type to (collection, id prefix, creatable fields,
#: updatable fields). ``name`` is required on create everywhere.
ENTITY_CONTRACTS: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {
    "object": {
        "collection": "objects",
        "prefix": "obj_",
        "create_required": ("name",),
        "create_optional": ("description", "quantity"),
        "update_fields": ("name", "description", "quantity"),
        "capability": "inventory.objects.write",
    },
    "project": {
        "collection": "projects",
        "prefix": "proj_",
        "create_required": ("name",),
        "create_optional": ("description", "status"),
        "update_fields": ("name", "description", "status"),
        "status_values": ("idea", "planned", "active", "paused",
                          "completed", "archived"),
        "capability": "inventory.projects.write",
    },
    "idea": {
        "collection": "ideas",
        "prefix": "idea_",
        "create_required": ("name",),
        "create_optional": ("description", "status"),
        "update_fields": ("name", "description", "status"),
        "status_values": ("raw", "considered", "planned", "rejected",
                          "converted"),
        "capability": "inventory.ideas.write",
    },
    "file": {
        "collection": "files",
        "prefix": "file_",
        "create_required": ("name", "sha256"),
        "create_optional": ("description", "file_kind", "mime_type",
                            "size_bytes", "status", "metadata"),
        "update_fields": ("name", "description", "file_kind",
                          "mime_type", "size_bytes", "status",
                          "metadata"),
        "file_kinds": ("cad", "mesh", "gcode", "image", "document",
                       "data", "other"),
        "file_statuses": ("available", "in_use", "maintenance",
                          "retired", "unknown"),
        "capability": "inventory.files.write",
    },
}

RELATIONSHIP_PREDICATES = frozenset({
    "used_in", "uses", "related_to", "part_of", "contains", "became",
    "led_to", "depends_on", "produced_by", "stored_in",
})

#: ID prefixes accepted as relationship endpoints (bridge prefixes
#: plus file_, which inventory/app/ids.py also generates).
RELATIONSHIP_ID_PREFIXES = ENTITY_ID_PREFIXES + ("file_",)

MAX_NAME_CHARS = 200
MAX_DESCRIPTION_CHARS = 5000


class InventoryWriteRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused the mutation; nothing was sent."""


class InventoryWriteFailedError(RuntimeError):
    """The write was refused or failed remotely; nothing is verified."""


def _check_base_url(raw) -> str:
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            "INVENTory base URL must be non-empty text")
    try:
        parts = urlsplit(raw.strip())
    except ValueError as error:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"Invalid INVENTory base URL: {error}") from error
    if parts.scheme != "http":
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            "INVENTory base URL must use http")
    if parts.username or parts.password:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            "INVENTory base URL must not contain credentials")
    host = (parts.hostname or "").lower()
    if host not in LOOPBACK_HOSTS:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"INVENTory host '{host or '?'}' is not loopback; refusing")
    if not parts.port:
        return f"http://{parts.hostname}"
    return f"http://{parts.hostname}:{parts.port}"


def _check_entity_id(entity_id, label: str = "Entity ID") -> str:
    if not isinstance(entity_id, str) or not entity_id.strip():
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(f"{label} must be non-empty text")
    clean = entity_id.strip()
    if not clean.startswith(RELATIONSHIP_ID_PREFIXES):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"{label} '{clean[:32]}' has an unknown prefix; refusing")
    return clean


def _check_name(value, label: str = "name") -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(f"{label} must be non-empty text")
    if len(value.strip()) > MAX_NAME_CHARS:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(f"{label} exceeds "
                                        f"{MAX_NAME_CHARS} characters")
    return value.strip()


def _check_description(value) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("description must be text")
    if len(value) > MAX_DESCRIPTION_CHARS:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("description too long")
    return value


def _check_quantity(value) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("quantity must be an integer")
    if value < 0:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("quantity must be >= 0")
    return value


def _check_status(value, allowed) -> str:
    if value not in allowed:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"status '{value}' unknown; expected one of {sorted(allowed)}")
    return value


def _check_sha256(value) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("sha256 must be text")
    text = value.strip().lower()
    if len(text) != 64 or any(
            char not in "0123456789abcdef" for char in text):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            "sha256 must be a 64-char hex digest")
    return text


def _check_mime_type(value) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("mime_type must be text")
    text = value.strip()
    if len(text) > 200:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("mime_type too long")
    if any(char in text for char in ("<>\"'")) or "\n" in text:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("mime_type is not plain text")
    return text


def _check_size_bytes(value) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, int):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("size_bytes must be an integer")
    if value < 0:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("size_bytes must be >= 0")
    return value


def _check_file_kind(value, allowed) -> str:
    if value not in allowed:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"file_kind '{value}' unknown; expected one of "
            f"{sorted(allowed)}")
    return value


def _check_metadata(value) -> dict:
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("metadata must be an object")
    return dict(value)


def _apply_file_fields(body: dict, fields: dict, contract: dict,
                       for_update: bool) -> None:
    """Shared file-kind/status/mime/size/sha/metadata handling."""
    if "sha256" in fields:
        body["sha256"] = _check_sha256(fields["sha256"])
    elif not for_update and "sha256" in contract["create_required"]:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("sha256 is required")
    if "file_kind" in fields:
        body["file_kind"] = _check_file_kind(fields["file_kind"],
                                             contract["file_kinds"])
    if "mime_type" in fields:
        body["mime_type"] = _check_mime_type(fields["mime_type"])
    if "size_bytes" in fields:
        body["size_bytes"] = _check_size_bytes(fields["size_bytes"])
    if "metadata" in fields:
        body["metadata"] = _check_metadata(fields["metadata"])


def _check_provenance(value) -> dict:
    """Provenance supplied with a write. AI output can never smuggle
    human_verified=True through here."""
    if value is None:
        return {}
    if not isinstance(value, dict):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("provenance must be an object")
    allowed_keys = {"source_type", "creator_id", "confidence_score",
                    "human_verified", "verified_by", "notes"}
    unknown = set(value) - allowed_keys
    if unknown:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"provenance carries unknown fields: {sorted(unknown)}")
    if value.get("human_verified") is True and not value.get("verified_by"):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            "human_verified=True without verified_by is refused; "
            "AI output never self-verifies")
    return dict(value)


def build_create_payload(entity_type: str, fields: dict) -> dict:
    """Validate create fields for one entity type. Fail-closed."""
    contract = ENTITY_CONTRACTS.get(entity_type)
    if contract is None:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"Create of '{entity_type}' is not a controlled mutation; "
            f"supported: {sorted(ENTITY_CONTRACTS)}")
    if not isinstance(fields, dict):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("Create fields must be an object")
    allowed = set(contract["create_required"]) | set(
        contract["create_optional"]) | {"provenance"}
    unknown = set(fields) - allowed
    if unknown:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"Create carries unauthorized fields: {sorted(unknown)}")
    body: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for field in contract["create_required"]:
        if field == "name":
            body["name"] = _check_name(fields.get("name", ""))
        elif field == "sha256":
            body["sha256"] = _check_sha256(fields.get("sha256", ""))
        else:  # pragma: no cover - current contracts require name/sha256
            body[field] = fields[field]
    if "description" in fields:
        body["description"] = _check_description(fields["description"])
    if "quantity" in fields and "quantity" in allowed:
        body["quantity"] = _check_quantity(fields["quantity"])
    if "status" in fields and "status" in allowed:
        status_values = (contract.get("status_values")
                         or contract.get("file_statuses", ()))
        body["status"] = _check_status(fields["status"], status_values)
    if "file_kinds" in contract:
        _apply_file_fields(body, fields, contract, for_update=False)
    body["provenance"] = _write_provenance(fields.get("provenance"))
    return body


def build_update_payload(entity_type: str, fields: dict) -> dict:
    """Validate patch fields for one entity type. Fail-closed."""
    contract = ENTITY_CONTRACTS.get(entity_type)
    if contract is None:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"Update of '{entity_type}' is not a controlled mutation; "
            f"supported: {sorted(ENTITY_CONTRACTS)}")
    if not isinstance(fields, dict) or not fields:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            "Update fields must be a non-empty object")
    allowed = set(contract["update_fields"]) | {"provenance"}
    unknown = set(fields) - allowed
    if unknown:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"Update carries unauthorized fields: {sorted(unknown)}")
    body: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if "name" in fields:
        body["name"] = _check_name(fields["name"])
    if "description" in fields:
        body["description"] = _check_description(fields["description"])
    if "quantity" in fields:
        body["quantity"] = _check_quantity(fields["quantity"])
    if "status" in fields:
        status_values = (contract.get("status_values")
                         or contract.get("file_statuses", ()))
        body["status"] = _check_status(fields["status"], status_values)
    if "file_kinds" in contract:
        _apply_file_fields(body, fields, contract, for_update=True)
    if "provenance" in fields:
        body["provenance"] = _write_provenance(fields["provenance"])
    else:
        body["provenance"] = _write_provenance(None)
    return body


def build_relationship_payload(fields: dict) -> dict:
    """Validate one relationship creation. Fail-closed."""
    if not isinstance(fields, dict):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            "Relationship fields must be an object")
    allowed = {"from_id", "predicate", "to_id", "metadata", "provenance"}
    unknown = set(fields) - allowed
    if unknown:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"Relationship carries unauthorized fields: {sorted(unknown)}")
    from_id = _check_entity_id(fields.get("from_id", ""), "from_id")
    to_id = _check_entity_id(fields.get("to_id", ""), "to_id")
    if from_id == to_id:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            "from_id and to_id must differ")
    predicate = fields.get("predicate", "")
    if predicate not in RELATIONSHIP_PREDICATES:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"predicate '{predicate}' unknown; expected one of "
            f"{sorted(RELATIONSHIP_PREDICATES)}")
    metadata = fields.get("metadata", {})
    if not isinstance(metadata, dict):
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError("metadata must be an object")
    return {
        "from_id": from_id,
        "predicate": predicate,
        "to_id": to_id,
        "metadata": dict(metadata),
        "provenance": _write_provenance(fields.get("provenance")),
    }


def _write_provenance(value) -> dict:
    """Execution provenance: AI-generated, human-approved, unverified."""
    checked = _check_provenance(value)
    provenance = {
        "source_type": "ai-generated",
        "creator_id": str(checked.get("creator_id", "mycelium-write")),
        "human_verified": False,
        "notes": "human-approved controlled write; "
                 "verification is a separate step",
    }
    if checked.get("confidence_score") is not None:
        provenance["confidence_score"] = checked["confidence_score"]
    return provenance


def propose_inventory_write(proposal_id: str, mutation: str,
                            entity_type: str, fields: dict, *,
                            entity_id: str = "",
                            actor: str = "mycelium",
                            provenance: Provenance | None = None,
                            ) -> WriteProposal:
    """Build a validated inventory write proposal. Performs nothing.

    ``mutation`` is one of ``create`` / ``update`` /
    ``create_relationship``; fields are validated now (fail fast)
    and revalidated at execution.
    """
    from .controlled_writes import propose_write
    if mutation == "create":
        body = build_create_payload(entity_type, fields)
        target = f"inventory:{entity_type}"
        mutation_type = "inventory.create"
        payload = {"entity_type": entity_type, "fields": body}
    elif mutation == "update":
        contract = ENTITY_CONTRACTS.get(entity_type)
        if contract is None:
            raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
                f"Update of '{entity_type}' is not controlled")
        clean_id = _check_entity_id(entity_id)
        if not clean_id.startswith(contract["prefix"]):
            raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
                f"Entity ID '{clean_id[:32]}' does not match "
                f"'{entity_type}' (expected {contract['prefix']}*)")
        body = build_update_payload(entity_type, fields)
        target = f"inventory:{entity_type}:{clean_id}"
        mutation_type = "inventory.update"
        payload = {"entity_type": entity_type, "entity_id": clean_id,
                   "fields": body}
    elif mutation == "create_relationship":
        body = build_relationship_payload(fields)
        target = (f"inventory:relationship:"
                  f"{body['from_id']}->{body['to_id']}")
        mutation_type = "inventory.create_relationship"
        payload = {"entity_type": "relationship", "fields": body}
    else:
        raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
            f"Unknown inventory mutation '{mutation}'; expected "
            "create, update or create_relationship")
    return propose_write(proposal_id, mutation_type, target, payload,
                         actor=actor, provenance=provenance)


def capability_for(proposal: WriteProposal) -> str:
    """Dotted capability for one inventory write proposal."""
    if proposal.mutation_type == "inventory.create":
        entity_type = proposal.payload.get("entity_type", "")
        contract = ENTITY_CONTRACTS.get(entity_type)
        if contract is None:
            raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
                f"Create of '{entity_type}' is not controlled")
        return str(contract["capability"])
    if proposal.mutation_type == "inventory.update":
        entity_type = proposal.payload.get("entity_type", "")
        contract = ENTITY_CONTRACTS.get(entity_type)
        if contract is None:
            raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
                f"Update of '{entity_type}' is not controlled")
        return str(contract["capability"])
    if proposal.mutation_type == "inventory.create_relationship":
        return "inventory.relationships.write"
    raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
        f"Mutation '{proposal.mutation_type}' is not an inventory write")


class InventoryWriter:
    """Executes approved inventory write proposals. POST/PATCH only."""

    def __init__(self, base_url=None,
                 timeout: float = MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                 transport=None):
        raw = (base_url if base_url is not None
               else os.environ.get(BASE_URL_ENV_VAR, DEFAULT_BASE_URL))
        self.base_url = _check_base_url(raw)
        try:
            self.timeout = min(float(timeout), MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self.timeout = MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        if self.timeout <= 0:
            self.timeout = MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        self._transport = transport

    def _client(self) -> httpx.AsyncClient:
        return httpx.AsyncClient(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            timeout=self.timeout,
            follow_redirects=False,
            transport=self._transport,
        )

    async def _send(self, method: str, path: str,
                    body: dict) -> dict:
        if method not in ("POST", "PATCH"):
            raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
                f"HTTP {method} is not a controlled write method")
        try:
            async with self._client() as client:
                if method == "POST":
                    response = await client.post(path, json=body)
                else:
                    response = await client.patch(path, json=body)
        except httpx.TimeoutException as error:
            raise InventoryWriteFailedError(
                f"INVENTory write timed out: {error}") from error
        except httpx.HTTPError as error:
            raise InventoryWriteFailedError(
                f"INVENTory unreachable: {error}") from error
        if response.status_code in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
            raise InventoryWriteFailedError("INVENTory redirect refused")
        if response.status_code not in (200, 201):
            raise InventoryWriteFailedError(
                f"INVENTory refused the write "
                f"(HTTP {response.status_code})")
        try:
            data = response.json()
        except ValueError as error:
            raise InventoryWriteFailedError(
                "INVENTory answered with invalid JSON") from error
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            raise InventoryWriteFailedError(
                "INVENTory answered with invalid JSON")
        return data


async def execute_inventory_write(proposal: WriteProposal,
                                  approval: WriteApproval, *,
                                  reader: InventoryReader,
                                  writer: InventoryWriter,
                                  now_str: str | None = None) -> WriteResult:
    """Execute one approved proposal. Revalidates first, snapshots
    before/after through independent reads. Transport failures yield
    a failed WriteResult — never a false success."""
    fingerprint = revalidate(proposal, approval,
                             now_str or now())
    capability_for(proposal)  # fail-closed on non-inventory mutations
    if proposal.mutation_type == "inventory.create":
        return await _execute_create(proposal, fingerprint, reader,
                                     writer)
    if proposal.mutation_type == "inventory.update":
        return await _execute_update(proposal, fingerprint, reader,
                                     writer)
    if proposal.mutation_type == "inventory.create_relationship":
        return await _execute_relationship(proposal, fingerprint,
                                           writer)
    raise InventoryWriteRefusedError(
        f"Mutation '{proposal.mutation_type}' is not an inventory write")


async def _execute_create(proposal: WriteProposal, fingerprint: str,
                          reader: InventoryReader,
                          writer: InventoryWriter) -> WriteResult:
    entity_type = proposal.payload["entity_type"]
    fields = build_create_payload(entity_type,
                                  proposal.payload.get("fields", {}))
    contract = ENTITY_CONTRACTS[entity_type]
    try:
        created = await writer._send(
            "POST", f"/api/v1/{contract['collection']}", fields)
    except InventoryWriteFailedError as error:
        return _failed(proposal, fingerprint, {}, str(error))
    entity_id = str(created.get("id", ""))
    after = await _readback(reader, entity_type, entity_id)
    return WriteResult(
        proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id, fingerprint=fingerprint,
        outcome="executed", before={},
        after=after or created,
        actor=proposal.actor, executed_at=now(),
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="ai-generated", creator_id=proposal.actor,
            human_verified=False,
            notes=f"controlled write {proposal.proposal_id}; "
                  "unverified until independent verification"),
    )


async def _execute_update(proposal: WriteProposal, fingerprint: str,
                          reader: InventoryReader,
                          writer: InventoryWriter) -> WriteResult:
    entity_type = proposal.payload["entity_type"]
    entity_id = proposal.payload["entity_id"]
    fields = build_update_payload(entity_type,
                                  proposal.payload.get("fields", {}))
    contract = ENTITY_CONTRACTS[entity_type]
    before_record = await _safe_get(reader, entity_type, entity_id)
    if before_record is None:
        return _failed(proposal, fingerprint, {},
                       f"Target '{entity_id}' does not exist; refusing")
    before = {"entity_id": entity_id,
              "title": before_record.title,
              "details": dict(before_record.details)}
    try:
        await writer._send(
            "PATCH",
            f"/api/v1/{contract['collection']}/{entity_id}", fields)
    except InventoryWriteFailedError as error:
        return _failed(proposal, fingerprint, before, str(error))
    after = await _readback(reader, entity_type, entity_id)
    return WriteResult(
        proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id, fingerprint=fingerprint,
        outcome="executed", before=before,
        after=after or {"entity_id": entity_id},
        actor=proposal.actor, executed_at=now(),
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="ai-generated", creator_id=proposal.actor,
            human_verified=False,
            notes=f"controlled write {proposal.proposal_id}; "
                  "unverified until independent verification"),
    )


async def _execute_relationship(proposal: WriteProposal,
                                fingerprint: str,
                                writer: InventoryWriter) -> WriteResult:
    fields = build_relationship_payload(
        proposal.payload.get("fields", {}))
    try:
        created = await writer._send(
            "POST", "/api/v1/relationships", fields)
    except InventoryWriteFailedError as error:
        return _failed(proposal, fingerprint, {}, str(error))
    return WriteResult(
        proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id, fingerprint=fingerprint,
        outcome="executed", before={},
        after={"relationship_id": str(created.get("id", "")),
               "from_id": fields["from_id"],
               "predicate": fields["predicate"],
               "to_id": fields["to_id"]},
        actor=proposal.actor, executed_at=now(),
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="ai-generated", creator_id=proposal.actor,
            human_verified=False,
            notes=f"controlled write {proposal.proposal_id}; "
                  "unverified until independent verification"),
    )


async def _safe_get(reader: InventoryReader, entity_type: str,
                    entity_id: str):
    try:
        return await reader.get(entity_type, entity_id)
    except Exception:
        return None


async def _readback(reader: InventoryReader, entity_type: str,
                    entity_id: str) -> dict:
    record = await _safe_get(reader, entity_type, entity_id)
    if record is None:
        return {}
    return {"entity_id": record.entity_id, "title": record.title,
            "provenance": record.provenance.model_dump(mode="json"),
            "details": dict(record.details)}


def _failed(proposal: WriteProposal, fingerprint: str, before: dict,
            error: str) -> WriteResult:
    return WriteResult(
        proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id, fingerprint=fingerprint,
        outcome="failed", before=before, after={},
        actor=proposal.actor, executed_at=now(),
        error=error[:2000],
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="ai-generated", creator_id=proposal.actor,
            human_verified=False,
            notes="controlled write failed; nothing is verified"),
    )
