<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/nodemesh.py">
"""Node mesh foundation (BIG #33): safe remote coordination.

Goal: Node A asks the coordinator to involve Node B (or B+C+D)
without ever controlling another machine directly.

Rules (fail-closed, tested):

- The coordinator stays the authority: every delegation is a
  regular task with capability routing, lease, and provenance.
- No shell, no RCE, no eval, no arbitrary command. Task kinds
  come from a closed allow-list of known-safe executors.
- No wildcard capabilities. `*` or empty requirements refuse.
- Both nodes must be registered; the target capability must be
  advertised by at least one node (by prefix, never by name
  trust — routing still decides at claim time).
- Bounded payloads: JSON-serializable refs only (ids, URLs
  already validated upstream), ≤4KB, no secrets (no keys,
  tokens, passwords by name).
- Result flows back through the normal task completion path
  with provenance naming the requesting node.

This module validates and describes; it never executes, never
opens sockets, never stores. Actual dispatch reuses the
existing task queue (`POST /api/v1/tasks`), so leases,
attempt caps, and node authentication keep applying.

BIG #41 (V2 foundation): targeted delegation. A request may
name an explicit target node. The target must be registered,
not disabled, and advertise the exact capability itself —
prefix-fuzzy matching across the mesh is NOT enough for a
pinned target, and a node never gains capabilities because
another node can reach it. Dispatch still creates a regular
queued task assigned to the target; the target must still
pull/claim it (liveness + credential re-checked at claim).
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json as _json

#: Task kinds a node may request for another node. Closed list:
#: fetch/extract/analyze over coordinator-validated inputs.
ALLOWED_TASK_KINDS = (
    "research.fetch_url",
    "research.extract",
    "analysis.summarize",
    "analysis.compare",
    "inventory.lookup",
    "vision.describe",
)

#: Capability prefixes that may be targeted. A request names a
#: full capability; the prefix must be known and the capability
#: must be advertised by a registered node.
ALLOWED_CAPABILITY_PREFIXES = (
    "research.", "analysis.", "inventory.", "camera.",
    "vision.", "mesh.", "cob.", "cad.", "system_inventory",
)

_SECRET_HINTS = ("token", "secret", "password", "passwd",
                  "api_key", "apikey", "bearer", "credential",
                  "private_key", "client_secret")

#: Request timeout bounds (seconds). Enforcement is the task
#: lease (300s); the requested timeout is validated, recorded
#: in the receipt/audit, and clamped to the lease.
MIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 5
MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 300

MAX_REASON_CHARS = 200


def validate_delegation(requesting_node: str,
                        task_kind: str,
                        capability: str,
                        payload: dict | None = None,
                        *, target_node: str | None = None,
                        timeout_seconds: int = 60,
                        reason: str = "") -> dict:
    """Validate a node→coordinator→node request. Raises ValueError.

    Keyword-only extensions (BIG #41, all fail-closed):
    target_node pins one registered, enabled node that must
    advertise the exact capability itself; timeout_seconds is
    validated 5..300 and recorded (enforced by the 300s task
    lease); reason is clipped audit text (escaped at render).
    """
    requester = str(requesting_node or "").strip()[:80]
    kind = str(task_kind or "").strip()[:80]
    raw_cap = str(capability or "").strip()
    if len(raw_cap) > 120:
        raise ValueError("capability too long (≤120)")
    cap = raw_cap
    if not requester:
        raise ValueError("requesting_node is required")
    if kind not in ALLOWED_TASK_KINDS:
        raise ValueError(f"task kind not delegable: {kind}")
    if not cap or cap == "*" or "*" in cap:
        raise ValueError("wildcard capabilities are refused")
    if not cap.startswith(ALLOWED_CAPABILITY_PREFIXES):
        raise ValueError(f"capability not delegable: {cap}")
    data = dict(payload or {})
    try:
        raw = _json.dumps(data)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise ValueError("payload must be JSON-serializable")
    if len(raw) > 4096:
        raise ValueError("payload too large (≤4KB)")
    lowered = raw.lower()
    for hint in _SECRET_HINTS:
        if hint in lowered:
            raise ValueError("payload must not carry secrets")
    try:
        timeout = int(timeout_seconds)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise ValueError("timeout must be an integer")
    if not MIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS <= timeout <= MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"timeout must be {MIN_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}.."
            f"{MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s (task lease bound)")
    why = " ".join(str(reason or "").split())[:MAX_REASON_CHARS]
    from . import main as _main
    try:
        nodes = _main.list_nodes()
    except Exception:
        raise ValueError("node registry unavailable")
    by_id = {str(row.get("node_id")): row for row in nodes}
    if requester not in by_id:
        raise ValueError("requesting node is not registered")
    target = str(target_node or "").strip()[:80] or ""
    if target:
        row = by_id.get(target)
        if row is None:
            raise ValueError("target node is not registered")
        if str(row.get("status", "")) == "disabled" or \
                str(row.get("derived_status", "")) == "disabled":
            raise ValueError("target node is disabled")
        advertised = {str(entry).strip().lower()
                      for entry in (row.get("capabilities") or [])}
        if cap.strip().lower() not in advertised:
            raise ValueError(
                "target node does not advertise that capability "
                "itself; reachability grants nothing")
        route = ("node → coordinator → pinned target "
                 "(must still claim)")
    else:
        advertised = [str(capability) for row in nodes
                      for capability in
                      (row.get("capabilities") or [])]
        if not any(str(entry) == cap or
                   str(entry).startswith(cap) or
                   cap.startswith(str(entry))
                   for entry in advertised):
            raise ValueError("no registered node advertises "
                             "that capability")
        route = "node → coordinator → eligible node(s)"
    return {"requesting_node": requester, "task_kind": kind,
            "capability": cap, "payload": data,
            "target_node": target,
            "timeout_seconds": timeout, "reason": why,
            "route": route,
            "authority": "coordinator (lease + provenance)",
            "honesty": "Validation only. Dispatch still uses "
                       "POST /api/v1/tasks; any node claims by "
                       "capability, never by remote control."}


def mesh_topology() -> dict:
    """Nodes, roles, and capability edges for the mesh view."""
    from . import main as _main
    from .ecosystem import node_roles
    try:
        nodes = _main.list_nodes()
    except Exception:
        return {"nodes": [], "edges": [], "error": "unavailable"}
    simple = [{"node_id": str(row.get("node_id")),
               "tier": str(row.get("tier", "")),
               "status": str(row.get("derived_status", "")),
               "capabilities": [str(cap) for cap in
                                (row.get("capabilities") or [])][:12],
               "roles": node_roles(row)}
              for row in nodes[:30]]
    edges: list[dict] = []
    for left in simple:
        for right in simple:
            if left["node_id"] == right["node_id"]:
                continue
            shared = [cap for cap in left["capabilities"]
                      if any(cap == other or
                             cap.split(".")[0] ==
                             other.split(".")[0]
                             for other in right["capabilities"])]
            if shared and len(edges) < 60:
                edges.append({"from": left["node_id"],
                              "to": right["node_id"],
                              "via": "coordinator",
                              "shared": shared[:3]})
    return {"nodes": simple, "edges": edges,
            "allowed_kinds": list(ALLOWED_TASK_KINDS),
            "honesty": "Edges are shared-capability hints. All "
                       "traffic goes through the coordinator task "
                       "queue — nodes never dial each other."}
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/observations.py">
"""Screen observations: what the desktop agent sees (Fase H).

An observation is metadata about one screenshot, never the pixels
themselves: an ID, a timestamp, screen dimensions, an optional local
file reference, and optional active-window metadata. Screenshots stay
on the local machine (temporary directory, bounded retention) and are
never uploaded: there is no cloud field, no external-AI flag, and no
function here sends anything anywhere.

Rules (tested):

- dimensions must be positive integers within sane bounds.
- image_ref, when present, must be a plain local filename (no
  directories, no URLs, no schemes); the runtime resolves it inside
  its own observation directory.
- active window titles are capped text; nothing secret is expected
  and nothing is parsed out of them.
- observations are ephemeral: helpers expose retention bounds, the
  runtime prunes beyond OBSERVATION_RETENTION.
"""

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

MAX_DIMENSION = 16384
MAX_TITLE_CHARS = 200
MAX_REF_CHARS = 200
OBSERVATION_RETENTION = 5


class ScreenObservation(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    observation_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    created_at: str = ""
    width: int = Field(ge=1, le=MAX_DIMENSION)
    height: int = Field(ge=1, le=MAX_DIMENSION)
    image_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_REF_CHARS)
    active_window: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_TITLE_CHARS)
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)


def check_image_ref(value: str) -> str:
    """Local filename only: no paths, URLs or schemes. Fail-closed."""
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError("image_ref must be text")
    text = value.strip()
    if not text:
        return ""
    if len(text) > MAX_REF_CHARS:
        raise ValueError("image_ref too long")
    lowered = text.lower()
    if ("://" in lowered or text.startswith("\\\\")
            or text.startswith("/") or ":" in text):
        raise ValueError("image_ref must be a plain local filename")
    if ".." in text or "/" in text or "\\" in text:
        raise ValueError("image_ref must not contain a path")
    if not text.lower().endswith((".bmp", ".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg")):
        raise ValueError("image_ref must be a .bmp, .png, .jpg or .jpeg file")
    return text


def new_observation(observation_id: str, width: int, height: int, *,
                    image_ref: str = "",
                    active_window: str = "") -> ScreenObservation:
    if not isinstance(width, int) or isinstance(width, bool):
        raise ValueError("width must be an integer")
    if not isinstance(height, int) or isinstance(height, bool):
        raise ValueError("height must be an integer")
    if not 1 <= width <= MAX_DIMENSION or not 1 <= height <= MAX_DIMENSION:
        raise ValueError("observation dimensions out of range")
    return ScreenObservation(
        observation_id=observation_id,
        width=width,
        height=height,
        image_ref=check_image_ref(image_ref),
        active_window=str(active_window or "")[:MAX_TITLE_CHARS],
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="sensor-observed",
            creator_id="desktop-agent",
            human_verified=False,
            notes="local screenshot metadata only; pixels never leave "
                  "the machine",
        ),
    )

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/ollama_chat.py">
"""Ollama-chat fallback (lokaal, gratis, geen key).

Tweede been naast Hermes voor NPC-antwoorden: Hermes eerst, bij
falen Ollama op loopback, bij falen een eerlijke system-noot (die
laatste stap woont in town_chat). Alleen JSON over HTTP naar
loopback; nooit shell, nooit credentials, nooit non-loopback.
"""

import os

DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
BASE_URL_ENV_VAR = "OLLAMA_BASE_URL"
MODEL_ENV_VAR = "OLLAMA_CHAT_MODEL"
DEFAULT_MODEL = "phi4-mini"
MAX_MODEL_LENGTH = 80
REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120.0


class OllamaRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Lokale validatie geweigerd; niets verzonden."""


class OllamaUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    """Ollama onbereikbaar of zonder bruikbaar antwoord."""


def _ollama_client():
    import httpx
    return httpx.Client(timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                        trust_env=False, follow_redirects=False)


def base_url() -> str:
    """Loopback-only basis-URL. Al het andere wordt geweigerd."""
    raw = str(os.environ.get(BASE_URL_ENV_VAR,
                             DEFAULT_BASE_URL) or "").strip()
    lowered = raw.lower()
    ok = lowered.startswith((
        "http://127.0.0.1", "http://localhost",
        "http://[::1]")) and " " not in raw and len(raw) <= 120
    if not ok:
        raise OllamaRefusedError(
            "Ollama base URL must be an http loopback address")
    return raw.rstrip("/")


def model_name() -> str:
    """Modelnaam: kort, veilige tekens, nooit leeg."""
    import re as _re
    raw = str(os.environ.get(MODEL_ENV_VAR,
                             DEFAULT_MODEL) or "").strip()
    if not raw or len(raw) > MAX_MODEL_LENGTH or not _re.match(
            r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$", raw):
        raise OllamaRefusedError(
            "Ollama model must be 1..80 chars "
            "[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]")
    return raw


def ollama_say(npc_id: str, message: str, system: str = "") -> str:
    """Eén chat-beurt via Ollama. Geeft de tekst terug.

    npc_id moet een bekende Hermes-NPC zijn (zelfde cast, zelfde
    regels); het system-prompt komt uit hun definitie. Lege
    antwoorden en fouten worden OllamaUnavailable — de caller
    beslist wat dan (town_chat: eerlijke noot).
    """
    from .hermes_npc import HERMES_NPCS
    npc_key = str(npc_id or "").strip()
    if npc_key not in HERMES_NPCS:
        raise OllamaRefusedError(f"Unknown NPC '{npc_key}'")
    text = str(message or "").strip()
    if not text:
        raise OllamaRefusedError("Message must be non-empty text")
    if len(text) > 2000:
        raise OllamaRefusedError("Message exceeds 2000 characters")
    npc = HERMES_NPCS[npc_key]
    url = base_url() + "/api/chat"
    prompt = str(system or npc.get("system", "") or "").strip()[:2000]
    try:
        with _ollama_client() as client:
            response = client.post(url, json={
                "model": model_name(),
                "stream": False,
                "options": {"num_predict": 220},
                "messages": [
                    {"role": "system", "content": prompt},
                    {"role": "user", "content": text[:2000]},
                ]})
    except Exception as error:
        raise OllamaUnavailable(
            f"Ollama unreachable: {type(error).__name__}")
    if response.status_code != 200:
        raise OllamaUnavailable(
            f"Ollama answered HTTP {response.status_code}")
    try:
        data = response.json()
    except Exception:
        raise OllamaUnavailable("Ollama answered invalid JSON")
    reply = str(((data.get("message") or {}).get("content")
                 or "").strip())
    if not reply:
        raise OllamaUnavailable("Ollama returned an empty reply")
    return reply
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/project_package.py">
"""Project-aware context packages (BIG #5).

One bounded question — "what are we building?" — answered from
live sources without dumping anything:

    Project
    +-- directly related INVENTory entities (bounded retrieval)
    +-- relevant missions (Mycelium-owned, bounded)
    +-- recent events (bounded)
    +-- git context (read-only status/branch, no diff contents)
    +-- provenance (every record keeps its source/verification)

INVENTory stays source of truth for world entities; Mycelium
stays owner of missions/agent/coordinator/conversational state.
This module never merges them into a new store — it projects a
compact, read-only package for reasoning, and the package is
never a permission for anything.

Bounds (tested):

- entities <= 10, missions <= 5, events <= 10, files listed by
  name only (never contents);
- no secrets: values whose keys look like credentials are
  dropped, absolute paths are redacted to $PROJECT;
- retrieval reuses hybrid_retrieve() with automatic lexical
  fallback — a missing embedding model never fails packaging.
"""

import os
import re
from typing import Any

SECRET_KEY_PATTERN = re.compile(
    r"(api[_-]?key|token|secret|password|passwd|credential|"
    r"private[_-]?key|auth)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)

MAX_ENTITIES = 10
MAX_MISSIONS = 5
MAX_EVENTS = 10
MAX_FILES = 10
MAX_OBSERVATIONS = 5
MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 500


def redact_path(text: str, repo_root: str = "") -> str:
    """Replace absolute local paths with $PROJECT. No sensitive
    absolute paths ever reach model context."""
    if not isinstance(text, str) or not text:
        return text
    redacted = text
    home = os.path.expanduser("~")
    if home and home in redacted:
        redacted = redacted.replace(home, "$HOME")
    if repo_root and repo_root in redacted:
        redacted = redacted.replace(repo_root, "$PROJECT")
    return redacted


def _clean_text(value, repo_root: str = "") -> str:
    text = str(value or "")[:MAX_TEXT_CHARS]
    return redact_path(text, repo_root)


def _clean_record(record: dict, repo_root: str = "") -> dict:
    """One entity summary: identity + snippet + provenance only."""
    provenance = record.get("provenance", {})
    if hasattr(provenance, "model_dump"):
        provenance = provenance.model_dump(mode="json")
    if not isinstance(provenance, dict):
        provenance = {}
    return {
        "entity_type": str(record.get("entity_type", "unknown")),
        "entity_id": str(record.get("entity_id", "")),
        "title": _clean_text(record.get("title", ""), repo_root),
        "snippet": _clean_text(record.get("snippet", ""), repo_root),
        "match_type": str(record.get("match_type", "lexical")),
        "provenance": {
            "source_type": str(provenance.get("source_type", "unknown")),
            "human_verified": bool(provenance.get(
                "human_verified", False)),
        },
    }


def _clean_mission(mission, repo_root: str = "") -> dict:
    status = mission.get("status", "") if isinstance(mission, dict) \
        else getattr(mission, "status", "")
    goal = mission.get("goal", "") if isinstance(mission, dict) \
        else getattr(mission, "goal", "")
    mission_id = mission.get("mission_id", "") \
        if isinstance(mission, dict) \
        else getattr(mission, "mission_id", "")
    steps: list[dict] = []
    raw_steps = mission.get("steps", []) if isinstance(mission, dict) \
        else getattr(mission, "steps", [])
    for step in list(raw_steps)[:10]:
        if isinstance(step, dict):
            steps.append({
                "description": _clean_text(
                    step.get("description", ""), repo_root),
                "kind": str(step.get("kind", "")),
                "status": str(step.get("status", "")),
            })
        else:
            steps.append({
                "description": _clean_text(
                    getattr(step, "description", ""), repo_root),
                "kind": str(getattr(step, "kind", "")),
                "status": str(getattr(step, "status", "")),
            })
    return {"mission_id": str(mission_id),
            "goal": _clean_text(goal, repo_root),
            "status": str(status), "steps": steps}


def _clean_event(event: dict, repo_root: str = "") -> dict:
    return {
        "event_type": str(event.get("event_type", "")),
        "message": _clean_text(event.get("message", ""), repo_root),
        "mission_id": str(event.get("mission_id", "")),
        "created_at": str(event.get("created_at", "")),
    }


def _clean_observation(observation: dict,
                       repo_root: str = "") -> dict:
    """One observation summary: identity + camera + timestamp +
    vision labels only. Never pixels, never media contents."""
    provenance = observation.get("provenance", {})
    if hasattr(provenance, "model_dump"):
        provenance = provenance.model_dump(mode="json")
    if not isinstance(provenance, dict):
        provenance = {}
    analyses = observation.get("analyses", [])
    labels: list[str] = []
    if isinstance(analyses, list):
        for analysis in analyses[:3]:
            if isinstance(analysis, dict):
                for label in list(analysis.get("labels", []))[:5]:
                    if (isinstance(label, str) and label
                            and label not in labels):
                        labels.append(label[:120])
    _ = repo_root
    return {
        "observation_id": str(observation.get("observation_id", "")),
        "device_id": str(observation.get("device_id", "")),
        "media_ref": str(observation.get("media_ref", "")),
        "created_at": str(observation.get("created_at", "")),
        "vision_labels": labels,
        "provenance": {
            "source_type": str(provenance.get(
                "source_type", "sensor-observed")),
            "human_verified": bool(provenance.get(
                "human_verified", False)),
        },
    }


def _clean_git(git: dict, repo_root: str = "") -> dict:
    if not isinstance(git, dict):
        return {}
    lines = [redact_path(str(line), repo_root)
             for line in list(git.get("lines", []))[:20]]
    return {
        "branch": str(git.get("branch", ""))[:120],
        "changed_files": len(lines),
        "clean": not lines,
    }


def _drop_secrets(mapping: dict) -> dict:
    """Remove anything whose key smells like a credential."""
    return {key: value for key, value in mapping.items()
            if not SECRET_KEY_PATTERN.search(str(key))}


def build_project_package(project, *, entities: list[dict] | None = None,
                          missions: list | None = None,
                          events: list[dict] | None = None,
                          git: dict | None = None,
                          files: list[dict] | None = None,
                          observations: list[dict] | None = None,
                          retrieval_mode: str = "lexical") -> dict:
    """Assemble one bounded, read-only project package (pure)."""
    if hasattr(project, "model_dump"):
        project_data = project.model_dump(mode="json")
    elif isinstance(project, dict):
        project_data = _drop_secrets(dict(project))
    else:
        raise ValueError("Project package needs a project context")
    repo_root = str(project_data.get("repository", ""))
    package = {
        "project_id": str(project_data.get("project_id", "")),
        "name": str(project_data.get("name", ""))[:120],
        "repository": redact_path(repo_root, repo_root),
        "retrieval_mode": retrieval_mode,
        "entities": [_clean_record(record, repo_root)
                     for record in list(entities or [])[:MAX_ENTITIES]],
        "missions": [_clean_mission(mission, repo_root)
                     for mission in list(missions or [])[:MAX_MISSIONS]],
        "events": [_clean_event(event, repo_root)
                   for event in list(events or [])[:MAX_EVENTS]],
        "git": _clean_git(git or {}, repo_root),
        "files": [{"name": str(item.get("name", ""))[:200]}
                  for item in list(files or [])[:MAX_FILES]],
        "observations": [_clean_observation(item, repo_root)
                         for item in
                         list(observations or [])[:MAX_OBSERVATIONS]],
        "provenance": {
            "source_type": "user-created",
            "human_verified": False,
            "notes": "bounded read-only projection; "
                     "not a permission for anything",
        },
    }
    return package


def summarize_for_chat(package: dict) -> str:
    """Two-to-five-line preamble answering 'what are we building?'."""
    lines = [f"Actief project: {package.get('name', '?')}"]
    entities = package.get("entities", [])
    if entities:
        lines.append(f"Gerelateerd uit INVENTory ({len(entities)}):")
        for entity in entities[:5]:
            verified = "✓" if entity.get("provenance", {}).get(
                "human_verified") else "○"
            lines.append(f"{verified} [{entity.get('entity_type')}] "
                         f"{entity.get('title')} "
                         f"({entity.get('entity_id')})")
    missions = [mission for mission in package.get("missions", [])
                if mission.get("status") not in ("completed", "cancelled")]
    if missions:
        lines.append("Open missies:")
        for mission in missions[:3]:
            lines.append(f"- {mission.get('goal', '')} "
                         f"[{mission.get('status', '')}]")
    git = package.get("git", {})
    if git:
        state = "schoon" if git.get("clean") else (
            f"{git.get('changed_files', 0)} gewijzigde bestanden")
        lines.append(f"Git ({git.get('branch', '?')}): {state}.")
    observations = package.get("observations", [])
    if observations:
        lines.append("Recente observaties:")
        for item in observations[:3]:
            labels = ", ".join(item.get("vision_labels", [])[:3])
            suffix = f" — VLM: {labels}" if labels else ""
            lines.append(f"- {item.get('observation_id', '?')} via "
                         f"{item.get('device_id', '?')} "
                         f"({item.get('created_at', '?')}){suffix}")
    lines.append("Details staan in INVENTory; dit is context, "
                 "geen toestemming.")
    return "\n".join(lines)


async def assemble_project_package(project, reader, *,
                                   query: str = "",
                                   missions: list | None = None,
                                   events: list[dict] | None = None,
                                   git: dict | None = None,
                                   observations: list[dict] | None = None,
                                   embedder=None,
                                   mode: str = "hybrid",
                                   limit: int = 10) -> dict:
    """Live assembly: project + retrieval + overlays, all bounded.

    Retrieval failures degrade to an empty entity list (lexical
    fallback lives inside hybrid_retrieve); packaging never raises
    for missing world data.
    """
    from .retrieval import hybrid_retrieve
    entities: list[dict] = []
    used_mode = "lexical"
    needle = (query or "").strip()
    if needle:
        try:
            found = await hybrid_retrieve(
                needle[:200], reader, embedder, mode=mode,
                limit=max(1, min(limit, MAX_ENTITIES)))
            entities = found.get("results", [])
            used_mode = found.get("mode_used", mode)
        except (ValueError, RuntimeError):
            entities = []
    return build_project_package(
        project, entities=entities, missions=missions, events=events,
        git=git, observations=observations,
        retrieval_mode=used_mode)

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/quests.py">
"""Quest trails (BIG #42).

The first real quest-trail abstraction over existing missions,
craft states, symbiosis and presence. A quest references real
work — it never duplicates state:

- A quest def names ordered steps, each pointing at a REAL record
  (mission_id, task id, finance/energy/hardware-link id, or an
  entity id). Steps carry no state of their own.
- Every read derives step state live from the underlying store:
  ✓ COMPLETE (underlying record reached its done state),
  ● ACTIVE (running/approved/in-flight), ! BLOCKED/FAILED,
  ○ MISSING (empty ref or record gone).
- Progress (done/total) is real progress, no XP.
- Hardware-aware readiness names WHY a step is READY / WAITING /
  BLOCKED / UNAVAILABLE from actual node/device state — offline
  hardware is never pretended available.

Quest-level states (closed): READY | ACTIVE | WAITING | BLOCKED |
COMPLETED | FAILED.

Storage: chat DB table quests holds ONLY the def (title + step
refs). All state derives on read.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re as _re
import secrets
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

QUEST_STATES = ("READY", "ACTIVE", "WAITING", "BLOCKED",
                "COMPLETED", "FAILED")
STEP_STATES = ("COMPLETE", "ACTIVE", "WAITING", "BLOCKED",
               "FAILED", "MISSING", "UNAVAILABLE")
STEP_KINDS = ("mission", "task", "entity", "finance", "energy",
              "hardware", "note")

STEP_GLYPHS = {"COMPLETE": "✓", "ACTIVE": "●", "WAITING": "○",
               "BLOCKED": "!", "FAILED": "!", "MISSING": "○",
               "UNAVAILABLE": "✕"}

_REF_RE = _re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,119}$")


class QuestRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was stored."""


class QuestStep(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    key: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=60)
    label: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=16)
    ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)


class QuestTrail(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    quest_id: str = Field(min_length=4, max_length=80)
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    steps: list[QuestStep] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                   max_length=24)
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_quest_id() -> str:
    return f"qst_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def init_quest_tables(db) -> None:
    db.execute("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS quests (
            quest_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            steps TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        """)


def _ensure(db) -> None:
    init_quest_tables(db)


def new_quest(title: str, steps: list[dict]) -> QuestTrail:
    cleaned_title = str(title or "").strip()
    if not cleaned_title:
        raise QuestRefusedError("Quest needs a title")
    if len(cleaned_title) > 200:
        raise QuestRefusedError("Quest title is too long")
    if not isinstance(steps, list) or not steps:
        raise QuestRefusedError("Quest needs at least one step")
    if len(steps) > 24:
        raise QuestRefusedError("Quest has at most 24 steps")
    parsed: list[QuestStep] = []
    seen_keys: set = set()
    for index, raw in enumerate(steps):
        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
            raise QuestRefusedError(f"Step {index} must be an object")
        key = str(raw.get("key", "")).strip()[:60] or f"step-{index}"
        if key in seen_keys:
            raise QuestRefusedError(f"Duplicate step key '{key}'")
        seen_keys.add(key)
        kind = str(raw.get("kind", "")).strip().lower()[:16]
        if kind not in STEP_KINDS:
            raise QuestRefusedError(
                f"Unknown step kind '{kind}'; expected one of "
                f"{list(STEP_KINDS)}")
        ref = str(raw.get("ref", "")).strip()[:120]
        if kind != "note" and ref and not _REF_RE.match(ref):
            raise QuestRefusedError(
                f"Step '{key}' ref is malformed")
        parsed.append(QuestStep(
            key=key,
            label=str(raw.get("label", "")).strip()[:200] or key,
            kind=kind, ref=ref))
    stamp = now()
    return QuestTrail(quest_id=generate_quest_id(),
                      title=cleaned_title[:200], steps=parsed,
                      created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp)


def save_quest(quest: QuestTrail) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        db.execute(
            """INSERT INTO quests
            (quest_id, title, steps, created_at, updated_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT(quest_id) DO UPDATE SET
             title=excluded.title, steps=excluded.steps,
             updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
            (quest.quest_id, quest.title,
             dump([step.model_dump(mode="json")
                   for step in quest.steps]),
             quest.created_at, quest.updated_at))
    _audit("quest.created", f"Quest '{quest.title}' defined",
           payload={"quest_id": quest.quest_id})


def _row_to_quest(row) -> QuestTrail:
    from .database import load
    try:
        raw_steps = load(row["steps"])
    except Exception:
        raw_steps = []
    steps = []
    if isinstance(raw_steps, list):
        for raw in raw_steps[:24]:
            try:
                steps.append(QuestStep(**raw) if isinstance(
                    raw, dict) else None)
            except Exception:
                continue
    steps = [step for step in steps if step is not None]
    return QuestTrail(quest_id=row["quest_id"],
                      title=row["title"] or "",
                      steps=steps,
                      created_at=row["created_at"] or "",
                      updated_at=row["updated_at"] or "")


def get_quest(quest_id: str) -> QuestTrail | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    cleaned = str(quest_id or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned:
        return None
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        row = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM quests WHERE quest_id=?",
            (cleaned,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return _row_to_quest(row)


def list_quests(limit: int = 50) -> list[QuestTrail]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 50), 100))
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM quests ORDER BY updated_at DESC "
            "LIMIT ?", (count,)).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_quest(row) for row in rows]


def delete_quest(quest_id: str) -> bool:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        _ensure(db)
        changed = db.execute(
            "DELETE FROM quests WHERE quest_id=?",
            (str(quest_id or "").strip()[:80],)).rowcount
    return bool(changed)


# -- live derivation ----------------------------------------------------

def _mission_state(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    """(state, detail, href) for a mission step."""
    try:
        from .missions import load_mission
        mission = load_mission(ref)
    except Exception:
        return ("MISSING", "mission record unreadable",
                f"/missions/{ref}")
    if mission is None:
        return ("MISSING", "mission not found", "/missions")
    try:
        record = getattr(mission, "record", None)
        if isinstance(record, dict):
            status = str(record.get("status", "unknown"))
        else:
            status = str(getattr(mission, "status", "unknown"))
    except Exception:
        status = "unknown"
    href = f"/missions/{ref}"
    if status == "completed":
        return ("COMPLETE", "mission completed", href)
    if status in ("approved", "running"):
        return ("ACTIVE", f"mission {status}", href)
    if status == "failed":
        return ("FAILED", "mission failed", href)
    if status in ("blocked",):
        return ("BLOCKED", "mission blocked", href)
    if status in ("pending_approval", "paused"):
        return ("WAITING", f"mission {status}", href)
    if status in ("cancelled",):
        return ("MISSING", "mission cancelled", href)
    return ("WAITING", f"mission {status}", href)


def _task_state(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    try:
        task_id = int(str(ref).strip())
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ("MISSING", "task ref is not a task id", "/activity")
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        from .database import connection
        with connection() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT id, kind, status, assigned_node_id FROM "
                "tasks WHERE id=?", (task_id,)).fetchone()
    except Exception:
        return ("MISSING", "task record unreadable", "/activity")
    if row is None:
        return ("MISSING", "task not found", "/activity")
    status = str(row["status"])
    href = f"/api/v1/tasks/by-id/{task_id}"
    if status == "completed":
        return ("COMPLETE", f"task #{task_id} completed", href)
    if status in ("assigned", "running"):
        return ("ACTIVE", f"task #{task_id} {status}", href)
    if status == "failed":
        return ("FAILED", f"task #{task_id} failed", href)
    if status in ("blocked", "cancelled"):
        return ("BLOCKED", f"task #{task_id} {status}", href)
    return ("WAITING", f"task #{task_id} {status}", href)


def _finance_state(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    try:
        from .finance import get_record
        record = get_record(ref)
    except Exception:
        return ("MISSING", "finance record unreadable", "/finance")
    if record is None:
        return ("MISSING", "finance record not found", "/finance")
    href = f"/finance?record_id={ref}"
    if record.status == "CONFIRMED":
        return ("COMPLETE", f"finance {record.kind} confirmed", href)
    if record.status == "ARCHIVED":
        return ("COMPLETE", "finance record archived", href)
    return ("WAITING", "finance record draft", href)


def _energy_state(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    try:
        from .energy import get_record
        record = get_record(ref)
    except Exception:
        return ("MISSING", "energy record unreadable", "/energy")
    if record is None:
        return ("MISSING", "energy record not found", "/energy")
    href = f"/energy?record_id={ref}"
    if record.value is None:
        return ("WAITING", "energy value unknown", href)
    return ("COMPLETE", f"energy {record.source} recorded", href)


def _hardware_state(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    try:
        from .hardware_links import get_link
        link = get_link(ref)
    except Exception:
        return ("MISSING", "hardware link unreadable", "/hardware")
    if link is None:
        return ("MISSING", "hardware link not found", "/hardware")
    href = f"/hardware?link_id={ref}"
    if link.status == "VERIFIED":
        return ("COMPLETE", "hardware human-verified", href)
    if link.status == "REVOKED":
        return ("BLOCKED", "hardware link revoked", href)
    return ("WAITING", "hardware link proposed", href)


def derive_step_state(step: QuestStep) -> dict:
    """Live state for one step — no stored state consulted."""
    if not step.ref:
        if step.kind == "note":
            return {"key": step.key, "label": step.label,
                    "kind": step.kind, "ref": "",
                    "state": "MISSING",
                    "glyph": STEP_GLYPHS["MISSING"],
                    "detail": "note without linked record",
                    "href": "/quests", "readiness": "WAITING",
                    "readiness_reason": "no linked record"}
        return {"key": step.key, "label": step.label,
                "kind": step.kind, "ref": "",
                "state": "MISSING",
                "glyph": STEP_GLYPHS["MISSING"],
                "detail": "no linked record yet",
                "href": "/quests", "readiness": "WAITING",
                "readiness_reason": "no linked record"}
    if step.kind == "mission":
        state, detail, href = _mission_state(step.ref)
    elif step.kind == "task":
        state, detail, href = _task_state(step.ref)
    elif step.kind == "finance":
        state, detail, href = _finance_state(step.ref)
    elif step.kind == "energy":
        state, detail, href = _energy_state(step.ref)
    elif step.kind == "hardware":
        state, detail, href = _hardware_state(step.ref)
    elif step.kind == "entity":
        state, detail, href = ("WAITING",
                               "entity link — open in world",
                               f"/world?entity_id={step.ref}")
    else:
        state, detail, href = ("MISSING", "note step",
                               "/quests")
    readiness, readiness_reason = step_readiness(step, state)
    return {"key": step.key, "label": step.label,
            "kind": step.kind, "ref": step.ref, "state": state,
            "glyph": STEP_GLYPHS.get(state, "○"), "detail": detail,
            "href": href, "readiness": readiness,
            "readiness_reason": readiness_reason}


def step_readiness(step: QuestStep,
                   state: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """Hardware-aware readiness: READY / WAITING / BLOCKED /
    UNAVAILABLE from actual node/device state. Honest — never
    claims hardware that is offline or missing."""
    if state in ("COMPLETE",):
        return ("READY", "underlying record is done")
    if state in ("FAILED", "BLOCKED"):
        return ("BLOCKED", "underlying record needs attention")
    label = f"{step.label} {step.ref}".lower()
    wants_camera = "camera" in label or "observ" in label
    wants_gpu = "gpu" in label
    wants_printer = ("fabricat" in label or "print" in label)
    wants_research = ("research" in label or step.kind == "mission"
                      and "research" in label)
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        nodes = _main.list_nodes()
    except Exception:
        return ("WAITING", "node state unreadable")
    live = [node for node in nodes
            if str(node.get("derived_status", "")) in
            ("online", "busy")]
    if not live and state == "MISSING":
        return ("WAITING", "no linked record yet")
    if wants_printer:
        return ("UNAVAILABLE", "printer transport is unavailable")
    if wants_camera:
        for node in live:
            hardware = node.get("hardware", []) or []
            for item in hardware:
                if not isinstance(item, dict):
                    continue
                if str(item.get("kind", "")).lower() == "camera" \
                        and str(item.get("status", "")).lower() \
                        == "connected":
                    return ("READY",
                            f"{node.get('node_id')} has a connected "
                            "camera")
        cams = [node.get("node_id") for node in nodes
                if any(str(item.get("kind", "")).lower() == "camera"
                       for item in (node.get("hardware", []) or [])
                       if isinstance(item, dict))]
        if cams:
            return ("WAITING",
                    f"camera node {cams[0]} is offline")
        return ("BLOCKED", "no camera hardware advertised")
    if wants_gpu or wants_research:
        try:
            from .presence import research_readiness
            readiness = research_readiness()
        except Exception:
            readiness = {}
        eligible = readiness.get("eligible", []) or []
        if eligible:
            return ("READY",
                    f"{eligible[0]} can run it now")
        return ("WAITING",
                str(readiness.get("text",
                                  "no eligible node"))[:160])
    if live:
        return ("READY", f"{len(live)} node(s) online")
    return ("WAITING", "no nodes online")


def quest_detail(quest: QuestTrail) -> dict:
    steps = [derive_step_state(step) for step in quest.steps]
    done = sum(1 for step in steps
               if step["state"] == "COMPLETE")
    states = [step["state"] for step in steps]
    if states and all(state == "COMPLETE" for state in states):
        level = "COMPLETED"
    elif "FAILED" in states:
        level = "FAILED"
    elif "BLOCKED" in states:
        level = "BLOCKED"
    elif "ACTIVE" in states:
        level = "ACTIVE"
    elif "WAITING" in states or "MISSING" in states:
        level = "WAITING"
    else:
        level = "READY"
    return {"quest_id": quest.quest_id, "title": quest.title,
            "state": level, "done": done, "total": len(steps),
            "steps": steps,
            "progress": f"{done}/{len(steps)}",
            "fabrication": _quest_fabrication(quest),
            "provenance": {"source_type": "derived",
                           "creator_id": "quest-trails",
                           "human_verified": False}}


def _quest_fabrication(quest: QuestTrail) -> list[dict]:
    """Existing fabrication_chain() states for fabrication-flavored
    quests, else []. Read-only representation of REAL / SIMULATED /
    BLOCKED / UNAVAILABLE transitions — never a capability claim,
    never execution. Same label heuristic as step_readiness."""
    try:
        wants_fab = any(
            any(token in str(step.label or "").lower()
                for token in ("fabricat", "print", "slice", "mesh",
                              "model", "gcode"))
            for step in quest.steps)
    except Exception:
        return []
    if not wants_fab:
        return []
    try:
        from .play_workshop import fabrication_chain
        return fabrication_chain()
    except Exception:
        return []


def list_quest_details(limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
    return [quest_detail(quest)
            for quest in list_quests(limit=limit)]


def _audit(event_type: str, summary: str, *,
           payload: dict | None = None) -> None:
    try:
        from .events import new_event, save_event
        save_event(new_event(event_type, summary,
                             payload=payload or {}))
    except Exception:
        pass

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/robots.py">
"""Robot domain (BIG #11-15, Phase 5).

Robots are allow-listed capability holders with an explicit
safety state. The flow is intent → plan → simulation note →
proposal → approval → task → lease → execute → telemetry →
observation → verification, but this module implements the
data half: proposal, approval record, telemetry validation
and independent verification. Physical execution itself is
HARDWARE_REQUIRED and never simulated as real.

Safety: physical actions (move/grab/place/navigate) need
safety_state safe|supervised AND a human approval. locked/
estop refuse everything physical. No wildcards, ever.
"""

import secrets
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

ROBOT_TYPES = (
    "robotic_arm",
    "mobile_rover",
    "stationary",
    "other",
)

ROBOT_CAPABILITIES = (
    "robot.move",
    "robot.observe",
    "robot.grab",
    "robot.place",
    "robot.speak",
    "robot.navigate",
    "robot.stop",
    "robot.status",
)

PHYSICAL_ACTIONS = (
    "robot.move",
    "robot.grab",
    "robot.place",
    "robot.navigate",
)

SAFETY_STATES = (
    "safe",
    "supervised",
    "locked",
    "estop",
    "unknown",
)

ROBOT_STATUSES = (
    "idle",
    "busy",
    "offline",
    "maintenance",
)


class RobotRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed robot validation."""


def now() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now(
        datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_robot_id() -> str:
    return f"rbt_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def generate_action_id() -> str:
    return f"ract_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


class Robot(BaseModel):
    robot_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    robot_type: str = Field(default="other", max_length=20)
    capabilities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                    max_length=20)
    location: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    status: str = Field(default="idle", max_length=20)
    safety_state: str = Field(default="safe", max_length=20)
    node_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    sensors: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                               max_length=20)
    actuators: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                 max_length=20)
    provenance: Provenance
    updated_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


class RobotTelemetry(BaseModel):
    action_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    robot_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    status: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    detail: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    observed_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


def new_robot(name: str, *, robot_type: str = "other",
              capabilities: list | None = None,
              location: str = "", node_id: str = "",
              sensors: list | None = None,
              actuators: list | None = None,
              provenance: Provenance | None = None) -> Robot:
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        raise RobotRefusedError("robot needs a name")
    if robot_type not in ROBOT_TYPES:
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            f"Unknown robot type '{robot_type}'")
    caps = []
    for cap in (capabilities or []):
        if cap not in ROBOT_CAPABILITIES:
            raise RobotRefusedError(
                f"Unknown robot capability '{cap}'; no "
                "wildcards, no custom capabilities")
        caps.append(cap)
    return Robot(
        robot_id=generate_robot_id(), name=name.strip()[:200],
        robot_type=robot_type, capabilities=caps,
        location=str(location or "")[:200],
        status="idle", safety_state="safe",
        node_id=str(node_id or "")[:80],
        sensors=[str(item)[:80]
                 for item in (sensors or [])][:20],
        actuators=[str(item)[:80]
                   for item in (actuators or [])][:20],
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="user-created", creator_id="robots",
            human_verified=False),
        updated_at=now())


def _row_to_robot(row) -> Robot:
    from .database import load
    return Robot(
        robot_id=row["robot_id"], name=row["name"],
        robot_type=row["robot_type"],
        capabilities=load(row["capabilities"]),
        location=row["location"], status=row["status"],
        safety_state=row["safety_state"],
        node_id=row["node_id"],
        sensors=[], actuators=[],
        provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
        updated_at=row["updated_at"])


def save_robot(robot: Robot) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO robots
        (robot_id, name, robot_type, capabilities, location,
         status, safety_state, node_id, provenance,
         updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(robot_id) DO UPDATE SET
         location=excluded.location, status=excluded.status,
         safety_state=excluded.safety_state,
         node_id=excluded.node_id,
         updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
                     (robot.robot_id, robot.name,
                      robot.robot_type,
                      dump(robot.capabilities), robot.location,
                      robot.status, robot.safety_state,
                      robot.node_id,
                      dump(robot.provenance.model_dump(
                          mode="json")), robot.updated_at))


def get_robot(robot_id: str) -> Robot | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM robots WHERE robot_id=?",
                         (robot_id,)).fetchone()
    return _row_to_robot(row) if row is not None else None


def list_robots() -> list[Robot]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM robots ORDER BY "
                          "updated_at DESC LIMIT 100").fetchall()
    return [_row_to_robot(row) for row in rows]


def set_safety(robot_id: str, safety_state: str) -> Robot:
    if safety_state not in SAFETY_STATES:
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            f"Unknown safety state '{safety_state}'")
    robot = get_robot(robot_id)
    if robot is None:
        raise RobotRefusedError("robot not found")
    updated = robot.model_copy(update={
        "safety_state": safety_state, "updated_at": now()})
    save_robot(updated)
    return updated


def build_robot_proposal(robot_id: str, action: str,
                         params: dict, actor: str,
                         *, simulation_note: str = ""):
    """Intent → inert WriteProposal (mutation type
    robot.execute). Same exact-YES/fingerprint/staleness
    machinery as every other mutation: approval happens
    through the generic write-approval flow, never through
    a robot-local string check. The payload snapshots the
    safety state and capabilities, so later changes break
    the fingerprint instead of slipping through."""
    from .controlled_writes import propose_write
    robot = get_robot(robot_id)
    if robot is None:
        raise RobotRefusedError("robot not found")
    if action not in ROBOT_CAPABILITIES:
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            f"Unknown robot action '{action}'")
    if action not in robot.capabilities:
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            f"robot lacks capability '{action}'")
    if not isinstance(params, dict) or len(params) > 10:
        raise RobotRefusedError("params must be a small object")
    if not isinstance(actor, str) or not actor.strip():
        raise RobotRefusedError("proposal needs an actor")
    return propose_write(
        generate_action_id(), "robot.execute",
        f"robot:{robot_id}",
        {"action": action, "params": dict(params),
         "physical": action in PHYSICAL_ACTIONS,
         "safety_state": robot.safety_state,
         "capabilities": sorted(robot.capabilities),
         "simulation_note": str(simulation_note or "")[:500]},
        actor=actor.strip()[:80])


def check_robot_state_for_approval(robot_id: str,
                                   proposal) -> Robot:
    """Pre-approval recheck against live state (not the
    client body): target binding, capability still owned,
    safety still safe|supervised for physical actions,
    robot still idle. Called by the approve route after
    loading the stored proposal."""
    robot = get_robot(robot_id)
    if robot is None:
        raise RobotRefusedError("robot not found")
    payload = proposal.payload or {}
    if proposal.target != f"robot:{robot_id}":
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            "proposal target does not bind to this robot")
    action = str(payload.get("action", ""))
    if action not in robot.capabilities:
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            f"robot no longer holds capability '{action}'")
    if payload.get("physical") and robot.safety_state not in (
            "safe", "supervised"):
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            f"physical action refused: safety state is "
            f"'{robot.safety_state}'")
    if robot.status != "idle":
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            f"robot is '{robot.status}'; only idle robots "
            "take new actions")
    return robot


def mark_robot_busy(robot_id: str) -> None:
    robot = get_robot(robot_id)
    if robot is None:
        raise RobotRefusedError("robot not found")
    save_robot(robot.model_copy(update={
        "status": "busy", "updated_at": now()}))


def record_telemetry(action_id: str, robot_id: str,
                     status: str, detail: str = ""
                     ) -> RobotTelemetry:
    """Validated telemetry envelope. Data in, no execution."""
    if not isinstance(status, str) or not status.strip() or \
            len(status) > 40:
        raise RobotRefusedError("telemetry needs a status")
    return RobotTelemetry(
        action_id=action_id, robot_id=robot_id,
        status=status.strip()[:40],
        detail=str(detail or "")[:500], observed_at=now())


def resolve_observation(ref: str) -> dict:
    """Resolve an observation reference to a stored record:
    mem_<...> memories or obs-... camera observations. Free
    caller text never resolves — it cannot become evidence."""
    text = str(ref or "").strip()
    if text.startswith("mem_"):
        from .memory import get_memory
        entry = get_memory(text)
        if entry is None or entry.status == "deleted":
            raise RobotRefusedError(
                "observation reference resolves to nothing")
        return {"kind": "memory", "id": entry.memory_id,
                "title": entry.title,
                "truth": entry.truth}
    if text.startswith("obs-"):
        from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
        init_chat_database()
        with chat_connection() as db:
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT record FROM camera_observations ORDER "
                "BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200").fetchall()
        from .database import load
        for row in rows:
            try:
                record = load(row["record"])
            except ValueError:
                continue
            if isinstance(record, dict) and record.get(
                    "observation_id") == text:
                return {"kind": "camera_observation",
                        "id": text,
                        "device_id": record.get("device_id",
                                                "")}
        raise RobotRefusedError(
            "observation reference resolves to nothing")
    raise RobotRefusedError(
        "observation must cite a stored record "
        "(mem_... memory or obs-... camera observation); "
        "caller assertions are never evidence")


def verify_action(telemetry: RobotTelemetry,
                  observation_ref: str) -> dict:
    """Independent verification: telemetry alone never
    verifies; a cited stored observation is required, and
    only telemetry success + resolvable evidence verifies."""
    evidence = resolve_observation(observation_ref)
    robot = get_robot(telemetry.robot_id)
    if robot is not None:
        save_robot(robot.model_copy(update={
            "status": "idle", "updated_at": now()}))
    verdict = "verified" if telemetry.status in (
        "completed", "success", "done") else "not_verified"
    return {"action_id": telemetry.action_id,
            "verdict": verdict,
            "method": "telemetry status + cited stored "
                      "observation (caller text alone never "
                      "verifies)",
            "evidence": evidence}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/skills.py">
"""Skills domain (BIG #11-15, Phase 3).

A skill is evidence-based: DISCOVERED → INTERESTED →
LEARNING → PRACTICING → APPLIED → DEMONSTRATED → MASTERED.
Stages advance on evidence, never on AI claims; the top two
stages need human confirmation.

Research/project context may only produce SkillCandidates
(candidate ≠ owned skill). A candidate becomes a skill
through explicit user acceptance.
"""

import secrets
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

SKILL_STAGES = (
    "discovered",
    "interested",
    "learning",
    "practicing",
    "applied",
    "demonstrated",
    "mastered",
)

PROFICIENCIES = (
    "unknown",
    "novice",
    "competent",
    "proficient",
    "expert",
)

# Deterministic discovery map: keyword → skill suggestion.
# A suggestion is a candidate with evidence, never a skill.
DISCOVERY_KEYWORDS = {
    "3d print": "3D printing",
    "robotic arm": "robotics",
    "robot": "robotics",
    "cad": "CAD",
    "mesh": "mesh repair",
    "slic": "slicer configuration",
    "electronic": "electronics",
    "motor": "motors",
    "control": "control systems",
    "python": "Python",
    "fabricat": "fabrication",
    "vegan": "vegan nutrition",
    "recipe": "recipe development",
    "danc": "dancing",
    "skate": "skating",
    "freerun": "freerunning",
    "solar": "sustainable design",
    "camera": "photography",
    "garmin": "endurance training",
    "drone": "drone operation",
}


class SkillRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed skill validation."""


def now() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now(
        datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_skill_id() -> str:
    return f"skl_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def generate_candidate_id() -> str:
    return f"skc_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


class SkillEvidence(BaseModel):
    kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    ref: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    observed_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=300)


class Skill(BaseModel):
    skill_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    category: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    prerequisites: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                     max_length=20)
    related_skills: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                      max_length=20)
    stage: str = Field(default="discovered", max_length=20)
    proficiency: str = Field(default="unknown", max_length=20)
    evidence: list[SkillEvidence] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                          max_length=50)
    source: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    provenance: Provenance
    project_refs: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                    max_length=20)
    created_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    updated_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


class SkillCandidate(BaseModel):
    candidate_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    evidence: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                max_length=10)
    project_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=100)
    status: str = Field(default="proposed", max_length=20)
    created_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


def new_skill(name: str, *, category: str = "",
              description: str = "",
              prerequisites: list | None = None,
              related_skills: list | None = None,
              stage: str = "discovered",
              proficiency: str = "unknown",
              project_refs: list | None = None,
              source: str = "",
              provenance: Provenance | None = None
              ) -> Skill:
    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
        raise SkillRefusedError("skill needs a name")
    if stage not in SKILL_STAGES:
        raise SkillRefusedError(f"Unknown stage '{stage}'")
    if proficiency not in PROFICIENCIES:
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            f"Unknown proficiency '{proficiency}'")
    if stage in ("demonstrated", "mastered"):
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            "top stages need evidence + human confirmation; "
            "use advance_skill()")
    stamp = now()
    return Skill(
        skill_id=generate_skill_id(), name=name.strip()[:200],
        category=str(category or "")[:80],
        description=str(description or "")[:1000],
        prerequisites=[str(item)[:80]
                       for item in (prerequisites or [])][:20],
        related_skills=[str(item)[:80]
                        for item in (related_skills or [])][:20],
        stage=stage, proficiency=proficiency, evidence=[],
        source=str(source or "")[:200],
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="user-created", creator_id="skills",
            human_verified=False),
        project_refs=[str(item)[:100]
                      for item in (project_refs or [])][:20],
        created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp)


def _row_to_skill(row) -> Skill:
    from .database import load
    return Skill(
        skill_id=row["skill_id"], name=row["name"],
        category=row["category"],
        description=row["description"],
        prerequisites=load(row["prerequisites"]),
        related_skills=load(row["related_skills"]),
        stage=row["stage"], proficiency=row["proficiency"],
        evidence=[SkillEvidence(**item)
                  for item in load(row["evidence"])],
        source=row["source"],
        provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
        project_refs=load(row["project_refs"]),
        created_at=row["created_at"],
        updated_at=row["updated_at"])


def save_skill(skill: Skill) -> None:
    """Persist a skill. Stage/evidence invariants hold here,
    not only in the routes: applied needs evidence,
    demonstrated/mastered need ≥2 evidence plus verified
    provenance. A future caller cannot bypass the gates by
    writing directly."""
    if skill.stage not in SKILL_STAGES:
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            f"Unknown stage '{skill.stage}'")
    if skill.proficiency not in PROFICIENCIES:
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            f"Unknown proficiency '{skill.proficiency}'")
    if skill.stage == "applied" and len(skill.evidence) < 1:
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            "applied needs at least one evidence entry")
    if skill.stage in ("demonstrated", "mastered"):
        if len(skill.evidence) < 2:
            raise SkillRefusedError(
                f"{skill.stage} needs at least two evidence "
                "entries")
        if not skill.provenance.human_verified:
            raise SkillRefusedError(
                f"{skill.stage} needs verified provenance")
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO skills
        (skill_id, name, category, description,
         prerequisites, related_skills, stage, proficiency,
         evidence, source, provenance, project_refs,
         created_at, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(skill_id) DO UPDATE SET
         stage=excluded.stage,
         proficiency=excluded.proficiency,
         evidence=excluded.evidence,
         project_refs=excluded.project_refs,
         updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
                     (skill.skill_id, skill.name,
                      skill.category, skill.description,
                      dump(skill.prerequisites),
                      dump(skill.related_skills), skill.stage,
                      skill.proficiency,
                      dump([item.model_dump(mode="json")
                            for item in skill.evidence]),
                      skill.source,
                      dump(skill.provenance.model_dump(
                          mode="json")),
                      dump(skill.project_refs),
                      skill.created_at, skill.updated_at))


def get_skill(skill_id: str) -> Skill | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM skills WHERE skill_id=?",
                         (skill_id,)).fetchone()
    return _row_to_skill(row) if row is not None else None


def list_skills(*, stage: str = "",
                limit: int = 100) -> list[Skill]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    if stage and stage not in SKILL_STAGES:
        raise SkillRefusedError(f"Unknown stage '{stage}'")
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        if stage:
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM skills WHERE stage=? ORDER BY "
                "updated_at DESC LIMIT ?",
                (stage, max(1, min(int(limit or 100),
                                   200)))).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM skills ORDER BY updated_at DESC "
                "LIMIT ?", (max(1, min(int(limit or 100),
                                       200)),)).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_skill(row) for row in rows]


def add_evidence(skill_id: str, kind: str, ref: str, *,
                 note: str = "") -> Skill:
    """Attach one evidence entry. Evidence is data, never a
    stage jump by itself."""
    skill = get_skill(skill_id)
    if skill is None:
        raise SkillRefusedError("skill not found")
    if not isinstance(kind, str) or not kind.strip() or \
            len(kind) > 40:
        raise SkillRefusedError("evidence kind must be text")
    if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref.strip() or \
            len(ref) > 200:
        raise SkillRefusedError("evidence ref must be text")
    entry = SkillEvidence(kind=kind.strip()[:40],
                          ref=ref.strip()[:200],
                          observed_at=now(),
                          note=str(note or "")[:300])
    updated = skill.model_copy(update={
        "evidence": [*skill.evidence, entry][:50],
        "updated_at": now()})
    save_skill(updated)
    return updated


def advance_skill(skill_id: str, to_stage: str, *,
                  confirmed_by: str = "") -> Skill:
    """One stage forward. 'applied' needs ≥1 evidence;
    'demonstrated'/'mastered' need ≥2 evidence plus a human
    confirmer. Never backwards, never skipping."""
    order = list(SKILL_STAGES)
    if to_stage not in order:
        raise SkillRefusedError(f"Unknown stage '{to_stage}'")
    skill = get_skill(skill_id)
    if skill is None:
        raise SkillRefusedError("skill not found")
    if order.index(to_stage) != order.index(skill.stage) + 1:
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            "stages advance one step at a time, never back")
    if to_stage == "applied" and len(skill.evidence) < 1:
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            "applied needs at least one evidence entry")
    if to_stage in ("demonstrated", "mastered"):
        if len(skill.evidence) < 2:
            raise SkillRefusedError(
                f"{to_stage} needs at least two evidence "
                "entries")
        if not str(confirmed_by or "").strip():
            raise SkillRefusedError(
                f"{to_stage} needs human confirmation")
    updated = skill.model_copy(update={
        "stage": to_stage, "updated_at": now(),
        "provenance": skill.provenance.model_copy(update={
            "human_verified": True,
            "verified_by": str(confirmed_by or
                               skill.provenance.verified_by or
                               "skills")[:80]})
        if to_stage in ("demonstrated", "mastered")
        else skill.provenance})
    save_skill(updated)
    return updated


def discover_candidates(project_text: str, *,
                        project_ref: str = "") -> list[SkillCandidate]:
    """Deterministic keyword discovery over project text.
    Returns candidates with evidence snippets — never skills."""
    if not isinstance(project_text, str) or not project_text.strip():
        raise SkillRefusedError("discovery needs project text")
    lowered = project_text.lower()
    owned = {skill.name.strip().lower()
             for skill in list_skills(limit=200)}
    candidates = []
    for keyword, name in DISCOVERY_KEYWORDS.items():
        if keyword not in lowered or name.lower() in owned:
            continue
        position = lowered.find(keyword)
        snippet = project_text[max(0, position - 40):
                               position + 80].strip()
        candidates.append(SkillCandidate(
            candidate_id=generate_candidate_id(), name=name,
            evidence=[f"keyword '{keyword}' in project "
                      f"context: …{snippet}…"],
            project_ref=str(project_ref or "")[:100],
            status="proposed", created_at=now()))
        if len(candidates) >= 10:
            break
    return candidates


def save_candidate(candidate: SkillCandidate) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO skill_candidates
        (candidate_id, name, evidence, project_ref, status,
         created_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(candidate_id) DO NOTHING""",
                     (candidate.candidate_id, candidate.name,
                      dump(candidate.evidence),
                      candidate.project_ref, candidate.status,
                      candidate.created_at))


def list_candidates(*, status: str = "proposed"
                    ) -> list[SkillCandidate]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    if status not in ("proposed", "accepted", "rejected"):
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            f"Unknown candidate status '{status}'")
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM skill_candidates WHERE "
                          "status=? ORDER BY created_at DESC "
                          "LIMIT 100", (status,)).fetchall()
    return [SkillCandidate(
        candidate_id=row["candidate_id"], name=row["name"],
        evidence=load(row["evidence"]),
        project_ref=row["project_ref"], status=row["status"],
        created_at=row["created_at"]) for row in rows]


def accept_candidate(candidate_id: str, *,
                     accepted_by: str) -> Skill:
    """User acceptance turns a candidate into an owned skill
    at 'interested'. The candidate row closes as accepted."""
    if not str(accepted_by or "").strip():
        raise SkillRefusedError(
            "accepting a candidate needs a human")
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM skill_candidates WHERE "
                         "candidate_id=?",
                         (candidate_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise SkillRefusedError("candidate not found")
        if row["status"] != "proposed":
            raise SkillRefusedError(
                "candidate already decided")
        db.execute("UPDATE skill_candidates SET status="
                   "'accepted' WHERE candidate_id=?",
                   (candidate_id,))
    skill = new_skill(
        row["name"], stage="interested",
        project_refs=[row["project_ref"]]
        if row["project_ref"] else [],
        source=f"candidate:{candidate_id}",
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="user-created",
            creator_id=accepted_by.strip()[:80],
            human_verified=True,
            verified_by=accepted_by.strip()[:80],
            notes="accepted skill candidate"))
    save_skill(skill)
    return skill

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/solarpunk.py">
"""Solar Punk City projection and browser client.

Districts are read through the coordinator's loopback INVENTory bridge.
Movement reuses the existing play-session position; town chat and actor
status reuse existing coordinator stores and routes. Camera capture is
user-triggered and fail-closed through the existing camera adapter.
This module adds no database or world-model entities.
"""

import json as _json

from .homebase import HOMEBASE_JS as _HOMEBASE_JS

MAP_W = 640
MAP_H = 400

# SP Home Base: ontwerp uit de referentiefoto (bakstenen pand met
# puntgevel, donkere kozijnen, rode dakpannen). Vaste landmark naast
# de spawn, herkenbaar in alle views. Enige game-eigendom: positie.
HOME_BASE = {
    "title": "SP Home Base",
    "blurb": ("Brick townhouse with a pointed gable, dark window "
              "frames and a red tile roof — the crew's front door "
              "in Solar Punk City."),
    "x": 620.0, "y": 250.0, "w": 240.0, "h": 170.0,
    "wall": "#8a4030", "frame": "#20261f", "roof": "#9c3a2b",
    "glass": "#e8d9a0",
}


def home_landmark() -> dict:
    """Vaste home-rect in wereldruimte, met herkomstvlag."""
    return {
        "x": HOME_BASE["x"], "y": HOME_BASE["y"],
        "w": HOME_BASE["w"], "h": HOME_BASE["h"],
        "title": HOME_BASE["title"], "home": True,
    }

# Zelfde wereldruimte als de bestaande play-sessies (play_workshop:
# PLAY_WORLD_W/H), zodat /solarpunk en /play één sessie delen.
WORLD_W = 3840.0
WORLD_H = 1400.0
WALL_H = 220.0
PLAYER_R = 30.0
# Solar-spawn: plein-voorland met vrij uitzicht op de
# NPC-werkspoten (JS spiegelt dit in SOLAR_SPAWN).
SPAWN = {"x": 1920.0, "y": 350.0, "a": 1.5708}


def district_rect(index: int, total: int) -> tuple:
    """Deterministische grid-layout: zelfde input -> zelfde rechthoek."""
    total = max(1, total)
    cols = max(1, round(total ** 0.5))
    rows = (total + cols - 1) // cols
    col = index % cols
    row = index // cols
    pad = 12
    cell_w = (MAP_W - pad * (cols + 1)) / cols
    cell_h = (MAP_H - pad * (rows + 1)) / rows
    return (
        pad + col * (cell_w + pad),
        pad + row * (cell_h + pad),
        cell_w,
        cell_h,
    )


def district_rect_world(index: int, total: int) -> tuple:
    """Zelfde grid als district_rect, geschaald naar wereldruimte."""
    x, y, w, h = district_rect(index, total)
    return (
        x * WORLD_W / MAP_W,
        y * WORLD_H / MAP_H,
        w * WORLD_W / MAP_W,
        h * WORLD_H / MAP_H,
    )


def world_payload(districts: list) -> list:
    """Districten -> bots- en tekenbare wereld-rects (wereldruimte)."""
    rects = []
    for pos, district in enumerate(districts or []):
        x, y, w, h = district_rect_world(pos, len(districts))
        rects.append({
            "x": round(x, 1), "y": round(y, 1),
            "w": round(w, 1), "h": round(h, 1),
            "title": str(district.get("title", "")),
        })
    return rects

function solidAt(nx,ny){

  if(nx<r||ny<r||nx>WW-r||ny>WH-r)return true;
  for(var i=0;i<world.length;i++){var o=world[i];

function cast(px,py,ang){
  var dx=Math.cos(ang),dy=Math.sin(ang),best=1e9,hit=null;
  for(var i=0;i<world.length;i++){var o=world[i];
    var t0=0,t1=1e9,ok=true;
    if(Math.abs(dx)<1e-9){if(px<o.x||px>o.x+o.w)ok=false;}
    else{var ta=(o.x-px)/dx,tb=(o.x+o.w-px)/dx;
      t0=Math.max(t0,Math.min(ta,tb));t1=Math.min(t1,Math.max(ta,tb));}
    if(ok){
      if(Math.abs(dy)<1e-9){if(py<o.y||py>o.y+o.h)ok=false;}
      else{var tc=(o.y-py)/dy,td=(o.y+o.h-py)/dy;
        t0=Math.max(t0,Math.min(tc,td));t1=Math.min(t1,Math.max(tc,td));}
    }
    if(ok&&t1>=Math.max(t0,0)&&t0<best){best=t0;hit=o;}
  }
  var edge=1e9;
  if(dx>1e-9)edge=Math.min(edge,(WW-px)/dx);else if(dx<-1e-9)edge=Math.min(edge,(0-px)/dx);
  if(dy>1e-9)edge=Math.min(edge,(WH-py)/dy);else if(dy<-1e-9)edge=Math.min(edge,(0-py)/dy);
  if(edge<best){best=edge;hit=null;}
  return {d:best,hit:hit,hx:px+dx*best,hy:py+dy*best};
}

SCAN_JS = """(function(){

function refresh(){
  fetch("/api/v1/cameras").then(function(r){return r.json();}).then(function(list){
    var found=null;
    for(var i=0;i<list.length;i++){
      if(list[i].source==="insta360"&&(list[i].kinds||[]).indexOf("snapshot")>=0){found=list[i];break;}
