        var id=(r.body.camera_observation&&r.body.camera_observation.observation_id)||"?";

        say("Grab refused ("+r.st+"). "+errors+"/3 errors.");

    }else{say("Grab refused ("+r.st+"). "+JSON.stringify(r.body).slice(0,140));}
  },function(){say("Grab failed: backend unreachable.");});
};
refresh();
})();"""

  if(document.hidden||actorLoading)return;
  actorLoading=true;
  fetch("/api/v1/town/actors").then(function(r){
    if(!r.ok)throw new Error("status "+r.status);
    return r.json();
  }).then(function(d){
    actors=(d.actors||[]).map(function(a){
      var names={mos:"Mos",oracle:"Orakel",smid:"Smid",archivaris:"Archivaris",voorman:"Voorman",seinwachter:"Seinwachter"};
      a.name=names[a.npc_id]||a.npc_id;return a;});
    window.__spcActors=actors.map(function(a){
      return {x:a.x,y:a.y,color:colorOf(a.npc_id)};});

      }).join(""):'<p class="muted">No activity yet.</p>';

function drawActors(p,VW,VH){
  var FOV=66*Math.PI/180;
  var seen=[];
  for(var i=0;i<actors.length;i++){var a=actors[i];
    var dx=a.x-p.x,dy=a.y-p.y;
    var dist=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);
    if(dist<40||dist>1600)continue;
    var rel=Math.atan2(dy,dx)-p.a;
    while(rel>Math.PI)rel-=2*Math.PI;
    while(rel<-Math.PI)rel+=2*Math.PI;
    if(Math.abs(rel)>FOV/2+0.35)continue;
    seen.push({a:a,dist:dist,rel:rel});
  }
  seen.sort(function(u,v){return v.dist-u.dist;});
  for(var j=0;j<seen.length;j++){var s=seen[j];
    var sx=VW/2+Math.tan(s.rel)*(VW/2)/Math.tan(FOV/2);
    var h=Math.min(VH*0.95,(110/s.dist)*900);
    var w=Math.max(3,h*0.34);
    var base=VH*0.82;
    var shade=Math.max(0.3,Math.min(1,420/(s.dist+120)));
    var c=colorOf(s.a.npc_id);
    ctx.globalAlpha=shade;
    ctx.fillStyle=c;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(sx,base,w*0.9,Math.max(2,h*0.05),0,0,7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillRect(sx-w/2,base-h*0.62,w,h*0.58);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(sx,base-h*0.74,w*0.42,0,7);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.globalAlpha=1;
    s._sx=sx;s._h=h;
  }
  ctx.font="11px Segoe UI,system-ui,sans-serif";
  var taken=[];
  for(var q=seen.length-1;q>=0;q--){var t=seen[q],sx2=t._sx;
    var label=t.a.name+" · "+(t.a.status||"idle");
    var lw=ctx.measureText(label).width+12;
    var lx=sx2-lw/2,overlap=false;
    for(var z=0;z<taken.length;z++){
      if(lx<taken[z][1]&&lx+lw>taken[z][0]){overlap=true;break;}
    }
    if(overlap)continue;
    taken.push([lx,lx+lw]);
    var ly=Math.min(Math.max(16,base-t._h-26),VH-40);
    ctx.fillStyle="rgba(20,26,20,0.85)";
    ctx.fillRect(lx,ly,lw,16);
    ctx.fillStyle="#ece7d8";
    ctx.fillText(label,lx+6,ly+12);
    if(t.a.detail){
      var d=t.a.detail.length>28?t.a.detail.slice(0,27)+"…":t.a.detail;
      var dw=ctx.measureText(d).width+10;
      var dy2=Math.min(Math.max(34,base-t._h-44),VH-58);
      ctx.fillStyle="rgba(20,26,20,0.7)";
      ctx.fillRect(sx2-dw/2,dy2-15,dw,15);
      ctx.fillStyle="#d9a441";
      ctx.fillText(d,sx2-dw/2+5,dy2-4);
    }
  }
  var near=null;
  for(var k=0;k<actors.length;k++){var b=actors[k];
    var ndx=b.x-p.x,ndy=b.y-p.y;
    var nd=ndx*ndx+ndy*ndy;
    if(nd<100*100&&(!near||nd<near.d)){near={a:b,d:nd};}
  }
  if(bar){
    if(near){
      var html="Dicht bij <b>"+esc(near.a.name)+"</b> ("+esc(near.a.status||"idle")+") — <button type='button' id='spc-near-talk'>Praat</button> <button type='button' id='spc-near-del'>Delegeer</button>";
      if(html===window.__spcHudHtml)return;
      window.__spcHudHtml=html;
      bar.hidden=false;
      bar.innerHTML=html;
      var hud=document.getElementById("spc-hud");
      if(hud)hud.innerHTML=html.replace(/spc-near-/g,"spc-hud-");
      var nid=near.a.npc_id;
      var wire=function(id,fn){var b=document.getElementById(id);if(b)b.onclick=fn;};
      var talkFn=function(){
        if(window.spcSetTarget)window.spcSetTarget(nid);
        var chat=document.getElementById("spc-hud-chat");
        if(chat)chat.hidden=false;
        var inp=document.getElementById("spc-hud-input");
        if(inp)inp.focus();
      };
      var delFn=function(){
        window.spcDelegateNpc=nid;
        var b=document.getElementById("spc-bureau");
        if(b)b.scrollIntoView();
      };
      wire("spc-near-talk",talkFn);wire("spc-hud-talk",talkFn);
      wire("spc-near-del",delFn);wire("spc-hud-del",delFn);
    }else{
      window.__spcHudHtml="";
      if(!bar.hidden)bar.hidden=true;
      var hud2=document.getElementById("spc-hud");
      var idle='<p class="muted">Loop naar een bewoner om te praten.</p>';
      if(hud2&&hud2.innerHTML!==idle)hud2.innerHTML=idle;
      if(window.spcTargetNpc&&window.spcSetTarget)window.spcSetTarget("");
    }
  }
}

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",function(){

});

})();"""

def district_payload(results) -> list:
    """SearchResult-lijst -> kale dicts voor render(). Negeert alles
    behalve id/titel/snippet; provenance tonen we als badge-tekst."""
    districts = []
    for item in results or []:
        districts.append({
            "entity_id": str(getattr(item, "entity_id", "")),
            "title": str(getattr(item, "title", "") or "Unnamed district"),
            "snippet": str(getattr(item, "snippet", "") or ""),
        })
    return districts


def _residents_panel() -> str:
    """Bewonerslijst met eerlijke waak-status. Import faalt nooit hard."""
    import os as _os
    from . import ui as _ui
    try:
        from .hermes_npc import HERMES_NPCS as _npcs
    except Exception:
        return ("<p class=\"muted\">Bewonerslijst tijdelijk "
                "onbeschikbaar.</p>")
    awake = bool((_os.environ.get("HERMES_API_KEY") or "").strip())
    chip = ("🟢 wakker" if awake
            else "😴 slaapt (geen model — zie keys-uitleg hieronder)")
    rows = "".join(
        f"<li><b>{_ui.esc(npc.get('name', key))}</b> — "
        f"{_ui.esc(npc.get('role', ''))} "
        f"<span class=\"muted\">{chip}</span></li>"
        for key, npc in _npcs.items())
    return f"<ul>{rows}</ul>"

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/sync.py">
"""Pull-based sync layer (BIG #10, deel 3).

Node A pulls change envelopes from a source (coordinator or
peer), validates, deduplicates and applies them into its own
durable log, then advances its cursor. No inbound ports, no
peer-to-peer shell, node identity/token rules unchanged.

Flow:

    source read_log(after, limit)   # bounded envelopes
      → transport (HTTP pull)
      → validate each envelope      # closed types, no SQL
      → apply_envelope (idempotent) # duplicate/conflict safe
      → advance cursor              # highest applied rowid

Sync status surfaces: last_sync, cursor, pending, failed,
conflicts, epoch, node liveness. The INVENTory side syncs
through the HTTP bridge only (fetch_inventory_changes with
cursor + limit + provenance); the SQLite file is never
copied and never opened by Mycelium.
"""

from .diststate import (
    DistEnvelope,
    DistStateRefusedError,
    apply_envelope,
    known_event_ids,
    read_log,
)
from .failover import FencingError

SYNC_BATCH = 100


class SyncRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was applied."""


def pull_changes(fetch, after_rowid: int = 0,
                 limit: int = SYNC_BATCH) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
    """Pull one bounded page via a caller-supplied fetch callable.
    ``fetch(after, limit)`` returns (items, latest). Transport
    stays with the caller (HTTP pull); this layer only bounds."""
    try:
        cursor = max(0, int(after_rowid or 0))
        count = max(1, min(int(limit or SYNC_BATCH), SYNC_BATCH))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise SyncRefusedError("cursor/limit must be integers")
    if not callable(fetch):
        raise SyncRefusedError("sync needs a fetch callable")
    items, latest = fetch(cursor, count)
    if not isinstance(items, list):
        raise SyncRefusedError("source returned no list")
    return items[:count], latest


def apply_pulled(items: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Validate + idempotently apply pulled envelopes. Returns a
    summary {applied, duplicates, conflicts, failed} plus the
    highest source cursor the caller may advance past ONLY for
    applied/duplicates (conflicts keep their cursor for review,
    failed items never advance anything)."""
    summary = {"applied": 0, "duplicates": 0, "conflicts": 0,
               "failed": 0, "conflict_ids": [], "applied_ids": []}
    for item in (items or [])[:SYNC_BATCH]:
        try:
            envelope = (item if isinstance(item, DistEnvelope)
                        else DistEnvelope.model_validate(item))
        except Exception:
            summary["failed"] += 1
            continue
        try:
            outcome = apply_envelope(envelope)
        except (DistStateRefusedError, FencingError):
            summary["failed"] += 1
            continue
        if outcome["status"] == "applied":
            summary["applied"] += 1
            summary["applied_ids"].append(envelope.event_id)
        elif outcome["status"] == "duplicate":
            summary["duplicates"] += 1
            summary["applied_ids"].append(envelope.event_id)
        else:
            summary["conflicts"] += 1
            summary["conflict_ids"].append(
                outcome.get("conflict_id", ""))
    return summary


def sync_status(nodes: list, cursor: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Local sync snapshot: cursor, log size, open conflicts,
    epoch, node liveness. Bounded, no dumps."""
    from .diststate import list_conflicts
    from .failover import current_epoch, sync_status as coord_status
    _, latest = read_log(after_rowid=10**12, limit=1)
    open_conflicts = list_conflicts(status="open", limit=100)
    live = sum(1 for node in (nodes or [])
               if isinstance(node, dict)
               and str(node.get("derived_status",
                                node.get("status", "")))
               in ("online", "busy"))
    return {
        "cursor": cursor,
        "log_latest": latest,
        "pending": max(0, latest - max(0, int(cursor or 0))),
        "failed_changes": 0,
        "open_conflicts": len(open_conflicts),
        "epoch": current_epoch(),
        "live_nodes": live,
        "coordinator": coord_status(nodes),
    }


async def fetch_inventory_changes(reader, since: str = "",
                                   limit: int = SYNC_BATCH
                                   ) -> list[dict]:
    """Pull INVENTory change notifications over HTTP. Uses the
    additive ``since`` cursor on /api/v1/events (timestamp
    filter); bounded pages; provenance preserved. Never SQL,
    never the database file."""
    try:
        count = max(1, min(int(limit or SYNC_BATCH), SYNC_BATCH))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise SyncRefusedError("limit must be an integer")
    getter = getattr(reader, "events_since", None)
    if not callable(getter):
        raise SyncRefusedError(
            "reader has no cursor change feed")
    raw = await getter(since=since or "", limit=count)
    items = []
    for entry in (raw or [])[:count]:
        if isinstance(entry, dict):
            items.append({
                "event_id": str(entry.get("id", "")),
                "event_type": str(entry.get("event_type", "")),
                "entity_id": str(entry.get("entity_id", "")),
                "timestamp": str(entry.get("timestamp", "")),
                "provenance": entry.get("provenance", {}),
            })
        else:
            items.append({
                "event_id": str(getattr(entry, "id", "")),
                "event_type": str(getattr(entry, "event_type",
                                          "")),
                "entity_id": str(getattr(entry, "entity_id", "")),
                "timestamp": str(getattr(entry, "timestamp", "")),
                "provenance": getattr(entry, "provenance", {}),
            })
    return items

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/twin.py">
"""Digital twin foundation (BIG #11-15, Phase 5).

physical entity ↔ digital entity ↔ observations ↔ sensors
↔ files ↔ events. Links are explicit records with source,
confidence and last-observed time — the digital side never
claims to be automatically current. Staleness is computed,
not assumed.

Structure (HOME → rooms/workshop/garden/…) is expressed
through INVENTory locations + relationships; this module
only links and scores freshness.
"""

import secrets
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

TWIN_LINK_TYPES = (
    "represents",
    "observes",
    "controls",
    "stored_at",
    "part_of",
)

TWIN_STATUSES = ("active", "stale", "retired")


class TwinRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed twin validation."""


def now() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now(
        datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_link_id() -> str:
    return f"twn_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


class TwinLink(BaseModel):
    link_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    physical_ref: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    digital_ref: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    link_type: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    source: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    confidence: float = Field(default=0.5, ge=0.0, le=1.0)
    last_observed_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    status: str = Field(default="active", max_length=20)
    provenance: Provenance
    updated_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


def new_link(physical_ref: str, digital_ref: str,
             link_type: str, *, source: str = "",
             confidence: float = 0.5,
             last_observed_at: str = "",
             provenance: Provenance | None = None) -> TwinLink:
    if not isinstance(physical_ref, str) or not \
            physical_ref.strip():
        raise TwinRefusedError("link needs a physical ref")
    if not isinstance(digital_ref, str) or not \
            digital_ref.strip():
        raise TwinRefusedError("link needs a digital ref")
    if link_type not in TWIN_LINK_TYPES:
        raise TwinRefusedError(
            f"Unknown link type '{link_type}'")
    stamp = now()
    return TwinLink(
        link_id=generate_link_id(),
        physical_ref=physical_ref.strip()[:200],
        digital_ref=digital_ref.strip()[:120],
        link_type=link_type, source=str(source or "")[:200],
        confidence=float(confidence),
        last_observed_at=last_observed_at or stamp,
        status="active",
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="sensor-observed",
            creator_id="digital-twin", human_verified=False),
        updated_at=stamp)


def _row_to_link(row) -> TwinLink:
    from .database import load
    return TwinLink(
        link_id=row["link_id"],
        physical_ref=row["physical_ref"],
        digital_ref=row["digital_ref"],
        link_type=row["link_type"], source=row["source"],
        confidence=row["confidence"],
        last_observed_at=row["last_observed_at"],
        status=row["status"],
        provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
        updated_at=row["updated_at"])


def save_link(link: TwinLink,
              expected_updated_at: str | None = None) -> None:
    """Persist a twin link. With expected_updated_at set, a
    moved row refuses (optimistic concurrency for future
    callers); routes keep working unchanged."""
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    if expected_updated_at is not None:
        with chat_connection() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT updated_at FROM twin_links WHERE "
                "link_id=?", (link.link_id,)).fetchone()
            if row is None or row["updated_at"] != \
                    expected_updated_at:
                raise TwinRefusedError(
                    "twin link moved; reload and retry "
                    "explicitly")
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO twin_links
        (link_id, physical_ref, digital_ref, link_type,
         source, confidence, last_observed_at, status,
         provenance, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(link_id) DO UPDATE SET
         confidence=excluded.confidence,
         last_observed_at=excluded.last_observed_at,
         status=excluded.status,
         updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
                     (link.link_id, link.physical_ref,
                      link.digital_ref, link.link_type,
                      link.source, link.confidence,
                      link.last_observed_at, link.status,
                      dump(link.provenance.model_dump(
                          mode="json")), link.updated_at))


def list_links(*, status: str = "") -> list[TwinLink]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    if status and status not in TWIN_STATUSES:
        raise TwinRefusedError(f"Unknown status '{status}'")
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        if status:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM twin_links WHERE "
                              "status=? ORDER BY updated_at DESC "
                              "LIMIT 200",
                              (status,)).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM twin_links ORDER "
                              "BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 200"
                              ).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_link(row) for row in rows]


def observe_link(link_id: str, *, source: str = "",
                 confidence: float = 0.5) -> TwinLink | None:
    """Refresh one link's observation stamp. Observation only:
    no state is claimed beyond 'seen now'."""
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM twin_links WHERE "
                         "link_id=?", (link_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            return None
        link = _row_to_link(row)
        updated = link.model_copy(update={
            "last_observed_at": now(), "status": "active",
            "confidence": max(0.0, min(1.0,
                                       float(confidence))),
            "source": str(source or link.source)[:200],
            "updated_at": now()})
        db.execute("UPDATE twin_links SET last_observed_at=?, "
                   "status='active', confidence=?, source=?, "
                   "updated_at=? WHERE link_id=?",
                   (updated.last_observed_at,
                    updated.confidence, updated.source,
                    updated.updated_at, link_id))
    return updated


def staleness_report(*, stale_hours: float = 24.0) -> dict:
    """Fresh/stale/unknown per link with the method shown.
    Stale links flip to status stale (observation hygiene,
    not a content change)."""
    import datetime
    current = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    try:
        bound = float(stale_hours)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise TwinRefusedError("stale_hours must be numeric")
    fresh, stale, unknown = [], [], []
    for link in list_links():
        try:
            moment = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(
                link.last_observed_at)
            if moment.tzinfo is None:
                moment = moment.replace(
                    tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            age_hours = (current - moment).total_seconds() / 3600.0
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            unknown.append(link.link_id)
            continue
        if age_hours > bound:
            stale.append({"link_id": link.link_id,
                          "age_hours": round(age_hours, 1),
                          "physical_ref": link.physical_ref,
                          "digital_ref": link.digital_ref})
        else:
            fresh.append(link.link_id)
    if stale:
        from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
        init_chat_database()
        with chat_connection() as db:
            for entry in stale:
                db.execute("UPDATE twin_links SET status="
                           "'stale' WHERE link_id=?",
                           (entry["link_id"],))
    return {"fresh": fresh, "stale": stale, "unknown": unknown,
            "method": f"last_observed_at older than "
                      f"{bound}h counts as stale",
            "warning": "fresh means recently observed, never "
                       "automatically current"}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/verification.py">
"""First-class verification for controlled writes (BIG #5).

APPROVAL means: "the human permits this proposed action."
VERIFICATION means: "it was checked that the expected result
actually came about." They are never the same object or status:

- an approval never sets human_verified=True;
- a successful mutation never means verified=True;
- verification is always a separate step with its own method,
  source, timestamp and provenance.

A verification describes OBSERVED (what an independent read
returned) separately from INFERRED (optional model analysis,
clearly labeled, never decisive). "The model thinks it probably
worked" is never a pass.

Outcomes:

- passed — independent readback matches the expectation;
- failed — execution succeeded but the world does not match
  (final state is NOT verified);
- inconclusive — the world could not be read (final state is
  NOT verified, no FACT promotion).

A forged or missing verification never becomes success: only
``outcome == "passed"`` counts as verified.
"""

import secrets
import time
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .inventory_read import InventoryReader, Provenance

VerificationOutcome = Literal["passed", "failed", "inconclusive"]

VALID_METHODS = frozenset({
    "inventory.readback",
    "inventory.graph_readback",
    "git.readback",
    "camera.readback",
    "print.telemetry_readback",
    "print.camera_readback",
})


class VerificationRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    verification_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    proposal_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    result_fingerprint: str = Field(min_length=64, max_length=64,
                                    pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    method: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    expected: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class VerificationResult(BaseModel):
    """The outcome of one independent check. Only passed verifies."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    verification_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    proposal_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    result_fingerprint: str = Field(min_length=64, max_length=64,
                                    pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    outcome: VerificationOutcome = "inconclusive"
    method: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    expected: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    observed: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    inferred: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)
    source: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    verified_at: str = ""
    observer: str = Field(default="mycelium-verifier",
                          min_length=1, max_length=80)
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)


def generate_verification_id() -> str:
    return f"ver_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def new_verification_request(proposal_id: str,
                             result_fingerprint: str,
                             method: str,
                             expected: dict) -> VerificationRequest:
    if method not in VALID_METHODS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Unknown verification method '{method}'; expected one of "
            f"{sorted(VALID_METHODS)}")
    if not isinstance(expected, dict) or not expected:
        raise ValueError("Verification needs a non-empty expectation")
    return VerificationRequest(
        verification_id=generate_verification_id(),
        proposal_id=proposal_id,
        result_fingerprint=result_fingerprint,
        method=method,
        expected=dict(expected),
    )


def is_verified(result: VerificationResult) -> bool:
    """Only an explicit pass counts. Failed, inconclusive and forged
    results are never verified."""
    return (isinstance(result, VerificationResult)
            and result.outcome == "passed")


def _base_result(request: VerificationRequest,
                 observer: str) -> dict:
    return {
        "verification_id": request.verification_id,
        "proposal_id": request.proposal_id,
        "result_fingerprint": request.result_fingerprint,
        "method": request.method,
        "expected": dict(request.expected),
        "observer": observer,
        "provenance": Provenance(
            source_type="sensor-observed", creator_id=observer,
            human_verified=False,
            notes="independent verification read; "
                  "human verification needs a human"),
    }


async def verify_inventory_write(request: VerificationRequest,
                                 result, *,
                                 reader: InventoryReader,
                                 observer: str = "mycelium-verifier",
                                 now_str: str | None = None
                                 ) -> VerificationResult:
    """Verify one inventory write by independent readback.

    The result payload is NEVER trusted: the entity (or graph) is
    re-read through the read bridge and compared field by field.
    Unreadable worlds yield inconclusive — never a pass.
    """
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    from .controlled_writes import WriteResult
    if not isinstance(result, WriteResult):
        raise ValueError("Verification needs a WriteResult")
    if result.proposal_id != request.proposal_id:
        raise ValueError("Verification does not belong to this result")
    if request.result_fingerprint != result.fingerprint:
        raise ValueError("Verification binds to a different result")
    if result.outcome != "executed":
        return VerificationResult(
            **_base_result(request, observer),
            outcome="failed",
            observed={"execution_outcome": result.outcome},
            source="write-result",
            verified_at=now_str or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            note="execution did not succeed; nothing to verify",
        )
    base = _base_result(request, observer)
    stamp = now_str or base["provenance"].created_at or ""
    try:
        observed = await _observe_inventory(request, result, reader)
    except Exception as error:
        return VerificationResult(
            **base, outcome="inconclusive",
            observed={"read_error": str(error)[:500]},
            source="inventory-read-bridge",
            verified_at=stamp,
            note="world unreadable; verification inconclusive, "
                 "no FACT promotion",
        )
    if _matches(request.expected, observed):
        return VerificationResult(
            **base, outcome="passed", observed=observed,
            source="inventory-read-bridge", verified_at=stamp,
            note="independent readback matches the expectation",
        )
    return VerificationResult(
        **base, outcome="failed", observed=observed,
        source="inventory-read-bridge", verified_at=stamp,
        note="independent readback differs from the expectation; "
             "execution succeeded but the result is NOT verified",
    )


async def _observe_inventory(request: VerificationRequest,
                             result, reader: InventoryReader) -> dict:
    expected = request.expected
    kind = str(expected.get("kind", "entity"))
    if kind == "entity":
        entity_type = str(expected.get("entity_type", ""))
        entity_id = str(expected.get("entity_id", ""))
        record = await reader.get(entity_type, entity_id)
        if record is None:
            return {"exists": False, "entity_id": entity_id}
        observed: dict[str, Any] = {
            "exists": True,
            "entity_id": record.entity_id,
            "title": record.title,
            "name": record.title,
            "details": dict(record.details),
        }
        for key in ("quantity", "description", "status"):
            if key in record.details:
                observed[key] = record.details[key]
        return observed
    if kind == "relationship":
        entity_id = str(expected.get("from_id", ""))
        graph = await reader.graph(entity_id, 1)
        edges = [{"id": edge.id, "from_id": edge.from_id,
                  "predicate": edge.predicate, "to_id": edge.to_id}
                 for edge in graph.edges]
        return {"from_id": entity_id, "edges": edges}
    raise ValueError(f"Unknown verification expectation kind '{kind}'")


def _matches(expected: dict, observed: dict) -> bool:
    kind = str(expected.get("kind", "entity"))
    if kind == "entity":
        if not observed.get("exists"):
            return False
        # title/name are spellings of the same INVENTory field.
        name = observed.get("name")
        for field in ("entity_id", "quantity", "description", "status"):
            if field in expected and expected[field] != observed.get(field):
                return False
        for field in ("title", "name"):
            if field in expected and expected[field] != name:
                return False
        expected_fields = expected.get("fields", {})
        if isinstance(expected_fields, dict):
            details = observed.get("details", {})
            for key, value in expected_fields.items():
                if key in ("name", "title"):
                    if value != observed.get("name"):
                        return False
                elif details.get(key, observed.get(key)) != value:
                    return False
        return True
    if kind == "relationship":
        wanted = (str(expected.get("from_id", "")),
                  str(expected.get("predicate", "")),
                  str(expected.get("to_id", "")))
        for edge in observed.get("edges", []):
            if ((edge.get("from_id"), edge.get("predicate"),
                 edge.get("to_id")) == wanted):
                return True
        return False
    return False

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/voice_approval.py">
"""Voice approval safety for Mycelium (BIG #9).

Spoken words are never authorization by themselves. A voice
approval resolves ONLY when ALL of these hold:

- exactly one active approval request exists (zero or several
  competing requests refuse — ambiguity never approves);
- the request has not expired;
- the transcript matches the small allowed response set
  (exact words, documented below — casual conversation never
  matches by accident because binding comes first);
- the target still exists in its pending state with an
  unchanged fingerprint/binding (rechecked live, never cached);
- the kind is not physical: voice can never satisfy
  approval for physical execution (printer.execute,
  robot.execute, drone.mission); those stay on their
  existing explicit channels. Desktop input counts as
  interface approval (option A): a spoken YES may resolve
  a pending desktop action through this same flow, but
  never a physical one.

On success this layer returns the canonical "YES" for the
caller to feed into the EXISTING decide path (decide_write /
approve_mission / agent decide). No second approval framework:
binding, staleness and fingerprint rules are reused, not
reinvented.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

#: Exact spoken responses accepted (after strip + one trailing
#: period). Small on purpose: anything else refuses.
VOICE_YES_WORDS = frozenset({"YES", "yes", "Yes", "JA", "ja", "Ja"})
VOICE_NO_WORDS = frozenset({"NO", "no", "No", "NEE", "nee", "Nee"})

#: Kinds that voice may resolve. "physical" is deliberately
#: absent: voice never satisfies physical approval.
VOICE_APPROVABLE_KINDS = frozenset({"write", "mission", "desktop"})


class VoiceApprovalRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Voice approval refused; nothing was decided.

    ``retryable`` is True only for a non-matching transcript
    (the operator may speak again); structural refusals
    (expired, competing, target-changed, physical) retire the
    request.
    """

    def __init__(self, message: str, retryable: bool = False):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.retryable = retryable


class VoiceApprovalRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    approval_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    target_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    fingerprint: str = Field(default="", max_length=64)
    summary: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    created_at: str = ""
    expires_at: str = ""
    status: str = Field(default="pending", max_length=20)


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _parse_time(value: str) -> datetime:
    moment = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    if moment.tzinfo is None:
        moment = moment.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return moment
    moment = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    if moment.tzinfo is None:
        moment = moment.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return moment


def normalize_transcript(transcript) -> str:
    """Normalize spoken text for matching. Returns '' when the
    transcript cannot resolve to a decision word."""
    if not isinstance(transcript, str):
        return ""
    return transcript.strip().rstrip(".").strip()


def resolve_voice_approval(active: list,
                           transcript: str, *,
                           kind: str,
                           target_ok: bool,
                           now_str: str | None = None) -> dict:
    """Resolve one spoken answer against the active requests.

    ``active``: pending VoiceApprovalRequests for this session.
    ``kind``/``target_ok``: caller-verified — kind in the
    approvable set and the target still pending with unchanged
    binding. Returns {"approved": bool, "response": "YES"/"NO",
    "reason": str}. Refusals raise VoiceApprovalRefusedError.
    """
    if kind == "physical" or kind not in VOICE_APPROVABLE_KINDS:
        raise VoiceApprovalRefusedError(
            f"kind '{kind}' never resolves by voice; physical "
            "approval stays on its explicit channel")
    pending = [request for request in (active or [])
               if getattr(request, "status", "") == "pending"]
    if not pending:
        raise VoiceApprovalRefusedError(
            "no active approval request; spoken words decide "
            "nothing")
    if len(pending) > 1:
        raise VoiceApprovalRefusedError(
            "competing approval requests; ambiguity never approves")
    request = pending[0]
    stamp = now_str or now()
    try:
        expired = _parse_time(request.expires_at) <= _parse_time(
            stamp)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        expired = True
    if expired:
        raise VoiceApprovalRefusedError(
            "approval request expired; re-request explicitly")
    if not target_ok:
        raise VoiceApprovalRefusedError(
            "target changed or left pending state; refusing")
    word = normalize_transcript(transcript)
    if word in VOICE_YES_WORDS:
        return {"approved": True, "response": "YES",
                "approval_id": request.approval_id,
                "reason": "exactly one active request, unexpired, "
                          "binding intact, explicit YES word"}
    if word in VOICE_NO_WORDS:
        return {"approved": False, "response": "NO",
                "approval_id": request.approval_id,
                "reason": "explicit NO word"}
    raise VoiceApprovalRefusedError(
        "spoken response matches no allowed approval word; "
        "refusing", retryable=True)


# -- store (chat DB; queue DB untouched, INVENTory untouched) -----------

def save_voice_request(request: VoiceApprovalRequest) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO voice_approvals
        (approval_id, kind, target_id, fingerprint, summary,
         status, created_at, expires_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(approval_id) DO UPDATE SET status=excluded.status""",
                    (request.approval_id, request.kind,
                     request.target_id, request.fingerprint,
                     request.summary, request.status,
                     request.created_at, request.expires_at))


def load_voice_request(approval_id: str,
                       ) -> VoiceApprovalRequest | None:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM voice_approvals "
                         "WHERE approval_id=?",
                         (approval_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return VoiceApprovalRequest(**{key: row[key] for key in (
        "approval_id", "kind", "target_id", "fingerprint",
        "summary", "status", "created_at", "expires_at")})


def pending_voice_requests() -> list[VoiceApprovalRequest]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT * FROM voice_approvals WHERE status='pending' "
            "ORDER BY created_at ASC").fetchall()
    return [VoiceApprovalRequest(**{key: row[key] for key in (
        "approval_id", "kind", "target_id", "fingerprint",
        "summary", "status", "created_at", "expires_at")})
        for row in rows]


def mark_voice_resolved(approval_id: str, status: str) -> None:
    if status not in ("resolved", "expired", "rejected"):
        raise VoiceApprovalRefusedError(
            f"Unknown voice status '{status}'")
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE voice_approvals SET status=? WHERE "
                   "approval_id=?", (status, approval_id))

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/watcher.py">
"""Watcher foundation (BIG #10, deel 11).

A watcher observes, detects and formulates findings — and
optionally proposes. It never silently executes anything
important: every finding is data for a human or an approved
flow, never an action.

Findings (closed kinds):

- stale_task: assigned/queued tasks older than a bound
- unfinished_project: projects stuck in non-terminal states
- forgotten_object: entities untouched for a long time
- inconsistent_relationship: edges pointing at missing nodes
- unverified_ai_info: ai-generated rows never human-verified
- missing_provenance: records without usable provenance
- old_idea: ideas sitting raw for a long time
- maintenance_hint: purely technical follow-ups (retention,
  prune counts)

All detectors are pure functions over caller-supplied rows:
this module never touches a database or the network, so every
read gate of the caller keeps applying. Bounds everywhere;
nothing unbounded; no execution surface of any kind.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Any

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

VALID_FINDING_KINDS = frozenset({
    "stale_task",
    "unfinished_project",
    "forgotten_object",
    "inconsistent_relationship",
    "unverified_ai_info",
    "missing_provenance",
    "old_idea",
    "maintenance_hint",
    "blocked_task",
    "failed_task",
    "orphan_file",
    "duplicate_file",
    "unfinished_design",
    "skill_gap",
    "device_stale",
})

MAX_FINDINGS = 50
MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS = 300


class WatcherRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was scanned."""


class Finding(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    finding_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    summary: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS)
    entity_refs: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                   max_length=10)
    observed_at: str = ""
    provenance: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _parse_time(value: str) -> datetime | None:
    try:
        moment = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None
    if moment.tzinfo is None:
        moment = moment.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return moment


def _age_hours(value: str, current: datetime) -> float | None:
    moment = _parse_time(value)
    if moment is None:
        return None
    return (current - moment).total_seconds() / 3600.0


def _finding(kind: str, summary: str, refs: list[str],
             current: datetime) -> Finding:
    import secrets
    import time
    if kind not in VALID_FINDING_KINDS:
        raise WatcherRefusedError(f"Unknown finding kind '{kind}'")
    clean_refs = [str(ref)[:100] for ref in (refs or [])[:10]]
    return Finding(
        finding_id=f"wfind_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}"
                   f"{secrets.token_hex(3)}",
        kind=kind, summary=str(summary or "")[:MAX_SUMMARY_CHARS],
        entity_refs=clean_refs, observed_at=current.isoformat(),
        provenance={"source_type": "sensor-observed",
                    "creator_id": "watcher",
                    "human_verified": False})


def scan_stale_tasks(tasks: list[dict], current: datetime,
                     older_than_hours: float = 24.0) -> list[Finding]:
    """Queued/assigned tasks older than the bound."""
    findings = []
    for task in (tasks or [])[:200]:
        if not isinstance(task, dict):
            continue
        if str(task.get("status", "")) not in ("queued",
                                               "assigned"):
            continue
        age = _age_hours(str(task.get("created_at", "")), current)
        if age is None or age < older_than_hours:
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            "stale_task",
            f"task {task.get('id', '?')} "
            f"({task.get('status', '?')}) is {age:.1f}h old",
            [str(task.get("id", ""))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_projects(projects: list[dict], current: datetime,
                  older_than_hours: float = 24.0 * 14) -> list[Finding]:
    """Projects sitting in idea/planned/paused for a long time."""
    findings = []
    for project in (projects or [])[:200]:
        if not isinstance(project, dict):
            continue
        if str(project.get("status", "")) not in (
                "idea", "planned", "paused"):
            continue
        age = _age_hours(str(project.get("updated_at",
                                         project.get(
                                             "created_at", ""))),
                         current)
        if age is None or age < older_than_hours:
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            "unfinished_project",
            f"project {project.get('id', '?')} "
            f"({project.get('status', '?')}) untouched for "
            f"{age / 24:.0f}d",
            [str(project.get("id", ""))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_entities(entities: list[dict], current: datetime, *,
                  kind: str, stale_hours: float,
                  id_key: str = "id",
                  time_key: str = "updated_at") -> list[Finding]:
    """Generic staleness scan for objects/ideas (forgotten
    objects, old raw ideas)."""
    if kind not in ("forgotten_object", "old_idea"):
        raise WatcherRefusedError(f"Unknown scan kind '{kind}'")
    findings = []
    for entity in (entities or [])[:200]:
        if not isinstance(entity, dict):
            continue
        if kind == "old_idea" and str(
                entity.get("status", "")) != "raw":
            continue
        age = _age_hours(str(entity.get(time_key, "")), current)
        if age is None or age < stale_hours:
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            kind,
            f"{entity.get(id_key, '?')} untouched for "
            f"{age / 24:.1f}d",
            [str(entity.get(id_key, ""))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_relationships(edges: list[dict], known_ids: set[str],
                       current: datetime) -> list[Finding]:
    """Edges pointing at unknown nodes (dangling references)."""
    findings = []
    for edge in (edges or [])[:500]:
        if not isinstance(edge, dict):
            continue
        missing = [key for key in ("from_id", "to_id")
                   if str(edge.get(key, ""))
                   and str(edge.get(key, "")) not in known_ids]
        if not missing:
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            "inconsistent_relationship",
            f"edge {edge.get('id', '?')} references unknown "
            f"{'/'.join(missing)}",
            [str(edge.get("id", ""))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_provenance(records: list[dict], current: datetime
                    ) -> list[Finding]:
    """AI-generated rows never verified + rows without usable
    provenance. Observation only."""
    findings = []
    for record in (records or [])[:200]:
        if not isinstance(record, dict):
            continue
        provenance = record.get("provenance", {})
        if hasattr(provenance, "model_dump"):
            provenance = provenance.model_dump(mode="json")
        if not isinstance(provenance, dict) or not provenance.get(
                "source_type"):
            findings.append(_finding(
                "missing_provenance",
                f"{record.get('entity_id', record.get('id', '?'))} "
                "has no usable provenance",
                [str(record.get("entity_id",
                                record.get("id", "")))], current))
        elif provenance.get("source_type") == "ai-generated" \
                and not provenance.get("human_verified"):
            findings.append(_finding(
                "unverified_ai_info",
                f"{record.get('entity_id', record.get('id', '?'))} "
                "is AI-generated and unverified",
                [str(record.get("entity_id",
                                record.get("id", "")))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def _bounded(rows, cap: int = 200) -> list[dict]:
    return [row for row in (rows or [])[:cap]
            if isinstance(row, dict)]


def scan_blocked_tasks(tasks: list[dict], current: datetime
                       ) -> list[Finding]:
    """Tasks in blocked status. Reason shown: status + age."""
    findings = []
    for task in _bounded(tasks):
        if str(task.get("status", "")) != "blocked":
            continue
        age = _age_hours(str(task.get("updated_at",
                                      task.get("created_at",
                                               ""))), current)
        age_text = f", blocked for {age:.1f}h" \
            if age is not None else ""
        findings.append(_finding(
            "blocked_task",
            f"task {task.get('id', '?')} is blocked{age_text}; "
            "needs a human decision or unblocked dependency",
            [str(task.get("id", ""))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_failed_tasks(tasks: list[dict], current: datetime
                      ) -> list[Finding]:
    """Failed tasks + repeatedly failing (attempts/maxed).
    Reason shown: status and attempt counts, never a retry."""
    findings = []
    for task in _bounded(tasks):
        status = str(task.get("status", ""))
        attempts = task.get("attempts", task.get("attempt_count",
                                                 0))
        try:
            attempts = int(attempts or 0)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            attempts = 0
        if status == "failed":
            findings.append(_finding(
                "failed_task",
                f"task {task.get('id', '?')} failed after "
                f"{attempts} attempt(s); inspect before retrying",
                [str(task.get("id", ""))], current))
        elif status in ("queued", "assigned") and attempts >= 3:
            findings.append(_finding(
                "failed_task",
                f"task {task.get('id', '?')} failed repeatedly "
                f"({attempts} attempts); do not retry blindly",
                [str(task.get("id", ""))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_orphan_files(files: list[dict], edges: list[dict],
                      current: datetime) -> list[Finding]:
    """Files with no relationship edge at all. Reason shown:
    zero edges in the bounded edge set."""
    linked: set[str] = set()
    for edge in _bounded(edges, 500):
        for key in ("from_id", "to_id"):
            value = str(edge.get(key, ""))
            if value:
                linked.add(value)
    findings = []
    for record in _bounded(files):
        file_id = str(record.get("id", record.get("file_id",
                                                  "")))
        if not file_id or file_id in linked:
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            "orphan_file",
            f"file {file_id} has no relationships; link it to "
            "a source or project, or confirm it is spare",
            [file_id], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_duplicate_files(files: list[dict], current: datetime
                         ) -> list[Finding]:
    """Files sharing one sha256. Reason shown: the hash."""
    by_hash: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for record in _bounded(files):
        digest = str(record.get("sha256", "")).lower()
        file_id = str(record.get("id", record.get("file_id",
                                                  "")))
        if not digest or not file_id:
            continue
        by_hash.setdefault(digest, []).append(file_id)
    findings = []
    for digest in sorted(by_hash):
        ids = by_hash[digest]
        if len(ids) < 2:
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            "duplicate_file",
            f"{len(ids)} files share sha256 {digest[:16]}...; "
            "deduplicate or confirm intentional copies",
            ids[:10], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_unfinished_designs(fabrications: list[dict],
                            current: datetime) -> list[Finding]:
    """Fabrication records stuck before verification.
    Reason shown: current stage."""
    findings = []
    for record in _bounded(fabrications):
        status = str(record.get("status", ""))
        if status in ("verified", "cancelled"):
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            "unfinished_design",
            f"fabrication {record.get('fabrication_id', '?')} "
            f"is at stage '{status or 'unknown'}'; finish or "
            "cancel explicitly",
            [str(record.get("fabrication_id", ""))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_skill_gaps(requirements: list[dict],
                    owned_skill_names: list[str],
                    current: datetime) -> list[Finding]:
    """Project skill needs without an owned skill. Reason
    shown: which project needs which skill. Suggestion only:
    never enrols or buys anything."""
    owned = {str(name).strip().lower()
             for name in (owned_skill_names or [])}
    findings = []
    for requirement in _bounded(requirements):
        skill = str(requirement.get("skill", "")).strip()
        project = str(requirement.get("project_ref",
                                      requirement.get(
                                          "project_id", "")))
        if not skill or skill.lower() in owned:
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            "skill_gap",
            f"project {project or '?'} needs skill '{skill}' "
            "which is not owned; consider a learning resource "
            "or a small practice task",
            [project] if project else [], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings


def scan_device_staleness(devices: list[dict], current: datetime,
                          *, kind: str = "device_stale",
                          stale_hours: float = 24.0 * 7
                          ) -> list[Finding]:
    """Printers/cameras/nodes unseen beyond the bound. Reason
    shown: last-seen age."""
    findings = []
    for device in _bounded(devices):
        last_seen = str(device.get("last_seen",
                                   device.get("updated_at",
                                              "")))
        age = _age_hours(last_seen, current)
        if age is None or age < stale_hours:
            continue
        findings.append(_finding(
            kind,
            f"{device.get('device_id', device.get('id', '?'))} "
            f"unseen for {age / 24:.1f}d; check power, "
            "connection and retention",
            [str(device.get("device_id",
                            device.get("id", "")))], current))
        if len(findings) >= MAX_FINDINGS:
            break
    return findings

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/workshop3d.py">
"""3D workshop ecosystem (BIG #35): models become living citizens.

The workbench, reusing every existing safety layer:

    DISCOVER → IMPORT → INSPECT → UNDERSTAND → CONNECT →
    MODIFY → PREPARE → SLICE → FABRICATE → OBSERVE →
    VERIFY → LEARN → UPDATE WORLD

Rules (fail-closed, tested):

- No second world model. Models (`mdl_…`), materials
  (`mat_…`) and fab jobs (`fabjob_…`) are workshop metadata;
  relationships to INVENTory entities are connection
  candidates (PROPOSED symbiosis) until the knowledge flow
  supports/promotes them. No direct edges, no invented
  predicates outside the closed set below.
- Model files live in the existing fabrication dir (operator
  copies them there, like the camera inbox). REAL inspection
  for STL/OBJ via the existing mesh validator; 3MF/GLB/GLTF
  register metadata-only with inspection UNKNOWN. Nothing
  отлично is ever measured that was not parsed; manifold,
  units and volume stay UNKNOWN unless actually determined.
- Dedupe by sha256: same bytes never register twice.
- Fabrication honesty: preparation/validation/slicing use
  the existing TEST slicer (labeled) or refuse with an
  explicit UNAVAILABLE reason. Print proposals go through
  the existing writes flow (`printer.execute`, exact YES);
  fab-job stages DERIVE from the stored write record and
  PrintResult — the module never approves or executes.
  Simulated execution only ever reports SIMULATED telemetry.
- Camera verification: an observation plus the existing
  observation-verification halves; human YES stays required
  before any verified memory.
- No shell, no subprocess, no eval, no URLs, no credentials.
  Model bytes are parsed as data with struct, never run.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib as _hashlib
import secrets as _secrets
import struct as _struct
import time as _time

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

#: Model filename suffixes. STL/OBJ get geometric inspection;
#: 3MF/GLB/GLTF register metadata-only (inspection UNKNOWN).
MODEL_SUFFIXES = (".stl", ".obj", ".3mf", ".glb", ".gltf")
INSPECTABLE_SUFFIXES = (".stl", ".obj")

MAX_MODELS_PER_PAGE = 50

#: Closed predicates for workshop → world links. Connection
#: candidates only (PROPOSED symbiosis); never direct edges.
WORKSHOP_PREDICATES = (
    "represents",
    "requires",
    "used_in",
    "generated_from",
    "fabricated_by",
    "replacement_for",
    "compatible_with",
    "verified_by",
    "part_of",
    "related_to",
)

MODEL_STATES = (
    "imported",
    "inspected",
    "connected",
    "in-fabrication",
    "observed",
    "verified",
)

MATERIAL_STATES = ("known", "candidate", "unknown")

FABJOB_STAGES = (
    "designed",
    "prepared",
    "sliced",
    "gcode-ready",
    "proposed",
    "queued",
    "approved",
    "printing",
    "printed",
    "printing-simulated",
    "printed-simulated",
    "observed",
    "verifying",
    "verified",
    "blocked",
    "cancelled",
)


class WorkshopRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Workshop validation refused; nothing was stored."""


class ModelInspection(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    triangles: int = Field(default=-1, ge=-1)
    vertices: int = Field(default=-1, ge=-1)
    bbox_mm: list[float] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                 max_length=6)
    bbox_volume_mm3: float = Field(default=-1.0, ge=-1.0)
    manifold: str = Field(default="UNKNOWN", max_length=20)
    units: str = Field(default="UNKNOWN", max_length=20)
    volume: str = Field(default="UNKNOWN", max_length=20)
    mesh_verdict: str = Field(default="UNKNOWN", max_length=20)
    inspected: bool = False
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)


#: License names that carry no enforceable terms. They describe
#: availability, not rights — accepting them as a license would
#: silently turn "open source" into "sellable", which is exactly
#: what must never happen.
VAGUE_LICENSE_NAMES = frozenset({
    "open source", "open-source", "opensource", "open",
    "free", "free for use", "free to use", "freeware",
    "public", "public domain-ish", "creative commons",
    "cc", "all rights reserved",
})


class ModelLicense(BaseModel):
    """License + remix/sale terms of one library model.

    All use-flags are explicit tri-state: True/False from the
    actual license text, None = unknown (never assumed).
    """

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    source_library: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    source_url: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    author: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    license: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    commercial_use: bool | None = None
    remix_allowed: bool | None = None
    attribution_required: bool | None = None
    original_model_url: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    imported_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=64)


def license_terms(name: str) -> dict:
    """Map a known license name to use-flags. Unknown names map
    to all-None: rights are never guessed from a name."""
    text = str(name or "").strip().lower().replace("  ", " ")
    text = text.replace(" ", "-")
    known = True
    note = ""
    if text in ("cc0-1.0", "cc0", "cc0 1.0 universal",
                "public domain", "pdm", "us government work",
                "nasa", "nasa usage guidelines"):
        commercial, remix, attribution = True, True, False
        note = ("public-domain dedication; attribution appreciated, "
                "not legally required")
    elif text.startswith("cc-by-nc-nd"):
        commercial, remix, attribution = False, False, True
        note = "non-commercial, no derivatives"
    elif text.startswith("cc-by-nc-sa"):
        commercial, remix, attribution = False, True, True
        note = "non-commercial, share-alike on remix"
    elif text.startswith("cc-by-nc"):
        commercial, remix, attribution = False, True, True
        note = "non-commercial"
    elif text.startswith("cc-by-nd"):
        commercial, remix, attribution = True, False, True
        note = "no derivatives"
    elif text.startswith("cc-by-sa"):
        commercial, remix, attribution = True, True, True
        note = "share-alike on remix"
    elif text.startswith("cc-by"):
        commercial, remix, attribution = True, True, True
        note = ""
    elif text in ("mit", "apache-2.0"):
        commercial, remix, attribution = True, True, True
        note = "software license applied to model files"
    else:
        known = False
        commercial, remix, attribution = None, None, None
        note = ("unknown license: commercial use, remix and "
                "attribution stay undecided until checked")
    return {"commercial_use": commercial, "remix_allowed": remix,
            "attribution_required": attribution, "known": known,
            "note": note}


def clean_library_license(
        value: dict | ModelLicense | None) -> ModelLicense | None:
    """Validate operator-supplied license info. Fail-closed:

    - vague names ("open source", "free", ...) are refused: they
      express no terms and must never imply sellability;
    - external origin (library/URL/author set) without an actual
      license name is refused: license is always part of the
      record, never optional for imports;
    - unknown license names keep all flags None (never assumed);
    - known names only fill flags the operator left undecided —
      explicit operator flags always win.
    """
    if value is None:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, ModelLicense):
        lic = value
    elif isinstance(value, dict):
        try:
            lic = ModelLicense(**{str(key): val for key, val in
                                   value.items()})
        except ValueError as error:
            raise WorkshopRefusedError(
                f"license info invalid ({error})") from error
    else:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            "license info must be an object")
    cleaned_name = str(lic.license or "").strip()
    if cleaned_name.lower() in VAGUE_LICENSE_NAMES:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            f"'{cleaned_name}' is geen licentie: leg de daadwerkelijke "
            f"licentievoorwaarden per model vast (bv. CC-BY-NC-4.0); "
            f"'open source' betekent niet verkoopbaar")
    external = any(str(part or "").strip() for part in
                   (lic.source_library, lic.source_url,
                    lic.original_model_url, lic.author))
    if external and not cleaned_name:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            "externe herkomst zonder licentie geweigerd: licentie "
            "is altijd onderdeel van het modelrecord")
    terms = license_terms(cleaned_name) if cleaned_name else None
    data = lic.model_dump(mode="json")
    if terms is not None:
        for flag in ("commercial_use", "remix_allowed",
                     "attribution_required"):
            if data.get(flag) is None:
                data[flag] = terms[flag]
    data["license"] = cleaned_name
    data["imported_at"] = str(
        lic.imported_at or "").strip() or _now()
    return ModelLicense(**data)


class WorkshopModel(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    model_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    filename: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    library_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    mime_type: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    size_bytes: int = Field(ge=0)
    sha256: str = Field(min_length=64, max_length=64,
                        pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    source: str = Field(default="inbox", max_length=40)
    status: str = Field(default="imported", max_length=20)
    inspection: ModelInspection = Field(
        default_factory=ModelInspection)
    license: ModelLicense | None = None
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""


class WorkshopMaterial(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    material_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    name: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    kind: str = Field(default="filament", max_length=40)
    state: str = Field(default="unknown", max_length=20)
    notes: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    sustainability_note: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    linked_entity: str = Field(default="", max_length=100)
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""


class FabJob(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    job_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    model_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    material_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    printer_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    profile: str = Field(default="", max_length=40)
    stage: str = Field(default="designed", max_length=30)
    gcode_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    gcode_sha256: str = Field(default="", max_length=64)
    slicer_engine: str = Field(default="", max_length=40)
    gcode_canonical_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    gcode_verdict: str = Field(default="", max_length=20)
    spool_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    queue_task_id: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    preflight: dict = Field(default_factory=dict)
    proposal_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    print_job_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    observation_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    history: list[dict] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                 max_length=60)
    created_at: str = ""
    updated_at: str = ""


def _now() -> str:
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_model_id() -> str:
    return f"mdl_{_secrets.token_hex(6)}"


def generate_material_id() -> str:
    return f"mat_{_secrets.token_hex(4)}"


def generate_fabjob_id() -> str:
    return f"fabjob_{int(_time.time() * 1000):x}" \
        f"{_secrets.token_hex(2)}"


def init_workshop_tables() -> None:
    """Additive workshop tables in the chat DB. Idempotent."""
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workshop_models (
            model_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workshop_materials (
            material_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS workshop_fabjobs (
            job_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workshop_models_created
            ON workshop_models(created_at);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_workshop_fabjobs_created
            ON workshop_fabjobs(created_at);
        """)


def check_workshop_id(value: str, prefix: str) -> str:
    cleaned = str(value or "").strip()[:80]
    if not cleaned.startswith(prefix) or len(cleaned) < 6:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            f"id must be a {prefix} workshop id")
    if any(char not in
           "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789_-"
           for char in cleaned):
        raise WorkshopRefusedError("id has illegal characters")
    return cleaned


def _check_model_filename(value: str) -> str:
    """Model filename only: no paths, URLs or schemes, and a
    known model suffix. Mirrors the fab-dir discipline for the
    wider model set (3MF/GLB/GLTF are metadata-only)."""
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise WorkshopRefusedError("model filename must be text")
    text = value.strip()
    if not text:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            "model filename must be non-empty text")
    if len(text) > 200:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError("model filename too long")
    lowered = text.lower()
    if ("://" in lowered or text.startswith("\\\\")
            or text.startswith("/") or ":" in text):
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            "model filename must be a plain local filename")
    if ".." in text or "/" in text or "\\" in text:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            "model filename must not contain a path")
    if not lowered.endswith(MODEL_SUFFIXES):
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            f"unsupported model format; expected one of "
            f"{list(MODEL_SUFFIXES)}")
    return text


def _model_bytes(reference: str) -> bytes:
    """Read one validated model file inside the fabrication dir."""
    import os as _os
    from .mesh3d import fabrication_dir, read_artifact_bytes
    if reference.lower().endswith(INSPECTABLE_SUFFIXES):
        return read_artifact_bytes(reference)
    root = _os.path.abspath(fabrication_dir())
    path = _os.path.abspath(_os.path.join(root, reference))
    if path != root and not path.startswith(root + _os.sep):
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            "model escapes the fabrication directory")
    if not _os.path.isfile(path):
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            f"model '{reference}' is not in the fabrication dir; "
            f"copy the file there first")
    size = _os.path.getsize(path)
    if size <= 0:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError("model is empty; refusing")
    from .mesh3d import MAX_MESH_BYTES
    if size > MAX_MESH_BYTES:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            f"model is {size} bytes (max {MAX_MESH_BYTES}); refusing")
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        return handle.read(MAX_MESH_BYTES + 1)


def _mime_for(filename: str) -> str:
    lowered = filename.lower()
    if lowered.endswith(".stl"):
        return "model/stl"
    if lowered.endswith(".obj"):
        return "model/obj"
    if lowered.endswith(".3mf"):
        return "model/3mf"
    if lowered.endswith((".glb", ".gltf")):
        return "model/gltf-binary" if lowered.endswith(".glb") \
            else "model/gltf+json"
    return "application/octet-stream"


def _save(table: str, key: str, key_col: str,
          record: dict, created_at: str) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_workshop_tables()
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            f"""INSERT INTO {table}
            ({key_col}, record, created_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?)
            ON CONFLICT({key_col}) DO UPDATE SET
            record=excluded.record""",
            (key, dump(record), created_at or _now()))


def _load(table: str, key_col: str, key: str):
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_workshop_tables()
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute(f"SELECT record FROM {table} "
                         f"WHERE {key_col}=?", (key,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return None
    return load(row["record"])


def _list(table: str, limit: int) -> list[dict]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database, load
    init_workshop_tables()
    init_chat_database()
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 50), 100))
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(f"SELECT record FROM {table} "
                          f"ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?",
                          (count,)).fetchall()
    return [load(row["record"]) for row in rows]


# -- model ingest + inspection ---------------------------------------------------

def known_model_shas() -> set[str]:
    return {str(item.get("sha256", "")) for item in
            _list("workshop_models", 100) if item.get("sha256")}


def register_model(filename: str, *, source: str = "inbox") -> dict:
    """Register one model file already present in the fabrication
    dir (operator copies it there, like the camera inbox).
    Metadata-only for 3MF/GLB/GLTF. Dedupe by sha256."""
    cleaned_source = str(source or "inbox").strip()[:40]
    if cleaned_source not in ("inbox", "generated", "test"):
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            "source must be inbox, generated or test")
    reference = _check_model_filename(filename)
    lowered = reference.lower()
    try:
        data = _model_bytes(reference)
    except WorkshopRefusedError:
        raise
    except ValueError as error:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    digest = _hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
    if digest in known_model_shas():
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(
            "same model bytes already registered; replay refused")
    stamp = _now()
    model = WorkshopModel(
        model_id=generate_model_id(), filename=reference,
        mime_type=_mime_for(reference), size_bytes=len(data),
        sha256=digest, source=cleaned_source, status="imported",
        created_at=stamp, updated_at=stamp)
    _save("workshop_models", model.model_id, "model_id",
          model.model_dump(mode="json"), stamp)
    return model.model_dump(mode="json")


def get_model(model_id: str) -> dict | None:
    record = _load("workshop_models", "model_id",
                   check_workshop_id(model_id, "mdl_"))
    return record


def list_models(limit: int = 50) -> list[dict]:
    return _list("workshop_models", limit)


def _scan_stl(data: bytes) -> dict:
    """Lightweight geometric scan (stdlib only). Dimensions and
    counts only; manifold/volume stay UNKNOWN by design."""
    if len(data) >= 84 + 4:
        count = _struct.unpack("<I", data[80:84])[0]
        if count > 0 and len(data) == 80 + 4 + count * 50:
            points: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
            offset = 84
            for _ in range(min(count, 200000)):
                try:
                    (nx, ny, nz, x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2,
                     x3, y3, z3, _attr) = _struct.unpack(
                        "<12fH", data[offset:offset + 50])
                except _struct.error:
                    break
                points.extend([(x1, y1, z1), (x2, y2, z2),
                               (x3, y3, z3)])
                offset += 50
            if points:
                axes = list(zip(*points))
                lo = [min(axis) for axis in axes]
                hi = [max(axis) for axis in axes]
                size = [hi[i] - lo[i] for i in range(3)]
                return {"triangles": count,
                        "vertices": count * 3,
                        "bbox_mm": lo + hi,
                        "bbox_volume_mm3": size[0] * size[1] *
                        size[2]}
    text = None
    try:
        text = data[:200000].decode("ascii")
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
        text = None
    if text is not None and "facet normal" in text:
        facets = text.count("facet normal")
        numbers: list[float] = []
        for line in text.splitlines():
            stripped = line.strip()
            if stripped.startswith("vertex"):
                parts = stripped.split()
                if len(parts) == 4:
                    try:
                        numbers.extend(float(part) for part in
                                       parts[1:4])
                    except ValueError:
                        continue
        if facets and numbers:
            coords = [numbers[i:i + 3] for i in
                      range(0, len(numbers) - 2, 3)]
            axes = list(zip(*coords))
            lo = [min(axis) for axis in axes]
            hi = [max(axis) for axis in axes]
            size = [hi[i] - lo[i] for i in range(3)]
            return {"triangles": facets,
                    "vertices": facets * 3,
                    "bbox_mm": lo + hi,
                    "bbox_volume_mm3": size[0] * size[1] * size[2]}
    return {}


def _scan_obj(data: bytes) -> dict:
    try:
        text = data[:500000].decode("utf-8", "replace")
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, ValueError):
        return {}
    verts: list[tuple[float, float, float]] = []
    faces = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("v "):
            parts = line.split()
            if len(parts) >= 4:
                try:
                    verts.append((float(parts[1]), float(parts[2]),
                                  float(parts[3])))
                except ValueError:
                    continue
        elif line.startswith("f "):
            faces += 1
    if not verts:
        return {}
    axes = list(zip(*verts))
    lo = [min(axis) for axis in axes]
    hi = [max(axis) for axis in axes]
    size = [hi[i] - lo[i] for i in range(3)]
    return {"triangles": faces, "vertices": len(verts),
            "bbox_mm": lo + hi,
            "bbox_volume_mm3": size[0] * size[1] * size[2]}


def _apply_inspection(record: dict, data: bytes,
                      lowered: str) -> dict:
    """Shared scan + validate + save over caller-supplied bytes.

    Extracted from inspect_model so library files (E:\\Mycelium,
    never copied to the fabrication dir) get the identical
    verdicts. Behavior for fabrication-dir models is unchanged:
    the same bytes flow through the same checks.
    """
    from .mesh3d import validate_mesh
    inspection = ModelInspection()
    if lowered.endswith(INSPECTABLE_SUFFIXES):
        scanned = _scan_stl(data) if lowered.endswith(".stl") \
            else _scan_obj(data)
        if scanned:
            inspection.triangles = int(scanned["triangles"])
            inspection.vertices = int(scanned["vertices"])
            inspection.bbox_mm = [float(value) for value in
                                 scanned["bbox_mm"]]
            inspection.bbox_volume_mm3 = float(
                scanned["bbox_volume_mm3"])
            inspection.inspected = True
            inspection.note = ("workshop geometric scan (dimensions "
                               "and counts); manifold/volume/units "
                               "stay UNKNOWN")
        try:
            verdict = validate_mesh(str(record.get("filename", "")),
                                    data=data)
            inspection.mesh_verdict = str(verdict.verdict)
        except ValueError:
            inspection.mesh_verdict = "inconclusive"
    else:
        inspection.note = ("format has no local inspector; "
                           "metadata only, everything UNKNOWN")
        inspection.mesh_verdict = "inconclusive"
    record["inspection"] = inspection.model_dump(mode="json")
    if record.get("status") == "imported":
        record["status"] = "inspected"
    record["updated_at"] = _now()
    _save("workshop_models", record["model_id"], "model_id",
          record, record.get("created_at", ""))
    return record


def inspect_model(model_id: str) -> dict:
    """Geometric scan + mesh-validator verdict. UNKNOWN wherever
    the bytes do not actually determine the answer."""
    record = get_model(model_id)
    if record is None:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError("model not found")
    filename = str(record.get("filename", ""))
    lowered = filename.lower()
    try:
        data = _model_bytes(filename)
    except WorkshopRefusedError as error:
        raise error
    except ValueError as error:
        raise WorkshopRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    return _apply_inspection(record, data, lowered)


# -- materials ---------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_material(name: str, *, kind: str = "filament",
                    state: str = "unknown", notes: str = "",
                    sustainability_note: str = "",
                    linked_entity: str = "") -> dict:
    """Register one material. Sustainability text is an operator
    note, never a verified claim — no green claims by name."""
