<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_dist_sim.py">
"""Distributed multi-node smoke (BIG #8, §22).

Three deterministic cases over real coordinator routes:

1. vision task routes to node_vision, claims, completes,
   result recorded (verification-style readback of the task).
2. node_vision stale: same non-physical task reroutes to (or
   waits for) another compatible node; vision node rejected.
3. physical task whose node disappears after lease: blocked,
   operator-required, never silently duplicated.
"""

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.sim_nodes import sim_registration


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sim.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sim-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def sim_token(node_id: str) -> str:
    return f"sim-token-{node_id}-123"


def register_all(test_client):
    for node_id in ("node_desktop", "node_vision", "node_cpu"):
        response = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/register",
            json={**sim_registration(node_id),
                  "node_token": sim_token(node_id)})
        assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def heartbeat(test_client, node_id):
    assert test_client.post(
        f"/api/v1/nodes/{node_id}/heartbeat",
        json={"available": True,
              "node_token": sim_token(node_id)}).status_code == 204


def claim(test_client, node_id):
    return test_client.post(
        f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{node_id}",
        params={"node_token": sim_token(node_id)}).json()


def test_case_1_vision_task_flows(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_all(test_client)
        task = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "vision.describe",
            "required_capabilities": ["vision.describe"],
            "requirements": {"required_model_types": ["vlm"]},
            "payload": {"routing": {
                "required_capabilities": ["vision.describe"],
                "required_model_types": ["vlm"]}},
        }).json()
        assigned = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task['id']}/assign",
            json={"policy": {
                "require_authenticated": False}}).json()
        assert assigned["assigned_node_id"] == "node_vision"
        claimed = claim(test_client, "node_vision")
        assert claimed["id"] == task["id"]
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task['id']}/complete",
            params={"node_id": "node_vision"},
            json={"success": True,
                  "result": {"observation": "simulated workbench",
                             "executor": "exec:vision",
                             "node_id": "node_vision"}}).status_code == 204
        stored = next(item for item in
                      test_client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
                      if item["id"] == task["id"])
        assert stored["status"] == "completed"
        assert stored["result"]["result"]["node_id"] == "node_vision"
        assert stored["assigned_node_id"] == "node_vision"
        detail = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/by-id/{task['id']}").json()
        assert detail["routing_decision"]["selected_node_id"] == \
            "node_vision"


def test_case_2_stale_vision_node_reroutes(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

def test_case_3_physical_disappearance_blocks(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    from coordinator.app.main import expire_leases
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_all(test_client)
        task = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "printer_run",
            "required_capabilities": ["printer.simulated"],
            "requirements": {"required_capabilities": [
                "printer.simulated"],
                "physical_action": True},
        }).json()
        # Extend node_cpu advertisement for this run only.
        heartbeat(test_client, "node_cpu")
        with connection() as db:
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE nodes SET capabilities=? WHERE node_id=?",
                ('["printer.simulated"]', "node_cpu"))
        assigned = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task['id']}/assign",
            json={"policy": {
                "require_authenticated": False}}).json()
        assert assigned["assigned_node_id"] == "node_cpu"
        claimed = claim(test_client, "node_cpu")
        assert claimed["id"] == task["id"]
        # Node disappears mid-lease: expire, then prove no reroute.
        with connection() as db:
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE tasks SET lease_until=? WHERE id=?",
                ("2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", task["id"]))
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE nodes SET last_seen=?",
                ("2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",))
        summary = expire_leases("2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
        assert summary["blocked"] == 1
        assert summary["requeued"] == 0
        with connection() as db:
            status = db.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=?",
                (task["id"],)).fetchone()["status"]
        assert status == "blocked"
        # Even a fresh capable node never re-claims it.
        heartbeat(test_client, "node_cpu")
        assert claim(test_client, "node_cpu") is None

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_fab_security.py">
"""Fabrication security tripwires (BIG #7).

No shell, no SQL on world tables, no cloud, no fake geometry/
G-code/telemetry, no auto-execution, no forged verification,
no safe_to_execute anywhere, no public exposure.
"""

import pathlib

import pytest


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def isolated_fab_dir(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Each test gets its own fabrication dir: no cross-test
    file bleed through the shared temp directory."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "fab"))


APP = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "coordinator" / "app"


def source_of(*names: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join(
        (APP / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8") for name in names)


FAB_MODULES = ("mesh3d.py", "slicer3d.py", "printer3d.py",
               "fab_flow.py")


def test_no_shell_or_code_execution():
    source = source_of(*FAB_MODULES)
    for token in ("subprocess", "os.system", "os.popen", "shell=True",
                  "eval(", "exec(", "__import__"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_no_heavy_or_vendor_dependencies():
    source = source_of(*FAB_MODULES)
    for token in ("import numpy", "import trimesh", "import PIL",
                  "from PIL", "import serial", "from serial",
                  "import usb", "octoprint", "cura", "prusa",
                  "import requests", "import boto"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_no_sql_on_world_tables():
    source = source_of(*FAB_MODULES)
    assert "import sqlite3" not in source
    for table in ("objects", "projects", "ideas", "relationships",
                  "files", "events", "camera_devices",
                  "camera_observations"):
        assert f"INTO {table}" not in source, f"table write: {table}"
        assert f"UPDATE {table}" not in source, f"table update: {table}"
        assert f"DELETE FROM {table}" not in source, (
            f"table delete: {table}")


def test_no_cloud_or_network():
    source = source_of(*FAB_MODULES)
    for token in ("import socket", "urlopen", "0.0.0.0", "listen(",
                  ".bind(", "https://", "upload("):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_no_safe_to_execute_anywhere():
    source = source_of(*FAB_MODULES)
    # Binding forms only: prose may name the forbidden concept,
    # but no field, flag or permission may ever carry it.
    for token in ("safe_to_execute=", "safe_to_execute :",
                  "'safe_to_execute'", '"safe_to_execute"'):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_no_auto_execution_path():
    from coordinator.app import fab_flow
    assert not hasattr(fab_flow, "auto_print")
    assert not hasattr(fab_flow, "start_print")
    source = (APP / "fab_flow.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for token in ("auto_print", "direct-print", "start_print(",
                  "auto_start"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"


def test_existing_pipeline_still_refuses_physical():
    from coordinator.app.pipeline3d import new_generation_request
    for method in ("printer", "gcode", "auto", "cloud"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            new_generation_request("req-s", "obj_x", method)


def test_changed_artifact_fingerprint_rejected():
    import hashlib
    from coordinator.app.mesh3d import (
        artifact_path,
        read_artifact_bytes,
    )
    from coordinator.app.slicer3d import TestSlicer, check_slicer_request
    from coordinator.app.mesh3d import ProceduralTestGenerator
    mesh = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {}).artifact_ref
    request = check_slicer_request(mesh, "draft-pla", "prt-s")
    result = TestSlicer().slice(request)
    original = hashlib.sha256(
        read_artifact_bytes(result.gcode_ref)).hexdigest()
    assert original == result.sha256
    with open(artifact_path(result.gcode_ref), "a",
              encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write("; tampered\n")
    tampered = hashlib.sha256(
        read_artifact_bytes(result.gcode_ref)).hexdigest()
    assert tampered != result.sha256


def test_telemetry_cannot_forge_verification():
    from coordinator.app.fab_flow import (
        new_telemetry_request,
        verify_print_telemetry,
    )
    from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import WriteResult, now
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance
    request = new_telemetry_request("wrt-s", "0" * 64, "ab" * 32)
    result = WriteResult(
        proposal_id="wrt-s", fingerprint="0" * 64,
        outcome="failed", actor="t", executed_at=now(),
        provenance=Provenance(source_type="sensor-observed",
                              creator_id="t",
                              human_verified=False))
    verification = verify_print_telemetry(request, result)
    assert verification.outcome == "failed"
    from coordinator.app.verification import is_verified
    assert is_verified(verification) is False


def test_ai_cannot_set_verified_or_safe():
    from coordinator.app.mesh3d import (
        ProceduralTestGenerator,
        validate_mesh,
    )
    report = validate_mesh(
        ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("x", {}).artifact_ref)

    assert report.verdict == "valid"
    from coordinator.app.slicer3d import (
        TestSlicer,
        check_slicer_request,
        validate_gcode,
    )
    from coordinator.app.mesh3d import ProceduralTestGenerator as Gen
    mesh = Gen().generate("x", {}).artifact_ref
    safety = validate_gcode(TestSlicer().slice(
        check_slicer_request(mesh, "draft-pla", "prt-s")).gcode_ref)

    assert not hasattr(safety, "safe_to_execute")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_failover.py">
"""Coordinator failover tests (BIG #10, deel 2).

Lease, epoch, fencing, deterministic election, quorum and
degraded mode, stale-coordinator write refusal, returning
primary sync. No Raft, no new dependencies.
"""

import pytest

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.failover import (
    ElectionRefusedError,
    FencingError,
    campaign,
    current_epoch,
    release,
    require_epoch,
    sync_status,
)


def use_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "fo.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "fo-chat.db"))


def register(node_id, capable=True, live=True):
    from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": [], "coordinator_capable": capable,
            "node_token": f"failover-token-{node_id}-123"})
        assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
        if not live:
            from coordinator.app.database import connection
            with connection() as db:
                db.execute(
                    "UPDATE nodes SET last_seen=? WHERE node_id=?",
                    ("2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", node_id))


def voters():
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute(
            "SELECT node_id, status, last_seen, "
            "coordinator_capable FROM nodes").fetchall()
    return [{
        "node_id": row["node_id"], "status": row["status"],
        "last_seen": row["last_seen"],
        "coordinator_capable": bool(row["coordinator_capable"]),
    } for row in rows]


def test_single_node_elects_degraded(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    register("node-solo")
    result = campaign("node-solo", voters)
    assert result["epoch"] == 1
    assert result["mode"] == "degraded"
    assert len(result["fencing_token"]) == 32
    assert current_epoch() == 1
    assert require_epoch(1) == 1
    # Renewal keeps the epoch, refreshes the lease.
    renewed = campaign("node-solo", voters)
    assert renewed["epoch"] == 1
    assert renewed["mode"] == "renewed"


def test_deterministic_order_and_quorum(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    register("node-b")
    register("node-a")
    with pytest.raises(ElectionRefusedError, match="node-a"):
        campaign("node-b", voters)
    result = campaign("node-a", voters)
    assert result["epoch"] == 1
    assert result["mode"] == "quorum"
    # Holder renews without quorum drama; a released lease with
    # too few fresh voters refuses (manual recovery).
    register("node-c", live=False)
    register("node-d", live=False)
    renewed = campaign("node-a", voters)
    assert renewed["mode"] == "renewed"
    release("node-a")
    stale("node-a")
    with pytest.raises(ElectionRefusedError, match="no quorum"):
        campaign("node-b", voters)
    from coordinator.app.failover import _capable_set
    assert len(_capable_set(voters())) == 4


def test_ineligible_nodes_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    register("node-plain", capable=False)
    with pytest.raises(ElectionRefusedError, match="eligible"):
        campaign("node-plain", voters)
    with pytest.raises(ElectionRefusedError, match="eligible"):
        campaign("node-ghost", voters)
    register("node-stale", live=False)
    with pytest.raises(ElectionRefusedError, match="eligible"):
        campaign("node-stale", voters)


def stale(node_id):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE nodes SET last_seen=? WHERE node_id=?",
                   ("2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", node_id))


def expire_lease():
    from coordinator.app.database import chat_connection
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE coordinator_lease SET expires_at=? "
                   "WHERE id=1",
                   ("2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",))


def disable(node_id):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute("UPDATE nodes SET status='disabled' "
                   "WHERE node_id=?", (node_id,))


def test_lease_holder_wins_and_release(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    register("node-1")
    register("node-2")
    first = campaign("node-1", voters)
    assert first["epoch"] == 1
    # Holder goes stale: the live lease still fences node-2 out.
    stale("node-1")
    with pytest.raises(ElectionRefusedError, match="held by"):
        campaign("node-2", voters)
    assert release("node-2") is False
    assert release("node-1") is True
    assert current_epoch() == 0
    # Manual recovery: disable the dead node, then node-2 wins
    # a new epoch in degraded mode. No split-brain: epoch grows.
    disable("node-1")
    second = campaign("node-2", voters)
    assert second["epoch"] == 2
    assert second["mode"] == "degraded"


def test_old_epoch_cannot_write(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    register("node-1")
    campaign("node-1", voters)
    assert current_epoch() == 1
    # Primary returns after failure elsewhere: it synchronizes
    # by reading (pull-only) and must campaign for a NEW epoch;
    # the old epoch never writes again.
    release("node-1")
    register("node-2")
    disable("node-1")
    campaign("node-2", voters)
    assert current_epoch() == 2
    with pytest.raises(FencingError, match="not the live epoch"):
        require_epoch(1)
    with pytest.raises(FencingError):
        require_epoch("nope")
    assert require_epoch(2) == 2


def test_sync_status_snapshot(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    use_dbs(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    register("node-1")
    empty = sync_status(voters())
    assert empty == {"epoch": 0, "holder": None,
                     "expires_at": None, "eligible_voters": [
                         "node-1"], "mode": "none"}
    campaign("node-1", voters)
    live = sync_status(voters())
    assert live["epoch"] == 1
    assert live["holder"] == "node-1"
    assert live["mode"] == "degraded"

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_inventory_read.py">
"""Tests for the M5.1 read-only INVENTory bridge (inventory_read.py).

All HTTP is faked with httpx.MockTransport. No real INVENTory server, no real
network, no database. Async client calls run via asyncio.run (no new deps).
"""
import asyncio

import httpx
import pytest

from coordinator.app.inventory_read import (
    BROWSE_MAX_TOTAL,
    BROWSE_PER_COLLECTION,
    LIST_TYPES,
    MAX_SEARCH_RESULTS,
    InventoryReader,
    InventoryRefusedError,
    InventoryUnavailable,
)

PROV = {"source_type": "user-created", "creator_id": "user",
        "human_verified": True, "created_at": "2026-09-11T00:00:00+00:00"}


def run(coro):
    return asyncio.run(coro)


class Recorder:
    """MockTransport handler that records requests and serves canned JSON."""

    def __init__(self, payload=None, status=200):
        self.requests = []
        self.payload = payload if payload is not None else {}
        self.status = status

    def __call__(self, request):
        self.requests.append(request)
        return httpx.Response(self.status, json=self.payload)


def reader(handler, **kwargs):
    kwargs.setdefault("base_url", "http://127.0.0.1:8080")
    return InventoryReader(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler), **kwargs)

# --- browse (q-less, bounded, deterministic) -----------------------------------

def browse_item(entity_id, name="Naam"):
    return {"id": entity_id, "name": name, "description": "beschrijving",
            "provenance": PROV}


def test_browse_uses_list_routes_bounded_and_deterministic():
    seen = []

    offer = {"objects": "obj", "projects": "proj", "ideas": "idea",
             "hardware": "hw"}

    def handle(request):
        seen.append(request)
        collection = request.url.path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
        if collection not in offer:
            return httpx.Response(200, json=[])
        return httpx.Response(200, json=[
            browse_item(f"{offer[collection]}_{i}") for i in range(5)])

    first = run(reader(handle).browse())
    assert [req.url.path for req in seen] == [
        "/api/v1/objects", "/api/v1/projects", "/api/v1/ideas",
        "/api/v1/hardware"]
    assert {req.method for req in seen} == {"GET"}
    for req in seen:
        assert dict(req.url.params) == {}
    assert first.query == ""
    assert first.total == BROWSE_MAX_TOTAL
    assert len(first.results) == BROWSE_MAX_TOTAL
    objects = [r for r in first.results if r.entity_type == "object"]
    assert len(objects) == BROWSE_PER_COLLECTION
    assert [r.entity_id for r in objects] == ["obj_0", "obj_1", "obj_2"]
    assert [r.entity_id for r in first.results
            if r.entity_type == "hardware"] == ["hw_0"]
    second = run(reader(handle).browse())
    assert [(r.entity_type, r.entity_id) for r in second.results] == [
        (r.entity_type, r.entity_id) for r in first.results]

def test_only_get_is_used():
    seen = []

    def dispatch(request):
        seen.append(request)
        if request.url.path == "/api/v1/objects":
            return httpx.Response(200, json=[list_item()])
        if request.url.path == "/api/v1/graph":
            return httpx.Response(200, json={"entity_id": "obj_abc", "depth": 1,
                                             "nodes": [], "edges": []})
        return httpx.Response(200, json=[])

    r = InventoryReader(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:8080",
                        transport=httpx.MockTransport(dispatch))
    run(r.search("moer"))
    run(r.graph("obj_abc"))
    assert seen, "expected requests to inspect"
    assert {req.method for req in seen} == {"GET"}
    for name in ("post", "put", "patch", "delete"):
        assert not hasattr(r, name), f"reader must not offer {name}"


def test_extra_fields_tolerated():
    def handle(request):
        if request.url.path == "/api/v1/objects":
            return httpx.Response(200, json=[dict(
                list_item(), brand_new_section=[1, 2])])
        return httpx.Response(200, json=[])

    res = run(reader(handle).search("moer"))
    assert res.total == 1
    assert res.results[0].entity_id == "obj_abc"


def test_env_override_and_defaults(monkeypatch):
    def fail(request):  # pragma: no cover
        raise AssertionError("no HTTP must happen")
    transport = httpx.MockTransport(fail)
    monkeypatch.delenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", raising=False)
    assert InventoryReader(transport=transport).base_url == "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
    assert InventoryReader(transport=transport).timeout == 5.0
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://localhost:8080")
    assert InventoryReader(transport=transport).base_url == "http://localhost:8080"
    assert InventoryReader(transport=transport, timeout=99).timeout == 5.0
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_BASE_URL", "http://example.com/")
    with pytest.raises(InventoryRefusedError):
        InventoryReader(transport=transport)

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_memory.py">
"""Phase 1 tests (BIG #11-15): memory, watcher detectors, reports."""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "p1.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "p1-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def human_prov():
    return {"source_type": "user-created",
            "creator_id": "jelles", "human_verified": True,
            "verified_by": "jelles"}


def test_memory_create_retrieve_and_truth_tiers(tmp_path,
                                                monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        # AI suggestion by default.
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "preference",
            "title": "Oat milk in coffee",
            "content": "Jelles prefers oat milk."}).json()
        assert created["memory_id"].startswith("mem_")
        assert created["truth"] == "ai_suggestion"
        # AI content cannot enter fact tiers directly.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "fact", "title": "X",
            "truth": "user_fact",
            "provenance": {"source_type": "ai-generated",
                           "creator_id": "m"}}).status_code == 422
        # Human fact works.
        fact = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "fact", "title": "Workshop address",
            "truth": "user_fact", "content": "Nijmegen",
            "provenance": human_prov()}).json()
        assert fact["truth"] == "user_fact"
        # Unknown type refuses.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "nope", "title": "X"}).status_code == 422
        # Retrieval finds the preference lexically.
        results = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory/retrieve",
                                   json={
                                       "query": "oat milk coffee",
                                       "limit": 5}).json()["results"]
        assert results
        assert results[0]["memory_id"] == created["memory_id"]
        # Filter by type/truth.
        facts = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory/retrieve",
                                 json={
                                     "query": "",
                                     "memory_types": ["fact"],
                                     "truth": "user_fact"}).json()[
                                         "results"]
        assert {item["memory_id"] for item in facts} == {
            fact["memory_id"]}
        # Get + list.
        assert test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/memory/{fact['memory_id']}").json()[
                "title"] == "Workshop address"
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/memory/mem_missing").status_code == 404


def test_memory_verify_promotion_and_tombstone(tmp_path,
                                               monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "fact", "title": "Needs review",
            "truth": "ai_inference",
            "provenance": human_prov()}).json()
        # Verify without human approver refuses.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/memory/{created['memory_id']}/verify",
            json={"verified_by": ""}).status_code == 422
        verified = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/memory/{created['memory_id']}/verify",
            json={"verified_by": "jelles"}).json()
        assert verified["truth"] == "verified"
        assert verified["revision"] == 2
        # Delete is a tombstone: get 404s, row preserved.
        assert test_client.delete(
            f"/api/v1/memory/{created['memory_id']}"
        ).status_code == 200
        assert test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/memory/{created['memory_id']}"
        ).status_code == 404
        from coordinator.app.memory import get_memory
        assert get_memory(created["memory_id"]).status == \
            "deleted"


def test_memory_consolidation_dedup_and_contradiction(
        tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        first = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory/consolidate",
                                 json={
                                     "raw_texts": [
                                         "Printer is in the workshop",
                                         "Printer is in the workshop",
                                         ""],
                                     "project_ref": "proj_x"}).json()
        assert len(first["candidates"]) == 1
        assert first["duplicates"] == 1
        assert first["contradictions"] == []
        # Nothing was stored by consolidation itself.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/memory/retrieve",
                                json={
                                    "query": "printer workshop"}
                                ).json()["results"] == []
        # Contradiction detection is structural.
        from coordinator.app.memory import (
            detect_contradictions, new_memory)
        left = new_memory("fact", "Filament left", truth="observed",
                          data={"grams": 500},
                          entity_refs=["spool_1"])
        right = new_memory("fact", "Filament right", truth="observed",
                           data={"grams": 120},
                           entity_refs=["spool_1"])
        flags = detect_contradictions([left, right])
        assert len(flags) == 1
        assert flags[0]["entity_ref"] == "spool_1"
        assert flags[0]["field"] == "grams"
        # Empty consolidation refuses.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/memory/consolidate",
                                json={
                                    "raw_texts": []}
                                ).status_code == 422


def test_health_memories_need_explicit_scope(tmp_path,
                                              monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        health = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "health", "title": "Sleep 7.5h",
            "content": "slept seven and a half hours",
            "truth": "observed"}).json()
        plain = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "fact", "title": "Workshop shelf",
            "content": "unrelated workshop note about brackets",
            "truth": "observed"}).json()
        # Default retrieval never surfaces health memories.
        results = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory/retrieve",
                                   json={
                                       "query": "sleep hours",
                                       "limit": 10}).json()["results"]
        assert health["memory_id"] not in {
            item["memory_id"] for item in results}
        # Explicit health type without scope refuses.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/memory/retrieve", json={
            "query": "sleep", "memory_types": ["health"]}
        ).status_code == 422
        # Opt-in returns them.
        scoped = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory/retrieve",
                                  json={
                                      "query": "sleep hours",
                                      "include_health": True,
                                      "limit": 10}).json()["results"]
        assert health["memory_id"] in {
            item["memory_id"] for item in scoped}
        # Same rule on the list endpoint.
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/memory",
            params={"memory_type": "health"}).status_code == 422
        listed = test_client.get("/api/v1/memory").json()
        assert health["memory_id"] not in {
            item["memory_id"] for item in listed}
        scoped_list = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/memory",
            params={"memory_type": "health",
                    "include_health": True}).json()
        assert {item["memory_id"] for item in scoped_list} == {
            health["memory_id"]}
        # Live memory sections exclude health without scope.
        session = test_client.post("/api/v1/live/sessions",
                                   json={
                                       "interface": "web",
                                       "actor": "jelles",
                                       "capabilities": [
                                           "memory.read"]}).json()[
                                               "session_id"]
        package = test_client.post("/api/v1/live/context",
                                   json={
                                       "session_id": session,
                                       "query": "sleep hours"}).json()
        assert "memory" in package["sections"]
        assert "7.5" not in package["sections"].get("memory", "")
        scoped_session = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/live/sessions",
            json={"interface": "web", "actor": "jelles",
                  "capabilities": ["memory.read", "health.read"],
                  "context_scope": {
                      "include_health": True}}).json()["session_id"]
        scoped_package = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/live/context",
            json={"session_id": scoped_session,
                  "query": "sleep hours"}).json()
        assert "7.5" in scoped_package["sections"].get("memory",
                                                       "")


def test_memory_no_shell_sql_in_module():
    import pathlib
    source = (pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent /
              "coordinator" / "app" / "memory.py").read_text(
                  encoding="utf-8")
    for token in ("subprocess", "os.system", "eval(",
                  "import sqlite3", "https://", "0.0.0.0"):
        assert token not in source


def test_watcher_new_detectors_pure():
    from coordinator.app import watcher as w
    current = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    old = (current - timedelta(hours=50)).isoformat()
    blocked = w.scan_blocked_tasks(
        [{"id": "t1", "status": "blocked", "updated_at": old}],
        current)
    assert len(blocked) == 1 and blocked[0].kind == "blocked_task"
    failed = w.scan_failed_tasks(
        [{"id": "t2", "status": "failed", "attempts": 2},
         {"id": "t3", "status": "queued", "attempts": 5},
         {"id": "t4", "status": "queued", "attempts": 1}],
        current)
    assert {item.entity_refs[0] for item in failed} == {
        "t2", "t3"}
    orphans = w.scan_orphan_files(
        [{"id": "file_a"}, {"id": "file_b"}],
        [{"from_id": "file_b", "to_id": "proj_1"}], current)
    assert [item.entity_refs[0] for item in orphans] == ["file_a"]
    dups = w.scan_duplicate_files(
        [{"id": "file_a", "sha256": "ab" * 32},
         {"id": "file_b", "sha256": "AB" * 32},
         {"id": "file_c", "sha256": "cd" * 32}], current)
    assert len(dups) == 1 and dups[0].kind == "duplicate_file"
    designs = w.scan_unfinished_designs(
        [{"fabrication_id": "fab_1", "status": "mesh_validated"},
         {"fabrication_id": "fab_2", "status": "verified"}],
        current)
    assert [item.entity_refs[0] for item in designs] == ["fab_1"]
    gaps = w.scan_skill_gaps(
        [{"skill": "CAD", "project_ref": "proj_x"},
         {"skill": "Python", "project_ref": "proj_x"}],
        ["python"], current)
    assert len(gaps) == 1 and "CAD" in gaps[0].summary
    stale = w.scan_device_staleness(
        [{"id": "prt_1",
          "last_seen": (current - timedelta(days=9)).isoformat()},
         {"id": "prt_2", "last_seen": current.isoformat()}],
        current)
    assert [item.entity_refs[0] for item in stale] == ["prt_1"]
    # Bounded and closed kinds.
    assert w.scan_blocked_tasks("nope", current) == []
    with pytest.raises(w.WatcherRefusedError):
        w.scan_entities([{}], current, kind="nope",
                        stale_hours=1.0)

"""Mesh generation + validation tests (BIG #7).

Deterministic test geometry, unavailable provider honesty,
format sanity (ASCII/binary STL, OBJ), NaN/Inf/excessive
geometry refusal, printability assessments.
"""

import hashlib
import os
import struct

import pytest


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def isolated_fab_dir(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    """Each test gets its own fabrication dir: no cross-test
    file bleed through the shared temp directory."""
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "fab"))
from coordinator.app.mesh3d import (
    MeshRefusedError,
    MeshUnavailable,
    ProceduralTestGenerator,
    UnavailableGenerator,
    artifact_path,
    assess_printability,
    check_artifact_ref,
    fabrication_dir,
    file_payload_for_mesh,
    get_generator,
    read_artifact_bytes,
    validate_mesh,
)


def test_generator_is_deterministic_and_marked():
    first = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {})
    second = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {})
    assert first.sha256 == second.sha256
    assert first.test_origin is True
    assert "test-origin" in first.provenance.notes
    assert first.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert first.format == "stl-ascii"


def test_unavailable_generator_refuses():
    with pytest.raises(MeshUnavailable, match="no fake STL"):
        get_generator("unavailable").generate("x", {})
    with pytest.raises(MeshRefusedError, match="Unknown 3D"):
        get_generator("cloud-magic")


def test_valid_cube_report():
    generated = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {})
    report = validate_mesh(generated.artifact_ref)
    assert report.verdict == "valid"
    assert report.faces == 12
    assert report.vertices == 36
    assert report.bounds_mm == [-10.0, -10.0, -10.0,
                                10.0, 10.0, 10.0]
    assessment = assess_printability(report)
    assert assessment.verdict == "printable"
    assert not hasattr(assessment, "safe_to_print")


def test_printability_rejects_oversize():
    generated = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {})
    report = validate_mesh(generated.artifact_ref)
    assessment = assess_printability(
        report, build_volume_mm=(5.0, 5.0, 5.0))
    assert assessment.verdict == "not_printable"
    assert any("exceeds build" in reason
               for reason in assessment.reasons)


def test_printability_needs_valid_mesh():
    report = validate_mesh(
        ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("x", {}).artifact_ref)
    broken = report.model_copy(update={"verdict": "invalid",
                                       "reasons": ["bad"]})
    assert assess_printability(broken).verdict == "not_printable"
    unknown = report.model_copy(update={"verdict": "inconclusive",
                                        "reasons": ["?"]})
    assert assess_printability(unknown).verdict == "inconclusive"


def _write(name: str, data: bytes) -> str:
    path = os.path.join(fabrication_dir(), name)
    with open(path, "wb") as handle:
        handle.write(data)
    return name


def test_malformed_meshes_invalid():
    ref = _write("fab-bad1.stl", b"geen mesh maar tekst\n")
    assert validate_mesh(ref).verdict in ("invalid", "inconclusive")
    ref = _write("fab-bad2.stl", b"solid\nvertex x y z\n")
    assert validate_mesh(ref).verdict == "invalid"
    ref = _write("fab-bad3.obj", b"v 0 0\nf 1 2\n")
    assert validate_mesh(ref).verdict == "invalid"


def test_nan_inf_refused():
    ref = _write("fab-nan.stl",
                 b"solid t\nfacet normal 0 0 0\nouter loop\n"
                 b"vertex nan 0 0\nvertex 0 0 0\nvertex 0 1 0\n"
                 b"endloop\nendfacet\nendsolid t\n")
    assert validate_mesh(ref).verdict == "invalid"
    ref = _write("fab-inf.obj", b"v inf 0 0\nv 0 0 0\nv 0 1 0\n"
                 b"f 1 2 3\n")
    assert validate_mesh(ref).verdict == "invalid"


def test_binary_stl_parses():
    header = b"\x00" * 80
    facet = struct.pack("<12fH", 0, 0, 1,
                        0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0)
    data = header + struct.pack("<I", 1) + facet
    ref = _write("fab-bin.stl", data)
    report = validate_mesh(ref)
    assert report.verdict == "valid"
    assert report.format == "stl-binary"
    assert report.faces == 1


def test_truncated_binary_is_invalid():
    ref = _write("fab-trunc.stl", b"\x00" * 90)
    report = validate_mesh(ref)
    assert report.verdict in ("invalid", "inconclusive")


def test_artifact_boundaries():
    with pytest.raises(MeshRefusedError):
        check_artifact_ref("../buiten.stl")
    with pytest.raises(MeshRefusedError):
        check_artifact_ref("C:\\x\\y.stl")
    with pytest.raises(MeshRefusedError):
        check_artifact_ref("model.step")
    with pytest.raises(MeshRefusedError):
        read_artifact_bytes("fab-bestaat-niet.stl")
    assert artifact_path("fab-test-cube.stl").endswith(
        "fab-test-cube.stl")


def test_file_payload_for_mesh():
    report = validate_mesh(
        ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("x", {}).artifact_ref)
    payload = file_payload_for_mesh(
        report, "ab" * 32, 1823, "testkubus")
    assert payload["file_kind"] == "mesh"
    assert payload["sha256"] == "ab" * 32
    assert payload["metadata"]["validation"] == "valid"
    broken = report.model_copy(update={"verdict": "invalid"})
    with pytest.raises(MeshRefusedError, match="Invalid meshes"):
        file_payload_for_mesh(broken, "ab" * 32, 10, "x")
    assert hashlib.sha256(b"").hexdigest() != "ab" * 32

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_mission_dispatch.py">
"""H1 auto-dispatch: mission step -> queue task -> node -> receipt.

Approved/running missions with a dispatchable research step
(parameters.dispatch is True + explicit source_urls) stage
research.fetch_url queue tasks; the step becomes dispatched and
tick waits. Claim/complete/lease/ownership gates are untouched.
H3 (result -> step close-out) closes the step once every linked
task completed successfully (see tests/test_mission_closeout.py).

Real coordinator routes + tmp DBs throughout; no network (fetch
execution is never invoked — receipts are simulated by the
claiming worker, exactly like a node reporting back).
"""

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

TOKEN = "dispatch-token-abcdef-123456"
URL = "https://example.com/onderzoek"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "dispatch-queue.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "dispatch-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def make_conversation(client):
    return client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={
        "message": "dispatch keten", "project_ref": "dispatch-ws"}).json()[
        "conversation_id"]


def make_mission(client, conv, steps, max_steps=3):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
        "conversation_id": conv, "goal": "Dispatch keten",
        "steps": steps, "max_steps": max_steps})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()["mission_id"]


def research_step(dispatch=True):
    params = {"question": "Wat is mycelium?",
              "source_urls": [URL]}
    if dispatch:
        params["dispatch"] = True
    return {"kind": "research", "description": "haal bron op",
            "parameters": params}


def approve(client, mission_id):
    response = client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
                           json={"response": "YES"})
    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text


def mission_state(client, mission_id):
    return client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()


def tasks_for_mission(client, mission_id):
    return [row for row in client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()
            if row.get("mission_id") == mission_id]


def register_worker(client, node_id="worker-1"):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
        "node_id": node_id, "hostname": node_id, "tier": "worker",
        "capabilities": ["research.fetch"], "cpu_cores": 2,
        "memory_mb": 4000, "energy_source": "grid",
        "node_token": TOKEN})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text


def test_dispatch_happy_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client), [research_step()])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        response = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/dispatch",
            json={"step_id": step_id})
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        body = response.json()
        assert len(body["task_ids"]) == 1
        task_id = body["task_ids"][0]
        rows = tasks_for_mission(client, mission_id)
        assert len(rows) == 1
        task = rows[0]
        assert task["id"] == task_id
        assert task["status"] == "queued"
        assert task["kind"] == "research.fetch_url"
        assert task["payload"]["mission_step_id"] == step_id
        assert task["payload"]["url"] == URL
        assert "mycelium" in task["payload"]["question"].lower()
        state = mission_state(client, mission_id)
        assert state["steps"][0]["status"] == "dispatched"
        events = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/events").json()
        assert any(row.get("event_type") == "task_dispatched"
                   and row.get("step_id") == step_id
                   for row in events)


def test_dispatch_via_tick(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client), [research_step()])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        response = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        assert response.json()["outcome"] == "waiting"
        rows = tasks_for_mission(client, mission_id)
        assert len(rows) == 1
        assert rows[0]["payload"]["mission_step_id"] == step_id
        assert mission_state(client, mission_id)[
            "steps"][0]["status"] == "dispatched"


def test_dispatch_idempotent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client), [research_step()])

            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/dispatch",

def test_dispatch_full_queue_chain(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        register_worker(client)
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client), [research_step()])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        task_id = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/dispatch",
            json={"step_id": step_id}).json()["task_ids"][0]
        claimed = client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/worker-1",
            params={"node_token": TOKEN}).json()
        assert claimed["id"] == task_id
        # Simulated node receipt (no network fetch in tests).
        done = client.post(f"/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}/complete",
                           params={"node_id": "worker-1"}, json={
                               "success": True,
                               "result": {"url": URL, "chars": 128}})
        assert done.status_code == 204, done.text
        rows = {row["id"]: row
                for row in client.get("/api/v1/tasks").json()}
        assert rows[task_id]["status"] == "completed"
        # H3 close-out: a completed H1 task closes its step.
        state = mission_state(client, mission_id)
        assert state["steps"][0]["status"] == "completed"
        events = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/events").json()
        assert any(row.get("event_type") == "step_completed"
                   and row.get("step_id") == step_id
                   for row in events)
        assert state["status"] in ("approved", "running")


def test_dispatch_race_single_task(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        mission_id = make_mission(
            client, make_conversation(client), [research_step()])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        step_id = mission_state(
            client, mission_id)["steps"][0]["step_id"]
        first = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/dispatch",
            json={"step_id": step_id})
        second = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/dispatch",
            json={"step_id": step_id})
        assert first.status_code == 200, first.text
        assert second.status_code == 200, second.text
        assert second.json()["task_ids"] == first.json()["task_ids"]
        assert len(tasks_for_mission(client, mission_id)) == 1
        # The conditional mission save stays leading: a stale
        # expected state must refuse instead of overwriting.
        from coordinator.app.missions import (
            MissionConflictError,
            load_mission,
            save_mission,
        )
        mission = load_mission(mission_id)
        try:
            save_mission(mission, expected=("approved", 99))
        except MissionConflictError:
            refused = True
        else:
            refused = False
        assert refused

        mission_id = make_mission(client, make_conversation(client), [{

            "parameters": {"research_run_id": "res_nonexistent123"}}])
        approve(client, mission_id)
        response = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        # Inline runner attempted (missing run -> blocked), never
        # dispatched: no queue task, step not dispatched.
        assert tasks_for_mission(client, mission_id) == []
        assert mission_state(client, mission_id)[
            "steps"][0]["status"] != "dispatched"

"""Model-router tests: central defaults, fail-closed tool routing.

The router is a pure decision layer: no HTTP, no execution, no

routing refuse; the worker safety pin is reported, never replaced.
"""

from coordinator.app import model_router as router
from coordinator.app.model_router import (

    resolve_model,
)


def test_chat_routes_local_default():

    assert route.local is True
    assert route.operator_override is False


def test_research_routes_local_default():
    route = resolve_model("research")
    assert (route.provider, route.model) == ("ollama", "qwen3.5:4b")
    assert route.local is True

    # nothing is proven, so nothing is chosen.

                      explicit_model=None)

        resolve_model("tool_execution", explicit_model="")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_n8n.py">
"""BIG #17 tests: n8n integration plane.

Auth, envelope validation, idempotency, scheduler trigger,
outbox, Garmin readiness, and every safety negative:
no approve, no physical execution, no human_verified
escalation, no secrets crossing, no DB access for n8n.
"""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

OPERATOR_KEY = "op-key-n8n-tests-123"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "n8n.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "n8n-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", OPERATOR_KEY)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def issue_key(client, integration_id="generic",
              capabilities=None):
    body = {"operator_key": OPERATOR_KEY}
    if capabilities is not None:
        body["capabilities"] = capabilities
    response = client.post(
        f"/api/v1/integrations/{integration_id}/keys",
        json=body)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()["key"]


def envelope(**overrides):
    body = {
        "integration_id": "generic",
        "source": "generic",
        "external_event_id": "evt-1",
        "event_type": "memory.observation",
        "occurred_at": "2026-09-17T08:00:00+00:00",
        "payload": {"title": "n8n note",
                    "content": "imported observation"},
        "provenance": {"source_type": "external-source",
                       "creator_id": "n8n:generic",
                       "human_verified": False},
        "schema_version": "1",
        "idempotency_key": "key-1",
    }
    body.update(overrides)
    return body


def post_event(client, body, key="MISSING"):
    headers = {}
    if key != "MISSING":
        headers["X-Integration-Key"] = key
    return client.post("/api/v1/integrations/events",
                       json=body, headers=headers)


def test_key_issuance_needs_operator(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/generic/keys",
            json={}).status_code == 403
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/generic/keys",
            json={"operator_key": "wrong"}).status_code == 403
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/nope/keys",
            json={"operator_key": OPERATOR_KEY}
        ).status_code == 422
        issued = client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/generic/keys",
            json={"operator_key": OPERATOR_KEY}).json()
        assert len(issued["key"]) == 64
        assert "key_hash" not in str(issued)
        # Rotation replaces the old key.
        rotated = client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/generic/keys",
            json={"operator_key": OPERATOR_KEY}).json()
        assert rotated["key"] != issued["key"]
        assert post_event(client, envelope(),
                          key=issued["key"]).status_code == 403
        assert post_event(client, envelope(),
                          key=rotated["key"]
                          ).status_code == 201


def test_auth_and_capability_gates(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert post_event(client, envelope()).status_code == 401
        assert post_event(
            client, envelope(), key="wrong").status_code == 403
        ingest_only = issue_key(
            client, "garmin", ["integration:ingest"])
        # Ingest-only key cannot trigger jobs.
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/trigger",
            json={"integration_id": "garmin",
                  "job_name": "watcher_scan"},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": ingest_only}
        ).status_code == 403
        # Unknown integration refused.
        assert post_event(
            client, envelope(integration_id="nope"),
            key=ingest_only).status_code in (403, 422)


def test_envelope_validation_negatives(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        key = issue_key(client)
        cases = [
            # executable payload
            {"payload": {"command": "rm -rf /"}},
            {"payload": {"outer": {"exec": "x"}}},
            # secret-shaped payload never crosses
            {"payload": {"refresh_token": "abc"}},
            {"payload": {"api_key": "abc"}},
            # deeply nested
            {"payload": {"a": {"b": {"c": {"d": {"e": {
                "f": {"g": 1}}}}}}}},
            # oversized value
            {"payload": {"title": "t",
                         "content": "x" * 501}},
            # source spoofing
            {"source": "garmin"},
            # wrong event type for the integration
            {"event_type": "robot.execute"},
            {"event_type": "approval.grant"},
            # provenance escalation
            {"provenance": {
                "source_type": "external-source",
                "creator_id": "n8n:generic",
                "human_verified": True}},
            {"provenance": {
                "source_type": "user-created",
                "creator_id": "n8n:generic",
                "human_verified": False}},
            {"provenance": {
                "source_type": "external-source",
                "creator_id": "someone-else",
                "human_verified": False}},
            # bad schema / time
            {"schema_version": "99"},
            {"occurred_at": "not-a-time"},
        ]
        for index, override in enumerate(cases):
            body = envelope(
                **override,
                idempotency_key=f"neg-{index}")
            assert post_event(client, body,
                              key=key).status_code == 422, override
        # Missing idempotency is a schema 422.
        body = envelope()
        del body["idempotency_key"]
        assert post_event(client, body,
                          key=key).status_code == 422


def test_idempotency_duplicate_and_conflict(tmp_path,
                                            monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        key = issue_key(client)
        first = post_event(client, envelope(), key=key).json()
        assert first["outcome"] == "accepted"
        again = post_event(client, envelope(), key=key).json()
        assert again["outcome"] == "duplicate"
        # Repeated duplicates never collide with each other.
        third = post_event(client, envelope(), key=key).json()
        assert third["outcome"] == "duplicate"
        changed = envelope(payload={"title": "n8n note",
                                    "content": "CHANGED"})
        conflict = post_event(client, changed, key=key).json()
        assert conflict["outcome"] == "conflict"
        # Nothing was silently overwritten: the accepted
        # memory still holds the original content.
        memories = client.post("/api/v1/memory/retrieve",
                               json={"query": "n8n note",
                                     "memory_types": [
                                         "observation"]}
                               ).json()["results"]
        assert len(memories) == 1
        stored = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/memory/{memories[0]['memory_id']}").json()
        assert stored["content"] == "imported observation"
        # Ledger shows the full history.
        ledger = client.get(
            "/api/v1/integrations/events",
            params={"integration_id": "generic"},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}).json()
        assert {item["status"] for item in ledger} == {
            "received", "accepted", "duplicate", "conflict"}


def test_ledger_needs_auth(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert client.get(
            "/api/v1/integrations/events").status_code == 403
        assert client.get(
            "/api/v1/integrations/events",
            params={"integration_id": "generic"},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": "wrong"}
        ).status_code == 403


def test_scheduler_trigger_known_jobs_only(tmp_path,
                                           monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        key = issue_key(client, "generic",
                        ["integration:trigger"])
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/trigger",
            json={"integration_id": "generic"},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}
        ).status_code == 422
        assert client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/trigger",
            json={"integration_id": "generic",
                  "job_name": "run_anything",
                  "params": {"code": "x"}},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}
        ).status_code == 422
        ran = client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/trigger",
            json={"integration_id": "generic",
                  "job_name": "watcher_scan",
                  "run_key": "n8n-sched-1"},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}).json()
        assert ran["status"] == "completed"
        assert ran["summary"]["tasks_scanned"] >= 0
        # Idempotent under the same run key.
        again = client.post(
            "/api/v1/integrations/trigger",
            json={"integration_id": "generic",
                  "job_name": "watcher_scan",
                  "run_key": "n8n-sched-1"},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}).json()
        assert again["run_id"] == ran["run_id"]


def test_outbox_poll_model(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert client.post("/api/v1/integrations/outbox", json={
            "target_label": "notify",
            "payload": {"text": "hello"}}).status_code == 403
        # Non-allow-listed targets (URLs!) refuse.
        assert client.post("/api/v1/integrations/outbox", json={
            "target_label": "https://evil.example/hook",
            "payload": {"text": "x"},
            "operator_key": OPERATOR_KEY}).status_code == 422
        queued = client.post("/api/v1/integrations/outbox",
                             json={
                                 "target_label": "notify",
                                 "payload": {"text": "hello"},
                                 "operator_key": OPERATOR_KEY}).json()
        assert queued["status"] == "pending"
        key = issue_key(client, "generic",
                        ["integration:trigger"])
        pending = client.get("/api/v1/integrations/outbox",
                             params={"status": "pending",
                                     "integration_id": "generic"},
                             headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}
                             ).json()
        assert [item["outbox_id"] for item in pending] == [
            queued["outbox_id"]]
        acked = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/integrations/outbox/"
            f"{queued['outbox_id']}/ack",
            json={"integration_id": "generic"},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}).json()
        assert acked["status"] == "acked"
        assert acked["acked_by"] == "generic"
        # Double-ack is idempotent.
        assert client.post(
            f"/api/v1/integrations/outbox/"
            f"{queued['outbox_id']}/ack",
            json={"integration_id": "generic"},
            headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}).json()[
                "status"] == "acked"
        assert client.get("/api/v1/integrations/outbox",
                          params={"status": "pending",
                                  "integration_id": "generic"},
                          headers={"X-Integration-Key": key}
                          ).json() == []

def test_no_secrets_reach_storage(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

            chat_connection, init_chat_database)

            payload={"note": "x", "refresh_token": "sekret"},
            idempotency_key="sec-1"), key=key).status_code == 422
        init_chat_database()
        with chat_connection() as db:
            tables = [row["name"] for row in db.execute(
                "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type="
                "'table'")]
            blob = ""
            for table in tables:
                try:
                    rows = db.execute(
                        f"SELECT * FROM {table} LIMIT 200").fetchall()
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    continue
                blob += str([dict(row) for row in rows])
        assert "sekret" not in blob

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_nodes.py">
"""Node registry tests (BIG #8).

Identity, advertisement validation, token auth, freshness
status, disable/enable. Pure nodes.py behavior plus HTTP
register/heartbeat flows.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.nodes import (
    NodeAuthError,
    NodeRefusedError,
    authenticate,
    check_capabilities,
    check_compute_capabilities,
    check_energy_state,
    check_executors,
    check_hardware,
    check_locality,
    check_models,
    check_resources,
    check_telemetry,
    compute_node_health,
    derive_status,
    generate_token,
    hash_token,
    verify_token,
)


def test_token_lifecycle():
    token = generate_token()
    assert len(token) == 64
    stored = hash_token("node-1", token)
    assert stored != token
    assert len(stored) == 64
    assert verify_token("node-1", token, stored) is True
    assert verify_token("node-1", "wrong", stored) is False
    assert verify_token("node-2", token, stored) is False
    assert authenticate("node-1", None, None) == "legacy"
    assert authenticate("node-1", stored, token) == "token"
    with pytest.raises(NodeAuthError):
        authenticate("node-1", stored, "wrong")
    with pytest.raises(NodeAuthError):
        authenticate("node-1", stored, None)


def test_capabilities_closed():
    assert check_capabilities(["camera.snapshot"]) == [
        "camera.snapshot"]
    for bad in (["*"], ["camera.*"], ["rm -rf"], ["a b"],
                ["x" * 81], ["bad/slash"], ["semi;colon"]):
        with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
            check_capabilities(bad)
    with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
        check_capabilities("not-a-list")
    with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
        check_capabilities(["ok"] * 51)


def test_executors_namespaced():
    assert check_executors(["exec:desktop"]) == ["exec:desktop"]
    for bad in (["desktop"], ["exec:Desktop X"], ["exec:*"],
                ["shell.exec"]):
        with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
            check_executors(bad)


def test_models_validated():
    models = check_models([{
        "model_id": "mod_abc123", "display_name": "Qwen",
        "model_type": "llm", "capabilities": ["text.generate"],
        "provider": "ollama", "status": "available"}])
    assert models[0]["model_id"] == "mod_abc123"
    local = check_models([{"model_id": "model:sim-vlm",
                           "model_type": "vlm"}])
    assert local[0]["provider"] == "local"
    for bad in ([{"model_id": "qwen", "model_type": "llm"}],
                [{"model_id": "mod_x", "model_type": "agi"}],
                [{"model_id": "mod_x", "model_type": "llm",
                  "provider": "https://evil.example/model"}],
                [{"model_id": "mod_x", "model_type": "llm",
                  "api_key": "x"}],
                [{"model_id": "mod_x", "model_type": "llm",
                  "capabilities": ["*"]}],
                "not-a-list"):
        with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
            check_models(bad)


def test_resources_bounded_hints():
    resources = check_resources({"cpu_cores": 4, "memory_mb": 8000,
                                 "gpu_available": True,
                                 "energy_source": "solar",
                                 "energy_level": 80,
                                 "energy_priority": "high"})
    assert resources["energy_level"] == 80
    assert check_resources(None) == {}
    for bad in ({"energy_source": "coal"},
                {"energy_level": 101},
                {"energy_level": -1},
                {"energy_priority": "urgent"},
                {"cpu_cores": -2},
                {"gpu_available": "yes"},
                {"backdoor": 1},
                "not-a-dict"):
        with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
            check_resources(bad)


def test_locality_closed():
    assert check_locality("same_host") == "same_host"
    assert check_locality(None) == "local_network"
    with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
        check_locality("internet")


def test_derive_status():
    assert derive_status("disabled", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                         "2026-06-01T00:00:00+00:00") == "disabled"
    assert derive_status("online", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                         "2026-01-01T00:00:30+00:00") == "online"
    assert derive_status("online", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                         "2026-01-01T00:05:00+00:00") == "stale"
    assert derive_status("offline", "2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                         "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00") == "offline"
    assert derive_status("busy", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                         "2026-01-01T00:00:10+00:00") == "busy"
    assert derive_status("weird", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                         "2026-01-01T00:00:10+00:00") == "unknown"
    assert derive_status("online", "not-a-time",
                         "2026-01-01T00:00:10+00:00") == "stale"


# -- Telemetry validation (BIG #39 Hardware Reality Layer) --

def test_telemetry_valid():
    """Test valid telemetry payload."""
    telemetry = {
        "hostname": "test-node",
        "os": "Linux",
        "platform": "Linux-5.15.0",
        "cpu_percent": 45.5,
        "cpu_count": 8,
        "memory_percent": 60.0,
        "memory_total_mb": 16384,
        "memory_available_mb": 6554,
        "disk_percent": 40.0,
        "disk_total_gb": 500.0,
        "disk_free_gb": 300.0,
        "uptime_seconds": 3600,
        "temperature_celsius": 42.5,
        "load_average": [1.2, 1.5, 1.8],
        "network_interfaces": ["eth0", "wlan0"],
        "boot_time": 1700000000,
    }
    result = check_telemetry(telemetry)
    assert result["hostname"] == "test-node"
    assert result["cpu_percent"] == 45.5
    assert result["memory_percent"] == 60.0
    assert result["load_average"] == [1.2, 1.5, 1.8]
    assert result["network_interfaces"] == ["eth0", "wlan0"]


def test_telemetry_unknown_fields_refused():
    """Unknown telemetry fields are refused."""
    for bad in ({"unknown_field": 1}, {"cpu_percent": 10, "evil": "x"}):
        with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
            check_telemetry(bad)


def test_telemetry_bounds_enforced():
    """Telemetry numeric bounds are enforced."""
    for field, bad_value in [
        ("cpu_percent", -1),
        ("cpu_percent", 101),
        ("memory_percent", -5),
        ("memory_percent", 150),
        ("disk_percent", 101),
        ("temperature_celsius", -51),
        ("temperature_celsius", 151),
        ("memory_total_mb", -1),
        ("memory_total_mb", 10**10),
        ("uptime_seconds", -1),
    ]:
        with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
            check_telemetry({field: bad_value})


def test_telemetry_load_average_format():
    """Load average must be [1m, 5m, 15m] - exactly 3 elements."""
    assert check_telemetry({"load_average": [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]})["load_average"] == [1.0, 2.0, 3.0]
    # Length must be exactly 3
    for bad in ([1.0], [1.0, 2.0], [1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0], "not-a-list"):
        with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
            check_telemetry({"load_average": bad})
    # Non-numeric values are filtered out but original length must be 3
    result = check_telemetry({"load_average": [1.0, "bad", 3.0]})
    assert result["load_average"] == [1.0, 3.0]


def test_telemetry_network_interfaces():
    """Network interfaces must be a list, truncated to 20."""
    assert check_telemetry({"network_interfaces": ["eth0"]})["network_interfaces"] == ["eth0"]
    long_list = [f"if{i}" for i in range(25)]
    result = check_telemetry({"network_interfaces": long_list})
    assert len(result["network_interfaces"]) == 20  # truncated to 20 in validation
    with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
        check_telemetry({"network_interfaces": "not-a-list"})


def test_telemetry_string_fields():
    """String fields are stripped and bounded."""
    result = check_telemetry({"hostname": "  test-node  ", "os": "Linux", "platform": "x"})
    assert result["hostname"] == "test-node"
    long_str = "x" * 150
    result = check_telemetry({"hostname": long_str})
    assert len(result["hostname"]) == 120
    with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
        check_telemetry({"hostname": 123})


def test_telemetry_none_returns_empty():
    assert check_telemetry(None) == {}


def test_telemetry_not_dict_refused():
    with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
        check_telemetry("not-a-dict")


def test_telemetry_too_many_fields():
    fields = {f"field{i}": i for i in range(35)}
    # Need to include at least one valid field
    fields["cpu_percent"] = 50
    with pytest.raises(NodeRefusedError):
        check_telemetry(fields)

def test_compute_node_health_online():

    record = {
        "derived_status": "online",

        "telemetry": {"cpu_percent": 50},
        "hardware": [{"status": "connected"}],

        "energy_state": {"source": "grid", "level_percent": 100},

"""Tests for the M8.1 local Ollama advisor (read-only advice only).

Ollama is fully faked with httpx.MockTransport. No real model, no real
network, no filesystem writes, no database. Async calls run via asyncio.
"""
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path

import httpx
import pytest

from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import (
    DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    MAX_CONTEXT_LENGTH,
    MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH,
    MAX_RECORDS,
    MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
    OllamaAdvisor,
    OllamaRefusedError,
    OllamaUnavailable,
    TIMEOUT_ENV_VAR,
    build_prompt,
    redact_paths,
)


def run(coro):
    return asyncio.run(coro)


def record(entity_id="obj_1", title="Moer M8",
           snippet="rvs zeskant", entity_type="object"):
    return {"entity_type": entity_type, "entity_id": entity_id, "title": title,
            "snippet": snippet,
            "provenance": {"source_type": "user-created",
                           "creator_id": "tester", "human_verified": True}}


def advisor(handler, **kwargs):
    kwargs.setdefault("base_url", "http://127.0.0.1:11434")
    kwargs.setdefault("model", "test-model")
    return OllamaAdvisor(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler), **kwargs)


def ok_handler(expected=None):
    def handle(request):
        if expected is not None:
            expected.append(request)
        return httpx.Response(200, json={"response": "Gebruik de Moer M8."})
    return handle


# --- normal advice -----------------------------------------------------------------

def test_normal_advice():
    seen = []
    res = run(advisor(ok_handler(seen)).advise(
        "Wat kan ik maken?", [record(), record("proj_2", "Bouw", "plan",
                                                "project")]))
    assert res.advice == "Gebruik de Moer M8."
    assert res.question == "Wat kan ik maken?"
    assert res.model == "test-model"
    assert res.records_used == 2
    assert len(res.sources) == 2
    assert res.sources[0].entity_id == "obj_1"
    assert res.sources[0].human_verified is True
    assert len(seen) == 1
    assert seen[0].method == "POST"
    assert seen[0].url.path == "/api/generate"


def test_think_disabled_in_generate_payload():
    import json as _json

    seen = []
    res = run(advisor(ok_handler(seen)).advise("Wat kan ik maken?", [record()]))
    assert res.advice == "Gebruik de Moer M8."
    assert len(seen) == 1
    payload = _json.loads(seen[0].content.decode("utf-8"))
    assert payload["think"] is False
    assert payload["stream"] is False
    assert payload["model"] == "test-model"
    assert "prompt" in payload and "Wat kan ik maken?" in payload["prompt"]


def test_prompt_construction():
    prompt, sources = build_prompt("  Vraag?  ", [record()])
    assert "Vraag?" in prompt
    assert "Moer M8" in prompt
    assert "obj_1" in prompt
    assert len(sources) == 1
    assert build_prompt("Vraag?", [record()]) == build_prompt("Vraag?", [record()])


def test_question_length_cap():
    with pytest.raises(OllamaRefusedError):
        build_prompt("x" * (MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH + 1), [record()])
    with pytest.raises(OllamaRefusedError):
        build_prompt("   ", [record()])
    prompt, _ = build_prompt("x" * MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH, [record()])
    assert "x" * MAX_QUESTION_LENGTH in prompt


def test_context_caps():
    many = [record(f"obj_{i}", f"Ding {i}", "vulling") for i in range(50)]
    prompt, sources = build_prompt("Wat?", many)
    assert len(sources) == MAX_RECORDS
    assert len(prompt) <= MAX_CONTEXT_LENGTH + 1000
    assert "Ding 49" not in prompt


def test_path_redaction():
    text = "staat op C:\\Temp\\werkplaats en \\\\nas\\share map"
    assert "C:\\Temp" not in redact_paths(text)
    assert "\\\\nas" not in redact_paths(text)
    assert "[redacted-path]" in redact_paths(text)
    prompt, _ = build_prompt("Waar?", [record(snippet=text)])
    assert "C:\\Temp" not in prompt
    assert "[redacted-path]" in prompt


def test_provenance_in_context():
    prompt, sources = build_prompt("Wat?", [record()])
    assert "user-created" in prompt
    assert sources[0].source_type == "user-created"


# --- URL safety ----------------------------------------------------------------------

@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
    "http://example.com:11434", "http://192.168.1.5:11434/",
    "https://127.0.0.1:11434/", "http://127.0.0.1.evil.com/",
    "http://user@127.0.0.1:11434/", "file:///tmp/x", "", "notaurl",
])
def test_non_loopback_refused(url):
    def fail(request):  # pragma: no cover
        raise AssertionError("no HTTP must happen")
    with pytest.raises(OllamaRefusedError):
        OllamaAdvisor(base_url=url, model="m",
                      transport=httpx.MockTransport(fail))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
    "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "http://localhost:11434/", "http://[::1]:11434",
])
def test_loopback_accepted(url):
    def fail(request):  # pragma: no cover
        raise AssertionError("no HTTP must happen")
    OllamaAdvisor(base_url=url, model="m", transport=httpx.MockTransport(fail))


def test_redirects_refused():
    def redirect(request):
        return httpx.Response(302, headers={"location": "http://example.com/"})
    with pytest.raises(OllamaUnavailable):
        run(advisor(redirect).advise("Wat?", [record()]))
