"""Phase 5 tests (BIG #11-15): robots, drones, familiars, twin."""

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "p5.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "p5-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_robot_exact_yes_approval(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        # No wildcards, no custom capabilities.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/robots", json={
            "name": "X", "capabilities": ["robot.*"]}
        ).status_code == 422
        robot = test_client.post("/api/v1/robots", json={
            "name": "Arm-1", "robot_type": "robotic_arm",
            "capabilities": ["robot.move", "robot.observe",
                             "robot.status"],
            "location": "workshop"}).json()
        assert robot["robot_id"].startswith("rbt_")
        robot_id = robot["robot_id"]
        # Unowned capability refuses.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/propose",
            json={"action": "robot.grab",
                  "actor": "jelles"}).status_code == 422
        proposed = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/propose",
            json={"action": "robot.move",
                  "params": {"to": "shelf"},
                  "simulation_note": "path clear in model",
                  "actor": "jelles"}).json()
        assert proposed["status"] == "proposed"
        assert proposed["proposal"]["mutation_type"] == \
            "robot.execute"
        assert proposed["proposal"]["payload"]["physical"] is True
        assert proposed["fingerprint"]
        proposal_id = proposed["proposal"]["proposal_id"]
        # Non-YES answers deny; empty decider refuses.
        denied = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/approve",
            json={"proposal_id": proposal_id, "response": "no",
                  "decided_by": "jelles"}).json()
        assert denied["status"] == "rejected"
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/approve",
            json={"proposal_id": proposal_id, "response": "YES",
                  "decided_by": ""}).status_code == 422
        # Fresh proposal: exact YES approves.
        proposed2 = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/propose",
            json={"action": "robot.move", "actor": "jelles"}).json()
        proposal_id2 = proposed2["proposal"]["proposal_id"]
        approved = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/approve",
            json={"proposal_id": proposal_id2, "response": "YES",
                  "decided_by": "jelles"}).json()
        assert approved["status"] == "approved"
        # Lock the robot: physical approval now refuses even
        # with YES (live state rechecked, never client-trusted).
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/safety",
                         json={"safety_state": "locked"})
        proposed3 = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/propose",
            json={"action": "robot.move",
                  "actor": "jelles"}).json()
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/approve",
            json={"proposal_id": proposed3["proposal"][
                "proposal_id"], "response": "YES",
                  "decided_by": "jelles"}).status_code == 422
        # Generic execute path has no robot executor.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/writes/{proposal_id2}/execute"
        ).status_code == 422


def test_robot_verification_needs_stored_evidence(
        tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        robot = test_client.post("/api/v1/robots", json={
            "name": "Arm-2", "robot_type": "robotic_arm",
            "capabilities": ["robot.move"]}).json()
        robot_id = robot["robot_id"]
        proposed = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/propose",
            json={"action": "robot.move",
                  "actor": "jelles"}).json()
        action_id = proposed["proposal"]["proposal_id"]
        # Telemetry without cited evidence does not verify.
        pending = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/telemetry",
            json={"action_id": action_id,
                  "robot_id": robot_id,
                  "status": "completed"}).json()
        assert pending["verification"] is None
        # Free caller text is not evidence.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/telemetry",
            json={"action_id": action_id,
                  "robot_id": robot_id,
                  "status": "completed",
                  "observation_ref": "arm at shelf, trust me"}
        ).status_code == 422
        # Unknown record refs refuse too.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/telemetry",
            json={"action_id": action_id,
                  "robot_id": robot_id,
                  "status": "completed",
                  "observation_ref": "mem_missing"}).status_code == 422
        # A stored memory observation verifies.
        memory = test_client.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
            "memory_type": "observation",
            "title": "Arm at shelf",
            "content": "camera frame 12 shows arm at shelf",
            "truth": "observed"}).json()
        verified = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/robots/{robot_id}/telemetry",
            json={"action_id": action_id,
                  "robot_id": robot_id,
                  "status": "completed",
                  "observation_ref": memory["memory_id"]}).json()
        assert verified["verification"]["verdict"] == "verified"
        assert verified["verification"]["evidence"]["id"] == \
            memory["memory_id"]

"""Printer device + execution tests (BIG #7).

Registration, capability filtering, unavailable honesty,
simulated execution, cancel semantics, and the physical
approval gate: mission YES never starts the machine.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import (
    decide_write,
    request_write_approval,
    revalidate,
)
from coordinator.app.fab_flow import (
    PrintRefusedError,
    execute_print,
    propose_print,
)
from coordinator.app.mesh3d import ProceduralTestGenerator
from coordinator.app.printer3d import (
    PrinterRefusedError,
    PrinterUnavailable,
    SimulatedPrinterAdapter,
    UnavailablePrinterAdapter,
    adapter_capabilities,
    adapter_for_printer,
    clear_printers,
    get_printer,
    list_printers,
    new_job as make_job,
    new_printer,
    register_printer,
    unregister_printer,
)
from coordinator.app.slicer3d import (
    TestSlicer,
    check_slicer_request,
    validate_gcode,
)


def make_gcode() -> tuple[str, str]:
    mesh = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {}).artifact_ref
    request = check_slicer_request(mesh, "draft-pla", "prt-test1")
    result = TestSlicer().slice(request)
    return result.gcode_ref, result.sha256


def make_device(printer_id="prt-test1"):
    return new_printer(printer_id, "Testprinter",
                       ["printer.status", "printer.start",
                        "printer.cancel"])


def approved(proposal):
    return decide_write(request_write_approval(proposal), proposal,
                        "YES", decided_by="jelles")


def test_registration_and_prefix():
    device = make_device()
    assert device.printer_id == "prt-test1"
    assert device.status == "registered"
    with pytest.raises(PrinterRefusedError, match="prt-"):
        new_printer("printer-1", "X", [])
    with pytest.raises(PrinterRefusedError, match="hw_"):
        new_printer("prt-2", "X", [],
                    inventory_hardware_id="obj_x")
    twin = new_printer("prt-3", "X", [], inventory_hardware_id="hw_x")
    assert twin.inventory_hardware_id == "hw_x"
    with pytest.raises(PrinterRefusedError, match="Unknown printer"):
        new_printer("prt-4", "X", ["printer.fly"])


def test_capability_spoofing_filtered():
    adapter = SimulatedPrinterAdapter()
    caps = adapter_capabilities(adapter)
    assert "printer.start" in caps
    assert "printer.upload" in caps

    class Spoof(SimulatedPrinterAdapter):
        capabilities = ["printer.start", "printer.launch-missiles",
                        "exec:anything"]

    assert adapter_capabilities(Spoof()) == ["printer.start"]


def test_unavailable_printer_refuses():
    device = make_device()
    adapter = UnavailablePrinterAdapter()
    with pytest.raises(PrinterUnavailable,
                       match="refusing instead of moving"):
        adapter.execute(device, make_job(
            "pjob-1", "prt-test1", "fab-x.gcode", "0" * 64,
            "draft-pla", "t"))
    assert "reviewed" in UnavailablePrinterAdapter.requirements()


def test_registry():
    clear_printers()
    device = make_device()
    adapter = SimulatedPrinterAdapter()
    register_printer(device, adapter)
    assert get_printer("prt-test1") is device
    assert adapter_for_printer("prt-test1") is adapter
    assert len(list_printers()) == 1
    unregister_printer("prt-test1")
    assert get_printer("prt-test1") is None
    with pytest.raises(PrinterRefusedError):
        register_printer(object())
    clear_printers()


def test_simulated_execution_completes():
    gcode_ref, sha = make_gcode()
    device = make_device()
    adapter = SimulatedPrinterAdapter()
    job = make_job("pjob-sim1", "prt-test1", gcode_ref, sha,
                   "draft-pla", "tester")
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-print1", job, safety_verdict="safe",
                             actor="tester")
    assert proposal.mutation_type == "printer.execute"
    assert proposal.capability() == "printer.execute"
    assert proposal.provenance.human_verified is False
    result = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                           device=device, adapter=adapter,
                           safety_verdict="safe")
    assert result.outcome == "executed"
    assert result.after["print_result"]["status"] == "completed"
    assert result.after["print_result"]["gcode_sha256"] == sha
    assert result.provenance.human_verified is False


def test_unsafe_safety_never_proposes_nor_executes():
    gcode_ref, sha = make_gcode()
    job = make_job("pjob-unsafe", "prt-test1", gcode_ref, sha,
                   "draft-pla", "tester")
    with pytest.raises(PrintRefusedError, match="never becomes"):
        propose_print("wrt-unsafe", job, safety_verdict="unsafe",
                      actor="tester")
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-unsafe2", job,
                             safety_verdict="safe", actor="tester")
    device = make_device()
    blocked = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                            device=device,
                            adapter=SimulatedPrinterAdapter(),
                            safety_verdict="unsafe")
    assert blocked.outcome == "blocked"


def test_changed_gcode_blocked():
    gcode_ref, sha = make_gcode()
    job = make_job("pjob-change", "prt-test1", gcode_ref, sha,
                   "draft-pla", "tester")
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-change", job,
                             safety_verdict="safe", actor="tester")
    approval = approved(proposal)
    # Tamper with the stored artifact after approval.
    import os
    from coordinator.app.mesh3d import artifact_path
    with open(artifact_path(gcode_ref), "a",
              encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write("G1 X999\n")
    device = make_device()
    blocked = execute_print(proposal, approval, device=device,
                            adapter=SimulatedPrinterAdapter(),
                            safety_verdict="safe")
    assert blocked.outcome == "blocked"
    assert "fingerprint mismatch" in blocked.error


def test_no_adapter_blocked_not_failed():
    gcode_ref, sha = make_gcode()
    job = make_job("pjob-noad", "prt-test1", gcode_ref, sha,
                   "draft-pla", "tester")
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-noad", job, safety_verdict="safe",
                             actor="tester")
    blocked = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                            device=make_device(), adapter=None,
                            safety_verdict="safe")
    assert blocked.outcome == "blocked"
    assert "no printer adapter" in blocked.error


def test_mission_yes_never_starts_machine():
    """A rejected (non-approved) proposal refuses at revalidation:
    plan-level approval lives elsewhere and cannot substitute."""
    gcode_ref, sha = make_gcode()
    job = make_job("pjob-noperm", "prt-test1", gcode_ref, sha,
                   "draft-pla", "tester")
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-noperm", job,
                             safety_verdict="safe", actor="tester")
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    rejected = decide_write(request, proposal, "NO")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Only an approved"):
        revalidate(proposal, rejected)


def test_cancel_semantics():
    device = make_device()
    adapter = SimulatedPrinterAdapter()
    adapter.request_cancel("pjob-cancel1")
    job = make_job("pjob-cancel1", "prt-test1", "fab-x.gcode",
                   "0" * 64, "draft-pla", "tester")
    cancelled = adapter.cancel(device, job)
    assert cancelled.status == "cancelled"
    assert "NOT a physical emergency stop" in (
        cancelled.error + cancelled.estop_note)


def test_simulated_failure_is_failed():
    gcode_ref, sha = make_gcode()
    job = make_job("pjob-fail", "prt-test1", gcode_ref, sha,
                   "draft-pla", "tester")
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-fail", job, safety_verdict="safe",
                             actor="tester")
    result = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                           device=make_device(),
                           adapter=SimulatedPrinterAdapter(fail=True),
                           safety_verdict="safe")
    assert result.outcome == "failed"
    assert "simulated" in result.error


# -- runtime connect (operator-triggered adapter attach) -------------------

BAMBU_ENV_KEYS = ("BAMBU_MQTT_HOST", "BAMBU_MQTT_PORT",
                  "BAMBU_MQTT_USERNAME", "BAMBU_MQTT_ACCESS_CODE",
                  "BAMBU_PRINTER_SERIAL")

FAKE_REPORT = {"print": {"gcode_state": "IDLE",
                         "gcode_file": "moon.gcode.3mf",
                         "subtask_name": "moon",
                         "nozzle_temper": 24.0,
                         "bed_temper": 22.0,
                         "mc_percent": 0,
                         "mc_remaining_time": 0,
                         "layer_num": 0,
                         "total_layer_num": 100,
                         "print_error": 0}}


class FakeBambuClient:
    """Fake paho client: connects, then delivers one canned
    report through the real adapter callbacks. ``publish`` explodes:
    the connect path must never move hardware."""

    def __init__(self, serial="TESTSERIAL", silent=False):
        import threading as _threading
        self.serial = serial
        self.silent = silent
        self.calls: list = []
        self.published: list = []
        self.on_connect = None
        self.on_disconnect = None
        self.on_message = None
        self._threading = _threading

    def username_pw_set(self, username, password):
        self.calls.append(("auth", username))

    def tls_set(self, **kwargs):
        self.calls.append(("tls", sorted(kwargs)))

    def subscribe(self, topic):
        self.calls.append(("subscribe", topic))
        return (0, 0)

    def connect_async(self, host, port, keepalive=60):
        self.calls.append(("connect", host, port))

    def loop_start(self):
        def _fire():
            import time as _time
            _time.sleep(0.05)
            if self.on_connect is not None:
                self.on_connect(self, None, None, 0)
            if not self.silent and self.on_message is not None:
                import json as _json
                msg = type("Msg", (), {
                    "topic": f"device/{self.serial}/report",
                    "payload": _json.dumps(
                        FAKE_REPORT).encode()})()
                self.on_message(self, None, msg)
        self._threading.Thread(target=_fire, daemon=True).start()

    def loop_stop(self):
        self.calls.append(("loop_stop",))

    def disconnect(self):
        self.calls.append(("disconnect",))

    def publish(self, *args, **kwargs):
        self.published.append((args, kwargs))
        raise AssertionError("motion publish during connect")


def _set_bambu_env(monkeypatch, **overrides):
    for key in BAMBU_ENV_KEYS:
        monkeypatch.delenv(key, raising=False)
    base = {"BAMBU_MQTT_HOST": "192.168.1.50",
            "BAMBU_MQTT_PORT": "8883",
            "BAMBU_MQTT_ACCESS_CODE": "fake-code-123",
            "BAMBU_PRINTER_SERIAL": "TESTSERIAL"}
    base.update(overrides)
    for key, value in base.items():
        if value is not None:
            monkeypatch.setenv(key, value)


def _conn_device(printer_id="prt-conn1"):
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import new_printer
    return new_printer(printer_id, "Connprinter",
                       ["printer.status", "printer.telemetry",
                        "printer.start"])


def test_connect_attaches_adapter_on_valid_telemetry(monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import (
        BambuPrinterAdapter,
        adapter_for_printer,
        connect_printer,
        register_printer,
        unregister_printer,
    )
    _set_bambu_env(monkeypatch)
    device = _conn_device()
    register_printer(device)
    try:
        result = connect_printer(
            "prt-conn1", timeout=5,
            client_factory=lambda: FakeBambuClient())
        assert result["reachable"] is True
        assert result["adapter"] == "bambu-a1-mini-ams"
        assert result["state"] == "idle"
        adapter = adapter_for_printer("prt-conn1")
        assert isinstance(adapter, BambuPrinterAdapter)
        # Fresh adapter, never connected: the check used its own
        # short-lived session (disconnected in finally).
        assert adapter.is_connected is False
    finally:
        unregister_printer("prt-conn1")

def test_connect_causes_no_motion(monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app import bambu_exec as exec_mod
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import (
        BambuPrinterAdapter,
        adapter_for_printer,
        connect_printer,
        register_printer,
        unregister_printer,
    )
    _set_bambu_env(monkeypatch)
    calls: list = []

    def _boom(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append((args, kwargs))
        raise AssertionError("motion path reached during connect")

    monkeypatch.setattr(exec_mod, "execute_bambu_job", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exec_mod, "ftps_upload", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exec_mod, "publish_request", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(BambuPrinterAdapter, "execute", _boom)
    register_printer(_conn_device("prt-conn4"))
    try:
        result = connect_printer(
            "prt-conn4", timeout=5,
            client_factory=lambda: FakeBambuClient())
        assert result["reachable"] is True
        assert calls == []
        assert isinstance(adapter_for_printer("prt-conn4"),
                          BambuPrinterAdapter)
    finally:
        unregister_printer("prt-conn4")


def test_connect_registry_empty_after_restart(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import (
        adapter_for_printer,
        clear_printers,
        connect_printer,
        get_printer,
        load_printer,
        register_printer,
        save_printer,
    )
    _set_bambu_env(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "conn-chat.db"))
    clear_printers()
    assert adapter_for_printer("prt-conn5") is None
    device = _conn_device("prt-conn5")
    save_printer(device)
    # Stored twin carries the device, never an adapter.
    assert load_printer("prt-conn5") is not None
    assert adapter_for_printer("prt-conn5") is None
    result = connect_printer(
        "prt-conn5", timeout=5,
        client_factory=lambda: FakeBambuClient())
    assert result["reachable"] is True
    # "Restart": in-memory registry is empty again.
    clear_printers()
    assert get_printer("prt-conn5") is None
    assert adapter_for_printer("prt-conn5") is None

def test_ams_slot_loaded_helper():

class FakeSessionAdapter(SimulatedPrinterAdapter):
    """Session adapter with canned telemetry. Records motion."""

    capabilities = ["printer.status", "printer.telemetry",
                    "printer.upload", "printer.start",
                    "printer.stop", "printer.cancel"]

    def __init__(self, live):
        super().__init__()
        self._live = dict(live or {})
        self.is_connected = True
        self.executions: list = []

    def _live_status(self):
        return dict(self._live)

    def execute(self, device, job):
        self.executions.append(job.job_id)
        return self._result(device, job, "completed")


def _slotted_job(slot="AMS-1"):
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import new_job
    gcode_ref, sha = make_gcode()
    return new_job("pjob-slot", "prt-test1", gcode_ref, sha,
                   "draft-pla", "tester", spool_id="spl-x",
                   slot=slot)


def test_execute_refuses_unloaded_slot():
    live = {"trays_loaded": [False, False, False, False]}
    adapter = FakeSessionAdapter(live)
    job = _slotted_job()
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-slot1", job,
                             safety_verdict="safe", actor="tester")
    result = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                           device=make_device(),
                           adapter=adapter, safety_verdict="safe")
    assert result.outcome == "failed"
    assert "not loaded" in result.error
    assert adapter.executions == []


def test_execute_refuses_unknown_tray_state():
    adapter = FakeSessionAdapter({})
    job = _slotted_job()
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-slot2", job,
                             safety_verdict="safe", actor="tester")
    result = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                           device=make_device(),
                           adapter=adapter, safety_verdict="safe")
    assert result.outcome == "failed"
    assert adapter.executions == []


def test_execute_proceeds_loaded_slot():
    live = {"trays_loaded": [True, False, False, False]}
    adapter = FakeSessionAdapter(live)
    job = _slotted_job()
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-slot3", job,
                             safety_verdict="safe", actor="tester")
    result = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                           device=make_device(),
                           adapter=adapter, safety_verdict="safe")
    assert result.outcome == "executed"
    assert adapter.executions == ["pjob-slot"]


def test_execute_without_slot_unchanged():
    adapter = FakeSessionAdapter({})
    gcode_ref, sha = make_gcode()
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import new_job
    job = new_job("pjob-noslot", "prt-test1", gcode_ref, sha,
                  "draft-pla", "tester")
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-slot4", job,
                             safety_verdict="safe", actor="tester")
    result = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                           device=make_device(),
                           adapter=adapter, safety_verdict="safe")
    assert result.outcome == "executed"


def test_execute_waits_for_partial_push_trays():
    """First pushes may lack the AMS node; the gate waits
    boundedly instead of judging one partial push."""

    class _Scripted(FakeSessionAdapter):
        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__({})
            self._reads = [{}, {},
                           {"trays_loaded": [True, False]}]
            self.waits = 0

        def _live_status(self):
            if len(self._reads) > 1:
                return self._reads.pop(0)
            return dict(self._reads[0])

        def wait_for_push(self, timeout=None):
            self.waits += 1
            return True

    adapter = _Scripted()
    job = _slotted_job()
    proposal = propose_print("wrt-slot5", job,
                             safety_verdict="safe", actor="tester")
    result = execute_print(proposal, approved(proposal),
                           device=make_device(),
                           adapter=adapter, safety_verdict="safe")
    assert result.outcome == "executed"
    assert adapter.waits >= 1
    assert adapter.executions == ["pjob-slot"]

"""Tests for M7.1 staged to queued promotion gate (decision + one UPDATE).

Coordinator database is always a tmp database via MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH.
Promotion flips exactly one staged row to queued; every other situation
fails closed with the row untouched.
"""
import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from coordinator.app.adapters import ReferenceNoopAdapter
from coordinator.app.adapter_contracts import AdapterRequest
from coordinator.app.approval import approve, decide, reject, request_approval
from coordinator.app.promotion import (
    PromotionAudit,
    PromotionRequest,
    promote,
    staged_fingerprint,
)
from coordinator.app.proposal_tasks import proposal_fingerprint, proposal_to_task
from coordinator.app.task_queue_bridge import STAGED_KIND, STAGED_STATUS, stage_task

PROV = {"source_type": "user-created", "creator_id": "tester",
        "human_verified": True}
MODEL = {"model_id": "mod_cam", "model_type": "vision",
         "capabilities": ["ocr"]}
REQUIRED = ["ocr"]
SNAPSHOT = ["ocr"]


@pytest.fixture()
def isolated_db(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH", str(tmp_path / "m71.db"))
    from coordinator.app.database import init_database
    init_database()
    return str(tmp_path / "m71.db")


def make_chain():
    adapter = ReferenceNoopAdapter()
    request = AdapterRequest(request_id="req-71", adapter_id="reference-noop",
                             model_id="mod_cam", node_id="node-7",
                             task_id="task_71",
                             input={"object_id": "obj_1"},
                             provenance=dict(PROV))
    proposal = adapter.propose(request)
    approval = approve(request_approval(proposal), proposal)
    task = proposal_to_task(proposal, approval,
                            approved_fingerprint=proposal_fingerprint(proposal),
                            task_type="inspect")
    return proposal, approval, task


def register_node(node_id="node-7", capabilities=("ocr",)):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection, dump
    with connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            """INSERT INTO nodes
            (node_id, hostname, tier, capabilities, cpu_cores,
             memory_mb, energy_source, last_seen, status)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'online')""",
            (node_id, "host", "worker", dump(list(capabilities)), 2, 1024,
             "solar", "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"))


def stage(task):
    return stage_task(task)


def make_promotion_request(staged, task, node_id="node-7"):
    task_data = task.model_dump(mode="json")
    return PromotionRequest(
        promotion_request_id="promo-1",
        staging_key=f"{task.proposal_id}:{task.request_id}:{task.proposal_fingerprint}",
        queue_id=staged.queue_id,
        proposal_fingerprint=task.proposal_fingerprint,
        staged_fingerprint=staged_fingerprint(task_data),
        selected_node_id=node_id,
        required_capabilities=list(REQUIRED),
        model=dict(MODEL),
        adapter_id="reference-noop",
        capability_snapshot=list(SNAPSHOT),
    )


def fresh_approval(proposal):
    return approve(request_approval(proposal), proposal, decided_by="operator")


def setup(isolated_db):
    proposal, _, task = make_chain()
    register_node()
    staged = stage(task)
    approval = fresh_approval(proposal)
    request = make_promotion_request(staged, task)
    return proposal, approval, task, staged, request


def row(queue_id):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    with connection() as db:
        return db.execute("SELECT * FROM tasks WHERE id=?",
                          (queue_id,)).fetchone()


# --- happy path ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_valid_promotion(isolated_db):
    proposal, approval, task, staged, request = setup(isolated_db)
    audit = promote(request, approval)
    assert isinstance(audit, PromotionAudit)
    assert audit.result == "queued"
    assert audit.promotion_request_id == "promo-1"
    assert audit.staging_key == request.staging_key
    assert audit.queue_id == staged.queue_id
    assert audit.original_fingerprint == task.proposal_fingerprint
    assert audit.current_fingerprint == request.staged_fingerprint
    assert audit.selected_node_id == "node-7"
    assert audit.capability_snapshot == ["ocr"]
    assert audit.approval == approval
    assert audit.provenance.human_verified is False
    stored = row(staged.queue_id)
    assert stored["status"] == "queued"
    assert stored["kind"] == STAGED_KIND


# --- refusals -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        promote(request, denied)
    denied = decide(request_approval(proposal), proposal, "NO")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        promote(request, denied)
    assert row(staged.queue_id)["status"] == STAGED_STATUS

def _raw_row(status, kind="staged-proposal"):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection, dump
    with connection() as db:
        cursor = db.execute(
            """INSERT INTO tasks (kind,payload,required_capabilities,preferred_tier,priority,status,created_at)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)""",
            (kind, dump({"staging_key": "other:other:" + "0" * 64}),
             dump([]), None, 0, status, "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"))
        return cursor.lastrowid

        required_capabilities=[], model=dict(MODEL),
        adapter_id="reference-noop", capability_snapshot=list(SNAPSHOT))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        promote(request, approval)
    assert row(queue_id)["status"] == status

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_proposal_tasks.py">
"""Tests for M6.4 approved-proposal to task translation (data only).

No network, no subprocess, no filesystem writes, no database, no hardware.
Translation is pure: identical inputs always yield identical tasks.
"""
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from coordinator.app.adapters import ReferenceNoopAdapter
from coordinator.app.adapter_contracts import AdapterRequest
from coordinator.app.approval import approve, decide, reject, request_approval
from coordinator.app.proposal_tasks import (
    CoordinatorTask,
    proposal_fingerprint,
    proposal_to_task,
)

PROV = {"source_type": "user-created", "creator_id": "tester",
        "human_verified": True}


def make_proposal(request_id="req-9"):
    adapter = ReferenceNoopAdapter()
    request = AdapterRequest(request_id=request_id, adapter_id="reference-noop",
                             model_id="mod_cam", node_id="node-1",
                             task_id="task_3",
                             input={"object_id": "obj_1"},
                             provenance=dict(PROV))
    return adapter.propose(request)


def make_approved(proposal=None):
    proposal = proposal if proposal is not None else make_proposal()
    approval_request = request_approval(proposal)
    approval = approve(approval_request, proposal, decided_by="jelles")
    return proposal, approval, proposal_fingerprint(proposal)


def translate(proposal=None, approval=None, fingerprint=None, **kwargs):
    proposal = proposal if proposal is not None else make_proposal()
    if approval is None or fingerprint is None:
        _, auto_approval, auto_fp = make_approved(proposal)
        approval = approval if approval is not None else auto_approval
        fingerprint = fingerprint if fingerprint is not None else auto_fp
    return proposal_to_task(proposal, approval, approved_fingerprint=fingerprint,
                            **kwargs)


# --- happy path --------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_valid_approved_proposal_translates():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    task = translate(proposal, approval, fingerprint,
                     task_type="inspect", input={"object_id": "obj_1"})
    assert isinstance(task, CoordinatorTask)
    assert task.status == "approved"
    assert task.proposal_id == proposal.proposal_id
    assert task.request_id == proposal.request_id
    assert task.model_id == "mod_cam"
    assert task.adapter_id == "reference-noop"
    assert task.node_id == "node-1"
    assert task.task_type == "inspect"
    assert task.input == {"object_id": "obj_1"}
    assert task.expected_output == proposal.expected_output
    assert task.approval_reference == approval
    assert task.proposal_fingerprint == fingerprint
    assert task.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert task.provenance.source_type == "ai-generated"


def test_default_task_id_derived_deterministically():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    first = translate(proposal, approval, fingerprint)
    second = translate(proposal, approval, fingerprint)
    assert first == second
    assert first.task_id == f"ctask-{proposal.proposal_id}"


# --- refusals ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_unapproved_proposal_refused():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(proposal, None, "x" * 64)


def test_rejected_approval_refused():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    approval_request = request_approval(proposal)
    denied = reject(approval_request, proposal)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(proposal, denied, proposal_fingerprint(proposal))


def test_decide_no_refused():
    proposal = make_proposal()
    approval_request = request_approval(proposal)
    denied = decide(approval_request, proposal, "NO")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(proposal, denied, proposal_fingerprint(proposal))


def test_proposal_id_mismatch_refused():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    other = make_proposal(request_id="req-other")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(other, approval, fingerprint)


def test_request_id_mismatch_refused():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    tampered = approval.model_copy(update={"request_id": "req-other"})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(proposal, tampered, fingerprint)


def test_requires_approval_false_refused():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    stripped = proposal.model_copy(update={"requires_approval": False})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(stripped, approval, proposal_fingerprint(stripped))


def test_verified_bypass_refused():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    faked = proposal.model_copy(update={"provenance": {
        "source_type": "ai-generated", "creator_id": "adapter:x",
        "human_verified": True}})
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(faked, approval, proposal_fingerprint(faked))


def test_modified_proposal_after_approval_refused():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    altered = proposal.model_copy(
        update={"proposed_action": "Do something entirely different"})
    assert proposal_fingerprint(altered) != fingerprint
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(altered, approval, fingerprint)


def test_wrong_fingerprint_refused():
    proposal, approval, _ = make_approved()
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        translate(proposal, approval, "0" * 64)


# --- preservation ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_fields_preserved():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    task = translate(proposal, approval, fingerprint, input={"k": "v"})
    assert task.model_id == proposal.model_id
    assert task.adapter_id == proposal.adapter_id
    assert task.node_id == proposal.node_id
    assert task.input == {"k": "v"}
    assert task.expected_output == proposal.expected_output
    assert task.approval_reference.proposal_id == proposal.proposal_id
    assert task.approval_reference.decided_by == "jelles"


def test_translation_marks_nothing_verified_or_done():
    proposal, approval, fingerprint = make_approved()
    task = translate(proposal, approval, fingerprint)
    assert task.status == "approved"
    assert task.provenance.human_verified is False
    dump = task.model_dump()
    assert dump["status"] == "approved"
    for forbidden in ("completed", "executed", "success"):
        assert forbidden not in str(dump.get("status"))

                       str(tmp_path / "p3.db"))

def test_research_source_pipeline_and_dedup(tmp_path,
                                            monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/research/sources",
                                json={"source_type": "nope",
                                      "title": "X"}).status_code == 422
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/research/sources",
                                   json={
                                       "source_type": "web",
                                       "title": "Oat milk protein",
                                       "content": "Oat milk has "
                                                  "about 1g protein "
                                                  "per 100ml.",
                                       "reference": "https://example.invalid/oats",
                                       "topics": ["vegan-food"]}
                                   ).json()
        assert created["source_id"].startswith("src_")
        assert created["status"] == "extracted"
        assert created["stored"] is True
        # Same content dedups.
        again = test_client.post("/api/v1/research/sources",
                                 json={
                                     "source_type": "web",
                                     "title": "Oat milk protein",
                                     "content": "Oat milk has "
                                                "about 1g protein "
                                                "per 100ml."}).json()
        assert again["duplicate"] is True
        # Stages advance one step, approval needs a human.
        source_id = created["source_id"]
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/research/sources/{source_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "stored"}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/research/sources/{source_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "proposed"}).json()[
                "status"] == "proposed"
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/research/sources/{source_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "approved",
                  "approved_by": ""}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/research/sources/{source_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "approved",
                  "approved_by": "jelles"}).json()[
                      "status"] == "approved"


def test_research_claims_must_cite_sources(tmp_path,
                                           monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        source = test_client.post("/api/v1/research/sources",
                                  json={
                                      "source_type": "document",
                                      "title": "Spool notes",
                                      "content": "PLA prints at "
                                                 "200C."}).json()
        # Uncited claim refuses (min_length=1 on source_ids
        # already 422s; unknown source refuses too).
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/research/records",
                                json={
                                    "question": "At what temp?",
                                    "claims": [{
                                        "claim": "200C",
                                        "source_ids": [
                                            "src_missing"],
                                        "evidence": "?"}]}
                                ).status_code == 422
        record = test_client.post("/api/v1/research/records",
                                  json={
                                      "question": "At what temp "
                                                  "to print PLA?",
                                      "claims": [{
                                          "claim": "PLA prints "
                                                   "around 200C",
                                          "source_ids": [
                                              source["source_id"]],
                                          "evidence": "spool "
                                                      "notes state "
                                                      "200C",
                                          "confidence": 0.7,
                                          "interpretation":
                                          "single source; verify "
                                          "per spool"}],
                                      "synthesis": "Start at 200C "
                                                   "per one note; "
                                                   "unverified."}
                                  ).json()
        assert record["record_id"].startswith("rsch_")
        fetched = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/research/records/{record['record_id']}").json()
        assert fetched["question"].startswith("At what temp")
        assert fetched["claims"][0]["source_ids"] == [
            source["source_id"]]


def test_instagram_manual_export_only(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        status = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/integrations/instagram/status").json()
        assert status["state"] == "UNAVAILABLE"
        # No live URLs, no scraped links.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/ingest/instagram",
                                json={
                                    "export": {"export_kind": "live",
                                               "items": []}}
                                ).status_code == 422
        mock = mock_instagram_export(3)
        assert mock["mock"] is True
        result = test_client.post("/api/v1/ingest/instagram",
                                  json={"export": mock,
                                        "collection": "vegan-food"}
                                  ).json()
        assert result["received"] == 3
        assert result["stored"] == 3
        refs = [item["reference"] for item in
                result["sources"]]
        creators = {item["provenance"]["creator_id"]
                    for item in result["sources"]}
        # Mock stays visibly mock down to storage.
        assert all(ref.startswith("mock:") for ref in refs)
        assert creators == {"instagram:mock"}
        # Re-ingest dedups on content hash.
        again = test_client.post("/api/v1/ingest/instagram",
                                 json={"export": mock}).json()
        assert again["stored"] == 0
        assert again["duplicates"] == 3
        listed = test_client.get("/api/v1/research/sources",
                                 params={
                                     "source_type": "instagram"}).json()
        assert len(listed) == 3
        # A genuine manual export keeps its honest label.
        real = test_client.post("/api/v1/ingest/instagram",
                                json={
                                    "export": {
                                        "export_kind":
                                        "manual_export",
                                        "items": [{
                                            "id": "saved-1",
                                            "title": "Saved reel",
                                            "author": "creator",
                                            "collection":
                                            "3d-printing",
                                            "caption": "bracket "
                                                       "idea",
                                            "topics": [
                                                "3d-printing"]}]},
                                    "collection": "3d-printing"}
                                ).json()
        assert real["stored"] == 1
        assert real["sources"][0][
            "reference"].startswith("manual-export:")
        assert real["sources"][0]["provenance"][
            "creator_id"] == "instagram:manual-export"


def test_skills_candidate_evidence_progression(tmp_path,
                                               monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        # Discovery finds candidates, creates no skills.
        found = test_client.post("/api/v1/skills/discover",
                                 json={
                                     "project_text":
                                     "3D printed robotic arm "
                                     "with CAD bracket, Python "
                                     "control and slicer tuning",
                                     "project_ref": "proj_arm"}).json()
        names = {item["name"] for item in
                 found["candidates"]}
        assert {"CAD", "robotics", "Python",
                "slicer configuration"} <= names
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/skills").json() == []
        candidate_id = found["candidates"][0]["candidate_id"]
        # Accept needs a human; creates interested skill.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/candidates/{candidate_id}/accept",
            json={"accepted_by": ""}).status_code == 422
        skill = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/candidates/{candidate_id}/accept",
            json={"accepted_by": "jelles"}).json()
        assert skill["stage"] == "interested"
        skill_id = skill["skill_id"]
        # applied needs evidence; top stages need 2 + human.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "learning"}).json()[
                "stage"] == "learning"
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "practicing"}).json()[
                "stage"] == "practicing"
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "applied"}).status_code == 422
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/evidence",
                         json={"kind": "project",
                               "ref": "proj_arm",
                               "note": "bracket printed"})
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "applied"}).json()[
                "stage"] == "applied"
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "demonstrated",
                  "confirmed_by": "jelles"}).status_code == 422
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/evidence",
                         json={"kind": "print",
                               "ref": "fab_1",
                               "note": "arm assembled"})
        demo = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "demonstrated",
                  "confirmed_by": "jelles"}).json()
        assert demo["stage"] == "demonstrated"
        # No skipping, no going back.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/skills/{skill_id}/advance",
            json={"to_stage": "learning"}).status_code == 422

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_routing.py">
"""Routing engine tests (BIG #8).

Deterministic selection, eligibility gates, explanations,
energy-as-preference, locality, model-type routing. Scheduling
logic only — never model-quality ranking.
"""

import pytest

from coordinator.app.routing import (
    RouteDecision,
    check_policy,
    check_requirements,
    requirements_from_payload,
    route_task,
)


def node(node_id, **overrides):
    record = {
        "node_id": node_id,
        "capabilities": [],
        "models": [],
        "executors": [],
        "resources": {},
        "locality_zone": "local_network",
        "status": "online",
        "fresh": True,
        "authenticated": True,
    }
    record.update(overrides)
    return record


def req(**overrides):
    base = {"required_capabilities": []}
    base.update(overrides)
    return check_requirements(base)


def test_selects_capable_node_with_reasons():
    nodes = [
        node("node_cpu", capabilities=["exec:system_inventory"]),
        node("node_vision",
             capabilities=["camera.snapshot", "vision.describe"]),
    ]
    decision = route_task(
        req(required_capabilities=["vision.describe"]), nodes)
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_vision"
    assert decision.eligible_nodes == ["node_vision"]
    assert decision.rejected[0].node_id == "node_cpu"
    assert any("missing vision.describe" in reason
               for reason in decision.rejected[0].reasons)
    assert any("node_vision" in reason
               for reason in decision.reasons)
    assert decision.decided_at != ""


def test_deterministic_tie_break_by_node_id():
    nodes = [node("node_b", capabilities=["x.y"]),
             node("node_a", capabilities=["x.y"])]
    first = route_task(req(required_capabilities=["x.y"]), nodes)
    second = route_task(req(required_capabilities=["x.y"]),
                        list(reversed(nodes)))
    assert first.selected_node_id == "node_a"
    assert second.selected_node_id == "node_a"


def test_no_eligible_node_explains():
    decision = route_task(req(required_capabilities=["nope"]),
                          [node("n1")])
    assert decision.selected_node_id is None
    assert decision.eligible_nodes == []
    assert len(decision.rejected) == 1


def test_hard_gates_reject():
    base = dict(capabilities=["camera.snapshot"],
                executors=["exec:camera"],
                models=[{"model_id": "model:v",
                         "model_type": "vlm"}],
                locality_zone="local_network")
    cases = [
        (dict(fresh=False), "not fresh"),
        (dict(status="disabled"), "not live"),
        (dict(status="stale"), "not live"),
        (dict(authenticated=False), "not authenticated"),
        (dict(capabilities=[]), "missing camera.snapshot"),
        (dict(models=[]), "missing model type vlm"),
        (dict(executors=[]), "missing executor exec:camera"),
        (dict(locality_zone="remote_lan"),
         "does not satisfy 'local_network'"),
    ]
    requirements = req(
        required_capabilities=["camera.snapshot"],
        required_model_types=["vlm"],
        required_executor="exec:camera",
        locality="local_network")
    for overrides, marker in cases:
        candidate = node("n1", **{**base, **overrides})
        decision = route_task(requirements, [candidate])
        assert decision.selected_node_id is None, overrides
        assert any(marker in reason
                   for entry in decision.rejected
                   for reason in entry.reasons), overrides
    # Intact base passes.
    assert route_task(requirements,
                      [node("n1", **base)]).selected_node_id == "n1"


def test_model_type_and_executor_gates():
    vision = node("node_vision",
                  capabilities=["camera.snapshot"],
                  executors=["exec:vision"],
                  models=[{"model_id": "model:sim-vlm",
                           "model_type": "vlm"}])
    cpu = node("node_cpu", capabilities=["camera.snapshot"],
               executors=["exec:system_inventory"])
    requirements = req(required_capabilities=["camera.snapshot"],
                       required_model_types=["vlm"],
                       required_executor="exec:vision")
    decision = route_task(requirements, [cpu, vision])
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_vision"


def test_preferred_models_order_but_never_require():
    low = node("node_a", capabilities=["x.y"],
               models=[{"model_id": "model:other",
                        "model_type": "llm"}])
    high = node("node_b", capabilities=["x.y"],
                models=[{"model_id": "mod_want",
                         "model_type": "llm"}])
    decision = route_task(
        req(required_capabilities=["x.y"],
            preferred_model_ids=["mod_want"]), [low, high])
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_b"
    # Without the preference both stay eligible (tie-break wins).
    plain = route_task(req(required_capabilities=["x.y"]),
                       [low, high])
    assert plain.selected_node_id == "node_a"


def test_energy_is_preference_never_disqualifier():
    grid = node("node_grid", capabilities=["x.y"],
                resources={"energy_source": "grid",
                           "energy_level": 10})
    solar = node("node_solar", capabilities=["x.y"],
                 resources={"energy_source": "solar",
                            "energy_level": 90})
    policy = check_policy({"prefer_solar": True,
                           "min_energy_level": 50})
    decision = route_task(req(required_capabilities=["x.y"]),
                          [grid, solar], policy)
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_solar"
    assert any("hint only" in reason or "policy-compatible" in reason
               for reason in decision.reasons)
    # Grid node alone stays eligible despite weak hints.
    alone = route_task(req(required_capabilities=["x.y"]), [grid],
                       policy)
    assert alone.selected_node_id == "node_grid"


def test_locality_matching():
    here = node("node_here", capabilities=["x.y"],
                locality_zone="same_host")
    away = node("node_away", capabilities=["x.y"],
                locality_zone="remote_lan")
    decision = route_task(req(required_capabilities=["x.y"],
                              locality="same_host"), [away, here])
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_here"
    open_decision = route_task(req(required_capabilities=["x.y"]),
                               [away, here])
    assert open_decision.selected_node_id in ("node_away",
                                              "node_here")


def test_requirements_validation_tripwires():
    assert check_requirements(None).required_capabilities == []
    assert requirements_from_payload({}).required_capabilities == []
    assert requirements_from_payload(None).required_capabilities == []
    assert requirements_from_payload(
        {"routing": {"required_capabilities": ["a.b"]}}
    ).required_capabilities == ["a.b"]
    for bad in ({"required_capabilities": ["*"]},
                {"required_capabilities": ["rm -rf"]},
                {"required_capabilities": ["a/b"]},
                {"required_capabilities": "not-a-list"},
                {"required_model_types": ["agi"]},
                {"preferred_model_ids": ["qwen"]},
                {"required_executor": "desktop"},
                {"required_executor": "exec:*"},
                {"locality": "internet"},
                {"min_memory_mb": -1},
                {"arbitrary_code": "x"},
                "not-a-dict"):
        with pytest.raises(ValueError):
            check_requirements(bad)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        check_policy("nope")
    assert isinstance(route_task(req(), []), RouteDecision)


# -- BIG #39: Hardware Reality Layer routing tests --

from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta


def node_with_telemetry(node_id, **overrides):
    """Create a node with telemetry and hardware reality layer fields."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    record = {
        "node_id": node_id,
        "capabilities": ["x.y"],  # Default capability for tests
        "models": [],
        "executors": [],
        "resources": {},
        "locality_zone": "local_network",
        "status": "online",
        "fresh": True,
        "authenticated": True,
        "telemetry": {"cpu_percent": 10},
        "telemetry_timestamp": now,
        "hardware": [{"kind": "camera", "identifier": "cam1", "status": "connected"}],
        "compute_capabilities": [{"capability": "ollama", "status": "available"}],
        "energy_state": {"source": "grid", "level_percent": 100},
        "health_status": "ONLINE",
    }
    record.update(overrides)
    return record


def test_required_hardware_gate():
    """Required hardware is a hard gate - missing connected hardware rejects."""
    cam_node = node_with_telemetry("node_cam",
        hardware=[{"kind": "camera", "identifier": "cam1", "status": "connected"}])
    no_cam_node = node_with_telemetry("node_no_cam",
        hardware=[{"kind": "usb", "identifier": "usb1", "status": "connected"}])
    req = check_requirements({
        "required_capabilities": ["x.y"],
        "required_hardware": ["camera"],
    })
    # Node with camera passes
    decision = route_task(req, [cam_node, no_cam_node])
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_cam"
    # Node without camera is rejected
    assert any("missing connected hardware camera" in r
               for r in decision.rejected[0].reasons)
    # Disconnected hardware doesn't count
    disconnected = node_with_telemetry("node_disc",
        hardware=[{"kind": "camera", "identifier": "cam1", "status": "disconnected"}])
    decision = route_task(req, [disconnected])
    assert decision.selected_node_id is None


def test_required_compute_gate():
    """Required compute capability is a hard gate."""
    gpu_node = node_with_telemetry("node_gpu",
        compute_capabilities=[{"capability": "gpu_available", "status": "available"}])
    cpu_node = node_with_telemetry("node_cpu",
        compute_capabilities=[{"capability": "cpu_inference", "status": "available"}])
    req = check_requirements({
        "required_capabilities": ["x.y"],
        "required_compute": ["gpu_available"],
    })
    decision = route_task(req, [gpu_node, cpu_node])
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_gpu"
    assert any("missing available compute gpu_available" in r
               for r in decision.rejected[0].reasons)
    # Busy compute doesn't count
    busy = node_with_telemetry("node_busy",
        compute_capabilities=[{"capability": "gpu_available", "status": "busy"}])
    decision = route_task(req, [busy])
    assert decision.selected_node_id is None


def test_max_telemetry_age_gate():
    """Max telemetry age is a hard gate."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    old_ts = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=10)).isoformat()
    fresh_node = node_with_telemetry("node_fresh", telemetry_timestamp=now)
    stale_node = node_with_telemetry("node_stale", telemetry_timestamp=old_ts)
    req = check_requirements({
        "required_capabilities": ["x.y"],
        "max_telemetry_age_seconds": 300,  # 5 minutes
    })
    decision = route_task(req, [fresh_node, stale_node])
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_fresh"
    assert any("telemetry too old" in r for r in decision.rejected[0].reasons)
    # No telemetry timestamp fails
    no_ts = node_with_telemetry("node_no_ts", telemetry_timestamp="")
    decision = route_task(req, [no_ts])
    assert decision.selected_node_id is None
    assert any("no telemetry timestamp" in r for r in decision.rejected[0].reasons)


def test_min_health_gate():
    """Minimum health is a hard gate."""
    online = node_with_telemetry("node_online", health_status="ONLINE")
    degraded = node_with_telemetry("node_degraded", health_status="DEGRADED")
    stale = node_with_telemetry("node_stale", health_status="STALE")
    req = check_requirements({
        "required_capabilities": ["x.y"],
        "min_health": "ONLINE",
    })
    decision = route_task(req, [online, degraded, stale])
    assert decision.selected_node_id == "node_online"
    assert len(decision.rejected) == 2
    # DEGRADED is below ONLINE
    assert any("health DEGRADED below minimum ONLINE" in r
               for r in decision.rejected[0].reasons)
    # Lower min_health allows more - both ONLINE and DEGRADED eligible
    # Tie-break by node_id: node_degraded < node_online alphabetically
    req2 = check_requirements({
        "required_capabilities": ["x.y"],
        "min_health": "DEGRADED",
    })
    decision2 = route_task(req2, [online, degraded, stale])
    assert decision2.selected_node_id == "node_degraded"
    assert len(decision2.rejected) == 1  # only STALE rejected


def test_telemetry_freshness_preference():
    """Fresh telemetry gives preference bonus."""
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    old_ts = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(minutes=10)).isoformat()
    fresh = node_with_telemetry("node_fresh", telemetry_timestamp=now)
    stale = node_with_telemetry("node_stale", telemetry_timestamp=old_ts)
    policy = check_policy({"prefer_fresh_telemetry": True})
    req = check_requirements({"required_capabilities": ["x.y"]})

"""Semantic retrieval tests (BIG #4, §21).

Provider contract, storage identity/staleness, hybrid ranking,
fallback, depth limits, provenance. Ollama HTTP is faked with
httpx.MockTransport; ranking uses a deterministic keyword
embedder — no real model anywhere.
"""

import httpx
import pytest

from coordinator.app.embeddings import (
    EmbeddingRefusedError,
    EmbeddingUnavailable,
    OllamaEmbeddingProvider,
    UnavailableEmbeddingProvider,
    check_texts,
    check_vectors,
    get_embed_provider,
)
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance, SearchResult
from coordinator.app.retrieval import hybrid_retrieve
from coordinator.app.semantic_store import (
    content_fingerprint,
    cosine_similarity,
    lookup_vector,
    pack_vector,
    store_vector,
    unpack_vector,
    vector_stats,
)


def ok_embed_handler(request):
    import json
    count = len(json.loads(request.content)["input"])
    return httpx.Response(200, json={
        "embeddings": [[0.1 * (i + 1), 0.2, 0.3] for i in range(count)]})


def make_result(entity_id="obj_1", title="Arduino Uno",
                snippet="bordje", kind="object"):
    return SearchResult(
        entity_type=kind, entity_id=entity_id, title=title,
        snippet=snippet,
        provenance=Provenance(source_type="user-created",
                              creator_id="jelles", human_verified=True),
        details={})


class KeywordEmbedder:
    """Deterministic test vectors: arduino->[1,.1,.1], sensor->[..]."""

    model = "fake-test"

    async def embed(self, texts):
        vectors = []
        for text in texts:
            lowered = text.lower()
            if "arduino" in lowered:
                vectors.append([1.0, 0.1, 0.1])
            elif "sensor" in lowered:
                vectors.append([0.1, 1.0, 0.1])
            else:
                vectors.append([0.2, 0.2, 0.9])
        return vectors


class FakeReader:
    def __init__(self, search_hits=None, browse_hits=None,
                 graph_map=None):
        self.search_hits = search_hits or []
        self.browse_hits = browse_hits or []
        self.graph_map = graph_map or {}
        self.calls = []

    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        self.calls.append(("search", q, type))
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query=q, results=list(self.search_hits),
                              total=len(self.search_hits))

    async def browse(self, type=None):
        self.calls.append(("browse", type))
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query="", results=list(self.browse_hits),
                              total=len(self.browse_hits))

    async def graph(self, entity_id, depth=1):
        self.calls.append(("graph", entity_id, depth))
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import (
            GraphEdge, GraphNode, GraphResponse)
        nodes, edges = self.graph_map.get(entity_id, ([], []))
        return GraphResponse(entity_id=entity_id, depth=depth,
                             nodes=nodes, edges=edges)


def run(coro):
    import asyncio
    return asyncio.run(coro)


# -- provider contract --------------------------------------------------

def test_ollama_embed_ok():
    provider = OllamaEmbeddingProvider(
        transport=httpx.MockTransport(ok_embed_handler))
    vectors = run(provider.embed(["hallo", "wereld"]))
    assert len(vectors) == 2 and len(vectors[0]) == 3


def test_ollama_embed_missing_model_is_unavailable():
    def gone(request):
        return httpx.Response(404, json={"error": "not found"})

    provider = OllamaEmbeddingProvider(
        transport=httpx.MockTransport(gone))
    with pytest.raises(EmbeddingUnavailable) as caught:
        run(provider.embed(["x"]))
    assert "ollama pull" in str(caught.value)


def test_ollama_embed_connection_loss_is_unavailable():

        raise httpx.ConnectError("nope")

    with pytest.raises(EmbeddingUnavailable):
        run(OllamaEmbeddingProvider(
            transport=httpx.MockTransport(down)).embed(["x"]))


def test_embed_refused_inputs():
    provider = OllamaEmbeddingProvider(
        transport=httpx.MockTransport(ok_embed_handler))
    with pytest.raises(EmbeddingRefusedError):
        run(provider.embed([]))
    with pytest.raises(EmbeddingRefusedError):
        run(provider.embed(["x"] * 65))
    with pytest.raises(EmbeddingRefusedError):
        OllamaEmbeddingProvider(base_url="http://example.com")
    with pytest.raises(EmbeddingRefusedError):
        get_embed_provider("quantum")

        check_texts([])

def test_pack_roundtrip_and_cosine():
    blob = pack_vector([1.0, 0.0, -2.5])
    assert unpack_vector(blob, 3) == pytest.approx([1.0, 0.0, -2.5])
    assert unpack_vector(blob, 2) is None
    assert unpack_vector(b"xx", 3) is None
    assert cosine_similarity([1, 0], [1, 0]) == pytest.approx(1.0)
    assert cosine_similarity([1, 0], [0, 1]) == pytest.approx(0.0)
    assert cosine_similarity([], [1]) == 0.0


def test_fingerprint_hit_and_stale_miss(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sem.db"))
    fingerprint = content_fingerprint("object", "obj_1", "Arduino",
                                      "bord", {"source_type": "user-created",
                                               "human_verified": True},
                                      "fake-test")
    assert lookup_vector("object", "obj_1", fingerprint, "fake-test",
                         3) is None
    store_vector("object", "obj_1", fingerprint, "fake-test",
                 [1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    assert lookup_vector("object", "obj_1", fingerprint, "fake-test",
                         3) == pytest.approx([1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
    # changed source content -> new fingerprint -> miss (never stale)
    changed = content_fingerprint("object", "obj_1", "Arduino MEGA",
                                  "bord", {"source_type": "user-created",
                                           "human_verified": True},
                                  "fake-test")
    assert changed != fingerprint
    assert lookup_vector("object", "obj_1", changed, "fake-test",
                         3) is None
    # same fingerprint, other model/dim -> miss
    assert lookup_vector("object", "obj_1", fingerprint, "other",
                         3) is None
    assert lookup_vector("object", "obj_1", fingerprint, "fake-test",
                         5) is None
    assert vector_stats()["fake-test"]["count"] == 1

def test_lexical_only_is_call_identical(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sem2.db"))

                                 mode="lexical"))

    assert reader.calls == [("search", "arduino", None)]
    assert result["results"][0]["match_type"] == "lexical"
    assert result["results"][0]["provenance"]["human_verified"] is True


def test_hybrid_ranks_semantic_first(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",

def test_relationship_expansion_bounded(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sem6.db"))
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import (
        GraphEdge, GraphNode, Provenance as Prov)
    parent = make_result("obj_1", "Arduino Uno", "arduino bord")
    neighbour = GraphNode(entity_type="project", entity_id="proj_7",
                          title="Weerstation",
                          provenance=Prov(human_verified=False))
    parent_node = GraphNode(entity_type="object", entity_id="obj_1",
                            title="Arduino Uno", provenance=Prov())
    edge = GraphEdge(id="rel_1", from_id="obj_1", predicate="used_in",
                     to_id="proj_7", provenance=Prov())
    reader = FakeReader(search_hits=[parent],
                        graph_map={"obj_1": ([parent_node, neighbour],
                                             [edge])})
    result = run(hybrid_retrieve("arduino", reader, KeywordEmbedder(),
                                 mode="hybrid", depth=1, limit=10))
    kinds = {entry["entity_id"]: entry["match_type"]
             for entry in result["results"]}
    assert kinds["proj_7"] == "relationship"
    assert result["expansions"] == 1
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run(hybrid_retrieve("x", reader, None, depth=5))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run(hybrid_retrieve("  ", reader, None))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        run(hybrid_retrieve("x", reader, None, mode="telepathie"))


def test_scores_are_ranking_signals_not_truth(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sem7.db"))

        "obj_2", "Moer M8", "moertje")])
    result = run(hybrid_retrieve("arduino", reader, KeywordEmbedder(),
                                 mode="hybrid", limit=2))
    assert len(result["results"]) == 2
    for entry in result["results"]:
        assert "not truth probability" in entry["why"]
        assert entry["score"] >= 0

def make_mesh_ref() -> str:
    return ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus", {}).artifact_ref


def make_slice() -> str:
    request = check_slicer_request(make_mesh_ref(), "draft-pla",
                                   "prt-test1")
    return TestSlicer().slice(request).gcode_ref


def test_profiles_are_closed():
    assert check_profile("draft-pla")["material"] == "PLA"
    with pytest.raises(SlicerRefusedError, match="Unknown slicer"):
        check_profile("turbo-abs")
    with pytest.raises(SlicerRefusedError, match="mesh artifact"):
        check_slicer_request("fab-x.gcode", "draft-pla", "prt-1")
    with pytest.raises(SlicerRefusedError, match="Unknown slicer"):
        get_slicer("cloud-slice")


def test_test_slicer_is_marked_and_deterministic():
    request = check_slicer_request(make_mesh_ref(), "fine-pla",
                                   "prt-test1")
    first = TestSlicer().slice(request)
    second = TestSlicer().slice(request)
    assert first.sha256 == second.sha256
    assert first.test_generated is True
    assert "test-origin" in first.provenance.notes
    assert first.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert first.line_count > 5


def test_unavailable_slicer_refuses():
    request = check_slicer_request(make_mesh_ref(), "draft-pla",
                                   "prt-test1")
    with pytest.raises(SlicerUnavailable, match="no fake G-code"):
        get_slicer("unavailable").slice(request)
    assert "reviewed" in UnavailableSlicer.requirements().lower() or \
        "reviewed" in UnavailableSlicer.requirements()


def test_test_gcode_is_safe_but_not_permission():
    assessment = validate_gcode(make_slice())
    assert assessment.verdict == "safe"
    assert not hasattr(assessment, "safe_to_execute")
    assert assessment.line_count > 5


def _write(name: str, text: str) -> str:
    path = os.path.join(fabrication_dir(), name)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(text)
    return name


def test_dangerous_gcode_is_unsafe():
    ref = _write("fab-evil.gcode",
                 "G28\nM104 S9999\nG1 X10 E1\n")
    assessment = validate_gcode(ref)
    assert assessment.verdict == "unsafe"
    assert any("exceeds" in finding
               for finding in assessment.findings)
    ref = _write("fab-evil2.gcode", "G28\nM112\nG1 X1\n")
    assert validate_gcode(ref).verdict == "unsafe"


def test_unknown_commands_are_inconclusive():
    ref = _write("fab-weird.gcode", "G28\nM9999 Z1\nG1 X1\n")
    assessment = validate_gcode(ref)
    assert assessment.verdict == "inconclusive"
    assert any("unknown command" in finding
               for finding in assessment.findings)


def test_gcode_boundaries():
    with pytest.raises(SlicerRefusedError):
        validate_gcode("../buiten.gcode")
    with pytest.raises(SlicerRefusedError):
        validate_gcode("fab-test-cube.stl")
    ref = _write("fab-empty.gcode", "M104 S200\n")
    assert validate_gcode(ref).verdict == "inconclusive"


def test_file_payload_for_gcode():
    assessment = validate_gcode(make_slice())
    payload = file_payload_for_gcode(
        assessment, "cd" * 32, 500, "testprint")
    assert payload["file_kind"] == "gcode"
    assert payload["metadata"]["safety"] == "safe"
    unsafe = assessment.model_copy(update={"verdict": "unsafe"})
    with pytest.raises(SlicerRefusedError, match="Unsafe G-code"):
        file_payload_for_gcode(unsafe, "cd" * 32, 500, "x")

"""SMOKE11_15: integrated BIG #11-15 walkthrough (41 steps).

Both apps run as TestClients on tmp DBs: INVENTory (real app,
real HTTP boundary on the coordinator side is unavailable in
this process, so world reads go straight to the INVENTory
client) and the coordinator. Every step asserts; the first
failure names its step.
"""

import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "inventory"))

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod


@pytest.fixture()
def clients(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "smoke.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "smoke-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("INVENTORY_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "smoke-inv.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "smoke-fab"))
    import importlib
    import app.database as inv_db
    import app.main as inv_main
    importlib.reload(inv_db)
    importlib.reload(inv_main)
    with TestClient(inv_main.app) as inv:
        with TestClient(main_mod.app) as coord:
            yield inv, coord


def test_smoke11_15_integrated(clients, monkeypatch):
    inv, c = clients
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_GIT_WRITE_REPOS", str(ROOT))
    step = {"n": 0}

    def check(name, cond):
        step["n"] += 1
        assert cond, f"SMOKE11_15 step {step['n']} FAILED: {name}"

    # 1-2. Both apps start and answer.
    check("inventory starts", inv.get(
        "/api/v1/health").status_code == 200)
    check("coordinator starts", c.get(
        "/api/v1/health").status_code == 200)
    # 3. Register nodes.
    for node_id in ("smoke-seed", "smoke-worker"):
        response = c.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"],
            "coordinator_capable": True,
            "node_token": f"smoke-token-{node_id}-123"})
        check(f"register {node_id}", response.status_code == 201)
    # 4. Load world: object round-trip in INVENTory.
    obj = inv.post("/api/v1/objects",
                   json={"name": "Smoke bracket"}).json()
    check("world object", obj["id"].startswith("obj_"))
    # 5. Create project in INVENTory.
    proj = inv.post("/api/v1/projects",
                    json={"name": "Smoke arm",
                          "status": "planned"}).json()
    check("project created", proj["id"].startswith("proj_"))
    # 6. Create memory in Mycelium.
    mem = c.post("/api/v1/memory", json={
        "memory_type": "project", "title": "Smoke arm goal",
        "content": "3D printed robotic arm",
        "truth": "user_fact", "project_ref": proj["id"],
        "provenance": {"source_type": "user-created",
                       "creator_id": "smoke",
                       "human_verified": True,

    check("memory created", mem["memory_id"].startswith("mem_"))
