# =============================================================================

@app.get("/api/v1/events", response_model=list[EventResponse])
def list_events(entity_id: str | None = None, limit: int = 100, since: str | None = None) -> list[EventResponse]:
    """Bounded event feed with an optional ``since`` timestamp cursor
    (BIG #10 change feed). Additive: existing entity_id/limit behavior
    is unchanged. No dumps: limit is clamped to 1..500."""
    try:
        count = max(1, min(int(limit), 500))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="limit must be an integer")
    cursor = None
    if since:
        from datetime import datetime
        try:
            cursor = datetime.fromisoformat(since)
        except ValueError:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="since must be an ISO timestamp")
    with connection() as db:
        if entity_id and cursor is not None:
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM events WHERE entity_id=? AND timestamp>? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?",
                (entity_id, since, count),
            ).fetchall()
        elif entity_id:
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT * FROM events WHERE entity_id=? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?",
                (entity_id, count),
            ).fetchall()
        elif cursor is not None:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM events WHERE timestamp>? ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?", (since, count)).fetchall()
        else:
            rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT ?", (count,)).fetchall()
    return [_row_to_event(r) for r in rows]


# =============================================================================
# REST API — SEARCH (M4.2, read-only over the FTS foundation)
# =============================================================================

def _search_result_for(entity_type: str, row) -> SearchResult:
    prov = Provenance(**load(row["provenance"]))
    if entity_type == "relationships":
        metadata = load(row["metadata"])
        return SearchResult(
            entity_type="relationship",
            entity_id=row["id"],
            title=f"{row['from_id']} —[{row['predicate']}]→ {row['to_id']}",
            snippet=dump(metadata),
            provenance=prov,
            details={"from_id": row["from_id"], "predicate": row["predicate"],
                     "to_id": row["to_id"], "metadata": metadata},
        )
    singular = {"objects": "object", "projects": "project", "ideas": "idea",
                "hardware": "hardware", "sensors": "sensor",
                "cameras": "camera", "locations": "location",
                "models": "model", "tasks": "task",
                "actuators": "actuator", "files": "file"}[entity_type]
    details: dict = {}
    if entity_type == "objects":
        details = {"quantity": row["quantity"]}
    elif entity_type == "hardware":
        details = {"category": row["category"], "status": row["status"],
                   "manufacturer": row["manufacturer"], "model": row["model"]}
    elif entity_type == "sensors":
        details = {"sensor_type": row["sensor_type"], "status": row["status"],
                   "unit": row["unit"], "manufacturer": row["manufacturer"]}
    elif entity_type == "cameras":
        details = {"camera_type": row["camera_type"], "status": row["status"],
                   "resolution": row["resolution"], "manufacturer": row["manufacturer"]}
    elif entity_type == "locations":
        details = {"location_type": row["location_type"], "status": row["status"]}
    elif entity_type == "models":
        details = {"model_type": row["model_type"], "status": row["status"],
                   "provider": row["provider"]}
    elif entity_type == "tasks":
        details = {"task_type": row["task_type"], "status": row["status"],
                   "priority": row["priority"]}
    elif entity_type == "actuators":
        details = {"actuator_type": row["actuator_type"], "status": row["status"],
                   "manufacturer": row["manufacturer"]}
    elif entity_type == "files":
        details = {"file_kind": row["file_kind"], "mime_type": row["mime_type"],
                   "status": row["status"]}
    else:
        details = {"status": row["status"]}
    return SearchResult(
        entity_type=singular,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        entity_id=row["id"],
        title=row["name"],
        snippet=row["description"],
        provenance=prov,
        details=details,
    )


@app.get("/api/v1/search", response_model=SearchResponse)
def search(q: str = "", type: str | None = None) -> SearchResponse:
    sanitized = sanitize_fts_query(q)
    if sanitized is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Query 'q' must be non-empty text (max 200 chars)")
    if type is not None and type not in SEARCHABLE_TYPES:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Unknown type '{type}'; expected one of {sorted(SEARCHABLE_TYPES)}",
        )
    hits = search_fts(sanitized, [type] if type else None)
    canonical = {"objects": "objects", "projects": "projects",
                 "ideas": "ideas", "relationships": "relationships",
                 "hardware": "hardware", "sensors": "sensors",
                 "cameras": "cameras", "locations": "locations",
                 "models": "models", "tasks": "tasks",
                 "actuators": "actuators", "files": "files"}
    results: list[SearchResult] = []
    with connection() as db:
        for entity_type, entity_id in hits:
            row = db.execute(
                f"SELECT * FROM {canonical[entity_type]} WHERE id = ?", (entity_id,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                continue
            results.append(_search_result_for(entity_type, row))
    return SearchResponse(query=q.strip(), results=results, total=len(results))


# =============================================================================
# REST API — GRAPH (M4.3, read-only traversal over relationships)
# =============================================================================

GRAPH_MAX_DEPTH = 2
GRAPH_MAX_EDGES = 200

_GRAPH_TABLES = (("object", "objects"), ("project", "projects"), ("idea", "ideas"),
                 ("hardware", "hardware"), ("sensor", "sensors"),
                 ("camera", "cameras"), ("location", "locations"),
                 ("model", "models"), ("task", "tasks"),
                 ("actuator", "actuators"), ("file", "files"))


def _graph_node_for(entity_type: str, row) -> GraphNode:
    details: dict = {}
    if entity_type == "object":
        details = {"quantity": row["quantity"]}
    elif entity_type == "hardware":
        details = {"category": row["category"], "status": row["status"]}
    elif entity_type == "sensor":
        details = {"sensor_type": row["sensor_type"], "status": row["status"]}
    elif entity_type == "camera":
        details = {"camera_type": row["camera_type"], "status": row["status"]}
    elif entity_type == "location":
        details = {"location_type": row["location_type"], "status": row["status"]}
    elif entity_type == "model":
        details = {"model_type": row["model_type"], "status": row["status"]}
    elif entity_type == "task":
        details = {"task_type": row["task_type"], "status": row["status"]}
    elif entity_type == "actuator":
        details = {"actuator_type": row["actuator_type"], "status": row["status"]}
    elif entity_type == "file":
        details = {"file_kind": row["file_kind"], "status": row["status"]}
    else:
        details = {"status": row["status"]}
    return GraphNode(
        entity_type=entity_type,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        entity_id=row["id"],
        title=row["name"],
        provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
        details=details,
    )


def _find_graph_node(db, entity_id: str) -> GraphNode | None:
    for entity_type, table in _GRAPH_TABLES:
        row = db.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {table} WHERE id = ?", (entity_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is not None:
            return _graph_node_for(entity_type, row)
    return None


@app.get("/api/v1/graph", response_model=GraphResponse)
def graph(entity_id: str | None = None, depth: int = 1) -> GraphResponse:
    if not entity_id or not entity_id.strip():
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Query 'entity_id' must not be empty")
    if depth < 1 or depth > GRAPH_MAX_DEPTH:
        raise HTTPException(
            status_code=422,
            detail=f"Query 'depth' must be between 1 and {GRAPH_MAX_DEPTH}",
        )
    entity_id = entity_id.strip()
    nodes: dict[str, GraphNode] = {}
    edges: dict[str, GraphEdge] = {}
    with connection() as db:
        start = _find_graph_node(db, entity_id)
        if start is None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=f"Entity '{entity_id}' not found")
        nodes[entity_id] = start
        visited = {entity_id}
        frontier = [entity_id]
        for _ in range(depth):
            next_frontier: list[str] = []
            for current in frontier:
                rows = db.execute(
                    "SELECT * FROM relationships WHERE from_id = ? OR to_id = ?"
                    " ORDER BY created_at DESC",
                    (current, current),
                ).fetchall()
                for row in rows:
                    if len(edges) >= GRAPH_MAX_EDGES:
                        break
                    rel = _row_to_relationship(row)
                    edges.setdefault(rel.id, GraphEdge(
                        id=rel.id, from_id=rel.from_id, predicate=rel.predicate,
                        to_id=rel.to_id, metadata=rel.metadata,
                        provenance=rel.provenance,
                    ))
                    other = rel.to_id if rel.from_id == current else rel.from_id
                    if other not in visited:
                        visited.add(other)
                        node = _find_graph_node(db, other)
                        if node is not None:
                            nodes[other] = node
                        next_frontier.append(other)
            frontier = next_frontier
    return GraphResponse(entity_id=entity_id, depth=depth,
                         nodes=list(nodes.values()), edges=list(edges.values()))

def _nav(active: str) -> str:
    items = [("objects", "/", "📦 Objects"), ("projects", "/projects", "🗂 Projects"), ("ideas", "/ideas", "💡 Ideas"), ("hardware", "/hardware", "🔧 Hardware"), ("sensors", "/sensors", "📡 Sensors"), ("cameras", "/cameras", "📷 Cameras"), ("locations", "/locations", "📍 Locations"), ("models", "/models", "🧠 Models"), ("tasks", "/tasks", "✅ Tasks"), ("actuators", "/actuators", "🦾 Actuators"), ("files", "/files", "📁 Files"), ("search", "/search", "🔍 Search")]
    links = ""
    for key, href, label in items:
        cls = ' class="active"' if key == active else ""
        links += f'<a href="{href}"{cls}>{label}</a>'
    return f'<nav><span class="logo">IN<span>VENT</span>ory</span>{links}<a href="/docs" style="margin-left:auto;font-size:13px;" target="_blank">API Docs ↗</a></nav>'


def _prov_badge(prov: dict) -> str:
    st = prov.get("source_type", "user-created")
    verified = prov.get("human_verified", False)
    if st == "ai-generated":
        return ('<span class="badge badge-ai-v">🤖 AI ✓</span>' if verified
                else '<span class="badge badge-ai-uv">🤖 AI ⚠</span>')
    if st == "user-created":
        return '<span class="badge badge-user">👤 User</span>'
    if st == "sensor-observed":
        return '<span class="badge badge-sensor">📡 Sensor</span>'
    if st == "imported":
        return '<span class="badge badge-imported">📥 Import</span>'
    return f'<span class="badge badge-ext">{escape(st)}</span>'


def _status_badge(status: str) -> str:
    return f'<span class="status-badge s-{escape(status)}">{escape(status)}</span>'


def _source_options(selected: str = "user-created") -> str:
    opts = [
        ("user-created", "👤 Handmatig"),
        ("ai-generated", "🤖 AI Observatie"),
        ("sensor-observed", "📡 Sensor"),
        ("imported", "📥 Geïmporteerd"),
        ("external-source", "🌐 Externe Bron"),
    ]
    return "".join(f'<option value="{v}"{"  selected" if v == selected else ""}>{l}</option>' for v, l in opts)


def _project_status_options(selected: str = "planned") -> str:
    opts = ["idea", "planned", "active", "paused", "completed", "archived"]
    return "".join(f'<option value="{s}"{"  selected" if s == selected else ""}>{s}</option>' for s in opts)


def _idea_status_options(selected: str = "raw") -> str:
    opts = ["raw", "considered", "planned", "rejected", "converted"]
    return "".join(f'<option value="{s}"{"  selected" if s == selected else ""}>{s}</option>' for s in opts)


def _predicate_options(selected: str = "related_to") -> str:
    opts = ["used_in", "uses", "related_to", "part_of", "contains", "became", "led_to", "depends_on", "produced_by", "stored_in"]
    return "".join(f'<option value="{s}"{"  selected" if s == selected else ""}>{s}</option>' for s in opts)


def _page(title: str, nav_active: str, body: str) -> str:

  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

def _render_relationships(rels: list[RelationshipResponse], current_id: str) -> str:
    if not rels:
        return '<p class="text-muted text-sm">Geen relaties.</p>'
    rows = ""
    for r in rels:
        direction = "→" if r.from_id == current_id else "←"
        other = r.to_id if r.from_id == current_id else r.from_id
        rows += f"""<div class="flex gap-2 items-center" style="padding:0.5rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:13px;">
          <code>{escape(r.from_id)}</code>
          <span class="text-muted">—[{escape(r.predicate)}]→</span>
          <code>{escape(r.to_id)}</code>
          <span class="text-muted" style="margin-left:auto;">{escape(r.created_at[:10])}</span>
          <form method="post" action="/web/relationships/{escape(r.id)}/delete" style="display:inline;" onsubmit="return confirm('Relatie verwijderen?')">
            <button class="btn btn-danger btn-sm" type="submit">✕</button>
          </form>
        </div>"""
    return rows


def _render_events(events: list[EventResponse]) -> str:
    if not events:
        return '<p class="text-muted text-sm">Geen historische events.</p>'
    rows = ""
    for e in events:
        rows += f"""<div class="event-row">
          <span class="event-type">{escape(e.event_type)}</span>
          <span class="event-time">{escape(e.timestamp[:19].replace("T", " "))}</span>
          <span class="text-muted">{escape(str(e.data))}</span>
        </div>"""
    return rows

@app.get("/", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def web_objects_index() -> str:
    with connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM objects ORDER BY created_at DESC").fetchall()

    table_rows = ""
    for r in rows:
        prov = load(r["provenance"])
        badge = _prov_badge(prov)
        table_rows += f"""<tr>
          <td><a href="/objects/{escape(r['id'])}"><code>{escape(r['id'])}</code></a></td>
          <td><strong>{escape(r['name'])}</strong></td>
          <td class="text-muted">{escape(r['description'][:60] + '…' if len(r['description']) > 60 else r['description'] or '—')}</td>
          <td>{r['quantity']}</td>
          <td>{badge}</td>
          <td class="text-sm text-muted">{r['created_at'][:10]}</td>
        </tr>"""

    empty = f'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Nog geen objecten. Voeg er hieronder één toe.</td></tr>' if not rows else ""

    body = f"""
<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
  <div>
    <h1>📦 Objects</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Fysieke en digitale objecten in je wereldmodel ({len(rows)} totaal)</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="card mb-3">
  <h3>🔍 Zoeken</h3>
  <form method="get" action="/search">
    <div class="form-row cols-3">
      <div><label>Zoekterm</label><input name="q" placeholder="bijv. stappenmotor"></div>
      <div><label>Type</label><select name="type"><option value="">Alle types</option><option value="objects">Objects</option><option value="projects">Projecten</option><option value="ideas">Ideeën</option><option value="relationships">Relaties</option></select></div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-end;"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Zoeken</button></div>
    </div>
  </form>

@app.post("/web/objects", response_class=RedirectResponse)
async def web_create_object(request: Request) -> RedirectResponse:
    form = _parse_form(await request.body())
    name = _form_str(form, "name")
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Name is required")
    prov = Provenance(source_type=_form_source(form), creator_id="web_ui",
                      human_verified=(_form_source(form) == "user-created"))
    create_object(ObjectCreate(name=name, description=_form_str(form, "description"),
                               quantity=max(0, _form_int(form, "quantity")), provenance=prov))
    return RedirectResponse(url="/", status_code=303)

    badge = _prov_badge(obj.provenance.model_dump())

    predicates = [("used_in", "gebruikt in"), ("uses", "gebruikt"), ("related_to", "gerelateerd aan"),
                  ("part_of", "onderdeel van"), ("contains", "bevat"), ("became", "werd"),

@app.get("/projects", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def web_projects_index() -> str:
    with connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM projects ORDER BY created_at DESC").fetchall()

    table_rows = ""
    for r in rows:
        prov = load(r["provenance"])
        table_rows += f"""<tr>
          <td><a href="/projects/{escape(r['id'])}"><code>{escape(r['id'])}</code></a></td>
          <td><strong>{escape(r['name'])}</strong></td>
          <td class="text-muted">{escape(r['description'][:60] + '…' if len(r['description']) > 60 else r['description'] or '—')}</td>
          <td>{_status_badge(r['status'])}</td>
          <td>{_prov_badge(prov)}</td>
          <td class="text-sm text-muted">{r['created_at'][:10]}</td>
        </tr>"""

    empty = f'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Nog geen projecten. Maak er hieronder één aan.</td></tr>' if not rows else ""

    body = f"""
<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
  <div>
    <h1>🗂 Projects</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Actieve en geplande projecten ({len(rows)} totaal)</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="card mb-3">
  <h3>Nieuw Project</h3>
  <form method="post" action="/web/projects">
    <div class="form-row cols-3">
      <div><label>Naam *</label><input name="name" required placeholder="bijv. 3D-Printer build"></div>
      <div><label>Omschrijving</label><input name="description" placeholder="Korte omschrijving"></div>

# =============================================================================
# WEB UI — RELATIONSHIPS
# =============================================================================

@app.post("/web/relationships", response_class=RedirectResponse)
async def web_create_relationship(request: Request) -> RedirectResponse:
    form = _parse_form(await request.body())
    from_id = _form_str(form, "from_id")
    to_id = _form_str(form, "to_id")
    predicate_raw = _form_str(form, "predicate", "related_to")
    if not from_id or not to_id:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="from_id and to_id required")
    valid_predicates = ("used_in", "uses", "related_to", "part_of", "contains", "became",
                        "led_to", "depends_on", "produced_by", "stored_in")
    from .schemas import RelationshipPredicate
    predicate: RelationshipPredicate = predicate_raw if predicate_raw in valid_predicates else "related_to"
    prov = Provenance(source_type="user-created", creator_id="web_ui", human_verified=True)
    create_relationship(RelationshipCreate(from_id=from_id, predicate=predicate, to_id=to_id, provenance=prov))
    # Redirect back to the from_id entity detail page
    if from_id.startswith("proj_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/projects/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("idea_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/ideas/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("hw_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/hardware/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("sns_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/sensors/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("cam_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/cameras/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("loc_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/locations/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("mod_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/models/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("task_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/tasks/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("act_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/actuators/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    if from_id.startswith("file_"):
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/files/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    return RedirectResponse(url=f"/objects/{from_id}", status_code=303)


@app.post("/web/relationships/{rel_id}/delete", response_class=RedirectResponse)
async def web_delete_relationship_form(rel_id: str, request: Request) -> RedirectResponse:
    # Find out from_id to redirect back
    with connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT from_id FROM relationships WHERE id=?", (rel_id,)).fetchone()
    from_id = row["from_id"] if row else None
    delete_relationship(rel_id)
    if from_id:
        if from_id.startswith("proj_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/projects/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("idea_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/ideas/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("hw_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/hardware/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("sns_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/sensors/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("cam_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/cameras/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("loc_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/locations/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("mod_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/models/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("task_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/tasks/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("act_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/actuators/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        if from_id.startswith("file_"):
            return RedirectResponse(url=f"/files/{from_id}", status_code=303)
        return RedirectResponse(url=f"/objects/{from_id}", status_code=303)
    return RedirectResponse(url="/", status_code=303)


# =============================================================================
# WEB UI — SEARCH & GRAPH (M4.4, read-only views over the search/graph APIs)
# =============================================================================

def _type_options(selected: str | None) -> str:
    opts = [("", "Alle types"), ("objects", "Objects"), ("projects", "Projecten"),
            ("ideas", "Ideeën"), ("relationships", "Relaties"),
            ("hardware", "Hardware"), ("sensors", "Sensoren"),
            ("cameras", "Camera's"), ("locations", "Locaties"),
            ("models", "Modellen"), ("tasks", "Taken"),
            ("actuators", "Actuatoren"), ("files", "Bestanden")]
    return "".join(
        f'<option value="{v}"{" selected" if v == (selected or "") else ""}>{l}</option>'
        for v, l in opts
    )


def _detail_url(entity_type: str, entity_id: str) -> str | None:
    if entity_type == "object":
        return f"/objects/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "project":
        return f"/projects/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "idea":
        return f"/ideas/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "hardware":
        return f"/hardware/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "sensor":
        return f"/sensors/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "camera":
        return f"/cameras/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "location":
        return f"/locations/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "model":
        return f"/models/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "task":
        return f"/tasks/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "actuator":
        return f"/actuators/{escape(entity_id)}"
    if entity_type == "file":
        return f"/files/{escape(entity_id)}"
    return None


def _search_form(q: str = "", selected_type: str | None = None) -> str:
    return f"""
<div class="card mb-3">
  <h3>🔍 Zoeken</h3>
  <form method="get" action="/search">
    <div class="form-row cols-3">
      <div><label>Zoekterm</label><input name="q" value="{escape(q)}" placeholder="bijv. stappenmotor"></div>
      <div><label>Type</label><select name="type">{_type_options(selected_type)}</select></div>
      <div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-end;"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Zoeken</button></div>
    </div>
  </form>
</div>"""


@app.get("/search", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def web_search(q: str = "", type: str | None = None) -> str:
    form = _search_form(q, type)
    if not q.strip():
        body = f"""
<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
  <div><h1>🔍 Search</h1><p class="subtitle">Doorzoek alle collecties</p></div>
</div>
{form}
<div class="card"><p class="text-muted text-sm">Vul hierboven een zoekterm in.</p></div>"""
        return _page("Search", "search", body)
    try:
        result = search(q, type)
    except HTTPException as error:
        body = f"""
<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
  <div><h1>🔍 Search</h1><p class="subtitle">Doorzoek alle collecties</p></div>
</div>
{form}
<div class="card"><p class="text-muted text-sm">{escape(str(error.detail))}</p></div>"""
        return _page("Search", "search", body)

    rows = ""
    for r in result.results:
        detail = _detail_url(r.entity_type, r.entity_id)
        title = (f'<a href="{detail}"><strong>{escape(r.title)}</strong></a>'
                 if detail else f"<strong>{escape(r.title)}</strong>")
        rows += f"""<tr>
          <td class="text-sm text-muted">{escape(r.entity_type)}</td>
          <td>{title}<br><code class="text-sm">{escape(r.entity_id)}</code></td>
          <td class="text-muted">{escape(r.snippet[:120] + '…' if len(r.snippet) > 120 else r.snippet or '—')}</td>
          <td>{_prov_badge(r.provenance.model_dump())}</td>
          <td><a class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm" href="/graph/{escape(r.entity_id) if r.entity_type != 'relationship' else escape(r.details.get('from_id', r.entity_id))}">⛨ Graaf</a></td>
        </tr>"""
    empty = (f'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">Geen resultaten voor «{escape(q.strip())}».</td></tr>'
             if not result.results else "")
    body = f"""
<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
  <div><h1>🔍 Search</h1><p class="subtitle">{result.total} resultaat/resultaten voor «{escape(result.query)}»</p></div>
</div>
{form}
<div class="card">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>Type</th><th>Titel</th><th>Fragment</th><th>Herkomst</th><th></th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>{rows}{empty}</tbody>
  </table>
</div>"""
    return _page("Search", "search", body)


@app.get("/graph/{entity_id}", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def web_graph(entity_id: str, depth: int = 1):
    try:
        result = graph(entity_id, depth)
    except HTTPException as error:
        status = error.status_code if error.status_code == 404 else 422
        body = f"""<div class="card"><p class="text-muted">Graaf niet beschikbaar: {escape(str(error.detail))}</p>
<p class="mt-2"><a href="/search" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">← Naar zoeken</a></p></div>"""
        return HTMLResponse(_page("Graph", "search", body), status_code=status)
    start = next((n for n in result.nodes if n.entity_id == result.entity_id), None)
    depth_links = " ".join(
        f'<a class="btn {"btn-primary" if d == result.depth else "btn-ghost"} btn-sm" href="/graph/{escape(result.entity_id)}?depth={d}">Diepte {d}</a>'
        for d in (1, 2)
    )
    node_rows = ""
    for node in result.nodes:
        node_rows += f"""<tr>
          <td class="text-sm text-muted">{escape(node.entity_type)}</td>
          <td><a href="/graph/{escape(node.entity_id)}"><strong>{escape(node.title)}</strong></a><br><code class="text-sm">{escape(node.entity_id)}</code></td>
          <td>{_prov_badge(node.provenance.model_dump())}</td>
        </tr>"""
    edge_rows = ""
    for edge in result.edges:
        edge_rows += f"""<div class="flex gap-2 items-center" style="padding:0.5rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);font-size:13px;">
          <a href="/graph/{escape(edge.from_id)}"><code>{escape(edge.from_id)}</code></a>
          <span class="text-muted">—[{escape(edge.predicate)}]→</span>
          <a href="/graph/{escape(edge.to_id)}"><code>{escape(edge.to_id)}</code></a>
          {_prov_badge(edge.provenance.model_dump())}
        </div>"""
    body = f"""
<div class="flex gap-2 items-center mb-3">
  <a href="/search" class="btn btn-ghost btn-sm">← Zoeken</a>
  <span class="text-muted text-sm">Graaf</span>
</div>
<div class="card mb-2">
  <div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-2">
    <div>
      <h1>{escape(start.title) if start else escape(result.entity_id)}</h1>
      <code class="text-sm">{escape(result.entity_id)}</code>
    </div>
    <div class="flex gap-2">{depth_links}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="card mb-2">
  <h3>Nodes ({len(result.nodes)})</h3>
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>Type</th><th>Titel</th><th>Herkomst</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>{node_rows}</tbody>
  </table>
</div>
<div class="card">
  <h3>Relaties ({len(result.edges)})</h3>
  {edge_rows if edge_rows else '<p class="text-muted text-sm">Geen relaties.</p>'}
</div>"""
    return _page(f"Graph: {start.title if start else result.entity_id}", "search", body)

@app.post("/web/hardware", response_class=RedirectResponse)
async def web_create_hardware(request: Request) -> RedirectResponse:
    form = _parse_form(await request.body())
    name = _form_str(form, "name")
    category = _form_str(form, "category")
    if not name or not category:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Name and category are required")
    status_raw = _form_str(form, "status", "unknown")
    status = status_raw if status_raw in ("available", "in_use", "maintenance", "retired", "unknown") else "unknown"
    prov = Provenance(source_type="user-created", creator_id="web_ui", human_verified=True)
    created = create_hardware(HardwareCreate(name=name, category=category, status=status,
                                             manufacturer=_form_str(form, "manufacturer"),
                                             model=_form_str(form, "model"),
                                             description=_form_str(form, "description"),
                                             provenance=prov))
    return RedirectResponse(url=f"/hardware/{created.id}", status_code=303)

@app.get("/sensors/{sensor_id}", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def web_sensor_detail(sensor_id: str) -> str:
    sns = get_sensor(sensor_id)
    rels = _get_relationships_for(sensor_id)

@app.post("/web/sensors/{sensor_id}/edit", response_class=RedirectResponse)
async def web_update_sensor(sensor_id: str, request: Request) -> RedirectResponse:
    form = _parse_form(await request.body())
    name = _form_str(form, "name")
    sensor_type = _form_str(form, "sensor_type")
    if not name or not sensor_type:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Name and sensor_type are required")
    status_raw = _form_str(form, "status", "unknown")
    status = status_raw if status_raw in ("available", "in_use", "maintenance", "retired", "unknown") else "unknown"
    update_sensor(sensor_id, SensorUpdate(
        name=name, sensor_type=sensor_type, status=status,
        manufacturer=_form_str(form, "manufacturer"),
        model=_form_str(form, "model"),
        unit=_form_str(form, "unit"),
    ))
    return RedirectResponse(url=f"/sensors/{sensor_id}", status_code=303)

def _camera_status_options(selected: str = "unknown") -> str:
    opts = ["available", "in_use", "maintenance", "retired", "unknown"]
    return "".join(f'<option value="{s}"{" selected" if s == selected else ""}>{s}</option>' for s in opts)


@app.get("/cameras", response_class=HTMLResponse)
def web_cameras_index() -> str:
    with connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM cameras ORDER BY created_at DESC").fetchall()

    table_rows = ""
    for r in rows:
        prov = load(r["provenance"])
        table_rows += f"""<tr>
          <td><a href="/cameras/{escape(r['id'])}"><code>{escape(r['id'])}</code></a></td>
          <td><strong>{escape(r['name'])}</strong></td>
          <td class="text-muted">{escape(r['camera_type'] or '—')}</td>
          <td>{_status_badge(r['status'])}</td>
          <td>{_prov_badge(prov)}</td>
          <td class="text-sm text-muted">{r['created_at'][:10]}</td>
        </tr>"""

    empty = f'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Nog geen camera\'s. Voeg er hieronder één toe.</td></tr>' if not rows else ""

    body = f"""
<div class="flex justify-between items-center mb-3">
  <div>
    <h1>📷 Cameras</h1>
    <p class="subtitle">Camera's in je wereldmodel ({len(rows)} totaal)</p>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="card mb-3">
  <h3>Nieuwe Camera</h3>
  <form method="post" action="/web/cameras">
    <div class="form-row cols-3">
      <div><label>Naam *</label><input name="name" required placeholder="bijv. Werkplaats USB-cam"></div>
      <div><label>Cameratype *</label><input name="camera_type" required placeholder="bijv. webcam"></div>
      <div><label>Status</label><select name="status">{_camera_status_options()}</select></div>
    </div>
    <div class="form-row cols-3">
      <div><label>Fabrikant</label><input name="manufacturer" placeholder="bijv. Logitech"></div>
      <div><label>Model</label><input name="model" placeholder="bijv. C920"></div>
      <div><label>Resolutie</label><input name="resolution" placeholder="bijv. 1920x1080"></div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">+ Camera toevoegen</button>
  </form>
</div>
<div class="card">
  <table>
    <thead><tr><th>ID</th><th>Naam</th><th>Type</th><th>Status</th><th>Herkomst</th><th>Aangemaakt</th></tr></thead>
    <tbody>{table_rows}{empty}</tbody>
  </table>
</div>"""
    return _page("Cameras", "cameras", body)

        description=_form_str(form, "description"),
    ))
    return RedirectResponse(url=f"/locations/{location_id}", status_code=303)


@app.post("/web/locations/{location_id}/delete", response_class=RedirectResponse)
def web_delete_location(location_id: str) -> RedirectResponse:
    delete_location(location_id)
    return RedirectResponse(url="/locations", status_code=303)

@app.post("/web/models", response_class=RedirectResponse)
async def web_create_model(request: Request) -> RedirectResponse:
    form = _parse_form(await request.body())
    name = _form_str(form, "name")
    model_type_raw = _form_str(form, "model_type", "other")
    valid_types = ("llm", "vlm", "vision", "detection", "ocr", "speech_to_text",
                   "embedding", "other")
    if not name:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Name is required")
    model_type = model_type_raw if model_type_raw in valid_types else "other"
    status_raw = _form_str(form, "status", "unknown")
    status = status_raw if status_raw in ("available", "in_use", "maintenance", "retired", "unknown") else "unknown"
    prov = Provenance(source_type="user-created", creator_id="web_ui", human_verified=True)
    created = create_model(ModelCreate(name=name, model_type=model_type, status=status,
                                       provider=_form_str(form, "provider"),
                                       model_identifier=_form_str(form, "model_identifier"),
                                       version=_form_str(form, "version"),
                                       provenance=prov))
    return RedirectResponse(url=f"/models/{created.id}", status_code=303)

@app.post("/web/files", response_class=RedirectResponse)
async def web_create_file(request: Request) -> RedirectResponse:
    form = _parse_form(await request.body())
    name = _form_str(form, "name")
    sha256 = _form_str(form, "sha256")
    if not name or not sha256:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="Name and sha256 are required")
    file_kind_raw = _form_str(form, "file_kind", "other")
    valid_kinds = ("cad", "mesh", "gcode", "image", "document", "data", "other")
    file_kind = file_kind_raw if file_kind_raw in valid_kinds else "other"
    status_raw = _form_str(form, "status", "unknown")
    status = status_raw if status_raw in ("available", "in_use", "maintenance", "retired", "unknown") else "unknown"
    try:
        size_bytes = max(0, _form_int(form, "size_bytes"))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail="size_bytes must be a non-negative integer")
    prov = Provenance(source_type="user-created", creator_id="web_ui", human_verified=True)
    try:
        created = create_file(FileCreate(name=name, file_kind=file_kind, sha256=sha256,
                                         mime_type=_form_str(form, "mime_type"),
                                         size_bytes=size_bytes, provenance=prov))
    except ValueError as error:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error))
    return RedirectResponse(url=f"/files/{created.id}", status_code=303)

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/controlled_writes.py">
"""Controlled-write foundation for Mycelium (BIG #5).

Generic, domain-agnostic layer between PROPOSAL and ACTION:

    FACT / OBSERVATION -> ADVICE -> PROPOSAL -> APPROVAL
        -> CONTROLLED ACTION / WRITE -> RESULT -> VERIFICATION
        -> WORLD MODEL UPDATE

An LLM may only ever produce a proposal. A proposal never touches
anything: it becomes an action exclusively through an exact human
YES, bound to that exact proposal content (fingerprint), and every
executor must revalidate the binding immediately before acting.
Proposals expire (staleness) so an old YES can never authorize a
new world.

Rules (tested, all fail-closed):

- mutation_type comes from a closed allow-list; unknown types,
  free SQL, shell, code or arbitrary HTTP writes cannot be
  expressed here at all.
- a WriteProposal never claims human verification: its provenance
  must carry human_verified=False (approval is permission, not
  truth — see verification.py).
- approval binds (proposal_id + content fingerprint); any content
  change after approval is a fingerprint mismatch and refuses.
- approval requires an exact ``YES`` (same dialect as approval.py
  and agent_loop.py — no second dialect); anything else denies.
- proposals expire after WRITE_TTL_SECONDS; stale approvals refuse.
- executors call revalidate() immediately before acting; the
  generic layer itself performs no I/O of any kind.
"""

import hashlib
import json
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

APPROVE_TEXT = "YES"
REJECT_TEXT = "NO"

#: Closed set of mutation types. Domains add executors for these;
#: nothing outside this set can be proposed, approved or executed.
#: ``printer.execute`` (BIG #7) reuses the exact-YES/fingerprint/
#: staleness machinery for physical execution: it is a second,
#: explicit approval on top of any mission/plan approval — a plan
#: YES never means "start the machine". ``robot.execute`` and
#: ``drone.mission`` (BIG #16) reuse the same machinery for
#: physical-agent actions; like printing, approval authorizes
#: but execution itself stays HARDWARE_REQUIRED.
VALID_MUTATION_TYPES = frozenset({
    "inventory.create",
    "inventory.update",
    "inventory.create_relationship",
    "git.commit",
    "printer.execute",
    "robot.execute",
    "drone.mission",
})

MUTATION_CAPABILITIES = {
    "inventory.create": "inventory.write.create",
    "inventory.update": "inventory.write.update",
    "inventory.create_relationship": "inventory.write.relate",
    "git.commit": "git.write.commit",
    "printer.execute": "printer.execute",
    "robot.execute": "robot.execute",
    "drone.mission": "drone.mission",
}

#: A proposal authorizes execution for at most one hour afterwards.
WRITE_TTL_SECONDS = 3600

WriteOutcome = Literal["executed", "failed", "blocked"]


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _parse_time(value: str) -> datetime:
    moment = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
    if moment.tzinfo is None:
        moment = moment.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return moment


class WriteProposal(BaseModel):
    """A validated, inert description of one intended mutation."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    proposal_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    mutation_type: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=40)
    target: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)
    actor: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    created_at: str = ""
    expires_at: str = ""

    def capability(self) -> str:
        return MUTATION_CAPABILITIES[self.mutation_type]


class WriteApprovalRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    proposal_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    fingerprint: str = Field(min_length=64, max_length=64,
                             pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")


class WriteApproval(BaseModel):
    """A recorded human decision. Permission only — never truth."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    proposal_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    fingerprint: str = Field(min_length=64, max_length=64,
                             pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    approved: bool = False
    decision: Literal["approved", "rejected"] = "rejected"
    decided_by: str = Field(default="human", min_length=1, max_length=80)
    decided_at: str = ""
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)


class WriteResult(BaseModel):
    """What execution actually did. Never automatically verified."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    proposal_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    fingerprint: str = Field(min_length=64, max_length=64,
                             pattern=r"^[0-9a-f]{64}$")
    outcome: WriteOutcome = "blocked"
    before: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    after: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    actor: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    executed_at: str = ""
    error: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)


def write_fingerprint(proposal: WriteProposal) -> str:
    """Deterministic content hash of a proposal (sha256, hex)."""
    canonical = json.dumps(proposal.model_dump(mode="json"),
                           sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _check_provenance(provenance: Provenance) -> None:
    verified = (provenance.get("human_verified")
                if isinstance(provenance, dict)
                else getattr(provenance, "human_verified", False))
    if verified:
        raise ValueError(
            "Write proposals never claim human verification; "
            "approval is permission, verification is a separate step")


def propose_write(proposal_id: str, mutation_type: str, target: str,
                  payload: dict, *, actor: str,
                  provenance: Provenance | None = None,
                  ttl_seconds: int = WRITE_TTL_SECONDS) -> WriteProposal:
    """Build a validated, inert write proposal. Performs nothing."""
    if mutation_type not in VALID_MUTATION_TYPES:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Unknown mutation type '{mutation_type}'; "
            f"expected one of {sorted(VALID_MUTATION_TYPES)}")
    if not isinstance(target, str) or not target.strip():
        raise ValueError("Write target must be non-empty text")
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise ValueError("Write payload must be an object")
    if not isinstance(actor, str) or not actor.strip():
        raise ValueError("actor must be non-empty text")
    provenance = provenance or Provenance(
        source_type="ai-generated", creator_id=actor.strip(),
        human_verified=False,
        notes="write proposal; inert until human approval")
    _check_provenance(provenance)
    try:
        ttl = int(ttl_seconds)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise ValueError("ttl_seconds must be an integer")
    if ttl <= 0 or ttl > 24 * 3600:
        raise ValueError("ttl_seconds must be 1..86400")
    created = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
    proposal = WriteProposal(
        proposal_id=proposal_id,
        mutation_type=mutation_type,
        target=target.strip(),
        payload=dict(payload),
        provenance=provenance,
        actor=actor.strip(),
        created_at=created.isoformat(),
        expires_at=(created + timedelta(seconds=ttl)).isoformat(),
    )
    return proposal


def request_write_approval(proposal: WriteProposal) -> WriteApprovalRequest:
    """Open an approval request bound to one exact proposal content."""
    if not isinstance(proposal, WriteProposal):
        raise ValueError("Approval needs a WriteProposal")
    return WriteApprovalRequest(proposal_id=proposal.proposal_id,
                                fingerprint=write_fingerprint(proposal))


def is_stale(proposal: WriteProposal, now_str: str | None = None) -> bool:
    """True when the proposal expired (or carries unreadable time)."""
    try:
        current = _parse_time(now_str) if now_str else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        return current > _parse_time(proposal.expires_at)
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return True


def decide_write(request: WriteApprovalRequest, proposal: WriteProposal,
                 response: str, decided_by: str = "human",
                 now_str: str | None = None) -> WriteApproval:
    """Resolve raw human input: exact YES approves, else denies.

    Approving a stale proposal or a proposal whose content changed
    since the request refuses (fail-closed).
    """
    if not isinstance(request, WriteApprovalRequest):
        raise ValueError("Decision needs a WriteApprovalRequest")
    if not isinstance(proposal, WriteProposal):
        raise ValueError("Decision needs a WriteProposal")
    if request.proposal_id != proposal.proposal_id:
        raise ValueError("Approval request does not match this proposal")
    if not isinstance(decided_by, str) or not decided_by.strip():
        raise ValueError("decided_by must be non-empty text")
    current_fingerprint = write_fingerprint(proposal)
    if request.fingerprint != current_fingerprint:
        raise ValueError("Proposal content differs from the approved content")
    if is_stale(proposal, now_str):
        raise ValueError("Proposal is stale; re-propose instead")
    stamp = now_str or now()
    if response == APPROVE_TEXT:
        return WriteApproval(
            proposal_id=request.proposal_id,
            fingerprint=current_fingerprint,
            approved=True, decision="approved",
            decided_by=decided_by.strip(), decided_at=stamp)
    note = ("human answered NO" if response == REJECT_TEXT
            else "unrecognized response; default deny")
    return WriteApproval(
        proposal_id=request.proposal_id,
        fingerprint=current_fingerprint,
        approved=False, decision="rejected",
        decided_by=decided_by.strip(), decided_at=stamp, note=note)


def revalidate(proposal: WriteProposal, approval: WriteApproval,
               now_str: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Final gate immediately before execution. Returns fingerprint.

    Every executor must call this right before acting; any mismatch
    raises and the write must not happen.
    """
    if not isinstance(proposal, WriteProposal):
        raise ValueError("Execution needs a WriteProposal")
    if not isinstance(approval, WriteApproval):
        raise ValueError("Execution needs a WriteApproval")
    if approval.approved is not True or approval.decision != "approved":
        raise ValueError("Only an approved decision executes")
    if (approval.proposal_id != proposal.proposal_id
            or approval.fingerprint != write_fingerprint(proposal)):
        raise ValueError("Approval does not bind to this exact proposal")
    if is_stale(proposal, now_str):
        raise ValueError("Proposal is stale; re-propose instead")
    return approval.fingerprint
</file>

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/embeddings.py">
"""Embedding providers for semantic retrieval (BIG #4).

Minimal interface: embed a bounded list of texts, get back vectors
of a declared dimension. Local-first, fail-closed:

- OllamaEmbeddingProvider talks to ONE loopback endpoint
  (POST {base}/api/embed) with an operator-chosen model. No
  download, no install, no hidden traffic: a missing model is
  EmbeddingUnavailable with an explicit `ollama pull` hint, never
  a silent fetch.
- UnavailableEmbeddingProvider always raises: the honest "no
  semantic runtime here" used for fallback tests and dry runs.

Rules (tested): loopback-only base URL, bounded input
(MAX_TEXTS texts of MAX_TEXT_CHARS), timeout clamped, non-empty
vectors of consistent dimension, zero-vectors refused (they carry
no signal and would fake similarity).
"""

import os

import httpx

from .model_router import DEFAULT_EMBED_MODEL as _ROUTER_EMBED_MODEL

DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
BASE_URL_ENV_VAR = "OLLAMA_BASE_URL"
MODEL_ENV_VAR = "OLLAMA_EMBED_MODEL"
# Normal default owned by the central model router (value unchanged;
# explicit-arg > OLLAMA_EMBED_MODEL env > this fallback is untouched).
DEFAULT_MODEL = _ROUTER_EMBED_MODEL
TIMEOUT_ENV_VAR = "OLLAMA_EMBED_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30.0
MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 30.0
EMBED_PATH = "/api/embed"
MAX_TEXTS = 64
MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 2000
LOOPBACK_HOSTS = frozenset({"127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1"})


class EmbeddingUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    """No usable embedding runtime. Fall back to lexical, never fake."""


class EmbeddingRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; nothing was sent anywhere."""


def _validate_base_url(raw) -> str:
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Embed base URL must be non-empty")
    try:
        parts = urlsplit(raw.strip())
    except ValueError as error:
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError(f"Invalid URL: {error}") from error
    if parts.scheme != "http":
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Embed base URL must use http")
    if parts.username or parts.password:
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Embed base URL must not "
                                    "contain credentials")
    host = (parts.hostname or "").lower()
    if host not in LOOPBACK_HOSTS:
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError(
            f"Embed host '{host or '?'}' is not loopback; refusing")
    return raw.strip()


def _resolve_timeout(raw) -> float:
    try:
        value = float(raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    if not (value > 0):
        return DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
    return min(value, MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)


def check_texts(texts) -> list[str]:
    if not isinstance(texts, (list, tuple)) or not texts:
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Texts must be a non-empty list")
    if len(texts) > MAX_TEXTS:
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError(f"At most {MAX_TEXTS} texts per call")
    cleaned = []
    for text in texts:
        if not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
            raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Each text must be non-empty")
        cleaned.append(text.strip()[:MAX_TEXT_CHARS])
    return cleaned


def check_vectors(vectors, expected_dim: int = 0) -> list[list[float]]:
    if not isinstance(vectors, list) or not vectors:
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError("No vectors returned")
    checked = []
    for vector in vectors:
        if (not isinstance(vector, (list, tuple)) or not vector
                or any(not isinstance(x, (int, float)) for x in vector)):
            raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Invalid vector shape")
        floats = [float(x) for x in vector]
        if all(x == 0.0 for x in floats):
            raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Zero vector carries no signal")
        checked.append(floats)
    dims = {len(vector) for vector in checked}
    if len(dims) != 1:
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Inconsistent vector dimensions")
    if expected_dim and dims.pop() != expected_dim:
        raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Unexpected vector dimension")
    return checked


class EmbeddingProvider:
    """Interface: embed texts -> vectors. Name + dimension declared."""

    name = "base"
    model = "none"
    dim = 0

    async def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        raise NotImplementedError


class OllamaEmbeddingProvider(EmbeddingProvider):
    """Local Ollama embeddings. Model must already be pulled."""

    name = "ollama"

    def __init__(self, base_url=None, model=None, timeout=None,
                 transport=None):
        raw = (base_url if base_url is not None
               else os.environ.get(BASE_URL_ENV_VAR, DEFAULT_BASE_URL))
        self.base_url = _validate_base_url(raw)
        name = (model if model is not None
                else os.environ.get(MODEL_ENV_VAR, DEFAULT_MODEL))
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
            raise EmbeddingRefusedError("Model name must be non-empty")
        self.model = name.strip()
        raw_timeout = (timeout if timeout is not None
                       else os.environ.get(TIMEOUT_ENV_VAR,
                                           DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS))
        self.timeout = _resolve_timeout(raw_timeout)
        self._transport = transport

    async def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        cleaned = check_texts(texts)
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(
                    base_url=self.base_url, timeout=self.timeout,
                    follow_redirects=False, trust_env=False,
                    transport=self._transport) as client:
                response = await client.post(
                    EMBED_PATH,
                    json={"model": self.model, "input": cleaned})
        except httpx.TimeoutException as error:
            raise EmbeddingUnavailable(f"Embed timed out: {error}") from error
        except httpx.HTTPError as error:
            raise EmbeddingUnavailable(
                f"Embed unreachable: {error}") from error
        if response.status_code in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
            raise EmbeddingUnavailable("Embed redirect refused")
        if response.status_code == 404:
            raise EmbeddingUnavailable(
                f"Model '{self.model}' not present locally; operator "
                f"must `ollama pull {self.model}` first — Mycelium "
                "never downloads models by itself")
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise EmbeddingUnavailable(
                f"Embed answered HTTP {response.status_code}")
        try:
            data = response.json()
        except ValueError as error:
            raise EmbeddingUnavailable("Embed answered invalid JSON") from error
        vectors = (data.get("embeddings") if isinstance(data, dict)
                   else None)
        try:
            checked = check_vectors(vectors or [])
        except EmbeddingRefusedError as error:
            raise EmbeddingUnavailable(
                f"Embed returned unusable vectors: {error}") from error
        if len(checked) != len(cleaned):
            raise EmbeddingUnavailable("Embed count mismatch")
        self.dim = len(checked[0])
        return checked


class UnavailableEmbeddingProvider(EmbeddingProvider):
    """Honest absence of a semantic runtime. Always fail-closed."""

    name = "unavailable"

    def __init__(self, reason: str = "no embedding runtime installed"):
        self._reason = str(reason or "unavailable")

    async def embed(self, texts: list[str]) -> list[list[float]]:
        check_texts(texts)
        raise EmbeddingUnavailable(f"Semantic unavailable: {self._reason}")


def get_embed_provider(name: str | None = None, **kwargs) -> EmbeddingProvider:
    resolved = (name or "ollama").strip().lower()
    if resolved == "ollama":
        return OllamaEmbeddingProvider(**kwargs)
    if resolved == "unavailable":
        return UnavailableEmbeddingProvider(**kwargs)
    raise EmbeddingRefusedError(f"Unknown embedding provider '{name}'")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/fabrication.py">
"""Automated fabrication orchestration (BIG #11-15, Phase 4).

IDEA → CAD → MESH → VALIDATION → SLICING → GCODE →
PRINTER → PRINT → CAMERA → TELEMETRY → VERIFICATION →
INVENTory. Every existing safety gate stays mandatory; this
module only plans, predicts and selects — the physical start
still needs the explicit approval in fab_flow (propose_print
→ execute_print), no exceptions.

Filament is a local resource record (material/color/
remaining/spool/compatibility/location): the system can
predict "enough filament?" but never claims a sensor value
is certain without provenance.
"""

import secrets
import time

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

from .inventory_read import Provenance

FILAMENT_DENSITIES = {
    "PLA": 1.24,
    "PETG": 1.27,
    "ABS": 1.04,
    "TPU": 1.21,
}

PIPELINE_STAGES = (
    "idea",
    "cad",
    "mesh",
    "validation",
    "slicing",
    "gcode",
    "printer_selection",
    "print_proposal",
    "print_approval",
    "print",
    "telemetry",
    "camera",
    "verification",
    "inventory",
)


class FabricationRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Fail-closed fabrication validation."""


def now() -> str:
    import datetime
    return datetime.datetime.now(
        datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def generate_spool_id() -> str:
    return f"spl_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}{secrets.token_hex(4)}"


class FilamentSpool(BaseModel):
    spool_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    material: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)
    color: str = Field(default="", max_length=40)
    diameter_mm: float = Field(default=1.75, gt=0, le=5)
    weight_remaining_g: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0)
    compatible_profiles: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list, max_length=10)
    source: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    location: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    provenance: Provenance
    updated_at: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)


def new_spool(material: str, weight_g: float, *,
              color: str = "",
              diameter_mm: float = 1.75,
              compatible_profiles: list | None = None,
              source: str = "",
              location: str = "",
              provenance: Provenance | None = None
              ) -> FilamentSpool:
    if material not in FILAMENT_DENSITIES:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            f"Unknown material '{material}'; expected one of "
            f"{sorted(FILAMENT_DENSITIES)}")
    try:
        weight = float(weight_g)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise FabricationRefusedError("weight must be numeric")
    if not 0 <= weight <= 10000:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "weight must be 0..10000g")
    return FilamentSpool(
        spool_id=generate_spool_id(), material=material,
        color=str(color or "")[:40],
        diameter_mm=float(diameter_mm),
        weight_remaining_g=weight,
        compatible_profiles=[
            str(item)[:40]
            for item in (compatible_profiles or [])][:10],
        source=str(source or "")[:200],
        location=str(location or "")[:200],
        provenance=provenance or Provenance(
            source_type="user-created", creator_id="filament",
            human_verified=False),
        updated_at=now())


def save_spool(spool: FilamentSpool) -> None:
    from .database import chat_connection, dump, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute("""INSERT INTO filament_spools
        (spool_id, material, color, diameter_mm,
         weight_remaining_g, compatible_profiles, source,
         location, provenance, updated_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(spool_id) DO UPDATE SET
         weight_remaining_g=excluded.weight_remaining_g,
         location=excluded.location,
         updated_at=excluded.updated_at""",
                     (spool.spool_id, spool.material,
                      spool.color, spool.diameter_mm,
                      spool.weight_remaining_g,
                      dump(spool.compatible_profiles),
                      spool.source, spool.location,
                      dump(spool.provenance.model_dump(
                          mode="json")), spool.updated_at))


def _row_to_spool(row) -> FilamentSpool:
    from .database import load
    return FilamentSpool(
        spool_id=row["spool_id"], material=row["material"],
        color=row["color"], diameter_mm=row["diameter_mm"],
        weight_remaining_g=row["weight_remaining_g"],
        compatible_profiles=load(row["compatible_profiles"]),
        source=row["source"], location=row["location"],
        provenance=Provenance(**load(row["provenance"])),
        updated_at=row["updated_at"])


def list_spools() -> list[FilamentSpool]:
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        rows = db.execute("SELECT * FROM filament_spools ORDER "
                          "BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100").fetchall()
    return [_row_to_spool(row) for row in rows]


def deduct_spool(spool_id: str, grams: float, *, reason: str,
                 usage_key: str) -> dict:
    """Deduct filament exactly once (M3.5/BIG57 accounting gate).

    Idempotent on ``usage_key`` (PRIMARY KEY): replaying the same
    key returns the existing record without deducting again.
    Refuses unknown spools, non-positive amounts and insufficient
    stock. NOTHING calls this yet — M4 physical execution will
    call it once per completed print with key
    f"print:{task_id}". Queueing/proposing/cancelling never
    deduct (proven by tests, enforced by absence of callers).
    """
    import re as _re
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    cleaned_id = str(spool_id or "").strip()[:80]
    cleaned_key = str(usage_key or "").strip()[:120]
    cleaned_reason = str(reason or "").strip()[:200]
    if not cleaned_id:
        raise FabricationRefusedError("spool_id is required")
    if not cleaned_key or not _re.match(
            r"^[A-Za-z0-9_:-]{1,120}$", cleaned_key):
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "usage_key must match [A-Za-z0-9_:-]{1,120}")
    try:
        amount = float(grams)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "grams must be numeric") from None
    if not amount > 0 or amount > 10000:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "grams must be 0..10000 (exclusive 0)")
    if not cleaned_reason:
        raise FabricationRefusedError("reason is required")
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        seen = db.execute(
            "SELECT spool_id, grams, reason, created_at FROM "
            "filament_usage WHERE usage_key=?",
            (cleaned_key,)).fetchone()
        if seen is not None:
            return {"spool_id": seen["spool_id"],
                    "grams": seen["grams"],
                    "reason": seen["reason"],
                    "deducted": False,
                    "created_at": seen["created_at"]}
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM filament_spools WHERE "
                         "spool_id=?", (cleaned_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise FabricationRefusedError("spool not found")
        spool = _row_to_spool(row)
        remaining = float(spool.weight_remaining_g or 0.0)
        if remaining < amount:
            raise FabricationRefusedError(
                f"spool holds {remaining:g}g, needs {amount:g}g; "
                f"refusing")
        stamp = now()
        db.execute("INSERT INTO filament_usage "
                   "(usage_key, spool_id, grams, reason, "
                   "created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                   (cleaned_key, cleaned_id, amount,
                    cleaned_reason, stamp))
        updated = spool.model_copy(update={
            "weight_remaining_g": round(remaining - amount, 2),
            "updated_at": stamp})
        db.execute("UPDATE filament_spools SET "
                   "weight_remaining_g=?, updated_at=? WHERE "
                   "spool_id=?",
                   (updated.weight_remaining_g, stamp, cleaned_id))
    return {"spool_id": cleaned_id, "grams": amount,
            "reason": cleaned_reason, "deducted": True,
            "remaining_g": updated.weight_remaining_g,
            "created_at": stamp}


#: Spool slot label: short printer-slot tag, no paths or spaces.
SLOT_PATTERN = r"^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,12}$"


def assign_spool_location(spool_id: str, printer_id: str = "",
                          slot: str = "") -> FilamentSpool:
    """Pin one spool to a printer + AMS slot (M1/BIG57).

    Stores ``printer_id/slot`` (or the bare slot for shelf stock)
    in the existing ``location`` field — no schema change. The
    printer must be registered when named; the slot is a short
    label, never a path. Compatibility enforcement happens at
    pre-flight (M3), not here.
    """
    import re as _re
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    cleaned_id = str(spool_id or "").strip()[:80]
    cleaned_printer = str(printer_id or "").strip()[:80]
    cleaned_slot = str(slot or "").strip()[:12]
    if not cleaned_id:
        raise FabricationRefusedError("spool_id is required")
    if cleaned_slot and not _re.match(SLOT_PATTERN, cleaned_slot):
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "slot must match [A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,12}")
    if cleaned_printer:
        from .printer3d import list_stored_printers
        known = {str(printer.printer_id or "")
                 for printer in list_stored_printers() or []}
        if cleaned_printer not in known:
            raise FabricationRefusedError(
                f"printer '{cleaned_printer[:40]}' is not "
                f"registered; refusing")
        if not cleaned_slot:
            raise FabricationRefusedError(
                "a printer slot label is required with a printer")
        try:
            holders = [spool for spool in list_spools() or []
                       if str(getattr(spool, "location", "") or "")
                       == f"{cleaned_printer}/{cleaned_slot}"
                       and spool.spool_id != cleaned_id]
        except FabricationRefusedError as error:
            raise FabricationRefusedError(str(error)) from error
        if holders:
            raise FabricationRefusedError(
                f"slot '{cleaned_slot[:12]}' op "
                f"'{cleaned_printer[:40]}' bevat al "
                f"'{holders[0].spool_id[:24]}'; refusing")
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM filament_spools WHERE "
                         "spool_id=?", (cleaned_id,)).fetchone()
        if row is None:
            raise FabricationRefusedError("spool not found")
        spool = _row_to_spool(row)
    location = (f"{cleaned_printer}/{cleaned_slot}"
                if cleaned_printer else cleaned_slot)
    updated = spool.model_copy(update={"location": location,
                                       "updated_at": now()})
    save_spool(updated)
    return updated


def estimate_filament_g(volume_cm3: float, material: str, *,
                        infill: float = 0.2) -> dict:
    """Estimate grams from mesh volume. Arithmetic with the
    method shown — never presented as measured."""
    try:
        volume = float(volume_cm3)
        fill = float(infill)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "volume/infill must be numeric")
    if volume < 0 or not 0 < fill <= 1.0:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "volume must be >= 0, infill 0..1")
    density = FILAMENT_DENSITIES.get(material)
    if density is None:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            f"Unknown material '{material}'")
    grams = round(volume * density * fill, 2)
    return {"grams": grams, "material": material,
            "method": f"volume {volume}cm³ × density "
                      f"{density}g/cm³ × infill {fill}",
            "warning": "estimate from mesh math, not a scale "
                       "reading"}


def spool_check(spool_id: str, grams_needed: float) -> dict:
    """Can this spool cover the estimate? Answered with the
    remaining weight on record and its provenance."""
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        row = db.execute("SELECT * FROM filament_spools WHERE "
                         "spool_id=?", (spool_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        raise FabricationRefusedError("spool not found")
    spool = _row_to_spool(row)
    try:
        needed = float(grams_needed)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        raise FabricationRefusedError("grams must be numeric")
    return {"spool_id": spool_id, "enough":
            spool.weight_remaining_g >= needed,
            "remaining_g": spool.weight_remaining_g,
            "needed_g": needed,
            "provenance": spool.provenance.model_dump(
                mode="json")}


def select_printer(requirements: dict) -> dict:
    """Deterministic printer choice over stored printers:
    capability match first, then explicit preference, then
    lowest printer_id. Returns the pick plus why — never a
    claim one printer is 'better'."""
    from .printer3d import list_stored_printers
    printers = list_stored_printers()
    if not printers:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "no printers registered; register one first")
    wanted = set(requirements.get("capabilities", []) or [])
    profile = str(requirements.get("profile", "") or "")
    eligible = []
    for printer in printers:
        caps = set(printer.capabilities or [])
        if wanted and not wanted <= caps:
            continue
        eligible.append(printer)
    if not eligible:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "no registered printer covers the required "
            "capabilities")
    preferred = str(requirements.get("printer_id", "") or "")
    for printer in sorted(eligible,
                          key=lambda item: item.printer_id):
        if preferred and printer.printer_id != preferred:
            continue
        return {"printer_id": printer.printer_id,
                "name": printer.name,
                "capabilities": sorted(
                    printer.capabilities or []),
                "why": "capability match"
                       + (" + explicit preference"
                          if preferred else "")
                       + "; deterministic lowest id on ties",
                "physical_start": "still gated: print proposal "
                                  "+ explicit approval required"}
    raise FabricationRefusedError(
        "preferred printer is not eligible")


def plan_pipeline(*, source_object_id: str = "",
                  source_idea_id: str = "",
                  profile: str = "draft-pla",
                  material: str = "PLA") -> dict:
    """Stage-by-stage fabrication plan as data. Preparation
    steps are actionable; the physical start is marked gated
    and never included as an action."""
    if not source_object_id and not source_idea_id:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            "pipeline needs a source object or idea")
    from .slicer3d import SLICER_PROFILES
    if profile not in SLICER_PROFILES:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            f"Unknown profile '{profile}'")
    if material not in FILAMENT_DENSITIES:
        raise FabricationRefusedError(
            f"Unknown material '{material}'")
    stages = []
    for stage in PIPELINE_STAGES:
        if stage in ("print",):
            action = "GATED: explicit approval via print "
            "proposal; never automatic"
        elif stage == "inventory":
            action = "record result via BIG #5 file proposal " \
                     "after independent verification"
        elif stage == "verification":
            action = "telemetry + camera, both required; " \
                     "telemetry never verifies alone"
        else:
            action = "preparable now"
        stages.append({"stage": stage, "action": action})
    return {"stages": stages,
            "source_object_id": source_object_id,
            "source_idea_id": source_idea_id,
            "profile": profile, "material": material,
            "gates": ["print proposal approval",
                      "physical start approval",
                      "independent verification"]}
