"""BIG #34 tests: camera ecosystem — sessions, VLM honesty,
candidates, matching, links, timeline, security, UI contracts.
"""

import os

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.camera_ecosystem import (
    EcosystemRefusedError,
    check_filenames,
    check_session_id,
    create_session,
    describe_observation,
    list_sessions,
    load_session,
    possible_matches,
    propose_candidates,
    run_session,
    suggest_link,
    timeline,
)


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b34.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "b34-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as client:
        yield client


def _write_inbox(filename: str, seed: int = 0x10) -> str:
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir, write_bmp_24
    path = os.path.join(camera_dir(), filename)
    write_bmp_24(path, 8, 8,
                 bytes([(seed + index) % 256 for index in
                        range(64 * 3)]))
    return filename


def _register(client, name="B34 cam", source="insta360"):
    response = client.post("/api/v1/cameras/register", json={
        "name": name, "kinds": ["snapshot"], "source": source})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    return response.json()["device_id"]


# -- session validation --------------------------------------------------------

def test_session_id_rules():
    with pytest.raises(EcosystemRefusedError):
        check_session_id("")
    with pytest.raises(EcosystemRefusedError):
        check_session_id("obs-123")
    with pytest.raises(EcosystemRefusedError):
        check_session_id("cing_../x")
    assert check_session_id("cing_abc123").startswith("cing_")


def test_filenames_hostile(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for _ in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        for bad in ([], ["../evil.png"], ["http://x/y.png"],
                    ["a.png"] * 9, [""], ["a.heic"], ["a.mp4"],
                    ["a.png", "a.png"],
                    ["/abs.png"], ["..\\win.png"]):
            with pytest.raises(EcosystemRefusedError):
                check_filenames(bad)
        assert check_filenames(["a.png", "b.bmp"]) == ["a.png", "b.bmp"]
        assert check_filenames(["a.jpg", "b.jpeg"]) == ["a.jpg", "b.jpeg"]


def test_session_unknown_device(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for _ in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        with pytest.raises(EcosystemRefusedError):
            create_session("cam_missing", ["a.png"])


# -- multi-file ingest + dedupe --------------------------------------------------

def test_session_ingest_and_dedupe(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        device_id = _register(client)
        first = _write_inbox("b34-first.png", seed=0x10)
        second = _write_inbox("b34-second.png", seed=0x90)
        created = client.post("/api/v1/camera-sessions", json={
            "device_id": device_id,
            "filenames": [first, second]}).json()
        assert created["session_id"].startswith("cing_")
        assert created["state"] == "open"
        ran = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/camera-sessions/{created['session_id']}/run"
        ).json()
        assert ran["session"]["state"] == "complete"
        assert len(ran["observations"]) == 2
        assert {item["state"] for item in
                ran["session"]["items"]} == {"observed"}
        # Replay: same bytes refuse as duplicates, no new observations.
        replay = client.post("/api/v1/camera-sessions", json={
            "device_id": device_id, "filenames": [first]}).json()
        rerun = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/camera-sessions/{replay['session_id']}/run"
        ).json()
        assert rerun["session"]["items"][0]["state"] == "duplicate"
        assert rerun["observations"] == []
        # Session detail + listing.
        fetched = client.get(
            f"/api/v1/camera-sessions/{created['session_id']}")
        assert fetched.status_code == 200
        assert len(fetched.json()["observations"]) == 2
        listed = client.get("/api/v1/camera-sessions",
                            params={"device_id": device_id}).json()
        assert len(listed["sessions"]) == 2
        assert client.get("/api/v1/camera-sessions/cing_nope"
                          ).status_code == 404
        assert client.get("/api/v1/camera-sessions/nope"
                          ).status_code == 422


def test_session_missing_file_refuses(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        device_id = _register(client)
        created = client.post("/api/v1/camera-sessions", json={
            "device_id": device_id,
            "filenames": ["b34-ghost.png"]}).json()
        ran = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/camera-sessions/{created['session_id']}/run"
        ).json()
        assert ran["session"]["items"][0]["state"] == "refused"
        assert ran["observations"] == []


# -- VLM honesty -------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_describe_fallback_unavailable(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.vision_provider import TestVisionProvider
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        main_mod, "get_vision_provider",
        lambda _name: TestVisionProvider(fail=True))
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        device_id = _register(client)
        name = _write_inbox("b34-vlm.png")
        created = client.post("/api/v1/camera-sessions", json={
            "device_id": device_id, "filenames": [name]}).json()
        ran = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/camera-sessions/{created['session_id']}/run"
        ).json()
        observation_id = ran["observations"][0]["observation_id"]
        # No Ollama here: honest UNAVAILABLE fallback, no labels.
        described = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/observations/{observation_id}/describe",
            json={}).json()
        assert described["vlm_state"] == "UNAVAILABLE"
        assert described["analysis"]["labels"] == []
        assert described["analysis"]["detected_objects"] == []
        assert described["analysis"]["model"] == ""
        assert "VLM" in described["analysis"]["uncertainty"]
        assert client.post("/api/v1/observations/obs_missing/describe",
                           json={}).status_code == 422
        # Fallback yields no candidates — nothing invented.
        proposed = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/observations/{observation_id}/propose-candidates"
        ).json()
        assert proposed["candidates"] == []


def test_describe_real_with_mock_transport(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import json as _json
    import httpx
    from coordinator.app.vision_provider import OllamaVisionProvider
    seen = {}

    def handler(request):
        seen["url"] = str(request.url)
        payload = {"message": {"content": (
            "label: zonnepaneel (0.82)\n"
            "label: kabel (0.41)\n"
            "Een paneel met een kabel ernaast.")}}
        return httpx.Response(200, json=payload)

    provider = OllamaVisionProvider(
        transport=httpx.MockTransport(handler))
    from coordinator.app.cameras import camera_dir
    from coordinator.app.vision_provider import VisionRequest
    name = _write_inbox("b34-mock.png")
    import anyio
    result = anyio.run(
        provider.analyze,
        VisionRequest(observation_id="obs-test", device_id="cam-x",
                      media_ref=name, question="Wat zie je?"))
    assert result.model == "qwen3.5:4b"
    assert "zonnepaneel" in result.labels
    assert seen["url"].startswith("http://127.0.0.1:11434")
    assert camera_dir()


# -- candidates: REAL labels only, idempotent -----------------------------------------

def test_propose_candidates_idempotent(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.vision_flow import (VisionAnalysisRecord,
                                             save_analysis)
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        device_id = _register(client)
        name = _write_inbox("b34-cand.png")
        created = client.post("/api/v1/camera-sessions", json={
            "device_id": device_id, "filenames": [name]}).json()
        ran = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/camera-sessions/{created['session_id']}/run"
        ).json()
        observation_id = ran["observations"][0]["observation_id"]
        save_analysis(VisionAnalysisRecord(
            analysis_id="an_b34test", observation_id=observation_id,
            device_id=device_id,
            result={"analysis_id": "an_b34test",
                    "observation_id": observation_id,
                    "device_id": device_id, "labels": ["zonnepaneel"],
                    "detected_objects": [
                        {"label": "zonnepaneel", "confidence": 0.8}],
                    "description": "test", "ocr_text": "",
                    "uncertainty": "", "raw_text": "test",
                    "model": "test-mock",
                    "observed_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                    "provenance": {}},
            created_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"))
        first = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/observations/{observation_id}/propose-candidates"
        ).json()
        assert len(first["candidates"]) == 1
        assert first["candidates"][0]["label"] == "zonnepaneel"
        candidate_id = client.get("/api/v1/candidates").json()[
            "candidates"][0]["candidate_id"]
        assert candidate_id.startswith("cand_")
        # Replay: idempotent, no second candidate.
        second = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/observations/{observation_id}/propose-candidates"
        ).json()
        assert second["candidates"] == []
        assert len(client.get("/api/v1/candidates").json()[
            "candidates"]) == 1

def test_match_api_and_suggest_link(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert client.get("/api/v1/camera-match",
                          params={"q": ""}).status_code == 422
        device_id = _register(client)
        name = _write_inbox("b34-link.png")
        created = client.post("/api/v1/camera-sessions", json={
            "device_id": device_id, "filenames": [name]}).json()
        ran = client.post(
            f"/api/v1/camera-sessions/{created['session_id']}/run"
        ).json()
        observation_id = ran["observations"][0]["observation_id"]
        bad = client.post("/api/v1/camera-suggest-link", json={
            "observation_id": observation_id, "entity_id": "xxx_1",
            "predicate": "used_in"})
        assert bad.status_code == 422
        bad_pred = client.post("/api/v1/camera-suggest-link", json={
            "observation_id": observation_id,
            "entity_id": "proj_demo", "predicate": "owns"})
        assert bad_pred.status_code == 422
        linked = client.post("/api/v1/camera-suggest-link", json={
            "observation_id": observation_id,
            "entity_id": "proj_demo", "predicate": "supports"})
        assert linked.status_code == 201, linked.text
        body = linked.json()
        assert body["state"] == "PROPOSED"
        # Visible as PROPOSED symbiosis via entity_refs.
        from coordinator.app.symbiosis import proposed
        assert any(body["candidate_id"] ==
                   item["candidate_id"] for item in proposed(limit=20))

"""Camera abstraction tests (BIG #4, §21).

Device/capability contracts, observation + provenance, snapshot
fail-closed without an adapter, test-adapter capture, registry,
read-only discovery shape, HTTP endpoints, and the no-network /
no-shell surface of the module.
"""

import os

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.cameras import (
    CameraRefusedError,
    CameraUnavailable,
    TestCameraAdapter,
    check_kinds,
    detect_local_imaging_devices,
    get_device,
    list_devices,
    list_observations,
    new_device,
    new_observation,
    save_device,
    save_observation,
    take_snapshot,
)


def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH", str(tmp_path / "c.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH", str(tmp_path / "c-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_device_contract():
    device = new_device("cam-1", "Insta360 X4", ["snapshot", "p360"],
                        "insta360")
    assert device.kinds == ["snapshot", "p360"]
    with pytest.raises(CameraRefusedError):
        new_device("cam-2", "X", ["teleport"], "usb")
    with pytest.raises(CameraRefusedError):
        new_device("cam-3", "X", ["snapshot"], "wifi-cloud")
    with pytest.raises(CameraRefusedError):
        new_device("cam-4", "  ", ["snapshot"], "manual")
    with pytest.raises(CameraRefusedError):
        check_kinds([])


def test_observation_contract_and_provenance():
    observation = new_observation("obs-1", "cam-1", "snapshot",
                                  media_ref="cam-1.bmp", width=64,
                                  height=48)
    assert observation.provenance.source_type == "sensor-observed"
    assert observation.provenance.human_verified is False
    assert "camera:cam-1" in observation.provenance.creator_id
    with pytest.raises(CameraRefusedError):
        new_observation("obs-2", "cam-1", "livestream")
    with pytest.raises(CameraRefusedError):
        new_observation("obs-3", "cam-1", "snapshot",
                        media_ref="http://x/y.png")
    with pytest.raises(CameraRefusedError):
        new_observation("obs-4", "cam-1", "snapshot",
                        file_id="not-a-file")


def test_snapshot_without_adapter_fails_closed():
    device = new_device("cam-9", "Lege camera", ["snapshot"], "manual")
    with pytest.raises(CameraUnavailable) as caught:
        take_snapshot(device, None)
    assert "refusing" in str(caught.value)
    webcam_only = new_device("cam-8", "Webcam", ["webcam"], "usb")
    with pytest.raises(CameraRefusedError):
        take_snapshot(webcam_only, TestCameraAdapter())


def test_test_adapter_captures_locally(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "cam.db"))
    import coordinator.app.cameras as module
    monkeypatch.setattr(module, "camera_dir", lambda: str(tmp_path))
    device = new_device("cam-t", "Test", ["snapshot"], "manual")
    observation = take_snapshot(device, TestCameraAdapter())
    assert observation.media_ref.endswith(".bmp")
    assert observation.width == 64
    full = str(tmp_path / observation.media_ref)
    assert os.path.isfile(full)
    save_device(device)
    save_observation(observation)
    assert get_device("cam-t").name == "Test"
    assert [dev.device_id for dev in list_devices()] == ["cam-t"]
    assert list_observations("cam-t")[0].observation_id == \
        observation.observation_id


def test_discovery_is_read_only_and_safe():
    result = detect_local_imaging_devices()
    assert set(result) == {"supported", "devices", "reason"}
    assert isinstance(result["devices"], list)
    for entry in result["devices"]:
        assert "path" in entry


def test_setupapi_functions_use_pointer_safe_signatures():
    import ctypes
    import coordinator.app.cameras as module

    class Procedure:
        pass

    class SetupApi:
        SetupDiGetClassDevsW = Procedure()
        SetupDiEnumDeviceInterfaces = Procedure()
        SetupDiGetDeviceInterfaceDetailW = Procedure()
        SetupDiDestroyDeviceInfoList = Procedure()

    api = SetupApi()
    module._configure_setupapi_signatures(
        api, ctypes.c_ubyte * 16, ctypes.c_ubyte * 32)

    assert api.SetupDiGetClassDevsW.restype is ctypes.c_void_p
    assert api.SetupDiGetClassDevsW.argtypes[-2:] == [
        ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_ulong]
    assert api.SetupDiEnumDeviceInterfaces.restype is ctypes.c_int
    assert api.SetupDiGetDeviceInterfaceDetailW.argtypes[2] is ctypes.c_void_p

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_chat_api.py">
"""Chat API tests (Fase A/N/Q).

Conversation persistence, INVENTory context integration, source
preservation, provider fallback honesty, and the chat UI pages.
World reads and providers are faked; nothing reaches INVENTory or
a real model.
"""

import os

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.inventory_read import Provenance, SearchResult
from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse


class FakeReader:
    def __init__(self, results=None, error=None):
        self._results = results or []
        self._error = error

    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        if self._error:
            raise self._error
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query=q, results=self._results,
                              total=len(self._results))

    async def browse(self, type=None):
        return await self.search("", type)


class FakeProvider:
    def __init__(self, advice="Gebruik je Arduino en sensor.",
                 fail=None):
        self._advice = advice
        self._fail = fail
        self.seen = []

    async def advise(self, question, records):
        if self._fail:
            raise self._fail
        self.seen.append((question, records))
        return AdviceResponse(
            question=question, advice=self._advice, model="fake-local",
            records_used=len(records), sources=[])


def make_result(entity_id="obj_abc123", title="Arduino Uno"):
    return SearchResult(
        entity_type="object", entity_id=entity_id, title=title,
        snippet="bordje in lade 3",
        provenance=Provenance(source_type="user-created",
                              creator_id="jelles", human_verified=True),
        details={})


def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch, reader=None, provider=None):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH", str(tmp_path / "chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH", str(
        tmp_path / "chat-state.db"))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader",
                        lambda: reader or FakeReader(
                            [make_result()]))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "get_provider",
                        lambda name=None, **k: provider or FakeProvider())
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client

        assert body["records_used"] == 1
        assert body["sources"][0]["entity_id"] == "obj_abc123"
        assert body["model"] == "fake-local"
        assert body["provider_error"] is None

        detail = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{body['conversation_id']}")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_dist_security.py">
"""Distributed security tripwires (BIG #8).

Unknown/disabled/unauthenticated nodes, stale claims,
wildcard and injection refusal, credential hygiene, identity
binding, lease ownership, bounded retry, no cloud, no public
bind, no privilege escalation.
"""

import pathlib

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod

APP = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "coordinator" / "app"


def source_of(*names: str) -> str:
    return "\n".join(
        (APP / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8") for name in names)


OPERATOR_KEY = "op-key-dist-security-123"


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sec.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "sec-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY", OPERATOR_KEY)
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def test_unknown_node_rejected(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-ghost").status_code == 404
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-ghost/heartbeat",
            json={"available": True}).status_code == 404
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-ghost").status_code == 404
        # Disable without operator key refuses first.
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-ghost/disable",
            json={}).status_code == 403
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-ghost/disable",
            json={"operator_key": OPERATOR_KEY}).status_code == 404


def test_invalid_credential_rejected(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-s1", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": [],
            "node_token": "right-token-123456"})
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-s1",
            params={"node_token": "wrong-token"}).status_code == 403
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/nodes/node-s1/heartbeat",
            json={"available": True,
                  "node_token": "wrong-token"}).status_code == 403
        # Re-register rebinding requires the old credential.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-s1", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": [], "node_token": "new-token-234567"}
        ).status_code == 403


def test_node_cannot_claim_another_identity(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        for node_id, token in (("node-a", "token-a-123456789"),
                                ("node-b", "token-b-123456789")):
            test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
                "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "h",
                "capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"],
                "node_token": token})
        task = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": [
                "exec:system_inventory"]}).json()
        assigned = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task['id']}/assign",
            json={"policy": {}}).json()
        assert assigned["assigned_node_id"] in ("node-a", "node-b")
        other = "node-b" if assigned["assigned_node_id"] == \
            "node-a" else "node-a"
        other_token = "token-b-123456789" if other == "node-b" else \
            "token-a-123456789"
        # Wrong node, right own token: assignment pins ownership.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/claim/{other}",
            params={"node_token": other_token}).json() is None


def test_stale_node_cannot_claim(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-old", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"],
            "node_token": "stale-token-123456"})
        test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"]})
        with connection() as db:
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE nodes SET last_seen=? WHERE node_id=?",
                ("2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", "node-old"))
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-old",
            params={
                "node_token": "stale-token-123456"}).json() is None


def test_task_cannot_grant_capabilities(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-plain", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": [],
            "node_token": "plain-token-123456"})
        # A task demanding an unadvertised capability matches nothing.
        task = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": ["printer.execute"]}).json()
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-plain",
            params={"node_token": "plain-token-123456"}
        ).json() is None
        preview = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks/route", json={
            "requirements": {"required_capabilities": [
                "printer.execute"]},
            "policy": {"require_authenticated": False}}).json()
        assert preview["selected_node_id"] is None
        # Task payload cannot inject executors or commands.
        evil = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "payload": {"routing": {
                "required_executor": "exec:printer"},
                "command": "rm -rf /",
                "exec": "/bin/sh"}})
        assert evil.status_code == 201
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-plain",
            params={"node_token": "plain-token-123456"}
        ).json() is None


def test_arbitrary_paths_and_commands_refused(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        for bad_req in ({"required_capabilities": ["/bin/sh"]},
                        {"required_capabilities": ["a; rm"]},
                        {"required_executor": "/usr/bin/x"},
                        {"preferred_model_ids": ["../../etc/passwd"]}):
            assert test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
                "kind": "system_inventory",
                "requirements": bad_req}).status_code == 422, bad_req
        for bad_reg in ({"capabilities": ["/bin/sh"]},
                        {"executors": ["exec:../x"]},
                        {"models": [{"model_id": "http://x/y",
                                     "model_type": "llm"}]}):
            body = {"node_id": "node-evil", "hostname": "h",
                    "node_token": "evil-token-123456"}
            body.update(bad_reg)
            assert test_client.post(
                "/api/v1/nodes/register",
                json=body).status_code == 422, bad_reg

                                              caplog):

def test_lease_ownership_preserved(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        for node_id in ("node-o1", "node-o2"):
            test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
                "node_id": node_id, "hostname": "h",
                "capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"],
                "node_token": f"owner-token-{node_id}-123"})
        task = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": [
                "exec:system_inventory"]}).json()
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-o1",
            params={
                "node_token": "owner-token-node-o1-123"}
        ).json()["id"] == task["id"]
        # Foreign completion is refused.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task['id']}/complete",
            params={"node_id": "node-o2"},
            json={"success": True, "result": {}}).status_code == 404
        # Owner completes within lease.
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/tasks/{task['id']}/complete",
            params={"node_id": "node-o1"},
            json={"success": True, "result": {}}).status_code == 204


def test_retry_bounded_for_software_tasks(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.database import connection
    from coordinator.app.main import MAX_ATTEMPTS, expire_leases
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-r1", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": ["exec:system_inventory"],
            "node_token": "retry-token-123456"})
        task = test_client.post("/api/v1/tasks", json={
            "kind": "system_inventory",
            "required_capabilities": [
                "exec:system_inventory"]}).json()
        for _ in range(MAX_ATTEMPTS):
            assert test_client.post(
                "/api/v1/tasks/claim/node-r1",
                params={
                    "node_token": "retry-token-123456"}
            ).json() is not None
            with connection() as db:
                db.execute(
                    "UPDATE tasks SET lease_until=? WHERE id=?",
                    ("2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", task["id"]))
            expire_leases("2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
        with connection() as db:
            row = db.execute(
                "SELECT status, attempt_count FROM tasks WHERE id=?",
                (task["id"],)).fetchone()
        assert row["attempt_count"] == MAX_ATTEMPTS
        with connection() as db:
            db.execute(
                "UPDATE tasks SET status='assigned', lease_until=? "
                "WHERE id=?",
                ("2020-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", task["id"]))
        summary = expire_leases("2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00")
        assert summary["failed"] == 1
        with connection() as db:
            assert db.execute(
                "SELECT status FROM tasks WHERE id=?",
                (task["id"],)).fetchone()["status"] == "failed"


def test_no_cloud_no_public_bind_no_shell():
    source = (APP / "routing.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8") + \
        (APP / "nodes.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8") + \
        (APP / "sim_nodes.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    for token in ("https://", "boto", "kubernetes", "celery",
                  "redis", "subprocess", "os.system", "eval(",
                  "0.0.0.0", "port_forward", "public"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"
    main_source = (APP / "main.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    ui_source = (APP / "ui.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    # The only loopback surface is the INVENTory link in the
    # shared shell; no public bind anywhere in UI or routing.
    assert "127.0.0.1" in main_source or "127.0.0.1" in ui_source
    assert "0.0.0.0" not in ui_source


def test_no_privilege_escalation_surface():
    source = (APP / "routing.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    # Routing compares advertisements; it never registers nodes,
    # writes capabilities or touches the database.
    for token in ("escalat", "INSERT", "UPDATE", "DELETE",
                  "register_node", "grant_capability"):
        assert token not in source, f"forbidden token: {token}"
    nodes_source = (APP / "nodes.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "escalat" not in nodes_source

def test_interface_chat_converges(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

        async def advise(self, question, records):

                question=question, advice="advies", model="fake",

                                         "limit": 10}).json()
        assert len(events) >= 1


def test_voice_transcribe_synthesize_unavailable(tmp_path,
                                                monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        ref = make_clip()
        try:
            refused = test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/transcribe",
                                       json={"audio_ref": ref})
            # No backend configured: honest 502, never fabricated.
            assert refused.status_code == 502
            missing = test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/transcribe",
                                       json={"audio_ref":
                                             "aud-missing.wav"})
            assert missing.status_code in (422, 502)
            tts = test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/synthesize",
                                   json={"text": "Hallo"})
            assert tts.status_code == 502
        finally:
            delete_audio(ref)

    from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse

    class FakeProvider:
        async def advise(self, question, records):
            return AdviceResponse(
                question=question, advice="advies", model="fake",
                records_used=len(records), sources=[])

    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "get_provider",
                            lambda name=None, **k: FakeProvider())

def test_capture_contracts(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-phone9", "hostname": "phone",
            "capabilities": ["phone.microphone.read"],
            "node_token": "phone9-token-123456"})
        opened = test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/capture/open",
                                  json={"node_id": "node-phone9",
                                        "max_seconds": 30})
        assert opened.status_code == 201, opened.text
        session_id = opened.json()["session_id"]
        ref = make_clip("aud-cap9.wav")
        try:
            closed = test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/capture/close",
                                      json={"session_id": session_id,
                                            "audio_ref": ref})
            assert closed.json()["status"] == "closed"
            deleted = test_client.delete(
                "/api/v1/voice/audio/aud-cap9.wav").json()
            assert deleted == {"audio_ref": "aud-cap9.wav",
                               "removed": True}
        finally:
            delete_audio(ref)
        # Node without the capability cannot open capture.
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-plain9", "hostname": "h",
            "capabilities": [],
            "node_token": "plain9-token-123456"})
        refused = test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/capture/open",
                                   json={"node_id": "node-plain9"})
        assert refused.status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/capture/open",
                                json={
                                    "node_id": "node-ghost"}
                                ).status_code == 404
        assert test_client.delete(
            "/api/v1/voice/audio/../x.wav").status_code == 404
        # Normalized away by routing; an invalid suffix still 422s.
        assert test_client.delete(
            "/api/v1/voice/audio/x.mp4").status_code == 422


def test_events_and_notifications(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "node-phone8", "hostname": "phone",
            "capabilities": ["phone.notification.send"],
            "node_token": "phone8-token-123456"})
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/notifications", json={
            "recipient_node_id": "node-phone8",
            "type": "approval_required",
            "title": "Missie wacht op YES",
            "related_mission": "mission_1"})
        assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
        notification_id = created.json()["notification_id"]
        listed = test_client.get("/api/v1/notifications",
                                 params={
                                     "node_id": "node-phone8"}).json()
        assert len(listed) == 1
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/notifications/{notification_id}/read",
            params={"node_id": "node-phone8"}).status_code == 200
        assert test_client.get("/api/v1/notifications", params={
            "node_id": "node-phone8",
            "unread_only": True}).json() == []
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/notifications", json={
            "recipient_node_id": "node-ghost",
            "type": "info", "title": "x"}).status_code == 404
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/notifications", json={
            "recipient_node_id": "node-phone8",
            "type": "launch", "title": "x"}).status_code == 422
        # Polling works with cursor + filter.
        first = test_client.get("/api/v1/events",
                                params={"limit": 1}).json()
        assert isinstance(first, list)
        second = test_client.get("/api/v1/events", params={
            "after": first[0]["event_id"] if first else "",
            "limit": 50}).json()
        assert isinstance(second, list)

def test_voice_approval_write_flow(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        proposed = test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/inventory",
                                    json={
                                        "proposal_id": "wrt-vap1",
                                        "mutation": "create",
                                        "entity_type": "object",
                                        "fields": {
                                            "name": "Spraakbout"}})
        assert proposed.status_code == 201
        opened = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/voice/approval-requests",
            json={"kind": "write", "target_id": "wrt-vap1",
                  "summary": "Maak Spraakbout"})
        assert opened.status_code == 201, opened.text
        approval_id = opened.json()["approval_id"]
        # Competing request refuses while one is pending.
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/voice/approval-requests",
            json={"kind": "write",
                  "target_id": "wrt-vap1"}).status_code == 409
        # Casual speech refuses; the proposal stays proposed.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/approve", json={
            "approval_id": approval_id,
            "transcript": "doe maar"}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-vap1").json()["status"] == "proposed"
        # Exact YES word approves through the existing gate.
        granted = test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/approve", json={
            "approval_id": approval_id, "transcript": "ja"})
        assert granted.status_code == 200, granted.text
        assert granted.json()["approved"] is True
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-vap1").json()["status"] == "approved"
        # Resolved requests cannot be reused.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/voice/approve", json={
            "approval_id": approval_id,
            "transcript": "YES"}).status_code == 409

def test_route_annotations_resolve():
    """Regression tripwire: PEP 649 lazy annotations hide missing
    imports until FastAPI inspects them (then params degrade to
    query args). Every route annotation must resolve."""
    import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
    bad = []
    for route in main_mod.app.routes:
        endpoint = getattr(route, "endpoint", None)
        if endpoint is None:
            continue
        try:
            annotations = endpoint.__annotations__
            for value in annotations.values():
                str(value)
        except NameError as error:
            bad.append((endpoint.__name__, str(error)))
    assert bad == []

"""Mission tests (BIG #3, §17).

Creation, persistence, validation, approvals, bindings, executor
chain (mission -> dact -> agent -> observation -> next step),
scope violations, races, events, chat integration. Fail-closed
first; the desktop side is simulated through HTTP (no real input).
"""

import os

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.missions import (
    MissionConflictError,
    approve_mission,
    check_binding,
    load_mission,
    new_mission,
    save_mission,
)


def client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH", str(tmp_path / "m.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH", str(tmp_path / "m-chat.db"))
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client


def readonly_steps():
    return [
        {"kind": "readout", "description": "Lees project",
         "parameters": {"source": "project"}},
        {"kind": "analysis", "description": "Vat samen",
         "parameters": {"question": "Wat moet er gebeuren?"}},
    ]


def make_conversation(test_client):
    response = test_client.post("/api/v1/chat", json={
        "message": "hallo"})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    return response.json()["conversation_id"]


class FakeProvider:
    def __init__(self, advice="Doe X, dan Y.", fail=None):
        self._advice = advice
        self._fail = fail

    async def advise(self, question, records):
        if self._fail:
            raise self._fail
        from coordinator.app.ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse
        return AdviceResponse(question=question, advice=self._advice,
                              model="fake", records_used=len(records),
                              sources=[])


class FakeReader:
    async def search(self, q, type=None):
        from coordinator.app.inventory_read import SearchResponse
        return SearchResponse(query=q, results=[], total=0)

    async def browse(self, type=None):
        return await self.search("", type)


@pytest.fixture()
def fakes(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader", lambda: FakeReader())
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "get_provider",
                        lambda name=None, **k: FakeProvider())
    return True


# -- creation & validation -----------------------------------------------

def test_mission_create_and_persist(tmp_path, monkeypatch, fakes):
    for test_client in client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(test_client)
        created = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": conversation,
            "goal": "Bekijk mijn project",
            "steps": readonly_steps()})
        assert created.status_code == 201, created.text
        body = created.json()
        assert body["mission_id"].startswith("mission_")
        assert body["status"] == "pending_approval"
        assert [step["sequence"] for step in body["steps"]] == [0, 1]
        assert body["steps"][0]["step_id"].startswith("step_")

        fetched = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{body['mission_id']}")
        assert fetched.status_code == 200
        assert fetched.json()["goal"] == "Bekijk mijn project"
        assert test_client.get("/api/v1/missions/unknown").status_code == 404


def test_mission_create_rejects_garbage(tmp_path, monkeypatch, fakes):
    for test_client in client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(test_client)
        base = {"conversation_id": conversation, "goal": "x"}
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            **base, "goal": "  "}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            **base, "steps": []}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            **base, "steps": [{"kind": "teleport",
                               "description": "x"}]}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            **base, "steps": [{"kind": "desktop",
                               "description": "x",
                               "action_type": "run_shell",
                               "parameters": {}}]}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            **base, "steps": [{"kind": "readout", "description": "x",
                               "parameters": {"source": "cloud"}}]
        }).status_code == 422
        # input step claiming no approval is refused
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            **base, "steps": [{"kind": "desktop", "description": "x",
                               "action_type": "click",
                               "parameters": {"x": 1, "y": 1},
                               "requires_approval": False}]
        }).status_code == 422
        # non-desktop step claiming approval is refused
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            **base, "steps": [{"kind": "readout", "description": "x",
                               "parameters": {"source": "project"},
                               "requires_approval": True}]
        }).status_code == 422


def test_new_mission_model_rules():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_mission("mission_a", "conv-1", "  ", [{"kind": "readout",
                                                   "description": "x",
                                                   "parameters": {
                                                       "source": "project"}}])
    mission = new_mission("mission_b", "conv-1", "doel",
                          readonly_steps(), max_steps=5)
    assert mission.max_steps == 5
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        new_mission("mission_c", "conv-1", "doel", readonly_steps(),
                    max_steps=99)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        approve_mission(mission, "ja graag")
    approved = approve_mission(mission, "YES", decided_by="jelles")
    assert approved.status == "approved"
    assert approved.approved_by == "jelles"
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        approve_mission(approved, "YES")


def test_save_conflict_is_atomic(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH", str(tmp_path / "c.db"))
    mission = new_mission("mission_race", "conv-1", "doel",
                          readonly_steps())
    save_mission(mission)
    with pytest.raises(MissionConflictError):
        save_mission(mission, expected=("running", 0))
    assert load_mission("mission_race").status == "pending_approval"


# -- control: approve/pause/resume/cancel ----------------------------------

def test_mission_control_lifecycle(tmp_path, monkeypatch, fakes):
    for test_client in client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(test_client)
        mission_id = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": conversation, "goal": "doel",
            "steps": [{"kind": "desktop", "description": "Klik",
                       "action_type": "click",
                       "parameters": {"x": 5, "y": 5},
                       "requires_approval": True}]}).json()["mission_id"]
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
            json={"response": "misschien"}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
            json={"response": "YES"}).json()["status"] == "approved"
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
            json={"response": "YES"}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick").status_code == 200
        paused = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/pause")
        assert paused.json()["status"] == "paused"
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick").status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/resume").json()["status"] \
            == "running"
        cancelled = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/cancel")
        assert cancelled.json()["status"] == "cancelled"
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick").status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/cancel").status_code == 422


# -- full chain: mission -> dact -> agent -> observation -> next -----------

def test_full_step_chain_with_agent(tmp_path, monkeypatch, fakes):
    for test_client in client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(test_client)
        mission_id = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": conversation,
            "goal": "Open mijn project en kijk wat er nog moet gebeuren",
            "steps": [
                {"kind": "readout", "description": "Lees projectcontext",
                 "parameters": {"source": "project"}},
                {"kind": "desktop", "description": "Bekijk desktop",
                 "action_type": "screenshot", "parameters": {},
                 "required_capabilities": ["desktop.screen.read"]},
                {"kind": "analysis", "description": "Vat samen",
                 "parameters": {}},
            ]}).json()["mission_id"]
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES"})
        first = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
        assert first.status_code == 200, first.text
        # readout done, screenshot proposed (auto-approved by policy)
        state = test_client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert state["steps"][0]["status"] == "completed"
        action_id = state["steps"][1]["desktop_action_id"]
        assert action_id.startswith("dact-")

        # binding proof travels with the action
        fetched = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}").json()
        assert fetched["mission_id"] == mission_id
        assert fetched["step_id"] == state["steps"][1]["step_id"]

        # standalone agent claims and "executes" (simulated via HTTP)
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "desktop-chain-01", "hostname": "pc",
            "capabilities": ["agent:desktop", "desktop.screen.read"],
            "node_token": "chain-token-123456"})
        claimed = test_client.post("/api/v1/desktop/actions/next",
                                   json={"node_id": "desktop-chain-01",
                                         "node_token":
                                         "chain-token-123456"})
        assert claimed.json()["action_id"] == action_id
        assert claimed.json()["mission_id"] == mission_id
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}/result",
                         json={"status": "completed",
                               "observation_reference": "obs-chain-1"})

        second = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
        assert second.status_code == 200, second.text
        done = test_client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert done["status"] == "completed"
        assert done["steps"][1]["observation_reference"] == "obs-chain-1"
        assert done["steps"][1]["status"] == "completed"

        events = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/events").json()
        types = [event["event_type"] for event in events]
        assert "mission_created" in types
        assert "mission_approved" in types
        assert "step_completed" in types
        assert "observation" in types
        assert "mission_completed" in types

        thread = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation}").json()
        texts = [msg["content"] for msg in thread["messages"]
                 if msg["role"] == "assistant"]
        assert any("Missie voltooid" in text for text in texts)
        assert any(action_id in text for text in texts)


def test_desktop_step_waits_for_human_yes(tmp_path, monkeypatch, fakes):
    for test_client in client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(test_client)
        mission_id = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": conversation, "goal": "klik iets",
            "steps": [{"kind": "desktop", "description": "Klik",
                       "action_type": "click",
                       "parameters": {"x": 10, "y": 10},
                       "requires_approval": True}]}).json()["mission_id"]
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES"})
        ticked = test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
        assert ticked.json()["outcome"] == "waiting"
        state = test_client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert state["status"] == "running"  # plan approved, step gated
        assert state["steps"][0]["status"] == "waiting_approval"
        action_id = state["steps"][0]["desktop_action_id"]
        # agent cannot claim before approval
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "desktop-wait-01", "hostname": "pc",
            "capabilities": ["agent:desktop", "desktop.mouse.click"],
            "node_token": "wait-token-123456"})
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/desktop/actions/next", json={
            "node_id": "desktop-wait-01",
            "node_token": "wait-token-123456"}).json() is None
        # human YES unblocks; agent claims; failure stops mission safely
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}/decision",
                         json={"response": "YES"})
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/desktop/actions/next", json={
            "node_id": "desktop-wait-01",
            "node_token": "wait-token-123456"}).json()[
                "action_id"] == action_id
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}/result",
                         json={"status": "failed",
                               "error": "knop niet gevonden"})
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
        failed = test_client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert failed["status"] == "failed"
        assert failed["steps"][0]["status"] == "failed"


def test_scope_violation_blocks_step(tmp_path, monkeypatch, fakes):
    import sqlite3
    for test_client in client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        conversation = make_conversation(test_client)
        mission_id = test_client.post("/api/v1/missions", json={
            "conversation_id": conversation, "goal": "kijk",
            "steps": [{"kind": "desktop", "description": "Kijk",
                       "action_type": "screenshot", "parameters": {}}]
        }).json()["mission_id"]
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES"})
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
        state = test_client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        action_id = state["steps"][0]["desktop_action_id"]
        # attacker removes the binding: executor must block, never adopt
        db_path = os.environ["MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"]
        db = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
        db.execute("DELETE FROM action_bindings WHERE action_id=?",
                   (action_id,))
        db.commit()
        db.close()
        test_client.post("/api/v1/nodes/register", json={
            "node_id": "desktop-scope-01", "hostname": "pc",
            "capabilities": ["agent:desktop", "desktop.screen.read"],
            "node_token": "scope-token-123456"})
        test_client.post("/api/v1/desktop/actions/next",
                         json={"node_id": "desktop-scope-01",
                               "node_token": "scope-token-123456"})
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/desktop/actions/{action_id}/result",
                         json={"status": "completed",
                               "observation_reference": "obs-x"})
        test_client.post(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}/tick")
        blocked = test_client.get(f"/api/v1/missions/{mission_id}").json()
        assert blocked["status"] == "blocked"
        assert blocked["steps"][0]["status"] == "blocked"

def test_graph_nodes_printers_overlay(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import asyncio
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import GraphResponse
    from coordinator.app.worldgraph import build_world_graph

    class Reader:
        async def graph(self, entity_id, depth=1):
            return GraphResponse(entity_id=entity_id, depth=depth,
                                 nodes=[], edges=[])

    async def run():
        return await build_world_graph(
            Reader(), "obj_x", 1,
            registry_nodes=[{"node_id": "node-1", "hostname": "h",
                    "tier": "worker", "derived_status": "online",
                    "capabilities": ["a", "b"],
                    "models": [{"model_id": "model:x"}],
                    "last_seen": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"}],
            printers=[{"printer_id": "prt-1", "name": "P",
                        "status": "registered",
                        "capabilities": ["printer.start"],
                        "inventory_hardware_id": ""}])

    graph = asyncio.run(run())
    node_ids = [node["id"] for node in graph["nodes"]]
    assert "node-1" in node_ids
    assert "prt-1" in node_ids
    node = next(entry for entry in graph["nodes"]
                if entry["id"] == "node-1")
    assert node["source"] == "mycelium"
    assert node["metadata"]["revision"] != ""

def test_mesh_preview_and_transform(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    from coordinator.app.mesh3d import ProceduralTestGenerator
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        generated = ProceduralTestGenerator().generate("kubus",
                                                       {})
        preview = test_client.get("/api/v1/fab/mesh/preview",
                                  params={
                                      "artifact_ref":
                                      generated.artifact_ref,
                                      "max_tris": 100}).json()
        assert preview["total_tris"] == 12
        assert len(preview["tris"]) == 12
        assert len(preview["tris"][0]) == 3
        refused = test_client.get("/api/v1/fab/mesh/preview",
                                  params={"artifact_ref":
                                          "../x.stl"})
        assert refused.status_code == 422
        # Preview-only transform: nothing persisted.
        moved = test_client.post("/api/v1/fab/transform", json={
            "artifact_ref": generated.artifact_ref,
            "op": "rotate",
            "params": {"axis": "z", "degrees": 90}}).json()
        assert moved["executed"] is False
        assert len(moved["preview_tris"]) == 12
        assert moved["preview_tris"] != preview["tris"]
        bad = test_client.post("/api/v1/fab/transform", json={
            "artifact_ref": generated.artifact_ref,
            "op": "melt", "params": {}})
        assert bad.status_code == 422
        bad2 = test_client.post("/api/v1/fab/transform", json={
            "artifact_ref": generated.artifact_ref,
            "op": "scale", "params": {"factor": 0}})
        assert bad2.status_code == 422
        # Persisted transform: local derived file + payload for
        # the proposal flow, nothing registered automatically.
        kept = test_client.post("/api/v1/fab/transform", json={
            "artifact_ref": generated.artifact_ref,
            "op": "translate",
            "params": {"dx": 5, "dy": 0, "dz": 0},
            "persist": True}).json()
        assert kept["executed"] is True
        assert kept["derived_ref"].startswith("fab-derived-")
        assert kept["file_payload"]["file_kind"] == "mesh"
        assert kept["validation"]["verdict"] == "valid"


def test_live_sessions_and_caps(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        opened = test_client.post("/api/v1/live/sessions", json={
            "interface": "web", "actor": "jelles",
            "capabilities": ["inventory.read", "git.diff"]}).json()
        session_id = opened["session_id"]
        assert session_id.startswith("live-")
        fetched = test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/live/sessions/{session_id}").json()
        assert fetched["active"] is True
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/live/sessions/live-missing/revoke"
        ).status_code == 404
        revoked = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/live/sessions/{session_id}/revoke").json()
        assert revoked["active"] is False
        assert test_client.get(
            f"/api/v1/live/sessions/{session_id}").status_code == 403
        # git.push is never granted, unknown caps refuse.
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/live/sessions", json={
            "interface": "web", "actor": "jelles",
            "capabilities": ["git.push"]}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.post("/api/v1/live/sessions", json={
            "interface": "web", "actor": "jelles",
            "capabilities": ["nope.everything"]}).status_code == 422
        assert test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/live/sessions/live-missing").status_code == 404

def test_library_license_terms_mapping():
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import license_terms

    nc = license_terms("CC-BY-NC-4.0")
    assert nc["commercial_use"] is False
    assert nc["attribution_required"] is True
    assert nc["known"] is True

    cc0 = license_terms("CC0-1.0")
    assert cc0["commercial_use"] is True
    assert cc0["attribution_required"] is False

    # Unknown license: everything stays undecided, never assumed.
    unknown = license_terms("some-custom-portal-terms-v2")
    assert unknown["known"] is False
    assert unknown["commercial_use"] is None
    assert unknown["remix_allowed"] is None
    assert unknown["attribution_required"] is None


def test_library_license_vague_names_refused():
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import (
        WorkshopRefusedError,
        clean_library_license,
    )

    for vague in ("open source", "Open-Source", "free",
                  "free for use"):
        try:
            clean_library_license({
                "source_library": "wikimedia-commons",
                "license": vague})
        except WorkshopRefusedError:
            continue
        raise AssertionError(
            f"vague license '{vague}' was accepted")


def test_library_license_required_for_external_origin():
    from coordinator.app.workshop3d import (
        WorkshopRefusedError,
        clean_library_license,
    )

    # External origin without actual license terms is refused.
    try:
        clean_library_license({
            "source_library": "nih-3d",
            "source_url": "https://3d.nih.gov/entries/123",
            "author": "NIH"})
    except WorkshopRefusedError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("licenseless import was accepted")

    # Known terms fill only undecided flags; explicit flags win.
    lic = clean_library_license({
        "source_library": "nasa-3d",
        "source_url": "https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/moon/",
        "author": "NASA",
        "license": "NASA",
        "original_model_url": "https://science.nasa.gov/x"})
    assert lic.commercial_use is True
    assert lic.attribution_required is False
    assert lic.imported_at != ""

    strict = clean_library_license({
        "source_library": "wikimedia-commons",
        "license": "CC-BY-4.0",
        "commercial_use": False})
    assert strict.commercial_use is False
    assert strict.remix_allowed is True


def test_library_license_attach_and_file_fields(tmp_path,
                                                monkeypatch):
    import coordinator.app.workshop3d as workshop

    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "lic.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "lic-chat.db"))
    record = {
        "model_id": "mdl_lictest01",
        "filename": "moon-far-side.stl",
        "library_ref": "bibliotheek/moon-far-side.stl",
        "mime_type": "model/stl",
        "size_bytes": 84,
        "sha256": "a" * 64,
        "source": "library",
        "status": "imported",
        "inspection": {"mesh_verdict": "UNKNOWN"},
        "license": None,
        "created_at": "2026-10-05T00:00:00+00:00",
        "updated_at": "2026-10-05T00:00:00+00:00",
    }
    workshop._save("workshop_models", "mdl_lictest01",
                   "model_id", record,
                   "2026-10-05T00:00:00+00:00")
    updated = workshop.attach_library_license(
        "mdl_lictest01", {
            "source_library": "nasa-3d",
            "source_url": "https://science.nasa.gov/3d-resources/",
            "author": "NASA",
            "license": "CC-BY-NC-4.0",
            "original_model_url": "https://science.nasa.gov/x"},
        actor="operator")
    assert updated["license"]["license"] == "CC-BY-NC-4.0"
    assert updated["license"]["commercial_use"] is False
    assert updated["license"]["source_library"] == "nasa-3d"

    fields = workshop.library_file_fields(updated)
    block = fields["metadata"]["license"]
    for key in ("source_library", "source_url", "author",
                "license", "commercial_use", "remix_allowed",
                "attribution_required", "original_model_url",
                "imported_at"):
        assert key in block
    assert "NIET toegestaan" in fields["description"]
    assert "CC-BY-NC-4.0" in fields["description"]

    # Model without license keeps the old proposal shape.
    plain = workshop.library_file_fields(record)
    assert "license" not in plain["metadata"]

def _mini_stl() -> bytes:
    """One-triangle binary STL (134 bytes, validator-verdict)."""
    import struct
    return b"\0" * 80 + struct.pack("<I", 1) + b"\0" * 50

def _commons_search_json() -> bytes:
    import json
    return json.dumps({"query": {"search": [
        {"ns": 6, "title": "File:Moon test.stl"}]}}).encode()


def _commons_detail_json(license_name="CC BY-SA 4.0") -> bytes:
    import json
    meta = {"Artist": {"value": "Test Maker"},
            "LicenseUrl": {"value": "https://creativecommons.org/x"},
            "UsageTerms": {"value": "Creative Commons"},
            "AttributionRequired": {"value": "true"}}
    if license_name:
        meta["LicenseShortName"] = {"value": license_name}
    return json.dumps({"query": {"pages": {"123": {
        "pageid": 123, "ns": 6, "title": "File:Moon test.stl",
        "imageinfo": [{
            "size": 134,
            "url": ("https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/"
                    "commons/m/Moon_test.stl"),
            "descriptionurl": ("https://commons.wikimedia.org/"
                               "wiki/File:Moon_test.stl"),
            "extmetadata": meta}]}}}}).encode()


def _fake_http_get_factory(monkeypatch, download_bytes=None,
                           license_name="CC BY-SA 4.0"):
    import coordinator.app.library_sources as libmod

    def _fake(url, *, max_bytes):
        if "list=search" in url:
            return (200, {"content-type": "application/json"},
                    _commons_search_json())
        if "prop=imageinfo" in url:
            return (200, {"content-type": "application/json"},
                    _commons_detail_json(license_name))
        assert download_bytes is not None, url
        if len(download_bytes) > max_bytes:
            raise AssertionError("byte cap bypassed")
        return (200, {"content-type": "model/stl"},
                download_bytes)

    monkeypatch.setattr(libmod, "_http_get", _fake)


def test_library_search_happy_path(tmp_path, monkeypatch):

    assert hit["remix_allowed"] is True
    assert hit["attribution_required"] is True

def test_library_search_marks_unknown_import_blocked(tmp_path,
                                                      monkeypatch):
    import coordinator.app.library_sources as libmod
    _lib_env(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    # No machine-readable terms at all -> skipped, never listed
    # as permission.
    _fake_http_get_factory(monkeypatch, license_name="")
    found = libmod.search_commons("moon")
    assert found["results"] == []
    # A specific but unknown license is shown honestly (all
    # flags undecided) ...
    _fake_http_get_factory(monkeypatch,
                           license_name="Custom Portal Terms v3")
    found = libmod.search_commons("moon")
    assert len(found["results"]) == 1
    hit = found["results"][0]
    assert hit["commercial_use"] is None
    # ... and the import gate blocks every use until checked.
    try:
        libmod.gate_import(
            {"source_library": "wikimedia-commons",
             "license": hit["license"]},
            intended_use="private")
    except libmod.LibraryRefusedError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("unknown license imported")

def test_library_yes_gate_still_required(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import pytest
    import coordinator.app.library_sources as libmod
    from coordinator.app.controlled_writes import (
        decide_write,
        request_write_approval,
        revalidate,
    )
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import (
        propose_inventory_write,
    )
    _lib_env(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    _fake_http_get_factory(monkeypatch,
                           download_bytes=_mini_stl())
    result = libmod.import_downloaded(
        source="nasa-3d",
        file_url="https://science.nasa.gov/moon.stl",
        license={"source_library": "nasa-3d", "license": "NASA"},
        intended_use="private")
    proposal = propose_inventory_write(
        "wrt-libgate1", "create", "file", result["fields"],
        actor="bibliotheek-import")
    request = request_write_approval(proposal)
    # Exact YES approves; anything else never executes.
    approved = decide_write(request, proposal, "YES",
                            decided_by="jelles")
    assert approved.approved is True
    rejected = decide_write(request, proposal, "NO")
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Only an approved"):
        revalidate(proposal, rejected)

def load_discovery():
    if not DISCOVERY.exists():
        return {"computer": "unknown", "projects": [], "timestamp": "nooit"}
    return json.loads(DISCOVERY.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def load_relations():
    """Stable IDs + relations from project_index.json, keyed by path.

    Best-effort: missing or invalid index means no relation badges,
    never a broken page. The index only ever derives from our own
    discovery.json (see project_index.py)."""
    try:
        if not INDEX.exists():
            return {}
        index = json.loads(INDEX.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        by_path = {}
        for entry in index.get("projects", []):
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                continue
            path = entry.get("path")
            if not isinstance(path, str):
                continue
            relations = entry.get("relations", {}) or {}
            by_path[path] = {
                "stable_id": entry.get("id", ""),
                "parent_id": relations.get("parent_id"),
                "nested_children": relations.get("nested_children_ids", []) or [],
                "possible_copies": relations.get("possible_copy_ids", []) or [],
            }
        return by_path
    except Exception:
        return {}


@app.route("/")
def index():
    data = load_discovery()
    raw_projects = data.get("projects", [])
    relations = load_relations()
    projects = []
    for project in raw_projects:
        merged = dict(project)
        info = relations.get(project.get("path", ""))
        if info:
            merged.update(info)
        else:
            merged.setdefault("stable_id", "")
            merged.setdefault("parent_id", None)
            merged.setdefault("nested_children", [])
            merged.setdefault("possible_copies", [])
        projects.append(merged)
    return render_template_string(HTML, computer=data.get("computer", "unknown"), projects=projects, git_count=sum(1 for p in projects if p.get("git")), timestamp=data.get("timestamp", "onbekend"))


@app.post("/scan")
def scan():
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(AGENT)], check=True)
    try:
        # Keep relations fresh: the index purely derives from the
        # discovery.json just written. Best-effort, never fails scan.
        subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c",
                        "import project_index; project_index.main()"],
                       check=False, cwd=str(BASE))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return redirect("/")
if __name__ == "__main__":
    app.run(host="127.0.0.1", port=8787, debug=False)
