<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/presence.py">
"""Presence ecosystem (BIG #40): what deserves Jelles' attention.

One unified attention layer over existing stores — no duplicate
state. Every item is derived live from approvals, missions,
nodes, telemetry, research, candidates, conversations, cameras,
craft, symbiosis, automation and fabrication. The ONLY thing
presence stores is the operator's own triage (SEEN/DEFERRED) in
the chat DB; everything else is read fresh on every call.

Attention item:
  {id, type, band, priority, priority_reasons, title, reason,
   source, related_entity, related_mission, related_task,
   action, open_href, created_at, updated_at, status,
   provenance}

Bands (display categories, not authority):
  needs (NEEDS YOU), waiting (WAITING), available (AVAILABLE),
  discovered (DISCOVERED), offline (OFFLINE).

Statuses:
  NEW / ACTIONABLE — derived from live sources.
  SEEN / DEFERRED — operator triage (stored; DEFER performs
    nothing, it only hides the item from NEEDS).
  RESOLVED — override exists but the source cleared (shown
    briefly from the stored snapshot, then pruned).
  EXPIRED — a DEFERRED item older than 7 days.

Priority is deterministic and rule-based (never an LLM):
base score per type + age bonus (1/hour, capped at +24), with
every point explained in priority_reasons. Same store state
always yields the same order.

Security: item ids are stable derivations of real ids
(`att_<kind>_<real_id>`); triage of an id that is not
currently derived is refused (fake ids, fake missions, replay
all fail). Presence never approves, executes, or grants
authority — YES/NO always travel through the existing gates.
All display text is clipped; rendering escapes via ui.esc.
Health content is never pulled in. Node capabilities are shown
as advertisements ("advertises X"), never as attestations.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
import time
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone

STATUSES = frozenset({
    "NEW", "SEEN", "DEFERRED", "ACTIONABLE", "RESOLVED", "EXPIRED",
})

    "waiting": {"glyph": "🟡", "title": "WAITING"},

MAX_ITEMS = 120

MAX_REASON = 240
MAX_TEXT = 160

ITEM_ID_PATTERN = re.compile(r"^att_[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$")
MAX_ITEM_ID = 160

TRIAGE_TTL_DAYS = 7
TRIAGE_PRUNE_DAYS = 30


class PresenceRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Presence refused; nothing was stored, nothing was done."""


def now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


def _clip(text, limit: int = MAX_TEXT) -> str:
    return " ".join(str(text or "").split())[:limit]


def _parse_time(value: str) -> datetime | None:
    try:
        moment = datetime.fromisoformat(str(value or ""))
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        return None
    if moment.tzinfo is None:
        moment = moment.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    return moment


def _age_hours(created_at: str) -> int:
    moment = _parse_time(created_at)
    if moment is None:
        return 0
    delta = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - moment
    if delta.total_seconds() < 0:
        return 0
    return int(delta.total_seconds() // 3600)


def score_item(item_type: str, created_at: str = "",
               extra: int = 0) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    """Deterministic priority + human-readable reasons.

    Pure function (no I/O): base score per closed type, +1 per
    hour of age capped at +24, plus an explicit extra with the
    caller's reason appended by the caller. Same inputs always
    yield the same output.
    """
    if item_type not in ITEM_TYPES:
        raise PresenceRefusedError(
            f"Unknown attention type '{item_type}'")
    base = BASE_SCORE.get(item_type, 10)
    reasons = [f"{BASE_WHY.get(item_type, item_type)} (+{base})"]
    age = _age_hours(created_at)
    bonus = min(24, age)
    if bonus:
        reasons.append(f"waiting {age}h (+{bonus})")
    if extra:
        reasons.append(f"linked strain (+{extra})")
    return base + bonus + extra, reasons


def _item(item_id: str, item_type: str, title: str, reason: str,
          source: str, action: dict | None = None,
          open_href: str = "", related_entity: str = "",
          related_mission: str = "", related_task: str = "",
          created_at: str = "", updated_at: str = "",
          extra_score: int = 0,
          extra_reason: str = "") -> dict:
    if item_type not in ITEM_TYPES:
        raise PresenceRefusedError(
            f"Unknown attention type '{item_type}'")
    if (not re.match(ITEM_ID_PATTERN, item_id)
            or len(item_id) > MAX_ITEM_ID):
        raise PresenceRefusedError(
            "Attention id must be att_<real-id>")
    priority, reasons = score_item(item_type, created_at,
                                   extra_score)
    if extra_reason:
        reasons.append(extra_reason)
    return {
        "id": item_id,
        "type": item_type,
        "band": TYPE_BAND[item_type],
        "priority": priority,
        "priority_reasons": reasons,
        "title": _clip(title, MAX_TITLE),
        "reason": _clip(reason, MAX_REASON),
        "source": _clip(source, 80),
        "related_entity": str(related_entity or "")[:100],
        "related_mission": str(related_mission or "")[:80],
        "related_task": str(related_task or "")[:80],
        "action": dict(action or {}),
        "open_href": str(open_href or "")[:200],
        "created_at": str(created_at or "")[:40],
        "updated_at": str(updated_at or created_at or "")[:40],
        "status": "ACTIONABLE" if action else "NEW",
        "provenance": {"source_type": "derived",
                       "creator_id": "presence-engine",
                       "human_verified": False},
    }


def _yes_no_open(yes_href: str, no_href: str,
                 open_href: str) -> dict:
    return {"YES": {"label": "YES", "href": yes_href,
                    "method": "POST"},
            "NO": {"label": "NO", "href": no_href,
                   "method": "POST"},
            "OPEN": {"label": "OPEN", "href": open_href,
                     "method": "GET"}}


def _open_defer(open_href: str) -> dict:
    return {"OPEN": {"label": "OPEN", "href": open_href,
                     "method": "GET"},
            "DEFER": {"label": "DEFER",
                      "href": "/api/v1/presence/defer",
                      "method": "POST"}}

def _collect_approvals(items: list) -> None:
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        status = _main.coordinator_status()
    except Exception:
        return
    approvals = status.get("pending_approvals", {})
    if not approvals:
        return
    try:
        desktop = _main._desktop_list(limit=20,
                                      status="pending_approval")
    except Exception:
        desktop = []
    for entry in desktop[:10]:
        try:
            record = entry.get("record", {})
            if isinstance(record, str):
                from .database import load
                record = load(record)
            action = record.get("action", {})
            action_id = str(action.get("action_id", ""))
            if not action_id:
                continue
            items.append(_item(
                f"att_approval_desktop_{action_id}",
                "approval_desktop",
                f"Desktop action waits: "
                f"{action.get('action_type', '?')}",
                str((action.get("parameters", {}) or {}).get(
                    "reason", "The desktop agent proposed one "
                    "bounded step.")),
                "desktop agent proposal",
                action=_yes_no_open(
                    f"/web/desktop/{action_id}/decision",
                    f"/web/desktop/{action_id}/decision",
                    "/agents"),
                open_href="/agents",
                created_at=str(entry.get("created_at", "")),
                updated_at=str(entry.get("created_at", ""))))
        except Exception:
            continue
    try:
        writes = [item for item in _main._write_list(limit=30)
                  if item.get("status") == "proposed"]
    except Exception:
        writes = []
    for entry in writes[:10]:
        try:
            proposal_id = str(entry.get("proposal_id", ""))
            if not proposal_id:
                continue
            items.append(_item(
                f"att_approval_write_{proposal_id}",
                "approval_write",
                f"Write proposal waits: "
                f"{entry.get('summary', '?')}",
                "A flow proposed a persistent or physical "
                "change and stopped for your decision.",
                "writes inbox proposal",
                action=_yes_no_open(
                    f"/web/writes/{proposal_id}/approve",
                    f"/web/writes/{proposal_id}/approve",
                    "/writes"),
                open_href="/writes",
                created_at=str(entry.get("created_at", "")),
                updated_at=str(entry.get("created_at", ""))))
        except Exception:
            continue
    try:
        from .missions import list_missions
        missions = [m for m in list_missions(limit=30)
                    if m.status == "pending_approval"]
    except Exception:
        missions = []
    for mission in missions[:10]:
        try:
            items.append(_item(
                f"att_approval_mission_{mission.mission_id}",
                "approval_mission",
                f"Mission waits: {mission.goal}",
                "A plan waits inside an approved-plan boundary. "
                "YES starts it; each consequential step asks "
                "again.",
                "mission plan",
                action=_yes_no_open(
                    f"/web/missions/{mission.mission_id}/approve",
                    f"/web/missions/{mission.mission_id}/cancel",
                    f"/missions/{mission.mission_id}"),
                open_href=f"/missions/{mission.mission_id}",
                related_mission=mission.mission_id,
                created_at=str(getattr(
                    mission, "created_at", "")),
                updated_at=str(getattr(
                    mission, "created_at", ""))))
        except Exception:
            continue

def _collect_nodes(items: list) -> None:
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        nodes = _main.list_nodes()
    except Exception:
        return
    for node in nodes:
        try:
            node_id = str(node.get("node_id", ""))
            if not node_id:
                continue
            name = (node.get("display_name")
                    or node.get("hostname") or node_id)
            derived = str(node.get("derived_status", ""))
            health = str(node.get("health_status", "UNKNOWN"))
            if derived in ("offline",) or health == "OFFLINE":
                items.append(_item(
                    f"att_node_offline_{node_id}",
                    "node_offline",
                    f"Node '{name}' is offline.",
                    "A pull-only helper stopped claiming work. "
                    "Queued tasks wait for a capable node.",
                    "node registry",
                    action=_open_defer("/nodes"),
                    open_href="/nodes",
                    updated_at=str(node.get("last_seen", ""))))
            elif derived == "stale" or health == "STALE":
                items.append(_item(
                    f"att_node_stale_{node_id}",
                    "node_stale",
                    f"Node '{name}' is stale.",
                    "No heartbeat for over 60 seconds. Check "
                    "connectivity before routing work to it.",
                    "node registry",
                    action=_open_defer("/nodes"),
                    open_href="/nodes",
                    updated_at=str(node.get("last_seen", ""))))
            elif health == "DEGRADED":
                items.append(_item(
                    f"att_telemetry_stale_{node_id}",
                    "telemetry_stale",
                    f"Node '{name}' telemetry is stale.",
                    "Telemetry older than 5 minutes. Routing "
                    "treats this node as degraded.",
                    "node telemetry",
                    action=_open_defer("/nodes"),
                    open_href="/nodes",
                    updated_at=str(node.get(
                        "telemetry_timestamp", ""))))
            if health != "ONLINE":
                continue
            for hw in (node.get("hardware") or []):
                if not isinstance(hw, dict):
                    continue
                ident = str(hw.get("identifier", ""))
                kind = str(hw.get("kind", "?"))
                if not ident:
                    continue
                safe = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+", "_",
                              ident)[:80]
                if str(hw.get("status", "")) == "disconnected":
                    items.append(_item(
                        f"att_hw_offline_{node_id}_{safe}",
                        "hardware_offline",
                        f"Hardware '{ident}' ({kind}) on "
                        f"'{name}' disconnected.",
                        "Previously seen, currently gone. Tasks "
                        "needing it wait honestly.",
                        "node hardware report",
                        action=_open_defer("/nodes"),
                        open_href="/nodes"))
                elif str(hw.get("status", "")) == "connected":
                    items.append(_item(
                        f"att_hw_available_{node_id}_{safe}",
                        "hardware_available",
                        f"Hardware '{ident}' ({kind}) on "
                        f"'{name}' available.",
                        "Connected and routable for tasks that "
                        "require it.",
                        "node hardware report",
                        action=_open_defer("/nodes"),
                        open_href="/nodes"))
            for comp in (node.get("compute_capabilities") or []):
                if not isinstance(comp, dict):
                    continue
                cap = str(comp.get("capability", ""))
                if (cap in ("ollama", "gpu_available")
                        and str(comp.get("status", ""))
                        == "available"):
                    items.append(_item(
                        f"att_cap_available_{node_id}_{cap}",
                        "capability_available",
                        f"Node '{name}' offers {cap}.",
                        "Routable now for tasks that require "
                        "this capability.",
                        "node compute report",
                        action=_open_defer("/nodes"),
                        open_href="/nodes"))
        except Exception:
            continue


def _collect_automation(items: list) -> None:

            state = str(getattr(
                dossier, "execution_state", ""))
            if state in ("COMPLETED", "READY", "completed"):
                claims = len(getattr(dossier, "claims", [])
                             or [])
                items.append(_item(
                    f"att_research_{dossier.dossier_id}",
                    "research_finding",
                    f"Research ready: {dossier.title}",
                    f"{claims} claim(s) with evidence. Review "
                    "before promoting anything.",
                    "research engine",
                    action=_open_defer("/research"),
                    open_href="/research",
                    created_at=str(getattr(
                        dossier, "created_at", "")),
                    updated_at=str(getattr(
                        dossier, "created_at", ""))))
        except Exception:
            continue
    # Node-aware research readiness (BIG #39 hardware reality).
    readiness = research_readiness()
    if readiness["eligible"]:
        return
    if readiness["checked"]:
        items.append(_item(
            "att_research_waiting_nodes",
            "research_waiting",
            "Research is waiting: no eligible node.",
            readiness["text"],
            "task routing",
            action=_open_defer("/nodes"),
            open_href="/nodes"))


def research_readiness() -> dict:
    """Which nodes could run research right now, and why not.

    Pure routing explanation over live registry state: eligible
    node ids plus per-node rejection reasons. Never executes.
    """
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        from .routing import check_requirements, route_task
        nodes = _main.list_nodes()
        requirements = check_requirements({
            "required_capabilities": ["research.fetch",
                                      "analysis.ollama"]})
        decision = route_task(requirements, [
            {**node,
             "capabilities": node.get("capabilities", []),
             "models": node.get("models", []),
             "executors": node.get("executors", []),
             "resources": node.get("resources", {}),
             "locality_zone": node.get("locality_zone",
                                       "local_network"),
             "status": node.get("derived_status", "unknown"),
             "fresh": node.get("derived_status") in (
                 "online", "busy"),
             "authenticated": node.get("last_auth") == "token",
             "hardware": node.get("hardware", []),
             "compute_capabilities": node.get(
                 "compute_capabilities", []),
             "telemetry_timestamp": node.get(
                 "telemetry_timestamp", ""),
             "health_status": node.get("health_status",
                                       "UNKNOWN")}
            for node in nodes if node.get("node_id")])
    except Exception:
        return {"eligible": [], "unavailable": [],
                "text": "Routing unavailable.", "checked": False}
    unavailable = [{"node_id": entry.node_id,
                    "reasons": list(entry.reasons)}
                   for entry in decision.rejected]
    if decision.selected_node_id is not None:
        return {"eligible": decision.eligible_nodes,
                "unavailable": unavailable,
                "text": f"{decision.selected_node_id} can run "
                        "research now.",
                "checked": True}
    detail = "; ".join(
        f"{entry['node_id']}: "
        f"{entry['reasons'][0] if entry['reasons'] else '?'}"
        for entry in unavailable[:3])
    return {"eligible": [],
            "unavailable": unavailable,
            "text": f"No eligible node with Ollama + fetch. "
                    f"{detail}" if detail else
                    "No nodes registered.",
            "checked": True}

        found = discoveries(limit=6)
    except Exception:

def _collect_craft(items: list) -> None:
    try:
        from .workshop3d import list_models
        from .knowledge import list_candidates
        models = list_models(limit=50)
        candidates = list_candidates(limit=300)
    except Exception:
        return
    linked: set[str] = set()
    for entry in candidates:
        try:
            data = entry.model_dump(mode="json")
        except Exception:
            continue
        if data.get("candidate_type") != "connection":
            continue
        for ref in data.get("entity_refs") or []:
            if str(ref).startswith("mdl_"):
                linked.add(str(ref))
    for model in models[:20]:
        try:
            model_id = str(model.get("model_id", ""))
            if not model_id or model_id in linked:
                continue
            items.append(_item(
                f"att_craft_gap_{model_id}",
                "craft_gap",
                f"{model.get('filename', '?')[:60]} has no "
                "material or project.",
                "A model alone builds nothing — link material "
                "and a project to start a craft chain.",
                "3D workshop",
                action=_open_defer("/3d"),
                open_href="/3d",
                related_entity=model_id))
            if len([i for i in items
                    if i["type"] == "craft_gap"]) >= 3:
                break
        except Exception:
            continue


def _collect_ecosystem(items: list) -> None:
    """BIG #42 ecosystem hardening: unverified hardware, blocked
    quests, pending finance, unknown energy. All best-effort,
    all link to their real record."""
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        nodes = _main.list_nodes()
    except Exception:
        nodes = []
    try:
        from .hardware_links import list_links as _hw_links
        verified_refs = {(link.node_id, link.device_ref)
                         for link in _hw_links(status="VERIFIED",
                                                limit=200)}
        proposed_count = len(_hw_links(status="PROPOSED",
                                       limit=200))
    except Exception:
        verified_refs = set()
        proposed_count = 0
    unverified = []
    for node in nodes:
        node_id = str(node.get("node_id", ""))
        for hw in (node.get("hardware", []) or []):
            if not isinstance(hw, dict):
                continue
            ident = str(hw.get("identifier", ""))
            if ident and (node_id, ident) not in verified_refs:
                unverified.append((node_id, ident,
                                   str(hw.get("kind", ""))))
    for node_id, ident, kind in unverified[:3]:
        items.append(_item(
            f"att_hardware_unverified_{node_id}_{ident}"[:150],
            "hardware_unverified",
            f"{node_id} advertises {kind or 'hardware'} "
            f"'{ident[:40]}' — not human-verified.",
            "Advertised is not a fact; only a human link "
            "verifies it.",
            "node registry",
            action=_open_defer("/hardware"),
            open_href="/hardware",
            created_at=node.get("last_seen", "") if isinstance(
                node, dict) else "",
            updated_at=""))
    if proposed_count and not unverified:
        items.append(_item(
            "att_hardware_unverified_proposed",
            "hardware_unverified",
            f"{proposed_count} hardware link(s) wait for "
            "operator verification.",
            "Proposed links verify nothing until a human with "
            "the operator key confirms them.",
            "hardware links",
            action=_open_defer("/hardware"),
            open_href="/hardware"))
    try:
        from .quests import list_quest_details as _quests
        for quest in _quests(limit=20):
            if quest.get("state") in ("BLOCKED", "FAILED"):
                items.append(_item(
                    f"att_quest_blocked_{quest.get('quest_id', '')}"
                    [:150],
                    "quest_blocked",
                    f"Quest '{quest.get('title', '')[:70]}' is "
                    f"{quest.get('state', '')} at "
                    f"{quest.get('done', 0)}/"
                    f"{quest.get('total', 0)}.",
                    "A step's underlying record failed or is "
                    "blocked.",
                    "quest trails",
                    action=_open_defer("/quests"),
                    open_href="/quests"))
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .campaigns import list_campaign_details as _camps
        for campaign in _camps(limit=10):
            if campaign.get("state") in ("BLOCKED", "FAILED"):
                items.append(_item(
                    f"att_campaign_blocked_"
                    f"{campaign.get('campaign_id', '')}"[:150],
                    "campaign_blocked",
                    f"Campaign "
                    f"'{campaign.get('title', '')[:70]}' is "
                    f"{campaign.get('state', '')} at "
                    f"{campaign.get('completed_count', 0)}/"
                    f"{campaign.get('total_count', 0)}.",
                    "A quest in the chain failed or is "
                    "blocked.",
                    "quest campaigns",
                    action=_open_defer("/campaigns"),
                    open_href="/campaigns"))
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .finance import list_records as _finance
        drafts = [record for record in _finance(limit=100)
                  if record.status == "DRAFT"][:3]
        for record in drafts:
            items.append(_item(
                f"att_finance_pending_{record.record_id}"[:150],
                "finance_pending",
                f"Finance {record.kind} '{record.title[:60]}' "
                "waits for confirmation.",
                "Draft figures confirm nothing until reviewed.",
                "finance records",
                action=_open_defer("/finance"),
                open_href="/finance"))
            break
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .energy import list_records as _energy
        unknowns = [record for record in _energy(limit=100)

        for record in unknowns:

                f"att_energy_unknown_{record.record_id}"[:150],

                f"Energy {record.source}/{record.kind} has no "

                "Unknown energy honestly blocks energy-aware "
                "decisions until observed.",
                "energy records",
                action=_open_defer("/energy"),

        pass


def _collect_failures(items: list) -> None:
    """Failed tasks/missions from the last 24h bus (honest,
    bounded, no new queries)."""
    try:
        from .events import list_events
        events = list_events(limit=100)
    except Exception:
        return
    cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=24)
    for event in events:
        try:
            if event.event_type not in ("task.failed",
                                        "mission.failed"):
                continue
            moment = _parse_time(event.created_at)
            if moment is None or moment < cutoff:
                continue
            if event.event_type == "task.failed":
                task_id = str(event.task_id or "?")
                items.append(_item(
                    f"att_task_failed_{task_id}",
                    "task_failed",
                    f"Task {task_id} failed.",
                    str(event.summary or "The task failed "
                        "safely; nothing executed beyond its "
                        "bounds."),
                    "task queue",
                    action=_open_defer("/activity"),
                    open_href="/activity",
                    related_task=task_id,
                    created_at=event.created_at,
                    updated_at=event.created_at))
        except Exception:
            continue


# -- triage store (operator decisions only) --------------------------------------

def _triage_db():
    from .database import chat_connection, init_chat_database
    init_chat_database()
    with chat_connection() as db:
        db.execute(
            "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS attention_triage ("
            "item_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL, "
            "decided_by TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'jelles', "
            "title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "
            "kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "
            "updated_at TEXT NOT NULL)")
    from .database import chat_connection as _conn
    return _conn()


def get_triage() -> dict[str, dict]:
    """All stored triage rows keyed by item id. Read-only."""
    try:
        with _triage_db() as db:
            rows = db.execute(
                "SELECT item_id, status, decided_by, title, "
                "kind, updated_at FROM attention_triage").fetchall()
    except Exception:
        return {}
    return {row["item_id"]: dict(row) for row in rows}


def check_item_id(item_id: str) -> str:
    cleaned = str(item_id or "").strip()[:MAX_ITEM_ID]
    if not re.match(ITEM_ID_PATTERN, cleaned):
        raise PresenceRefusedError(
            "Unknown attention item (bad id shape)")
    return cleaned


def set_triage(item_id: str, status: str,
               decided_by: str = "jelles",
               title: str = "", kind: str = "") -> dict:
    """Store SEEN/DEFERRED for a currently-derived item.

    Refuses unknown statuses, malformed ids, and ids that are
    not live right now (fake ids, resolved items, replay).
    DEFER performs nothing — it only hides the item.
    """
    cleaned_id = check_item_id(item_id)
    cleaned_status = str(status or "").strip().upper()
    if cleaned_status not in ("SEEN", "DEFERRED"):
        raise PresenceRefusedError(
            "Triage stores SEEN or DEFERRED only")
    live = {item["id"] for item in attention_items(limit=200)}
    if cleaned_id not in live:
        raise PresenceRefusedError(
            "Unknown attention item (not live)")
    who = str(decided_by or "jelles").strip()[:80] or "jelles"
    stamp = now()
    with _triage_db() as db:
        db.execute(
            "INSERT INTO attention_triage (item_id, status, "
            "decided_by, title, kind, updated_at) VALUES "
            "(?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(item_id) DO UPDATE "
            "SET status=excluded.status, "
            "decided_by=excluded.decided_by, "
            "title=excluded.title, kind=excluded.kind, "
            "updated_at=excluded.updated_at",
            (cleaned_id, cleaned_status, who,
             str(title or "")[:MAX_TITLE],
             str(kind or "")[:40], stamp))
        db.execute(
            "DELETE FROM attention_triage WHERE updated_at < ?",
            ((datetime.now(timezone.utc)
              - timedelta(days=TRIAGE_PRUNE_DAYS)).isoformat(),))
    return {"item_id": cleaned_id, "status": cleaned_status,
            "decided_by": who, "updated_at": stamp}


# -- aggregation ------------------------------------------------------------------

def _apply_triage(items: list[dict]) -> tuple[list[dict], list[dict]]:
    """Join live items with stored triage. Returns (visible,
    cleared). DEFERRED items hide from NEEDS/WAITING bands but
    stay visible as deferred; source-gone overrides surface as
    RESOLVED/EXPIRED in cleared."""
    triage = get_triage()
    live_ids = {item["id"] for item in items}
    visible: list[dict] = []
    for item in items:
        override = triage.get(item["id"])
        if override and override.get("status") == "DEFERRED":
            moment = _parse_time(override.get("updated_at", ""))
            if (moment is not None and datetime.now(
                    timezone.utc) - moment > timedelta(
                        days=TRIAGE_TTL_DAYS)):
                item["status"] = "EXPIRED"
            else:
                item["status"] = "DEFERRED"
        elif override and override.get("status") == "SEEN":
            item["status"] = "SEEN"
        visible.append(item)
    cleared: list[dict] = []
    cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(
        days=TRIAGE_TTL_DAYS)
    for item_id, row in triage.items():
        if item_id in live_ids:
            continue
        moment = _parse_time(row.get("updated_at", ""))
        if moment is None or moment < cutoff:
            continue
        cleared.append({
            "id": item_id,
            "type": "resolved",
            "band": "discovered",
            "priority": 0,
            "priority_reasons": ["source cleared"],
            "title": row.get("title") or item_id,
            "reason": "This stopped needing attention.",
            "source": "presence memory",
            "related_entity": "",
            "related_mission": "",
            "related_task": "",
            "action": {},
            "open_href": "/activity",
            "created_at": row.get("updated_at", ""),
            "updated_at": row.get("updated_at", ""),
            "status": "RESOLVED",
            "provenance": {"source_type": "derived",
                           "creator_id": "presence-engine",
                           "human_verified": False},
        })
    return visible, cleared


def attention_items(limit: int = MAX_ITEMS) -> list[dict]:
    """Derive all attention items from live stores. Never raises;
    deterministic order: priority desc, type asc, id asc."""
    items: list[dict] = []
    for collector in (_collect_approvals, _collect_missions,
                      _collect_nodes, _collect_automation,
                      _collect_fabrication, _collect_research,
                      _collect_knowledge, _collect_intel,
                      _collect_camera, _collect_symbiosis,
                      _collect_craft, _collect_failures,
                      _collect_ecosystem):
        try:
            collector(items)
        except Exception:
            continue
    # Deduplicate by stable id (first wins = highest source
    # precedence: approvals first).
    seen: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for item in items:
        seen.setdefault(item["id"], item)
    ordered = sorted(seen.values(),
                     key=lambda entry: (-entry["priority"],
                                        entry["type"],
                                        entry["id"]))
    return ordered[:max(1, min(int(limit or MAX_ITEMS), 200))]


def attention_snapshot(limit: int = MAX_ITEMS) -> dict:
    """Bands + cleared + counts for API and pages."""
    items = attention_items(limit=limit)
    visible, cleared = _apply_triage(items)
    bands: dict[str, list[dict]] = {band: [] for band in BANDS}
    for item in visible:
        # DEFERRED items leave the urgent bands but stay listed.
        if item.get("status") == "DEFERRED":
            bands["waiting"].append(item)
        else:
            bands[item.get("band", "discovered")].append(item)
    counts = {band: len(entries)
              for band, entries in bands.items()}
    counts["cleared"] = len(cleared)
    counts["total"] = len(visible)
    return {"items": visible, "bands": bands, "cleared": cleared,
            "counts": counts, "generated_at": now(),
            "provenance": {"source_type": "derived",
                           "creator_id": "presence-engine",
                           "human_verified": False}}


# -- progression (game-layer foundation; real state only) --------------------------

def progression() -> dict:
    """Quests, discoveries, growth, capabilities, activity —
    every number backed by a live store, nothing invented."""
    quests: list[dict] = []
    try:
        from .missions import list_missions
        for mission in list_missions(limit=20):
            if mission.status not in ("approved", "running",
                                      "pending_approval",
                                      "paused"):
                continue
            steps = getattr(mission, "steps", []) or []
            done = sum(1 for step in steps
                       if str(getattr(step, "status", ""))
                       in ("done", "completed", "skipped"))
            quests.append({
                "title": str(mission.goal or "?")[:100],
                "done": done, "total": len(steps),
                "status": str(mission.status or ""),
                "href": f"/missions/{mission.mission_id}",
                "kind": "mission"})
            if len(quests) >= 5:
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .automation import list_runs
        for run in list_runs(limit=20):
            if run.state in ("completed", "failed",
                             "cancelled"):
                continue
            steps = getattr(run, "steps", []) or []
            done = sum(1 for step in steps
                       if str(getattr(step, "status", ""))
                       == "done")
            quests.append({
                "title": f"Automation: {run.goal}"[:100],
                "done": done, "total": len(steps),
                "status": str(run.state or ""),
                "href": f"/automation/{run.run_id}",
                "kind": "automation"})
            if len(quests) >= 8:
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    discoveries_24h = 0
    observations_24h = 0
    growth_24h = 0
    activity_24h = 0
    try:
        from .events import list_events
        cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(
            hours=24)
        for event in list_events(limit=200):
            moment = _parse_time(event.created_at)
            if moment is None or moment < cutoff:
                continue
            activity_24h += 1
            if event.event_type == "observation.created":
                observations_24h += 1
            if event.event_type in ("candidate.observed",
                                    "candidate.supported",
                                    "relation.proposed"):
                discoveries_24h += 1
            if event.event_type in ("candidate.supported",
                                    "candidate.promoted"):
                growth_24h += 1
    except Exception:
        pass
    capabilities: list[str] = []
    online_nodes = 0
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        for record in _main.list_nodes():
            if record.get("derived_status") not in ("online",
                                                    "busy"):
                continue
            online_nodes += 1
            for cap in record.get("capabilities", []) or []:
                text = str(cap)
                if text and text not in capabilities:
                    capabilities.append(text)
            if len(capabilities) >= 20:
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {"quests": quests,
            "discoveries_24h": discoveries_24h,
            "observations_24h": observations_24h,
            "growth_24h": growth_24h,
            "activity_24h": activity_24h,
            "online_nodes": online_nodes,
            "capabilities_unlocked": sorted(capabilities)[:20]}


# -- overnight digest (read-only) ----------------------------------------------------

def overnight_digest(hours: int = 12) -> dict:
    """What changed while Jelles was away. Observation only:
    event counts per type in the window + current waiting
    totals. Never executes, never proposes, never approves."""
    window = max(1, min(int(hours or 12), 48))
    cutoff = datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(
        hours=window)
    by_type: dict[str, int] = {}
    samples: dict[str, str] = {}
    try:
        from .events import list_events
        for event in list_events(limit=200):
            moment = _parse_time(event.created_at)
            if moment is None or moment < cutoff:
                continue
            by_type[event.event_type] = by_type.get(
                event.event_type, 0) + 1
            samples.setdefault(event.event_type,
                               str(event.summary or "")[:120])
    except Exception:
        pass
    waiting_now = 0
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        approvals = _main.coordinator_status().get(
            "pending_approvals", {})
        waiting_now = sum(int(approvals.get(key, 0))
                          for key in ("desktop_actions",
                                      "write_proposals",
                                      "missions"))
    except Exception:
        pass
    lines = [f"{event_type}: {count}"
             for event_type, count in sorted(by_type.items())]
    return {"window_hours": window,
            "changes": by_type,
            "samples": samples,
            "lines": lines[:20],
            "waiting_now": waiting_now,
            "generated_at": now()}

def morning_presence_sections() -> dict[str, list[str]]:
    """Seven presence sections for the morning report. All
    derived from live state right here, right now."""
    snapshot = attention_snapshot(limit=120)
    bands = snapshot["bands"]
    overnight = overnight_digest(hours=12)
    prog = progression()

    def _line(item: dict) -> str:
        return (f"{item['title']} — {item['reason']} "
                f"[{item['open_href']}]")[:280]

    needs = [_line(item) for item in bands["needs"][:8]] or [
        "Nothing needs you right now."]
    discoveries = [
        _line(item) for item in bands["discovered"][:6]]
    # Craft gaps are growth-relevant discoveries of missing
    # links (BIG #41): honestly worded, capped at two.
    discoveries += [
        _line(item) for item in bands["waiting"]
        if item["type"] == "craft_gap"][:2]
    discoveries = discoveries[:8] or ["No new discoveries."]
    resources = [
        _line(item) for item in bands["available"][:8]] or [
        "No special resources online right now."]
    blocked = [_line(item) for item in
               bands["needs"][:20]
               if item["type"] in ("mission_blocked",
                                   "mission_failed",
                                   "task_failed",
                                   "automation_failed",
                                   "fabrication_blocked")]
    blocked = blocked[:8] or ["Nothing is blocked."]
    offline = ([_line(item) for item in bands["offline"][:8]
                ] + [_line(item) for item in bands["waiting"]
                     if item["type"] == "telemetry_stale"][:4])
    offline = offline[:8] or ["All known hardware is quiet."]
    next_actions = []
    for item in bands["needs"][:5]:
        action = item.get("action", {}) or {}
        first = next(iter(action.values()), {})
        href = first.get("href", item["open_href"])
        next_actions.append(
            f"{item['title']} → {first.get('label', 'OPEN')} "
            f"at {href}"[:280])
    next_actions = next_actions or [
        "Nothing urgent — check the guide for open threads."]
    return {
        "presence_needs": needs,
        "presence_overnight": overnight["lines"][:8] or [
            "Nothing changed overnight."],
        "presence_discoveries": discoveries,
        "presence_resources": resources,
        "presence_blocked": blocked,
        "presence_offline": offline,
        "presence_next": next_actions,
    }

#: Attention type → IN_APP notification kind. Types without a
#: mapping stay presence-only (never notify).
NOTIFY_KIND = {
    "approval_desktop": "approval_required",
    "approval_write": "approval_required",
    "approval_mission": "mission_waiting",
    "mission_blocked": "mission_blocked",
    "mission_failed": "system_attention",
    "task_failed": "system_attention",
    "automation_waiting": "automation_waiting",
    "automation_failed": "system_attention",
    "fabrication_waiting": "fabrication_waiting",

    "hardware_offline": "hardware_disconnected",
    "hardware_available": "hardware_connected",
    "capability_available": "capability_available",
    "research_finding": "research_finding",
    "research_waiting": "capability_unavailable",
    "candidate_new": "candidate_waiting",
    "contradiction": "contradiction_detected",
    "observation_inbox": "new_observation",
    "symbiosis_proposed": "new_connection",
}

PRESENCE_RECIPIENT = "jelles"


def sync_presence_notifications(limit: int = 5) -> dict:
    """Fan out top attention items as IN_APP notifications.

    Explicit call only (API button, never background).
    Deduplicates: an unread notification with the same kind +
    title is never sent twice. Returns receipts + skips.
    WEB_PUSH is never involved (UNAVAILABLE by design).
    """
    from .events import list_notifications
    from .notify_center import send, severity_for
    count = max(1, min(int(limit or 5), 10))
    try:
        existing = {(note.type, note.title)
                    for note in list_notifications(
                        PRESENCE_RECIPIENT, limit=50,
                        unread_only=True)}
    except Exception:
        existing = set()
    snapshot = attention_snapshot(limit=60)
    ordered = sorted(
        snapshot["items"],
        key=lambda entry: (-entry["priority"], entry["type"],
                           entry["id"]))
    sent: list[dict] = []
    skipped = 0
    for item in ordered:
        if len(sent) >= count:
            break
        kind = NOTIFY_KIND.get(item["type"])
        if not kind:
            continue
        if item.get("status") == "DEFERRED":
            skipped += 1
            continue
        try:
            bucket = severity_for(kind)
        except Exception:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        if (bucket, item["title"]) in existing:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        try:
            receipt = send(
                PRESENCE_RECIPIENT, kind, item["title"],
                f"{item['reason']} Next: {item['open_href']}",
                related_entity=item["related_entity"],
                related_mission=item["related_mission"],
                related_task=item["related_task"])
        except Exception:
            skipped += 1
            continue
        existing.add((bucket, item["title"]))
        sent.append({"item_id": item["id"], "kind": kind,
                     **receipt})
    return {"sent": sent, "skipped": skipped,
            "transport": "IN_APP", "web_push": "UNAVAILABLE",
            "generated_at": now()}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/vision_provider.py">
"""Local VLM provider abstraction for Mycelium (BIG #6).

Vision output is ADVICE/ANALYSIS — never FACT, never verified,
never a write. The chain stays:

    observation -> VLM analysis -> proposal -> approval
        -> controlled write -> verification

Rules (tested, all fail-closed):

- Local-first: Ollama on loopback is the only backend
  (``VISION_MODEL`` configures the model, default below).
  No runtime downloads, no cloud, no credentials anywhere.
- Input security: the VLM reads exactly one explicitly named
  local media file inside the camera dir. Plain filename only
  (existing ``check_image_ref``), known suffix, capped size,
  boundary-checked path. Traversal, hidden scans, credential
  files and arbitrary extensions are inexpressible here.
- Output is structured (labels, detected objects with model-
  supplied confidence, description, OCR text, uncertainty) plus
  the raw text for audit. Malformed model output refuses —
  structure is never fabricated.
- Provenance is set by this module (ai-generated, unverified,
  referencing the observation). Model-supplied provenance or
  ``human_verified`` claims are ignored entirely.
- Missing model / missing backend refuses with an explicit
  reason and a no-download policy note (Mycelium never pulls
  models itself).
"""

import base64
import os
from typing import Any

import httpx
from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .cameras import camera_dir
from .inventory_read import Provenance
from .observations import check_image_ref
from .ollama_advisor import LOOPBACK_HOSTS
from .model_router import DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL as _ROUTER_VISION_MODEL

DEFAULT_BASE_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
BASE_URL_ENV_VAR = "OLLAMA_BASE_URL"
VISION_MODEL_ENV_VAR = "VISION_MODEL"
# Normal default owned by the central model router (value unchanged;
# explicit-arg > VISION_MODEL env > this fallback is untouched).
DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL = _ROUTER_VISION_MODEL
TIMEOUT_ENV_VAR = "OLLAMA_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120.0
MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120.0
CHAT_PATH = "/api/chat"

MAX_MEDIA_BYTES = 10 * 1024 * 1024
MAX_QUESTION_CHARS = 500
MAX_LABELS = 20
MAX_LABEL_CHARS = 120
MAX_TEXT_CHARS = 2000


class VisionUnavailable(RuntimeError):
    """No vision result. Fail-closed, never a fabricated analysis."""


class VisionRefusedError(ValueError):
    """Local validation refused; no media was read, nothing sent."""


class VisionRequest(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    observation_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    device_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    media_ref: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    question: str = Field(default="Wat zie je op deze foto?",
                          max_length=MAX_QUESTION_CHARS)


class DetectedObject(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    label: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=MAX_LABEL_CHARS)
    confidence: float = Field(default=0.0, ge=0.0, le=1.0)


class VisionResult(BaseModel):
    """Structured model analysis. ADVICE — never fact, never verified."""

    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    analysis_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    observation_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    device_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80)
    labels: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                              max_length=MAX_LABELS)
    detected_objects: list[DetectedObject] = Field(
        default_factory=list, max_length=MAX_LABELS)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_TEXT_CHARS)
    ocr_text: str = Field(default="", max_length=MAX_TEXT_CHARS)
    uncertainty: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    raw_text: str = Field(default="", max_length=4000)
    model: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    observed_at: str = ""
    provenance: Provenance = Field(default_factory=Provenance)


def _validate_base_url(raw) -> str:
    from urllib.parse import urlsplit
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
        raise VisionRefusedError(
            "Vision base URL must be non-empty text")
    try:
        parts = urlsplit(raw.strip())
    except ValueError as error:
        raise VisionRefusedError(
            f"Invalid vision base URL: {error}") from error
    if parts.scheme != "http":
        raise VisionRefusedError("Vision base URL must use http")
    if parts.username or parts.password:
        raise VisionRefusedError(
            "Vision base URL must not contain credentials")
    host = (parts.hostname or "").lower()
    if host not in LOOPBACK_HOSTS:
        raise VisionRefusedError(
            f"Vision host '{host or '?'}' is not loopback; refusing")
    return raw.strip()


def read_vision_media(media_ref: str) -> tuple[bytes, str]:
    """Read one allow-listed local media file. Returns (bytes, mime).

    Plain filename only, inside the camera dir or the screen-
    observation dir (both operator-local %TEMP% dirs), known
    suffix, capped size. Everything else refuses before any byte
    is read. Screen files are included so an explicit opt-in VLM
    text summary can describe them; raw pixels still never leave
    this layer except toward the loopback model.
    """
    try:
        reference = check_image_ref(media_ref)
    except ValueError as error:
        raise VisionRefusedError(str(error)) from error
    if not reference:
        raise VisionRefusedError("Vision needs a media reference")
    roots = [os.path.abspath(camera_dir())]
    try:
        from .desktop_runtime import observation_dir
        roots.append(os.path.abspath(observation_dir()))
    except Exception:
        pass
    path = ""
    for root in roots:
        candidate = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(root, reference))
        if candidate != root and candidate.startswith(root + os.sep):
            if os.path.isfile(candidate):
                path = candidate
                break
    if not path:
        raise VisionRefusedError(
            f"Media '{reference}' is outside the allow-listed "
            "camera/screen directories; refusing")
    size = os.path.getsize(path)
    if size <= 0:
        raise VisionRefusedError("Media is empty; refusing")
    if size > MAX_MEDIA_BYTES:
        raise VisionRefusedError(
            f"Media is {size} bytes (max {MAX_MEDIA_BYTES}); refusing")
    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        data = handle.read(MAX_MEDIA_BYTES + 1)
    if len(data) > MAX_MEDIA_BYTES:  # pragma: no cover - TOCTOU guard
        raise VisionRefusedError("Media grew past the cap; refusing")
    lowered = reference.lower()
    if lowered.endswith(".bmp"):
        mime = "image/bmp"
    elif lowered.endswith((".jpg", ".jpeg")):
        mime = "image/jpeg"
    else:
        mime = "image/png"
    return data, mime


def _clean_label(value) -> str | None:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        return None
    text = value.strip()
    if len(text) > MAX_LABEL_CHARS:
        return None
    return text


def parse_vision_text(text: str) -> dict:
    """Parse model text into structure. Best-effort extraction with
    honest uncertainty: labels come from explicit `label:` /
    `object:` lines, the rest stays description. Inline descriptions
    and malformed confidence placeholders are preserved as text.
    Unparseable text yields empty labels — never invented ones."""
    import re
    labels: list[str] = []
    seen: list[str] = []
    detected: list[dict] = []
    description_lines: list[str] = []
    for line in (text or "").splitlines():
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped:
            continue
        lowered = stripped.lower()
        if lowered.startswith("description:"):
            description = stripped.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            if description:
                description_lines.append(description)
            continue
        label_line = re.match(
            r"^(?:label|object|voorwerp)\s*:\s*(.*)$",
            stripped, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        if label_line:
            chunk = label_line.group(1).strip()
            confidence = 0.0
            inline_description = ""
            parenthetical = re.match(
                r"^(.+?)\s+\(([^()]*)\)\s*(.*)$", chunk)
            if parenthetical:
                possible_label, token, rest = parenthetical.groups()
                token = token.strip()
                try:
                    numeric_confidence = float(token)
                except ValueError:
                    numeric_confidence = -1.0
                if 0.0 <= numeric_confidence <= 1.0:
                    chunk = possible_label.strip()
                    confidence = numeric_confidence
                    inline_description = rest.strip()
                elif token.casefold() in {"0..1", "0-1"}:
                    # Models sometimes echo the prompt's confidence
                    # range as though it were a score. Never treat it
                    # as a confidence value.
                    chunk = possible_label.strip()
                    inline_description = rest.strip()
                elif rest.strip():
                    # This line does not follow the structured label
                    # format. Keep it intact as a description instead
                    # of turning a whole sentence into an object label.
                    description_lines.append(stripped)
                    continue
            label = _clean_label(chunk)
            if label and label.lower() not in seen:
                seen.append(label.lower())
                labels.append(label)
                detected.append({"label": label,
                                 "confidence": confidence})
                if len(labels) >= MAX_LABELS:
                    break
                if inline_description:
                    description_lines.append(inline_description)
            elif not label:
                description_lines.append(stripped)
        else:
            description_lines.append(stripped)
    return {
        "labels": labels,
        "detected_objects": detected,
        "description": "\n".join(description_lines)[:MAX_TEXT_CHARS],
    }


class VisionProvider:
    """Interface for vision sources. Subclasses implement analyze()."""

    name = "base"

    async def analyze(self, request: VisionRequest) -> VisionResult:
        raise NotImplementedError


class OllamaVisionProvider(VisionProvider):
    """Local Ollama vision. One endpoint, loopback only, base64
    image from the allow-listed media root. Missing model refuses
    with a pull hint — Mycelium never downloads anything itself."""

    name = "ollama"

    def __init__(self, base_url=None, model=None, timeout=None,
                 transport=None):
        raw = (base_url if base_url is not None
               else os.environ.get(BASE_URL_ENV_VAR, DEFAULT_BASE_URL))
        try:
            self.base_url = _validate_base_url(raw)
        except VisionRefusedError as error:
            raise error
        name = (model if model is not None
                else os.environ.get(VISION_MODEL_ENV_VAR,
                                    DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL))
        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name.strip():
            raise VisionRefusedError(
                "Vision model name must be non-empty text")
        self.model = name.strip()
        try:
            self.timeout = min(float(
                timeout if timeout is not None else os.environ.get(
                    TIMEOUT_ENV_VAR, DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)),
                MAX_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        except (TypeError, ValueError):
            self.timeout = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        if self.timeout <= 0:
            self.timeout = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
        self._transport = transport

    async def analyze(self, request: VisionRequest) -> VisionResult:
        if not isinstance(request, VisionRequest):
            raise VisionRefusedError("Vision needs a VisionRequest")
        try:
            media, _mime = read_vision_media(request.media_ref)
        except VisionRefusedError as error:
            raise error
        payload = {
            "model": self.model,
            "stream": False,
            "think": False,
            "options": {"num_predict": 160},
            "messages": [{
                "role": "user",
                "content": (
                    f"{request.question} Antwoord uitsluitend met "
                    f"korte regels: voor elk herkenbaar voorwerp "
                    f"'label: <korte naam>' op een eigen regel, en "
                    f"daarna 'description: <korte beschrijving>'. "
                    f"Geef geen confidence-scores. Noem alleen wat "
                    f"zichtbaar is; bij onzekerheid, zeg dat."),
                "images": [base64.b64encode(media).decode("ascii")],
            }],
        }
        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(
                    base_url=self.base_url, timeout=self.timeout,
                    follow_redirects=False, trust_env=False,
                    transport=self._transport) as client:
                response = await client.post(CHAT_PATH, json=payload)
        except httpx.TimeoutException as error:
            raise VisionUnavailable(
                f"Vision model timed out: {error}") from error
        except httpx.HTTPError as error:
            raise VisionUnavailable(
                f"Vision backend unreachable: {error}") from error
        if response.status_code in (301, 302, 303, 307, 308):
            raise VisionUnavailable("Vision backend redirect refused")
        if response.status_code == 404:
            raise VisionUnavailable(
                f"Vision model '{self.model}' not found on the local "
                f"backend (no automatic download; ask the operator "
                f"to `ollama pull {self.model}`)")
        if response.status_code != 200:
            raise VisionUnavailable(
                f"Vision backend answered HTTP {response.status_code}")
        try:
            data = response.json()
        except ValueError as error:
            raise VisionUnavailable(
                "Vision backend answered invalid JSON") from error
        text = _response_text(data)
        if not text:
            raise VisionUnavailable(
                "Vision backend answered without usable text")
        return build_result(request, text, self.model)

    def config(self) -> dict:
        return {"backend": "ollama-loopback", "base_url": self.base_url,
                "model": self.model, "timeout": self.timeout}


def _response_text(data) -> str:
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return ""
    message = data.get("message")
    if isinstance(message, dict):
        content = message.get("content", "")
        return content.strip() if isinstance(content, str) else ""
    # Fallback: generate-style shape (never relied upon, just read).
    response = data.get("response", "")
    return response.strip() if isinstance(response, str) else ""


def build_result(request: VisionRequest, text: str,
                 model: str) -> VisionResult:
    """Assemble a structured, explicitly unverified VisionResult."""
    import secrets
    import time
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    parsed = parse_vision_text(text)
    return VisionResult(
        analysis_id=f"vis_{int(time.time() * 1000):x}"
                    f"{secrets.token_hex(4)}",
        observation_id=request.observation_id,
        device_id=request.device_id,
        labels=parsed["labels"],
        detected_objects=[
            DetectedObject(label=item["label"],
                           confidence=item["confidence"])
            for item in parsed["detected_objects"]],
        description=parsed["description"],
        ocr_text="",
        uncertainty=("model output is advice; identity and counts "
                     "are unconfirmed until human approval and "
                     "independent verification"),
        raw_text=text.strip()[:4000],
        model=model,
        observed_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        provenance=Provenance(
            source_type="ai-generated",
            creator_id=f"vision:{model}",
            human_verified=False,
            notes=f"VLM analysis of {request.observation_id}; "
                  "advice only, never fact"),
    )


class UnavailableVisionProvider(VisionProvider):
    """Fail-closed stub: no backend configured. Always refuses with
    an explicit reason (mirrors ExternalProvider)."""

    name = "unavailable"

    def __init__(self, reason: str = "no vision backend configured"):
        self.reason = reason

    async def analyze(self, request: VisionRequest) -> VisionResult:
        raise VisionUnavailable(
            f"{self.reason}; no automatic download, no cloud fallback")


class TestVisionProvider(VisionProvider):
    """Deterministic test provider. Canned structure, test-marked."""

    name = "test-only"

    def __init__(self, labels=None, fail: bool = False):
        self._labels = list(labels) if labels is not None else ["moer"]
        self._fail = fail

    async def analyze(self, request: VisionRequest) -> VisionResult:
        if self._fail:
            raise VisionUnavailable("synthetic vision failure (test)")
        lines = [f"label: {label} (0.5)" for label in self._labels]
        lines.append("Een testbeschrijving, geen echte waarneming.")
        return build_result(request, "\n".join(lines), "test-only")


def get_vision_provider(name: str | None = None, **kwargs
                        ) -> VisionProvider:
    """Resolve a vision provider by name. Unknown names fail closed."""
    resolved = (name or "unavailable").strip().lower()
    if resolved == "ollama":
        try:
            return OllamaVisionProvider(**kwargs)
        except VisionRefusedError as error:
            raise error
    if resolved == "unavailable":
        return UnavailableVisionProvider(**kwargs)
    if resolved == "test-only":
        return TestVisionProvider(**kwargs)
    raise VisionRefusedError(f"Unknown vision provider '{name}'")

# 3D Workflow (BIG #35: workbench)

PHOTO / OBJECT → OBSERVATION → 3D MODEL CANDIDATE → MODEL → EDIT →
PREPARE → SLICE → G-CODE → PRINTER → VERIFY.

Full ecosystem in `docs/3d-workshop.md`.

## What exists (REAL)

- Procedural/test mesh generation + STL/OBJ validation + printability
  assessment (`mesh3d.py`, `meshops.py`, `cad.py` procedural only)
- Wireframe preview + validated transform proposals (rotate/translate/
  scale) in `/workshop/3d`; persisting makes a derived file + payload
  for the proposal/approval path — never auto-registered
- Test slicer + G-code safety assessment (`slicer3d.py`; preview-only,
  never-for-printers, no `safe_to_execute` anywhere)
- Fabrication orchestration (`fabrication.py`, `fab_flow.py`,
  `printer3d.py`): proposal → physical exact-YES → simulated
  execution → telemetry + camera verification; software cancel ≠
  e-stop
- `/3d` pipeline view with stage chips: READY / WAITING / SIMULATED /
  TEST / HARDWARE_REQUIRED / UNAVAILABLE

## What is missing (UNAVAILABLE / HARDWARE_REQUIRED)

True photo→mesh reconstruction transport and real printer
transports. OBJECT → CREATE 3D MODEL says so openly and offers the
procedural/test workflow instead. No fake generated mesh, ever.

## Linking a model

A model links visibly to project / file / object / research / mission
/ fabrication plan through existing relations where they exist, or
explicit candidate relations (dashed overlays in `/world`) where the
source is a Mycelium domain. Chain inspection: `/workshop`, per-run
`/workshop?fabrication_id=...`, `/fabrication`.

New in BIG #31: the **Connect a model** panel on `/3d` (and the
propose forms on `/writes`) create `create_relationship` write
proposals with closed predicates (`used_in`, `part_of`,
`produced_by`, `related_to`, …). The proposal waits in the
`/writes` inbox for an exact YES — nothing links itself. Object
creation from mobile follows the same inbox (`/web/objects/propose`
→ YES → execute → verify).

## Related relations (BIG #32)

`/3d?entity_id=mod_…` shows the entity's CONNECTED TO panel
(stored relations via the ecosystem context) with a link into
the world graph — model ↔ project ↔ file ↔ object ↔ research
becomes navigable instead of implied. Links themselves are still
proposed through `/writes` and need YES.

## Workbench (BIG #35)

`/3d` is now one workbench: Models (`mdl_…` registry, STL/OBJ
inspection, 3MF/GLB/GLTF metadata-only), Materials (known /
candidate / unknown), per-entity presence checklists with gaps,
fab jobs (designed → … → verified state machine around the
existing YES flow), Machines (printer badges SIMULATED /
UNAVAILABLE + mesh-capable nodes), link proposals (PROPOSED
symbiosis), continuation packet (`/api/v1/workshop/packet`),
real progress bars. Details in `docs/3d-workshop.md`.

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/tests/test_fab_api.py">
"""Fabrication API tests (BIG #7).

End-to-end over coordinator routes with faked INVENTory:
generate -> validate -> slice -> safety -> propose -> approve ->
execute (simulated) -> telemetry verify -> camera verify.
Plus missions, printers, assess, fabrication page and graph.
"""

import json
import os

import httpx
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

import coordinator.app.main as main_mod
from coordinator.app.printer3d import (
    SimulatedPrinterAdapter,
    clear_printers,
    new_printer,
)
from coordinator.app.printer3d import (
    register_printer as register_device,
)


class FakeStore:
    def __init__(self):
        self.entities: dict = {}
        self.counter = 0

    def _record(self, prefix, body, extra):
        self.counter += 1
        entity_id = f"{prefix}_fab{self.counter:03d}"
        record = {"id": entity_id, **extra,
                  "provenance": body.get("provenance", {}),
                  "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00",
                  "updated_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"}
        return entity_id, record

    def handler(self, request: httpx.Request) -> httpx.Response:
        path = request.url.path
        if request.method == "POST" and path == "/api/v1/objects":
            body = json.loads(request.content.decode())
            entity_id, record = self._record(
                "obj", body, {"name": body["name"],
                              "description": body.get("description", ""),
                              "quantity": body.get("quantity", 1)})
            self.entities[entity_id] = record
            return httpx.Response(201, json=record)
        if request.method == "POST" and path == "/api/v1/files":
            body = json.loads(request.content.decode())
            entity_id, record = self._record(
                "file", body, {"name": body["name"],
                               "file_kind": body.get("file_kind",
                                                     "other"),
                               "mime_type": body.get("mime_type", ""),
                               "sha256": body.get("sha256", "0" * 64),
                               "size_bytes": body.get("size_bytes", 0),
                               "description": body.get("description", ""),
                               "status": body.get("status", "unknown"),
                               "metadata": body.get("metadata", {})})
            self.entities[entity_id] = record
            return httpx.Response(201, json=record)
        if path.startswith("/api/v1/objects/") or path.startswith(
                "/api/v1/files/"):
            entity_id = path.rsplit("/", 1)[-1]
            record = self.entities.get(entity_id)
            if record is None:
                return httpx.Response(404, json={})
            return httpx.Response(200, json=record)
        if path == "/api/v1/graph":
            return httpx.Response(200, json={
                "entity_id": "obj_x", "depth": 1,
                "nodes": [], "edges": []})
        if request.method == "GET":
            return httpx.Response(200, json=[])
        return httpx.Response(404, json={})


def make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    store = FakeStore()
    transport = httpx.MockTransport(store.handler)
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "f.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH",
                       str(tmp_path / "f-chat.db"))
    monkeypatch.setenv("MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR",
                       str(tmp_path / "f-fab"))
    from coordinator.app.inventory_read import InventoryReader
    from coordinator.app.inventory_writes import InventoryWriter
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "_world_reader",
                        lambda: InventoryReader(transport=transport))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_mod, "InventoryWriter",
                        lambda *a, **k: InventoryWriter(
                            transport=transport))
    clear_printers()
    with TestClient(main_mod.app) as test_client:
        yield test_client
    clear_printers()


def register_test_printer(test_client, printer_id="prt-fab1"):
    response = test_client.post("/api/v1/printers/register", json={
        "printer_id": printer_id, "name": "Fabprinter",
        "capabilities": ["printer.status", "printer.start",
                         "printer.cancel"]})
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    register_device(
        new_printer(printer_id, "Fabprinter",
                    ["printer.status", "printer.start",
                     "printer.cancel"]),
        SimulatedPrinterAdapter())
    return printer_id


def test_full_physical_chain(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        printer_id = register_test_printer(test_client)
        # 1. Generate + validate + printability.
        generated = test_client.post("/api/v1/fab/generate", json={
            "description": "testkubus voor smoke",
            "generator": "procedural-test"})
        assert generated.status_code == 201, generated.text
        body = generated.json()
        assert body["validation"]["verdict"] == "valid"
        assert body["printability"]["verdict"] == "printable"
        fabrication_id = body["fabrication"]["fabrication_id"]
        # 2. Slice + safety.
        sliced = test_client.post("/api/v1/fab/slice", json={
            "artifact_ref": body["generation"]["artifact_ref"],
            "profile": "draft-pla", "printer_id": printer_id})
        assert sliced.status_code == 201, sliced.text
        assert sliced.json()["safety"]["verdict"] == "safe"
        gcode = sliced.json()["slice"]
        # 3. Physical proposal (inert).
        proposed = test_client.post("/api/v1/prints/propose", json={
            "proposal_id": "wrt-fab1", "printer_id": printer_id,
            "gcode_ref": gcode["gcode_ref"],
            "gcode_sha256": gcode["sha256"],
            "profile": "draft-pla"})
        assert proposed.status_code == 201, proposed.text
        assert proposed.json()["status"] == "proposed"
        assert proposed.json()["safety"]["verdict"] == "safe"
        # 4. Execute before approval refuses.
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-fab1/execute").status_code == 409
        # 5. Physical YES -> execute (simulated).
        assert test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-fab1/approve",
            json={"response": "YES"}).status_code == 200
        executed = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-fab1/execute")
        assert executed.status_code == 200, executed.text
        assert executed.json()["status"] == "executed"
        # 6. Telemetry half.
        verified = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-fab1/verify")
        assert verified.json()["verification"]["outcome"] == "passed"
        # 7. Camera half needs an observation; unknown refuses.
        combined = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-fab1/verify-print",
            params={"observation_id": "obs-missing"})
        assert combined.status_code == 404
        # 8. Fabrication records + graph overlay ride along.
        records = test_client.get(
            "/api/v1/fabrication/records").json()
        assert any(record["fabrication_id"] == fabrication_id
                   for record in records)
        graph = test_client.get("/api/v1/graph", params={
            "entity_id": "obj_x", "include_fabrication": True,
            "fabrication_id": fabrication_id})
        assert graph.status_code == 200, graph.text


def test_verify_print_full_both_halves(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import coordinator.app.main as main_module
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        printer_id = register_test_printer(test_client)
        mesh = test_client.post("/api/v1/fab/generate", json={
            "description": "x"}).json()
        gcode = test_client.post("/api/v1/fab/slice", json={
            "artifact_ref": mesh["generation"]["artifact_ref"],
            "profile": "draft-pla",
            "printer_id": printer_id}).json()["slice"]
        test_client.post("/api/v1/prints/propose", json={
            "proposal_id": "wrt-fab2", "printer_id": printer_id,
            "gcode_ref": gcode["gcode_ref"],
            "gcode_sha256": gcode["sha256"],
            "profile": "draft-pla"})
        test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/wrt-fab2/approve",
                         json={"response": "YES"})
        test_client.post("/api/v1/writes/wrt-fab2/execute")
        # Fake a stored observation for the camera half.
        from coordinator.app.cameras import new_observation
        observation = new_observation(
            "obs-fab1", "cam-fab1", "snapshot",
            media_ref="", width=64, height=48)
        from coordinator.app.cameras import save_observation
        save_observation(observation)
        combined = test_client.post(
            "/api/v1/writes/wrt-fab2/verify-print",
            params={"observation_id": "obs-fab1"})
        assert combined.status_code == 200, combined.text
        verification = combined.json()["verification"]
        # No local media file -> camera half fails -> not verified.
        assert verification["outcome"] == "failed"
        assert verification["observed"]["verdict"] == "not_verified"
        assert "media file missing" in verification["note"] or \
            "camera=failed" in verification["note"]
        _ = main_module

def _connect_env(monkeypatch, **overrides):
    import coordinator.app.printer3d as printer_mod
    for key in ("BAMBU_MQTT_HOST", "BAMBU_MQTT_PORT",
                "BAMBU_MQTT_USERNAME", "BAMBU_MQTT_ACCESS_CODE",
                "BAMBU_PRINTER_SERIAL"):
        monkeypatch.delenv(key, raising=False)
    base = {"BAMBU_MQTT_HOST": "192.168.1.50",
            "BAMBU_MQTT_ACCESS_CODE": "route-canary-999",
            "BAMBU_PRINTER_SERIAL": "TESTSERIAL"}
    base.update(overrides)
    for key, value in base.items():
        if value is not None:
            monkeypatch.setenv(key, value)
    return printer_mod


def _canned_live():
    return {"state": "idle", "gcode_state": "IDLE",
            "nozzle_c": 24.0, "bed_c": 22.0, "progress_pct": 0,
            "last_read_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00"}

    response = test_client.post("/api/v1/printers/register", json={

        "capabilities": ["printer.status", "printer.telemetry",
                         "printer.start"]})

    return printer_id


def test_connect_route_success_registers(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import coordinator.app.printer3d as printer_mod
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import adapter_for_printer
    _connect_env(monkeypatch)
    monkeypatch.setattr(printer_mod, "read_bambu_once",

        body = response.json()

        assert body["reachable"] is True
        assert body["state"] == "idle"
        assert "192.168.1.50" not in response.text
        assert "route-canary-999" not in response.text
        assert adapter_for_printer(printer_id) is not None

def test_connect_route_causes_no_motion(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    import coordinator.app.bambu_exec as exec_mod
    import coordinator.app.printer3d as printer_mod
    from coordinator.app.printer3d import adapter_for_printer
    _connect_env(monkeypatch)
    calls: list = []

    def _boom(*args, **kwargs):
        calls.append((args, kwargs))
        raise AssertionError("motion path reached via connect")

    monkeypatch.setattr(exec_mod, "execute_bambu_job", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exec_mod, "ftps_upload", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(exec_mod, "publish_request", _boom)
    monkeypatch.setattr(printer_mod, "read_bambu_once",
                        lambda *a, **k: _canned_live())
    for test_client in make_client(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
        printer_id = _register_bare_printer(
            test_client, printer_id="prt-conn4")
        response = test_client.post(
            f"/api/v1/printers/{printer_id}/connect", json={})
        assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
        assert calls == []
        assert adapter_for_printer(printer_id) is not None

                   for step in mission["steps"])

        assert "NIET" in mission["steps"][2]["result_text"]
