def connected_panel(limit: int = 6) -> dict:
    """Connected ecosystem for the phone (BIG #45): CONNECTED
    (verified + supported + linked counts), WAITING (open
    proposals, drafts, unknowns), DISCOVERED (seedlings).
    Counts from live stores; no graph on the phone."""
    connected = 0
    waiting = 0
    seedlings: list[dict] = []
    try:
        from .hardware_links import list_links
        verified = sum(
            1 for link in list_links(status="VERIFIED",
                                     limit=200))
        connected += verified
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .finance import list_records as _fin
        confirmed = sum(
            1 for record in _fin(limit=200)
            if record.status == "CONFIRMED")
        drafts = sum(
            1 for record in _fin(limit=200)
            if record.status == "DRAFT")
        connected += confirmed
        waiting += drafts
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .energy import list_records as _enr
        known = 0
        unknown = 0
        for record in _enr(limit=200):
            if record.value is None:
                unknown += 1
            else:
                known += 1
        connected += known
        waiting += unknown
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .symbiosis import proposed
        open_props = proposed(limit=60)
        waiting += len(open_props)
        for prop in open_props[:max(1, min(int(limit or 6),
                                           10))]:
            seedlings.append({
                "title": str(prop.get("title", ""))[:80],
                "entities": prop.get("entities", [])[:2],
                "href": prop.get("link", "/symbiosis"),
            })
    except Exception:
        pass
    return {"connected": connected, "waiting": waiting,
            "discovered": seedlings,
            "href": "/world"}

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/worldgraph.py">
"""Mycelium World Graph foundation (BIG #4).

One uniform representation over two sources of truth that stay
separate: INVENTory owns world entities (object, project, idea,
hardware, sensor, camera, location, model, task, actuator, file)
plus their relationships; Mycelium owns mission/agent/node
records. This module never merges them into a new store — it
projects both into nodes/edges for navigation and future UI.

Node: {id, type, label, source, metadata}
Edge: {from, predicate, to, provenance}

Bounds (tested): seed expansion depth 1|2 through the existing
reader (bounded there too), mission/agent fan-out capped, total
nodes/edges capped. No full-database graph by default.
"""

from .missions import list_missions

MAX_NODES = 200
MAX_EDGES = 400
GRAPH_DEPTHS = (1, 2)

INVENTORY_NODE_TYPES = frozenset({
    "object", "project", "idea", "hardware", "sensor", "camera",
    "location", "model", "task", "actuator", "file",
})
MYCELIUM_NODE_TYPES = frozenset({"mission", "agent", "node"})

#: Overlay node types owned by Mycelium (BIG #10 uniform layer).
#: INVENTory types above stay authoritative; these never pretend
#: to be world entities.
OVERLAY_NODE_TYPES = frozenset({
    "mission", "agent", "node", "observation", "artifact",
    "print_job", "printer", "live_session", "research",
    "memory", "candidate", "conversation",
    "theme", "decision", "promise", "question",
})

#: Truth classes for filtering (BIG #32). Inventory nodes map by
#: provenance; overlays map by kind. Health-tagged content is
#: refused at the overlay builders, never filtered client-side.
TRUTH_FILTERS = frozenset({
    "all", "verified", "memory", "candidate", "observation",
})

MAX_NODE_OVERLAY = 50


def _inventory_node(node) -> dict:
    provenance = node.provenance
    prov = (provenance.model_dump(mode="json")
            if hasattr(provenance, "model_dump") else {})
    return {
        "id": str(node.entity_id),
        "type": node.entity_type,
        "label": node.title,
        "source": "inventory",
        "metadata": {"human_verified": bool(prov.get(
            "human_verified", False)),
            "source_type": str(prov.get("source_type", "unknown"))},
    }


def _inventory_edge(edge) -> dict:
    provenance = edge.provenance
    prov = (provenance.model_dump(mode="json")
            if hasattr(provenance, "model_dump") else {})
    return {
        "from": str(edge.from_id),
        "predicate": edge.predicate,
        "to": str(edge.to_id),
        "provenance": prov,
    }


async def build_world_graph(reader, entity_id: str, depth: int = 1, *,
                            include_missions: bool = False,
                            agent_nodes: list[dict] | None = None,
                            observations: list[dict] | None = None,
                            fabrication: list[dict] | None = None,
                            registry_nodes: list[dict] | None = None,
                            printers: list[dict] | None = None,
                            research_runs: list[dict] | None = None,
                            memories: list[dict] | None = None,
                            candidates: list[dict] | None = None,
                            conversations: list[dict] | None = None,
                            intel: list[dict] | None = None,
                            truth: str = "all",
                            source: str = "all",
                            kind: str = "all",
                            since: str = "",
                            # BIG #39: Hardware Reality Layer
                            include_hardware: bool = False,
                            include_compute: bool = False,
                            ) -> dict:
    """Project inventory graph + optional Mycelium overlay."""
    if isinstance(depth, bool) or depth not in GRAPH_DEPTHS:
        raise ValueError("Graph depth must be 1 or 2")
    graph = await reader.graph(entity_id, depth)
    nodes: dict[str, dict] = {}
    edges: list[dict] = []
    for node in graph.nodes:
        if node.entity_type not in INVENTORY_NODE_TYPES:
            continue
        nodes[str(node.entity_id)] = _inventory_node(node)
        if len(nodes) >= MAX_NODES:
            break
    for edge in graph.edges:
        if len(edges) >= MAX_EDGES:
            break
        edges.append(_inventory_edge(edge))
    if include_missions:
        _overlay_missions(nodes, edges)
    if research_runs:
        _overlay_research(nodes, edges, research_runs)
    if observations:
        _overlay_observations(nodes, edges, observations)
    if fabrication:
        _overlay_fabrication(nodes, edges, fabrication)
    if registry_nodes:
        _overlay_registry_nodes(nodes, edges, registry_nodes)
        # BIG #39: Hardware and compute overlays from node registry
        if include_hardware:
            _overlay_hardware(nodes, edges, registry_nodes)
        if include_compute:
            _overlay_compute(nodes, edges, registry_nodes)
    if printers:
        _overlay_printers(nodes, edges, printers)
    if memories:
        _overlay_memories(nodes, edges, memories)
    if candidates:
        _overlay_candidates(nodes, edges, candidates)
    if conversations:
        _overlay_conversations(nodes, edges, conversations)
    if intel:
        _overlay_intel(nodes, edges, intel)
    for agent in (agent_nodes or [])[:50]:
        node_id = str(agent.get("node_id", ""))
        if not node_id or node_id in nodes:
            continue
        nodes[node_id] = {
            "id": node_id,
            "type": "agent",
            "label": node_id,
            "source": "mycelium",
            "metadata": {"capabilities": list(
                agent.get("capabilities", []))[:30]},
        }
        if len(nodes) >= MAX_NODES:
            break
    filtered = filter_graph(
        {"entity_id": entity_id, "depth": depth,
         "nodes": list(nodes.values())[:MAX_NODES],
         "edges": edges[:MAX_EDGES]},
        truth=truth, source=source, kind=kind, since=since)
    filtered["filters"] = {"truth": truth, "source": source,
                           "kind": kind, "since": since}
    return filtered


def _truth_class(node: dict) -> str:
    """Map one graph node to a truth filter class."""
    kind = str(node.get("type", ""))
    if kind == "candidate":
        return "candidate"
    if kind in ("observation",):
        return "observation"
    if kind in ("memory",):
        return "memory"
    if node.get("source") == "inventory":
        metadata = node.get("metadata", {})
        if isinstance(metadata, dict) and metadata.get(
                "human_verified"):
            return "verified"
        return "memory"
    return "memory"


def filter_graph(graph: dict, *, truth: str = "all",
                 source: str = "all", kind: str = "all",
                 since: str = "") -> dict:
    """Bounded post-filter over a built graph. Pure: no fetching,
    caps preserved, edges pruned to surviving nodes."""
    cleaned_truth = str(truth or "all").strip().lower()
    if cleaned_truth not in TRUTH_FILTERS:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Unknown truth filter '{truth}'; expected one of "
            f"{sorted(TRUTH_FILTERS)}")
    cleaned_source = str(source or "all").strip().lower()
    cleaned_kind = str(kind or "all").strip().lower()
    cutoff = str(since or "").strip()[:10]
    if cleaned_truth == "all" and cleaned_source == "all" and \
            cleaned_kind == "all" and not cutoff:
        return {"entity_id": graph.get("entity_id", ""),
                "depth": graph.get("depth", 1),
                "nodes": list(graph.get("nodes", []))[:MAX_NODES],
                "edges": list(graph.get("edges", []))[:MAX_EDGES]}
    keep: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for node in graph.get("nodes", []):
        if cleaned_truth != "all" and _truth_class(node) != \
                cleaned_truth:
            continue
        if cleaned_source != "all" and str(
                node.get("source", "")).lower() != cleaned_source:
            continue
        if cleaned_kind != "all" and str(
                node.get("type", "")).lower() != cleaned_kind:
            continue
        if cutoff:
            stamp = str((node.get("metadata", {}) or {}).get(
                "created_at", node.get("metadata", {}).get(
                    "updated_at", "")) or "")[:10]
            if stamp and stamp < cutoff:
                continue
        keep[str(node.get("id", ""))] = node
        if len(keep) >= MAX_NODES:
            break
    edges = [edge for edge in graph.get("edges", [])
             if str(edge.get("from", "")) in keep
             and str(edge.get("to", "")) in keep][:MAX_EDGES]
    return {"entity_id": graph.get("entity_id", ""),
            "depth": graph.get("depth", 1),
            "nodes": list(keep.values()),
            "edges": edges}


MAX_MEMORY_NODES = 20
MAX_CANDIDATE_NODES = 20
MAX_CONVERSATION_NODES = 10


def _overlay_memories(nodes: dict, edges: list,
                      memories: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Memory entries as overlay (never health: callers must pass
    health-scoped lists; entries with memory_type health refuse)."""
    for item in list(memories or [])[:MAX_MEMORY_NODES]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        if str(item.get("memory_type", "")) == "health":
            continue
        memory_id = str(item.get("memory_id", ""))
        if not memory_id or memory_id in nodes:
            continue
        nodes[memory_id] = {
            "id": memory_id,
            "type": "memory",
            "label": str(item.get("title", memory_id))[:120],
            "source": "mycelium",
            "metadata": {
                "memory_type": str(item.get("memory_type", "")),
                "truth": str(item.get("truth", "")),
                "human_verified": str(item.get("truth", "")) in (
                    "user_fact", "verified"),
                "project_ref": str(item.get("project_ref", "")),
            },
        }
        for ref in list(item.get("entity_refs", []))[:10]:
            target = str(ref or "")
            if not target or target not in nodes:
                continue
            if len(edges) >= MAX_EDGES:
                return
            edges.append({
                "from": memory_id,
                "predicate": "remembers",
                "to": target,
                "provenance": {"source_type": "memory",
                               "creator_id": "memory-layer",
                               "human_verified": str(item.get(
                                   "truth", "")) in (
                                       "user_fact", "verified")},
            })
        if len(nodes) >= MAX_NODES:
            return

MAX_OBSERVATION_NODES = 20
MAX_FABRICATION_NODES = 20
MAX_RESEARCH_NODES = 20


def _overlay_research(nodes: dict, edges: list,
                      runs: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Research runs as Mycelium-owned overlay nodes.

    Question -> run -> claims -> sources -> entities. Run nodes
    link to INVENTory entities only through the run's own
    linked_entities (user/project context or stated
    candidates); INVENTory stays the source of truth, these
    nodes carry external-source, unverified provenance.
    """
    for item in list(runs or [])[:MAX_RESEARCH_NODES]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        run_id = str(item.get("run_id", ""))
        if not run_id or run_id in nodes:
            continue
        nodes[run_id] = {
            "id": run_id,
            "type": "research",
            "label": str(item.get("question", ""))[:120],
            "source": "mycelium",
            "metadata": {"status": item.get("status", ""),
                         "execution_state": item.get(
                             "execution_state", "UNAVAILABLE"),
                         "sources": len(item.get("source_ids",
                                                 []) or []),
                         "claims": len(item.get("claims", [])
                                       or [])},
        }
        for link in (item.get("linked_entities", "") or [])[:10]:
            entity_id = str((link or {}).get("entity_id", ""))
            if not entity_id or entity_id not in nodes:
                continue
            if len(edges) >= MAX_EDGES:
                return
            edges.append({
                "from": run_id,
                "predicate": "researches",
                "to": entity_id,
                "provenance": {"source_type": "external-source",
                               "creator_id": f"research:{run_id}",
                               "human_verified": False},
            })
        if len(nodes) >= MAX_NODES:
            return

#: Fabrication edge predicates. Closed: only derivation and
#: execution links the flow actually records.
FABRICATION_PREDICATES = frozenset({
    "derived_from", "sliced_to", "executed_as", "produced",
    "observed_by",
})


def _overlay_observations(nodes: dict, edges: list,
                          observations: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Camera observations as Mycelium-owned overlay nodes.

    Camera -captured-> observation, plus -describes-> inventory
    entity edges only when the caller supplies an explicit
    entity link (e.g. from a verified write). Observations are
    never a second source of truth: INVENTory nodes stay
    authoritative, these nodes carry sensor-observed,
    unverified provenance.
    """
    for item in list(observations or [])[:MAX_OBSERVATION_NODES]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        obs_id = str(item.get("observation_id", ""))
        device_id = str(item.get("device_id", ""))
        if not obs_id or obs_id in nodes:
            continue
        provenance = item.get("provenance", {})
        if hasattr(provenance, "model_dump"):
            provenance = provenance.model_dump(mode="json")
        if not isinstance(provenance, dict):
            provenance = {}
        nodes[obs_id] = {
            "id": obs_id,
            "type": "observation",
            "label": f"observatie {obs_id} ({device_id})",
            "source": "mycelium",
            "metadata": {
                "device_id": device_id,
                "media_ref": str(item.get("media_ref", "")),
                "created_at": str(item.get("created_at", "")),
                "human_verified": bool(provenance.get(
                    "human_verified", False)),
                "source_type": str(provenance.get(
                    "source_type", "sensor-observed")),
            },
        }
        if len(edges) >= MAX_EDGES:
            return
        if device_id:
            edges.append({
                "from": device_id,
                "predicate": "captured",
                "to": obs_id,
                "provenance": {"source_type": "sensor-observed",
                               "creator_id": f"camera:{device_id}",
                               "human_verified": False},
            })
        describes = str(item.get("describes_entity_id", "") or "")
        if describes and describes in nodes:
            if len(edges) >= MAX_EDGES:
                return
            edges.append({
                "from": obs_id,
                "predicate": "describes",
                "to": describes,
                "provenance": {"source_type": "ai-generated",
                               "creator_id": "vision-flow",
                               "human_verified": False},
            })
        if len(nodes) >= MAX_NODES:
            return


def _overlay_fabrication(nodes: dict, edges: list,
                         artifacts: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Fabrication chain as Mycelium-owned overlay nodes.

    Artifact nodes (mesh/gcode files, print jobs, physical
    instances) link with closed predicates (derived_from,
    sliced_to, executed_as, produced, observed_by). Links only
    attach to nodes already present or added here — never a
    graph dump, never a second truth store.
    """
    for item in list(artifacts or [])[:MAX_FABRICATION_NODES]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        node_id = str(item.get("id", ""))
        kind = str(item.get("kind", "artifact"))
        if not node_id or node_id in nodes:
            continue
        nodes[node_id] = {
            "id": node_id,
            "type": kind,
            "label": str(item.get("label", node_id))[:120],
            "source": "mycelium",
            "metadata": {
                "status": str(item.get("status", ""))[:40],
                "sha256": str(item.get("sha256", ""))[:64],
            },
        }
        for link in list(item.get("links", []))[:10]:
            if not isinstance(link, dict):
                continue
            predicate = str(link.get("predicate", ""))
            target = str(link.get("to", ""))
            if (predicate not in FABRICATION_PREDICATES
                    or not target or target not in nodes):
                continue
            if len(edges) >= MAX_EDGES:
                return
            edges.append({
                "from": node_id,
                "predicate": predicate,
                "to": target,
                "provenance": {"source_type": "ai-generated",
                               "creator_id": "fabrication-flow",
                               "human_verified": False},
            })
        if len(nodes) >= MAX_NODES:
            return


MAX_REGISTRY_NODES = 50


def _overlay_registry_nodes(nodes: dict, edges: list,
                            registry: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Coordinator node registry as overlay (BIG #10 uniform
    layer). Nodes carry derived status, capability/model counts
    and revision hints (last_seen); they never merge with
    INVENTory entities.

    BIG #39: Includes health status, telemetry summary, and
    hardware/compute capability counts.

    BIG #41: Includes presence attention counts per node
    (needs/offline items naming it), best-effort via a lazy
    presence import — no new store, no cycle.
    """
    attention: dict[str, dict] = {}
    try:
        from .presence import attention_snapshot
        names = {str(row.get("node_id", ""))
                 for row in list(registry or [])
                 if row.get("node_id")}
        for entry in attention_snapshot(limit=200)["items"]:
            ident = str(entry.get("id", ""))
            if entry.get("band") not in ("needs", "offline"):
                continue
            # Boundary match only: att_<kind>_<node>[_suffix].
            # A bare substring test would credit "cam" for
            # "cam-2" items.
            for name in names:
                if ident.endswith("_" + name) or \
                        ("_" + name + "_") in ident:
                    slot = attention.setdefault(
                        name, {"needs": 0, "offline": 0})
                    slot[entry["band"]] += 1
                    break
    except Exception:
        attention = {}
    for item in list(registry or [])[:MAX_REGISTRY_NODES]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        node_id = str(item.get("node_id", ""))
        if not node_id or node_id in nodes:
            continue
        capabilities = item.get("capabilities", [])
        models = item.get("models", [])
        telemetry = item.get("telemetry", {})
        hardware = item.get("hardware", [])
        compute = item.get("compute_capabilities", [])
        health_status = item.get("health_status", "UNKNOWN")
        telemetry_ts = item.get("telemetry_timestamp", "")
        nodes[node_id] = {
            "id": node_id,
            "type": "node",
            "label": str(item.get("display_name")
                         or item.get("hostname", "")
                         or node_id)[:120],
            "source": "mycelium",
            "metadata": {
                "status": str(item.get("derived_status",
                                       item.get("status", ""))),
                "health": health_status,
                "tier": str(item.get("tier", "")),
                "capabilities": len(capabilities)
                if isinstance(capabilities, list) else 0,
                "models": len(models)
                if isinstance(models, list) else 0,
                "revision": str(item.get("last_seen", "")),
                "last_seen": str(item.get("last_seen", "")),
                "telemetry_timestamp": telemetry_ts,
                "telemetry_fields": len(telemetry) if isinstance(telemetry, dict) else 0,
                "hardware_count": len(hardware) if isinstance(hardware, list) else 0,
                "hardware_connected": sum(1 for h in hardware if isinstance(h, dict) and h.get("status") == "connected") if isinstance(hardware, list) else 0,
                "compute_count": len(compute) if isinstance(compute, list) else 0,
                "compute_available": sum(1 for c in compute if isinstance(c, dict) and c.get("status") == "available") if isinstance(compute, list) else 0,
                "cpu_percent": telemetry.get("cpu_percent") if isinstance(telemetry, dict) else None,
                "memory_percent": telemetry.get("memory_percent") if isinstance(telemetry, dict) else None,
                "energy_source": item.get("energy_state", {}).get("source") if isinstance(item.get("energy_state"), dict) else "unknown",
                "attention_needs": attention.get(node_id, {}).get("needs", 0),
                "attention_offline": attention.get(node_id, {}).get("offline", 0),
            },
        }
        if len(nodes) >= MAX_NODES:
            return


# BIG #39: Hardware Reality Layer - hardware inventory as overlay nodes
MAX_HARDWARE_OVERLAY = 30

def _overlay_hardware(nodes: dict, edges: list,
                       registry: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Node-reported hardware inventory as overlay nodes.

    Each hardware item becomes a node linked to its host node.
    Only connected hardware is shown. Hardware never merges with
    INVENTory hardware entities - this is node-reported runtime state.

    BIG #43 living game layer: a live VERIFIED human link for
    the exact node + device marks the overlay node
    verified=True (and its edge provenance human_verified=True)
    so the graph can render verified connections stronger.
    Nothing is derived — only the human-link store counts.
    """
    try:
        from .hardware_links import list_links as _hw_links
        verified_refs = {(link.node_id, link.device_ref)
                         for link in _hw_links(status="VERIFIED",
                                                limit=200)}
    except Exception:
        verified_refs = set()
    for item in list(registry or [])[:MAX_REGISTRY_NODES]:
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            continue
        node_id = str(item.get("node_id", ""))
        if not node_id:
            continue
        hardware = item.get("hardware", [])
        if not isinstance(hardware, list):
            continue
        for hw in hardware[:5]:  # limit per node
            if not isinstance(hw, dict):
                continue
            if str(hw.get("status", "")).lower() != "connected":
                continue
            identifier = str(hw.get("identifier", ""))
            if not identifier:
                continue
            hw_node_id = f"hw_{node_id}_{identifier}"
            if hw_node_id in nodes:
                continue
            kind = str(hw.get("kind", "other"))
            details = hw.get("details", {})
            is_verified = (node_id, identifier) in verified_refs
            nodes[hw_node_id] = {
                "id": hw_node_id,
                "type": "hardware",
                "label": f"{kind}: {identifier}",
                "source": "mycelium",
                "metadata": {
                    "kind": kind,
                    "identifier": identifier,
                    "host_node": node_id,
                    "details": details if isinstance(details, dict) else {},
                    "connected_since": hw.get("connected_since"),
                    "verified": is_verified,
                },
            }
            # Edge from node to hardware
            if len(edges) < MAX_EDGES:
                edges.append({
                    "from": node_id,
                    "predicate": "HAS",
                    "to": hw_node_id,
                    "provenance": {"source_type": "human-verified"
                                    if is_verified
                                    else "node-reported",
                                   "creator_id": f"node:{node_id}",
                                   "human_verified": is_verified},
                })
            if len(nodes) >= MAX_NODES:
                return

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/guide.py">
"""Mycelium Guide (BIG #33): what needs Jelles, derived live.

The guide is not a chatbot and never invents advice. It reads
existing state on every call and returns WHAT / WHY / NEXT
items that link to real pages:

- approvals waiting (desktop, writes, missions)
- knowledge candidates waiting for review
- conversation missed items (unresolved questions, ideas)
- research dossiers with open questions
- camera inbox files ready for analysis
- fabrications waiting for a next step
- nodes that went quiet
- projects that have no mission carrying them

Read-only. Bounded. Nothing stored, nothing promoted.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

GUIDE_KINDS = (
    "approval", "candidate", "conversation", "research",
    "camera", "fabrication", "node", "project", "mission",
    "workshop",
    # BIG #42 ecosystem workflows: hardware verification,
    # finance/energy links, quest trails.
    "hardware", "finance", "energy", "quest",
)


#: AFTERWARDS per kind (BIG #40 explanation layer): what
#: truthfully happens after the NEXT step. Mechanics only —
#: no invented outcomes, no promises.
AFTER_TEXT = {
    "approval": "After your YES the existing decision "
                "endpoint runs exactly that payload; the item "
                "then leaves the waiting list. NO closes it "
                "without effect.",
    "candidate": "Support keeps it a reviewed candidate; "
                 "promote turns it into memory. Either way it "
                 "leaves this list.",
    "conversation": "Queued research returns findings you "
                    "review line by line; nothing promotes "
                    "itself.",
    "research": "Completed dossiers wait for your review; "
                "claims become candidates only when you say "
                "so.",
    "camera": "Ingest turns files into observations; a VLM "
              "description turns them into reviewable text.",
    "fabrication": "Your approval moves exactly the proposed "
                   "payload; execution and independent "
                   "verification follow as their own steps.",
    "node": "Nodes are pull-only helpers; restored "
            "connectivity lets them claim work again. "
            "Nothing is ever pushed to a node.",
    "project": "Opening a mission for the project gives it a "
               "carrier; each step still asks its own gates.",
    "mission": "Resuming wakes one quest; consequential "
              "steps stop for YES again.",
    "workshop": "Linking material and project starts a real "
               "craft chain you can verify step by step.",
    "hardware": "Verifying names a human, a device and evidence; "
                "only the operator key completes it. Revoking "
                "returns the claim to ADVERTISED.",
    "finance": "Confirming keeps the figure as stated; unknown "
               "amounts stay UNKNOWN. Finance never enters "
               "generic telemetry.",
    "energy": "Recording a reading stores exactly what was "
              "observed; unknown stays UNKNOWN and can still "
              "block routing honestly.",
    "quest": "Opening the quest shows each step's live record; "
             "progress is done/total over real work, never XP.",
}


def _item(kind: str, glyph: str, what: str, why: str,
          label: str, href: str, after: str = "",
          blocked_by: list | None = None,
          unlocks: list | None = None,
          evidence: list | None = None) -> dict:
    afterwards = (after or AFTER_TEXT.get(kind, "")[:240])

    def _clean(entries) -> list:
        cleaned = []
        for entry in (entries or [])[:4]:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                continue
            label_text = str(entry.get("label", ""))[:60]
            href_text = str(entry.get("href", ""))[:200]
            if label_text and href_text:
                cleaned.append({"label": label_text,
                                "href": href_text})
        return cleaned

    return {"kind": kind, "glyph": glyph, "what": what[:160],
            "why": why[:240], "next": {"label": label[:60],
                                       "href": href[:200]},
            "after": afterwards,
            # BIG #43 companion layer: what blocks this, what it
            # unlocks, and the real records behind it.
            "blocked_by": _clean(blocked_by),
            "unlocks": _clean(unlocks),
            "evidence": _clean(evidence)}


def guide_items(limit: int = 12) -> list[dict]:
    """Compute guide items from live stores. Never raises."""
    items: list[dict] = []
    try:
        from . import main as _main

                f"{campaign.get('title', '')[:70]}: "
                f"{nxt.get('step', '')[:70]}",
                f"Campaign {campaign.get('completed_count', 0)}/"
                f"{campaign.get('total_count', 0)} — current "
                f"quest '{current.get('title', '')[:60]}'. "
                f"{nxt.get('readiness_reason', '')[:120]}",
                "Open campaign", "/campaigns",
                blocked_by=[{
                    "label": nxt.get("readiness", "see step"),
                    "href": nxt.get("href", "/quests")}],
                unlocks=[{
                    "label": "campaign step",
                    "href": "/campaigns"}],
                evidence=[
                    {"label": entry.get("label", "")[:60],
                     "href": entry.get("href", "/quests")}
                    for entry in
                    campaign.get("evidence", [])[:3]]))
            if len(items) >= 20:
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    # BIG #45 relationship-aware cards: why entities are
    # connected, why a link is only PROPOSED, what blocks it,
    # what would verify it, which node can help. Evidence
    # only — no duplicated relationship logic.
    try:
        from .symbiosis import proposed as _props45
        proposals = _props45(limit=10)
        if proposals:
            first = proposals[0]
            entities = first.get("entities", [])[:2]
            pair = " ↔ ".join(entities) if entities else \
                "entities"
            items.append(_item(
                "finance" if any(str(entity).startswith(
                    "fin_") for entity in entities)
                else "energy" if any(str(entity).startswith(
                    "enr_") for entity in entities)
                else "candidate", "🔗",
                f"Possible connection: {pair[:90]}.",
                f"'{first.get('title', '')[:100]}' is "
                "PROPOSED because a candidate names both "
                "sides and nobody reviewed it yet. "
                "Verification needs the gate of its kind: "
                "knowledge review, operator key, or "
                "confirmation.",
                "Review connection", "/symbiosis",
                blocked_by=[{
                    "label": "human review",
                    "href": "/symbiosis"}],
                unlocks=[{
                    "label": "supported connection",
                    "href": "/symbiosis"}],
                evidence=[{
                    "label": "open proposals",
                    "href": "/symbiosis"}]))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .presence import research_readiness as _ready45
        readiness = _ready45()
        eligible = readiness.get("eligible", []) or []
        if eligible:
            items.append(_item(
                "research", "🔧",
                f"Node {eligible[0]} can help with open "
                "research-linked work.",
                str(readiness.get("text", ""))[:200],
                "Queue research", "/research",
                unlocks=[{
                    "label": "research findings",
                    "href": "/research"}],
                evidence=[{
                    "label": f"{eligible[0]} nodes",
                    "href": "/nodes"}]))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        items.extend(_verdant_items())
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        missing = _missing_sensor_item()
        if missing is not None:
            items.append(missing)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return items[: max(1, min(int(limit or 12), 20))]


def _missing_sensor_item() -> dict | None:
    """Eerlijke ontbrekende capability: geen enkele node adverteert
    verbonden sensor-hardware → bodem/water-meten is FUTURE. Zodra
    een sensor verschijnt, verdwijnt dit item vanzelf."""
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        records = _main.list_nodes() or []
    except Exception:
        return None
    for record in records:
        hardware = record.get("hardware", []) or []
        for item in hardware:
            if not isinstance(item, dict):
                continue
            if str(item.get("kind", "")).lower() == "sensor" \
                    and str(item.get("status", "")).lower() == \
                    "connected":
                return None
    return _item(
        "hardware", "📡",
        "Geen sensor-hardware verbonden — bodem/water meten "
        "is FUTURE.",
        "Ecology-meting vereist een node met verbonden sensor; "
        "alleen camera/snapshot bestaat echt.",
        "Bekijk hardware", "/hardware",
        evidence=[{"label": "node-hardware",
                   "href": "/nodes"}])


def _verdant_items() -> list[dict]:
    """Verdant-signalen als Guide-items met hun natuurlijke kinds.

    Geen nieuw kind, geen wereldontwaking-claim: solar-metingen als
    energy-item, ecology-dossiers als research-items. Alleen lokale
    stores (sync); INVENTory-termen blijven voorbehouden aan de
    /play-Verdant (async bridge). Lege stores = geen items.
    """
    from .world import VERDANT_TERMS
    found: list[dict] = []
    try:
        from .energy import list_records
        solar = list_records(source="solar", limit=50) or []
        if solar:
            found.append(_item(
                "energy", "☀",
                f"{len(solar)} solar-meting(en) in Mycelium.",
                "Echte metingen — de Verdant-bioom in /play "
                "ontwaakt hierdoor mee.",
                "Bekijk energy", "/energy",
                unlocks=[{"label": "Verdant in /play",
                           "href": "/play"}],
                evidence=[{"label": "energy records",
                           "href": "/energy"}]))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .research_engine import list_dossiers
        for dossier in list_dossiers(limit=10) or []:
            try:
                data = dossier.model_dump(mode="json")
            except Exception:
                continue
            haystack = (f"{data.get('title', '')} "
                        f"{data.get('question', '')} "
                        f"{' '.join(data.get('open_questions', []) or [])}"
                        ).lower()
            if not any(term in haystack
                       for term in VERDANT_TERMS):
                continue
            dossier_id = str(data.get("dossier_id", "") or "")
            if not dossier_id:
                continue
            found.append(_item(
                "research", "🌿",
                f"Ecology-dossier: {str(data.get('title', ''))[:80]}.",
                "Echt onderzoek — voedt de Verdant-bioom in /play.",
                "Open dossier", f"/research/{dossier_id}",
                evidence=[{"label": "dossier",
                           "href": f"/research/{dossier_id}"}]))
            if len(found) >= 3:
                break
    except Exception:
        pass
    return found

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/database.py">
import json
import os
import sqlite3
import threading
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path


#: Serializes schema setup. DDL (executescript with CREATE
#: TABLE/INDEX) cannot run concurrently against one file;
#: this lock makes first-touch init a critical section.
#: Data writes never take this lock — they serialize in
#: the engine via WAL + busy_timeout instead.
_INIT_LOCK = threading.Lock()


def database_path() -> str:
    path = os.environ.get("MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH", "data/mycelium.db")
    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


#: Conservative busy timeout for local concurrent writers
#: (claim + campaign + sync-apply + jobs). Writers wait
#: instead of failing with "database is locked"; no retry
#: loop masks real contention, the engine serializes it.
BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS = 15000


def _open_db(path: str) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    """One deterministic connection setup for every database
    file: WAL journal mode (readers never block writers),
    busy timeout (writers wait instead of failing), row
    factory. Short-lived connections only — never shared
    across threads, never held open across requests."""
    db = sqlite3.connect(path, timeout=BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000.0)
    db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    db.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout={BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS}")
    db.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
    return db


@contextmanager
def connection():
    db = _open_db(database_path())
    try:
        yield db
        db.commit()
    finally:
        db.close()


def init_database() -> None:
    with _INIT_LOCK:
        with connection() as db:
            db.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS nodes (
            node_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            hostname TEXT NOT NULL,
            tier TEXT NOT NULL,
            capabilities TEXT NOT NULL,
            cpu_cores INTEGER NOT NULL,
            memory_mb INTEGER NOT NULL,
            energy_source TEXT NOT NULL,
            last_seen TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'online'
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tasks (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            kind TEXT NOT NULL,
            payload TEXT NOT NULL,
            required_capabilities TEXT NOT NULL,
            preferred_tier TEXT,
            priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'queued',
            assigned_node_id TEXT,
            result TEXT,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            completed_at TEXT,
            assigned_at TEXT,
            lease_until TEXT,
            attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            mission_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tasks_status
            ON tasks(status, priority DESC, id ASC);
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_nodes_last_seen
            ON nodes(last_seen);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_sessions (
            session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            x REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 800,
            y REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 500,
            zone TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            moved_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_play_sessions_updated
            ON play_sessions(updated_at);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_inventory (
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            item TEXT NOT NULL,
            qty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (session_id, item)
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_play_inventory_session
            ON play_inventory(session_id);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_gather (
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            node_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            gathered_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (session_id, node_id)
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_builds (
            build_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            kind TEXT NOT NULL,
            x REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            y REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_play_builds_session
            ON play_builds(session_id);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_chests (
            chest_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            x REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            y REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_play_chests_session
            ON play_chests(session_id);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_chest_items (
            chest_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            item TEXT NOT NULL,
            qty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (chest_id, item)
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_npc (
            npc_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            house_build_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'settled',
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (npc_id, session_id)
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_flags (
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            flag TEXT NOT NULL,
            set_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (session_id, flag)
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS world_clock (
            session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            day INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
            minute INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 480,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS play_notes (
            session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            note_key TEXT NOT NULL,
            text TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (session_id, note_key)
        );
        """)
            _ensure_task_columns(db)
            _ensure_node_columns(db)
            _ensure_play_columns(db)


def _ensure_node_columns(db) -> None:
    """Additive, idempotent migration for distributed nodes (BIG #8).

    Auth hash, display name, model/executor advertisements,
    resource hints and locality zone. All nullable/defaulted so
    existing positional INSERTs (9 values) keep working.

    Hardware Reality Layer (BIG #39): telemetry, hardware inventory,
    compute capabilities, and energy state columns.
    """
    existing = {row["name"] for row in db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(nodes)").fetchall()}
    for column, ddl in (
        ("auth_token_hash", "TEXT DEFAULT NULL"),
        ("display_name", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("models", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
        ("executors", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
        ("resources", "TEXT DEFAULT '{}'"),
        ("locality_zone", "TEXT DEFAULT 'local_network'"),
        ("last_auth", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("coordinator_capable", "INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("telemetry", "TEXT DEFAULT '{}'"),
        ("telemetry_timestamp", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("hardware", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
        ("compute_capabilities", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
        ("energy_state", "TEXT DEFAULT '{}'"),
        ("health", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        # VERTICAL SLICE 1 (physical digital world): read-only
        # display report stored as node-state JSON (like hardware).
        # No display table, no second truth — a VIEW derives from
        # this column on read (derive_digital_world).
        ("displays", "TEXT DEFAULT '[]'"),
    ):
        if column not in existing:
            db.execute(f"ALTER TABLE nodes ADD COLUMN {column} {ddl}")


def _ensure_task_columns(db) -> None:
    """Additive, idempotent migration for pre-M7.4 databases.

    Existing tables gain the M7.4 columns without touching stored rows
    beyond safe defaults (attempt_count 0, no assignment, no lease).
    """
    existing = {row["name"] for row in db.execute("PRAGMA table_info(tasks)").fetchall()}
    if "assigned_at" not in existing:
        db.execute("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN assigned_at TEXT")
    if "lease_until" not in existing:
        db.execute("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN lease_until TEXT")
    if "attempt_count" not in existing:
        db.execute("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN attempt_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")
    if "routing" not in existing:
        db.execute("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN routing TEXT DEFAULT '{}'")
    if "routing_decision" not in existing:
        db.execute("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN routing_decision TEXT DEFAULT '{}'")
    if "mission_id" not in existing:
        db.execute("ALTER TABLE tasks ADD COLUMN mission_id TEXT DEFAULT NULL")


def _ensure_play_columns(db) -> None:
    """Additive, idempotent migration for player sessions.

    Facing direction (radians, 0=east) so a reload restores
    the view as well as the feet. Default 0 keeps existing
    positional INSERTs working."""
    existing = {row["name"] for row in db.execute(
        "PRAGMA table_info(play_sessions)").fetchall()}
    if "angle" not in existing:
        db.execute("ALTER TABLE play_sessions ADD COLUMN "
                   "angle REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0")


CHAT_DATABASE_ENV_VAR = "MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH"


def chat_database_path() -> str:
    path = os.environ.get(CHAT_DATABASE_ENV_VAR, "data/mycelium-chat.db")
    Path(path).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    return path


@contextmanager
def chat_connection():
    """Separate SQLite file for chat/agent interaction state.

    The task-queue database keeps exactly its nodes/tasks tables (an
    existing test pins this); conversations, messages and desktop
    actions live here instead. Same JSON conventions, same additive
    discipline, lazily initialized on first use.
    """
    db = _open_db(chat_database_path())
    try:
        yield db
        db.commit()
    finally:
        db.close()


def init_chat_database() -> None:
    with _INIT_LOCK:
        with chat_connection() as db:
            db.executescript("""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (
            conversation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            title TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            project_ref TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
            message_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            role TEXT NOT NULL,
            content TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            provenance TEXT NOT NULL,
            sources TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_conversation
            ON messages(conversation_id, created_at);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS desktop_actions (
            action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_approval',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS missions (
            mission_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending_approval',
            current_step INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
            updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_missions_conversation
            ON missions(conversation_id, created_at);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversation_events (
            event_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            conversation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            mission_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            step_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            message TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
            metadata TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_events_conversation
            ON conversation_events(conversation_id, created_at);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS action_bindings (
            action_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            mission_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            step_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            bound_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS semantic_vectors (
            entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
            entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL,
            model TEXT NOT NULL,
            dim INTEGER NOT NULL,
            vector BLOB NOT NULL,
            updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
            PRIMARY KEY (entity_type, entity_id, model)
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vectors_model
            ON semantic_vectors(model, updated_at);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS camera_devices (
            device_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS camera_observations (
            observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            device_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cam_obs_device
            ON camera_observations(device_id, created_at);
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vision_analyses (
            analysis_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
            observation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
            record TEXT NOT NULL,
            created_at TEXT NOT NULL
        );
        CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vision_obs

# NEXT-AI-CONTEXT — continue Mycelium development here

Date: 2026-09-20. HEAD: `BIG #45 - finish living ecosystem connections`
(main, pushed to origin/main). Start with `git log --oneline -5`
and `git status` (a pre-existing `Mycelium/agent/agent_ui.py`
modification is NOT ours — leave it; `scripts/b38_screenshots.py`
is an untracked BIG #38 leftover — leave it).

## Architecture in one paragraph

Local-first personal AI: coordinator (`:8000`, FastAPI + SQLite
WAL) is the authority (approvals, tasks, leases, missions);
INVENTory (`:8080`) is the world memory, read via GET-only
loopback bridge (`inventory_read.py`), written only via gated
proposals (`inventory_writes.py` + exact YES + verification);
Ollama/external models are advisors (never authority); desktop
agent is the only hands (pull-only, outbound). V2
(`docs/v2-ecosystem.md`, BIG #41) unifies BIG #1–40 systems;
BIG #42 hardened it (links, finance/energy, quests,
workflows); BIG #43 added the game layer (campaigns, game
state view, companion guide); BIG #44 made /world the
primary experience (HUD + objects + symbiosis + craft +
campaign + energy + attention); BIG #45 adds the living
connections view over it all (`connections.py`: unified
entity connections, cross-project network over shared
records, campaign ecosystem, Guide-vocabulary detail,
POSSIBLE discovery — read-only over symbiosis, finance
(amounts never leak), energy, hardware, quests, campaigns,
research, registry nodes + claimed tasks; bare names must
exist in a registry or refuse 422). Presentation over real
state only — no XP, no scores, no second truth. Provenance
always; health scoped; no shell/RCE; no background threads
(explicit triggers only). Tests: `pytest -v` per project with
tmp DB env vars (`MYCELIUM_DATABASE_PATH`,
`MYCELIUM_CHAT_DATABASE_PATH` before TestClient;
`MYCELIUM_FABRICATION_DIR` for fab tests;
`MYCELIUM_OPERATOR_KEY` for hardware verify tests). Testing
discipline (BIG #43+): targeted tests during dev,
touched-module regression, smoke for the BIG, FULL Mycelium
suite ONCE + FULL INVENTory suite ONCE at finalization only,
bounded batches (single run exceeds 10-min timeout; camera
device enumeration may log access-violation noise on
Windows — pre-existing, unrelated).

## What BIG #45 added (where)

- `connections.py` (new) — `entity_connections()`,
  `project_network()` (shared-record cross-links only),
  `campaign_ecosystem()`, `connection_detail()`,
  `possible_connections()`; `_check_entity` (prefixes pass,
  bare names need node registry or live-link device_ref),
  `_known_device_ref`, device-side hardware lookup
- `main.py` — `GET /api/v1/connections*` (entity, network,
  detail, campaign, possible), `/connections` detail page,
  `_world_connections_html` (focused groups + unfocused
  clusters) in `world_page`, morning `connections` builder
- `guide.py` — possible-connection card (WHY PROPOSED /
  gate / blocked_by / unlocks / evidence) + node
  research-readiness card
- `mobile.py` — `connected_panel()` (CONNECTED / WAITING /
  DISCOVERED) + dashboard key
- `presence.py` — additive `campaign_blocked` type (needs,
  88, "campaign chain blocked")
- `reports.py` — `connections` morning key (additive)
- `ui.py` — `conn-cluster` CSS, `data-proposed` signal +
  JS (same loop, reduced-motion safe)
- Tests: `tests/test_big45_connections.py` (16).
- Scripts: `scripts/b45_smoke.py` (43 checks, fresh tmp DBs;
  claims via the real pull endpoint before asserting
  WORKING — delegation only pins), `scripts/b45_shots.py`
  (+ `shots_ids.json`) + `scripts/b45_screenshots.py`.
- Docs: `docs/BIG45-final-report.md`.
- Lessons: delegation leaves tasks queued+pinned — claim
  before asserting WORKING; `_assigned_tasks_map` emits
  `task_id` (older readers expect `id` — accept both at
  the consumer); the hardware store has no device filter —
  scan live links for device-side lookups.

"""Living Workshop visual system (BIG #19).

One design language for every coordinator page: dark-earth
SolarPunk tokens, a three-column workshop shell (world nav
/ workspace / context), organic status language, and
shared components. Pages supply content; this module owns
all presentation. Backend calls stay where they were —
this layer never fetches data itself (callers pass rows).

Accessibility: semantic landmarks, visible focus,
prefers-reduced-motion kills animation, contrast-checked
palette (warm off-white on near-black soil).
"""
