def nav_html(active: str) -> str:
    parts = []
    for group, links in NAV:
        parts.append(f"<h4>{esc(group)}</h4>")
        for href, label in links:
            current = ' aria-current="page"' if href == active \
                else ""
            parts.append(
                f'<a href="{esc(href)}"{current}>{esc(label)}</a>')
    return "<nav class=\"sidenav\" aria-label=\"Workshop areas\">" + \
        "".join(parts) + "</nav>"


# -- vertical slice: one coherent journey ------------------------------------
# HOME → READY? → WORLD → CHAT → ADVISE → MISSION → APPROVAL → TASK → EVENT.
# Presentational only: every step links to an existing page/route, the
# `now` marker only reflects the `active` path passed by the caller.

JOURNEY_STEPS = (
    ("Home", "/"),
    ("Ready?", "/#ready"),
    ("World", "/world"),
    ("Chat", "/chat"),
    ("Advise", "/advise"),
    ("Mission", "/missions"),
    ("Approval", "/approvals"),
    ("Task", "/tasks"),
    ("Event", "/activity"),
)


def journey_strip(active: str = "") -> str:
    """Game-trail nav over existing pages. No new routes, no state."""
    bits = []
    for label, href in JOURNEY_STEPS:
        cls = "now" if href == active or (
            label == "Home" and active in ("", "/")) else ""
        bits.append(
            f"<span class=\"step {cls}\">{esc(label)} · "
            f"<a href=\"{esc(href)}\">open</a></span>")
    trail = "<span class=\"arrow\">→</span>".join(bits)
    return (
        "<div class=\"panel living\" aria-label=\"Mycelium journey\">"
        "<h2>🌱 The journey</h2>"
        f"<div class=\"path\">{trail}</div>"
        "<p class=\"muted\">Home checks readiness, the world gives "
        "context, chat asks, advise answers, a mission plans, your YES "
        "approves, a task delegates, events show the result. Nothing "
        "skips your approval.</p></div>")


def readiness_strip(cells: list) -> str:
    """Honest REAL / SIMULATED / UNAVAILABLE chips from caller data.

    This helper never fetches: callers pass (label, state, detail,
    href) tuples built best-effort from existing stores. Unknown
    stays unknown.
    """
    cards = []
    for label, state, detail, href in cells:
        key = str(state or "UNKNOWN").strip().upper().replace(" ", "_")
        link = (f"<br><a href=\"{esc(href)}\">Open →</a>"
                if href else "")
        cards.append(
            f"<div class=\"hud-cell\"><small>{esc(label)}</small><br>"
            f"{visual_state(key)}<br>"
            f"<small class=\"muted\">{esc(detail)}</small>{link}</div>")
    return (
        "<div class=\"panel hud\" id=\"ready\" role=\"status\" "
        "aria-label=\"System readiness\">"
        "<h2>🌍 System ready?</h2>"
        "<div class=\"hud-row\">" + "".join(cards) + "</div>"
        "<p class=\"muted\">REAL = live record/loopback behind it · "
        "SIMULATED = test adapter, never physical · UNAVAILABLE = "
        "not configured or unreachable. Details stay one click away."
        "</p></div>")


def advise_form(q: str = "", question: str = "",
                type_: str = "", mode: str = "lexical") -> str:
    """Advise form posting to the existing /web/advise bridge."""
    modes = "".join(
        f"<option value='{m}'"
        + (" selected" if m == mode else "") + f">{m}</option>"
        for m in ("lexical", "semantic", "hybrid"))
    return (
        "<div class=\"panel\"><h2>🔮 Ask for advice</h2>"
        "<p class=\"muted\">Reads INVENTory (loopback only), asks the "
        "local model, stores nothing. Unavailable Ollama answers "
        "honestly — the question is never fabricated.</p>"
        "<form method=\"post\" action=\"/web/advise\" "
        "aria-label=\"Advise\">"
        f"<input type=\"text\" name=\"q\" placeholder=\"Search, e.g. camper…\" "
        f"value=\"{esc(q)}\" style=\"width:30%\" aria-label=\"Search\"> "
        f"<input type=\"text\" name=\"question\" placeholder=\"Question…\" "
        f"value=\"{esc(question)}\" style=\"width:40%\" aria-label=\"Question\"> "
        f"<input type=\"text\" name=\"type\" placeholder=\"type (optional)\" "
        f"value=\"{esc(type_)}\" style=\"width:12%\" aria-label=\"Type\"> "
        f"<select name=\"mode\" aria-label=\"Mode\">{modes}</select> "
        "<button type=\"submit\">Advise</button></form></div>")


def status_dot(status: str) -> str:
    key = str(status or "unknown").strip().lower()
    return f"<span class=\"dot {esc(key)}\" aria-hidden=\"true\"" \
        f"></span><span class=\"sr\">{esc(status)}</span>"


def chip(text: str, kind: str = "") -> str:
    return f"<span class=\"chip {esc(kind)}\">{esc(text)}</span>"


def truth_chip(truth: str) -> str:
    return chip(str(truth).replace("_", " "),
                f"truth-{truth}")


def state_chip(state: str) -> str:
    return chip(state, f"state-{state}")


MISSION_GLYPHS = {
    "running": "🟢",
    "approved": "🟢",
    "pending_approval": "🟡",
    "paused": "⚫",
    "blocked": "🟠",
    "failed": "✕",
    "completed": "✓",
    "cancelled": "✕",
    "draft": "🌱",
}


def mission_glyph(status: str) -> str:
    return MISSION_GLYPHS.get(str(status or "").strip().lower(), "🌱")


def growth_class(status: str, done: int = 0, total: int = 0) -> str:
    """Organic growth state for cards: seed → sprout → grown → bloom.
    Purely presentational; status text stays next to it."""
    key = str(status or "").strip().lower()
    if key in ("completed",):
        return "growth-bloom"
    if key in ("failed", "blocked", "cancelled"):
        return "growth-seed"
    try:
        if total > 0 and done >= total:
            return "growth-bloom"
        if total > 0 and done > 0:
            return "growth-grown"
    except TypeError:
        pass
    if key in ("running", "approved"):
        return "growth-sprout"
    return "growth-seed"


def empty(text: str = "Nothing here yet.") -> str:
    return f"<p class=\"empty\">{esc(text)}</p>"


def _living_chip_default() -> str:
    """Global living-state indicator for the topbar (BIG #31).

    Exception to the no-fetch rule, deliberately: the indicator is
    global chrome, not page data, and every page must show the same
    state without per-page wiring. Best-effort — an empty string on
    any failure, so a page never breaks on the indicator. Callers
    may still pass `living=` explicitly to override (tests, embeds).

    BIG #40 appends compact presence counts (waiting ·
    discoveries · offline) linking to /presence — same
    best-effort rule, counts vanish (never break) on failure.
    """
    try:
        from .living_state import current_state
        state = current_state()
        base = (f"<span aria-label=\"Mycelium state: "
                f"{esc(state.get('line', ''))}\" role=\"status\">"
                f"{esc(state.get('glyph', ''))} "
                f"{esc(state.get('line', ''))}</span>")
    except Exception:
        return ""
    try:
        from .presence import attention_snapshot
        counts = attention_snapshot(limit=120)["counts"]
        waiting = int(counts.get("needs", 0))
        found = int(counts.get("discovered", 0))
        offline = int(counts.get("offline", 0))
        extra = (f" <span class=\"presence-chip\">· "
                 f"{waiting} waiting · {found} discoveries · "
                 f"{offline} offline "
                 f"<a href=\"/presence\">attention →</a></span>")
    except Exception:
        extra = ""
    return base + extra


def shell(title: str, active: str, main: str, context: str = "",
          command: str = "", living: str | None = None) -> str:
    """Full workshop shell. `main` is the workspace column,
    `context` the right rail, `command` the bottom bar, `living`
    an optional pre-rendered living-state chip for the topbar
    (None = compute the global indicator)."""
    context_html = f"<aside class=\"context\" " \
        f"aria-label=\"Context\">{context}</aside>" if context \
        else ""
    cmd_html = f"<div class=\"cmdbar\">{command}</div>" \
        if command else ""
    living_html = ""
    chip = living if living is not None else _living_chip_default()
    if chip:
        living_html = f"<span class=\"ext\">{chip}</span>"
    return f"""<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head>
<meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>{esc(title)} — Mycelium Living Workshop</title>
<style>{BASE_CSS}</style></head>
<body><div class="shell">
<header class="topbar"><span class="brand">MYCELIUM <small>living workshop · local-first</small></span><span class="spacer"></span>{living_html}<a class="ext" href="http://127.0.0.1:8080" target="_blank" rel="noopener">INVENTory :8080</a> <a class="ext" href="/api/v1/agent/status">agent JSON</a></header>
{nav_html(active)}
<main class="workspace" id="main">{main}</main>
{context_html}
{cmd_html}
</div></body></html>"""


def command_bar(action: str = "/web/chat",
                placeholder: str = "Ask Mycelium…") -> str:
    return f"""<form method="post" action="{esc(action)}" role="search" aria-label="Ask Mycelium">
<input type="text" name="message" placeholder="{esc(placeholder)}" aria-label="Message" autocomplete="off">
<button type="submit">Send</button></form>"""


def context_block(title: str, body: str) -> str:
    return f"<section class=\"panel\"><h3>{esc(title)}</h3>{body}</section>"


def kv_list(rows) -> str:
    items = "".join(
        f"<tr><th scope=\"row\">{esc(key)}</th><td>{value}</td></tr>"
        for key, value in rows)
    return f"<table><tbody>{items}</tbody></table>"


def link_entities(text: str) -> str:
    """Linkify world/memory/mission ids in prose. Entity ids
    focus the world graph; memories open the memory page."""
    import re
    safe = esc(text)
    def world_link(match):
        ident = match.group(0)
        return f"<a href=\"/world?entity_id={ident}\"><code>{ident}</code></a>"
    safe = re.sub(r"\b(obj|proj|idea|loc|hw|file)_[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\b",
                  world_link, safe)
    def mem_link(match):
        ident = match.group(0)
        return f"<a href=\"/memory\"><code>{ident}</code></a>"
    safe = re.sub(r"\bmem_[A-Za-z0-9]+\b", mem_link, safe)
    def mission_link(match):
        ident = match.group(0)
        return f"<a href=\"/missions/{ident}\"><code>{ident}</code></a>"
    safe = re.sub(r"\bmission_[A-Za-z0-9]+\b", mission_link, safe)
    return safe


# -- BIG #33 living world helpers ---------------------------------------------
# Presentational only: technical state text always stays next to
# the visual. Growth vocabulary (seed/sprout/growing/bloom/
# harvest) never replaces backend status.

GROWTH_STAGES = ("seed", "sprout", "growing", "bloom", "harvest")

LIVING_BG_JS = """
(function(){
try{
if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
var c = document.getElementById('living-canvas');
if (!c) return;
var x = c.getContext('2d');
function size(){ c.width = window.innerWidth; c.height = window.innerHeight; }
size();
window.addEventListener('resize', size);
function clampInt(name, fallback, lo, hi){
var v = parseInt(c.getAttribute(name) || String(fallback), 10);
if (!(v >= lo && v <= hi)) v = fallback;
return v;
}
var density = clampInt('data-spores', 26, 8, 48);
var waiting = c.getAttribute('data-waiting') === '1';
var onlineNodes = clampInt('data-nodes', 0, 0, 30);
var research = clampInt('data-research', 0, 0, 12);
var discovery = clampInt('data-discovery', 0, 0, 24);
var verified = clampInt('data-verified', 0, 0, 24);
var fab = clampInt('data-fab', 0, 0, 12);
var offline = clampInt('data-offline', 0, 0, 30);
var energy = clampInt('data-energy', 0, 0, 24);
var needs = clampInt('data-needs', 0, 0, 40);
var proposed = clampInt('data-proposed', 0, 0, 24);
var tempo = 1 + Math.min(onlineNodes, 6) * 0.08 + Math.min(research, 4) * 0.04;
var dim = 1 - Math.min(offline, 6) * 0.05;
var spores = [];
for (var i = 0; i < density; i++) spores.push({x: Math.random(), y: Math.random(), r: 1 + Math.random() * 2, s: .0002 + Math.random() * .0006, o: .15 + Math.random() * .3});
var pulse = 0;
function frame(){
pulse += .008 * tempo;
x.clearRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
var i, p, px, py;
if (verified > 0) {
x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(125,155,106,0.07)';
x.lineWidth = 1;
for (i = 0; i + 1 < spores.length; i += 3) {
var a = spores[i], b = spores[i + 1];
var dx = (a.x - b.x) * c.width, dy = (a.y - b.y) * c.height;
if (dx * dx + dy * dy < 120 * 120) {
x.beginPath();
x.moveTo(a.x * c.width, a.y * c.height);
x.lineTo(b.x * c.width, b.y * c.height);
x.stroke();
}
}
}
for (i = 0; i < spores.length; i++){
p = spores[i];
p.y -= p.s * tempo;
if (p.y < -0.02) { p.y = 1.02; p.x = Math.random(); }
px = p.x * c.width + Math.sin(pulse + i) * 8;
py = p.y * c.height;
var o = p.o * dim;
var col = '201,214,107';
if (waiting && (i % 5 === 0)) col = '217,164,65';
else if (research > 0 && (i % 7 === 0)) col = '150,200,160';
else if (fab > 0 && (i % 6 === 0)) col = '217,140,90';
else if (energy > 0 && (i % 8 === 0)) col = '255,214,120';
if (discovery > 0 && (i % 9 === 0)) o = Math.min(0.6, o * 1.5);
if (proposed > 0 && (i % 10 === 0)) o = Math.min(0.55, o * 1.4);
if (energy > 0 && (i % 8 === 0)) { py -= 6; o = Math.min(0.65, o * 1.6); }
if (needs > 0 && (i % 11 === 0)) { col = '217,164,65'; o = Math.min(0.6, o * 1.4); }
x.beginPath();
x.arc(px, py, p.r, 0, 6.283);
x.fillStyle = 'rgba(' + col + ',' + o.toFixed(2) + ')';
x.fill();
}
window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
window.requestAnimationFrame(frame);
} catch (e) { /* decorative only */ }
})();
"""


def living_bg() -> str:
    """Subtle drifting-spore canvas. Decorative, reduced-motion safe.

    BIG #35: density follows recent ecosystem activity (more
    events = more spores, 8..48) and every fifth spore glows
    amber while approvals wait. BIG #41: drift tempo rises
    slightly with online nodes (capped +48%). BIG #43 living
    world: research quickens flow, fresh candidates pulse,
    verified connections draw faint mycelium threads, active
    fabrication warms spores, offline nodes dim the field.
    BIG #44 living solarpunk world: solar production lifts
    bright energy spores, presence NEEDS tint a few spores
    amber as subtle world emphasis. BIG #45 living
    connections: open proposals pulse like seedlings.
    Every signal derives from real stores, clamped, ambient
    only — motion never claims specific events happened."""
    spores = 26
    waiting = False
    online_nodes = 0
    research = 0
    discovery = 0
    verified = 0
    fab = 0
    offline = 0
    energy = 0
    needs = 0
    proposed = 0
    try:
        from .living_state import current_state
        state = current_state()
        activity = int(state.get("new_observations_24h", 0)) + \
            int(state.get("new_candidates_24h", 0)) + \
            int(state.get("new_connections_24h", 0)) + \
            int(state.get("running_missions", 0)) + \
            int(state.get("active_research_runs", 0)) + \
            int(state.get("automation_running", 0)) + \
            int(state.get("automation_waiting", 0))
        spores = max(8, min(48, 16 + activity * 2))
        waiting = int(state.get("waiting_approvals", 0)) > 0
        online_nodes = max(0, min(30, int(
            state.get("online_nodes", 0))))
        research = max(0, min(12, int(
            state.get("active_research_runs", 0))))
        discovery = max(0, min(24, int(
            state.get("new_candidates_24h", 0))))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .hardware_links import list_links
        verified = sum(1 for link in list_links(
            status="VERIFIED", limit=200))
        verified = max(0, min(24, verified))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from . import main as _main
        live_fabs = 0
        quiet_nodes = 0
        for item in _main.list_fabrications(20):
            try:
                data = item.model_dump(mode="json") \
                    if hasattr(item, "model_dump") else dict(item)
            except Exception:
                continue
            if str(data.get("status", "")) in (
                    "started", "approved", "ready", "waiting"):
                live_fabs += 1
        fab = max(0, min(12, live_fabs))
        for record in _main.list_nodes():
            if str(record.get("derived_status", "")) not in (
                    "online", "busy"):
                quiet_nodes += 1
        offline = max(0, min(30, quiet_nodes))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .energy import list_records as _energy_records
        production = sum(
            1 for record in _energy_records(limit=100)
            if record.kind == "production" and
            record.value is not None)
        energy = max(0, min(24, production))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .presence import attention_snapshot as _snapshot
        counts = (_snapshot(limit=60).get("counts", {}) or {})
        needs = max(0, min(40, int(counts.get("needs", 0))))
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        from .symbiosis import proposed as _proposed
        proposed = max(0, min(24, len(_proposed(limit=60))))
    except Exception:
        pass
    return ('<div class="living-bg" aria-hidden="true"></div>'
            '<canvas id="living-canvas" class="living-canvas" '
            f'data-spores="{spores}" '
            f'data-waiting="{1 if waiting else 0}" '
            f'data-nodes="{online_nodes}" '
            f'data-research="{research}" '
            f'data-discovery="{discovery}" '
            f'data-verified="{verified}" '
            f'data-fab="{fab}" '
            f'data-offline="{offline}" '
            f'data-energy="{energy}" '
            f'data-needs="{needs}" '
            f'data-proposed="{proposed}" '
            'aria-hidden="true"></canvas>'
            f'<script>{LIVING_BG_JS}</script>')


def visual_state(state: str) -> str:
    """State language chip: REAL solid, TEST/SIMULATED dashed,
    UNAVAILABLE muted, WAITING amber, ACTIVE living, BLOCKED
    contained, VERIFIED glow, CANDIDATE sprout, OBSERVATION
    spore. The exact technical state stays as text."""
    key = str(state or "unknown").strip().upper().replace(" ", "_")
    known = {"REAL", "TEST", "SIMULATED", "UNAVAILABLE", "WAITING",
             "ACTIVE", "BLOCKED", "VERIFIED", "CANDIDATE",
             "OBSERVATION"}
    css = key if key in known else "OBSERVATION"
    return f"<span class=\"chip state-{esc(css.lower())}\">{esc(key)}</span>"


def growth_bar(stage: str, label: str = "") -> str:
    """Organic progress: seed — sprout — growing — bloom — harvest."""
    key = str(stage or "seed").strip().lower()
    try:
        level = GROWTH_STAGES.index(key) + 1
    except ValueError:
        level, key = 1, "seed"
    glyphs = "🌱—🌿—🌳" if level < 4 else "🌱—🌿—🌳✿"
    bars = "".join(
        f"<span class=\"g{' on' if i < level else ''}\"></span>"
        for i in range(5))
    caption = esc(label or key)
    return (f"<div class=\"growthbar\" role=\"img\" aria-label=\"Growth: {caption}\">"
            f"<span aria-hidden=\"true\">{glyphs}</span>{bars}"
            f"<small class=\"muted\">{caption}</small></div>")


def quest_steps(steps: list) -> str:
    """Mission steps as a quest trail: ✓ done, ● now, ○ open.
    Backend status text is kept per step."""
    rows = []
    for step in steps or []:
        status = str(step.get("status", step.get("state", "open")))
        text = str(step.get("description", step.get("title", status)))[:120]
        key = status.strip().lower()
        if key in ("done", "completed", "verified", "succeeded"):
            rows.append(f"<li><span class=\"q-done\">✓</span> {esc(text)} "
                        f"<span class=\"muted\">[{esc(status)}]</span></li>")
        elif key in ("running", "active", "in_progress", "now"):
            rows.append(f"<li><span class=\"q-now\">●</span> {esc(text)} "
                        f"<span class=\"muted\">[{esc(status)}]</span></li>")
        elif key in ("blocked", "failed", "paused"):
            rows.append(f"<li><span class=\"q-now\">■</span> {esc(text)} "
                        f"<span class=\"muted\">[{esc(status)}]</span></li>")
        else:
            rows.append(f"<li><span class=\"q-todo\">○</span> {esc(text)} "
                        f"<span class=\"muted\">[{esc(status)}]</span></li>")
    return f"<ul class=\"quest\"> {''.join(rows) or '<li>○ No steps yet.</li>'} </ul>"


def symbiosis_chip(state: str) -> str:
    key = str(state or "").strip().upper()
    if key not in ("PROPOSED", "SUPPORTED", "VERIFIED"):
        key = "PROPOSED"
    return f"<span class=\"chip sym-{esc(key)}\">{esc(key)}</span>"


#: Stage states that count as done for progress bars. Everything
#: else counts as open; blocked/failed show separately. Callers
#: pass real backend states — this helper only renders.
PROGRESS_DONE = frozenset({
    "done", "completed", "verified", "approved", "prepared",
    "sliced", "gcode-ready", "printed-simulated", "observed",
    "connected", "inspected",
})

PROGRESS_BAD = frozenset({"blocked", "failed", "cancelled",
                          "rejected"})


def stage_progress(title: str, stages: list) -> str:
    """Real progress from real stages: [██████░░░░] 60% plus a
    ✓/○/■ checklist with backend state text. No XP, no levels —
    the bar derives from the stages passed in."""
    items = list(stages or [])
    total = len(items)
    done = sum(1 for label, state in items
               if str(state).strip().lower() in PROGRESS_DONE)
    percent = int(100 * done / total) if total else 0
    filled = max(0, min(10, round(10 * done / total))) if total \
        else 0
    bar = "█" * filled + "░" * (10 - filled)
    rows = []
    for label, state in items:
        key = str(state).strip().lower()
        if key in PROGRESS_DONE:
            mark = "<span class=\"q-done\">✓</span>"
        elif key in PROGRESS_BAD:
            mark = "<span class=\"q-now\">■</span>"
        else:
            mark = "<span class=\"q-todo\">○</span>"
        rows.append(f"<li>{mark} {esc(label)} "
                    f"<span class=\"muted\">[{esc(state)}]</span></li>")
    return (
        f"<div class=\"panel\"><h3>{esc(title)}</h3>"
        f"<p role=\"img\" aria-label=\"{esc(title)}: {percent}%\">"
        f"<code>[{bar}] {percent}%</code></p>"
        f"<ul class=\"quest\">{''.join(rows) or '<li>No stages.</li>'}</ul>"
        f"</div>")


def guide_card(item: dict) -> str:
    kind = str(item.get("kind", ""))
    nxt = item.get("next", {}) if isinstance(item.get("next"), dict) else {}
    after = str(item.get("after", ""))

    def _links(entries) -> str:
        bits = []
        for entry in (entries or [])[:4]:
            if not isinstance(entry, dict):
                continue
            label = str(entry.get("label", ""))[:60]
            href = str(entry.get("href", "/"))[:200]
            if label and href:
                bits.append(f"<a href=\"{esc(href)}\">"
                            f"{esc(label)}</a>")
        return " · ".join(bits)

    afterwards = (f"<br><small class=\"muted\">Afterwards: "
                  f"{esc(after)}</small>" if after else "")
    # BIG #43 companion fields: BLOCKED BY / UNLOCKS / EVIDENCE.
    # Rendered only when present; existing cards unchanged.
    companion = ""
    blocked_by = _links(item.get("blocked_by"))
    unlocks = _links(item.get("unlocks"))
    evidence = _links(item.get("evidence"))
    if blocked_by or unlocks or evidence:
        rows = ""
        if blocked_by:
            rows += (f"<small><b>Blocked by:</b> "
                     f"{blocked_by}</small>")
        if unlocks:
            rows += (f"<small><b>Unlocks:</b> "
                     f"{unlocks}</small>")
        if evidence:
            rows += (f"<small><b>Evidence:</b> "
                     f"{evidence}</small>")
        companion = f"<div class=\"companion\">{rows}</div>"
    return (f"<div class=\"sprout guide-card kind-{esc(kind)}\">"
            f"<b>{esc(item.get('glyph', '🌱'))} "
            f"{esc(item.get('what', ''))}</b><br>"
            f"<small>{esc(item.get('why', ''))}</small><br>"
            f"<a href=\"{esc(nxt.get('href', '/'))}\">"
            f"{esc(nxt.get('label', 'Open'))} →</a>"
            f"{afterwards}{companion}</div>")


def presence_card(item: dict) -> str:
    """One attention card: WHAT / WHY / SOURCE / NEXT + actions.

    All text escaped here at the render boundary. YES/NO reuse
    the exact form mechanics of the approval gates (response
    field for desktop/write decisions, path-bound mission
    endpoints); everything else offers OPEN + DEFER only.
    DEFER posts the item id to the presence triage endpoint and
    performs nothing.
    """
    band = str(item.get("band", "discovered"))
    kind = str(item.get("type", ""))
    action = item.get("action", {}) if isinstance(
        item.get("action"), dict) else {}
    yes_href = esc(str((action.get("YES", {}) or {}).get(
        "href", "")))
    no_href = esc(str((action.get("NO", {}) or {}).get(
        "href", "")))
    buttons: list[str] = []
    if kind in ("approval_desktop", "approval_write") and \
            yes_href and no_href:
        buttons.append(
            f"<form method=\"post\" action=\"{yes_href}\" "
            f"style=\"display:inline\">"
            f"<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"response\" "
            f"value=\"YES\"><button type=\"submit\">YES"
            f"</button></form>")
        buttons.append(
            f"<form method=\"post\" action=\"{no_href}\" "
            f"style=\"display:inline\">"
            f"<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"response\" "
            f"value=\"NO\"><button type=\"submit\">NO"
            f"</button></form>")
    elif kind == "approval_mission" and yes_href and no_href:
        buttons.append(
            f"<form method=\"post\" action=\"{yes_href}\" "
            f"style=\"display:inline\">"
            f"<button type=\"submit\">YES, doorgaan</button>"
            f"</form>")
        buttons.append(
            f"<form method=\"post\" action=\"{no_href}\" "
            f"style=\"display:inline\">"
            f"<button type=\"submit\">Cancel plan</button>"
            f"</form>")
    open_href = esc(str(item.get("open_href", "/activity")))
    buttons.append(f"<a class=\"chip\" href=\"{open_href}\">"
                   f"OPEN</a>")
    buttons.append(
        f"<form method=\"post\" "
        f"action=\"/web/presence/defer\" "
        f"style=\"display:inline\">"
        f"<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"item_id\" "
        f"value=\"{esc(item.get('id', ''))}\">"
        f"<button type=\"submit\" title=\"Nothing changes; "
        f"decide later\">DEFER</button></form>")
    why_points = "".join(
        f"<li><small>{esc(reason)}</small></li>"
        for reason in (item.get("priority_reasons", []) or [])[:4])
    return (f"<div class=\"sprout band-{esc(band)}\">"
            f"<b>{esc(item.get('title', ''))}</b> "
            f"{chip(esc(item.get('status', 'NEW')))}<br>"
            f"<small><b>WHY:</b> {esc(item.get('reason', ''))}"
            f"</small><br>"
            f"<small class=\"muted\">SOURCE: "
            f"{esc(item.get('source', ''))}</small><br>"
            f"<small class=\"muted\">NEXT: "
            f"<a href=\"{open_href}\">Open →</a></small>"
            f"<ul class=\"quest\">{why_points}</ul>"
            f"<p>{' '.join(buttons)}</p></div>")


def empty_grove(text: str, actions: list | None = None) -> str:
    """Empty state with a small mycelium character, never a void."""
    links = "".join(
        f"<a class=\"chip\" href=\"{esc(href)}\">{esc(label)}</a>"
        for label, href in (actions or []))
    return (f"<div class=\"panel empty-hero\"><div class=\"sprout-char\" "
            f"aria-hidden=\"true\">🌱</div><p>{esc(text)}</p>"
            f"<p class=\"flowline\">{links}</p></div>")


# -- world graph -----------------------------------------------------------
# Organic visual grammar (SVG, no framework):
# object: moss circle · project: double ring cluster ·
# idea: seed diamond · memory/mission: luminous halo ·
# node: technical square · observation: small pulse ·
# event: short-lived particle · task: amber circle ·
# source ring: world solid, mycelium dashed, conflict red.
# Bounded server data in, pan/zoom/select/focus/expand out.

GRAPH_JS = """
constWGDATA;
let scale = 1, tx = 0, ty = 0, selected = null;
const svg = document.getElementById('wstage');
const NS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
function wcolor(n){
  if ((n.metadata && n.metadata.status === 'conflict') || n.type === 'conflict') return 'var(--danger)';
  if (n.source === 'inventory') return 'var(--moss)';
  if (n.kind === 'memory' || n.type === 'memory') return 'var(--spore)';
  if (n.kind === 'mission' || n.type === 'mission') return 'var(--amber)';
  return 'var(--ink-dim)';
}
function wkind(n){ return (n.kind || n.type || 'entity').toLowerCase(); }
function wvisible(n){
  const f = id => document.getElementById(id).checked;
  if (wcolor(n) === 'var(--danger)') return f('f-conflict');
  const t = document.getElementById('f-type').value;
  if (t !== 'all' && wkind(n) !== t) return false;
  return n.source === 'inventory' ? f('f-world') : f('f-mycelium');
}
function wlayout(){
  const nodes = WGDATA.nodes.filter(wvisible);
  const byId = {};
  nodes.forEach((n, i) => {
    const a = 2 * Math.PI * i / Math.max(1, nodes.length);
    const r = n.source === 'inventory' ? 150 : 210;
    byId[n.id] = {x: 500 + r * Math.cos(a), y: 240 + r * Math.sin(a), n};
  });
  return byId;
}
function wshape(g, p){
  const k = wkind(p.n), c = wcolor(p.n), id = p.n.id;
  const grp = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
  grp.setAttribute('class', 'w-node');
  grp.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  grp.setAttribute('role', 'button');
  grp.setAttribute('aria-label', (p.n.label || id) + ' (' + k + ')');
  const halo = (k === 'memory' || k === 'mission');
  if (halo) {
    const h = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
    h.setAttribute('cx', p.x); h.setAttribute('cy', p.y); h.setAttribute('r', 16);
    h.setAttribute('fill', 'none'); h.setAttribute('stroke', c);
    h.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '.35'); h.setAttribute('stroke-width', '5');
    h.setAttribute('class', 'breathe'); grp.appendChild(h);
  }
  let el;
  if (k === 'idea') {
    el = document.createElementNS(NS, 'rect');
    el.setAttribute('x', p.x - 7); el.setAttribute('y', p.y - 7);
    el.setAttribute('width', 14); el.setAttribute('height', 14);
    el.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(45 ${p.x} ${p.y})`);
  } else if (k === 'node' || k === 'device' || k === 'printer') {
    el = document.createElementNS(NS, 'rect');
    el.setAttribute('x', p.x - 7); el.setAttribute('y', p.y - 7);
    el.setAttribute('width', 14); el.setAttribute('height', 14);
    el.setAttribute('rx', 2);
  } else {
    el = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
    el.setAttribute('cx', p.x); el.setAttribute('cy', p.y);
    const r = k === 'project' ? 12 : k === 'observation' || k === 'event' ? 5 : 8;
    el.setAttribute('r', id === selected ? r + 4 : r);
  }
  el.setAttribute('fill', k === 'project' ? 'none' : c);
  el.setAttribute('stroke', c);
  el.setAttribute('stroke-width', k === 'project' ? 3 : 1.5);
  if (p.n.source !== 'inventory') el.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '4 2');
  if (k === 'observation') el.setAttribute('class', 'pulse');
  const verified = p.n.metadata && p.n.metadata.verified === true;
  if (verified) {
    el.setAttribute('stroke-width', 3);
    el.setAttribute('class', ((k === 'observation') ? 'pulse ' : '') + 'verified-glow');
    const ring = document.createElementNS(NS, 'circle');
    ring.setAttribute('cx', p.x); ring.setAttribute('cy', p.y); ring.setAttribute('r', 13);
    ring.setAttribute('fill', 'none'); ring.setAttribute('stroke', c);
    ring.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '.5'); ring.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.5');
    grp.appendChild(ring);
  }
  grp.appendChild(el);
  const t = document.createElementNS(NS, 'text');
  t.setAttribute('x', p.x + 13); t.setAttribute('y', p.y + 4);
  t.textContent = (p.n.label || id).slice(0, 26);
  grp.appendChild(t);
  const pick = () => wselect(p.n);
  grp.addEventListener('click', pick);
  grp.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); pick(); }
  });
  g.appendChild(grp);
}
function wrender(){
  while (svg.firstChild) svg.removeChild(svg.firstChild);
  const g = document.createElementNS(NS, 'g');
  g.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${tx},${ty}) scale(${scale})`);
  svg.appendChild(g);
  const byId = wlayout();
  (WGDATA.areas || []).forEach(a => {
    if (!a || !a.id) return;
    const pts = (a.members || []).map(id => byId[id]).filter(p => p);
    if (!pts.length) return;
    const xs = pts.map(p => p.x), ys = pts.map(p => p.y);
    const pad = 34;
    const x0 = Math.min(...xs) - pad, y0 = Math.min(...ys) - pad - 14;
    const x1 = Math.max(...xs) + pad, y1 = Math.max(...ys) + pad;
    const label = String(a.label || a.id).slice(0, 40);
    const go = () => { location.href = '/world?entity_id=' + encodeURIComponent(a.id) + WSSUFFIX; };
    const r = document.createElementNS(NS, 'rect');
    r.setAttribute('x', x0); r.setAttribute('y', y0);
    r.setAttribute('width', Math.max(10, x1 - x0));
    r.setAttribute('height', Math.max(10, y1 - y0));
    r.setAttribute('rx', 18); r.setAttribute('class', 'w-area');
    r.setAttribute('tabindex', '0'); r.setAttribute('role', 'link');
    r.setAttribute('aria-label', label + ' area — open neighborhood');
    const tip = document.createElementNS(NS, 'title');
    tip.textContent = label + ' — open area';
    r.appendChild(tip);
    r.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    r.addEventListener('click', go);
    r.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); go(); }
    });
    g.appendChild(r);
    const lab = document.createElementNS(NS, 'text');
    lab.setAttribute('x', x0 + 12); lab.setAttribute('y', y0 + 20);
    lab.setAttribute('class', 'w-area-label');
    lab.textContent = '▦ ' + label + ' (' + pts.length + ')';
    g.appendChild(lab);
  });
  (WGDATA.edges || []).forEach(e => {
    if (!byId[e.from] || !byId[e.to]) return;
    const l = document.createElementNS(NS, 'line');
    l.setAttribute('x1', byId[e.from].x); l.setAttribute('y1', byId[e.from].y);
    l.setAttribute('x2', byId[e.to].x); l.setAttribute('y2', byId[e.to].y);
    l.setAttribute('stroke', 'var(--line)'); l.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.5');
    l.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    l.addEventListener('click', () => wselectEdge(e));
    g.appendChild(l);
    const t = document.createElementNS(NS, 'text');
    t.setAttribute('x', (byId[e.from].x + byId[e.to].x) / 2);
    t.setAttribute('y', (byId[e.from].y + byId[e.to].y) / 2 - 3);
    t.setAttribute('font-size', '9'); t.setAttribute('fill', 'var(--ink-faint)');
    t.textContent = e.predicate || '';
    g.appendChild(t);
  });
  Object.values(byId).forEach(p => wshape(g, p));
  const n = WGDATA.nodes.filter(wvisible).length;
  document.getElementById('wcount').textContent = n + ' shown / ' + WGDATA.nodes.length + ' loaded';
}
function wdetails(html){ document.getElementById('wdetails').innerHTML = html; }
function wselect(n){
  selected = n.id;
  const meta = n.metadata || {};
  const rows = [['id', n.id], ['kind', wkind(n)], ['source', n.source || '?']]
    .map(([k, v]) => `<tr><th scope="row">${k}</th><td>${String(v).replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</td></tr>`).join('');
  let links = '';
  if (String(n.id).match(/^(obj_|proj_|idea_|loc_|hw_|file_)/))
    links += `<p><a href="/world?entity_id=${encodeURIComponent(n.id)}${WSSUFFIX}">Open neighborhood</a></p>`;
  if (String(n.id).startsWith('mem_'))
    links += `<p><a href="/memory">Open in memory</a></p>`;
  if (String(n.id).startsWith('prt-'))
    links += `<p><a href="/devices">Open in devices</a></p>`;
  wdetails(`<table><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>`
    + `<details><summary>metadata</summary><code>${JSON.stringify(meta).replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</code></details>` + links);
  wrender();
}
function wselectEdge(e){
  wdetails(`<table><tbody><tr><th scope="row">relation</th><td>${String(e.predicate || '').replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</td></tr>`
    + `<tr><th scope="row">from</th><td>${String(e.from).replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</td></tr>`
    + `<tr><th scope="row">to</th><td>${String(e.to).replace(/</g, '&lt;')}</td></tr></tbody></table>`);
}
document.getElementById('wzin').addEventListener('click', () => { scale *= 1.2; wrender(); });
document.getElementById('wzout').addEventListener('click', () => { scale /= 1.2; wrender(); });
document.getElementById('wfocus').addEventListener('click', () => { tx = 0; ty = 0; scale = 1; wrender(); });
['f-world', 'f-mycelium', 'f-conflict'].forEach(id =>
  document.getElementById(id).addEventListener('change', wrender));
document.getElementById('f-type').addEventListener('change', wrender);
let wdrag = null;
svg.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => { wdrag = [e.clientX, e.clientY]; svg.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId); });
svg.addEventListener('pointerup', () => wdrag = null);
svg.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  if (!wdrag) return;
  tx += e.clientX - wdrag[0]; ty += e.clientY - wdrag[1];
  wdrag = [e.clientX, e.clientY]; wrender();
});
svg.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  scale *= e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9; wrender();
}, {passive: false});
wrender();
"""


def graph_panel(data_json: str, form_action: str, entity_id: str = "",
                depth: int = 1, show: str = "missions,nodes",
                error: str = "", workspace: str = "") -> str:
    """Interactive world graph: form + SVG stage + details.
    `data_json` is the already-serialized graph dict. An
    empty graph renders guidance plus a static mycelium
    figure (decorative, aria-hidden) instead of a void.
    `workspace` (optional) is preserved across the focus form
    and area/entity deep links."""
    import json as _json
    safe_data = data_json.replace("</", "<\\/")
    ws_field = (f"<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"workspace\" "
                f"value=\"{esc(workspace)}\">") if workspace else ""
    # Workspace slugs are [A-Za-z0-9_-] (validated server-side), so
    # this suffix is URL-safe verbatim.
    ws_const = (f"const WSSUFFIX = '&workspace={esc(workspace)}';"
                if workspace else "const WSSUFFIX = '';")
    try:
        node_count = len(_json.loads(data_json).get("nodes",
                                                    []))
    except ValueError:
        node_count = -1
    empty_html = ""
    if node_count == 0:
        empty_html = """<div class="panel"><h2>A quiet patch of soil</h2>
<p class="muted">Nothing grows here yet. Pick a seed above, open a project, or check that INVENTory is running — the graph only ever shows real data.</p>
<p><a href="/projects">Browse projects</a> · <a href="/memory">Browse memory</a></p>
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 120" width="100%" height="120" aria-hidden="true">
<g fill="none" stroke="var(--fern)" stroke-width="1.5" opacity=".55">
<path d="M20 100 C 90 90, 120 60, 200 62 S 330 40, 385 55"/>
<path d="M200 62 C 190 40, 170 30, 150 28"/>
<path d="M200 62 C 220 45, 250 42, 275 30"/>
<path d="M90 92 C 80 75, 60 70, 45 60"/>
<circle cx="150" cy="28" r="3.5" fill="var(--moss)" stroke="none" opacity=".8"/>
<circle cx="275" cy="30" r="3.5" fill="var(--spore)" stroke="none" opacity=".8"/>
<circle cx="45" cy="60" r="3" fill="var(--moss)" stroke="none" opacity=".7"/>
<circle cx="385" cy="55" r="2.5" fill="var(--ink-faint)" stroke="none" opacity=".7"/>
</g></svg></div>"""
    return f"""<div class="panel"><form method="get" action="{esc(form_action)}" role="search" aria-label="Graph focus">
<label>Entity <input type="text" name="entity_id" placeholder="obj_… / proj_… / mem_…" value="{esc(entity_id)}" style="width:16rem"></label>
<label>Depth <input type="number" name="depth" value="{esc(depth)}" min="1" max="2" style="width:3.5rem"></label>
<label>Overlays <input type="text" name="show" value="{esc(show)}" style="width:12rem"></label>
{ws_field}
<button type="submit">Grow</button></form>
<p class="muted">world <span class="dot online"></span> · mycelium overlay (dashed) · memory <span class="dot" style="background:var(--spore)"></span> · mission <span class="dot" style="background:var(--amber)"></span> · conflict <span class="dot" style="background:var(--danger)"></span> · area <span style="color:var(--spore)">▦</span> = location containment</p>
<p><small>Show:</small>
<label><input type="checkbox" id="f-world" checked> world</label>
<label><input type="checkbox" id="f-mycelium" checked> mycelium</label>
<label><input type="checkbox" id="f-conflict" checked> conflict</label>
<label>Type <select id="f-type"><option value="all">all</option><option value="object">objects</option><option value="project">projects</option><option value="idea">ideas</option><option value="memory">memories</option><option value="mission">missions</option><option value="task">tasks</option><option value="node">nodes</option><option value="observation">observations</option><option value="event">events</option></select></label>
<button id="wzin" aria-label="Zoom in">+</button><button id="wzout" aria-label="Zoom out">−</button>
<button id="wfocus">Reset view</button>
<span id="wcount" class="muted" role="status"></span></p>
<p style="color:var(--danger)">{esc(error)}</p></div>
<svg id="wstage" class="world" viewBox="0 0 1000 480" role="application" aria-label="World graph. Tab to move between nodes, Enter to select."></svg>
{empty_html}
<div class="panel"><h2>Details</h2><div id="wdetails">Select a node or relation. Keyboard: Tab to a node, Enter to open.</div></div>
<script>const WGDATA = {safe_data};
{ws_const}
{GRAPH_JS.replace("constWGDATA;", "")}</script>"""


# -- infinite canvas (MVP) ---------------------------------------------------
# Additive workshop lens over the same graph payload as /world. Own
# script (draggable nodes, camera transform, search-to-focus) so the
# world graph stays byte-identical in behavior. Positions live in a
# session-only offsets map — never persisted, never sent anywhere.

CANVAS_JS = """
let cscale = 1, ctx = 0, cty = 0, coff = {}, csel = null;
let cdrag = null, cmoved = false;
const csvg = document.getElementById('cstage');
const cNS = 'http://www.w3.org/2000/svg';
const px2u = () => 1000 / (csvg.clientWidth || 1000);
function ckind(n){ return (n.kind || n.type || 'entity').toLowerCase(); }
function ccolor(n){
  if ((n.metadata && n.metadata.status === 'conflict') || n.type === 'conflict') return 'var(--danger)';
  if (n.source === 'inventory') return 'var(--moss)';
  if (n.kind === 'memory' || n.type === 'memory') return 'var(--spore)';
  if (n.kind === 'mission' || n.type === 'mission') return 'var(--amber)';
  return 'var(--ink-dim)';
}
function clayout(){
  const byId = {};
  (CDATA.nodes || []).forEach((n, i) => {
    const a = 2 * Math.PI * i / Math.max(1, CDATA.nodes.length);
    const r = n.source === 'inventory' ? 150 : 210;
    const o = coff[n.id] || {dx: 0, dy: 0};
    byId[n.id] = {x: 500 + r * Math.cos(a) + o.dx, y: 300 + r * Math.sin(a) + o.dy, n};
  });
  return byId;
}
function cshape(g, p){
  const k = ckind(p.n), c = ccolor(p.n), id = p.n.id;
  const grp = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'g');
  grp.setAttribute('class', 'c-node');
  grp.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  grp.setAttribute('role', 'button');
  grp.setAttribute('aria-label', (p.n.label || id) + ' (' + k + ')');
  grp.dataset.nid = id;
  if (ckind(p.n) === 'memory' || ckind(p.n) === 'mission') {
    const h = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'circle');
    h.setAttribute('cx', p.x); h.setAttribute('cy', p.y); h.setAttribute('r', 16);
    h.setAttribute('fill', 'none'); h.setAttribute('stroke', c);
    h.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '.35'); h.setAttribute('stroke-width', '5');
    grp.appendChild(h);
  }
  let el;
  if (k === 'idea') {
    el = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'rect');
    el.setAttribute('x', p.x - 7); el.setAttribute('y', p.y - 7);
    el.setAttribute('width', 14); el.setAttribute('height', 14);
    el.setAttribute('transform', `rotate(45 ${p.x} ${p.y})`);
  } else if (k === 'node' || k === 'device' || k === 'printer') {
    el = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'rect');
    el.setAttribute('x', p.x - 7); el.setAttribute('y', p.y - 7);
    el.setAttribute('width', 14); el.setAttribute('height', 14);
    el.setAttribute('rx', 2);
  } else {
    el = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'circle');
    el.setAttribute('cx', p.x); el.setAttribute('cy', p.y);
    const rr = k === 'project' ? 12 : 8;
    el.setAttribute('r', id === csel ? rr + 4 : rr);
  }
  el.setAttribute('fill', k === 'project' ? 'none' : c);
  el.setAttribute('stroke', c);
  el.setAttribute('stroke-width', k === 'project' ? 3 : 1.5);
  if (p.n.source !== 'inventory') el.setAttribute('stroke-dasharray', '4 2');
  if (id === csel) el.setAttribute('class', 'w-hi');
  grp.appendChild(el);
  const t = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'text');
  t.setAttribute('x', p.x + 13); t.setAttribute('y', p.y + 4);
  t.textContent = (p.n.label || id).slice(0, 26);
  grp.appendChild(t);
  g.appendChild(grp);
}
function careas(g, byId){
  (CDATA.areas || []).forEach(a => {
    if (!a || !a.id) return;
    const pts = (a.members || []).map(id => byId[id]).filter(p => p);
    if (!pts.length) return;
    const xs = pts.map(p => p.x), ys = pts.map(p => p.y);
    const pad = 34;
    const x0 = Math.min(...xs) - pad, y0 = Math.min(...ys) - pad - 14;
    const x1 = Math.max(...xs) + pad, y1 = Math.max(...ys) + pad;
    const label = String(a.label || a.id).slice(0, 40);
    const r = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'rect');
    r.setAttribute('x', x0); r.setAttribute('y', y0);
    r.setAttribute('width', Math.max(10, x1 - x0));
    r.setAttribute('height', Math.max(10, y1 - y0));
    r.setAttribute('rx', 18); r.setAttribute('class', 'w-area');
    const tip = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'title');
    tip.textContent = label + ' — open area in World';
    r.appendChild(tip);
    r.style.cursor = 'pointer';
    r.addEventListener('click', () => {
      if (cmoved) return;
      location.href = '/world?entity_id=' + encodeURIComponent(a.id) + CWSSUFFIX;
    });
    g.appendChild(r);
    const lab = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'text');
    lab.setAttribute('x', x0 + 12); lab.setAttribute('y', y0 + 20);
    lab.setAttribute('class', 'w-area-label');
    lab.textContent = '▦ ' + label + ' (' + pts.length + ')';
    g.appendChild(lab);
  });
}
function cside(html){ document.getElementById('cside-body').innerHTML = html; }
function cesc(s){ return String(s == null ? '' : s).replace(/</g, '&lt;'); }
function clinks(n){
  const id = String(n.id);
  let out = `<p><a href="/world?entity_id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}${CWSSUFFIX}">Open in World →</a></p>`;
  if (/^(obj_|proj_|idea_|loc_|hw_|file_)/.test(id))
    out += `<p><a href="/world?entity_id=${encodeURIComponent(id)}${CWSSUFFIX}">Open entity neighborhood →</a></p>`;
  if (id.startsWith('mem_')) out += `<p><a href="/memory">Open in memory →</a></p>`;
  if (id.startsWith('mission_')) out += `<p><a href="/missions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}">Open mission →</a></p>`;
  if (id.startsWith('prt-')) out += `<p><a href="/devices">Open in devices →</a></p>`;
  return out;
}
function cselect(n){
  csel = n.id;
  const meta = n.metadata || {};
  const rows = [['type', ckind(n)], ['source', n.source || '?']]
    .concat(Object.entries(meta).slice(0, 6).map(([k, v]) => [k, String(v).slice(0, 80)]))
    .map(([k, v]) => `<tr><th scope="row">${cesc(k)}</th><td>${cesc(v)}</td></tr>`).join('');
  cside(`<b>${cesc(n.label || n.id)}</b><br><code>${cesc(n.id)}</code>`
    + `<table><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table>` + clinks(n));
  crender();
}
function crender(){
  [...csvg.children].forEach(ch => {
    if (ch.tagName && ch.tagName.toLowerCase() !== 'defs') csvg.removeChild(ch);
  });
  const grid = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'rect');
  grid.setAttribute('x', -5000); grid.setAttribute('y', -5000);
  grid.setAttribute('width', 10000); grid.setAttribute('height', 10000);
  grid.setAttribute('fill', 'url(#cdot)');
  const g = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'g');
  g.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${ctx},${cty}) scale(${cscale})`);
  g.appendChild(grid);
  csvg.appendChild(g);
  const byId = clayout();
  careas(g, byId);
  (CDATA.edges || []).forEach(e => {
    if (!byId[e.from] || !byId[e.to]) return;
    const l = document.createElementNS(cNS, 'line');
    l.setAttribute('x1', byId[e.from].x); l.setAttribute('y1', byId[e.from].y);
    l.setAttribute('x2', byId[e.to].x); l.setAttribute('y2', byId[e.to].y);
    l.setAttribute('stroke', 'var(--line)'); l.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.5');
    g.appendChild(l);
  });
  Object.values(byId).forEach(p => cshape(g, p));
  const n = (CDATA.nodes || []).length;
  document.getElementById('ccount').textContent = n + ' nodes · drag to arrange (session only)';
}
csvg.addEventListener('pointerdown', e => {
  const grp = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.c-node') : null;
  csvg.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  cmoved = false;
  if (grp && grp.dataset.nid)
    cdrag = {kind: 'node', id: grp.dataset.nid, sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, lx: e.clientX, ly: e.clientY};
  else cdrag = {kind: 'pan', sx: e.clientX, sy: e.clientY, lx: e.clientX, ly: e.clientY};
});
csvg.addEventListener('pointermove', e => {
  if (!cdrag) return;
  if (Math.abs(e.clientX - cdrag.sx) + Math.abs(e.clientY - cdrag.sy) > 4) cmoved = true;
  const dx = e.clientX - cdrag.lx, dy = e.clientY - cdrag.ly;
  cdrag.lx = e.clientX; cdrag.ly = e.clientY;
  if (cdrag.kind === 'node') {
    const f = px2u() / cscale;
    const o = coff[cdrag.id] || {dx: 0, dy: 0};
    o.dx += dx * f; o.dy += dy * f;
    coff[cdrag.id] = o;
    crender();
  } else {
    const f = px2u();
    ctx += dx * f; cty += dy * f;
    crender();
  }
});
csvg.addEventListener('pointerup', e => {
  const wasDrag = cdrag && cdrag.kind === 'node' ? cdrag.id : null;
  cdrag = null;
  if (wasDrag && !cmoved) {
    const found = (CDATA.nodes || []).find(n => n.id === wasDrag);
    if (found) cselect(found);
  }
});
csvg.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  const grp = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('.c-node') : null;
  if (grp && grp.dataset.nid && (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')) {
    e.preventDefault();
    const found = (CDATA.nodes || []).find(n => n.id === grp.dataset.nid);
    if (found) cselect(found);
  }
});
csvg.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
  e.preventDefault();
  cscale = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(4, cscale * (e.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 0.9)));
  crender();
}, {passive: false});
document.getElementById('czin').addEventListener('click', () => { cscale = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(4, cscale * 1.2)); crender(); });
document.getElementById('czout').addEventListener('click', () => { cscale = Math.max(0.2, Math.min(4, cscale / 1.2)); crender(); });
document.getElementById('creset').addEventListener('click', () => { cscale = 1; ctx = 0; cty = 0; coff = {}; csel = null; crender(); });
async function csearchGo(){
  const box = document.getElementById('cresults');
  const q = document.getElementById('csearch').value.trim();
  if (!q) { box.innerHTML = '<li class="muted">Type to search the world.</li>'; return; }
  box.innerHTML = '<li class="muted">Searching…</li>';
  try {
    const res = await fetch('/api/v1/world/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q));
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('search ' + res.status);
    const data = await res.json();
    const rows = (data.results || []).slice(0, 8);
    if (!rows.length) { box.innerHTML = '<li class="muted">Nothing found.</li>'; return; }
    box.innerHTML = '';
    rows.forEach(r => {
      const li = document.createElement('li');
      const b = document.createElement('button');
      b.textContent = (r.title || r.entity_id) + ' [' + (r.entity_type || '?') + ']';
      b.addEventListener('click', () => cfocus(r.entity_id));
      li.appendChild(b);
      box.appendChild(li);
    });
  } catch (err) {
    box.innerHTML = '<li class="muted">Search unavailable.</li>';
  }
}
function cfocus(id){
  const box = document.getElementById('cresults');
  const byId = clayout();
  const p = byId[id];
  if (!p) {
    box.innerHTML = '<li class="muted">Not in this workspace — clear the scope or open it in <a href="/world?entity_id=' + encodeURIComponent(id) + '">World</a>.</li>';
    return;
  }
  ctx = 500 - p.x * cscale; cty = 300 - p.y * cscale;
  const found = (CDATA.nodes || []).find(n => n.id === id);
  if (found) cselect(found); else crender();
}
document.getElementById('cgo').addEventListener('click', csearchGo);
document.getElementById('csearch').addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (e.key === 'Enter') { e.preventDefault(); csearchGo(); }
});
crender();
"""


def canvas_panel(data_json: str, workspace: str = "",
                 back_to_world_href: str = "/world") -> str:
    """Infinite-canvas workshop lens over a world-graph payload.

    Same node/edge/area shapes as the world graph; own script for
    draggable nodes (session-only offsets), camera transform and
    search-to-focus. Positions are never persisted or sent anywhere.
    `workspace` scopes deep links; `back_to_world_href` returns."""
    safe_data = data_json.replace("</", "<\\/")
    try:
        import json as _json
        node_count = len(_json.loads(data_json).get("nodes", []))
    except ValueError:
        node_count = -1
    ws_const = (f"const CWSSUFFIX = '&workspace={esc(workspace)}';"
                if workspace else "const CWSSUFFIX = '';")

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/docs/ARCHITECTURE_STATUS.md">
# Architecture Status (september 2026, na BIG #29)

Momentopname van wat het systeem IS. Voor flows, zie
`chat-agent-architecture.md`; voor richting, zie `ROADMAP.md`.

## Current system

- **Mycelium = brain/orchestrator.** Begrijpt, plant, vraagt
  toestemming, orkestreert. Redeneert nooit direct met hardware.
- **Coordinator = authority.** Enige partij die approvals, taken,
  leases en missies mag uitgeven of sluiten. Fail-closed bij twijfel.
- **INVENTory = world memory.** Persistent wereldmodel (SQLite WAL,
  13 tabellen). Alleen-lezen voor Mycelium via een GET-only
  loopback-bridge; geen gedeelde database, geen cross-imports.
- **Ollama / external models = advisors.** Geven tekstadvies op
  aangeleverde records. Advies is geen waarheid en start niets.
- **Desktop Agent = hands.** Enige partij die scherm/muis/toetsenbord
  aanraakt. Pull-based, outbound-only, voert uitsluitend goedgekeurde
  acties uit binnen een goedgekeurd plan.

## Begrippen (in volgorde van vertrouwen)

1. **FACT** — rij in INVENTory of lokale status (git, project).
   Bron van waarheid binnen zijn domein.
2. **OBSERVATION** — wat de agent zag (screenshot-metadata, status-
   output). Gebeurd, maar interpretatie is nog open.
3. **ADVICE** — AI-tekst op basis van context. Altijd
   `ai-generated`, nooit `human_verified`, start niets.
4. **PROPOSAL** — concreet voorstel (AdapterProposal, missie-stap,
   3D-artefact). Wacht op een mens.
5. **APPROVAL** — exact `YES` van een mens op een specifiek voorstel.
   Niet overdraagbaar, niet herbruikbaar, geen bypass.
6. **TASK** — goedgekeurde werkeenheid (CoordinatorTask, desktop-
   actie, missie-stap). Mag uitgevoerd worden zoals beschreven —
   en alleen zoals beschreven (binding-bewijs vereist).
7. **RESULT** — completed/failed/cancelled/blocked met timing, error
   en observatie-referentie. Nooit automatisch verified.
8. **VERIFICATION** — aparte, eersteklas stap (`verification.py`):
   onafhankelijke readback (inventory/graph/git) met
   passed/failed/inconclusive. Alleen passed telt als
   geverifieerd; approval is toestemming, verificatie is waarheid.
9. **WORLD MODEL UPDATE** — alleen na passed verificatie; anders
   geen FACT-promotie.

# Mycelium AI + INVENTory — Roadmap

Strategische roadmap na BIG #3 (september 2026). Geen microtask-lijst:
per fase staat wat af is, wat volgt, en wat bewust nog niet bestaat.
Principes uit `living-principles.md` blijven leidend: local-first,
kleinste bruikbare stap, geen cloud-afhankelijkheid voor de kern,
mens beslist.

Legenda: **DONE** werkt en is getest · **PARTIAL** werkt deels of
alleen als contract · **NEXT** eerstvolgende verticale slice ·
**FUTURE** later, nog geen ontwerpverplichting.

## PHASE A — BRAIN (DONE)

Kern van redeneren, coördineren en gecontroleerd uitvoeren.

- Core coordinator (nodes, queue, leases) — DONE (M7.4)
- INVENTory als wereldmodel (read-only bridge) — DONE (M5)
- Lokale AI via Ollama/Qwen — DONE (M8.1)
- Chat met conversaties, context en bronnen — DONE (BIG #1)
- Provider-abstractie (extern = fail-closed stub) — DONE (BIG #1)
- Approvals (exact YES, geen bypass) — DONE (M6.3/M8.4)
- CoordinatorTask / staging / promotion — DONE (M6.4/M7.1)
- Desktop-agent: contract, runtime, observe→act→observe — DONE (BIG #1)
- Standalone agent-proces met claim + revalidatie — DONE (BIG #2)
- Missies: plan, steps, executor, events, binding-bewijs — DONE (BIG #3)
- Testbasis: 515 Mycelium-tests, 178 INVENTory-tests — DONE

## PHASE B — UNDERSTANDING (DONE als BIG #4)

Zie `docs/semantic-world-model.md` en `docs/camera-architecture.md`.

- Semantische retrieval naast de substring-bridge (lokaal
  embedding-model via Ollama, lexicaal als fallback) — DONE
- Rijker wereldmodel-redeneren (hybride RRF + relatie-expansie
  als plan-context, provenance-bewust) — DONE
- Missie-sjablonen per projecttype (5 stuks, geen bypass) — DONE
- Uniforme wereldgrafiek-projectie (INVENTory + missie/agent
  overlay, geen tweede waarheid) — DONE
- Camera-foundation (abstractie, read-only detectie, observatie-
  contract, Insta360-fase 1) — DONE (start van PHASE D)
- Project-bewuste context (actief project als standaard-filter) —
  DONE (BIG #5: bounded pakketten + missie-context)
- `docs/first-node-blueprint.md` herstellen (README linkt erheen,
  bestand ontbreekt) — DONE (BIG #5)
- Testbasis: 629 Mycelium-tests — DONE

## PHASE C — CONTROLLED WRITES (DONE als BIG #5)

Zie `docs/controlled-writes-and-verification.md`.

- INVENTory-schrijfvoorstellen (operator-keurt-goed, provenance
  `ai-generated` → nooit automatisch `human_verified`) — DONE
  (object/project/idea + relaties; deletes en M3+-typen weigeren)
- Git-voorstellen en commits via expliciete capability (push/merge
  blijven verboden) — DONE (allow-list, geen push)
- Bestands-/projectwijzigingen via missie-stappen met diff-preview — PARTIAL
  (write-stap + git-voorstel; file-inhoud schrijven volgt later)
- Verificatie-stap als eersteklas burger (resultaat ≠ verified) — DONE
- Sterkere audit-trail (wie/wat/waarom per mutatie, exporteerbaar) — PARTIAL
  (before/after + write/result/verification-events; export volgt later)

## PHASE D — VISION (PARTIAL als BIG #6)

Zie `docs/vision-architecture.md` en `docs/camera-architecture.md`.

- Camera-ingestie (lokaal, tijdelijk, retentie-begrensd zoals screenshots) — DONE
  (snapshot-ingestie met hash/size-caps; webcam/stream als contract + stub)
- VLM-adapter (lokaal eerst; extern alleen via provider-beleid) — DONE
  (Ollama loopback, `VISION_MODEL`, geen downloads, geen cloud)
- Object-identificatie → voorstel → menselijke verificatie → INVENTory — DONE
  (generieke keten via BIG #5; onzekerheid behouden, 0.99 autoriseert niets)
- Beeld-provenance (bron, tijd, model, verificatiestatus) — DONE
- Echte Windows-capture-runtime — FUTURE (stub + vereisten gedocumenteerd)
- Echte Insta360-capture (webcam-driver of file-ingest) — FUTURE
  (foundation zonder gegokte SDK; expliciet unavailable)
- Live-stream-transport naar lokale consumer — FUTURE (alleen lifecycle)

## PHASE E — CREATION / 3D (PARTIAL als BIG #7)

Zie `docs/3d-architecture.md`. Contracten + test-pipeline bestaan;
echte hardware/transporten niet.

- Object → 3D-haalbaarheid → CAD/mesh (lokaal) — DONE
  (deterministische test-kubus, STL/OBJ-validatie, printability-
  advies; geen CAD-kernel, geen downloads)
- Slicer/G-code als preview-only, nooit directe printeraansturing — DONE
  (test-slicer met never-for-printers-markering, G-code-safety-

- Fysieke executie via dubbele approval (plan-YES + fysieke YES),
  simulated/unavailable adapters, cancel-grens (geen e-stop-claim) — DONE
- Menselijke goedkeuring vóór elk fysiek artefact — DONE
  (printer.execute-voorstel + fingerprint + safety + revalidatie)
- Fysieke verificatie-terugkoppeling naar INVENTory — DONE
  (telemetrie + camera, beide vereist; INVENTory-update via BIG #5)
- Echte printertransport/vendorintegratie — FUTURE
- Echte slicer-runtime — FUTURE

- Interface-abstractie (tekst echt, voice als architectuur,

## PHASE M — AUTONOMOUS MISSION LOOP (DONE als BIG #21)

Zie `docs/autonomous-mission-loop.md`. Eén veilige

vindt nooit stappen uit, voert nooit fysiek uit

## PHASE N — DESKTOP AGENT HANDS (DONE als BIG #22)

attempt-bounds (max 3) en lazy expiry; mission loop
gaat na desktop-resultaat automatisch verder. Echte
Windows-backend (ctypes, geen deps) bewezen over live
localhost HTTP met zero desktop disturbance
(screenshot-reads alleen). Fysiek onmogelijk via deze
keten; geen shell/RCE/cloud. Testbasis: 961
Mycelium-tests + 9-checks live hands-smoke.

<file path="mycelium-ai-main/coordinator/app/schemas.py">
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field

from .adapter_contracts import AdapterProposal
from .approval import ApprovalResult
from .ollama_advisor import AdviceResponse


NodeTier = Literal["seed", "worker", "core"]


class NodeRegistration(BaseModel):
    node_id: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=80, pattern=r"^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$")
    hostname: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    tier: NodeTier = "seed"
    capabilities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=50)
    cpu_cores: int = Field(default=1, ge=1, le=512)
    memory_mb: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
    energy_source: str = Field(default="unknown", max_length=40)
    display_name: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    models: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                         max_length=20)
    executors: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    resources: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    locality_zone: str = Field(default="local_network", min_length=1,
                               max_length=20)
    node_token: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=8,
                                   max_length=256)
    operator_key: str = Field(default="", max_length=256)
    coordinator_capable: bool = False


class OperatorBody(BaseModel):
    """Operator authorization for identity administration
    (enable/disable). Key lives in local env, never in DB."""

    operator_key: str = Field(default="", max_length=256)


class NodeRotateBody(BaseModel):
    """Bind or rotate a node token. Bound identities need
    the current token; legacy identities need the operator
    key. The new token must be non-trivial."""

    current_token: str = Field(default="", max_length=256)
    new_token: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=256)
    operator_key: str = Field(default="", max_length=256)


class NodeResponse(NodeRegistration):
    last_seen: datetime
    status: str


class Heartbeat(BaseModel):
    cpu_load_percent: float | None = Field(default=None, ge=0, le=100)
    free_memory_mb: int | None = Field(default=None, ge=0)
    available: bool = True
    node_token: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=8,
                                   max_length=256)
    capabilities: list[str] | None = Field(default=None,
                                           max_length=50)
    models: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = Field(default=None,
                                                max_length=20)
    executors: list[str] | None = Field(default=None, max_length=20)
    resources: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    # BIG #39 Hardware Reality Layer: telemetry and hardware inventory
    telemetry: dict[str, Any] | None = Field(default=None)
    hardware: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = Field(default=None,
                                                   max_length=50)
    compute_capabilities: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = Field(default=None,
                                                               max_length=20)
    energy_state: dict[str, Any] | None = Field(default=None)
    # VERTICAL SLICE 1: read-only display report (node-state,
    # validated by check_displays; unknown values stay null).
    displays: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = Field(default=None,
                                                  max_length=16)


class PresenceTriageBody(BaseModel):
    """Operator triage on one attention item (BIG #40).

    SEEN/DEFERRED only; the item must be live right now or the
    call refuses. DEFER performs nothing — it only hides the
    item from the urgent bands.
    """

    item_id: str = Field(min_length=5, max_length=160)
    decided_by: str = Field(default="jelles", min_length=1,
                            max_length=80)


class PresenceNotifyBody(BaseModel):
    """Explicit presence fan-out (BIG #40). Deduplicated
    IN_APP delivery; WEB_PUSH never involved."""

    limit: int = Field(default=5, ge=1, le=10)


class MeshDelegateBody(BaseModel):
    """One node→coordinator→node delegation (BIG #41).

    Closed task kind + explicit capability + optional pinned
    target. Dispatch creates a regular queued task the target
    must still pull/claim; nothing is pushed, nothing is
    executed here.
    """

    requesting_node: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    node_token: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=8,
                                   max_length=256)
    target_node: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1,
                                    max_length=80)
    task_kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    capability: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    timeout_seconds: int = Field(default=60, ge=5, le=300)
    reason: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)
    priority: int = Field(default=0, ge=-10, le=10)


class MeshPreviewBody(BaseModel):
    """Dry-run delegation check (BIG #41). Validates and
    explains; creates nothing."""

    requesting_node: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    target_node: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1,
                                    max_length=80)
    task_kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    capability: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    timeout_seconds: int = Field(default=60, ge=5, le=300)
    reason: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)


class HardwareLinkBody(BaseModel):
    """Propose a human hardware link (BIG #42). Anyone may
    propose; the row always starts as PROPOSED. Verification
    is a separate operator-key call."""

    human_ref: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    node_id: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    device_ref: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    device_kind: str = Field(default="", max_length=60)
    capability: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    evidence: str = Field(default="", max_length=2000)


class HardwareVerifyBody(BaseModel):
    """Verify a PROPOSED link (BIG #42). Operator key required:
    a node token can never verify, so devices cannot
    self-verify."""

    verified_by: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    operator_key: str = Field(default="", max_length=256)


class HardwareRevokeBody(BaseModel):
    """Revoke a link (BIG #42). Operator key required; REVOKED
    sticks and never counts as verified."""

    revoked_by: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=120)
    reason: str = Field(default="", max_length=500)
    operator_key: str = Field(default="", max_length=256)


class FinanceRecordBody(BaseModel):
    """Create a finance record (BIG #42). Explicit figures only;
    omit amount_minor to keep the amount UNKNOWN."""

    kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=16)
    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    amount_minor: int | None = Field(default=None)
    currency: str = Field(default="EUR", max_length=3)
    project_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    recorded_by: str = Field(default="operator", max_length=120)


class FinanceStatusBody(BaseModel):
    """Move a finance record between DRAFT/CONFIRMED/ARCHIVED."""

    status: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=16)


class EnergyRecordBody(BaseModel):
    """Record one energy observation (BIG #42). Omit value to
    keep the measurement UNKNOWN — never invented."""

    source: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=16)
    kind: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=16)
    value: float | None = Field(default=None)
    unit: str = Field(default="", max_length=24)
    project_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    device_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=120)
    note: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    recorded_by: str = Field(default="operator", max_length=120)


class QuestCreateBody(BaseModel):
    """Define a quest trail (BIG #42). Steps reference real
    records only; all state derives on read."""

    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                        max_length=24)


class WorkflowDispatchBody(BaseModel):
    """Dispatch a bounded multi-node workflow (BIG #42). Each
    step is one pinned mesh delegation through the existing
    task queue; the coordinator stays authoritative, nodes
    stay pull-based."""

    requesting_node: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    node_token: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=8,
                                   max_length=256)
    mission_id: str = Field(default="", max_length=80)
    steps: list[dict[str, Any]] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                        max_length=6)


class CampaignCreateBody(BaseModel):
    """Define a quest campaign (BIG #43). Quest ids must
    reference real quests; all progress derives on read. No
    XP, no rewards — a view over real work."""

    title: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=200)
    description: str = Field(default="", max_length=1000)
    quest_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                 max_length=12)


class TaskCreate(BaseModel):
    kind: str = Field(min_length=2, max_length=80, pattern=r"^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+$")
    payload: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    required_capabilities: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, max_length=20)
    preferred_tier: NodeTier | None = None
    priority: int = Field(default=0, ge=-10, le=10)
    requirements: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    mission_id: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=80)


class TaskAssignBody(BaseModel):
    """Explicit (re-)assignment of one queued task. node_id empty
    means auto-route; a given node_id must prove eligible."""

    node_id: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=3,
                                max_length=80)
    policy: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class TaskRouteBody(BaseModel):
    """Dry-run routing: requirements + policy, no assignment."""

    requirements: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    policy: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ClaimedTask(BaseModel):
    id: int
    kind: str
    payload: dict[str, Any]
    required_capabilities: list[str]
    mission_id: str | None = None


class TaskResult(BaseModel):
    success: bool = True
    result: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    error: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)


class AdviseRequest(BaseModel):
    q: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    question: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=500)
    type: str | None = None
    mode: str = Field(default="hybrid", min_length=1, max_length=20)


class AdviseResponse(AdviceResponse):
    """Advice plus an optional validated AI proposal (M8.3).

    The proposal is a best-effort enrichment for the operator: either a
    validated AdapterProposal (ai-generated, unverified, approval still
    required) or None when the advice carries no usable proposal block.
    Never approved, staged, queued or dispatched here.
    """

    proposal: AdapterProposal | None = None
    retrieval_mode: str = "lexical"


class DecideApprovalBody(BaseModel):
    """Explicit operator decision on one full proposal (M8.4).

    The complete proposal travels with the decision because M8.3 proposals
    are never stored server-side: binding is verified on content, never on
    a bare proposal_id. Only an exact "YES" approves; anything else denies.
    """

    proposal: AdapterProposal
    response: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)
    decided_by: str = Field(default="human", min_length=1, max_length=80)


class TaskFromProposalBody(BaseModel):
    """Explicit operator trigger from approval to task (M8.5).

    Stateless like M8.4: the full proposal, its ApprovalResult and the
    fingerprint recorded at approval time travel together. The server
    revalidates everything through the existing M6.4 conversion only.
    The result is a task representation with status "approved" — never
    queued, staged, promoted or dispatched here.
    """

    proposal: AdapterProposal
    approval: ApprovalResult
    approved_fingerprint: str = Field(min_length=64, max_length=64)
    task_id: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=3, max_length=80)
    task_type: str = Field(default="other", min_length=1, max_length=40)
    input: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class ChatRequest(BaseModel):
    """One chat turn: message plus optional conversation/project/provider."""

    conversation_id: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=3,
                                        max_length=80)
    message: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=4000)
    project_ref: str = Field(default="", max_length=200)
    provider: str = Field(default="ollama", min_length=1, max_length=40)
    mode: str = Field(default="hybrid", min_length=1, max_length=20)
    observation_ids: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list,
                                       max_length=3)
    input_type: str = Field(default="text", min_length=1,
                            max_length=20)
